kikuyu: Hapo mwanzo Mungu aliumba mbingu na dunia.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

kikuyu: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa haina umbo, tena ilikuwa tupu. Giza lilikuwa juu ya uso wa vilindi vya maji, naye Roho wa Mungu alikuwa ametulia juu ya maji.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nuru,” nayo nuru ikawepo.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

kikuyu: Mungu akaona ya kuwa nuru ni njema, ndipo Mungu akatenganisha nuru na giza.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

kikuyu: Mungu akaiita nuru “mchana,” na giza akaliita “usiku.” Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya kwanza.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo nafasi kati ya maji igawe maji na maji.”
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mungu akafanya nafasi, akatenganisha maji yaliyo chini ya hiyo nafasi na maji yaliyo juu yake. Ikawa hivyo.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

kikuyu: Mungu akaiita hiyo nafasi “anga.” Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya pili.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Maji yaliyopo chini ya anga na yakusanyike mahali pamoja, pawepo na nchi kavu.” Ikawa hivyo.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Mungu akaiita nchi kavu “ardhi,” nalo lile kusanyiko la maji akaliita “bahari.” Mungu akaona kuwa ni vyema.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Kisha Mungu akasema, “Ardhi na itoe mimea: miche itoayo mbegu, miti juu ya nchi itoayo matunda yenye mbegu ndani yake, kila mmea kulingana na aina zake mbalimbali.” Ikawa hivyo.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Ardhi ikachipua mimea: Mimea itoayo mbegu kulingana na aina zake, na miti itoayo matunda yenye mbegu kulingana na aina zake. Mungu akaona ya kuwa hili ni jema.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tatu.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Iwepo mianga kwenye nafasi ya anga ili itenganishe usiku na mchana, nayo iwe alama ya kutambulisha majira mbalimbali, siku na miaka,
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

kikuyu: nayo iwe mianga kwenye nafasi ya anga ya kutia nuru juu ya dunia.” Ikawa hivyo.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Mungu akafanya mianga miwili mikubwa: mwanga mkubwa utawale mchana, na mwanga mdogo utawale usiku. Pia Mungu akafanya nyota.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

kikuyu: Mungu akaiweka katika nafasi ya anga iangaze dunia,
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

kikuyu: itawale usiku na mchana, na ikatenganishe nuru na giza. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya nne.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Kuwepo na viumbe hai tele kwenye maji, nao ndege waruke juu ya dunia katika nafasi ya anga.”
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mungu akaumba viumbe wakubwa wa baharini na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho majini kulingana na aina zake, na kila ndege mwenye mabawa kulingana na aina yake. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Mungu akavibariki, akasema, “Zaeni mwongezeke, mkayajaze maji ya bahari, nao ndege waongezeke katika dunia.”
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya tano.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Ardhi na itoe viumbe hai kulingana na aina zake: wanyama wa kufugwa, viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini na wanyama pori, kila mnyama kulingana na aina yake.” Ikawa hivyo.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Mungu akafanya wanyama pori kulingana na aina zake, wanyama wa kufugwa kulingana na aina zake, na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi kulingana na aina zake. Mungu akaona kuwa hili ni jema.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ndipo Mungu akasema, “Tufanye mtu kwa mfano wetu, kwa sura yetu, wakatawale juu ya samaki wa baharini na ndege wa angani, juu ya mifugo, juu ya dunia yote, na juu ya viumbe wote watambaao juu ya nchi.”
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamuumba mtu kwa mfano wake mwenyewe, kwa mfano wa Mungu alimuumba; mwanaume na mwanamke aliwaumba.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

kikuyu: Mungu akawabariki na akawaambia, “Zaeni na mkaongezeke, mkaijaze tena dunia na kuitiisha. Mkatawale samaki wa baharini, ndege wa angani, na kila kiumbe hai kiendacho juu ya ardhi.”
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kisha Mungu akasema, “Nimewapa kila mche utoao mbegu juu ya uso wa dunia yote, na kila mti wenye matunda yenye mbegu ndani yake. Vitakuwa chakula chenu.
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

kikuyu: Nao wanyama wote wa dunia, ndege wote wa angani, na viumbe vyote viendavyo juu ya ardhi: yaani kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai, ninawapa kila mche wa kijani kuwa chakula.” Ikawa hivyo.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Mungu akaona vyote alivyoumba, na tazama, ilikuwa vizuri sana. Ikawa jioni, ikawa asubuhi, siku ya sita.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo mbingu na dunia zikakamilika, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.
english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya saba Mungu alikuwa amekamilisha kazi aliyokuwa akiifanya, hivyo siku ya saba akapumzika kutoka kazi zake zote.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

kikuyu: Mungu akaibariki siku ya saba akaifanya takatifu, kwa sababu katika siku hiyo alipumzika kutoka kazi zote za kuumba alizokuwa amefanya.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo maelezo ya mbingu na dunia wakati zilipoumbwa. Bwana Mungu alipoziumba mbingu na dunia,
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: hapakuwepo na mche wa shambani uliokuwa umejitokeza ardhini, wala hapakuwepo na mmea wa shamba uliokuwa umeota, kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu alikuwa hajanyeshea mvua juu ya nchi, na hapakuwepo mtu wa kuilima ardhi,
english: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

kikuyu: lakini umande ulitokeza kutoka ardhini na kunyesha uso wote wa nchi:
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu alimuumba mtu kutoka mavumbi ya ardhi, akampulizia pumzi ya uhai puani mwake, naye mtu akawa kiumbe hai.
english: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

kikuyu: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa ameotesha bustani upande wa mashariki, katika Edeni, huko akamweka huyo mtu aliyemuumba.
english: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu akafanya aina zote za miti ziote kutoka ardhini, miti yenye kupendeza macho na mizuri kwa chakula. Katikati ya bustani ulikuwepo mti wa uzima na mti wa kujua mema na mabaya.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

kikuyu: Mto wa kunyeshea bustani ulitiririka toka Edeni, kuanzia hapa ukagawanyika kuwa mito minne.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

kikuyu: Mto wa kwanza uliitwa Pishoni, nao huzunguka nchi yote ya Havila ambako kuna dhahabu.
english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

kikuyu: (Dhahabu ya nchi hiyo ni nzuri, bedola na vito shohamu pia hupatikana huko.)
english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

kikuyu: Jina la mto wa pili ni Gihoni, ambao huzunguka nchi yote ya Kushi.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

kikuyu: Jina la mto wa tatu ni Tigrisi, unaopita mashariki ya Ashuru. Mto wa nne ni Frati.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu akamchukua huyo mtu, akamweka kwenye Bustani ya Edeni ailime na kuitunza.
english: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu akamwagiza huyo mtu, akamwambia, “Uko huru kula matunda ya mti wowote katika bustani,
english: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

kikuyu: lakini kamwe usile matunda ya mti wa kujua mema na mabaya, kwa maana siku utakapokula matunda yake, hakika utakufa.”
english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu akasema, “Si vyema huyu mtu awe peke yake. Nitamfanyia msaidizi wa kumfaa.”
english: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

kikuyu: Basi Bwana Mungu alikuwa amefanyiza kutoka ardhi wanyama wote wa porini na ndege wote wa angani. Akawaleta kwa huyu mtu aone atawaitaje, nalo jina lolote alilokiita kila kiumbe hai, likawa ndilo jina lake.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

kikuyu: Hivyo Adamu akawapa majina wanyama wote wa kufugwa, ndege wa angani, na wanyama wote wa porini. Lakini kwa Adamu hakupatikana msaidizi wa kumfaa.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

kikuyu: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamfanya Adamu kulala usingizi mzito, naye alipokuwa amelala akachukua moja ya mbavu zake, akapafunika mahali pale kwa nyama.
english: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana Mungu akamfanya mwanamke kutoka kwenye ule ubavu aliouchukua kutoka kwa huyo mwanaume, akamleta huyo mwanamke kwa huyo mwanaume.
english: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

kikuyu: Huyo mwanaume akasema, “Huyu sasa ni mfupa wa mifupa yangu na nyama ya nyama yangu, ataitwa ‘mwanamke,’ kwa kuwa alitolewa katika mwanaume.”
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake na kuambatana na mkewe, nao watakuwa mwili mmoja.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

kikuyu: Adamu na mkewe wote wawili walikuwa uchi, wala hawakuona aibu.
english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

kikuyu: Basi nyoka alikuwa mwerevu kuliko wanyama wote wa porini ambao Bwana Mungu aliwafanya. Nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Ati kweli Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile matunda ya mti wowote wa bustanini’?”
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

kikuyu: Mwanamke akamjibu nyoka, “Tunaweza kula matunda ya miti iliyoko bustanini,
english: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

kikuyu: lakini Mungu alisema, ‘Kamwe msile tunda la mti ulio katikati ya bustani, wala kuugusa, la sivyo mtakufa.’ ”
english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

kikuyu: Lakini nyoka akamwambia mwanamke, “Hakika hamtakufa.
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mungu anajua ya kuwa wakati mtakapoyala, macho yenu yatafumbuliwa, nanyi mtakuwa kama Mungu, mkijua mema na mabaya.”
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

kikuyu: Mwanamke alipoona ya kuwa tunda la mti huo lilikuwa zuri kwa chakula na la kupendeza macho, tena linatamanika kwa kujipatia hekima, basi akachuma katika matunda yake, akala, pia akampa mumewe, aliyekuwa pamoja naye, naye akala.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

kikuyu: Ndipo macho yao wote wawili yakafumbuliwa, wakajiona kwamba walikuwa uchi; hivyo wakashona majani ya mtini, wakajifunika.
english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

kikuyu: Ndipo yule mwanaume na mkewe, waliposikia sauti ya Bwana Mungu alipokuwa akitembea bustanini jioni, wakajificha kutoka mbele za Bwana Mungu katikati ya miti ya bustani.
english: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana Mungu akamwita Adamu, “Uko wapi?”
english: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

kikuyu: Naye akajibu, “Nilikusikia katika bustani nikaogopa kwa sababu nilikuwa uchi, hivyo nikajificha.”
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

kikuyu: Mungu akamuuliza, “Ni nani aliyekuambia ya kuwa ulikuwa uchi? Je, umekula matunda ya mti niliokuamuru usile?”
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

kikuyu: Adamu akasema, “Huyu mwanamke uliyenipa awe pamoja nami alinipa sehemu ya tunda kutoka kwenye huo mti, nami nikala.”
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana Mungu akamuuliza mwanamke, “Ni nini hili ambalo umelifanya?” Mwanamke akajibu, “Nyoka alinidanganya, nami nikala.”
english: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamwambia nyoka, “Kwa kuwa umefanya hili, “Umelaaniwa kuliko wanyama wote wa kufugwa na wa porini! Utatambaa kwa tumbo lako na kula mavumbi siku zote za maisha yako.
english: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Nami nitaweka uadui kati yako na huyo mwanamke, na kati ya uzao wako na wake, yeye atakuponda kichwa, nawe utamuuma kisigino.”
english: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

kikuyu: Kwa mwanamke akasema, “Nitakuzidishia sana utungu wakati wa kuzaa kwako; kwa utungu utazaa watoto. Tamaa yako itakuwa kwa mumeo naye atakutawala.”
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

kikuyu: Kwa Adamu akasema, “Kwa sababu umemsikiliza mke wako na ukala kutoka kwenye mti niliokuamuru, ‘Msile tunda lake,’ “Ardhi imelaaniwa kwa sababu yako, kwa kazi ngumu utakula chakula kitokacho humo siku zote za maisha yako.
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Itazaa miiba na mibaruti kwa ajili yako, nawe utakula mimea ya shambani.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

kikuyu: Kwa jasho la uso wako utakula chakula chako hadi utakaporudi ardhini, kwa kuwa ulitwaliwa kutoka humo, kwa kuwa wewe u mavumbi na mavumbini wewe utarudi.”
english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

kikuyu: Adamu akamwita mkewe Eva, kwa kuwa atakuwa mama wa wote walio hai.
english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu akawatengenezea Adamu na mkewe mavazi ya ngozi, akawavika.
english: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana Mungu akasema, “Sasa mtu huyu amekuwa kama mmoja wetu, kwa kujua mema na mabaya. Sharti asiruhusiwe kunyoosha mkono wake na kuchuma pia kutoka mti wa uzima akala, naye akaishi milele.”
english: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

kikuyu: Hivyo Bwana Mungu akamfukuzia mbali kutoka Bustani ya Edeni, akalime ardhi ambamo alitolewa.
english: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumfukuzia mbali Adamu, Mungu akaweka makerubi mashariki ya Bustani ya Edeni, pamoja na upanga wa moto ukimulika huku na huko kulinda njia ya kuuendea mti wa uzima.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

kikuyu: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mkewe Eva, naye akapata mimba, akamzaa Kaini. Eva akasema, “Kwa msaada wa Bwana nimemzaa mwanaume.”
english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

kikuyu: Baadaye akamzaa Abeli ndugu yake. Basi Abeli akawa mfugaji, na Kaini akawa mkulima.
english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

kikuyu: Baada ya muda Kaini akaleta baadhi ya mazao ya shamba kama sadaka kwa Bwana.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

kikuyu: Lakini Abeli akaleta fungu nono kutoka baadhi ya wazaliwa wa kwanza wa mifugo yake. Bwana akamkubali Abeli pamoja na sadaka yake,
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

kikuyu: lakini Mungu hakumkubali Kaini pamoja na sadaka yake. Kwa hiyo Kaini akakasirika sana, uso wake ukawa na huzuni.
english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Kaini, “Kwa nini umekasirika? Kwa nini uso wako una huzuni?
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

kikuyu: Ukifanya lililo sawa, je, hutakubalika? Lakini usipofanya lililo sawa, dhambi inakuvizia mlangoni mwako, inakutamani wewe, lakini inakupasa uishinde.”
english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

kikuyu: Basi Kaini akamwambia ndugu yake Abeli, “Twende shambani.” Walipokuwa shambani, Kaini akamshambulia Abeli ndugu yake, akamuua.
english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamuuliza Kaini, “Ndugu yako Abeli yuko wapi?” Akamjibu, “Sijui, je, mimi ni mlinzi wa ndugu yangu?”
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

kikuyu: Bwana akasema, “Umefanya nini? Sikiliza! Damu ya ndugu yako inanililia mimi kutoka ardhini.
english: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

kikuyu: Sasa umelaaniwa na umehamishwa kutoka ardhi, ambayo imefungua kinywa chake na kupokea damu ya ndugu yako kutoka mkononi mwako.
english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

kikuyu: Utakapoilima ardhi, haitakupa tena mazao yake. Utakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga duniani asiye na utulivu.”
english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kaini akamwambia Bwana, “Adhabu yangu ni zaidi ya niwezavyo kustahimili.
english: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

kikuyu: Leo unanifukuza kutoka nchi, nami nitafichwa mbali na uwepo wako. Nitakuwa mtu wa kutangatanga asiyetulia duniani na yeyote anionaye ataniua.”
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana akamwambia, “La sivyo, ikiwa mtu yeyote atamuua Kaini atalipizwa kisasi mara saba zaidi.” Kisha Bwana akamwekea Kaini alama ili mtu yeyote ambaye angemwona asimuue.
english: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Kaini akaondoka mbele za Bwana akaenda kuishi katika nchi ya Nodi, iliyoko mashariki ya Edeni.
english: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

kikuyu: Kaini akakutana kimwili na mkewe, naye akapata mimba na akamzaa Enoki. Wakati huo Kaini alikuwa anajenga mji, akauita Enoki jina la mtoto wake.
english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

kikuyu: Enoki akamzaa Iradi, Iradi akamzaa Mehuyaeli, Mehuyaeli akamzaa Methushaeli, na Methushaeli akamzaa Lameki.
english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Lameki alioa wanawake wawili, mmoja aliitwa Ada, na mwingine Sila.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

kikuyu: Ada akamzaa Yabali ambaye ni baba wa wale walioishi katika mahema na kufuga wanyama.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

kikuyu: Kaka yake aliitwa Yubali, aliyekuwa baba wa wote wapigao zeze na filimbi.
english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

kikuyu: Pia Sila alikuwa na mtoto wa kiume aliyeitwa Tubali-Kaini ambaye alifua vifaa vya aina mbalimbali vya shaba na chuma. Naama alikuwa dada wa Tubali-Kaini.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

kikuyu: Lameki akawaambia wake zake, “Ada na Sila nisikilizeni mimi; wake wa Lameki sikieni maneno yangu. Nimemuua mtu kwa kunijeruhi, kijana mdogo kwa kuniumiza.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

kikuyu: Kama Kaini atalipizwa kisasi mara saba, basi Lameki itakuwa mara sabini na saba.”
english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

kikuyu: Adamu akakutana kimwili na mke wake tena, akamzaa mwana, akamwita Sethi, akisema, “Mungu amenijalia mwana mwingine badala ya Abeli, kwa kuwa Kaini alimuua.”
english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

kikuyu: Naye Sethi akamzaa mwana, akamwita Enoshi. Wakati huo watu wakaanza kuliitia jina la Bwana.
english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Hii ni orodha iliyoandikwa ya vizazi vya Adamu. Wakati Mungu alipomuumba Adamu, alimfanya kwa sura ya Mungu.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

kikuyu: Aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke, akawabariki. Walipokwisha kuumbwa, akawaita “mwanadamu.”
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

kikuyu: Adamu alipokuwa ameishi miaka 130, alikuwa na mwana aliyekuwa na sura yake, mwenye kufanana naye. Akamwita Sethi.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

kikuyu: Baada ya Sethi kuzaliwa, Adamu aliishi miaka 800, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Adamu aliishi jumla ya miaka 930, ndipo akafa.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

kikuyu: Sethi alipokuwa ameishi miaka 105, akamzaa Enoshi.
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Enoshi, Sethi aliishi miaka 807, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Sethi aliishi jumla ya miaka 912, ndipo akafa.
english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

kikuyu: Enoshi alipokuwa ameishi miaka tisini, akamzaa Kenani.
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Kenani, Enoshi aliishi miaka 815, naye alikuwa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Enoshi aliishi jumla ya miaka 905, ndipo akafa.
english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Kenani alipokuwa ameishi miaka sabini, akamzaa Mahalaleli.
english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Mahalaleli, Kenani aliishi miaka 840, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

kikuyu: Kenani aliishi jumla ya miaka 910, ndipo akafa.
english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

kikuyu: Mahalaleli alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Yaredi.
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Yaredi, Mahalaleli aliishi miaka 830, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Mahalaleli aliishi jumla ya miaka 895, ndipo akafa.
english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Yaredi alipokuwa ameishi miaka 162, akamzaa Enoki.
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Enoki, Yaredi aliishi miaka 800, naye akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Yaredi aliishi jumla ya miaka 962, ndipo akafa.
english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

kikuyu: Enoki alipokuwa ameishi miaka sitini na mitano, akamzaa Methusela.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Methusela, Enoki alitembea na Mungu miaka 300, na akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Enoki aliishi jumla ya miaka 365.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

kikuyu: Enoki akatembea na Mungu, kisha akatoweka, kwa sababu Mungu alimchukua.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

kikuyu: Methusela alipokuwa ameishi miaka 187, akamzaa Lameki.
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Lameki, Methusela aliishi miaka 782, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Methusela aliishi jumla ya miaka 969, ndipo akafa.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

kikuyu: Lameki alipokuwa ameishi miaka 182, alimzaa mwana.
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

kikuyu: Akamwita jina lake Noa, akasema, “Yeye ndiye atakayetufariji katika kazi na maumivu makali ya mikono yetu yaliyosababishwa na ardhi iliyolaaniwa na Bwana.”
english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

kikuyu: Baada ya Noa kuzaliwa, Lameki aliishi miaka 595, akawa na watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Lameki aliishi jumla ya miaka 777, ndipo akafa.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

kikuyu: Baada ya Noa kuishi miaka 500, aliwazaa Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Watu walipoanza kuongezeka idadi katika uso wa dunia na watoto wa kike wakazaliwa kwao,
english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

kikuyu: wana wa Mungu wakawaona kuwa hao binti za wanadamu walikuwa wazuri wa sura, wakaoa yeyote miongoni mwao waliyemchagua.
english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana akasema, “Roho yangu haitashindana na mwanadamu milele, kwa kuwa yeye ni wa kufa, siku zake zitakuwa miaka 120.”
english: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

kikuyu: Wanefili walikuwako duniani siku hizo, na baadaye, hao wana wa Mungu walipoingia kwa binti za wanadamu na kuzaa nao. Wanefili walikuwa mashujaa na watu waliojulikana wa zamani hizo.
english: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

kikuyu: Bwana akaona jinsi uovu wa mwanadamu ulivyokuwa mkubwa duniani, na ya kuwa kila mwelekeo wa mawazo ya moyo wake wakati wote ulikuwa mbaya tu.
english: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

kikuyu: Bwana akasikitika kwamba alimuumba mwanadamu duniani, moyo wa Mungu ukajaa masikitiko.
english: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Bwana akasema, “Nitamfutilia mbali mwanadamu niliyemuumba kutoka kwenye uso wa dunia, wanadamu na wanyama, pamoja na viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege wa angani. Kwa maana nasikitika kuwaumba.”
english: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

kikuyu: Lakini Noa akapata kibali machoni pa Bwana.
english: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Noa. Noa alikuwa mtu wa haki, na mkamilifu miongoni mwa watu wa wakati wake, tena alitembea na Mungu.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

kikuyu: Noa alikuwa na wana watatu: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Wakati huu dunia ilikuwa imejaa uharibifu na ukatili machoni pa Mungu.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

kikuyu: Mungu akaona jinsi dunia ilivyoharibika, kwa maana watu wote duniani walikuwa wameharibu njia zao.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Nitawaangamiza watu wote, kwa kuwa dunia imejaa ukatili kwa sababu yao. Hakika mimi nitaangamiza watu pamoja na dunia.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo jitengenezee safina kubwa kwa mbao za mvinje, tengeneza vyumba ndani yake na uipake lami ndani na nje.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo utakavyoitengeneza: Safina iwe na urefu wa dhiraa 300, upana wake dhiraa hamsini na kimo chake dhiraa thelathini.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

kikuyu: Itengenezee paa na umalizie safina kwa kuacha nafasi ya dhiraa moja juu. Weka mlango ubavuni mwa safina, na uifanye ya ghorofa ya chini, ya kati na ya juu.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

kikuyu: Nitaleta gharika ya maji juu ya nchi ili kuangamiza uhai wote chini ya mbingu, kila kiumbe chenye pumzi ya uhai ndani yake. Kila kitu juu ya nchi kitaangamia.
english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.

kikuyu: Lakini Mimi nitaweka Agano langu na wewe, nawe utaingia ndani ya Safina, wewe pamoja na mke wako, wanao na wake zao.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Utaingiza ndani ya Safina kila aina ya kiumbe hai wawili wawili, wa kiume na wa kike, ili kuwahifadhi hai pamoja na wewe.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

kikuyu: Wawili wa kila aina ya ndege, wa kila aina ya mnyama na wa kila aina ya kitambaacho ardhini watakuja kwako ili wahifadhiwe hai.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

kikuyu: Utachukua kila aina ya chakula kitakacholiwa, na ukiweke akiba kama chakula kwa ajili yako na yao.”
english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

kikuyu: Noa akafanya kila kitu kama vile Mungu alivyomwamuru.
english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Noa, “Ingia katika safina wewe na jamaa yako yote, kwa sababu katika kizazi hiki nimeona ya kuwa wewe ni mwenye haki.
english: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

kikuyu: Uchukue wanyama saba walio safi wa kila aina, wa kiume na wa kike, na wanyama wawili wawili wa kila aina walio najisi wa kiume na wa kike.
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

kikuyu: Pia uchukue ndege saba walio safi wa kila aina, wa kiume na wa kike, ili kuhifadhi aina zao mbalimbali katika dunia yote.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Siku saba kuanzia sasa nitaleta mvua juu ya nchi kwa siku arobaini usiku na mchana, nami nitafutilia mbali kutoka uso wa nchi kila kiumbe hai nilichokiumba.”
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

kikuyu: Noa akafanya yote kama Bwana alivyomwamuru.
english: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: Noa alikuwa na miaka 600 gharika ilipokuja juu ya dunia.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Noa na mkewe na wanawe na wake zao wakaingia katika safina ili waepuke ile gharika.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

kikuyu: Jozi ya wanyama walio safi na walio najisi, ndege na viumbe vitambaavyo,
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

kikuyu: wa kiume na wa kike, walikuja kwa Noa wakaingia katika safina kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

kikuyu: Baada ya siku saba, maji ya gharika yakaja juu ya dunia.
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya kumi na saba ya mwezi wa pili mwaka wa 600 wa kuishi kwake Noa, siku hiyo ndipo chemchemi zote hata zilizo chini sana ya ardhi zilibubujika kwa nguvu, na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakafunguliwa.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

kikuyu: Mvua ikanyesha juu ya nchi siku arobaini usiku na mchana.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Siku hiyo Noa, na mkewe, na wanawe Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi pamoja na wake zao wakaingia katika ile safina.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

kikuyu: Nao walikuwa pamoja na kila mnyama wa mwituni kufuatana na aina yake, wanyama wote wafugwao kufuatana na aina zao, kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi kwa aina yake, na kila ndege kufuatana na aina yake, naam kila kiumbe chenye mabawa.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

kikuyu: Viumbe vyote vyenye pumzi ya uhai ndani yake vikaja kwa Noa viwili viwili, vikaingia katika safina.
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

kikuyu: Wanyama walioingia katika safina walikuwa wa kiume na wa kike, wa kila kiumbe chenye uhai kama Mungu alivyomwamuru Noa, ndipo Bwana akamfungia ndani.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.

kikuyu: Kwa siku arobaini mafuriko yaliendelea kujaa duniani na maji yalivyozidi kuongezeka, yaliinua safina juu sana kutoka kwenye uso wa nchi.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

kikuyu: Maji yakajaa na kuongezeka sana juu ya nchi, na safina ikaelea juu ya uso wa maji.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Maji yakazidi kujaa juu ya nchi, yakaifunika milima yote mirefu chini ya mbingu yote.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

kikuyu: Maji yakaendelea kujaa yakaifunika milima kwa kina cha zaidi ya dhiraa kumi na tano.
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

kikuyu: Kila kiumbe hai kitambaacho juu ya nchi kikaangamia: Ndege, wanyama wa kufugwa, wanyama pori, viumbe vyote juu ya nchi na wanadamu wote.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

kikuyu: Kila kiumbe juu ya nchi kavu chenye pumzi ya uhai kikafa.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

kikuyu: Kila kitu chenye uhai juu ya uso wa nchi kilifutiliwa mbali, watu, wanyama, viumbe vitambaavyo na ndege warukao angani wakafutiliwa mbali toka duniani. Waliobaki ni Noa peke yake na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye ndani ya safina.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

kikuyu: Maji yakaifunika dunia kwa siku 150.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

kikuyu: Mungu akamkumbuka Noa na wanyama wote wa porini na wa kufugwa waliokuwa naye ndani ya safina, akatuma upepo ukavuma katika dunia, nayo maji yakaondoka.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

kikuyu: Zile chemchemi zilizo chini sana ya ardhi pamoja na malango ya mafuriko ya mbinguni yakawa yamefungwa nayo mvua ikawa imekoma kunyesha kutoka angani.
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

kikuyu: Maji yakaendelea kupungua taratibu katika nchi. Kunako mwisho wa siku ya 150, maji yalikuwa yamepungua,
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

kikuyu: katika siku ya kumi na saba ya mwezi wa saba, safina ikatua katika milima ya Ararati.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

kikuyu: Maji yakaendelea kupungua hadi mwezi wa kumi, na siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi, vilele vya milima vikaonekana.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

kikuyu: Baada ya siku arobaini Noa akafungua dirisha alilokuwa amelifanya katika safina
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

kikuyu: na akamtoa kunguru, akawa akiruka kwenda na kurudi mpaka maji yalipokwisha kukauka juu ya nchi.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

kikuyu: Kisha akamtoa hua ili aone kama maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa ardhi.
english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

kikuyu: Lakini hua hakupata mahali pa kutua kwa kuwa maji yalienea juu ya uso wa dunia yote, kwa hiyo akarudi kwa Noa ndani ya safina. Noa akanyoosha mkono akamchukua yule hua akamrudisha ndani ya safina.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

kikuyu: Noa akangojea siku saba zaidi kisha akamtoa tena hua kutoka safina.
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

kikuyu: Wakati hua aliporejea kwa Noa jioni, alikuwa amechukua katika mdomo wake jani bichi la mzeituni, lililochumwa wakati ule ule! Ndipo Noa akajua ya kuwa maji yameondoka juu ya uso wa dunia.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

kikuyu: Akangojea siku saba zaidi na akamtuma tena hua, lakini wakati huu hua hakurudi tena kwa Noa.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza ya mwaka 601, wa kuishi kwake Noa, maji yalikuwa yamekauka duniani. Kisha Noa akafungua mlango wa safina akaona ya kuwa uso wa ardhi ulikuwa umekauka.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi wa pili dunia ilikuwa imekauka kabisa.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

kikuyu: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa,
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

kikuyu: “Toka ndani ya safina, wewe na mkeo na wanao na wake zao.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Utoe nje kila aina ya kiumbe hai aliye pamoja nawe: Ndege, wanyama na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi, ili wakazae, na kuongezeka na kuijaza tena dunia.”
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Noa akatoka nje pamoja na mkewe, wanawe na wake zao.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

kikuyu: Wanyama wote na viumbe vyote vitambaavyo juu ya ardhi na ndege wote, kila kitu kiendacho juu ya nchi, aina moja baada ya nyingine vikatoka katika safina, kila aina ya kiumbe, kimoja baada ya kingine.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

kikuyu: Kisha Noa akamjengea Bwana madhabahu, akachukua baadhi ya wale wanyama na ndege wote walio safi, akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.
english: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

kikuyu: Bwana akasikia harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, naye akasema moyoni mwake, “Kamwe sitailaani tena ardhi kwa sababu ya mwanadamu, hata ingawa kila mwelekeo wa moyo wake ni mbaya tangu ujana. Kamwe sitaangamiza tena viumbe hai vyote kama nilivyofanya.
english: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

kikuyu: “Kwa muda dunia idumupo, wakati wa kupanda na wa kuvuna, wakati wa baridi na wa joto, wakati wa kiangazi na wa masika, usiku na mchana kamwe havitakoma.”
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Mungu akambariki Noa na wanawe, akiwaambia, “Zaeni mkaongezeke kwa idadi na mkaijaze tena dunia.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

kikuyu: Wanyama wote wa duniani, ndege wote wa angani, kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, na samaki wote wa baharini wamekabidhiwa mikononi mwenu, nao watawaogopa na kuwahofu.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

kikuyu: Kila kitu chenye uhai kiendacho kitakuwa chakula chenu. Kama vile nilivyowapa mimea mbalimbali, sasa nawapa kila kitu.
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

kikuyu: “Lakini kamwe msile nyama ambayo bado ina damu ya uhai wake, kwa maana damu ni uhai.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

kikuyu: Hakika damu ya uhai wenu nitaidai. Nitaidai kutoka kwa kila mnyama. Kutoka kwa kila mwanadamu pia nitaidai kwa ajili ya uhai wa mtu mwenzake.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

kikuyu: “Yeyote amwagaye damu ya mwanadamu, damu yake itamwagwa na mwanadamu, kwa kuwa katika mfano wa Mungu, Mungu alimuumba mwanadamu.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

kikuyu: Kuhusu ninyi, zaeni mwongezeke kwa wingi, mzidi katika dunia na kuijaza.”
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Mungu akamwambia Noa na wanawe pamoja naye:
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

kikuyu: “Sasa mimi ninaweka Agano langu nanyi, pamoja na uzao wenu baada yenu,
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

kikuyu: pia na kila kiumbe hai kilichokuwa pamoja nanyi: Ndege, wanyama wa kufugwa na wanyama wote wa porini, wale wote waliotoka katika safina pamoja nanyi, kila kiumbe hai duniani.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

kikuyu: Ninaweka Agano nanyi: Kamwe uhai hautafutwa tena kwa gharika, kamwe haitakuwepo tena gharika ya kuangamiza dunia.”
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

kikuyu: Mungu akasema, “Hii ni ishara ya Agano ninalofanya kati yangu na ninyi na kila kiumbe hai kilicho pamoja nanyi, Agano kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo:
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

kikuyu: Nimeweka upinde wangu wa mvua mawinguni, nao utakuwa ishara ya Agano nifanyalo kati yangu na dunia.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

kikuyu: Wakati wowote ninapotanda mawingu juu ya dunia na upinde wa mvua ukijitokeza mawinguni,
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

kikuyu: nitakumbuka Agano langu kati yangu na ninyi na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai vya kila aina. Kamwe maji hayatakuwa tena gharika ya kuangamiza uhai wote.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

kikuyu: Wakati wowote upinde wa mvua unapotokea mawinguni, nitauona na kukumbuka Agano la milele kati ya Mungu na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai vya kila aina duniani.”
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Mungu akamwambia Noa, “Hii ndiyo ishara ya Agano ambalo nimelifanya kati yangu na viumbe vyote vilivyo hai duniani.”
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Wana wa Noa waliotoka ndani ya safina ni: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi. (Hamu ndiye alikuwa baba wa Kanaani.)
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana watatu wa Noa, kutokana nao watu walienea katika dunia.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

kikuyu: Noa akawa mkulima, akawa mtu wa kwanza kupanda mizabibu.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

kikuyu: Alipokunywa huo mvinyo wake akalewa na akalala uchi kwenye hema lake.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

kikuyu: Hamu, baba wa Kanaani, akauona uchi wa baba yake na kuwaeleza ndugu zake wawili waliokuwa nje.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

kikuyu: Lakini Shemu na Yafethi wakachukua nguo wakaitanda mabegani mwao wote wawili, kisha wakaenda kinyumenyume, wakaufunika uchi wa baba yao. Nyuso zao zilielekea upande mwingine ili wasiuone uchi wa baba yao.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Noa alipolevuka kutoka kwenye mvinyo wake na kujua lile ambalo mwanawe mdogo kuliko wote alilokuwa amemtendea,
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

kikuyu: akasema, “Alaaniwe Kanaani! Atakuwa mtumwa wa chini sana kuliko watumwa wote kwa ndugu zake.”
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

kikuyu: Pia akasema, “Abarikiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Shemu! Kanaani na awe mtumwa wa Shemu.
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

kikuyu: Mungu na apanue mipaka ya Yafethi; Yafethi na aishi katika mahema ya Shemu, na Kanaani na awe mtumwa wake.”
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

kikuyu: Baada ya gharika Noa aliishi miaka 350.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

kikuyu: Noa alikuwa na jumla ya miaka 950, ndipo akafa.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio wazao wa Noa: Shemu, Hamu na Yafethi, ambao walizaa wana baada ya gharika.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

kikuyu: Wana wa Yafethi walikuwa: Gomeri, Magogu, Madai, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tirasi.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: Wana wa Gomeri walikuwa: Ashkenazi, Rifathi na Togarma.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

kikuyu: Wana wa Yavani walikuwa: Elisha, Tarshishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

kikuyu: (Kutokana na hawa mataifa ya Pwani yalienea katika nchi zao, kwa koo zao katika mataifa yao, kila moja kwa lugha yake.)
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

kikuyu: Wana wa Hamu walikuwa: Kushi, Misraimu, Putu na Kanaani.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Wana wa Kushi walikuwa: Seba, Havila, Sabta, Raama na Sabteka. Wana wa Raama walikuwa: Sheba na Dedani.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Kushi akamzaa Nimrodi, ambaye alikua akawa mtu shujaa duniani.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

kikuyu: Alikuwa mwindaji hodari mbele za Bwana. Ndiyo sababu watu husema, “Kama Nimrodi, hodari wa kuwinda mbele za Bwana.”
english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

kikuyu: Vituo vyake vya kwanza katika ufalme wake vilikuwa Babeli, Ereki, Akadi na Kalne katika Shinari.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

kikuyu: Kutoka nchi ile alikwenda Ashuru, ambako alijenga Ninawi, Rehoboth-iri, Kala,
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

kikuyu: na Reseni, iliyo kati ya Ninawi na Kala; huo ndio mji mkubwa.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

kikuyu: Misraimu alikuwa baba wa: Waludi, Waanami, Walehabi, Wanaftuhi,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

kikuyu: Wapathrusi, Wakasluhi (hao ndio asili ya Wafilisti), na Wakaftori.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: Kanaani alikuwa baba wa: Sidoni mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Hethi,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

kikuyu: Wayebusi, Waamori, Wagirgashi,
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

kikuyu: Wahivi, Waariki, Wasini,
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

kikuyu: Waarvadi, Wasemari na Wahamathi. Baadaye koo za Wakanaani zilitawanyika,
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

kikuyu: na mipaka ya Kanaani ilienea kutoka Sidoni kuelekea Gerari hadi Gaza, kisha kuelekea Sodoma, Gomora, Adma na Seboimu, hadi kufikia Lasha.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

kikuyu: Hawa ni wana wa Hamu kwa koo zao na lugha zao, katika nchi zao na mataifa yao.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

kikuyu: Shemu ambaye ni ndugu mkubwa wa Yafethi, kwake kulizaliwa wana pia. Shemu alikuwa baba wa wana wote wa Eberi.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

kikuyu: Wana wa Shemu walikuwa: Elamu, Ashuru, Arfaksadi, Ludi na Aramu.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

kikuyu: Wana wa Aramu walikuwa: Usi, Huli, Getheri na Mesheki.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

kikuyu: Arfaksadi alikuwa baba wa Shela, naye Shela akamzaa Eberi.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Eberi akapata wana wawili: Mmoja wao aliitwa Pelegi, kwa kuwa wakati wake ndipo dunia iligawanyika; nduguye aliitwa Yoktani.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Yoktani alikuwa baba wa: Almodadi, Shelefu, Hasarmawethi, Yera,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

kikuyu: Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikla,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

kikuyu: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheba,
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

kikuyu: Ofiri, Havila na Yobabu. Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Yoktani.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

kikuyu: Nchi waliyoishi ilienea toka Mesha kuelekea Sefari kwenye nchi ya vilima iliyoko mashariki.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kikuyu: Hao ndio wana wa Shemu kwa koo zao na lugha zao, katika nchi zao na mataifa yao.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo koo za wana wa Noa, kufuatana na vizazi vyao, katika mataifa yao. Kutokana na hawa mataifa yalienea duniani kote baada ya gharika.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

kikuyu: Wakati huo dunia yote ilikuwa na lugha moja na msemo mmoja.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

kikuyu: Watu walipoelekea upande wa mashariki, wakafika kwenye tambarare katika nchi ya Shinari nao wakaishi huko.
english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

kikuyu: Wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Njooni, tufyatue matofali na tuyachome vizuri kwa moto.” Walitumia matofali badala ya mawe, na lami kwa ajili ya kushikamanishia hayo matofali.
english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

kikuyu: Ndipo wakasema, “Njooni, tujijengee mji wenye mnara ambao utafika hadi mbinguni, ili tujipatie jina tusije tukatawanyika usoni pa dunia yote.”
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana akashuka ili auone mji na mnara ambao wanadamu waliokuwa wanaujenga.
english: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

kikuyu: Bwana akasema, “Ikiwa kama taifa moja wanaozungumza lugha moja wameanza kufanya hili, basi hakuna lolote watakalopanga kufanya ambalo halitawezekana kwao.
english: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

kikuyu: Njooni, tushuke tuvuruge lugha yao ili wasielewane wao kwa wao.”
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Bwana akawatawanya kutoka mahali pale kwenda katika dunia yote, nao wakaacha kuujenga huo mji.
english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

kikuyu: Ndiyo maana pakaitwa Babeli, kwa sababu hapo ndipo Bwana alipoivuruga lugha ya dunia nzima. Kutoka hapo Bwana akawatawanya katika uso wa dunia yote.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo vizazi vya Shemu. Miaka miwili baada ya gharika, Shemu alipokuwa na miaka 100, akamzaa Arfaksadi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumzaa Arfaksadi, Shemu aliishi miaka 500, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Wakati Arfaksadi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na mitano, akamzaa Shela.
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

kikuyu: Baada ya Arfaksadi kumzaa Shela, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Shela alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Eberi.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Shela baada ya kumzaa Eberi, aliishi miaka 403, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Eberi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na minne, akamzaa Pelegi.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

kikuyu: Baada ya Eberi kumzaa Pelegi, aliishi miaka 430, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Pelegi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Reu.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

kikuyu: Baada ya Pelegi kumzaa Reu, aliishi miaka 209, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Reu alipokuwa na miaka thelathini na miwili, akamzaa Serugi.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

kikuyu: Baada ya Reu kumzaa Serugi, aliishi miaka 207, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Serugi alipokuwa na miaka thelathini, akamzaa Nahori.
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

kikuyu: Baada ya Serugi kumzaa Nahori, aliishi miaka 200, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Nahori alipokuwa na miaka ishirini na tisa, akamzaa Tera.
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

kikuyu: Baada ya Nahori kumzaa Tera, aliishi miaka 119, akazaa watoto wengine wa kiume na wa kike.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Tera alipokuwa na miaka sabini, akamzaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio wazao wa Tera. Tera aliwazaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani. Harani akamzaa Loti.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

kikuyu: Tera alipokuwa bado hai, Harani akafa huko Uru ya Wakaldayo, nchi alimozaliwa.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

kikuyu: Abramu na Nahori walioa. Mke wa Abramu aliitwa Sarai, na mke wa Nahori aliitwa Milka; Milka na Iska walikuwa watoto wa Harani.
english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

kikuyu: Sarai alikuwa tasa, hakuwa na watoto.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

kikuyu: Tera akamchukua Abramu mwanawe, Loti mwana wa Harani mwanawe, na Sarai mkwewe, mke wa Abramu mwanawe, wakatoka kwa pamoja katika Uru ya Wakaldayo kwenda nchi ya Kanaani. Lakini walipofika Harani, wakaishi huko.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

kikuyu: Tera alikufa huko Harani akiwa na miaka 205.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

kikuyu: Bwana akawa amemwambia Abramu, “Ondoka kutoka nchi yako, uache jamii yako na nyumba ya baba yako, uende hadi nchi nitakayokuonyesha.
english: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

kikuyu: “Mimi nitakufanya taifa kubwa na nitakubariki, Nitalikuza jina lako, nawe utakuwa baraka.
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

kikuyu: Nitawabariki wale wanaokubariki, na yeyote akulaaniye nitamlaani; na kupitia kwako mataifa yote duniani yatabarikiwa.”
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Abramu akaondoka kama Bwana alivyokuwa amemwambia; naye Loti akaondoka pamoja naye. Wakati Abramu alipoitwa aondoke Harani, alikuwa na miaka sabini na mitano.
english: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

kikuyu: Abramu akamchukua Sarai mkewe pamoja na Loti mwana wa ndugu yake, mali zote walizokuwa nazo pamoja na watu aliokuwa amewapata huko Harani, wakasafiri mpaka nchi ya Kanaani, wakafika huko.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Abramu akasafiri katika nchi hiyo akafika huko Shekemu, mahali penye mti wa mwaloni ulioko More. Wakati huo Wakanaani walikuwa wanaishi katika nchi hiyo.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

kikuyu: Bwana akamtokea Abramu, akamwambia, “Nitawapa uzao wako nchi hii.” Hivyo hapa akamjengea madhabahu Bwana aliyekuwa amemtokea.
english: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

kikuyu: Kutoka huko Abramu akasafiri kuelekea kwenye vilima mashariki ya Betheli, naye akapiga hema huko, Betheli ikiwa upande wa magharibi na Ai upande wa mashariki. Huko alimjengea Bwana madhabahu na akaliitia jina la Bwana.
english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kisha Abramu akasafiri kuelekea upande wa Negebu.
english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

kikuyu: Basi kulikuwako na njaa katika nchi, naye Abramu akashuka kwenda Misri kukaa huko kwa muda, kwa maana njaa ilikuwa kali.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa karibu kuingia Misri, akamwambia Sarai mkewe, “Ninajua ya kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mzuri wa sura.
english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

kikuyu: Wakati Wamisri watakapokuona, watasema, ‘Huyu ni mke wake.’ Ndipo wataniua, lakini wewe watakuacha hai.
english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

kikuyu: Sema wewe ni dada yangu, ili nitendewe mema kwa ajili yako, na maisha yangu yatahifadhiwa kwa sababu yako.”
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

kikuyu: Abramu alipoingia Misri, Wamisri wakamwona Sarai kuwa ni mwanamke mzuri sana wa sura.
english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

kikuyu: Maafisa wa Farao walipomwona, wakamsifia kwa Farao; ndipo Sarai akapelekwa kwa nyumba ya mfalme.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya Sarai, Farao akamtendea Abramu mema, naye Abramu akapata kondoo, ngʼombe, punda, ngamia na watumishi wa kiume na wa kike.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana akamwadhibu Farao na nyumba yake kwa maradhi ya kufisha kwa sababu ya kumchukua Sarai, mke wa Abramu.
english: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

kikuyu: Ndipo Farao akamwita Abramu, akamuuliza, “Umenifanyia nini? Kwa nini hukuniambia ni mke wako?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

kikuyu: Kwa nini ulisema, ‘Yeye ni dada yangu,’ hata nikamchukua kuwa mke wangu? Sasa basi, mke wako huyu hapa. Mchukue uende zako!”
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

kikuyu: Kisha Farao akawapa watu wake amri kuhusu Abramu, wakamsindikiza pamoja na mke wake na kila alichokuwa nacho.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

kikuyu: Hivyo Abramu akakwea kutoka Misri kwenda Negebu, yeye na mkewe na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, pia Loti akaenda pamoja naye.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

kikuyu: Wakati huo Abramu alikuwa tajiri sana wa mifugo, fedha na dhahabu.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

kikuyu: Kutoka Negebu, akapita mahali hadi mahali, hadi akafika Betheli, mahali hapo ambapo mwanzoni alipiga hema lake kati ya Betheli na Ai
english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

kikuyu: hapo ambapo alikuwa amejenga madhabahu ya kwanza. Huko Abramu akaliitia jina la Bwana.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Basi Loti, ambaye alikuwa anafuatana na Abramu, alikuwa pia na makundi ya mbuzi, kondoo, ngʼombe na mahema.
english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

kikuyu: Lakini nchi haikuwatosha kukaa pamoja kwa ajili ya wingi wa mali zao.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

kikuyu: Ukazuka ugomvi kati ya wachunga mifugo wa Abramu na wale wa Loti. Wakati huo, Wakanaani na Waperizi ndio waliokuwa wenyeji wa nchi hiyo.
english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

kikuyu: Hivyo Abramu akamwambia Loti, “Pasiwe na ugomvi wowote kati yangu na wewe, wala kati ya wachungaji wangu na wako, kwa kuwa sisi ni ndugu.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

kikuyu: Je, nchi yote haiko mbele yako? Tutengane. Kama ukielekea kushoto, nitakwenda kulia; kama ukielekea kulia, mimi nitakwenda kushoto.”
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

kikuyu: Loti akatazama akaona lile bonde lote la Yordani kuwa lilikuwa na maji tele, kama bustani ya Bwana, kama nchi ya Misri, kuelekea Soari. (Hii ilikuwa kabla Bwana hajaharibu Sodoma na Gomora.)
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

kikuyu: Hivyo Loti akajichagulia bonde lote la Yordani, akaelekea upande wa mashariki. Watu hao wawili wakatengana:
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

kikuyu: Abramu akaishi katika nchi ya Kanaani, wakati Loti aliishi miongoni mwa miji ya lile bonde na kupiga mahema yake karibu na Sodoma.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

kikuyu: Basi watu wa Sodoma walikuwa waovu, wakifanya sana dhambi dhidi ya Bwana.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.

kikuyu: Baada ya Loti kuondoka Bwana akamwambia Abramu, “Ukiwa hapo ulipo, inua macho yako utazame kaskazini na kusini, mashariki na magharibi.
english: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

kikuyu: Nchi yote unayoiona nitakupa wewe na uzao wako hata milele.
english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

kikuyu: Nitaufanya uzao wako uwe mwingi kama mavumbi ya nchi, hivyo kama kuna yeyote awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi, basi uzao wako utahesabika.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

kikuyu: Ondoka, tembea katika marefu na mapana ya nchi, kwa maana ninakupa wewe.”
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
