kikuyu: “Yeyote ampigaye mtu na kumuua ni lazima auawe hakika.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, kama hakumuua kwa makusudi, lakini Mungu akaruhusu itendeke, basi atakimbilia mahali nitakapomchagulia.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mtu akipanga na kumuua mwingine kwa makusudi, mwondoe katika madhabahu yangu na kumuua.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

kikuyu: “Yeyote amshambuliaye baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: “Yeyote amtekaye nyara mwingine akamuuza au akamweka kwake, akikamatwa ni lazima auawe.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Yeyote atakayemlaani baba yake au mama yake ni lazima auawe.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Kama watu wakigombana na mmoja akimpiga mwingine kwa jiwe au kwa ngumi yake na hakufa bali akaugua na kulala kitandani,
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

kikuyu: yule aliyempiga ngumi hatahesabiwa kuwa na hatia kama mwenzake ataamka na kujikongoja kwa fimbo yake, lakini hata hivyo, ni lazima amlipe fidia ya muda wake aliopoteza na awajibike mpaka apone kabisa.
english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akimpiga mtumwa wake wa kiume au wa kike kwa fimbo na mtumwa huyo akafa papo hapo, ni lazima aadhibiwe
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

kikuyu: lakini ikiwa mtumwa ataamka baada ya siku moja au mbili, hataadhibiwa, kwa sababu yule mtumwa ni mali yake.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa watu wawili wanapigana na wakamuumiza mwanamke mjamzito, naye akazaa kabla ya wakati lakini hakuna majeraha makubwa, mhalifu atatozwa mali kiasi cha madai ya mume wa yule mwanamke, na jinsi mahakama itakavyoamua.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

kikuyu: Lakini kukiwa na jeraha kubwa, ni lazima ulipe uhai kwa uhai,
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

kikuyu: jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino, mkono kwa mkono, mguu kwa mguu,
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

kikuyu: kuchomwa moto kwa kuchomwa moto, jeraha kwa jeraha, mchubuko kwa mchubuko.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa mtu atampiga mtumwa mwanaume au mwanamke kwenye jicho na kuliharibu, ni lazima amwache huru yule mtumwa kama fidia ya hilo jicho.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

kikuyu: Kama akimvunja jino mtumwa wa kiume au wa kike, ni lazima amwache huru huyo mtumwa kwa kufidia hilo jino.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

kikuyu: “Kama fahali akimuua mwanaume au mwanamke kwa kumpiga kwa pembe, fahali huyo ni lazima auawe kwa kupigwa mawe, na nyama yake haitaliwa. Lakini mwenye fahali huyo hatawajibika.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

kikuyu: Lakini hata hivyo, ikiwa huyo fahali amekuwa na tabia ya kupiga kwa pembe, na mwenyewe ameonywa na hakutaka kumfungia naye akamuua mwanaume au mwanamke, huyo fahali ni lazima auawe kwa mawe na mwenye fahali pia auawe.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa malipo yatatakiwa kwake, basi anaweza kulipa kinachodaiwa ili kuukomboa uhai wake.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

kikuyu: Sheria hii pia itatumika ikiwa fahali atampiga kwa pembe mwana au binti.
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

kikuyu: Ikiwa fahali atampiga mtumwa wa kike au wa kiume, mwenye fahali atalipa shekeli thelathini za fedha kwa bwana mwenye mtumwa, na fahali ni lazima auawe kwa mawe.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akiacha shimo wazi, ama akachimba shimo kisha asilifukie, na ngʼombe au punda akatumbukia ndani yake,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

kikuyu: mwenye shimo ni lazima alipe hasara iliyotokea; ni lazima amlipe mwenye mnyama. Mnyama aliyekufa atakuwa wake.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

kikuyu: “Kama fahali wa mtu fulani atamuumiza fahali wa mtu mwingine na akafa, watamuuza yule aliye hai na wagawane sawa fedha pamoja na mnyama aliyekufa.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, kama ikifahamika kwamba fahali huyo alikuwa na tabia ya kupiga kwa pembe na mwenyewe hakumfunga, ni lazima mwenye fahali alipe mnyama kwa mnyama, na mnyama aliyekufa atakuwa wake.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akiiba maksai au kondoo na kumchinja au kumuuza, ni lazima alipe ngʼombe watano badala ya maksai mmoja na kondoo wanne badala ya kondoo mmoja.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

kikuyu: “Kama mwizi akishikwa anavunja nyumba akapigwa hata akafa, aliyemuua hana hatia ya kumwaga damu;
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

kikuyu: lakini jambo hilo likitokea wakati jua limechomoza, huyo mtu atakuwa na hatia ya kumwaga damu. “Mwizi huyo sharti alipe, lakini kama hana kitu, lazima auzwe ili alipe kwa ajili ya wizi wake.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

kikuyu: “Kama mnyama aliyeibwa akikutwa hai mikononi mwake, ikiwa ni maksai au punda au kondoo, lazima alipe mara mbili.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akichunga mifugo yake katika shamba au shamba la mizabibu, na akawaachia wajilishe katika shamba la mtu mwingine, ni lazima alipe vitu bora kutoka kwenye shamba lake mwenyewe au kutoka shamba lake la mizabibu.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

kikuyu: “Kama moto ukiwaka na kuenea kwenye vichaka vya miiba na kuteketeza miganda ya nafaka au nafaka ambayo haijavunwa, au kuteketeza shamba lote, mtu yule aliyewasha moto lazima alipe.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akimpa jirani yake fedha au mali nyingine amtunzie, na kama vikiibwa kutoka nyumba ya huyo jirani, kama mwizi atashikwa, lazima alipe mara mbili.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: Lakini mwizi asipopatikana, mwenye nyumba atafika mbele ya waamuzi ili kuthibitisha kuwa hakuchukua mali ya mwenzake.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

kikuyu: Pakiwepo jambo lolote la mali isiyo halali, ikiwa ni maksai, punda, kondoo, mavazi, ama mali yoyote iliyopotea ambayo fulani atasema, ‘Hii ni mali yangu,’ pande zote mbili wataleta mashauri yao mbele ya waamuzi. Yule ambaye waamuzi watamwona kuwa na hatia atamlipa jirani yake mara mbili.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akimpa jirani yake punda, ngʼombe, kondoo au mnyama mwingine yeyote amtunzie, akifa au akijeruhiwa au akichukuliwa wakati haonekani na mtu yeyote,
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

kikuyu: jambo hili kati yao wawili litaamuliwa kwa kuapa kiapo mbele za Bwana, kwamba huyo jirani hakuhusika na wizi wa mali ya jirani yake. Mwenye mali itampasa akubali jambo hili, na hakuna malipo yatakayohitajika.
english: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mnyama aliibwa kwa jirani, itampasa amlipe mwenye mnyama.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

kikuyu: Kama ameraruliwa na mnyama pori, ataleta mabaki ya mnyama kama ushahidi, naye hatadaiwa kulipa mnyama aliyeraruliwa.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akimwazima mnyama kutoka kwa jirani yake, na kama akiumia au akafa na mwenye mnyama hayupo, lazima amlipe huyo mnyama.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: Lakini mwenye mnyama akiwa angalipo na mnyama wake, mwazimaji hatalazimika kumlipa. Kama mnyama alikuwa amekodishwa, fedha iliyolipwa kwa kukodisha inatosha kwa kufidia hasara.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akimshawishi bikira ambaye hajaposwa na akilala naye, lazima alipe mahari, kisha atamwoa msichana huyo.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

kikuyu: Baba wa msichana akikataa katakata kumpa huyo mtu huyo msichana wake, bado ni lazima huyo mtu atalipa mahari kama inavyostahili malipo ya ubikira.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

kikuyu: “Usiruhusu mwanamke mchawi aishi.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

kikuyu: “Mtu yeyote aziniye na mnyama lazima auawe.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Mtu awaye yote anayemtolea mungu mwingine dhabihu isipokuwa Bwana, lazima aangamizwe.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.

kikuyu: “Usimtendee mgeni vibaya au kumwonea, kwa kuwa nanyi mlikuwa wageni huko Misri.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Usimdhulumu mjane wala yatima.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

kikuyu: Kama ukifanya hivyo nao wakinililia, hakika nitasikia kilio chao.
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

kikuyu: Hasira yangu itawaka, nami nitawaua kwa upanga, wake zenu watakuwa wajane na watoto wenu watakuwa yatima.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

kikuyu: “Kama ukimkopesha mmojawapo wa watu wangu fedha ambaye ni mhitaji, usiwe kama mtu mkopesha fedha; usimtoze riba.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

kikuyu: Kama ukichukua vazi la jirani kama rehani, ulirudishe kwake kabla jua kuzama,
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa vazi lake ndilo pekee alilo nalo la kumfunika mwili wake. Ni nini kingine atajifunika nacho? Atakaponililia, nitasikia, kwa kuwa nina huruma.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

kikuyu: “Usimkufuru Mungu au kumlaani mtawala wa watu wako.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

kikuyu: “Usiache kutoa sadaka kutoka ghala lako au mapipa yako. “Lazima unipe mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wana wako.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

kikuyu: Ufanye vivyo hivyo kwa ngʼombe wako na kwa kondoo wako. Waache wakae na mama zao kwa siku saba, lakini siku ya nane unipe.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

kikuyu: “Ninyi mtakuwa watu wangu watakatifu. Kwa hiyo msile nyama ya mnyama aliyeraruliwa na wanyama pori; mtupieni mbwa.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

kikuyu: “Usieneze habari za uongo. Usimsaidie mtu mwovu kwa kuwa shahidi mwenye nia ya kudhuru wengine.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

kikuyu: “Usifuate umati wa watu katika kutenda mabaya. Unapotoa ushahidi kwenye mashtaka, usipotoshe haki ukijumuika na umati wa watu,
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

kikuyu: nawe usimpendelee mtu maskini katika mashtaka yake.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

kikuyu: “Kama ukikutana na maksai au punda wa adui yako anapotea, hakikisha umemrudisha kwake.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

kikuyu: Ukiona punda wa mtu anayekuchukia ameanguka na mzigo wake, usimwache hapo alipoangukia; hakikisha kuwa umemsaidia.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

kikuyu: “Usiwanyime haki watu wako walio maskini katika mashtaka yao.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

kikuyu: Ujiepushe na mashtaka ya uongo, wala usimuue mtu asiye na hatia au mtu mwaminifu, kwa maana sitamhesabia hana hatia yeye aliye na hatia.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

kikuyu: “Usipokee rushwa, kwa kuwa rushwa hupofusha wale waonao, na kupinda maneno ya wenye haki.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

kikuyu: “Usimwonee mgeni; ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi mgeni anavyojisikia, kwa sababu mlikuwa wageni Misri.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Kwa muda wa miaka sita mtapanda mashamba yenu na kuvuna mazao,
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

kikuyu: lakini katika mwaka wa saba usiilime ardhi wala kuitumia, ili watu walio maskini miongoni mwenu waweze kupata chakula kutoka kwenye hayo mashamba, nao wanyama pori wapate chakula kwa yale mabaki watakayobakiza. Utafanya hivyo katika shamba lako la mizabibu na la mizeituni.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

kikuyu: “Kwa siku sita fanya kazi zako, lakini siku ya saba usifanye kazi, ili maksai wako na punda wako wapate kupumzika, naye mtumwa aliyezaliwa nyumbani mwako, pamoja na mgeni, wapate kustarehe.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

kikuyu: “Uzingatie kutenda kila kitu nilichokuambia. Usiombe kwa majina ya miungu mingine, wala usiyaruhusu kusikika kinywani mwako.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

kikuyu: “Mara tatu kwa mwaka utanifanyia sikukuu.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

kikuyu: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu; kwa siku saba utakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu kama nilivyokuagiza. Fanya jambo hili kwa wakati uliopangwa katika mwezi wa Abibu, ndio mwezi wa nne, kwa sababu katika mwezi huo ulitoka Misri. “Mtu yeyote asije mbele yangu mikono mitupu.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Mavuno kwa malimbuko ya mazao yako uliyopanda katika shamba lako. “Utaadhimisha Sikukuu ya Kukusanya mavuno mwishoni mwa mwaka, unapokusanya mavuno yako toka shambani.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

kikuyu: “Mara tatu kwa mwaka wanaume wote watakuja mbele za Bwana Mwenyezi.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “Msitoe damu ya dhabihu kwangu pamoja na kitu chochote kilicho na chachu. “Mafuta ya mnyama wa sadaka ya sikukuu yangu yasibakizwe mpaka asubuhi.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

kikuyu: “Utaleta malimbuko bora ya ardhi yako katika nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wako. “Usimchemshe mwana-mbuzi katika maziwa ya mama yake.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

kikuyu: “Tazama, ninamtuma malaika akutangulie mbele yako akulinde njiani na kukuleta mpaka mahali nilipoandaa.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

kikuyu: Mtamtii na kusikiliza kile anachokisema. Usiasi dhidi yake; hatakusamehe uasi wako, kwa maana Jina langu limo ndani yake.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

kikuyu: Kama ukitii kweli kweli kile asemacho na kufanya yote nisemayo, nitakuwa adui wa adui zako, na nitawapinga wale wakupingao.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

kikuyu: Malaika wangu atatangulia mbele yako na kukuleta katika nchi ya Waamori, Wahiti, Waperizi, Wakanaani, Wahivi na Wayebusi, nami nitawafutilia mbali.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

kikuyu: Usiisujudie miungu yao, au kuiabudu, wala kufuata desturi yao. Utayabomoa kabisa na kuvunjavunja mawe yao ya ibada vipande vipande.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

kikuyu: Utamwabudu Bwana Mungu wako, na baraka zake zitakuwa juu ya vyakula vyako na maji yako. Nami nitaondoa maradhi miongoni mwako,
english: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

kikuyu: na hakuna atakayeharibu mimba wala atakayekuwa tasa katika nchi yako. Nami nitakupa maisha makamilifu.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

kikuyu: “Nitapeleka utisho wangu mbele yako na kufadhaisha kila taifa utakalolifikia. Nitafanya adui zako wote wakupe kisogo na kukimbia.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

kikuyu: Nitatanguliza manyigu mbele yako kuwafukuza Wahivi, Wakanaani na Wahiti waondoke njiani mwako.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

kikuyu: Lakini sitawafukuza kwa mara moja, kwa sababu nchi itabaki ukiwa na wanyama pori watakuwa wengi mno kwako.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

kikuyu: Nitawafukuza kidogo kidogo mbele yako, mpaka uwe umeongezeka kiasi cha kutosha kuimiliki nchi.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

kikuyu: “Nitaweka mipaka ya nchi yako kuanzia Bahari ya Shamu hadi Bahari ya Wafilisti, na kuanzia jangwani hadi Mto Frati. Nitawatia watu wanaoishi katika nchi hizo mikononi mwako, nawe utawafukuza watoke mbele yako.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

kikuyu: Usifanye agano lolote nao wala na miungu yao.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

kikuyu: Usiwaache waishi katika nchi yako, la sivyo watakusababisha utende dhambi dhidi yangu, kwa sababu ibada ya miungu yao hakika itakuwa mtego kwako.”
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

kikuyu: Kisha Mungu akamwambia Mose, “Njooni huku juu kwa Bwana, wewe na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, pamoja na wazee sabini wa Israeli. Mniabudu kwa mbali,
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

kikuyu: lakini Mose peke yake ndiye atakayemkaribia Bwana; wengine wasije karibu. Nao watu wasije wakapanda pamoja naye.”
english: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

kikuyu: Mose alipokwenda na kuwaambia watu maneno yote na sheria zote za Bwana, wakaitikia kwa sauti moja, “Kila kitu alichosema Bwana tutakifanya.”
english: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Mose akaandika kila kitu Bwana alichokuwa amesema. Akaamka kesho yake asubuhi na mapema na kujenga madhabahu chini ya mlima na kusimamisha nguzo kumi na mbili za mawe kuwakilisha makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
english: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Kisha akawatuma vijana wanaume wa Kiisraeli, nao wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu za mafahali wachanga kuwa sadaka za amani kwa Bwana.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.

kikuyu: Mose akachukua nusu ya damu ya wale wanyama na kuiweka kwenye mabakuli na nusu nyingine akainyunyiza juu ya madhabahu.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

kikuyu: Kisha akachukua kile Kitabu cha Agano na kuwasomea watu. Nao wakajibu, “Tutafanya kila kitu alichosema Bwana, nasi tutatii.”
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Mose akachukua ile damu, akawanyunyizia wale watu, akasema, “Hii ni damu ya agano ambalo Bwana amelifanya nanyi kufuatana na maneno haya yote.”
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”

kikuyu: Mose na Aroni, Nadabu na Abihu, pamoja na wazee sabini wa Israeli wakapanda mlimani,
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

kikuyu: nao wakamwona Mungu wa Israeli. Chini ya miguu yake kulikuwa na kitu kama sakafu ya mawe ya yakuti samawi, iliyo safi kama anga angavu.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

kikuyu: Lakini Mungu hakuinua mkono wake dhidi ya hawa viongozi wa Waisraeli; walimwona Mungu, nao wakala na kunywa.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda uje kwangu huku mlimani na ukae hapa, nami nitakupa vibao vya mawe, vyenye sheria na amri ambazo nimeziandika ziwe mwongozo wao.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

kikuyu: Basi Mose akaondoka na Yoshua mtumishi wake, naye Mose akapanda juu kwenye mlima wa Mungu.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

kikuyu: Mose akawaambia wazee wa Israeli, “Tungojeni hapa mpaka tutakapowarudia. Aroni na Huri wako pamoja nanyi, na kila aliye na neno aweza kuwaendea wao.”
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

kikuyu: Mose alipopanda juu mlimani, wingu liliufunika huo mlima,
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

kikuyu: nao utukufu wa Bwana ukatua juu ya Mlima Sinai. Kwa muda wa siku sita wingu lilifunika mlima, na siku ya saba Bwana akamwita Mose kutoka katikati ya lile wingu.
english: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

kikuyu: Kwa Waisraeli utukufu wa Bwana ulionekana kama moto uteketezao juu ya mlima.
english: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akaingia ndani ya lile wingu alivyokuwa akipanda mlimani. Naye akakaa huko mlimani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, usiku na mchana.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waambie Waisraeli waniletee sadaka. Utapokea sadaka kwa niaba yangu kutoka kwa kila mtu ambaye moyo wake wapenda kutoa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo sadaka utakazozipokea kutoka kwao: dhahabu, fedha na shaba;
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu, pamoja na kitani safi; singa za mbuzi;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

kikuyu: ngozi za kondoo dume zilizopakwa rangi nyekundu, na ngozi za pomboo; mbao za mshita;
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

kikuyu: mafuta ya zeituni kwa ajili ya taa; vikolezi kwa ajili ya mafuta ya upako, pamoja na uvumba wa harufu nzuri;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: na vito vya shohamu na vito vingine vya thamani vya kuweka kwenye kisibau na kile kifuko cha kifuani.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

kikuyu: “Kisha uwaamuru wanitengenezee mahali patakatifu, nami nitakaa miongoni mwao.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

kikuyu: Tengeneza hema hili na vyombo vyake vyote sawasawa na kielelezo nitakachokuonyesha.
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

kikuyu: “Nao watatengeneza Sanduku la mbao za mshita, lenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: Utalifunika hilo Sanduku kwa dhahabu safi ndani na nje, na kulifanyia ukingo wa dhahabu juu yake kulizunguka.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Utalisubu kwa pete nne za dhahabu na kuzifungia kwenye miguu yake minne, pete mbili kwa upande mmoja na pete mbili kwa upande mwingine.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

kikuyu: Kisha utatengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita na kuzifunika kwa dhahabu.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

kikuyu: Utaiingiza hiyo mipiko kwenye zile pete katika pande mbili za Sanduku ili kulibeba.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

kikuyu: Hiyo mipiko itabakia daima katika hizo pete za hilo Sanduku; haitaondolewa.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

kikuyu: Kisha weka ndani ya hilo Sanduku ule Ushuhuda nitakaokupa.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza kifuniko cha upatanisho cha dhahabu safi, chenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili na nusu, na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: Tengeneza makerubi wawili wa dhahabu iliyofuliwa katika miisho ya hicho kifuniko.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Tengeneza kerubi mmoja kwenye mwisho mmoja, na kerubi mwingine kwenye mwisho mwingine; watengeneze makerubi hao wawe kitu kimoja na hicho kifuniko katika miisho hiyo miwili.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Makerubi hao watakuwa wametandaza mabawa kuelekea juu, yakitia kivuli hicho kifuniko. Makerubi hao wataelekeana, wakitazama hicho kifuniko.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Weka huo Ushuhuda nitakaokupa ndani ya hilo Sanduku la Agano, na uweke hicho kifuniko juu ya hilo Sanduku.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

kikuyu: Hapo juu ya hicho kifuniko, kati ya hao makerubi wawili walioko juu ya hilo Sanduku la Ushuhuda, hapo ndipo nitakapokutana nawe na kukupa maagizo yangu kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza meza ya mbao za mshita yenye urefu wa dhiraa mbili, upana wa dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa moja na nusu.
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

kikuyu: Ifunike kwa dhahabu safi, na kuitengenezea ukingo wa dhahabu kuizunguka pande zote.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Kisha tengeneza upapi wenye upana wa nyanda nne, na ufanyie ule upapi ukingo wa dhahabu kuuzunguka pande zote.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

kikuyu: Tengeneza pete nne za dhahabu kwa ajili ya meza hiyo, na uzifungie kwenye pembe nne, pale penye miguu yake minne.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

kikuyu: Pete hizo zitakuwa karibu na ukingo ule ili kuishikilia ile mipiko itakayotumika kuibebea hiyo meza.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Tengeneza mipiko hiyo kwa mbao za mshita, uifunike na dhahabu, uitumie kubeba hiyo meza.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

kikuyu: Tengeneza sahani zake na masinia yake kwa dhahabu safi, pamoja na bilauri na bakuli zake kwa ajili ya kumiminia sadaka.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

kikuyu: Utaweka mikate ya Wonyesho juu ya meza hii iwe mbele yangu daima.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi iliyofuliwa vizuri katika kitako chake na ufito wake; vikombe vyake vinavyofanana na ua, matovu yake na maua yake viwe kitu kimoja.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Matawi sita yatatokeza kuanzia ule ufito wa katikati wa kinara cha taa: matawi matatu upande mmoja na matatu upande mwingine.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

kikuyu: Vikombe vitatu vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yenye matovu na maua vitakuwa katika tawi moja, vikombe vitatu katika tawi jingine, na vivyo hivyo kwa matawi yote sita yanayotokeza kwenye kile kinara cha taa.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

kikuyu: Juu ya kinara chenyewe vitakuwepo vikombe vinne vya mfano wa maua ya mlozi yakiwa na matovu yake na maua yake.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: Tovu moja litakuwa chini ya jozi ya kwanza ya matawi yaliyotokeza kwenye kinara cha taa, tovu la pili chini ya jozi ya pili, nalo tovu la tatu chini ya jozi ya tatu, yaani matawi sita kwa jumla.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Matovu na matawi yote yatakuwa kitu kimoja na kile kinara cha taa, yakifuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: “Kisha tengeneza taa zake saba na uziweke juu ya kinara hicho ili ziangaze mbele yake.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

kikuyu: Mikasi ya kusawazishia tambi, pamoja na masinia, zote zitakuwa za dhahabu safi.
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

kikuyu: Utatumia talanta moja ya dhahabu safi kutengeneza hicho kinara na vifaa vyake vyote.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

kikuyu: Hakikisha kuwa umevitengeneza sawasawa na ule mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza maskani kwa mapazia kumi ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, naye fundi stadi atatarizi makerubi kwenye mapazia hayo.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Mapazia yote yatatoshana kwa ukubwa: kila moja litakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa ishirini na nane, na upana wa dhiraa nne
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Unganisha mapazia matano pamoja; fanya vivyo hivyo kwa hayo mengine matano.
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

kikuyu: Tengeneza vitanzi vya kitambaa cha buluu kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu la kwanza, na ufanye vivyo hivyo na pazia la fungu la mwisho.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Fanya vitanzi hamsini katika pazia mmoja, na vitanzi vingine hamsini kwenye pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine, nazo vitanzi vyote vielekeane.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

kikuyu: Kisha tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya dhahabu ili vitumike kufunga na kuunganisha mapazia pamoja kufanya Hema liwe kitu kimoja.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza mapazia kumi na moja ya singa za mbuzi kwa ajili ya kufunika maskani.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

kikuyu: Mapazia hayo kumi na moja yatakuwa na kipimo kimoja, yaani urefu wa dhiraa thelathini, na upana wa dhiraa nne.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Unganisha hayo mapazia matano yawe fungu moja, na hayo mengine sita yawe fungu lingine. Kunja hilo pazia la sita mara mbili mbele ya maskani.
english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

kikuyu: Tengeneza vitanzi hamsini kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu moja, na vivyo hivyo kwenye upindo wa pazia la mwisho la fungu hilo lingine.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Kisha tengeneza vifungo hamsini vya shaba, uviingize katika vile vitanzi ili kukaza hema pamoja kuwa kitu kimoja.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

kikuyu: Kuhusu kile kipande cha ziada cha pazia la Hema, nusu ya hilo pazia lililobaki litaningʼinizwa upande wa nyuma wa Hema.
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Mapazia ya hema yatakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa moja zaidi pande zote, sehemu itakayobaki itaningʼinia pande zote za Hema ili kuifunika.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

kikuyu: Tengeneza kifuniko cha hema kwa ngozi za kondoo dume zilizotiwa rangi nyekundu, na juu yake kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo.
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza mihimili ya kusimamisha ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya maskani.
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

kikuyu: Kila mhimili uwe na urefu wa dhiraa kumi na upana wa dhiraa moja na nusu,
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

kikuyu: zikiwa na ndimi mbili zilizo sambamba kila mmoja na mwingine. Tengeneza mihimili yote ya maskani jinsi hii.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Tengeneza mihimili ishirini kwa ajili ya upande wa kusini wa maskani,
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

kikuyu: kisha tengeneza vitako arobaini vya fedha vya kuweka chini ya hiyo mihimili, vitako viwili kwa kila mhimili, kimoja chini ya kila ulimi.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Kuhusu upande wa kaskazini wa maskani, tengeneza mihimili ishirini
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

kikuyu: na vitako arobaini vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Kisha tengeneza mihimili sita kwa mwisho ulio mbali, yaani upande wa magharibi wa maskani,
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

kikuyu: na pia utengeneze mihimili miwili ya pembe za upande ulio mbali.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

kikuyu: Katika pembe hizi mbili ni lazima mihimili yake iwe miwili kuanzia chini mpaka juu, na iingizwe kwenye pete moja; mihimili ya pembe hizi mbili itafanana.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo itakuwepo mihimili minane, na vitako kumi na sita vya fedha, viwili chini ya kila mhimili.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: “Pia tengeneza mataruma ya mti wa mshita: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mmoja wa maskani,
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande mwingine, na matano kwa ajili ya mihimili ya upande wa magharibi, mwisho kabisa mwa maskani.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

kikuyu: Taruma la katikati litapenya katikati ya mihimili kutoka mwisho mmoja hadi mwisho mwingine.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

kikuyu: Funika hiyo mihimili kwa dhahabu, kisha tengeneza pete za dhahabu ambazo zitashikilia hayo mataruma. Pia funika hayo mataruma kwa dhahabu.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

kikuyu: “Simamisha Hema sawasawa na mfano ulioonyeshwa kule mlimani.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, naye fundi stadi atirizi makerubi kwenye hilo pazia.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Litundike kwa kulabu za dhahabu kwenye nguzo nne za mti wa mshita ambazo zimefunikwa kwa dhahabu, zikiwa zimesimamishwa kwenye vitako vinne vya fedha.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

kikuyu: Ningʼiniza pazia hilo kwenye vifungo, kisha weka Sanduku la Ushuhuda nyuma ya pazia. Pazia litatenganisha Mahali Patakatifu kutoka Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

kikuyu: Weka kifuniko cha kiti cha rehema juu ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

kikuyu: Weka meza nje ya pazia upande wa kaskazini wa Hema, kisha weka kinara cha taa upande wa kusini wa Hema.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

kikuyu: “Kwa ajili ya ingilio la hema, tengeneza pazia la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Tengeneza kulabu za dhahabu kwa ajili ya hilo pazia, na nguzo tano za mshita zilizofunikwa kwa dhahabu. Kisha mimina vitako vitano vya shaba kwa ajili yake.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

kikuyu: “Jenga madhabahu ya mbao za mti wa mshita, kimo chake kiwe dhiraa tatu; itakuwa mraba, urefu wake dhiraa tano, na upana wake dhiraa tano.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

kikuyu: Tengeneza upembe kwenye kila pembe ya hizo pembe nne, ili zile pembe na madhabahu ziwe zimeungana, na ufunike madhabahu kwa shaba.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

kikuyu: Tengeneza vyombo vyake vyote kwa shaba: vyungu vyake vya kuondolea majivu, masepetu, mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, uma za nyama, na vyombo vya kuchukulia moto.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Kisha tengenezea hayo madhabahu wavu wa shaba, na utengeneze pete za shaba kwenye kila moja ya hizo pembe nne za huo wavu.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

kikuyu: Weka wavu huo chini ya ukingo wa madhabahu ili ufikie nusu ya kimo cha madhabahu.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

kikuyu: Tengeneza mipiko ya mti wa mshita kwa ajili ya madhabahu, na uifunike kwa shaba.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

kikuyu: Hiyo mipiko itaingizwa kwenye zile pete ili iwe pande mbili za madhabahu inapobebwa.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

kikuyu: Tengeneza madhabahu yawe na uvungu ndani yake ukitumia mbao. Utaitengeneza sawasawa na vile ulivyoonyeshwa mlimani.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza ua kwa ajili ya Hema la Kukutania. Upande wa kusini utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, na utakuwa na mapazia ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri,
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

kikuyu: pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

kikuyu: Upande wa kaskazini utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja, nao utakuwa na mapazia, pamoja na nguzo ishirini na vitako vya shaba ishirini, pamoja na kulabu na tepe za fedha juu ya hizo nguzo.
english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: “Upande wa magharibi wa ua utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini, nao utakuwa na mapazia, na nguzo kumi na vitako vyake kumi.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

kikuyu: Upande wa mwisho wa mashariki jua linakochomoza, ua pia utakuwa na upana wa dhiraa hamsini.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

kikuyu: Mapazia yenye urefu wa dhiraa kumi na tano yatakuwa upande mmoja wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Kutakuwepo tena na mapazia ya dhiraa kumi na tano kwa upande mwingine wa ingilio, pamoja na nguzo tatu na vitako vitatu.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: “Kuhusu ingilio la ua, weka pazia lenye urefu wa dhiraa ishirini la nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri, kazi ya mtarizi. Pazia hilo litashikiliwa na nguzo nne na vitako vinne.
english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

kikuyu: Nguzo zote zinazozunguka ua zitakuwa na tepe na kulabu za fedha, na vitako vya shaba.
english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

kikuyu: Ua wa kukutania utakuwa na urefu wa dhiraa mia moja na upana wa dhiraa hamsini, ukiwa na mapazia ya kitani yaliyosokotwa vizuri yenye urefu wa dhiraa tano kwenda juu na vitako vya shaba.
english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

kikuyu: Vyombo vingine vyote vinavyotumika katika maskani kwa shughuli yoyote, pamoja na vigingi vyote na hata vile vya ua, vitakuwa vya shaba.
english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

kikuyu: “Utawaamuru Waisraeli wakuletee mafuta safi ya zeituni yaliyokamuliwa kwa ajili ya mwanga ili zile taa ziwake mfululizo.
english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

kikuyu: Katika Hema la Kukutania, nje ya pazia lililo mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda, Aroni na wanawe watahakikisha kuwa taa hizo zinawaka kuanzia jioni mpaka asubuhi mbele za Bwana. Hili litakuwa agizo la milele miongoni mwa Waisraeli kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo.
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “Mtwae Aroni ndugu yako aliyeletwa kwako kutoka miongoni mwa Waisraeli, pamoja na wanawe Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari, ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

kikuyu: Mshonee Aroni ndugu yako mavazi matakatifu ili yampe ukuu na heshima.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: Waambie mafundi stadi wote niliowapa hekima katika shughuli hiyo wamtengenezee Aroni mavazi hayo, ili awekwe wakfu, anitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo mavazi watakayoshona: kifuko cha kifuani, kisibau, kanzu, joho lililorembwa, kilemba na mshipi. Mavazi haya yatashonwa kwa ajili ya ndugu yako Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Waambie watumie dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu pamoja na kitani safi.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza kisibau cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, za rangi nyekundu na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kazi ya fundi stadi.
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Kitakuwa na vipande viwili vya mabegani vilivyoshikizwa kwenye pembe zake mbili ili kufungia kisibau.
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

kikuyu: Mshipi wa kiunoni uliofumwa kwa ustadi utafanana nacho: utakuwa kitu kimoja na hicho kisibau, nao utengenezwe kwa dhahabu na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na kwa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: “Chukua vito viwili vya shohamu, na uchore juu yake majina ya wana wa Israeli
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: kufuatana na walivyozaliwa: majina sita katika kito kimoja, na mengine sita katika kito kingine.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

kikuyu: Yachore majina ya wana wa Israeli juu ya vito hivyo viwili kama vile sonara anavyochonga muhuri. Kisha uvitie vito hivyo katika vijalizo vya dhahabu,
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

kikuyu: na uvifungie juu ya vipande vya mabega ya kisibau yawe kama vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli. Aroni atavaa majina hayo mabegani mwake kama kumbukumbu mbele za Bwana.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial.

kikuyu: Tengeneza vijalizo vya dhahabu
english: You shall make settings of gold,

kikuyu: na mikufu miwili ya dhahabu safi iliyosokotwa kama kamba, na uifunge mikufu hiyo kwenye vijalizo.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

kikuyu: “Fanyiza kifuko cha kifuani kwa ajili ya kufanya maamuzi, kazi ya fundi stadi. Kitengeneze kama kile kisibau: cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, cha kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

kikuyu: Kitakuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, na kikunjwe mara mbili.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

kikuyu: Kisha weka safu nne za vito vya thamani juu yake. Safu ya kwanza itakuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

kikuyu: katika safu ya pili itakuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: safu ya tatu itakuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: na safu ya nne itakuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Yote yatiwe kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

kikuyu: Patakuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kwa jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli, kila kimoja kichorwe kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: “Kwa ajili ya kile kifuko cha kifuani, tengeneza mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu kwa ajili yake, uzifungie kwenye pembe mbili za hicho kifuko cha kifuani.
english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Funga ile mikufu miwili ya dhahabu kwenye hizo pete zilizo katika pembe za hicho kifuko cha kifuani,
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu zifunge kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na uzishikamanishe na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

kikuyu: Tengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu, uzishikamanishe kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Tengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, na uzishikamanishe sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Pete za kifuko cha kifuani zitafungwa kwenye pete zile za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, ziunganishwe na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

kikuyu: “Wakati wowote Aroni aingiapo Mahali Patakatifu, atakuwa na yale majina ya wana wa Israeli moyoni mwake juu ya kile kifuko cha kifuani cha uamuzi kama kumbukumbu ya kudumu mbele za Bwana.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: Pia weka Urimu na Thumimu ndani ya kifuko cha kifuani, yawe juu ya moyo wa Aroni kila mara aingiapo mbele za Bwana. Kwa hiyo siku zote Aroni atakuwa na uwezo kufanya maamuzi kwa ajili ya wana wa Israeli mbele za Bwana.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: “Shona joho la kisibau lote kwa kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu tupu,
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

kikuyu: na katikati uweke nafasi ya kuingizia kichwa. Kutakuwa na utepe uliofumwa, unaofanana na ukosi kuizunguka nafasi hiyo, ili isichanike.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

kikuyu: Tengeneza makomamanga ya nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu kuzunguka pindo la hilo joho, na uweke pia vikengele vya dhahabu kati ya hayo makomamanga.
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

kikuyu: Hivyo vikengele vya dhahabu na makomamanga vitapishana kuzunguka upindo wa joho lile.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

kikuyu: Ni lazima Aroni alivae anapofanya huduma. Sauti ya hivyo vikengele itasikika anapoingia na kutoka Mahali Patakatifu mbele za Bwana, ili asije akafa.
english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he not die.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza bamba la dhahabu safi na uchore juu yake maneno haya kama vile muhuri huchorwa: Mtakatifu kwa Bwana.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO THE LORD.’

kikuyu: Lifunge hilo bamba kwa kamba ya buluu kwenye kilemba, nalo ni lazima liwe mbele ya kilemba.
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

kikuyu: Aroni alivae bamba hilo kwenye paji la uso wake, naye atachukua hatia kuhusu sadaka takatifu za Waisraeli wanazoweka wakfu, sadaka za aina yoyote. Litakuwa kwenye paji la uso wa Aroni daima ili zikubalike kwa Bwana.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: “Fuma koti la kitani safi na ufanye kilemba cha kitani safi. Mshipi uwe ni kazi ya mtarizi.
english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Watengenezee wana wa Aroni makoti, mishipi na kofia, ili kuwapa ukuu na heshima.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumvika Aroni ndugu yako pamoja na wanawe nguo hizi, watie mafuta na kuwabariki. Waweke wakfu ili wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: “Watengenezee nguo za ndani za kitani zitakazofunika mwili, kutoka kiunoni hadi mapajani.
english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

kikuyu: Aroni na wanawe ni lazima wavae haya kila wanapoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au wanaposogelea madhabahu wakati wa kutoa huduma katika Mahali Patakatifu, ili wasije wakafanya kosa wakafa. “Haya yawe maagizo ya kudumu kwa Aroni na vizazi vyake.
english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

kikuyu: “Hili ndilo utakalofanya ili kuwaweka wakfu makuhani ili wanitumikie mimi katika kazi ya ukuhani: Chukua fahali mchanga mmoja na kondoo dume wawili wasio na dosari.
english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

kikuyu: Kutokana na unga laini wa ngano usiotiwa chachu, tengeneza mikate na maandazi yaliyokandwa kwa mafuta, pamoja na mikate midogo myembamba.
english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

kikuyu: Viwekwe vyote ndani ya kikapu na kuvitoa pamoja na yule fahali na wale kondoo dume wawili.
english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

kikuyu: Kisha mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.
english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: Chukua yale mavazi na umvike Aroni koti, joho la kisibau na kisibau chenyewe pamoja na kile kifuko cha kifuani. Mfungie hicho kisibau kwa ule mshipi wa kiunoni uliosukwa kwa ustadi.
english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Weka kilemba kichwani mwake na kuweka taji takatifu ishikamane na hicho kilemba.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

kikuyu: Chukua yale mafuta ya upako umimine juu ya kichwa chake.
english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

kikuyu: Walete wanawe na uwavike makoti,
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: pia uwavike zile tepe za kichwani. Ndipo uwafunge Aroni na wanawe mishipi. Ukuhani ni wao kwa agizo la kudumu. Kwa njia hii utamweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

kikuyu: “Mlete yule fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

kikuyu: Mchinje huyo fahali mbele za Bwana kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
english: You shall kill the bull before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Chukua sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali na kuipaka kwenye pembe za hayo madhabahu kwa kidole chako, na damu iliyobaki uimwage sehemu ya chini ya madhabahu.
english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Kisha chukua mafuta yote ya huyo mnyama ya sehemu za ndani, yale yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, uviteketeze juu ya madhabahu.
english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

kikuyu: Lakini nyama ya huyo fahali na ngozi yake na matumbo yake utavichoma nje ya kambi. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: “Chukua mmoja wa wale kondoo dume, naye Aroni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Mchinje huyo kondoo dume, chukua damu yake na uinyunyize pande zote za hayo madhabahu.
english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

kikuyu: Mkate huyo kondoo dume vipande vipande na usafishe sehemu za ndani pamoja na miguu, ukiviweka pamoja na kichwa na vipande vingine.
english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

kikuyu: Kisha mteketeze huyo kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa Bwana, harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “Mchukue yule kondoo dume mwingine, naye Aroni na wanawe waweke mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Mchinje, uchukue sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka kwenye masikio ya Aroni na wanawe, kwenye vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kuume, pia kwenye vidole gumba vya miguu yao ya kuume. Kisha nyunyiza hiyo damu pande zote za madhabahu.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Pia chukua sehemu ya damu iliyo juu ya madhabahu na sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, umnyunyizie Aroni na mavazi yake, pia wanawe na mavazi yao. Ndipo Aroni na wanawe pamoja na mavazi yao watakuwa wamewekwa wakfu.
english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

kikuyu: “Chukua mafuta ya huyu kondoo dume, mafuta ya mkia, mafuta ya sehemu za ndani yale yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili na mafuta yake, pamoja na paja la kulia. (Huyo ndiye kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu.)
english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

kikuyu: Kutoka kwenye kile kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichoko mbele za Bwana, chukua mkate, andazi lililokandwa kwa mafuta na mkate mdogo mwembamba.
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.

kikuyu: Viweke vitu hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe na uviinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha vichukue vitu hivyo kutoka mikononi mwao, uviteketeze juu ya madhabahu pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa harufu nzuri ya kupendeza kwa Bwana, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Baada ya kuchukua kidari cha huyo kondoo dume wa kuwekwa wakfu kwa Aroni, kiinue mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa, nayo itakuwa fungu lako.
english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be your portion.

kikuyu: “Weka wakfu zile sehemu za kondoo dume aliyetumika kwa kumweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe: kidari kile kilichoinuliwa na lile paja lililotolewa.
english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

kikuyu: Siku zote hili litakuwa fungu la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe. Hili ni toleo la Waisraeli watakalotoa kwa Bwana kutoka sadaka zao za amani.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: “Mavazi matakatifu ya Aroni yatakuwa ya wazao wake ili kwamba waweze kutiwa mafuta na kuwekwa wakfu wakiwa wameyavaa.
english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

kikuyu: Mwana atakayeingia mahali pake kuwa kuhani na kuja kwenye Hema la Kukutania kuhudumu katika Mahali Patakatifu atayavaa kwa siku saba.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

kikuyu: “Chukua nyama ya huyo kondoo dume wa kuwaweka wakfu uipike katika Mahali Patakatifu.
english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

kikuyu: Aroni na wanawe wataila ile nyama ya huyo kondoo dume pamoja na ile mikate iliyo kwenye hicho kikapu wakiwa hapo ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Watakula sadaka hizi ambazo upatanisho ulifanywa kwazo kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu na kuwatakasa. Lakini hakuna mtu mwingine yeyote anayeruhusiwa kuvila, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.
english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

kikuyu: Ikiwa nyama yoyote ya huyo kondoo dume iliyotumika kwa kuwaweka wakfu au mkate wowote umebaki mpaka asubuhi, vichomwe. Kamwe visiliwe, kwa sababu ni vitakatifu.
english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

kikuyu: “Hivyo utamfanyia Aroni na wanawe kila kitu kama vile nilivyokuamuru: Utachukua muda wa siku saba kuwaweka wakfu.
english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

kikuyu: Utatoa dhabihu ya fahali kila siku kuwa sadaka ya dhambi ili kufanya upatanisho. Takasa madhabahu kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, nayo uitie mafuta na kuiweka wakfu.
english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

kikuyu: Kwa muda wa siku saba fanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu na kuiweka wakfu. Ndipo madhabahu itakuwa takatifu sana na chochote kitakachoigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.
english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

kikuyu: “Kwa kawaida hiki ndicho utakachotoa juu ya madhabahu kila siku: wana-kondoo wawili wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja.
english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

kikuyu: Utamtoa mmoja asubuhi na huyo mwingine jioni.
english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mwana-kondoo wa kwanza utatoa efa moja ya unga wa ngano laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta yaliyokamuliwa, pamoja na robo ya hini ya divai kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji.
english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

kikuyu: Huyo mwana-kondoo mwingine mtoe dhabihu wakati wa machweo pamoja na sadaka za unga na za kinywaji kama vile ulivyofanya asubuhi, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “Kwa vizazi vijavyo itakuwa kawaida kutoa sadaka hii ya kuteketezwa kila mara kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana. Hapo ndipo nitakapokutana na ninyi na kusema nanyi,
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

kikuyu: Huko ndipo nitakapokutana na Waisraeli, nalo Hema la Kukutania litatakaswa na utukufu wangu.
english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

kikuyu: “Kwa hiyo nitaliweka wakfu Hema la Kukutania pamoja na madhabahu, nami nitamweka wakfu Aroni na wanawe ili wanitumikie mimi katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Ndipo nitakapofanya makao miongoni mwa Waisraeli na kuwa Mungu wao.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

kikuyu: Nao watajua kuwa Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wao, aliyewatoa Misri ili nipate kufanya makao miongoni mwao. Mimi Ndimi Bwana Mungu wao.
english: They shall know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.

kikuyu: “Tengeneza madhabahu kwa mbao za mshita kwa ajili ya kufukizia uvumba.
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

kikuyu: Madhabahu hayo yawe mraba, urefu na upana wake dhiraa moja, na kimo cha dhiraa mbili, nazo pembe zake zitakuwa kitu kimoja nayo.
english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.
