english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akatengeneza vito vya shohamu vilivyowekwa katika vijalizo vya dhahabu, navyo vilichorwa na majina ya wana wa Israeli kama vile muhuri huchorwa.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kisha akavifungia kwenye vipande vya mabega ya kisibau kuwa vito vya ukumbusho kwa wana wa Israeli, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akafanyiza kifuko cha kifuani, kazi ya fundi stadi. Akakitengeneza kama kile kisibau: cha dhahabu, na nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na za rangi nyekundu, cha kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Kifuko hicho kilikuwa cha mraba, chenye urefu wa shibiri moja na upana wa shibiri moja, nacho kilikunjwa mara mbili.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

kikuyu: Kifuko hicho kilipambwa kwa safu nne za vito vya thamani. Safu ya kwanza ilikuwa na akiki, yakuti manjano na zabarajadi;
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

kikuyu: safu ya pili ilikuwa na almasi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: safu ya tatu ilikuwa na hiakintho, akiki nyekundu na amethisto;
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: katika safu ya nne ilikuwa na krisolitho, shohamu na yaspi. Vito hivyo vilitiwa kwenye vijalizo vya dhahabu.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

kikuyu: Palikuwa na vito kumi na viwili, kila kimoja kikiwa na jina mojawapo la wana wa Israeli; kila kimoja kilichorwa kama muhuri kikiwa na jina mojawapo la yale makabila kumi na mawili.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya kile kifuko cha kifuani akakitengenezea mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Akatengeneza vijalizo viwili vya dhahabu na pete mbili za dhahabu, na kuzifungia pete hizo kwenye pembe mbili za hicho kifuko cha kifuani.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Akafunga hiyo mikufu miwili ya dhahabu kwenye hizo pete katika pembe za hicho kifuko cha kifuani,
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: nazo zile ncha nyingine za mkufu akazifunga kwenye vile vijalizo viwili, na kuzishikamanisha na vile vipande vya mabega vya kile kisibau upande wa mbele.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

kikuyu: Akatengeneza pete mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha kwenye pembe mbili za chini, upande wa ndani wa kifuko cha kifuani karibu na kisibau.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Kisha akatengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu na kuzishikamanisha sehemu ya chini ya vipande vya mabega upande wa mbele wa kile kisibau, karibu na pindo juu kidogo ya mshipi wa kiunoni wa kisibau.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Akafunga pete za hicho kifuko cha kifuani kwenye pete za kisibau kwa kamba ya buluu, wakiziunganisha na ule mshipi wa kiunoni, ili kifuko cha kifuani kisisogee kutoka kwenye kile kisibau, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akashona joho la kisibau lote kwa kitambaa cha rangi ya buluu tupu, kazi ya mfumaji,
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

kikuyu: na lilikuwa na nafasi ya shingo katikati ya joho lile iliyofanana na ukosi, na utepe ulioshonwa kuizunguka nafasi hiyo ili isichanike.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

kikuyu: Akatengeneza makomamanga ya nyuzi za rangi ya buluu, za zambarau, na nyekundu na ya kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri kuzunguka pindo la hilo joho.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

kikuyu: Kisha akatengeneza vikengele vya dhahabu safi na kuvishikamanisha kuzunguka pindo hilo kati ya hayo makomamanga.
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

kikuyu: Hivyo vikengele na makomamanga vilipishana kuzunguka upindo wa joho ili livaliwe kwa kuhudumu, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Pia akamtengenezea Aroni na wanawe makoti ya kitani safi, kazi ya mfumaji,
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

kikuyu: na kilemba cha kitani safi, tepe za kichwani za kitani, na nguo za ndani za kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

kikuyu: Mshipi ulikuwa wa kitani iliyosokotwa vizuri ya rangi ya buluu, na zambarau, na nyekundu, kazi ya mtarizi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha akatengeneza lile bamba, taji takatifu, kwa dhahabu safi na kuchora juu yake maneno haya kama vile muhuri huchorwa: Mtakatifu kwa Bwana.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.

kikuyu: Kisha wakalifunga kwa kamba ya rangi ya buluu ili kulishikamanisha na kile kilemba kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo kazi yote ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania ikakamilika. Waisraeli wakafanya kila kitu sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.

kikuyu: Ndipo wakaleta maskani kwa Mose: hema pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote, vibanio vyake, mihimili yake, mataruma yake, nguzo na vitako vyake;
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: kifuniko cha ngozi za kondoo dume kilichotiwa rangi nyekundu, kifuniko cha ngozi za pomboo, pazia la kufunikia;
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

kikuyu: Sanduku la Ushuhuda pamoja na mipiko yake na kiti cha rehema,
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

kikuyu: meza pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote na mikate ya Wonyesho;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

kikuyu: kinara cha taa cha dhahabu safi, safu zake za taa pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote pamoja na mafuta kwa ajili ya taa;
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

kikuyu: madhabahu ya dhahabu, mafuta ya upako, uvumba wenye harufu nzuri na pazia la ingilio la hema;
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

kikuyu: madhabahu ya shaba, pamoja na wavu wa shaba, nguzo zake na vyombo vyake vyote, sinia, na tako lake;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: mapazia ya ua pamoja na nguzo na vitako vyake, pia na pazia kwa ajili ya ingilio la kwenye ua; kamba zake na vigingi vya hema kwa ajili ya ua; vyombo vyote vilivyohitajiwa kwa ajili ya maskani, Hema la Kukutania;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: na mavazi yaliyofumwa yanayovaliwa wakati wa huduma katika mahali patakatifu, yaani mavazi matakatifu ya kuhani Aroni na mavazi kwa ajili ya wanawe watakapokuwa wakihudumu katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Waisraeli walikuwa wamefanya kazi yote sawasawa na vile Bwana alivyokuwa amemwagiza Mose.
english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

kikuyu: Mose akakagua kazi na kuona kuwa walikuwa wameifanya sawasawa kama vile Bwana alivyokuwa ameagiza. Kwa hiyo Mose akawabariki.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Simika Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza.
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Weka Sanduku la Ushuhuda ndani yake na ulifunike kwa pazia. Ingiza meza na kupanga vitu vyake juu yake.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

kikuyu: Kisha ingiza kinara cha taa na uweke taa zake juu yake.
english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

kikuyu: Weka madhabahu ya dhahabu ya kufukizia uvumba mbele ya Sanduku la Ushuhuda kisha uweke pazia kwenye lango la Maskani ya Mungu.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: “Weka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa mbele ya lango la Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania;
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: weka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, na uweke maji ndani yake.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

kikuyu: Fanyiza ua kuzunguka maskani na uweke pazia penye ingilio la ua.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

kikuyu: “Chukua mafuta ya upako, ipake Maskani ya Mungu pamoja na kila kitu kilichomo ndani yake; iweke wakfu pamoja na vitu vyote vilivyomo ndani mwake, nayo itakuwa takatifu.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

kikuyu: Kisha yapake mafuta hayo madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka pamoja na vifaa vyake vyote; weka wakfu madhabahu nayo yatakuwa takatifu sana.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

kikuyu: Paka sinia mafuta pamoja na kishikilio chake na uviweke wakfu.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

kikuyu: “Mlete Aroni na wanawe kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na uwaoshe kwa maji.
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: Kisha mvike Aroni yale mavazi matakatifu, umtie mafuta na kumweka wakfu ili apate kunitumikia katikati ya ukuhani.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Walete wanawe na uwavike makoti.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: Kisha watie mafuta kama ulivyomtia baba yao, ili nao pia wanitumikie katika kazi ya ukuhani. Kutiwa mafuta kwao kutakuwa kwa ajili ya ukuhani utakaoendelea kwa vizazi vyote vijavyo.”
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

kikuyu: Mose akafanya kila kitu sawa kama vile Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Maskani ya Mungu ilisimikwa katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kwanza, katika mwaka wa pili.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

kikuyu: Mose alipoweka wakfu Maskani ya Mungu, aliweka vitako mahali pake, akasimamisha mihimili, akatia mataruma na kusimamisha nguzo.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

kikuyu: Kisha akalitandaza hema juu ya Maskani ya Mungu na kuifunika hema, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akachukua ule Ushuhuda na kuuweka ndani ya Sanduku la Agano, akaweka ile mipiko ya kubebea hilo Sanduku na kuweka kiti cha rehema juu yake.
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akalileta Sanduku ndani ya Maskani ya Mungu, akatundika pazia ili kulifunika Sanduku la Ushuhuda, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mose akaweka meza ndani ya Hema la Kukutania, upande wa kaskazini ya Maskani ya Mungu nje ya pazia
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

kikuyu: na kupanga mikate juu yake mbele za Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akaweka kinara cha taa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mkabala na meza upande wa kusini mwa Maskani ya Mungu
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: na kuziweka taa mbele za Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mose akaweka madhabahu ya dhahabu ndani ya Hema la Kukutania mbele ya pazia
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

kikuyu: na kufukiza uvumba wenye harufu nzuri, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Mose akaweka madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa karibu na ingilio la Maskani ya Mungu, yaani Hema la Kukutania, na kutoa juu yake sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za nafaka kama Bwana alivyomwagiza.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akaweka sinia kati ya Hema la Kukutania na madhabahu, akaweka maji ndani yake kwa ajili ya kunawia,
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

kikuyu: Naye Mose, Aroni na wanawe wakayatumia kwa kunawia mikono na miguu yao.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

kikuyu: Wakanawa kila walipoingia katika Hema la Kukutania au walipoikaribia madhabahu kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akafanya ua kuizunguka Maskani ya Mungu na madhabahu, pia akaweka pazia kwenye ingilio la huo ua. Hivyo Mose akaikamilisha kazi.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

kikuyu: Ndipo wingu likafunika Hema la Kukutania, na utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Mose hakuweza kuingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kwa sababu wingu lilikuwa limetua juu ya Hema, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukaijaza Maskani ya Mungu.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Katika safari yote ya Waisraeli, kila wakati wingu lilipoinuka kutoka juu ya Maskani ya Mungu, wangeondoka;
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

kikuyu: lakini kama wingu halikuinuka, hawakuondoka, mpaka siku lilipoinuka.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wingu la Bwana lilikuwa juu ya maskani mchana, na moto ulikuwa katika hilo wingu wakati wa usiku, machoni pa nyumba yote ya Israeli siku zote za safari zao.
english: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwita Mose na kusema naye kutoka kwenye Hema la Kukutania, akamwambia,
english: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: “Sema na Waisraeli na uwaambie, ‘Yeyote miongoni mwenu aletapo sadaka ya mnyama kwa Bwana, alete mnyama kama sadaka yake kutoka kundi lake la ngʼombe au la kondoo na mbuzi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama sadaka hiyo ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la ngʼombe, atamtoa ngʼombe dume asiye na dosari. Ni lazima amlete kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania ili aweze kukubalika kwa Bwana.
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka ya kuteketezwa, nayo itakubaliwa kwa niaba yake ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

kikuyu: Atamchinja yule fahali mchanga mbele za Bwana, kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani wataleta damu na kuinyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu yaliyo penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Ataichuna hiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuikata vipande vipande.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

kikuyu: Wana wa Aroni kuhani wataweka moto juu ya madhabahu na kupanga kuni juu ya huo moto.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

kikuyu: Kisha wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watapanga vile vipande vya nyama, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya huyo mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

kikuyu: Ataziosha sehemu za ndani na miguu yake kwa maji, naye kuhani atavichoma vyote juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, yenye harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama sadaka ni ya kuteketezwa kutoka kwenye kundi la kondoo au mbuzi, atamtoa mnyama dume asiye na dosari.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

kikuyu: Atamchinjia upande wa kaskazini wa madhabahu mbele za Bwana, nao wana wa Aroni walio makuhani watanyunyizia damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Atamkata vipande vipande, naye kuhani atavipanga, pamoja na kichwa na mafuta ya mnyama juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

kikuyu: Ataosha sehemu za ndani na miguu kwa maji, naye kuhani atavileta vyote na kuvichoma juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa inayotolewa kwa Bwana ni ndege, atamtoa hua au kinda la njiwa.
english: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

kikuyu: Kuhani atamleta kwenye madhabahu, naye atamvunja shingo na kumnyofoa kichwa na kumchoma juu ya madhabahu. Damu yake itachuruzishwa ubavuni mwa madhabahu.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

kikuyu: Ataondoa kifuko cha chakula pamoja na uchafu wake na kuvitupa upande wa mashariki wa madhabahu, mahali pale penye majivu.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

kikuyu: Atampasua na kumweka wazi katika mabawa yake, lakini asimwachanishe kabisa, kisha kuhani ataichoma juu ya zile kuni zinazowaka juu ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mtu yeyote aletapo sadaka ya nafaka kwa Bwana, sadaka yake itakuwa ya unga laini. Atamimina mafuta juu yake, aweke uvumba juu yake,
english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

kikuyu: naye atapeleka kwa makuhani wana wa Aroni. Kuhani atachukua konzi moja iliyojaa unga laini na mafuta pamoja na uvumba wote, na kuuteketeza kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu juu ya madhabahu, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki ni ya Aroni na wanawe, ni sehemu ya sadaka iliyo takatifu sana iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama utaleta sadaka ya nafaka iliyookwa jikoni, itakuwa ya unga laini: maandazi yaliyotengenezwa bila kutiwa chachu, yaliyochanganywa na mafuta, au mikate myembamba iliyotengenezwa bila kutiwa chachu, na iliyopakwa mafuta.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

kikuyu: Iwapo sadaka yako ya nafaka imeandaliwa kwenye kikaango, itakuwa ni ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, bila chachu.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

kikuyu: Ukande na kumimina mafuta juu yake; hii ni sadaka ya nafaka.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Kama sadaka yako ya nafaka imepikwa kwenye sufuria, itatengenezwa kwa unga laini na mafuta.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

kikuyu: Ilete hiyo sadaka ya nafaka iliyotengenezwa kwa vitu hivi kwa Bwana; mkabidhi kuhani ambaye ataipeleka madhabahuni.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

kikuyu: Naye atatoa ile sehemu ya kumbukumbu kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya nafaka na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki ni ya Aroni na wanawe; ni sehemu ya sadaka iliyo takatifu sana ya sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kila sadaka ya nafaka unayoleta kwa Bwana ni lazima ifanywe bila kutiwa chachu, kwa kuwa huna ruhusa kuchoma chachu yoyote au asali katika sadaka itolewayo kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Unaweza kuzileta kwa Bwana kama sadaka ya malimbuko, lakini haziwezi kutolewa juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

kikuyu: Koleza sadaka zako zote za nafaka kwa chumvi. Usiache kuweka chumvi ya Agano la Mungu wako katika sadaka zako za nafaka; weka chumvi kwenye sadaka zako zote.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama ukileta malimbuko ya sadaka ya nafaka kwa Bwana, utatoa masuke yaliyopondwa ya nafaka mpya iliyookwa kwa moto.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

kikuyu: Weka mafuta na uvumba juu yake; ni sadaka ya nafaka.
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Kuhani atateketeza ile sehemu ya kumbukumbu kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya nafaka iliyopondwa kwa mafuta, pamoja na uvumba wote, kama sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama sadaka ya mtu ni sadaka ya amani, naye akatoa ngʼombe kutoka kundi, akiwa dume au jike, atamleta mnyama asiye na dosari mbele za Bwana.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka yake na kumchinja penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania. Ndipo makuhani wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya amani ataleta sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yote ya mnyama yafunikayo sehemu za ndani, ama yanayoungana na hizo sehemu za ndani,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: figo zote pamoja na mafuta yote yanayozizunguka karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo atayaondoa pamoja na figo.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Kisha wana wa Aroni wataiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, juu ya ile sadaka ya kuteketezwa iliyoko juu ya kuni zinazowaka, kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama akitoa kondoo au mbuzi kutoka kundi kama sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana, atamtoa dume au jike asiye na dosari.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

kikuyu: Kama akimtoa mwana-kondoo, atamleta mbele za Bwana.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka yake, naye atamchinja mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Kisha wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya amani ataleta dhabihu iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yake, mafuta yote ya mkia uliokatwa karibu na uti wa mgongo, mafuta yote yanayofunika sehemu za ndani au yale yanayounganika nazo,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

kikuyu: figo mbili pamoja na mafuta yanayozizunguka yaliyo karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo atayatoa pamoja na figo.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu kama chakula, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama sadaka yake ni mbuzi, ataileta mbele za Bwana.
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa chake na kumchinja mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Kisha wana wa Aroni watanyunyiza damu yake kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Kutokana na ile sadaka anayotoa, atatoa sadaka hii kwa Bwana kwa moto: mafuta yote yanayofunika sehemu za ndani na yale yanayoungana nazo,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yaliyo juu yake karibu na kiuno na yanayofunika ini, ambayo atayaondoa pamoja na figo.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu kama chakula, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa moto, harufu nzuri. Mafuta yote ya mnyama ni ya Bwana.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: “ ‘Hii ni kanuni ya kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo, popote muishipo: Msile mafuta yoyote ya mnyama wala damu.’ ”
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mtu yeyote afanyapo dhambi bila kukusudia na akatenda lile lililokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana:
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta amefanya dhambi na kuwaletea watu hatia, lazima alete kwa Bwana fahali mchanga asiye na dosari, kuwa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya dhambi aliyotenda.
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to the LORD for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Atamkabidhi huyo fahali kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana. Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali na kumchinja mbele za Bwana.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani huyo aliyetiwa mafuta atachukua sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali na kuileta katika Hema la Kukutania.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Atachovya kidole chake katika hiyo damu na kuinyunyiza sehemu yake mara saba mbele za Bwana mbele ya pazia la mahali patakatifu.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atatia sehemu ya hiyo damu juu ya pembe za madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba wenye harufu nzuri iliyoko mbele za Bwana katika Hema la Kukutania. Damu iliyobaki ya huyo fahali ataimwaga chini ya hayo madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Atayaondoa mafuta yote ya fahali huyo wa sadaka ya dhambi, mafuta yale yanayofunika sehemu za ndani au zile zinazounganika nazo,
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: figo zote mbili na mafuta yaliyo juu yake karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini ambayo atayaondoa pamoja na figo zote,
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

kikuyu: kama vile mafuta yanayoondolewa kutoka kwenye maksai aliyetolewa sadaka ya amani. Kisha kuhani ataviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Lakini ngozi ya huyo fahali na nyama zake zote, pamoja na kichwa na miguu yake, sehemu za ndani na matumbo,
english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

kikuyu: yaani sehemu nyingine zote zilizobaki za huyo fahali, lazima azitoe nje ya kambi mpaka mahali palipo safi kiibada, ambapo majivu hutupwa, naye atamchoma kwa moto juu ya kuni zilizoko juu ya lundo la majivu.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa jumuiya yote ya Israeli watatenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia na kufanya lile lililokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana, hata kama jumuiya haifahamu juu ya jambo hilo, wana hatia.
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

kikuyu: Wanapotambua kuhusu dhambi waliyoitenda, lazima kusanyiko lilete fahali mchanga kuwa sadaka ya dhambi na kuikabidhi mbele ya Hema la Kukutania.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Wazee wa jumuiya wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha huyo fahali aliye mbele za Bwana, naye fahali atachinjwa mbele za Bwana.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD; and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta ataiingiza sehemu ya damu ya huyo fahali ndani ya Hema la Kukutania.
english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Atachovya kidole chake kwenye damu na kuinyunyiza mara saba mbele za Bwana mbele ya hilo pazia.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, before the veil.

kikuyu: Atatia sehemu ya hiyo damu juu ya pembe za madhabahu yaliyo mbele za Bwana katika Hema la Kukutania. Damu iliyobaki ataimwaga chini ya madhabahu ya kuteketezea sadaka, penye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Atayaondoa mafuta yote ya yule fahali na kuyateketeza juu ya madhabahu,
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

kikuyu: naye atamfanyia fahali huyu kama alivyomfanyia yule fahali mwingine wa sadaka ya dhambi. Kwa njia hii kuhani atawafanyia watu upatanisho, nao watasamehewa.
english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Kisha atamchukua yule fahali nje ya kambi na kumteketeza kama alivyomteketeza yule wa kwanza. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya jumuiya.
english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wakati kiongozi ametenda dhambi bila kukusudia na kufanya yaliyokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana Mungu wake, ana hatia.
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

kikuyu: Atakapofahamishwa dhambi aliyotenda, ni lazima alete mbuzi dume asiye na dosari kama sadaka yake.
english: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha yule mbuzi na kumchinja mahali pale ambapo sadaka za kuteketezwa huchinjiwa mbele za Bwana. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya damu ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa kidole chake na kuitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketeza, na kuimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Atayateketeza mafuta yote juu ya madhabahu, kama alivyoteketeza mafuta ya sadaka ya amani. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho wa dhambi kwa ajili ya yule mtu, naye atasamehewa.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama mtu katika jumuiya ametenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia na kufanya lile lililokatazwa katika amri yoyote ya Bwana, yeye ana hatia.
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

kikuyu: Atakapofahamishwa dhambi yake aliyoitenda, ni lazima alete mbuzi jike asiye na dosari kama sadaka yake kwa ajili ya dhambi aliyotenda.
english: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha sadaka ya dhambi na kumchinjia mahali pa kuteketezea sadaka.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya ile damu kwa kidole chake na kuitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Atayaondoa mafuta yote, kama vile mafuta yaondolewavyo kwenye sadaka ya amani, naye kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atasamehewa.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to the LORD; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa ataleta mwana-kondoo kama sadaka yake ya dhambi, atamleta jike asiye na dosari.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

kikuyu: Ataweka mkono wake juu ya kichwa cha huyo mwana-kondoo na kumchinja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi mahali sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atachukua sehemu ya damu ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa kidole chake na kuitia juu ya pembe za madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na ile damu iliyobaki ataimwaga chini ya madhabahu.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Ataondoa mafuta yote, kama vile mafuta yaondolewavyo kutoka kwenye mwana-kondoo wa sadaka ya amani, naye kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu juu ya zile sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi aliyoitenda, naye atasamehewa.
english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atakuwa ametenda dhambi kwa sababu hakusema alipotakiwa kutoa ushahidi hadharani kuhusu jambo aliloona au kujua habari zake, yeye anastahili adhabu.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: “ ‘Au kama mtu akigusa kitu chochote ambacho ni najisi, iwe ni mizoga ya wanyama pori walio najisi, au ya wanyama wafugwao walio najisi, au ya viumbe vitambaavyo ardhini, hata akiwa hana habari, amekuwa najisi na mwenye hatia.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

kikuyu: “ ‘Au kama akigusa kitu kilicho kichafu kinachotokana na binadamu, kitu chochote kile kinachoweza kumfanya awe najisi, hata akiwa hana habari, atakapofahamu atakuwa na hatia.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

kikuyu: “ ‘Au kama mtu ameapa kufanya kitu chochote bila kufikiri, kiwe chema au kibaya, kwa vyovyote mtu aweza kuapa bila kujali, hata akiwa hana habari, atakapofahamu atakuwa na hatia.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wakati mtu yeyote atakapokuwa na hatia katika mojawapo ya haya, lazima akiri ni kwa njia gani ametenda dhambi,
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

kikuyu: na kama adhabu ya dhambi aliyoitenda, lazima alete kwa Bwana kondoo jike au mbuzi jike kutoka kwenye kundi lake kama sadaka ya dhambi; naye kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi yake.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lakini huyo mtu kama hataweza kumtoa mwana-kondoo, ataleta hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa kwa Bwana kuwa adhabu kwa ajili ya dhambi yake, mmoja wa hao ndege kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na wa pili kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

kikuyu: Atawaleta kwa kuhani, ambaye atamtoa kwanza ndege mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi. Atamvunja shingo na kuacha kichwa chake kikiningʼinia,
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

kikuyu: naye atanyunyiza sehemu ya hiyo damu ya sadaka ya dhambi kwenye pembe za madhabahu. Damu iliyobaki lazima ichuruzwe chini ya madhabahu. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atamtoa yule ndege wa pili kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa kufuata utaratibu uliowekwa, na hivyo kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi aliyoitenda, naye atasamehewa.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa basi, hawezi kupata hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, ataleta sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi. Kamwe asiweke mafuta wala uvumba juu yake, kwa sababu ni sadaka ya dhambi.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Atauleta unga kwa kuhani, ambaye atachukua konzi moja kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na atauteketeza kwenye madhabahu juu ya sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Hii ni sadaka ya dhambi.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa dhambi yoyote ya hizo alizotenda, naye atasamehewa. Sadaka iliyobaki itakuwa ya kuhani, kama ilivyokuwa ile sadaka ya nafaka.’ ”
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Mtu anapokiuka na kutenda dhambi pasipo kukusudia kuhusu mojawapo ya mambo matakatifu ya Bwana, huyo mtu ataleta kwa Bwana kama adhabu kondoo dume mmoja kutoka kundi lake, asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani halisi kifedha, kulingana na shekeli ya mahali patakatifu. Hii ni sadaka ya hatia.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding the LORD’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

kikuyu: Ni lazima alipe kwa yale aliyoshindwa kufanya kuhusu vitu vitakatifu, kwa kuongeza sehemu ya tano ya thamani ile na kuitoa yote kwa kuhani, ambaye atamfanyia upatanisho kwa huyo kondoo dume kama sadaka ya dhambi, naye atasamehewa.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akifanya dhambi na kufanya yale yaliyokatazwa katika mojawapo ya amri za Bwana, hata ikiwa hajui, yeye ana hatia na anastahili adhabu.
english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: Atamletea kuhani kama sadaka ya hatia kondoo dume kutoka kundi lake, kondoo asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani halisi kifedha. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake kwa kosa alilotenda bila kukusudia, naye atasamehewa.
english: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Hii ni sadaka ya hatia; amekuwa na hatia kwa kufanya kosa dhidi ya Bwana.”
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Kama mtu yeyote akitenda dhambi, naye si mwaminifu kwa Bwana kwa kumdanganya jirani yake kuhusu kitu fulani alichokabidhiwa, au kimeachwa chini ya utunzaji wake, au kimeibwa, au kama akimdanganya,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against the LORD, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

kikuyu: au akiokota mali iliyopotea na akadanganya, au kuapa kwa uongo, au kama akitenda dhambi yoyote ambayo watu waweza kuitenda;
english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

kikuyu: wakati akitenda dhambi hizo na kuwa mwenye hatia, ni lazima arudishe kile alichokuwa amekiiba au amekichukua kwa dhuluma, au alichokuwa amekabidhiwa, au mali iliyokuwa imepotea akaipata,
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

kikuyu: au chochote alichokuwa amekiapia kwa uongo. Lazima akirudishe kikamilifu, na aongeze sehemu ya tano ya thamani yake, vyote ampe mwenye mali siku ile anapeleka sadaka yake ya hatia.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

kikuyu: Kisha kama adhabu lazima amletee kuhani, yaani kwa Bwana, kama sadaka yake ya hatia, kondoo dume asiye na dosari na mwenye thamani kamili kutoka kundi lake.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

kikuyu: Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana, naye atasamehewa kwa kosa lolote katika mambo hayo aliyoyatenda yaliyomfanya kuwa na hatia.”
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Mpe Aroni na wanawe agizo hili: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa: Sadaka ya kuteketezwa itabaki kwenye moto juu ya madhabahu usiku kucha, mpaka asubuhi, nao moto lazima uwe unaendelea kuwaka juu ya madhabahu.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atavaa mavazi yake ya kitani, pamoja na nguo za ndani za kitani mwilini wake, na aondoe majivu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa ambayo moto umeteketeza juu ya madhabahu, na kuyaweka kando ya madhabahu.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

kikuyu: Kisha atayavua mavazi haya na kuvaa mengine, naye achukue yale majivu nje ya kambi na kuyapeleka mahali palipo safi kwa kawaida ya ibada.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

kikuyu: Moto ulio juu ya madhabahu lazima uwe unaendelea kuwaka, kamwe usizimike. Kila asubuhi kuhani ataongeza kuni na kupanga sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya moto, na kuteketeza mafuta ya sadaka za amani juu yake.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

kikuyu: Moto lazima uendelee kuwaka juu ya madhabahu mfululizo, kamwe usizimike.
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

kikuyu: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti ya sadaka ya nafaka: Wana wa Aroni wataileta mbele za Bwana, mbele za madhabahu.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

kikuyu: Kuhani atachukua konzi ya unga laini na mafuta, pamoja na uvumba wote ulioko juu ya sadaka ya nafaka, ateketeze sehemu ya kumbukumbu juu ya madhabahu kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to the LORD.

kikuyu: Aroni na wanawe watakula sehemu iliyobaki, lakini italiwa bila kutiwa chachu mahali patakatifu, nao wataila kwenye ua wa Hema la Kukutania.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Kamwe haitaokwa na chachu; nimewapa kama fungu lao la sadaka iliyotolewa kwangu kwa moto. Ni takatifu sana, kama vile ilivyo sadaka ya dhambi na ya hatia.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

kikuyu: Kila mwanaume mzao wa Aroni aweza kuila. Ni fungu lake la kawaida la sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto kwa vizazi vijavyo. Chochote kinachozigusa kitakuwa kitakatifu.’ ”
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

kikuyu: Tena Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Hii ni sadaka ambayo Aroni na wanawe wanapaswa kuleta kwa Bwana siku atakapotiwa mafuta: sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kama sadaka ya kawaida ya nafaka. Nusu yake ataitoa asubuhi na nusu nyingine jioni.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

kikuyu: Iandae kwa mafuta kwenye kikaango; ilete ikiwa imechanganywa vizuri, na utoe hiyo sadaka ya nafaka ikiwa imevunjwa vipande vipande kuwa harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Mwanawe atakayeingia mahali pake kama kuhani aliyetiwa mafuta ndiye atakayeiandaa. Ni fungu la kawaida la Bwana, nalo litateketezwa kabisa.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kila sadaka ya nafaka ya kuhani itateketezwa kabisa; kamwe haitaliwa.”
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Mwambie Aroni na wanawe: ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi: Sadaka ya dhambi itachinjiwa mbele za Bwana mahali sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, ni takatifu sana.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before the LORD. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Kuhani anayeitoa ndiye atakayeikula; itakuliwa katika mahali patakatifu, katika ua wa Hema la Kukutania.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Chochote kitakachogusa nyama yoyote ya hiyo sadaka kitakuwa kitakatifu, na kama hiyo damu itadondokea juu ya vazi, lazima uifulie mahali patakatifu.
english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

kikuyu: Chungu cha udongo kitakachopikiwa nyama lazima kivunjwe, lakini kama imepikiwa kwenye chombo cha shaba, chombo hicho kitasuguliwa na kusuuzwa kwa maji.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

kikuyu: Kila mwanaume katika familia ya kuhani aweza kula nyama hiyo; ni takatifu sana.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Lakini kila sadaka ya dhambi ambayo damu yake imeletwa ndani ya Hema la Kukutania kufanya upatanisho katika Mahali Patakatifu kamwe haitaliwa; lazima iteketezwe.
english: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya hatia, ambayo ni takatifu sana:
english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

kikuyu: Sadaka ya hatia itachinjiwa mahali pale ambapo sadaka ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa, nayo damu yake itanyunyizwa pande zote za madhabahu.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

kikuyu: Mafuta yake yote yatatolewa sadaka: mafuta ya mkia na mafuta yale yanayofunika sehemu za ndani,
english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

kikuyu: figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yanayozizunguka yaliyo karibu na kiuno na yale yanayofunika ini, ambayo yataondolewa pamoja na hizo figo.
english: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

kikuyu: Kuhani atayateketeza juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto. Hii ni sadaka ya hatia.
english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to the LORD: it is a trespass offering.

kikuyu: Mwanaume yeyote katika jamaa ya kuhani aweza kuila, lakini lazima iliwe mahali patakatifu; ni takatifu sana.
english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

kikuyu: “ ‘Sheria hii ya sadaka ya hatia ni sawasawa na ile ya sadaka ya dhambi: Nyama ya yule mnyama aliyetolewa sadaka ni ya yule kuhani anayesimamia ibada ya upatanisho.
english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

kikuyu: Kuhani anayetoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya mtu yeyote anaweza kuichukua ngozi ya mnyama yule aliyetolewa iwe yake.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

kikuyu: Kila sadaka ya nafaka iliyookwa jikoni au kupikwa katika sufuria au katika kikaangio itakuwa ya kuhani anayeitoa.
english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

kikuyu: Nayo kila sadaka ya nafaka, iwe imechanganywa na mafuta au iko kavu, itakuwa ya wana wa Aroni, nayo itagawanywa sawa kati yao.
english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

kikuyu: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani ambayo mtu aweza kuileta kwa Bwana:
english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to the LORD:

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu atatoa sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya kuonyesha shukrani, pamoja na sadaka hii ya shukrani, atatoa maandazi yasiyotiwa chachu yaliyochanganywa na mafuta, mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta, maandazi ya unga laini uliokandwa vizuri na kuchanganywa na mafuta.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

kikuyu: Pamoja na sadaka hii ya amani ya shukrani ataleta sadaka ya maandazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa chachu.
english: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

kikuyu: Ataleta moja ya kila aina ya andazi kama sadaka, matoleo kwa Bwana; hii ni ya kuhani anayenyunyiza damu ya sadaka ya amani.
english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to the LORD. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

kikuyu: Nyama ya sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya shukrani lazima iliwe siku iyo hiyo inapotolewa; hutabakiza kitu chochote mpaka asubuhi.
english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lakini kama sadaka yake ni kwa ajili ya nadhiri au ni sadaka ya hiari, sadaka hiyo italiwa siku hiyo inapotolewa, lakini chochote kinachobakia kinaweza kuliwa kesho yake.
english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

kikuyu: Nyama yoyote ya sadaka inayobaki mpaka siku ya tatu lazima iteketezwe kwa moto.
english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Kama nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani italiwa siku ya tatu, Bwana hataikubali. Haitahesabiwa kwake huyo aliyeitoa, kwa kuwa ni najisi. Mtu atakayekula sehemu yake yoyote atahesabiwa hatia.
english: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nyama ile inayogusa chochote ambacho ni najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada kamwe haitaliwa, ni lazima iteketezwe kwa moto. Kuhusu nyama nyingine, mtu yeyote aliye safi kwa kawaida ya ibada anaweza kuila.
english: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

kikuyu: Lakini kama mtu yeyote najisi akila nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, huyo mtu lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
english: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote akigusa kitu kilicho najisi, iwe ni uchafu wa mwanadamu, au mnyama najisi, au kitu chochote kilicho najisi, kitu cha kuchukiza, kisha akala nyama yoyote ya sadaka ya amani iliyotolewa kwa Bwana, mtu huyo ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.’ ”
english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to the LORD, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Msile mafuta yoyote ya ngʼombe, kondoo wala mbuzi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

kikuyu: Mafuta ya mnyama aliyekutwa amekufa au ameraruliwa na mnyama pori yanaweza kutumika kwa kazi nyingine yoyote, lakini kamwe msiyale.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote alaye mafuta ya mnyama ambaye ametolewa sadaka kwa Bwana kwa moto ni lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Popote mtakapoishi, kamwe msinywe damu ya ndege yeyote wala ya mnyama.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atakunywa damu, mtu huyo lazima akatiliwe mbali na watu wake.’ ”
english: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mtu yeyote aletaye sadaka ya amani kwa Bwana ataleta sehemu ya sadaka hiyo kama dhabihu yake kwa Bwana.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

kikuyu: Ataleta sadaka kwa mikono yake mwenyewe iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto; ataleta mafuta ya huyo mnyama pamoja na kidari, naye atainua hicho kidari mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuhani atayateketeza hayo mafuta juu ya madhabahu, lakini kidari kitakuwa cha Aroni na wanawe.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

kikuyu: Paja la kulia la sadaka zako za amani utampa kuhani kama matoleo.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Aroni atoaye damu na mafuta ya sadaka ya amani ndiye atakayepewa paja hilo la kulia kuwa fungu lake.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

kikuyu: Kutoka kwenye sadaka za amani za Waisraeli, mimi Mungu nimepokea kidari kile kilichoinuliwa pamoja na lile paja lililotolewa, nami nimevitoa kwa kuhani Aroni na wanawe kuwa fungu lao la kawaida kutoka kwa Waisraeli.’ ”
english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo sehemu ya sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, ambazo zilitengwa kwa ajili ya Aroni na wanawe siku ile walipowekwa wakfu ili kumtumikia Bwana katika kazi ya ukuhani.
english: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest’s office;

kikuyu: Siku ile walipotiwa mafuta, Bwana aliagiza kwamba Waisraeli wawape hili kama fungu lao la kawaida kwa vizazi vijavyo.
english: which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

kikuyu: Basi haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya nafaka, sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya hatia, sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu, na sadaka ya amani,
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

kikuyu: ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose juu ya Mlima Sinai siku ile alipowaagiza Waisraeli walete sadaka zao kwa Bwana, katika Jangwa la Sinai.
english: which the LORD commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waletee Aroni na wanawe mavazi yao, mafuta ya upako, fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kondoo dume wawili na kikapu chenye mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu.
english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

kikuyu: Kisha kusanya mkutano wote kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.”
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

kikuyu: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, na mkutano ukakusanyika kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Mose akaliambia kusanyiko, “Hili ndilo Bwana ameagiza lifanyike.”
english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded to be done.”

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akamleta Aroni na wanawe mbele, akawaosha kwa maji.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

kikuyu: Akamvika Aroni koti, akamfunga mshipi, akamvika joho na kumvalisha kisibau. Pia akafunga kisibau juu yake na kukifunga kiunoni mwake kwa mshipi wake uliosokotwa kwa ustadi.
english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

kikuyu: Akaweka kifuko cha kifuani juu yake, na kuweka Urimu na Thumimu kwenye hicho kifuko.
english: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

kikuyu: Kisha akamvika Aroni kilemba kichwani pake, akaweka lile bamba la dhahabu, yaani ile taji takatifu, upande wa mbele wa kilemba, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ndipo Mose akachukua mafuta ya upako na kuipaka maskani na kila kitu kilichokuwamo ndani yake, kisha akaviweka wakfu.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

kikuyu: Akanyunyiza baadhi ya mafuta juu ya madhabahu mara saba, akaipaka madhabahu mafuta na vyombo vyake vyote pamoja na sinia na kinara chake, ili kuviweka wakfu.
english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

kikuyu: Akamimina sehemu ya hayo mafuta ya upako kichwani mwa Aroni, akamtia mafuta ili kumweka wakfu.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

kikuyu: Kisha akawaleta wana wa Aroni mbele, akawavika makoti, akawafunga mishipi na kuwavika vilemba, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha akamtoa fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, nao Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

kikuyu: Mose akamchinja yule fahali na akachukua sehemu ya hiyo damu, kisha kwa kidole chake akaitia kwenye pembe zote za madhabahu ili kutakasa madhabahu. Akaimwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu. Kwa hiyo akayaweka wakfu ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya madhabahu.
english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

kikuyu: Pia Mose akachukua mafuta yote yanayozunguka sehemu za ndani, mafuta yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, akayateketeza juu ya madhabahu.
english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

kikuyu: Lakini fahali, ikiwa pamoja na ngozi yake na nyama yake na sehemu zake za ndani na matumbo, akaiteketeza nje ya kambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akamleta kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Ndipo Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume na kunyunyiza damu yake pande zote za madhabahu.
english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Mose akamkata yule kondoo dume vipande vipande na kukiteketeza kichwa, vile vipande na yale mafuta.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

kikuyu: Kisha akamsafisha sehemu za ndani na miguu kwa maji, na kumteketeza yule kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha akaleta kondoo dume mwingine, ndiye kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwaweka wakfu, naye Aroni na wanawe wakaweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

kikuyu: Mose akamchinja yule kondoo dume, akaichukua sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka juu ya ncha ya sikio la kuume la Aroni, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume na juu ya kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.
english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

kikuyu: Pia Mose akawaleta hao wana wa Aroni mbele, akaipaka sehemu ya hiyo damu kwenye ncha za masikio yao ya kuume, juu ya vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kuume, na juu ya vidole vikubwa vya miguu yao ya kuume. Kisha akanyunyiza damu pande zote za madhabahu.
english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Akachukua mafuta ya mnyama, mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yote yanayozunguka sehemu za ndani, mafuta yanayofunika ini, figo zote mbili pamoja na mafuta yake, na paja la kulia.
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

kikuyu: Kisha kutoka kwenye kikapu cha mikate iliyotengenezwa bila chachu, kilichokuwa mbele za Bwana, akachukua andazi moja, na jingine lililotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mwembamba; akaviweka hivi vyote juu ya mafungu ya mafuta ya mnyama, na juu ya lile paja la kulia.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

kikuyu: Akaviweka hivi vyote mikononi mwa Aroni na wanawe, na kuviinua mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akavichukua kutoka mikononi mwao na kuviteketeza juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kuwa sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to the LORD.
