kikuyu: Kisha akachukua kidari, kilicho fungu la Mose la kondoo dume kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu, na kukiinua mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akachukua sehemu ya mafuta ya upako, na sehemu ya damu kutoka kwenye madhabahu, na kuvinyunyiza juu ya Aroni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na mavazi yao. Kwa hiyo akamweka Aroni na mavazi yake wakfu, pamoja na wanawe na mavazi yao.
english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni na wanawe, “Pika hiyo nyama kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, na uile hapo pamoja na mkate kutoka kwenye kikapu cha sadaka ya kuweka wakfu, kama nilivyoagiza, nikisema, ‘Aroni na wanawe wataila.’
english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

kikuyu: Kisha teketeza nyama na mikate iliyobaki.
english: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

kikuyu: Msitoke kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania kwa muda wa siku saba, mpaka siku zenu za kuwekwa wakfu ziwe zimetimia, kwa kuwa muda wenu wa kuwekwa wakfu utakuwa siku saba.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

kikuyu: Lile lililofanyika leo liliagizwa na Bwana ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
english: What has been done today, so the LORD has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Lazima mkae kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania usiku na mchana kwa siku saba, na kufanya lile Bwana analolitaka, ili kwamba msife; kwa kuwa hilo ndilo nililoamriwa.”
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep the LORD’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Aroni na wanawe wakafanya kila kitu Bwana alichoamuru kupitia kwa Mose.
english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which the LORD commanded by Moses.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya nane, Mose akawaita Aroni na wanawe, na wazee wa Israeli.
english: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

kikuyu: Akamwambia Aroni, “Chukua ndama dume kwa ajili ya sadaka yako ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, wote wawili wasiwe na dosari, nao uwalete mbele za Bwana.
english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha waambie Waisraeli: ‘Chukueni mbuzi dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na ndama na mwana-kondoo, wote wawili wawe wa umri wa mwaka mmoja, na wasio na dosari, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa,
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: na pia maksai na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani, ili kutoa dhabihu mbele za Bwana, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka iliyochanganywa na mafuta. Kwa kuwa leo Bwana atawatokea.’ ”
english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today the LORD appears to you.’”

kikuyu: Wakavileta vile vitu Mose alivyowaagiza mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, nalo kusanyiko lote likakaribia na kusimama mbele za Bwana.
english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ndipo Mose akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilowaagiza mlifanye, ili utukufu wa Bwana upate kuonekana kwenu.”
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which the LORD commanded that you should do; and the LORD’s glory shall appear to you.”

kikuyu: Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Njoo madhabahuni ili utoe dhabihu yako ya sadaka ya dhambi na sadaka yako ya kuteketezwa, ufanye upatanisho kwa ajili yako mwenyewe na kwa ajili ya watu. Kisha utoe sadaka ya upatanisho kwa ajili ya watu, kama vile Bwana alivyoagiza.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as the LORD commanded.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Aroni akaja madhabahuni na kumchinja yule ndama kuwa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.
english: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

kikuyu: Wanawe wakamletea damu, naye akachovya kidole chake katika hiyo damu, akaitia kwenye pembe za madhabahu, nayo damu iliyobaki akaimwaga chini ya madhabahu.
english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

kikuyu: Juu ya madhabahu akateketeza mafuta, figo na mafuta yanayofunika ini kutoka kwenye hiyo sadaka ya dhambi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akateketeza nyama na ngozi nje ya kambi.
english: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

kikuyu: Kisha Aroni akachinja sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Wanawe wakamletea damu, naye akainyunyiza pande zote za madhabahu.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

kikuyu: Wakamletea sadaka ya kuteketezwa kipande kwa kipande, pamoja na kichwa, naye akaviteketeza juu ya madhabahu.
english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

kikuyu: Akasafisha sehemu za ndani na miguu, akaviteketeza juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu.
english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

kikuyu: Kisha Aroni akaleta sadaka ile iliyokuwa kwa ajili ya watu. Akachukua yule mbuzi wa sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya watu, akamchinja na kumtoa kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, kama alivyofanya kwa ile ya kwanza.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

kikuyu: Aroni akaleta sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kuitoa kama ilivyoelekezwa.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

kikuyu: Pia akaleta sadaka ya nafaka, akachukua konzi moja na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya asubuhi.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

kikuyu: Akachinja maksai na kondoo dume kama sadaka ya amani kwa ajili ya watu. Wanawe Aroni wakampa ile damu, naye akainyunyiza kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

kikuyu: Lakini sehemu zile za mafuta ya yule maksai na kondoo dume, yaani mafuta ya mkia, mafuta yaliyofunika tumbo, ya figo na yaliyofunika ini,
english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

kikuyu: hivi vyote wakaviweka juu ya vidari, kisha Aroni akayateketeza hayo mafuta ya wanyama juu ya madhabahu.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

kikuyu: Aroni akaviinua vile vidari na paja la kulia mbele za Bwana ili viwe sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kama Mose alivyoagiza.
english: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses commanded.

kikuyu: Kisha Aroni akainua mikono yake kuwaelekea watu na kuwabariki. Naye baada ya kutoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka ya amani, akashuka chini.
english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose na Aroni wakaingia kwenye Hema la Kukutania. Walipotoka nje, wakawabariki watu. Nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawatokea watu wote.
english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and the LORD’s glory appeared to all the people.

kikuyu: Moto ukaja kutoka uwepo wa Bwana, ukairamba ile sadaka ya kuteketezwa, pamoja na sehemu ya mafuta yaliyokuwa juu ya madhabahu. Watu wote walipoona jambo hili, wakapiga kelele kwa furaha na kusujudu.
english: Fire came out from before the LORD, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Nadabu na Abihu, wana wa Aroni, wakachukua vyetezo vyao, wakaweka moto ndani yake na kuongeza uvumba; kisha wakamtolea Bwana moto usio halali, kinyume na agizo la Mungu.
english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.

kikuyu: Hivyo moto ukaja kutoka kwa uwepo wa Bwana na kuwaramba, nao wakafa mbele za Bwana.
english: Fire came out from before the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akamwambia Aroni, “Hili ndilo alilonena Bwana wakati aliposema: “ ‘Miongoni mwa wale watakaonikaribia nitajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu; machoni pa watu wote nitaheshimiwa.’ ” Aroni akanyamaza.
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what the LORD spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

kikuyu: Mose akawaita Mishaeli na Elisafani, wana wa Uzieli mjomba wake Aroni, akawaambia, “Njooni hapa. Ondoeni miili ya binamu zenu mbele ya mahali patakatifu, mkaipeleke nje ya kambi.”
english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

kikuyu: Hivyo wakaja na kuwaondoa, wakiwa bado wamevalia makoti yao ya ibada, wakawapeleka nje ya kambi, kama Mose alivyoamuru.
english: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

kikuyu: Ndipo Mose akamwambia Aroni pamoja na wanawe, Eleazari na Ithamari, “Msifunue vichwa vyenu wala msirarue mavazi yenu, la sivyo mtakufa na Bwana ataikasirikia jumuiya nzima. Lakini ndugu zenu, nyumba yote ya Israeli, wanaweza kuwaombolezea wale ambao Bwana amewaangamiza kwa moto.
english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD has kindled.

kikuyu: Msitoke nje ya ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo mtakufa, kwa sababu mafuta ya Bwana ya upako yako juu yenu.” Hivyo wakafanya kama vile Mose alivyosema.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the LORD is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Aroni,
english: Then the LORD said to Aaron,

kikuyu: “Wewe na wanao msinywe mvinyo wala kinywaji kingine kilichochachuka wakati mwingiapo katika Hema la Kukutania, la sivyo mtakufa. Hili litakuwa Agizo la kudumu kwa vizazi vijavyo.
english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Ni lazima mtenganishe kilicho kitakatifu na kile kilicho cha kawaida, kati ya yaliyo najisi na yaliyo safi,
english: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

kikuyu: na lazima mwafundishe Waisraeli amri zote ambazo Bwana aliwapa kupitia Mose.”
english: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD has spoken to them by Moses.”

kikuyu: Mose akamwambia Aroni pamoja na wanawe waliosalia, Eleazari na Ithamari, “Chukueni sadaka ya nafaka iliyobaki kutoka sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, muile hapo kando ya madhabahu ikiwa imeandaliwa bila chachu, kwa sababu ni takatifu sana.
english: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;

kikuyu: Mtaila katika mahali patakatifu kwa sababu ni fungu lenu na fungu la wana wenu la sadaka zilizotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, kwa maana hivyo ndivyo nilivyoamriwa.
english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of the LORD made by fire; for so I am commanded.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe na wanao na binti zako mwaweza kula kidari kile kilichoinuliwa na paja lile lililotolewa. Mtavila mahali safi pa kawaida ya ibada; mmepewa wewe na watoto wako kuwa fungu lenu la sadaka za amani za Waisraeli.
english: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Paja lile lililotolewa na kidari kile kilichoinuliwa lazima viletwe pamoja na sehemu za mafuta ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, ili kuinuliwa mbele za Bwana kama sadaka ya kuinuliwa. Hili litakuwa fungu lako la kawaida na wanao, kama Bwana alivyoagiza.”
english: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as the LORD has commanded.”

kikuyu: Mose alipouliza kuhusu mbuzi atolewaye kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kukuta kwamba ameteketezwa, aliwakasirikia Eleazari na Ithamari, wana wa Aroni waliobaki, akawauliza,
english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

kikuyu: “Kwa nini hamkula sadaka ya dhambi katika eneo la mahali patakatifu? Ni takatifu sana. Mlipewa ninyi ili kuondoa hatia ya jumuiya kwa ajili ya kuwafanyia upatanisho mbele za Bwana.
english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa damu yake haikuletwa ndani ya Mahali Patakatifu, mngemla mbuzi huyo katika sehemu ya mahali patakatifu kama nilivyoagiza.”
english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

kikuyu: Aroni akamjibu Mose, “Leo wanangu wametoa sadaka zao za dhambi na sadaka zao za kuteketezwa mbele za Bwana, lakini mambo kama haya yamenitokea mimi. Je, Bwana angependezwa kama ningekuwa nimekula sadaka ya dhambi leo?”
english: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in the LORD’s sight?”

kikuyu: Mose aliposikia haya, akaridhika.
english: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

kikuyu: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

kikuyu: “Waambieni Waisraeli: ‘Kati ya wanyama wote waishio juu ya nchi, hawa ndio mtakaowala:
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

kikuyu: Mwaweza kula mnyama yeyote mwenye kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili na ambaye hucheua.
english: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuna wanyama wengine ambao hucheua tu au wenye kwato zilizogawanyika tu, lakini hao kamwe msiwale. Ngamia ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; kwa kawaida ya ibada hiyo ni najisi kwenu.
english: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Pelele ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
english: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Sungura ingawa hucheua hana kwato zilizogawanyika; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
english: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Naye nguruwe ingawa anazo kwato zilizogawanyika sehemu mbili, hacheui; huyo ni najisi kwenu.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

kikuyu: Kamwe msile nyama yao wala kugusa mizoga yao; wao ni najisi kwenu.
english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuhusu viumbe wote wanaoishi ndani ya maji ya bahari na vijito, mtakula wale wote wenye mapezi na magamba.
english: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

kikuyu: Lakini viumbe wote ndani ya bahari au vijito wasio na mapezi na magamba, wakiwa miongoni mwa makundi au viumbe wote ndani ya maji, hao ni machukizo kwenu.
english: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

kikuyu: Nao watakuwa machukizo kwenu. Msile nyama yao, nayo mizoga yao itakuwa machukizo.
english: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

kikuyu: Chochote kinachoishi ndani ya maji ambacho hakina mapezi na magamba kitakuwa chukizo kwenu.
english: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wafuatao ndio ndege watakaokuwa machukizo kwenu, hivyo msiwale kwa sababu ni chukizo: tai, furukombe, kipungu,
english: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

kikuyu: mwewe mwekundu, aina zote za mwewe mweusi,
english: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

kikuyu: aina zote za kunguru,
english: any kind of raven,

kikuyu: mbuni, kiruka-njia, dudumizi, kipanga, shakwe, aina zote za kipanga,
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

kikuyu: bundi, mnandi, bundi mkubwa,
english: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

kikuyu: mumbi, mwari, nderi,
english: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

kikuyu: korongo, koikoi wa aina yoyote, hudihudi na popo.
english: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wadudu wote warukao ambao hutembea kwa miguu minne watakuwa chukizo kwenu.
english: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

kikuyu: Lakini wako viumbe wenye mabawa ambao hutembea kwa miguu minne mtakaowala: wale wenye vifundo katika miguu yao ya kurukaruka juu ya ardhi.
english: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.

kikuyu: Miongoni mwa hawa, mtakula nzige wa aina zote, senene, parare au panzi.
english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

kikuyu: Lakini viumbe wengine wote wenye mabawa na wenye miguu minne ni machukizo kwenu.
english: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mtajinajisi kwa wanyama hawa. Yeyote agusaye mizoga yao atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayebeba mizoga ya viumbe hawa ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kila mnyama mwenye ukwato ulioachana lakini haukugawanyika kabisa, au yule asiyecheua, huyo ni najisi kwenu; yeyote agusaye mzoga wowote wa hao atakuwa najisi.
english: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Miongoni mwa wanyama wote watembeao kwa miguu minne, wale watembeao kwa vitanga vyao ni najisi kwenu; yeyote agusaye mizoga yao atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayebeba mizoga yao ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Wanyama hawa ni najisi kwenu.
english: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kuhusu wanyama watambaao juu ya ardhi, hawa ni najisi kwenu: kicheche, panya, aina yoyote ya mijusi mikubwa,
english: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

kikuyu: guruguru, kenge, mijusi ya ukutani, goromoe na kinyonga.
english: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

kikuyu: Hao wote watambaao juu ya ardhi ni najisi kwenu. Yeyote agusaye mizoga yao atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mmoja wao atakufa na kuangukia juu ya kitu fulani, chombo hicho, hata kikiwa cha matumizi gani, kitakuwa najisi, kiwe kimetengenezwa kwa mti, nguo, ngozi au gunia. Kiweke ndani ya maji; kitakuwa najisi mpaka jioni, kisha kitakuwa safi tena.
english: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mmoja wa wanyama aliyekufa ataangukia ndani ya chungu, kila kilichomo katika chungu hicho kitakuwa najisi, nawe ni lazima uvunje chungu hicho.
english: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.

kikuyu: Chakula chochote ambacho chaweza kuliwa lakini kikawa kimeingia maji kutoka kwenye chungu hicho ni najisi, na kitu chochote cha majimaji ambacho chaweza kunyweka kutoka kwenye chungu hicho ni najisi.
english: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Chochote ambacho mzoga wa mmojawapo utaangukia kitakuwa najisi. Jiko au chungu cha kupikia ni lazima kivunjwe. Ni najisi, nawe ni lazima uvihesabu kuwa najisi.
english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

kikuyu: Lakini chemchemi au kisima, mahali pa kuchota maji, patakuwa safi, lakini yeyote atakayegusa moja ya mizoga hii ni najisi.
english: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Kama mzoga ukianguka juu ya mbegu zozote ambazo ni za kupanda, zinabaki safi.
english: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mbegu imetiwa maji na mzoga ukaanguka juu yake, hiyo mbegu ni najisi kwenu.
english: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama mnyama ambaye mnaruhusiwa kumla akifa, yeyote atakayeugusa mzoga wake atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayekula sehemu ya mzoga huo ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Yeyote atakayebeba mzoga huo ni lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kila kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi ni chukizo; kisiliwe.
english: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

kikuyu: Msile kiumbe chochote kitambaacho juu ya ardhi, kiwe kitambaacho kwa tumbo lake, au kitambaacho kwa miguu minne au kwa miguu mingi; ni chukizo.
english: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

kikuyu: Msijitie unajisi kwa chochote katika viumbe hivi. Msijitie unajisi kwa viumbe hivyo au kutiwa unajisi navyo.
english: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

kikuyu: Mimi ndimi Bwana Mungu wenu; jitakaseni mwe watakatifu, kwa sababu mimi ni mtakatifu. Msijitie unajisi wenyewe kwa kiumbe chochote kile kiendacho juu ya ardhi.
english: For I am the LORD your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

kikuyu: Mimi ndimi Bwana niliyewapandisha mtoke Misri ili niwe Mungu wenu. Kwa hiyo kuweni watakatifu kwa sababu Mimi ni mtakatifu.
english: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

kikuyu: “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu wanyama, ndege, kila kiumbe hai kiendacho ndani ya maji, na kila kiumbe kiendacho juu ya ardhi.
english: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

kikuyu: Ni lazima mpambanue kati ya kilicho najisi na kilicho safi, kati ya viumbe hai vinavyoweza kuliwa na vile visivyoweza kuliwa.’ ”
english: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waambie Waisraeli: ‘Mwanamke ambaye atapata mimba na kuzaa mtoto wa kiume atakuwa najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada kwa siku saba, kama anavyokuwa najisi wakati wa siku zake za hedhi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Mvulana atatahiriwa siku ya nane.
english: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

kikuyu: Kisha ni lazima huyo mwanamke asubiri kwa siku thelathini na tatu, ndipo atakaswe kutoka damu kwake. Hataruhusiwa kugusa kitu chochote kilicho kitakatifu au kuingia mahali patakatifu, mpaka siku za kutakaswa kwake zimetimia.
english: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

kikuyu: Kama akimzaa mtoto wa kike, mwanamke huyo atakuwa najisi kwa majuma mawili, kama wakati wake wa hedhi. Kisha atasubiri kwa siku sitini na sita, ndipo atatakaswa kutoka damu kwake.
english: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

kikuyu: “ ‘Siku zake za utakaso kwa ajili ya mwana au binti zitakapotimia, mwanamke huyo atamletea kuhani kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mwana-kondoo mwenye umri wa mwaka mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na kinda la njiwa au hua kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
english: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Atavitoa mbele za Bwana ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, na kisha atakuwa safi kwa desturi ya ibada kutokana na kutokwa damu kwake. “ ‘Haya ndiyo masharti kwa ajili ya mwanamke atakayezaa mtoto wa kiume au wa kike.
english: He shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

kikuyu: Kama huyo mwanamke hana uwezo wa kumpata mwana-kondoo, ataleta hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, moja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na mwingine kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi. Kwa njia hii, kuhani atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake, naye atakuwa safi.’ ”
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Iwapo mtu yeyote atakuwa na uvimbe au upele au alama nyeupe juu ya ngozi yake ambayo yaweza kuwa ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza, ni lazima aletwe kwa Aroni kuhani ama kwa wanawe, kuhani mmojawapo.
english: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

kikuyu: Kuhani atachunguza hicho kidonda kilichopo juu ya ngozi yake, na kama nywele za mahali palipo na kidonda zimebadilika kuwa nyeupe, na ikiwa kidonda kimeingia ndani ya ngozi, basi ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza, yaani ukoma. Kuhani atakapomchunguza, atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa ni najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada.
english: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

kikuyu: Kama alama juu ya ngozi yake ni nyeupe, lakini haionekani kuwa imeingia ndani zaidi ya ngozi, na nywele kwenye alama hiyo hazijageuka kuwa nyeupe, kuhani atamtenga mtu huyo mahali pa pekee kwa siku saba.
english: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba, kuhani atamchunguza, na kama hakuona badiliko kwenye kile kidonda na hakijaenea juu ya ngozi, atamtenga kwa siku nyingine saba.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba kuhani atamchunguza tena, na kama kidonda kimepungua na hakijaenea juu ya ngozi, kuhani atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa ni safi, ni upele tu. Ni lazima mtu huyo afue mavazi yake, naye atakuwa safi.
english: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa ule upele utaenea juu ya ngozi yake baada ya yeye kujionyesha kwa kuhani na kutangazwa kuwa safi, ni lazima aende tena kwa kuhani.
english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

kikuyu: Kuhani atamchunguza, na kama upele umeenea kwenye ngozi, atamtangaza kuwa najisi, kwani ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza, yaani ukoma.
english: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

kikuyu: “Wakati mtu yeyote ana ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza, ni lazima aletwe kwa kuhani.
english: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

kikuyu: Kuhani atamchunguza na kama kuna uvimbe mweupe juu ya ngozi ambao umefanya nywele kuwa nyeupe, na kama kuna nyama mbichi ndani ya uvimbe,
english: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

kikuyu: ni ugonjwa sugu wa ngozi, na kuhani atamtangaza kuwa najisi. Hatamtenga tena kwa sababu ni najisi tayari.
english: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa ugonjwa utakuwa umeenea kwenye ngozi yake yote kwa kadiri kuhani atakavyoweza kuona, kwamba umeenea kwenye ngozi yote ya huyo mgonjwa kutoka kichwani mpaka wayo,
english: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,

kikuyu: kuhani atamchunguza, na kama ugonjwa umeenea mwili mzima, atamtangaza huyo mtu kuwa safi. Kwa kuwa mwili wote umekuwa mweupe, yeye ni safi.
english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

kikuyu: Lakini itokeapo nyama mbichi kwenye ngozi yake, atakuwa najisi.
english: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Kuhani atakapoiona hiyo nyama mbichi, atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa najisi. Hiyo nyama mbichi ni najisi, ana ugonjwa wa kuambukiza.
english: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

kikuyu: Hiyo nyama mbichi ikigeuka na kuwa nyeupe, ni lazima amwendee kuhani.
english: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.

kikuyu: Kuhani atamchunguza, na kama vidonda vimekuwa vyeupe, kuhani atamtangaza mgonjwa huyo kuwa safi; kisha atakuwa safi.
english: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

kikuyu: “Wakati mtu ana jipu juu ya ngozi yake nalo likapona,
english: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

kikuyu: napo mahali palipokuwa na jipu pakatokea uvimbe mweupe, au alama yenye wekundu na weupe, ni lazima akajionyeshe kwa kuhani.
english: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.

kikuyu: Kuhani atapachunguza, na kama uvimbe umezama ndani ya ngozi, na nywele zimegeuka kuwa nyeupe, kuhani atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa najisi. Ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza uliojitokeza pale jipu lilipokuwa.
english: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa wakati kuhani anapopachunguza pakawa hapana nywele nyeupe ndani yake, wala hakuna shimo bali pamepungua, basi kuhani atamtenga mtu huyo kwa siku saba.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

kikuyu: Kama unaenea kwenye ngozi, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa najisi; ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza.
english: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa ile alama haijabadilika wala kuenea, ni kovu tu kutokana na jipu, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa safi.
english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

kikuyu: “Wakati mtu ameungua kwenye ngozi yake, pakatokea alama yenye wekundu na weupe, au alama nyeupe ikaonekana penye nyama mbichi pale palipoungua,
english: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

kikuyu: kuhani ataichunguza ile alama, na kama nywele zilizoko juu yake zimegeuka kuwa nyeupe, napo pametokea shimo, basi huo ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza ambao umetokea juu ya jeraha la moto. Kuhani atamtangaza kuwa najisi; ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza.
english: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

kikuyu: Lakini kama kuhani akichunguza na kuona kwamba hakuna nywele nyeupe kwenye alama ile, wala hakuna shimo napo pameanza kupungua, basi kuhani atamtenga kwa siku saba.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba kuhani atamchunguza tena, na kama unaenea kwenye ngozi, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa najisi; ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

kikuyu: Lakini, kama alama ile haikubadilika na wala haijaenea kwenye ngozi, napo pamepungua, ni uvimbe kutokana na jeraha la moto, na kuhani atamtangaza kuwa safi; ni kovu tu kutokana na kuungua.
english: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa mwanaume au mwanamke ana kidonda juu ya kichwa au juu ya kidevu,
english: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

kikuyu: kuhani atakichunguza kile kidonda, na kama ataona kuwa kimeingia ndani, na nywele zilizoko juu yake ni njano na nyembamba, kuhani atamtangaza mtu huyo kuwa najisi, kwani ni upele; ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza wa kichwa au kidevu.
english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

kikuyu: Lakini kama kuhani akichunguza aina hii ya kidonda, kionekane kuwa hakina shimo na hakuna nywele nyeusi juu yake, basi atamtenga mtu huyo kwa siku saba.
english: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba kuhani atachunguza kidonda kile, na kama upele haujaenea, na hakuna nywele za manjano juu yake, wala hakuna shimo lolote,
english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

kikuyu: mtu huyo ni lazima anyolewe, isipokuwa mahali palipo na ugonjwa, naye kuhani atamtenga kwa siku nyingine saba.
english: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba kuhani atachunguza tena ule upele; ikiwa haujaenea kwenye ngozi na hakuna shimo mahali pale, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa safi. Lazima afue nguo zake, naye atakuwa safi.
english: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa upele utaenea juu ya ngozi baada ya kutangazwa kuwa safi,
english: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

kikuyu: kuhani atamchunguza, na kama upele umeenea kwenye ngozi, kuhani hana haja ya kutazama kama kuna nywele za manjano, mtu huyo ni najisi.
english: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, katika uchunguzi wake akiona hapajabadilika, na nywele nyeusi zimeota juu yake, upele umepona. Yeye si najisi, kuhani atamtangaza kuwa safi.
english: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa mwanaume au mwanamke ana alama nyeupe juu ya ngozi yake,
english: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

kikuyu: kuhani atamchunguza, na kama alama hizo zina weupe uliofifia, ni vipele visivyo na madhara vilivyojitokeza kwenye ngozi; mtu huyo ni safi.
english: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

kikuyu: “Wakati mwanaume hana nywele naye ana upaa, yeye ni safi.
english: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

kikuyu: Ikiwa hana nywele kwenye ngozi ya kichwa chake, na ana upaa tangu kwenye paji, ni safi.
english: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

kikuyu: Lakini kama ana kidonda chenye wekundu na weupe kwenye kichwa chake chenye upaa, au kwenye paji la uso, ni ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza unaojitokeza kichwani au kwenye paji lake la uso.
english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

kikuyu: Kuhani atamchunguza, na kama kidonda kilichovimba juu ya kichwa chake au kwenye paji la uso ni chekundu au cheupe kama ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza,
english: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

kikuyu: mtu huyo ni mgonjwa, na ni najisi. Kuhani atamtangaza kuwa najisi kwa sababu ya kidonda kwenye kichwa chake.
english: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

kikuyu: “Mtu mwenye ugonjwa kama huo wa kuambukiza ni lazima avae nguo zilizoraruka, awachilie nywele zake bila kuzichana, afunike sehemu ya chini ya uso wake, na apige kelele, ‘Najisi! Najisi!’
english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

kikuyu: Kwa muda wote atakaokuwa na ugonjwa huo wa kuambukiza atabaki kuwa najisi. Ni lazima aishi peke yake; ni lazima aishi nje ya kambi.
english: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

kikuyu: “Kama vazi lolote lina maambukizo ya upele: likiwa ni vazi la sufu au kitani,
english: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

kikuyu: lolote lililofumwa au kusokotwa likiwa la kitani au la sufu, ngozi yoyote au chochote kilichotengenezwa kwa ngozi,
english: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

kikuyu: tena kama maambukizo kwenye vazi, au ngozi, au lililofumwa au kusokotwa, au kifaa chochote cha ngozi, ni rangi ya kijani au nyekundu, huo ni upele unaoenea na ni lazima kuhani aonyeshwe.
english: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

kikuyu: Kuhani atachunguza upele huo na kukitenga kifaa hicho kwa siku saba.
english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba atakichunguza, na kama upele umeenea kwenye nguo, au kifaa kilichofumwa au kusokotwa, au ngozi, kwa vyovyote vile itumikavyo, ni upele uangamizao, kifaa hicho ni najisi.
english: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

kikuyu: Ni lazima aichome hiyo nguo, ikiwa ni ya sufu ama kitani iliyofumwa ama kusokotwa, ama chombo chochote cha ngozi chenye maambukizo, kwa kuwa ni upele unaoangamiza; chombo chote ni lazima kichomwe moto.
english: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

kikuyu: “Lakini wakati kuhani atakapokichunguza na kuona kuwa ule upele haujaenea kwenye nguo iliyofumwa au kusokotwa, au vifaa vya ngozi,
english: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

kikuyu: ataagiza kwamba kifaa chenye maambukizo kisafishwe. Kisha atakitenga kwa siku saba.
english: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

kikuyu: Baada ya kifaa chenye maambukizo kusafishwa, kuhani atakichunguza, na kama upele haujaonyesha badiliko lolote, hata kama haujaenea, ni najisi. Kichome kwa moto, iwe upele umeenea upande mmoja au mwingine.
english: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

kikuyu: Kama kuhani ataona kuwa ile alama imefifia baada ya kuoshwa, basi atararua sehemu iliyo ambukizwa ya nguo au ngozi au kifaa kilichofumwa au kusokotwa.
english: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

kikuyu: Lakini kama ikijitokeza tena kwenye nguo au kitu kilichofumwa au kusokotwa, ama kifaa cha ngozi, kwamba ule upele unaenea, chochote chenye upele ni lazima kichomwe kwa moto.
english: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

kikuyu: Nguo, au kitu kilichofumwa au kusokotwa, au kifaa chochote cha ngozi ambacho kimesafishwa na kuondolewa upele, ni lazima kioshwe tena, nacho kitakuwa safi.”
english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

kikuyu: Haya ni masharti kuhusu maambukizo ya upele kwenye mavazi ya sufu au kitani, yaliyofumwa ama kusokotwa, ama kifaa chochote cha ngozi, kwa ajili ya kuvitangaza kuwa safi au najisi.
english: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Haya ndiyo masharti yamhusuyo mtu mgonjwa wakati wa kufanyiwa ibada ya utakaso wakati aletwapo kwa kuhani:
english: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,

kikuyu: Kuhani atakwenda kumchunguza nje ya kambi. Kama mtu huyo atakuwa amepona ugonjwa wake wa ngozi wa kuambukiza,
english: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

kikuyu: kuhani ataagiza vitu vifuatavyo viletwe kwa ajili ya mtu atakayetakaswa: ndege wawili safi walio hai, mti wa mwerezi, kitani nyekundu, na hisopo.
english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani ataagiza kwamba mmoja wa ndege wale achinjwe kwenye chungu chenye maji safi.
english: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani atamchukua ndege aliye hai na kumtumbukiza pamoja na mti wa mwerezi, kitani nyekundu na hisopo ndani ya damu ya yule ndege aliyechinjiwa kwenye maji safi.
english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

kikuyu: Atamnyunyizia yule mwenye ugonjwa wa kuambukiza maji hayo mara saba, na kumtangaza kuwa safi. Kisha atamwachia yule ndege aliye hai aende zake kwenye mashamba.
english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

kikuyu: “Huyo mtu atakayetakaswa ni lazima afue nguo zake, anyoe nywele zake zote, na aoge kwa maji; ndipo atakapokuwa safi kwa desturi ya ibada. Baada ya hili anaweza kuingia kambini, lakini ni lazima akae nje ya hema lake kwa siku saba.
english: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba ni lazima anyoe nywele zake zote; yaani anyoe nywele za kichwa, ndevu zake, kope zake na nywele nyingine zote. Ni lazima afue nguo zake, na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa safi.
english: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.

kikuyu: “Siku ya nane, ni lazima alete kondoo dume wawili na kondoo jike mmoja, wote wa mwaka mmoja na wasio na dosari, pamoja na sehemu tatu za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka, na logi moja ya mafuta.
english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

kikuyu: Kuhani atakayemtangaza kuwa safi atahitaji kumkabidhi mgonjwa aliyepona pamoja na sadaka zake zote mbele za Bwana katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “Kisha kuhani atamchukua mmoja wa wale kondoo dume na kumtoa kuwa sadaka ya hatia, pamoja na ile logi moja ya mafuta; ataviinua mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Atamchinja huyo kondoo katika mahali patakatifu ambapo sadaka ya dhambi na ile ya kuteketezwa huchinjiwa. Kama ilivyo sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya hatia ni ya kuhani; nayo ni takatifu sana.
english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

kikuyu: Kuhani atachukua sehemu ya damu ya sadaka ya hatia na kuitia kwenye ncha ya sikio la kuume la yule atakayetakaswa, kwenye kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume, na kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

kikuyu: Kuhani atachukua sehemu ya ile logi ya mafuta, ayamimine kwenye kiganja cha mkono wake mwenyewe wa kushoto,
english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

kikuyu: na achovye kidole chake cha shahada cha mkono wake wa kuume kwenye mafuta yaliyoko kwenye kiganja chake, na kwa kidole hicho anyunyize mafuta hayo mara saba mbele za Bwana.
english: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuhani atampaka yule anayetakaswa sehemu ya mafuta yaliyobaki kiganjani kwenye ncha ya sikio lake la kuume, kwenye kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume, na kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume, mahali palepale alipompaka damu ya sadaka ya kuondoa hatia.
english: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

kikuyu: Kuhani atayapaka mafuta yaliyobaki kwenye kiganja chake juu ya kichwa cha yule anayetakaswa, na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD.

kikuyu: “Kisha kuhani atatoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya dhambi na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya yule atakayetakaswa kutoka unajisi wake. Baada ya hayo, kuhani atachinja sadaka ya kuteketezwa
english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

kikuyu: na kuitoa juu ya madhabahu, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka ili kumfanyia upatanisho, naye atakuwa safi.
english: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

kikuyu: “Hata hivyo, kama ni maskini na hawezi kupata vitu hivi, lazima achukue mwana-kondoo mmoja kama sadaka ya hatia ipate kuinuliwa ili kumfanyia upatanisho, pamoja na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na logi moja ya mafuta kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka,
english: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

kikuyu: na hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, kile atakachoweza kupata, mmoja kwa sadaka ya dhambi, na mwingine kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
english: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

kikuyu: “Katika siku ya nane, lazima avilete vitu hivyo kwa kuhani, kwa ajili ya kutakaswa kwake kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania mbele za Bwana.
english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kuhani atamchukua mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya hatia, pamoja na ile logi ya mafuta ya kuinuliwa mbele za Bwana kuwa sadaka ya kuinuliwa.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.

kikuyu: Atamchinja huyo mwana-kondoo kwa ajili ya sadaka ya hatia. Pia ataichukua sehemu ya damu yake na kuipaka kwenye ncha ya sikio la kuume la yule anayetakaswa, na aipake pia kwenye kidole gumba cha mkono wa kuume wa huyo mtu, na kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.
english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

kikuyu: Kuhani atamiminia sehemu ya mafuta kwenye kiganja chake cha mkono wa kushoto,
english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

kikuyu: na kwa kidole chake cha shahada cha mkono wa kuume, atamnyunyizia yule anayetakaswa yale mafuta yaliyo kwenye kiganja chake mara saba mbele za Bwana.
english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD.

kikuyu: Atampaka mafuta yaliyobaki kwenye kiganja chake katika sehemu zote, kama alivyompaka damu ya sadaka ya hatia: yaani, kwenye ncha ya sikio la kuume la yule anayetakaswa, kwenye kidole gumba cha mkono wake wa kuume, na kidole kikubwa cha mguu wake wa kuume.
english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

kikuyu: Kuhani atayapaka mafuta yaliyobaki katika kiganja chake kwenye kichwa cha yule anayetakaswa, na kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kisha atatoa dhabihu wale hua ama yale makinda ya njiwa ambayo mtu ataweza kuwapata,
english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

kikuyu: mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na mwingine kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka. Kwa njia hii kuhani atafanya upatanisho mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya yule anayetakaswa.”
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo masharti kwa mtu yeyote mwenye ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza, na ambaye hana uwezo wa kutoa sadaka za kawaida kwa ajili ya kutakaswa kwake.
english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

kikuyu: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Mtakapoingia katika nchi ya Kanaani ambayo ninawapa kuwa milki yenu, nami nikaweka upele ueneao kwenye nyumba katika nchi ile,
english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

kikuyu: ni lazima mwenye nyumba hiyo akamwambie kuhani, ‘Nimeona kitu fulani kinachofanana na upele kwenye nyumba yangu.’
english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

kikuyu: Kuhani ataagiza vitu vyote vitolewe ndani ya nyumba, kabla hajaenda kuchunguza kama ina ugonjwa huo, ili kitu chochote ndani ya nyumba kisitangazwe kuwa najisi. Baada ya hili, kuhani ataingia ndani na kuikagua hiyo nyumba.
english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

kikuyu: Atachunguza upele huo katika kuta za nyumba hiyo, nazo kama zina rangi ya kijani kibichi au wekundu, na kuna mibonyeo ndani ya ukuta,
english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

kikuyu: kuhani atatoka na kufunga mlango wa nyumba hiyo kwa siku saba.
english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba, kuhani atarudi kuikagua nyumba. Kama upele umeenea juu ya kuta,
english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

kikuyu: ataagiza kwamba mawe yote yaliyoambukizwa yaondolewe na kutupwa katika eneo lililo najisi nje ya mji.
english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

kikuyu: Kuta zote za ndani ya nyumba hiyo ni lazima zikwanguliwe, na kifusi chake kitupwe mahali najisi nje ya mji.
english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

kikuyu: Kisha watachukua mawe mengine na kujenga palipobomolewa kwa udongo mpya wa mfinyanzi, na kuipiga nyumba hiyo lipu mpya.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa upele huo utatokea tena ndani ya ile nyumba baada ya mawe kuondolewa na nyumba kukwanguliwa na kuwekwa lipu mpya,
english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

kikuyu: kuhani atakwenda kuikagua, na kama upele umeenea ndani ya nyumba, basi ni upele uharibuo; nyumba hiyo ni najisi.
english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

kikuyu: Ni lazima ibomolewe: mawe yake, mbao na lipu yake, vyote vikatupwe nje ya mji mahali palipo najisi.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

kikuyu: “Yeyote atakayeingia katika nyumba hiyo ikiwa imefungwa, atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayelala au kula ndani ya nyumba hiyo ni lazima afue nguo zake.
english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

kikuyu: “Lakini ikiwa kuhani atakuja kuikagua na kukuta kuwa upele haujaenea tena baada ya nyumba kupigwa lipu, ataitangaza nyumba ile kuwa safi, kwa sababu upele umekwisha.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

kikuyu: Ili kuitakasa nyumba hiyo, mwenye nyumba ataleta ndege wawili, mti wa mwerezi, kitani nyekundu na hisopo.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

kikuyu: Atamchinja mmoja wa wale ndege kwenye chungu chenye maji safi.
english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

kikuyu: Kisha atachukua mti wa mwerezi, hisopo, kitani nyekundu na ndege aliye hai, na kuvitumbukiza ndani ya damu ya ndege aliyechinjwa pamoja na maji safi, na kuinyunyizia nyumba ile mara saba.
english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

kikuyu: Ataitakasa nyumba kwa damu ya yule ndege, maji safi, ndege aliye hai, mti wa mwerezi, hisopo na kitani nyekundu.
english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

kikuyu: Kisha atamwachia yule ndege aliye hai huru mashambani nje ya mji. Kwa njia hii atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya nyumba ile, nayo itakuwa safi.”
english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu aina yoyote ya ugonjwa wa ngozi wa kuambukiza, mwasho wowote,
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

kikuyu: upele ndani ya nguo au ndani ya nyumba,
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

kikuyu: kwa uvimbe, vipele au kipaku kingʼaacho,
english: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

kikuyu: kupambanua wakati kitu fulani ni safi au najisi. Haya ndiyo masharti kuhusu magonjwa ya ngozi ya kuambukiza na upele.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

kikuyu: Bwana akawaambia Mose na Aroni,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Semeni na Waisraeli mwaambie: ‘Wakati mtu yeyote anapotokwa na usaha mwilini, usaha huo ni najisi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

kikuyu: Iwe unaendelea kutiririka kutoka mwilini mwake au umeziba, utamfanya kuwa najisi. Hivi ndivyo usaha wake utakavyomletea unajisi:
english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kitanda chochote atakacholalia mtu mwenye kutokwa na usaha kitakuwa najisi, na chochote atakachokalia kitakuwa najisi.
english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayegusa kitanda chake ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayeketi juu ya kitu chochote alichokalia mwenye kutokwa na usaha, ni lazima afue nguo zake, na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yeyote atakayemgusa mtu mwenye kutokwa na usaha, ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa mtu mwenye kutokwa na usaha atamtemea mate mtu yeyote ambaye ni safi, mtu huyo ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kila tandiko ambalo mtu huyo atalikalia wakati wa kupanda mnyama litakuwa najisi,
english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: na yeyote atakayegusa kitu chochote alichokuwa amekalia atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni. Yeyote atakayeinua vitu hivyo ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yeyote atakayeguswa na mtu anayetokwa na usaha bila kunawa mikono yake kwa maji, ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Chungu cha udongo kitakachoguswa na mtu huyo ni lazima kivunjwe, na kifaa chochote cha mbao kitaoshwa kwa maji.
english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wakati mtu atakapotakasika kutoka usaha wake, anapaswa kuhesabu siku saba kwa utakaso wake. Ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji safi, naye atatakasika.
english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

kikuyu: Siku ya nane, atachukua hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, aje mbele za Bwana kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania, na kumpa kuhani.
english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

kikuyu: Kuhani atavitoa dhabihu, mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi na huyo mwingine kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii atafanya upatanisho mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya huyo mtu kwa sababu ya kutokwa usaha kwake.
english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the LORD for his discharge.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wakati mtu akitokwa na shahawa, ni lazima aoge mwili mzima kwa maji, na atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Vazi lolote ama ngozi yoyote yenye shahawa juu yake ni lazima ioshwe kwa maji, na itakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtu atalala na mwanamke, na kukawa na kutoka kwa shahawa, ni lazima wote waoge kwa maji, nao watakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanamke atatokwa na damu ya kawaida ya mwezi, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba, na yeyote atakayemgusa atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Chochote atakacholalia wakati wake wa hedhi kitakuwa najisi, na chochote atakachokikalia kitakuwa najisi.
english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayegusa kitanda chake ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Yeyote atakayegusa chochote atakachokalia ni lazima afue nguo zake na aoge kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Kiwe ni kitanda ama chochote alichokuwa amekikalia, ikiwa mtu yeyote atakigusa, atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanaume atalala naye na ile damu ya mwezi ikamgusa, atakuwa najisi kwa siku saba; kitanda chochote atakachokilalia huyo mwanaume kitakuwa najisi.
english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ikiwa mwanamke atatokwa na damu kwa siku nyingi zaidi ya siku zake za mwezi, au amekuwa na damu inayoendelea zaidi ya kipindi chake, atakuwa najisi kwa kipindi chote cha shida hiyo, kama ilivyokuwa katika siku za hedhi yake.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

kikuyu: Kitanda chochote atakachokilalia huyo mwanamke wakati anaendelea kutokwa na damu kitakuwa najisi, kama kilivyokuwa kitanda chake wakati wa siku zake za hedhi, na chochote atakachokalia kitakuwa najisi, kama wakati wake wa hedhi.
english: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

kikuyu: Yeyote agusaye vitu hivyo atakuwa najisi; ni lazima afue nguo zake na kuoga kwa maji, naye atakuwa najisi mpaka jioni.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wakati atakapotakasika kutoka hedhi yake, ni lazima ahesabu siku saba, na baada ya hapo atakuwa safi kwa kawaida ya ibada.
english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

kikuyu: Siku ya nane ni lazima achukue hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa, na kumletea kuhani kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Kuhani atatoa dhabihu, mmoja kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na huyo mwingine kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Kwa njia hii, atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake mbele za Bwana kwa sababu ya unajisi wa kutokwa damu kwake.
english: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before the LORD for the uncleanness of her discharge.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ni lazima uwatenge Waisraeli kutokana na vitu ambavyo vinawafanya najisi, ili wasife katika unajisi wao kwa kunajisi makao yangu, ambayo yapo katikati yao.’ ”
english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

kikuyu: Haya ni masharti kwa ajili ya mtu mwenye kutokwa na usaha, kwa ajili ya yeyote atakayetokwa na shahawa,
english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

kikuyu: kwa ajili ya mwanamke katika siku zake za hedhi, kwa ajili ya mwanaume au mwanamke atokwaye na usaha, na kwa ajili ya mwanaume alalaye na mwanamke ambaye ni najisi kwa kawaida ya ibada.
english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

kikuyu: Bwana akasema na Mose baada ya kifo cha wale wana wawili wa Aroni waliokufa walipokaribia mbele za Bwana.
english: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before the LORD, and died;

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose: “Mwambie ndugu yako Aroni asije wakati wowote atakavyo yeye ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, nyuma ya pazia pale mbele ya kiti cha rehema kile kilichoko juu ya Sanduku la Agano, la sivyo atakufa, kwa sababu huwa ninatokea ndani ya wingu juu ya kile kiti cha rehema.
english: and the LORD said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

kikuyu: “Hivi ndivyo Aroni atakavyoingia katika mahali patakatifu: atachukua fahali mchanga kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

kikuyu: Atavaa koti takatifu la kitani, pamoja na nguo za ndani za kitani; atafunga mshipi wa kitani kiunoni, na kuvaa kilemba cha kitani. Haya ni mavazi matakatifu, kwa hiyo ni lazima aoge kwa maji kabla ya kuyavaa mavazi hayo.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

kikuyu: Atachukua mbuzi dume wawili kutoka kwa jumuiya ya Israeli kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi, na kondoo dume kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

kikuyu: “Aroni atamtoa huyo fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka yake ya dhambi ili afanye upatanisho kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na nyumba yake.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

kikuyu: Kisha atawachukua wale mbuzi dume wawili na kuwaleta mbele za Bwana kwenye ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before the LORD at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Aroni atapiga kura kwa ajili ya hao mbuzi wawili, mmoja kwa ajili ya Bwana na mwingine kwa ajili ya kubebeshwa dhambi.
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

kikuyu: Aroni atamleta yule mbuzi ambaye kura ya Bwana imemwangukia na kumtoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for the LORD, and offer him for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Lakini mbuzi aliyechaguliwa kwa kura kuwa wa kubebeshwa dhambi atatolewa akiwa hai mbele za Bwana, atumike kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa kumwacha aende jangwani akiwa amebebeshwa dhambi.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

kikuyu: “Aroni atamleta yule fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi yake mwenyewe, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yake na nyumba yake, naye atamchinja huyo fahali kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi yake mwenyewe.
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

kikuyu: Atachukua chetezo kilichojaa makaa yanayowaka kutoka madhabahuni mbele za Bwana, na konzi mbili za uvumba laini uliosagwa vizuri wenye harufu, na kuvipeleka nyuma ya pazia.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

kikuyu: Ataweka uvumba juu ya moto mbele za Bwana, na moshi wa uvumba utafunika kile kiti cha rehema kilicho juu ya Ushuhuda, ili asife.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

kikuyu: Atachukua sehemu ya damu ya fahali, na kwa kidole chake atanyunyiza sehemu ya mbele ya kiti cha rehema; kisha atanyunyiza sehemu ya hiyo damu kwa kidole chake mara saba mbele ya kiti cha rehema.
