english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

kikuyu: Balaamu akasema, “Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, mnitayarishie mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

kikuyu: Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema; hao wawili kila mmoja wao akatoa fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

kikuyu: Kisha Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati mimi ninakwenda kando. Huenda Bwana atakuja kukutana nami. Lolote atakalonifunulia, nitakuambia.” Basi akaenda hata mahali peupe palipoinuka.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

kikuyu: Mungu akakutana naye, kisha Balaamu akasema, “Nimekwisha kutengeneza madhabahu saba, na juu ya kila madhabahu nimetoa sadaka ya fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja.”
english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

kikuyu: Bwana akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa cha Balaamu na kusema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”
english: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

kikuyu: Basi Balaamu akarudi kwa Balaki, akamkuta amesimama kando ya sadaka yake akiwa na wakuu wote wa Moabu.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki amenileta kutoka Aramu, mfalme wa Moabu kutoka milima ya mashariki. Akasema, ‘Njoo, unilaanie Yakobo; njoo unishutumie Israeli.’
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

kikuyu: Nitawezaje kuwalaani, hao ambao Mungu hajawalaani? Nitawezaje kuwashutumu hao ambao Bwana hakuwashutumu?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

kikuyu: Kutoka vilele vya miamba ninawaona, kutoka mahali palipoinuka ninawatazama. Ninaliona taifa ambalo wanaishi peke yao, nao hawahesabiwi kama mojawapo ya mataifa.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

kikuyu: Ni nani awezaye kuhesabu mavumbi ya Yakobo, au kuhesabu robo ya Israeli? Mimi na nife kifo cha mtu mwenye haki, na mwisho wangu na uwe kama wao!”
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

kikuyu: Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Ni nini ulichonitendea? Nimekuleta ulaani adui zangu, lakini wewe badala yake umewabariki!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

kikuyu: Balaamu akajibu, “Je, hainipasi kusema kile Bwana anachoweka katika kinywa changu?”
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Balaki akamwambia, “Twende pamoja mahali pengine ambapo unaweza kuwaona; utawaona baadhi tu wala si wote. Nawe kutoka huko, unilaanie hao.”
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

kikuyu: Basi akampeleka kwenye shamba la Sofimu, juu ya kilele cha Mlima Pisga. Pale akajenga madhabahu saba na kutoa sadaka ya fahali na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Kaa hapa kando ya sadaka yako wakati ninapokwenda kuonana na Mungu kule.”
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

kikuyu: Bwana akakutana na Balaamu, akaweka ujumbe katika kinywa chake akasema, “Rudi kwa Balaki umpe ujumbe huu.”
english: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

kikuyu: Basi Balaamu akarudi kwa Balaki, akamkuta amesimama kando ya sadaka yake, akiwa na wakuu wa Moabu. Balaki akamuuliza, “Je, Bwana amesema nini?”
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Balaamu akasema ujumbe wake: “Balaki, inuka na usikilize, nisikie mimi, wewe mwana wa Sipori.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

kikuyu: Mungu si mtu, hata aseme uongo, wala yeye si mwanadamu, hata ajute. Je, anasema, kisha asitende? Je, anaahidi, asitimize?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

kikuyu: Nimepokea agizo kubariki; amebariki, nami siwezi kubadilisha.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

kikuyu: “Haijaonekana bahati mbaya katika Yakobo, wala taabu katika Israeli. Bwana, Mungu wao yu pamoja nao, nayo sauti kuu ya Mfalme imo katikati yao.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

kikuyu: Mungu aliwatoa kutoka Misri; wao wana nguvu za nyati.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

kikuyu: Hakuna uchawi dhidi ya Yakobo, wala hakuna uaguzi dhidi ya Israeli. Sasa itasemwa kuhusu Yakobo na Israeli, ‘Tazama yale Mungu aliyotenda!’
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

kikuyu: Taifa lainuka kama simba jike; linajiinua kama simba ambaye hatulii mpaka amalize kurarua mawindo yake na kunywa damu ya mawindo yake.”
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

kikuyu: Kisha Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Usiwalaani kabisa, wala usiwabariki kabisa!”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

kikuyu: Balaamu akajibu, “Je, sikukuambia ni lazima nifanye lolote analosema Bwana?”
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”

kikuyu: Basi Balaki akamwambia Balaamu, “Njoo, nikupeleke mahali pengine. Huenda itampendeza Mungu kukuruhusu unilaanie hao watu kutoka mahali hapo.”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

kikuyu: Balaki akamchukua Balaamu juu ya Mlima Peori, unaotazamana na nyika.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

kikuyu: Balaamu akasema, “Nijengee hapa madhabahu saba, uandae mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba kwa ajili yangu.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

kikuyu: Balaki akafanya kama Balaamu alivyosema, kisha akatoa sadaka ya fahali mmoja na kondoo dume mmoja juu ya kila madhabahu.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Basi Balaamu alipoona imempendeza Bwana kubariki Israeli, hakuendelea tena kutafuta uchawi kama nyakati nyingine, bali aligeuza uso wake kuelekea nyikani.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

kikuyu: Balaamu alipotazama nje na kuona Israeli amepiga kambi kabila kwa kabila, Roho wa Mungu akawa juu yake,
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

kikuyu: naye akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: ujumbe wake yeye ambaye husikia maneno ya Mungu, ambaye huona maono kutoka kwa Mwenyezi, ambaye huanguka kifudifudi, na ambaye macho yake yamefunguka:
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: “Tazama jinsi yalivyo mazuri mahema yako, ee Yakobo, maskani yako, ee Israeli!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

kikuyu: “Kama mabonde, yanaenea, kama bustani kando ya mto, kama miti ya udi iliyopandwa na Bwana, kama mierezi kando ya maji.
english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

kikuyu: Maji yatatiririka kutoka ndoo zake; mbegu yake itakuwa na maji tele. “Mfalme wake atakuwa mkuu kuliko Mfalme Agagi; ufalme wake utatukuka.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

kikuyu: “Mungu alimleta kutoka Misri; yeye ana nguvu kama nyati. Anayararua mataifa yaliyo adui zake, na kuvunja mifupa yao vipande vipande; huwachoma kwa mishale yake.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

kikuyu: Hujikunyata na kuvizia kama simba, kama simba jike; nani anayethubutu kumwamsha? “Abarikiwe kila akubarikiye, na alaaniwe kila akulaaniye!”
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

kikuyu: Ndipo hasira ya Balaki ikawaka dhidi ya Balaamu. Akapiga mikono yake pamoja, akamwambia Balaamu, “Nilikuita uje kuwalaani adui zangu, lakini umewabariki mara hizi tatu.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

kikuyu: Sasa ondoka upesi uende nyumbani! Mimi nilisema nitakuzawadia vizuri sana, lakini Bwana amekuzuia usizawadiwe.”
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

kikuyu: Balaamu akamwambia Balaki, “Je, hukumbuki jinsi nilivyowaambia wajumbe uliowatuma kwangu? Niliwaambia hivi,
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Hata ikiwa Balaki angenipa jumba lake la kifalme likiwa limejazwa fedha na dhahabu, nisingeweza kufanya kitu chochote kwa matakwa yangu, kikiwa kizuri au kibaya, kwenda kinyume na agizo la Bwana, nami imenipasa kusema tu kile Bwana atakachosema’?
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

kikuyu: Sasa ninarudi kwa watu wangu. Lakini njoo, nikuonye kuhusu kile watu hawa watakachowatenda watu wako siku zijazo.”
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

kikuyu: Kisha Balaamu akatoa ujumbe wake: “Ujumbe wa Balaamu mwana wa Beori, ujumbe wake yeye ambaye jicho lake linaona vizuri;
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: ujumbe wake yeye ambaye husikia maneno ya Mungu, ambaye ana maarifa kutoka kwa Aliye Juu Sana, huona maono kutoka Mwenyezi, ambaye huanguka kifudifudi na ambaye macho yake yamefunguka:
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: “Namwona yeye, lakini si sasa; namtazama yeye, lakini si karibu. Nyota itatoka kwa Yakobo, fimbo ya ufalme itainuka kutoka kwa Israeli. Atawaponda Wamoabu vipaji vya nyuso na mafuvu yote ya wana wa Shethi.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

kikuyu: Edomu itamilikiwa, Seiri, adui wake, itamilikiwa, lakini Israeli atakuwa na nguvu.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

kikuyu: Mtawala atakuja kutoka kwa Yakobo na kuangamiza walionusurika katika mji.”
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

kikuyu: Kisha Balaamu akawaona watu wa Amaleki, na kutoa ujumbe wake: “Amaleki ilikuwa ya kwanza miongoni mwa mataifa, lakini mwisho wake itaangamizwa milele.”
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Kisha akawaona Wakeni, akatoa ujumbe wake: “Makao yenu ni salama, kiota chenu kiko kwenye mwamba.
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo ninyi Wakeni mtaangamizwa Ashuru atakapowachukua mateka.”
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

kikuyu: Ndipo akatoa ujumbe wake: “Lo, ni nani atakayeweza kuishi wakati Mungu atakapofanya hili?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

kikuyu: Meli zitakuja kutoka pwani za Kitimu, zitaitiisha Ashuru na Eberi, lakini nao pia wataangamizwa.”
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Kisha Balaamu akainuka na kurudi nyumbani kwake, naye Balaki akashika njia yake.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

kikuyu: Israeli alipokuwa akikaa Shitimu, wanaume wa Israeli walianza kuzini na wanawake wa Kimoabu,
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

kikuyu: ambao waliwaalika kushiriki katika kutoa kafara kwa miungu yao. Watu wakala na kusujudu mbele ya miungu hii.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Israeli akaungana katika kumwabudu Baali wa Peori. Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi yao.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Uwachukue viongozi wote wa watu hawa, uwaue na uwaweke hadharani mchana peupe mbele za Bwana, ili hasira kali ya Bwana iweze kuondoka kwa Israeli.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia waamuzi wa Israeli, “Kila mmoja wenu lazima awaue wale wanaume wenu, walioshiriki katika kumwabudu Baali wa Peori.”
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

kikuyu: Ndipo mwanaume wa Kiisraeli akamleta mwanamke wa Kimidiani katika jamaa yake palepale mbele ya Mose na mkutano wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wakilia kwenye lango la Hema la Kukutania.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, alipoona jambo hili, akaondoka kwenye kusanyiko, akachukua mkuki mkononi mwake,
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

kikuyu: akamfuata yule Mwisraeli ndani ya hema. Akawachoma mkuki wote wawili kwa pamoja, ukapenya kwenye mwili wa yule Mwisraeli na mwili wa yule mwanamke. Ndipo tauni iliyokuwepo dhidi ya Waisraeli ikakoma.
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Lakini wale waliokufa kwa hiyo tauni walikuwa watu 24,000.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari, mwana wa kuhani Aroni, amegeuza hasira yangu mbali na Waisraeli, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kama nilio nao kwa heshima yangu miongoni mwao, hata kwamba kwa wivu wangu sikuwaangamiza.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo mwambie Finehasi ninafanya Agano langu la amani naye.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

kikuyu: Yeye pamoja na wazao wake watakuwa na Agano la ukuhani milele, kwa sababu alikuwa na wivu kwa ajili ya heshima ya Mungu wake, na akafanya upatanisho kwa Waisraeli.”
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Jina la Mwisraeli ambaye aliuawa pamoja na mwanamke wa Kimidiani ni Zimri mwana wa Salu, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Simeoni.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

kikuyu: Jina la mwanamke wa Kimidiani aliyeuawa ni Kozbi binti wa Suri, aliyekuwa mkuu wa kabila la jamaa ya Wamidiani.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Watendeeni Wamidiani kama adui na mwaue,
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

kikuyu: kwa sababu wao waliwatendea kama adui wakati waliwadanganya katika tukio la Peori na dada yao Kozbi, binti wa kiongozi wa Kimidiani, mwanamke ambaye aliuawa wakati tauni ilikuja kama matokeo ya tukio la Peori.”
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

kikuyu: Baada ya hiyo tauni, Bwana akamwambia Mose na Eleazari mwana wa kuhani Aroni,
english: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

kikuyu: “Hesabu jumuiya yote ya Kiisraeli kwa jamaa zao, wale wote wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, ambao wanaweza kutumika katika jeshi la Israeli.”
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakazungumza na watu kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, ngʼambo ya Yordani kutokea Yeriko, wakasema,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: “Hesabuni wanaume wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.” Hawa ndio Waisraeli waliotoka Misri:
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Reubeni, mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Israeli, walikuwa: kutoka kwa Hanoki, ukoo wa Wahanoki; kutoka kwa Palu, ukoo wa Wapalu;
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Hesroni, ukoo wa Wahesroni; kutoka kwa Karmi, ukoo wa Wakarmi.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

kikuyu: Hizi zilikuwa ndizo koo za Reubeni; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 43,730.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Palu alikuwa Eliabu,
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

kikuyu: nao wana wa Eliabu walikuwa Nemueli, Dathani na Abiramu. Hawa wawili Dathani na Abiramu ndio walikuwa maafisa wa jumuiya ambao walimwasi Mose na Aroni, na walikuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora wakati walimwasi Bwana.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;

kikuyu: Ardhi ilifunua kinywa chake na kuwameza pamoja na Kora, ambaye wafuasi wake walikufa wakati moto ulipowateketeza wanaume 250. Nao walikuwa kama alama ya onyo.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

kikuyu: Pamoja na hayo, hao ukoo wa Kora hawakufa.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Simeoni kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Nemueli, ukoo wa Wanemueli; kutoka kwa Yamini, ukoo wa Wayamini; kutoka wa Yakini, ukoo wa Wayakini;
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Zera, ukoo wa Wazera; kutoka kwa Shauli, ukoo wa Washauli.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo koo za Simeoni; walikuwa 22,200.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Gadi kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Sifoni, ukoo wa Wasifoni; kutoka kwa Hagi, ukoo wa Wahagi; kutoka kwa Shuni, ukoo wa Washuni;
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Ozni, ukoo wa Waozni; kutoka kwa Eri, ukoo wa Waeri;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Arodi, ukoo wa Waarodi; kutoka kwa Areli, ukoo wa Waareli.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Gadi; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 40,500.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

kikuyu: Eri na Onani walikuwa wana wa Yuda, lakini walifia huko Kanaani.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Yuda kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Shela, ukoo wa Washela; kutoka kwa Peresi, ukoo wa Waperesi; kutoka kwa Zera, ukoo wa Wazera.
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Peresi walikuwa: kutoka kwa Hesroni, ukoo wa Wahesroni; kutoka kwa Hamuli, ukoo wa Wahamuli.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Yuda; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 76,500.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Isakari kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Tola, ukoo wa Watola; kutoka kwa Puva, ukoo wa Wapuva;
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Yashubu, ukoo wa Wayashubu; kutoka kwa Shimroni, ukoo wa Washimroni.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Isakari; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,300.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Zabuloni kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Seredi, ukoo wa Waseredi; kutoka kwa Eloni, ukoo wa Waeloni; kutoka kwa Yaleeli, ukoo wa Wayaleeli.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Zabuloni, wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 60,500.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao kutoka kwa Manase na kwa Efraimu walikuwa:
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Manase: kutoka kwa Makiri, ukoo wa Wamakiri (Makiri alikuwa baba wa Gileadi); kutoka kwa Gileadi, ukoo wa Wagileadi.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Gileadi: kutoka kwa Iezeri, ukoo wa Waiezeri; kutoka kwa Heleki, ukoo wa Waheleki;
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Asirieli, ukoo wa Waasirieli; kutoka kwa Shekemu, ukoo wa Washekemu;
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Shemida, ukoo wa Washemida; kutoka kwa Heferi, ukoo wa Waheferi.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

kikuyu: (Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi hakuzaa wana, bali alikuwa na watoto wa kike tu, ambao majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.)
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Manase; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 52,700.
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Hawa walikuwa wazao wa Efraimu kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Shuthela, ukoo wa Washuthela; kutoka kwa Bekeri, ukoo wa Wabekeri; kutoka kwa Tahani, ukoo wa Watahani;
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio walikuwa wazao wa Shuthela: kutoka kwa Erani, ukoo wa Waerani.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Efraimu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 32,500. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Yosefu kwa koo zao.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Benyamini kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Bela, ukoo wa Wabela; kutoka kwa Ashbeli, ukoo wa Waashbeli; kutoka kwa Ahiramu, ukoo wa Waahiramu;
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Shufamu, ukoo wa Washufamu; kutoka kwa Hufamu, ukoo wa Wahufamu.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Bela kutoka kwa Ardi na Naamani walikuwa: kutoka kwa Ardi, ukoo wa Waardi; kutoka kwa Naamani, ukoo wa Wanaamani.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Benyamini; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 45,600.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Dani kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Shuhamu, ukoo wa Washuhamu. Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Dani:
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

kikuyu: Wote walikuwa koo za Washuhamu; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 64,400.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Asheri kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Imna, ukoo wa Waimna; kutoka kwa Ishvi, ukoo wa Waishvi; kutoka kwa Beria, ukoo wa Waberia;
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

kikuyu: kutoka kwa wazao wa Beria: kutoka kwa Heberi, ukoo wa Waheberi; kutoka kwa Malkieli, ukoo wa Wamalkieli.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

kikuyu: (Asheri alikuwa na binti aliyeitwa Sera.)
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Asheri; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 53,400.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Naftali kwa koo zao walikuwa: kutoka kwa Yaseeli, ukoo wa Wayaseeli; kutoka kwa Guni, ukoo wa Waguni;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

kikuyu: kutoka kwa Yeseri, ukoo wa Wayeseri; kutoka kwa Shilemu, ukoo wa Washilemu.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

kikuyu: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Naftali; wale waliohesabiwa walikuwa 45,400.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Jumla ya hesabu ya wanaume wa Israeli ilikuwa 601,730.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Watagawiwa nchi kama urithi kwa kulingana na hesabu ya majina.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

kikuyu: Kundi kubwa zaidi lipe urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kundi dogo zaidi lipewe urithi mdogo zaidi; kila kundi litapokea urithi wake kulingana na hesabu ya wale walioorodheshwa.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

kikuyu: Hakikisha kuwa nchi inagawanywa kwa kura. Kile kitakachorithiwa na kila kikundi kitakuwa kwa kulingana na majina ya kabila la babu yao.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

kikuyu: Kila urithi utagawanywa kwa kura miongoni mwa makundi makubwa na madogo.”
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

kikuyu: Hawa walikuwa Walawi ambao walihesabiwa kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Gershoni, ukoo wa Wagershoni; kutoka kwa Kohathi, ukoo wa Wakohathi; kutoka kwa Merari, ukoo wa Wamerari.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

kikuyu: Hizi pia zilikuwa koo za Walawi: ukoo wa Walibni; ukoo wa Wahebroni; ukoo wa Wamahli; ukoo wa Wamushi; ukoo wa wana wa Kora. (Kohathi alikuwa baba aliyemzaa Amramu;
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

kikuyu: jina la mke wa Amramu ni Yokebedi, naye pia alikuwa mzao wa Lawi, ambaye alizaliwa kwa Walawi nchini Misri. Alimzalia Amramu: Aroni, Mose na dada yao Miriamu.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

kikuyu: Aroni alikuwa baba yake Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa wakati walitoa sadaka mbele za Bwana kwa moto usioruhusiwa.)
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

kikuyu: Wanaume wote wa Walawi wa umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi walikuwa 23,000. Wao hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine kwa sababu hawakupokea urithi miongoni mwao.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio walioorodheshwa na Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakati waliwahesabu Waisraeli kwenye nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyekuwa miongoni mwa wale waliohesabiwa na Mose na kuhani Aroni wakati waliwahesabu Waisraeli katika Jangwa la Sinai.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana alikuwa amewaambia hao Waisraeli hakika wangekufa huko jangwani, wala hakuna mmoja wao aliyeachwa, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
english: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Binti za Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, walikuwa wa koo za Manase mwana wa Yosefu. Majina ya hao binti yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa. Walikaribia
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: ingilio la Hema la Kukutania na kusimama mbele ya Mose, kuhani Eleazari, viongozi na kusanyiko lote, wakasema,
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: “Baba yetu alikufa jangwani. Hakuwa miongoni mwa wafuasi wa Kora, ambao walifungamana pamoja dhidi ya Bwana, lakini alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi yake mwenyewe na hakuacha wana.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

kikuyu: Kwa nini jina la baba yetu lifutike kutoka ukoo wake kwa sababu hakuwa na mwana? Tupatie milki miongoni mwa ndugu za baba yetu.”
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mose akalileta shauri lao mbele za Bwana,
english: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

kikuyu: naye Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Wanachosema binti za Selofehadi ni sawa. Ni lazima kwa hakika uwape milki kama urithi miongoni mwa ndugu za baba yao, na kubadili urithi wa baba yao uwe wao.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

kikuyu: “Waambie Waisraeli, ‘Ikiwa mtu atakufa naye hakuacha mwana, utampa binti yake urithi wake.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

kikuyu: Ikiwa hana binti, wape ndugu zake wa kiume urithi wake.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

kikuyu: Ikiwa hana ndugu wa kiume toa urithi wake kwa ndugu za baba yake.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

kikuyu: Ikiwa baba yake hakuwa na ndugu wa kiume, toa urithi wake kwa ndugu wa karibu katika ukoo wake, ili aumiliki. Hili litakuwa dai la sheria kwa Waisraeli, kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.’ ”
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Panda juu ya mlima huu katika kilele cha Abarimu uione nchi ambayo nimewapa Waisraeli.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Baada ya kuiona, wewe pia utakusanywa pamoja na watu wako kama ndugu yako Aroni alivyokusanywa,
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

kikuyu: kwa kuwa jumuiya ilipoasi amri yangu kwenye maji katika Jangwa la Sini, wakati jumuiya ilipogombana nami, nyote wawili mliacha kuitii amri yangu ya kuniheshimu kama mtakatifu mbele ya macho yao.” (Haya yalikuwa maji ya Meriba huko Kadeshi, katika Jangwa la Sini.)
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

kikuyu: Mose akamwambia Bwana,
english: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: “Bwana, Mungu wa roho zote za wanadamu, na amteue mtu juu ya jumuiya hii
english: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

kikuyu: ili atoke na kuingia mbele yao, atakayewaongoza katika kutoka kwao na kuingia kwao, ili watu wa Bwana wasiwe kama kondoo wasio na mchungaji.”
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Bwana akamwambia Mose, “Mchukue Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, mtu ambaye Roho yuko ndani yake, uweke mkono juu yake.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

kikuyu: Msimamishe mbele ya kuhani Eleazari pamoja na kusanyiko lote, umpe maagizo mbele yao.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

kikuyu: Mpe sehemu ya mamlaka yako ili jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli ipate kumtii.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

kikuyu: Atasimama mbele ya kuhani Eleazari, ambaye atapokea maamuzi kwa ajili yake, kwa kuuliza mbele za Bwana kwa ile Urimu. Kwa amri yake, yeye na jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli watatoka, na kwa amri yake, wataingia.”
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

kikuyu: Mose akafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza. Akamtwaa Yoshua na kumsimamisha mbele ya kuhani Eleazari na kusanyiko lote.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

kikuyu: Kisha akaweka mikono yake juu ya kichwa cha Yoshua na kumpa maagizo, kama vile Bwana alivyoelekeza kupitia kwa Mose.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Wape Waisraeli agizo hili na uwaambie: ‘Hakikisheni kwamba mnaniletea mimi kwa wakati uliowekwa chakula kwa ajili ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa moto, kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza.’
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

kikuyu: Waambie: ‘Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto mnayomtolea Bwana: wana-kondoo wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasio na dosari, kama sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa kila siku.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Andaa mwana-kondoo mmoja asubuhi na mwingine jioni,
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

kikuyu: kila mmoja atolewe pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa pamoja na robo ya hini ya mafuta ya zeituni.
english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

kikuyu: Hii ni sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa iliyoanzishwa katika Mlima Sinai kama harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, sadaka iliyotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Sadaka ya kinywaji itakayotolewa pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo ni robo ya hini ya kinywaji kilichochachuka. Mimina sadaka ya kinywaji kwa Bwana mahali patakatifu.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

kikuyu: Andaa yule mwana-kondoo wa pili jioni, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji kama ulivyofanya kwa ile sadaka nyingine ya asubuhi. Hii ni sadaka iliyotolewa kwa kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Siku ya Sabato, utatoa sadaka ya wana-kondoo wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasiokuwa na dosari pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji na sadaka ya nafaka yenye uzito wa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

kikuyu: Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa itakayotolewa kwa ajili ya kila Sabato, pamoja na sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Siku ya kwanza ya kila mwezi, mtamletea Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasiokuwa na dosari.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

kikuyu: Pamoja na kila fahali, kutakuwa na sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa, uliochanganywa na mafuta, pamoja na kondoo dume mmoja, sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta;
english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

kikuyu: pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo, sadaka ya nafaka yenye uzito wa sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta. Hii ni kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, harufu nzuri, sadaka ya kuteketezwa iliyotolewa kwa moto kwa Bwana.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Pamoja na kila fahali kutakuwa na sadaka ya kinywaji nusu ya hini ya divai; pamoja na kila kondoo dume, theluthi moja ya hini, na pamoja na kila mwana-kondoo robo hini. Hii ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila mwezi itakayotolewa kila mwandamo wa mwezi kwa mwaka.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji, mbuzi mmoja dume atatolewa kwa Bwana kama sadaka ya dhambi.
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza, itafanyika Pasaka ya Bwana.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi huo itakuwa sikukuu; kwa siku saba mtakula mikate isiyotiwa chachu.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya kwanza mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, msifanye kazi za kawaida.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

kikuyu: Leteni mbele za Bwana sadaka ya kuteketezwa, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mafahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja na wana-kondoo dume saba wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

kikuyu: Pamoja na kila fahali, andaa sadaka ya nafaka sehemu tatu za kumi za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa;
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

kikuyu: pia pamoja na kila mmoja wa wale wana-kondoo saba, andaa sehemu ya kumi ya efa.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Pia mtoe beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi ambaye atafanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Andaa hizi licha ya zile sadaka za kawaida za kuteketezwa za kila asubuhi.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Kwa njia hii andaa chakula cha sadaka ya kuteketezwa kila siku, kwa siku saba kama harufu nzuri impendezayo Bwana. Hii itaandaliwa licha ya ile sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku pamoja na sadaka yake ya kinywaji.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Siku ya saba mwe na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: “ ‘Siku ya malimbuko, mnapomletea Bwana sadaka ya nafaka mpya wakati wa Sikukuu ya Majuma, mwe na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi zenu za kawaida.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: Mlete sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya mafahali wawili wachanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na pia wana-kondoo saba wenye umri wa mwaka mmoja, kama harufu nzuri ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

kikuyu: Pamoja na kila fahali itatolewa sadaka ya nafaka ya unga laini sehemu tatu za kumi za efa uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, andaa sehemu mbili za kumi za efa za unga laini;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kwa kila mmoja wa wana-kondoo saba.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Ongeza beberu mmoja kwa kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Andaa hizi sadaka pamoja na sadaka zake za vinywaji, kuwa nyongeza ya sadaka za kawaida za kuteketezwa, pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka. Hakikisha kuwa wanyama hao hawana dosari.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu na msifanye kazi ya kawaida. Ni siku kwa ajili yenu ya kupiga tarumbeta.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

kikuyu: Mtatayarisha sadaka ya kuteketezwa kama harufu nzuri impendezayo Bwana ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na fahali, andaeni sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kwa kondoo dume, andaa unga sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

kikuyu: na pamoja na wana-kondoo saba kila mmoja aandaliwe na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yenu.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

kikuyu: Hivi ni nyongeza ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kila mwezi na kila siku pamoja na sadaka zake za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji kama ilivyoainishwa. Ni sadaka zinazotolewa kwa Bwana kwa moto, harufu inayopendeza.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kwenye siku ya kumi ya mwezi huu wa saba mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu. Mtajikana wenyewe na msifanye kazi.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

kikuyu: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja mchanga, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na fahali, andaeni sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; pamoja na kondoo dume, sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa za unga laini;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: na kwa kila mmoja wa wana-kondoo saba andaa sehemu ya kumi ya unga laini kwa kila mmoja.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya dhambi kwa ajili ya upatanisho, na sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa pamoja na sadaka yake ya nafaka, na sadaka zake za vinywaji.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa saba, mtakuwa na kusanyiko takatifu, na hamtafanya kazi za kawaida. Adhimisheni sikukuu kwa Bwana kwa siku saba.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

kikuyu: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa mafahali wachanga kumi na watatu, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari, kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na hao mafahali kumi na watatu, kila mmoja aandaliwe na sadaka ya nafaka sehemu ya kumi tatu za efa za unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta; kwa kondoo dume wawili, kila mmoja aandaliwe sehemu ya kumi mbili za efa za unga laini;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

kikuyu: na kwa wana-kondoo kumi na wanne, kila mmoja aandaliwe sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

kikuyu: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka ya vinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya pili andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya tatu andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya nne andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya tano andaeni mafahali tisa, kondoo dume wawili na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za kinywaji kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa na sadaka yake ya nafaka pamoja na sadaka ya kinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya sita andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya saba andaeni mafahali wachanga kumi na wawili, kondoo dume wawili, na wana-kondoo kumi na wanne wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na mafahali, kondoo dume, na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Weka beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, kwa nyongeza ya kawaida ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka, pamoja na sadaka zao za vinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Katika siku ya nane mtakuwa na kusanyiko, na msifanye kazi ya kawaida.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: Toeni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kama harufu nzuri inayompendeza Bwana, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya fahali mmoja, kondoo dume mmoja, na wana-kondoo dume saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na dosari.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Pamoja na fahali, kondoo dume na wana-kondoo, andaeni sadaka zao za nafaka, na sadaka za vinywaji, kulingana na idadi iliyoainishwa.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Ongeza beberu mmoja kama sadaka ya dhambi, katika nyongeza ya sadaka ya kawaida ya kuteketezwa, na sadaka yake ya nafaka pamoja na sadaka ya kinywaji.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Zaidi ya kile unachoweka nadhiri na sadaka zenu za hiari, andaeni hizi kwa ajili ya Bwana kwenye sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa: sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka, sadaka za vinywaji, pamoja na sadaka zenu za amani.’ ”
english: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

kikuyu: Mose akawaambia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana alimwagiza.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mose akawaambia viongozi wa makabila ya Israeli: “Hili ndilo Bwana analoagiza:
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

kikuyu: Mwanaume awekapo nadhiri kwa Bwana, au anapoapa kujifunga kwa ahadi, kamwe asitangue neno lake, bali ni lazima afanye kila kitu alichosema.
english: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

kikuyu: “Wakati mwanamwali anayeishi bado nyumbani kwa baba yake atakapoweka nadhiri kwa Bwana, ama amejifunga mwenyewe kwa ahadi,
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

kikuyu: na baba yake akasikia kuhusu nadhiri au ahadi yake lakini asimwambie lolote, ndipo nadhiri zake zote na kila ahadi aliyoiweka na kujifunga kwayo itathibitika.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Lakini kama baba yake akimkataza wakati anapoisikia, hakuna nadhiri wala ahadi yake yoyote aliyojifunga kwayo itakayosimama; Bwana atamweka huru huyo mwanamwali kwa sababu baba yake amemkataza.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa ataolewa baada ya kuweka nadhiri au baada ya midomo yake kutamka ahadi fulani bila kufikiri akawa amejifunga hivyo,
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

kikuyu: na mume wake akasikia habari hiyo asimwambie neno lolote, ndipo nadhiri zake ama ahadi zake ambazo alikuwa amejifunga nazo zitathibitika.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa mume wake atamkataza atakaposikia kuhusu hilo, atakuwa ametangua nadhiri ambazo zilikuwa zimemfunga mkewe, ama ahadi aliyotamka pasipo kufikiri ambayo amejifunga kwayo, naye Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: “Nadhiri yoyote ama patano ambalo limefanywa na mjane ama mwanamke aliyeachwa vitakuwa vimemfunga.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa mwanamke anayeishi na mumewe ataweka nadhiri ama kujifunga mwenyewe kwa ahadi chini ya kiapo,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

kikuyu: na mumewe akasikia kuhusu jambo hili lakini asimwambie lolote wala hakumkataza, ndipo viapo vyake vyote au ahadi zinazomfunga zitakapothibitika.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa mumewe atabatilisha nadhiri hizo baada ya kuzisikia, basi hakuna nadhiri au ahadi zozote alizoziweka kwa midomo yake zitakazothibitika. Mumewe atakuwa amezibatilisha, na Bwana atamweka huru yule mwanamke.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: Mumewe anaweza kuthibitisha au kutangua nadhiri yoyote anayoweka, au ahadi yoyote aliyoweka kwa kuapa ili kujikana mwenyewe.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa mumewe hasemi lolote kwake kuhusu jambo hilo siku baada ya siku, basi mumewe atakuwa amethibitisha nadhiri zote, na ahadi zote zinazomfunga mkewe. Anavithibitisha kwa kutokusema lolote kwa mkewe anapoyasikia hayo.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, ikiwa mumewe atavibatilisha baada ya kusikia hayo, basi atawajibika kwa hatia ya mkewe.”
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo masharti ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose kuhusu mahusiano kati ya mtu na mkewe, na kati ya baba na binti yake ambaye bado anaishi nyumbani kwa baba yake.
english: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Uwalipize kisasi Wamidiani kwa ajili ya Waisraeli. Halafu baada ya hayo, utakufa.”
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mose akawaambia watu, “Waandaeni baadhi ya wanaume wenu waende vitani kupigana na Wamidiani ili wawalipize kisasi cha Bwana.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.

kikuyu: Peleka wanaume 1,000 vitani kutoka kila kabila la Israeli.”
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo waliandaliwa wanaume 12,000 kwa vita, wanaume 1,000 kutoka kila kabila, walitolewa kutoka koo za Israeli.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

kikuyu: Mose aliwatuma vitani, watu 1,000 kutoka kila kabila, pamoja na Finehasi mwana wa kuhani Eleazari, ambaye alichukua vyombo vya mahali patakatifu na tarumbeta za kuashiria.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

kikuyu: Walipigana dhidi ya Wamidiani, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose, nao waliua kila mwanaume.
english: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.

kikuyu: Miongoni mwa watu waliouawa walikuwepo wafalme watano wa Midiani, nao ni Evi, Rekemu, Suri, Huri na Reba. Vilevile walimuua Balaamu mwana wa Beori kwa upanga.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

kikuyu: Waisraeli waliwateka wanawake wa Kimidiani pamoja na watoto wao na walichukua makundi ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mali zao kama nyara.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

kikuyu: Walichoma moto miji yote ambayo Wamidiani walikuwa wanaishi, pamoja na kambi zao zote.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

kikuyu: Walichukua nyara zote na mateka, pamoja na watu na wanyama,
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

kikuyu: nao waliwaleta wafungwa mateka na nyara kwa Mose na kwa kuhani Eleazari, nao Waisraeli walikusanyika kwenye kambi zao katika tambarare za nchi ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Mose, kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wote wa jumuiya wakatoka kuwalaki nje ya kambi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Mose aliwakasirikia maafisa wa jeshi, yaani hao wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, ambao walirudi kutoka vitani.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

kikuyu: Mose akawauliza, “Je, mmewaacha wanawake wote hai?”
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

kikuyu: “Wanawake hao ndio waliofuata ushauri wa Balaamu, nao ndio waliowasababisha Waisraeli wamwasi Bwana kwa kile kilichotokea kule Peori, na kwa hiyo pigo liliwapata watu wa Bwana.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.

kikuyu: Sasa waue wavulana wote. Pia muue kila mwanamke ambaye alikwisha fanya tendo la ndoa,
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: lakini mwacheni hai kwa ajili yenu kila msichana ambaye kamwe hajawahi kuzini na mwanaume.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

kikuyu: “Ninyi nyote ambao mmeua mtu yeyote au kumgusa mtu yeyote ambaye ameuawa, lazima mkae nje ya kambi kwa muda wa siku saba. Katika siku ya tatu na ya saba lazima mjitakase wenyewe pamoja na wafungwa wenu.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

kikuyu: Takaseni kila vazi pamoja na kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa ngozi, kwa singa za mbuzi au kwa mti.”
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani Eleazari aliwaambia askari waliokuwa wamekwenda vitani, “Haya ndiyo matakwa ya sheria ambayo Bwana alimpa Mose:
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Dhahabu, fedha, shaba, chuma, bati, risasi,
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

kikuyu: na kitu kingine chochote ambacho kinaweza kuhimili moto lazima mkipitishe kwenye moto, kisha kitakuwa safi. Lakini ni lazima pia kitakaswe kwa maji ya utakaso. Kitu chochote kisichoweza kuhimili moto lazima kipitishwe kwenye yale maji ya utakaso.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya saba fueni nguo zenu, nanyi mtakuwa safi. Kisha mtaweza kuingia kambini.”
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Wewe na kuhani Eleazari pamoja na viongozi wa jamaa ya jumuiya mtahesabu watu wote na wanyama ambao walitekwa.
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

kikuyu: Gawanyeni hizo nyara kati ya askari ambao walishiriki katika vita na kwa jumuiya.
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

kikuyu: Kutoka fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani, tenga kama ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana kitu kimoja kati ya kila mia tano, ikiwa ni wanadamu, ngʼombe, punda, kondoo au mbuzi.
english: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

kikuyu: Chukua ushuru huu kutoka fungu lao, umpe kuhani Eleazari kama sehemu ya Bwana.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.

kikuyu: Kutoka fungu la Waisraeli, chukua kitu kimoja kati ya kila hamsini, ikiwa ni wanadamu, ngʼombe, punda, kondoo, mbuzi au wanyama wengine. Hivyo uwape Walawi, ambao wanawajibika kutunza Maskani ya Bwana.”
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Nyara zilizobaki kutoka mateka ambayo askari walichukua ni kondoo 675,000,
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

kikuyu: ngʼombe 72,000,
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: punda 61,000,
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

kikuyu: na wanawake 32,000 ambao hawakumjua mume kwa kufanya tendo la ndoa.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Nusu ya fungu la wale waliokwenda kupigana vitani lilikuwa: Kondoo 337,500
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

kikuyu: ambayo ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ilikuwa kondoo 675;
english: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

kikuyu: ngʼombe 36,000 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa ngʼombe 72;
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.

kikuyu: punda 30,500 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa punda 61;
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.

kikuyu: Watu 16,000 ambao ushuru kwa ajili ya Bwana ulikuwa watu 32.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

kikuyu: Mose alimpa kuhani Eleazari ushuru kama sehemu ya Bwana, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza Mose.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ile nusu iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli, ambayo Mose aliitenga kutoka kwa ile ya watu waliokwenda vitani,
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

kikuyu: nusu iliyokuwa ya jumuiya, ilikuwa kondoo 337,500,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

kikuyu: ngʼombe 36,000,
english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: punda 30,500,
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

kikuyu: na wanadamu 16,000.
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

kikuyu: Kutoka hiyo nusu iliyokuwa ya Waisraeli, Mose alichagua moja kati ya kila hamsini ya wanadamu na wanyama, kama Bwana alivyomwagiza, naye aliwapa Walawi, ambao waliwajibika kutunza Maskani ya Bwana.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Kisha maafisa waliokuwa juu ya vikosi vya jeshi, wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, walimwendea Mose
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

kikuyu: na kumwambia, “Watumishi wako wamehesabu askari walio chini ya amri yetu na hakuna hata mmoja aliyekosekana.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo tumeleta kama sadaka kwa Bwana vyombo vya dhahabu kila mmoja wetu alivyopata, yaani vikuku, bangili, pete za muhuri, vipuli na mikufu, ili kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili yetu mbele za Bwana.”
english: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Mose na kuhani Eleazari wakapokea kutoka kwao dhahabu, yaani vyombo vyote vilivyonakshiwa.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

kikuyu: Dhahabu yote kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia ambavyo Mose na kuhani Eleazari walimletea Bwana kama zawadi ilikuwa shekeli 16,750
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

kikuyu: Kila askari alikuwa amejichukulia nyara zake binafsi.
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

kikuyu: Mose na kuhani Eleazari walipokea dhahabu kutoka kwa wakuu wa jeshi wa maelfu na wakuu wa jeshi wa mamia, wakazileta katika Hema la Kukutania kama ukumbusho kwa Waisraeli mbele za Bwana.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

kikuyu: Kabila la Wareubeni na Wagadi, waliokuwa na makundi makubwa ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mbuzi, waliona kuwa nchi ya Yazeri na nchi ya Gileadi ni nzuri kwa mifugo.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

kikuyu: Hivyo walimjia Mose, na kuhani Eleazari na viongozi wa jumuiya, na kuwaambia,
