english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

kikuyu: “Atarothi, Diboni, Yazeri, Nimra, Heshboni, Eleale, Sebamu, Nebo na Beoni,
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

kikuyu: nchi ambayo Bwana ameishinda mbele ya wana wa Israeli, inafaa kwa mifugo, nao watumishi wako wana mifugo.
english: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

kikuyu: Kama tumepata kibali mbele ya macho yako, nchi hii na ipewe watumishi wako kama milki yetu. Usitufanye tuvuke Yordani.”
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Mose akawaambia Wagadi na Wareubeni, “Je, watu wa nchi yenu watakwenda vitani wakati ninyi mmeketi hapa?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

kikuyu: Kwa nini mmewakatisha Waisraeli tamaa wasivuke katika nchi ambayo Bwana amewapa?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo baba zenu walivyofanya wakati nilipowatuma kutoka Kadesh-Barnea kuipeleleza nchi.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

kikuyu: Baada ya kufika kwenye Bonde la Eshkoli na kuitazama nchi, waliwakatisha tamaa Waisraeli wasiingie katika nchi ambayo Bwana alikuwa amewapa.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

kikuyu: Siku ile hasira ya Bwana iliwaka naye akaapa kiapo hiki:
english: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Kwa kuwa hawakunifuata kwa moyo wote, hakuna mtu yeyote mwenye miaka ishirini au zaidi ambaye alikuja kutoka Misri atakayeona nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kwa Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo;
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

kikuyu: hakuna hata mmoja isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, Mkenizi, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, kwa sababu walimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.’
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’

kikuyu: Hasira ya Bwana iliwaka dhidi ya Waisraeli na akawafanya watangetange katika jangwa kwa miaka arobaini, mpaka kizazi chote cha wale waliofanya maovu mbele yake kimeangamia.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

kikuyu: “Nanyi mko hapa, uzao wa wenye dhambi, mkisimamia mahali pa baba zenu na mkimfanya Bwana kuwakasirikia Waisraeli hata zaidi.
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

kikuyu: Kama mkigeuka na mkiacha kumfuata, atawaacha tena watu hawa wote jangwani, na mtakuwa sababu ya maangamizi yao.”
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakamjia Mose na kumwambia, “Tungalitaka kujenga mazizi hapa kwa ajili ya mifugo yetu na miji kwa ajili ya wanawake wetu na watoto.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

kikuyu: Lakini sisi tuko tayari kuchukua silaha zetu na kutangulia mbele ya Waisraeli mpaka tutakapowaleta mahali pao. Wakati huo wanawake wetu na watoto wataishi katika miji yenye ngome, kwa ajili ya ulinzi dhidi ya wenyeji wa nchi.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

kikuyu: Hatutarudi nyumbani mwetu mpaka kila Mwisraeli apokee urithi wake.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

kikuyu: Hatutapokea urithi wowote pamoja nao ngʼambo ya Yordani, kwa sababu urithi wetu umekuja kwetu upande wa mashariki ya Yordani.”
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akawaambia, “Kama mtafanya jambo hili, kama mtajivika silaha mbele za Bwana kwa ajili ya vita,
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

kikuyu: na kama ninyi nyote mtakwenda mmejivika silaha ngʼambo ya Yordani mbele za Bwana mpaka awe amewafukuza adui zake mbele zake,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

kikuyu: hadi wakati nchi itakapokuwa imeshindwa mbele za Bwana, ndipo mtaweza kurudi na kuwa huru kutoka masharti yenu kwa Bwana na Israeli. Nayo nchi hii itakuwa milki yenu mbele za Bwana.
english: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

kikuyu: “Lakini mkishindwa kufanya hili, mtakuwa mnatenda dhambi dhidi ya Bwana; nanyi kuweni na hakika kuwa dhambi yenu itawapata.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.

kikuyu: Jengeni miji kwa ajili ya wanawake na watoto wenu, na mazizi kwa ajili ya mbuzi na kondoo zenu, lakini fanyeni yale mliyoahidi.”
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

kikuyu: Wagadi na Wareubeni wakamwambia Mose, “Sisi watumishi wako tutafanya kama bwana wetu anavyotuagiza.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

kikuyu: Watoto na wake zetu, makundi ya mbuzi na kondoo, na makundi ya ngʼombe zetu, watabaki hapa katika miji ya Gileadi.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

kikuyu: Lakini watumishi wenu, kila mwanaume aliyevaa silaha za vita, watavuka ngʼambo kupigana mbele za Bwana, sawa kama bwana wetu anavyosema.”
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akatoa amri kuhusu wao kwa kuhani Eleazari, na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na viongozi wa jamaa za makabila ya Waisraeli.
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Mose akawaambia, “Ikiwa Wagadi na Wareubeni, kila mwanaume aliyevaa silaha za vita, atavuka Yordani pamoja nanyi mbele za Bwana, basi wakati mtakapoishinda nchi iliyoko mbele yenu, wapeni nchi ya Gileadi kama milki yao.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

kikuyu: Lakini kama hawatavuka pamoja nanyi wakiwa wamevaa silaha za vita, lazima wakubali kupokea milki yao pamoja nanyi katika nchi ya Kanaani.”
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

kikuyu: Wagadi na Wareubeni wakajibu, “Watumishi wako watafanya lile Bwana alilosema.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

kikuyu: Tutavuka mbele za Bwana kuingia Kanaani tukiwa tumevaa silaha za vita, lakini mali tutakayoirithi itakuwa ngʼambo hii ya Yordani.”
english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Kisha Mose akawapa Wagadi, Wareubeni, na nusu ya kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu ufalme wa Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, na ufalme wa Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, nchi yote pamoja na miji yake, na nchi inayowazunguka.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

kikuyu: Wagadi wakajenga Diboni, Atarothi, Aroeri,
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

kikuyu: Atroth-Shofani, Yazeri, Yogbeha,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

kikuyu: Beth-Nimra na Beth-Harani kama miji iliyozungushiwa ngome, tena wakajenga mazizi kwa ajili ya makundi yao ya mbuzi na kondoo.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

kikuyu: Nao Wareubeni wakajenga upya miji ya Heshboni, Eleale na Kiriathaimu,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: pia Nebo na Baal-Meoni (majina ya hiyo miji yalibadilishwa) na Sibma. Miji waliyoijenga upya waliipa majina.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Makiri mwana wa Manase walikwenda Gileadi, wakaiteka nchi na kuwafukuza Waamori waliokuwa huko.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mose akawapa Wamakiri, wazao wa Manase, nchi ya Gileadi, nao wakakaa huko.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

kikuyu: Yairi, mzao wa Manase, akateka makao yao, akayaita Hawoth-Yairi.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

kikuyu: Naye Noba akateka Kenathi na makao yaliyoizunguka, akayaita Noba kwa jina lake.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo vituo katika safari ya Waisraeli walipotoka Misri kwa vikosi chini ya uongozi wa Mose na Aroni.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Kwa agizo la Bwana, Mose aliweka kumbukumbu ya vituo katika safari yao. Hivi ndivyo vituo katika safari yao:
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

kikuyu: Waisraeli walisafiri kutoka Ramesesi katika siku ya kumi na tano ya mwezi wa kwanza, siku iliyofuata Pasaka. Walitembea kwa ujasiri wazi mbele ya Wamisri wote,
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

kikuyu: waliokuwa wakizika wazaliwa wao wa kwanza wote, ambao Bwana alikuwa amewaua katikati yao, kwa kuwa Bwana alikuwa ameleta hukumu juu ya miungu yao.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

kikuyu: Waisraeli waliondoka Ramesesi na kupiga kambi huko Sukothi.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Sukothi na kupiga kambi huko Ethamu, pembeni mwa jangwa.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Ethamu, wakageuka wakarudi Pi-Hahirothi, hadi mashariki ya Baal-Sefoni, wakapiga kambi yao karibu na Migdoli.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Pi-Hahirothi wakapita katikati ya bahari mpaka jangwani, na baada ya kusafiri kwa siku tatu katika Jangwa la Ethamu, walipiga kambi huko Mara.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Mara wakaenda Elimu, mahali ambapo palikuwa na chemchemi kumi na mbili na mitende sabini, huko wakapiga kambi.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Elimu na kupiga kambi kando ya Bahari ya Shamu.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka kando ya Bahari ya Shamu na kupiga kambi katika Jangwa la Sini.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sini, wakapiga kambi huko Dofka.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Dofka, wakapiga kambi huko Alushi.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Alushi, wakapiga kambi Refidimu, mahali ambapo hapakuwa na maji kwa ajili ya watu kunywa.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Refidimu na kupiga kambi katika Jangwa la Sinai.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka katika Jangwa la Sinai na kupiga kambi huko Kibroth-Hataava.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Kibroth-Hataava na kupiga kambi huko Haserothi.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Haserothi na kupiga kambi huko Rithma.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Rithma na kupiga kambi huko Rimon-Peresi.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Rimon-Peresi na kupiga kambi huko Libna.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Libna na kupiga kambi huko Risa.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Risa na kupiga kambi huko Kehelatha.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Kehelatha na kupiga kambi kwenye mlima Sheferi.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka kwenye mlima Sheferi na kupiga kambi huko Harada.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Harada na kupiga kambi huko Makelothi.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Makelothi na kupiga kambi huko Tahathi.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Tahathi na kupiga kambi huko Tera.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Tera na kupiga kambi huko Mithka.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Mithka na kupiga kambi huko Hashmona.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Hashmona na kupiga kambi Moserothi.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Moserothi na kupiga kambi huko Bene-Yakani.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Bene-Yakani na kupiga kambi huko Hor-Hagidgadi.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Hor-Hagidgadi na kupiga kambi huko Yotbatha.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Yotbatha na kupiga kambi huko Abrona.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Abrona na kupiga kambi huko Esion-Geberi.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Esion-Geberi na kupiga kambi huko Kadeshi katika Jangwa la Sini.
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Kadeshi na kupiga kambi kwenye Mlima Hori, mpakani mwa Edomu.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Kwa amri ya Bwana, kuhani Aroni alipanda Mlima Hori, mahali alipofia katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa tano, mwaka wa arobaini baada ya Waisraeli kutoka Misri.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

kikuyu: Aroni alikufa juu ya Mlima Hori akiwa na umri wa miaka 123.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Mfalme Mkanaani wa Aradi, ambaye aliishi huko Negebu ya Kanaani, akasikia kwamba Waisraeli wanakuja.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka kwenye mlima Hori na kupiga kambi huko Salmona.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Salmona, wakapiga kambi huko Punoni.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Punoni, wakapiga kambi huko Obothi.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Obothi, wakapiga kambi huko Iye-Abarimu, mipakani mwa Moabu.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Iye-Abarimu, wakapiga kambi huko Dibon-Gadi.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Dibon-Gadi na kupiga kambi huko Almon-Diblathaimu.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka Almon-Diblathaimu na kupiga kambi katika milima ya Abarimu, karibu na Nebo.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

kikuyu: Wakaondoka kwenye milima ya Abarimu na kupiga kambi kwenye tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Huko kwenye tambarare za Moabu walipiga kambi kandokando ya Mto Yordani, kuanzia Beth-Yeshimothi mpaka Abel-Shitimu.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

kikuyu: Katika tambarare za Moabu kando ya Yordani kuvukia Yeriko, Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: “Sema na Waisraeli uwaambie: ‘Mtakapovuka Mto Yordani kuingia Kanaani,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: wafukuzeni wakazi wote wa nchi iliyo mbele yenu. Haribuni sanamu zao zote za kuchongwa, na sanamu zilizotengenezwa kwa kuyeyusha chuma, na kupabomoa mahali pao pa ibada.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

kikuyu: Mtaimiliki nchi hiyo na kukaa huko, kwa kuwa nimewapeni ninyi kuimiliki.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

kikuyu: Mtaigawanya nchi hiyo kwa kupiga kura, kufuatana na koo zenu. Kwa kundi kubwa zaidi toa urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kwa kundi dogo zaidi urithi mdogo zaidi. Chochote kinachowaangukia kwa kura kitakuwa chao. Mtaigawanya nchi kufuatana na makabila ya babu zenu.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lakini kama hamkuwafukuza wenyeji wakaao katika nchi hiyo, wale mtakaowaruhusu wabaki watakuwa kama sindano kwenye macho yenu na miiba kwenu kila upande. Watawasumbua katika nchi mtakayoishi.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

kikuyu: Kisha nitawatenda ninyi kile ambacho nimepanga kuwatenda wao.’ ”
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waamuru Waisraeli na uwaambie: ‘Mtakapoingia nchi ya Kanaani, nchi ambayo itagawanywa kwenu kama urithi itakuwa na mipaka ifuatayo:
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

kikuyu: “ ‘Upande wenu wa kusini utajumuisha sehemu ya Jangwa la Sini kufuata mpaka wa Edomu. Upande wa mashariki mpaka wenu wa kusini utaanzia mwisho wa Bahari ya Chumvi,
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

kikuyu: katiza kusini mwa Pito la Akrabimu, endelea mpaka Sini na kwenda kusini ya Kadesh-Barnea. Kisha mpaka huo utaenda hadi Hasar-Adari hadi Azmoni,
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

kikuyu: mahali ambapo utapinda, na kuunganika na Kijito cha Misri na kumalizikia kwenye Bahari ya Kati.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mpaka wenu wa magharibi utakuwa Bahari ya Kati. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa magharibi.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa kaskazini, wekeni alama kuanzia Bahari ya Kati hadi mlima Hori,
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

kikuyu: na kutoka mlima Hori hadi Pito la Hamathi. Kisha mpaka utaenda hadi Sedadi,
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

kikuyu: kuendelea hadi Zifroni, na kuishia Hasar-Enani. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu upande wa kaskazini.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kwa mpaka wenu wa mashariki, wekeni alama kuanzia Hasar-Enani hadi Shefamu.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

kikuyu: Mpaka utaelekea kusini kuanzia Shefamu hadi Ribla upande wa mashariki wa Aini, na kuendelea kwenye miteremko mashariki mwa Bahari ya Kinerethi.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

kikuyu: Kisha mpaka utashuka kuelekea Mto Yordani na kuishia katika Bahari ya Chumvi. “ ‘Hii itakuwa nchi yenu, ikiwa na mipaka yake kila upande.’ ”
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

kikuyu: Mose akawaamuru Waisraeli: “Gawanyeni nchi hii kwa kura kama urithi. Bwana ameagiza kwamba itolewe kwa yale makabila tisa na nusu,
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

kikuyu: kwa sababu jamaa ya kabila la Reubeni, kabila la Gadi, na nusu ya kabila la Manase wamekwishapokea urithi wao.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

kikuyu: Haya makabila mawili na nusu wamekwishapokea urithi wao upande wa mashariki wa Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko, kuelekea mawio ya jua.”
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Haya ndiyo majina ya watu ambao watakusaidia kugawanya nchi kama urithi: Eleazari kuhani na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Tena uteue kiongozi mmoja kutoka kila kabila kusaidia kuigawanya nchi.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo majina yao: “Kalebu mwana wa Yefune, kutoka kabila la Yuda;
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Shemueli mwana wa Amihudi, kutoka kabila la Simeoni;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Elidadi mwana wa Kisloni, kutoka kabila la Benyamini;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

kikuyu: Buki mwana wa Yogli, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Dani;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

kikuyu: Hanieli mwana wa Efodi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Manase mwana wa Yosefu;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

kikuyu: Kemueli mwana wa Shiftani, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Efraimu mwana wa Yosefu;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

kikuyu: Elisafani mwana wa Parnaki, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Zabuloni;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

kikuyu: Paltieli mwana wa Azani, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Isakari;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

kikuyu: Ahihudi mwana wa Shelomi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Asheri;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

kikuyu: Pedaheli mwana wa Amihudi, kiongozi kutoka kabila la Naftali.”
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

kikuyu: Hawa ndio watu ambao Bwana aliamuru wagawanye urithi kwa Waisraeli katika nchi ya Kanaani.
english: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Mose katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani kuvukia Yeriko,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: “Waagize Waisraeli kuwapa Walawi miji ya kuishi kutoka urithi ambao Waisraeli wataumiliki. Wape maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka hiyo miji.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Kisha watakuwa na miji ya kuishi na maeneo ya malisho kwa ajili ya ngʼombe zao, mbuzi, kondoo na mifugo yao mingine yote.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

kikuyu: “Maeneo ya malisho kuzunguka miji hiyo ambayo mtawapa Walawi yataenea mita 450 kutoka kwenye ukuta wa miji.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

kikuyu: Nje ya mji, pima mita 900 upande wa mashariki, upande wa kusini mita 900, upande wa magharibi mita 900, na upande wa kaskazini mita 900, na mji utakuwa katikati. Eneo hili litakuwa lao kwa ajili ya malisho.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

kikuyu: “Miji sita mtakayowapa Walawi itakuwa ya makimbilio, ambayo mtu anayemuua mwenzake aweza kukimbilia humo. Zaidi ya hiyo, wapeni miji mingine arobaini na miwili.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

kikuyu: Kwa jumla inawapasa kuwapa Walawi miji arobaini na minane, pamoja na maeneo ya malisho yao.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Miji ambayo mtawapa Walawi kutoka nchi ambayo Waisraeli wanamiliki itatolewa kwa uwiano wa urithi wa kila kabila. Chukua miji mingi kutoka lile kabila lenye miji mingi, lakini uchukue miji michache kutoka kwa kabila lile lenye miji michache.”
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamwambia Mose:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Sema na Waisraeli, uwaambie: ‘Mtakapovuka Yordani kuingia Kanaani,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: chagueni baadhi ya miji iwe miji yenu ya makimbilio, ambayo mtu ambaye ameua mwenzake bila kukusudia aweza kukimbilia humo.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Itakuwa mahali pa kukimbilia kutoka mlipiza kisasi, ili kwamba mtu aliyeshtakiwa kwa mauaji asife kabla ya kujitetea mbele ya mkutano.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

kikuyu: Miji hii sita mtakayoitoa itakuwa miji yenu ya makimbilio.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Mtatoa miji mitatu ngʼambo hii ya Yordani na miji mingine mitatu upande wa Kanaani kama miji ya makimbilio.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Miji hii sita itakuwa mahali pa makimbilio kwa ajili ya Waisraeli, wageni na watu wengine wanaoishi katikati yenu, ili kwamba mtu yeyote ambaye ameua mtu mwingine pasipo kukusudia aweze kukimbilia humo.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kama mtu akimpiga mwenzake kwa chuma naye mtu huyo akafa, mtu huyo ni muuaji; muuaji sharti atauawa.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Au kama mtu analo jiwe mkononi mwake ambalo laweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Au kama mtu ana chombo cha mti mkononi mwake ambacho chaweza kuua, naye akampiga mwenzake akafa, yeye ni muuaji; muuaji huyo sharti atauawa.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Mlipiza kisasi cha damu atamuua muuaji; wakati akikutana naye, atamuua.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtu ana chuki ya siku nyingi na mwenzake akamsukuma au akamtupia kitu kwa kukusudia naye akafa,
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

kikuyu: au ikiwa katika uadui akampiga ngumi naye akafa, mtu yule sharti atauawa; yeye ni muuaji. Mlipiza kisasi cha damu atamuua muuaji atakapokutana naye.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lakini kama mtu akimsukuma mwenziwe ghafula pasipo chuki, au kumtupia kitu pasipo kukusudia,
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

kikuyu: au, pasipo kumwona, akimwangushia jiwe ambalo laweza kumuua naye akafa, basi kwa kuwa hakuwa adui yake naye hakukusudia kumuumiza,
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

kikuyu: kusanyiko lazima liamue kati yake na mlipiza kisasi wa damu kufuatana na sheria hizi.
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

kikuyu: Kusanyiko ni lazima limlinde yule anayeshtakiwa kuua kutoka kwa mlipiza kisasi wa damu, na kumrudisha katika mji wa makimbilio alikokuwa amekimbilia. Lazima akae humo mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu ambaye alikuwa amepakwa mafuta matakatifu.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lakini kama mshtakiwa atatoka nje ya mipaka ya mji wa makimbilio ambao amekimbilia,
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

kikuyu: na mlipiza kisasi wa damu akamkuta nje ya mji, mlipiza kisasi wa damu anaweza kumuua mshtakiwa huyo bila kuwa na hatia ya kuua.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

kikuyu: Mshtakiwa lazima akae katika mji wake wa makimbilio mpaka atakapokufa kuhani mkuu; atarudi tu kwenye mali yake baada ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

kikuyu: “ ‘Hizi ndizo kanuni za sheria zitakazohitajiwa kwenu na katika vizazi vyenu vijavyo, popote mtakapoishi.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yeyote anayeua mtu atauawa kama muuaji ikiwa tu kuna ushuhuda wa mashahidi. Lakini hakuna mtu atakayeuawa kwa ushuhuda wa shahidi mmoja tu.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

kikuyu: “ ‘Usikubali fidia yoyote ya kuokoa uhai wa muuaji ambaye anastahili kufa. Mtu huyo hakika lazima auawe.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “ ‘Usikubali fidia ya mtu yeyote ambaye amekimbilia katika mji wa makimbilio na kumruhusu kurudi kuishi katika nchi yake kabla ya kifo cha kuhani mkuu.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

kikuyu: “ ‘Msiinajisi nchi mnayoishi. Umwagaji damu hunajisi nchi, na upatanisho hauwezekani kufanyika katika nchi ambayo damu imemwagwa, isipokuwa tu kwa damu ya yule aliyeimwaga damu.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

kikuyu: Msiinajisi nchi mnayoishi, ambayo nami ninakaa, kwa kuwa Mimi, Bwana, ninakaa katikati ya Waisraeli.’ ”
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Viongozi wa jamaa ya ukoo wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase, waliokuwa wametoka katika koo za wazao wa Yosefu, walikuja na kuzungumza mbele ya Mose na viongozi, wakuu wa jamaa ya Waisraeli.
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Wakasema, “Bwana alipomwamuru bwana wangu kuwapa Waisraeli nchi kama urithi kwa kura, alikuamuru kutoa urithi wa ndugu yetu Selofehadi kwa binti zake.
english: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

kikuyu: Sasa ikiwa wataolewa na watu wa makabila mengine ya Kiisraeli, itakuwa kwamba urithi wao utaondolewa kutoka urithi wa mababu zetu na kuongezwa katika urithi wa kabila ambalo dada hao wameolewa. Kwa hiyo sehemu ya urithi tuliyogawiwa itachukuliwa kutoka kwetu.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

kikuyu: Wakati mwaka wa Yubile kwa Waisraeli utafika, urithi wao utaongezwa kwa lile kabila ambalo wameolewa, na mali yao itaondolewa kutoka urithi wa kabila la mababu zetu.”
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

kikuyu: Ndipo kwa agizo la Bwana Mose akatoa amri ifuatayo kwa Waisraeli: “Kile wazao wa kabila la Yosefu wanachosema ni kweli.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo Bwana anavyoamuru kwa binti za Selofehadi: Wanaweza kuolewa na mtu yeyote wampendaye, mradi tu waolewe miongoni mwa koo za kabila za baba yao.
english: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

kikuyu: Hakuna urithi katika Israeli utakaohamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila Mwisraeli atatunza ardhi ya kabila lake aliyoirithi kutoka kwa baba zake.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

kikuyu: Kila binti atakayerithi ardhi katika kabila lolote la Israeli ni lazima aolewe na mtu kutoka kabila na ukoo wa baba yake, ili kila Mwisraeli amiliki urithi wa baba zake.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

kikuyu: Hakuna urithi uwezao kuhamishwa kutoka kabila moja kwenda kabila jingine, kwa kuwa kila kabila la Israeli litatunza nchi linayorithi.”
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo binti za Selofehadi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyomwamuru Mose.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:

kikuyu: Binti za Selofehadi, ambao ni Mahla, Tirsa, Hogla, Milka na Noa, wakaolewa na waume, wana wa ndugu za baba yao.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

kikuyu: Waliolewa ndani ya koo za wazao wa Manase mwana wa Yosefu, na urithi wao ukabaki katika ukoo na kabila la baba yao.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo maagizo na masharti ambayo Bwana aliwapa Waisraeli kupitia Mose katika tambarare za Moabu, karibu na Yordani ngʼambo ya Yeriko.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Haya ni maneno Mose aliyoyasema kwa Israeli yote jangwani mashariki ya Yordani, ambayo iko Araba, inayokabiliana na Sufu, kati ya Parani na Tofeli, Labani, Haserothi na Dizahabu.
english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

kikuyu: (Ni mwendo wa siku kumi na moja kutoka Horebu kwa njia ya Mlima Seiri mpaka Kadesh-Barnea.)
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Katika mwaka wa arobaini, siku ya kwanza ya mwezi wa kumi na moja, Mose aliwatangazia Waisraeli yale yote Bwana aliyomwamuru kuwahusu.
english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,

kikuyu: Hii ilikuwa baada ya kumshinda Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala Heshboni, na pia huko Edrei alikuwa amemshinda Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, ambaye alitawala huko Ashtarothi.
english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

kikuyu: Huko mashariki ya Yordani katika nchi ya Moabu, Mose alianza kuielezea sheria hii, akisema:
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu wetu alisema nasi huko Horebu, “Mmekaa vya kutosha katika mlima huu.
english: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

kikuyu: Vunjeni kambi, msonge mbele kuelekea nchi ya vilima ya Waamori; nendeni kwa watu wote ambao ni majirani wa Araba, katika milima, upande wa magharibi chini ya vilima, katika Negebu na kandokando ya pwani, mpaka nchi ya Wakanaani hadi Lebanoni, na kufika mto mkubwa Frati.
english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Tazama, nimewapa ninyi nchi hii. Ingieni mkaimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana aliapa kuwa angaliwapa baba zenu, Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo, pamoja na vizazi vyao baada yao.”
english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

kikuyu: Wakati ule niliwaambia, “Ninyi mmekuwa mzigo mzito sana kwangu kuwachukua peke yangu.
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu wenu ameongeza hesabu yenu, hivi kwamba leo ninyi ni wengi kama nyota za angani.
english: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: Naye Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu na awaongeze mara elfu na kuwabariki kama alivyoahidi!
english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

kikuyu: Lakini mimi nitawezaje kubeba matatizo yenu, na mizigo yenu, na magomvi yenu peke yangu?
english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

kikuyu: Chagueni baadhi ya watu wenye hekima, wenye ufahamu na wanaoheshimika kutoka kila kabila lenu, nami nitawaweka juu yenu.”
english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

kikuyu: Mlinijibu, “Shauri ulilolitoa ni zuri.”
english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo niliwachukua wanaume viongozi wa makabila yenu, wenye hekima na wanaoheshimika, nami nikawateua wawe na mamlaka juu yenu kama majemadari wa maelfu, wa mamia, wa hamsini, na wa makumi, na kama maafisa wa makabila.
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

kikuyu: Nami wakati ule nikawaagiza waamuzi wenu: Sikilizeni magomvi kati ya ndugu zenu na mwamue kwa haki, hata kama shauri ni kati ya ndugu wa Kiisraeli, au kati ya mmoja wa ndugu wa Kiisraeli na mgeni.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

kikuyu: Msionyeshe upendeleo katika maamuzi; wasikilizeni wote sawasawa, wadogo kwa wakubwa. Msimwogope mtu yeyote, kwa kuwa hukumu ni ya Mungu. Mniletee mimi shauri lolote lililo gumu sana kwenu, nami nitalisikiliza.
english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

kikuyu: Nami wakati ule niliwaambia kila kitu ambacho mngefanya.
english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

kikuyu: Kisha, kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyotuamuru, tuliondoka kutoka Horebu na kwenda kuelekea nchi ya vilima ya Waamori, kupitia jangwa lile kubwa lote la kutisha, lile mliloliona, nasi tukafika Kadesh-Barnea.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Kisha niliwaambia, “Mmefika katika nchi ya vilima ya Waamori, ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupa.
english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.

kikuyu: Tazama, Bwana Mungu wenu amewapa nchi. Pandeni mkaimiliki kama Bwana, Mungu wa baba zenu, alivyowaambia. Msiogope, wala msikate tamaa.”
english: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

kikuyu: Ndipo ninyi nyote mkanijia na kusema, “Tupeleke watu watutangulie kuipeleleza nchi kwa ajili yetu, na kutuletea taarifa kuhusu njia tutakayopita, na miji tutakayoiendea.”
english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

kikuyu: Wazo hilo lilionekana zuri kwangu; kwa hiyo niliwachagua watu wenu kumi na wawili, mwanaume mmoja kutoka kila kabila.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

kikuyu: Waliondoka na kukwea katika nchi ya vilima, wakafika katika Bonde la Eshkoli na kuipeleleza.
english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

kikuyu: Wakachukua baadhi ya matunda ya nchi, wakatuletea na kutuarifu, “Ni nchi nzuri ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupa.”
english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”

kikuyu: Lakini hamkuwa tayari kukwea, mkaasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana Mungu wenu.
english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Mkanungʼunika ndani ya mahema yenu na kusema, “Bwana anatuchukia, kwa hiyo alitutoa Misri ili kututia mikononi mwa Waamori kutuangamiza.
english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

kikuyu: Twende wapi? Ndugu zetu wametufanya kufa moyo. Wanasema, ‘Watu wa huko wana nguvu zaidi na ni warefu kuliko sisi tulivyo; miji ni mikubwa, yenye kuta zilizofika juu angani. Zaidi ya hayo, tumewaona Waanaki huko.’ ”
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

kikuyu: Ndipo nikawaambia, “Msihofu, wala msiwaogope.
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu wenu anayewatangulia, atawapigania, kama alivyofanya kwa ajili yenu huko Misri, mbele ya macho yenu hasa,
english: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

kikuyu: na pia huko jangwani. Huko mliona jinsi Bwana Mungu wenu alivyowachukua, kama baba amchukuavyo mwanawe, katika njia yote mliyoiendea mpaka mkafika mahali hapa.”
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

kikuyu: Pamoja na hili, hamkumtegemea Bwana Mungu wenu,
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,

kikuyu: ambaye aliwatangulia katika safari yenu, kwa moto usiku na kwa wingu mchana, kuwatafutia mahali penu pa kupiga kambi na kuwaonyesha njia mtakayoiendea.
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

kikuyu: Wakati Bwana aliposikia lile mlilosema, alikasirika, akaapa, akasema:
english: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

kikuyu: “Hakuna mtu wa kizazi hiki kiovu atakayeona nchi nzuri niliyoapa kuwapa baba zenu,
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

kikuyu: isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune. Yeye ataiona, nami nitampa yeye na wazao wake nchi aliyoikanyaga kwa miguu, kwa sababu alimfuata Bwana kwa moyo wote.”
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”

kikuyu: Kwa sababu yenu Bwana pia alinikasirikia mimi, akasema, “Hutaingia hiyo nchi pia.
english: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

kikuyu: Lakini msaidizi wako, Yoshua mwana wa Nuni, ataingia. Mtie moyo, kwa sababu atawaongoza Waisraeli kuirithi hiyo nchi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

kikuyu: Wale watoto ambao mliwasema wangelichukuliwa mateka, yaani watoto wenu ambao bado hawajui jema na baya, wataingia katika nchi. Nitawapa hiyo nchi, nao wataimiliki.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

kikuyu: Bali ninyi geukeni, mwondoke kuelekea jangwani kwa kufuata njia ya Bahari ya Shamu.”
english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

kikuyu: Ndipo mkanijibu, “Tumemtenda Bwana dhambi. Tutakwenda kupigana, kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyotuamuru.” Hivyo kila mmoja wenu akachukua silaha zake, huku mkifikiri kuwa ni rahisi kukwea katika nchi ya vilima.
english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana aliniambia, “Waambie, ‘Msipande kupigana, kwa sababu sitakuwa pamoja nanyi. Mtashindwa na adui zenu.’ ”
english: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

kikuyu: Hivyo niliwaambia, lakini hamkutaka kusikia. Mliasi dhidi ya amri ya Bwana, na katika kiburi chenu mlienda katika nchi ya vilima.
english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Waamori ambao waliishi katika vilima hivyo waliinuka dhidi yenu, wakawafukuza kama kundi la nyuki wakiwapiga njia yote ya Seiri mpaka Horma.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

kikuyu: Mlirudi na kulia mbele za Bwana, lakini Mungu hakusikiliza kilio chenu, wala hakuwajali.
english: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

kikuyu: Hivyo mlikaa Kadeshi kwa siku nyingi, kwa muda ule wote mliokaa huko.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

kikuyu: Kisha tukageuka nyuma na kusafiri kuelekea jangwani kwa njia inayoelekea Bahari ya Shamu, kama Bwana alivyonielekeza. Kwa muda mrefu tulitembea kuzunguka vilima katika nchi ya Seiri.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akaniambia,
english: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: “Umetembea kuzunguka hii nchi ya vilima kwa muda wa kutosha; sasa geukia kaskazini.
english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

kikuyu: Wape watu maagizo haya: ‘Mko karibu kupita katikati ya nchi ya ndugu zako ambao ni wazao wa Esau, ambao wanaishi Seiri. Watawaogopa, lakini mwe waangalifu.
english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

kikuyu: Msiwachokoze kwa vita kwa maana sitawapa ninyi sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao, hata sehemu ya kutosha kuweka wayo wenu juu yake. Nimempa Esau nchi ya vilima ya Seiri kama yake mwenyewe.
english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

kikuyu: Mtawalipa fedha kwa chakula mtakachokula na maji mtakayokunywa.’ ”
english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu wenu amewabariki kwa kazi yote ya mikono yenu. Amewalinda katika safari yenu katikati ya jangwa hili kubwa. Kwa miaka hii arobaini Bwana Mungu wenu amekuwa pamoja nanyi, na hamkupungukiwa na kitu chochote.
english: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

kikuyu: Basi tulipita kwa ndugu zetu wazao wa Esau ambao wanaishi Seiri. Tuligeuka kutoka njia ya Araba ambayo inatokea Elathi na Esion-Geberi, tukasafiri kufuata njia ya jangwa la Moabu.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akaniambia, “Usiwasumbue Wamoabu kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa sehemu yoyote ya nchi yao. Nimetoa nchi ya Ari kwa wazao wa Loti kama milki yao.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

kikuyu: (Waemi walikuwa wakiishi huko hapo zamani, watu wenye nguvu na wengi, warefu kama Waanaki.
english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

kikuyu: Kama walivyokuwa Waanaki, hao pia walikuwa kama Warefai, lakini Wamoabu waliwaita Waemi.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

kikuyu: Wahori waliishi Seiri, lakini wazao wa Esau waliwafukuza. Waliwaangamiza Wahori na kukaa mahali pao, kama Waisraeli walivyofanya katika nchi ambayo Bwana aliwapa kama milki yao.)
english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.)

kikuyu: Bwana akasema, “Sasa ondokeni mvuke Bonde la Zeredi.” Hivyo tukavuka bonde.
english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

kikuyu: Miaka thelathini na minane ilipita tangu wakati tulipoondoka Kadesh-Barnea mpaka tulipovuka Bonde la Zeredi. Kwa wakati huo kile kizazi chote cha wanaume kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kilikuwa kimekufa, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amewaapia.
english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.

kikuyu: Mkono wa Bwana uliwakabili hadi alipowaangamiza wote huko kambini.
english: Moreover the LORD’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

kikuyu: Ikawa baada ya mtu wa mwisho kuanzia wale wawezao kwenda vitani kufa,
english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

kikuyu: Bwana akaniambia,
english: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: “Leo utapita katika nchi ya Moabu huko Ari.
english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

kikuyu: Utakapokuja kwa Waamoni, msiwasumbue wala kuwachokoza kwa vita, kwa kuwa sitawapa ardhi yoyote iliyo ya Waamoni kuwa milki yenu. Nimeitoa kama milki ya wazao wa Loti.”
english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

kikuyu: (Hiyo pia ilidhaniwa kuwa nchi ya Warefai waliokuwa wakiishi huko, lakini Waamoni waliwaita Wazamzumi.
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

kikuyu: Walikuwa watu wenye nguvu na wengi, warefu kama Waanaki. Bwana akawaangamiza kutoka mbele ya Waamoni, ambao waliwafukuza na kukaa mahali pao.
english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

kikuyu: Bwana alikuwa amefanya vivyo hivyo kwa wazao wa Esau, ambao waliishi Seiri, wakati alipowaangamiza Wahori watoke mbele yao. Waliwafukuza na wao wakaishi mahali pao mpaka leo.
english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

kikuyu: Nao Waavi ambao waliishi katika vijiji mpaka Gaza, Wakaftori waliokuja kutoka Kaftori waliwaangamiza na kukaa mahali pao.)
english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

kikuyu: “Ondoka sasa na uvuke Bonde la Arnoni. Tazama, nimemweka mikononi mwako Sihoni Mwamori, mfalme wa Heshboni na nchi yake. Anza kuimiliki nchi hiyo na umwingize katika vita.
english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

kikuyu: Siku hii ya leo nitaanza kuwatia hofu na woga mataifa yote chini ya mbingu wawaogope ninyi. Watakaposikia taarifa zenu, watatetemeka na kufadhaika kwa sababu yenu.”
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

kikuyu: Kutoka jangwa la Kedemothi nilituma wajumbe wenye maneno ya amani kwa Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni kusema,
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

kikuyu: “Turuhusu tupite katika nchi yako. Tutapita katika barabara kuu, hatutageuka kuume wala kushoto.
english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

kikuyu: Tuuzie chakula tule na maji tunywe kwa thamani yake katika fedha. Turuhusu tu tupite kwa miguu,
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

kikuyu: kama wazao wa Esau ambao wanaishi Seiri na Wamoabu ambao wanaishi Ari walivyotufanyia, mpaka tuvuke Yordani kuingia nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wetu anatupatia.”
english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.”

kikuyu: Lakini Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni alikataa kuturuhusu kupita. Kwa kuwa Bwana Mungu wako alikuwa ameifanya roho yake kuwa ngumu na moyo wake kuwa mkaidi ili amweke kwenye mikono yenu, kama alivyofanya sasa.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

kikuyu: Bwana akaniambia, “Tazama, nimeanza kuwapa Mfalme Sihoni na nchi yake kwako. Sasa anzeni kuishinda na kuimiliki nchi yake.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

kikuyu: Wakati Sihoni pamoja na jeshi lake lote walipokuja kukutana nasi katika vita huko Yahazi,
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu wetu alimweka mikononi mwetu, nasi tukamwangamiza pamoja na wanawe na jeshi lake lote.
english: The LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

kikuyu: Kwa wakati ule tuliteka miji yake yote na kuiangamiza kabisa: wanaume, wanawake na watoto. Hatukumwacha yeyote.
english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

kikuyu: Lakini mifugo na nyara tulizoziteka kutoka ile miji tulijichukulia wenyewe.
english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

kikuyu: Kutoka Aroeri kwenye ukingo wa Bonde la Arnoni, kutoka mji ulio ndani ya bonde, hata mpaka Gileadi, hapakuwa na mji hata mmoja uliokuwa na nguvu kutushinda. Bwana Mungu wetu alitupa yote.
english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God delivered up all before us.

kikuyu: Lakini kulingana na amri ya Bwana Mungu wetu, hamkujiingiza katika nchi yoyote ya Waamoni, wala katika sehemu yoyote iliyo kandokando ya Mto Yaboki, wala katika miji iliyoko katika vilima.
english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God forbade us.

kikuyu: Kisha tukageuka tukakwea kufuata njia iliyoelekea Bashani, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani akaondoka na jeshi lake lote kupigana na sisi huko Edrei.
english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

kikuyu: Bwana akaniambia, “Usimwogope kwa kuwa nimekwisha mkabidhi mikononi mwako pamoja na jeshi lake lote na nchi yake. Umfanyie sawasawa na ulivyomfanyia Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, ambaye alitawala huko Heshboni.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Bwana Mungu wetu pia akamweka Ogu mfalme wa Bashani pamoja na jeshi lake lote mikononi mwetu. Tuliwaangamiza wote, hakubakia hata mmoja.
english: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

kikuyu: Wakati huo tuliteka miji yake yote. Hakuna mji hata mmoja kati ya ile sitini ambao hatukuuteka, yaani eneo lote la Argobu, utawala wa Mfalme Ogu katika Bashani.
english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

kikuyu: Miji yote hii ilijengewa ngome zenye kuta ndefu zenye malango na makomeo, pia kulikuwako na vijiji vingi ambavyo havikujengewa kuta.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

kikuyu: Tuliwaangamiza kabisa, kama tulivyomfanyia Sihoni mfalme wa Heshboni, tukiangamiza kila mji, yaani wanaume, wanawake na watoto.
english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

kikuyu: Lakini wanyama wote wa kufuga pamoja na nyara kutoka kwenye miji yao tulichukua vikawa vyetu.
english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

kikuyu: Hivyo kwa wakati huo tukachukua kutoka kwa wafalme hawa wawili wa Waamori nchi ya mashariki ya Yordani, kutoka Bonde la Arnoni mpaka kufika kwenye Mlima Hermoni.
english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: (Wasidoni huuita mlima huo Sirioni, nao Waamori huuita Seniri.)
english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

kikuyu: Tuliteka miji yote kwenye uwanda wa juu, Gileadi yote, Bashani yote mpaka kufika Saleka na Edrei, miji ya utawala wa Ogu huko Bashani.
english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

kikuyu: (Mfalme Ogu wa Bashani ndiye peke yake aliyesalia miongoni mwa mabaki ya Warefai. Kitanda chake kilikuwa cha chuma chenye urefu wa dhiraa tisa na upana wa dhiraa nne. Mpaka sasa kinaweza kuonekana katika mji wa Waamoni wa Raba.)
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

kikuyu: Katika nchi tuliyoiteka wakati ule, niliwapa kabila la Reubeni na Gadi eneo lililoko kaskazini la Aroeri kando ya Bonde la Arnoni, na nusu ya eneo la milima ya Gileadi, pamoja na miji yake.
english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

kikuyu: Kisha nusu ya kabila la Manase niliwapa sehemu ya Gileadi iliyobaki pamoja na Bashani yote, ambayo ilikuwa utawala wa Ogu. (Eneo lote la Argobu katika Bashani lilikuwa linajulikana kama nchi ya Warefai.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Yairi, mzao wa kabila la Manase, alichukua eneo lote la nchi ya Argobu hadi kufikia mpaka wa Wageshuri na Wamaaka, ukaitwa kwa jina lake; kwa hiyo mpaka leo hii Bashani inaitwa Hawoth-Yairi.)
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

kikuyu: Nikampa Makiri nchi ya Gileadi.
english: I gave Gilead to Machir.

kikuyu: Lakini niliwapa Wareubeni na Wagadi eneo kuanzia Gileadi hadi Bonde la Arnoni (katikati ya bonde ulikuwa ndio mpaka), kuelekea mpaka Mto Yaboki, ambao ndio mpaka wa Waamoni.
english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Kwa upande wa magharibi mpaka wao ulikuwa Yordani katika Araba, toka ziwa Galilaya hadi Bahari ya Araba (yaani Bahari ya Chumvi), kwenye miteremko ya Pisga upande wa mashariki.
english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

kikuyu: Wakati huo nilikuamuru: “Bwana Mungu wako amekupa nchi hii uimiliki. Lakini ni lazima wanaume wenu wote wenye uwezo, wakiwa wamejiandaa tayari kwa vita, wavuke ngʼambo wakiwatangulia ndugu zako Waisraeli.
english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Lakini wake zenu, watoto wenu na mifugo yenu (kwani najua mnayo mifugo mingi) wanaweza kukaa katika miji niliyowapa,
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

kikuyu: mpaka hapo Bwana atakapowapa ndugu zenu kupumzika kama alivyowapa ninyi, wao pia wamiliki ile nchi ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu anawapa, ngʼambo ya Yordani. Baada ya hapo, kila mmoja wenu anaweza kurudi kwenye milki niliyowapa.”
english: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo nilimwamuru Yoshua, “Umejionea kwa macho yako mwenyewe yale yote ambayo Bwana Mungu wenu amewafanyia wafalme hawa wawili. Bwana atazifanyia falme zote huko mnakokwenda vivyo hivyo.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

kikuyu: Msiwaogope, Bwana Mungu wenu atapigana kwa ajili yenu.”
english: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo nilimsihi Bwana:
english: I begged GOD at that time, saying,

kikuyu: “Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, umemwonyesha mtumishi wako ukuu wako na mkono wako wenye uweza. Kwa kuwa ni mungu yupi aliye mbinguni au duniani anayeweza kufanya kazi na matendo makuu kama ufanyayo wewe?
english: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

kikuyu: Acha niende nikaione hiyo nchi nzuri ngʼambo ya Yordani, ile nchi nzuri ya vilima na Lebanoni.”
english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

kikuyu: Lakini kwa sababu yenu Bwana alinikasirikia na hakutaka kunisikiliza. Bwana aliniambia, “Hilo latosha; usiseme nami jambo hili tena.
english: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

kikuyu: Kwea juu ya kilele cha Pisga uangalie magharibi, kaskazini, kusini na mashariki. Iangalie hiyo nchi kwa macho yako, kwa vile wewe hutavuka Yordani.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

kikuyu: Lakini mwagize Yoshua, mtie moyo na umtie nguvu, kwa kuwa yeye atawaongoza watu hawa hadi ngʼambo na kuwarithisha nchi utakayoiona.”
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo tulikaa kwenye bonde karibu na Beth-Peori.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

kikuyu: Sikia sasa, ee Israeli, amri na sheria nitakazokufundisha wewe. Zifuate ili upate kuishi na uingie kuimiliki nchi ambayo Bwana, Mungu wa baba zako anawapa.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.

kikuyu: Usiongeze wala usipunguze chochote ninachowaamuru ninyi, ila myashike maagizo ya Bwana Mungu wenu ambayo nawapa.
english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

kikuyu: Mliona kwa macho yenu wenyewe kile Bwana alichokifanya kule Baal-Peori. Bwana Mungu wenu aliwaangamiza kutoka miongoni mwenu kila mmoja aliyemfuata Baali wa Peori,
english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

kikuyu: lakini ninyi nyote mlioshikamana na Bwana kwa uthabiti, Mungu wenu, mko hai mpaka leo.
english: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.

kikuyu: Tazama, nimewafundisha amri na sheria kama Bwana Mungu wangu alivyoniamuru mimi, ili mzifuate katika nchi mnayoiingia kuimiliki.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Zishikeni kwa uangalifu, kwa kuwa hii itaonyesha hekima na ufahamu wenu kwa mataifa, ambayo yatasikia kuhusu amri zote hizi, nao watasema, “Hakika taifa hili kubwa ni watu wenye hekima na ufahamu.”
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

kikuyu: Ni taifa gani jingine lililo kubwa kiasi cha kuwa na miungu yao iliyo karibu nao kama Bwana Mungu wetu alivyo karibu nasi wakati wowote tunapomwomba?
english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?

kikuyu: Nalo ni taifa gani jingine lililo kubwa hivi lenye kuwa na amri na sheria za haki kama hizi ninazoweka mbele yenu leo?
english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

kikuyu: Mwe waangalifu, na makini ili msije mkasahau mambo ambayo mliyaona kwa macho yenu, wala kuyaacha yaondoke moyoni mwenu siku zote za uhai wenu. Mwafundishe hayo watoto wenu na watoto wao baada yao.
english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

kikuyu: Kumbuka siku uliyosimama mbele za Bwana Mungu wako kule Horebu, wakati aliponiambia, “Wakutanishe watu mbele yangu wasikie maneno yangu ili kwamba waweze kujifunza kuniheshimu kwa muda wote watakaoishi katika nchi, nao waweze kuwafundisha watoto wao maneno hayo.”
english: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

kikuyu: Mlisogea karibu na mkasimama chini ya mlima wakati ulipowaka moto mpaka mbinguni juu, pamoja na mawingu meusi na giza nene.
english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana alipozungumza nanyi kutoka moto. Mkasikia sauti ya maneno lakini hamkuona umbo, kulikuwa na sauti tu.
english: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

kikuyu: Aliwatangazia Agano lake na Amri Kumi, ambazo aliwaamuru mzifuate, kisha akaziandika juu ya vibao viwili vya mawe.
english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

kikuyu: Naye Bwana alinielekeza wakati huo kuwafundisha ninyi sheria na amri ambazo mnapaswa kuzifuata katika nchi ambayo mnavuka Yordani kuimiliki.
english: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

kikuyu: Hamkuona umbo la aina yoyote siku ambayo Bwana alizungumza nanyi kule Horebu kutoka kwenye moto. Kwa hiyo mjihadhari kwa uangalifu sana,
english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

kikuyu: ili msije mkajichafua na kujitengenezea sanamu au kinyago chenye umbo lolote kama la mwanaume au mwanamke,
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

kikuyu: au kama mnyama aliye juu ya nchi au ndege yeyote arukaye angani,
english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

kikuyu: au kama kiumbe kitambaacho juu ya ardhi au samaki yeyote aliye ndani ya maji.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

kikuyu: Na utazamapo juu angani na ukaliona jua, mwezi na nyota na vyote vinavyoipamba mbingu, usije ukashawishiwa kuviinamia na kuviabudu vile ambavyo Bwana Mungu wenu alivyogawia mataifa yote chini ya mbingu.
english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
