kikuyu: Hawa walikuwa ndio wana wa Abihaili mwana wa Huri, mwana wa Yaroa, mwana wa Gileadi, mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Yeshishai, mwana wa Yahdo, mwana wa Buzi.
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

kikuyu: Ahi mwana wa Abdieli, mwana wa Guni, alikuwa ndiye kiongozi wa jamaa yao.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Wagadi waliishi Gileadi, huko Bashani pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka, pia katika nchi yote ya malisho ya Sharoni kote walikoenea.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

kikuyu: Yote haya yaliwekwa katika kumbukumbu za ukoo wao wakati wa utawala wa Yothamu, mfalme wa Yuda na Yeroboamu mfalme wa Israeli.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

kikuyu: Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa na watu mashujaa 44,760 waliokuwa wameandaliwa kwa ajili ya vita: watu wenye nguvu, hodari wa kutumia ngao na upanga, mashujaa wa kutumia upinde, waliokuwa tayari kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

kikuyu: Walipigana vita dhidi ya Wahagari, Yeturi, Nafishi na Nodabu.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

kikuyu: Walisaidiwa katika kupigana nao, Mungu akawatia Wahagari pamoja na wote walioungana nao mikononi mwao, kwa sababu walimlilia Mungu wakati wa vita. Alijibu maombi yao, kwa sababu walimtegemea.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

kikuyu: Walitwaa mifugo ya Wahagari: ngamia 50,000, kondoo 250,000, punda 2,000. Pia wakateka watu 100,000,
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

kikuyu: na wengine wengi waliuawa kwa sababu vita vilikuwa ni vya Mungu. Nao waliendelea kuikalia nchi hiyo mpaka wakati wa uhamisho.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

kikuyu: Idadi ya nusu ya kabila la Manase walikuwa wengi sana, Wakakaa kuanzia Bashani hadi Baal-Hermoni, yaani mpaka Seniri na mlima Hermoni.
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za kabila hilo: Eferi, Ishi, Elieli, Azrieli, Yeremia, Hodavia na Yahdieli. Walikuwa askari shujaa watu maarufu, viongozi wa jamaa zao.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Lakini hawakuwa waaminifu kwa Mungu wa baba zao, nao wakafanya ukahaba kwa miungu ya mataifa, ambayo Mungu alikuwa ameyaangamiza mbele yao.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mungu wa Israeli akaiamsha roho ya Pulu, mfalme wa Ashuru (ambaye pia alijulikana kama Tiglath-Pileseri), ambaye aliwachukua Wareubeni, Wagadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase kwenda uhamishoni. Akawapeleka huko Hala, Habori, Hara na mto Gozani, ambako wamekaa mpaka leo.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

kikuyu: Wana wa Lawi walikuwa: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Amramu alikuwa na wana: Aroni, Mose, na Miriamu. Aroni alikuwa na wana: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Eleazari akamzaa Finehasi, Finehasi akamzaa Abishua,
english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

kikuyu: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi,
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

kikuyu: Uzi akamzaa Zerahia, Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi,
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

kikuyu: Merayothi akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

kikuyu: Ahimaasi akamzaa Azaria, Azaria akamzaa Yohanani,
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

kikuyu: Yohanani akamzaa Azaria (ndiye alifanya kazi ya ukuhani katika Hekalu alilojenga Mfalme Solomoni huko Yerusalemu),
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Azaria akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Shalumu,
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

kikuyu: Shalumu akamzaa Hilkia, Hilkia akamzaa Azaria,
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

kikuyu: Azaria akamzaa Seraya, Seraya akamzaa Yehosadaki.
english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

kikuyu: Yehosadaki alihamishwa wakati Bwana aliwapeleka uhamishoni watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu kwa mkono wa Mfalme Nebukadneza.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Wana wa Lawi walikuwa: Gershoni, Kohathi na Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo majina ya wana wa Gershoni: Libni na Shimei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: Wana wa Kohathi walikuwa: Amramu, Ishari, Hebroni na Uzieli.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Wana wa Merari walikuwa: Mahli na Mushi. Zifuatazo ni koo za Walawi zilizoorodheshwa kufuatana na baba zao:
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Gershoni: Gershoni akamzaa Libni, Libni akamzaa Yahathi, Yahathi akamzaa Zima,
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

kikuyu: Zima akamzaa Yoa, Yoa akamzaa Ido, Ido akamzaa Zera, Zera akamzaa Yeatherai.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Kohathi: Kohathi akamzaa Aminadabu, Aminadabu akamzaa Kora, Kora akamzaa Asiri,
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: Asiri akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Ebiasafu, Ebiasafu akamzaa Asiri,
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: Asiri akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akamzaa Urieli, Urieli akamzaa Uzia, Uzia akamzaa Shauli.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Elikana walikuwa: Amasai na Ahimothi,
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

kikuyu: Ahimothi akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Sofai, Sofai akamzaa Nahathi,
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

kikuyu: Nahathi akamzaa Eliabu, Eliabu akamzaa Yerohamu, Yerohamu akamzaa Elikana, Elikana akamzaa Samweli.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

kikuyu: Wana wa Samweli walikuwa: Yoeli mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, na Abiya mwanawe wa pili.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

kikuyu: Wafuatao ndio wazao wa Merari: Merari akamzaa Mahli, Mahli akamzaa Libni, Libni akamzaa Shimei, Shimei akamzaa Uza,
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

kikuyu: Uza akamzaa Shimea, Shimea akamzaa Hagia, Hagia akamzaa Asaya.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio watu ambao Daudi aliwaweka kuwa viongozi wa uimbaji katika nyumba ya Bwana, baada ya Sanduku la Agano kuletwa ili kukaa huko.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.

kikuyu: Walihudumu kwa kuimba mbele ya Maskani, Hema la Kukutania, mpaka hapo Mfalme Solomoni alipojenga Hekalu la Bwana huko Yerusalemu. Walitimiza wajibu wao kulingana na taratibu walizokuwa wamewekewa.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

kikuyu: Wafuatao ni watu waliohudumu pamoja na wana wao: Kutoka ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa: Hemani, mpiga kinanda, alikuwa mwana wa Yoeli, mwana wa Samweli,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

kikuyu: mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Elieli, mwana wa Toa,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

kikuyu: mwana wa Sufu, mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Mahathi, mwana wa Amasai,
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

kikuyu: mwana wa Elikana, mwana wa Yoeli, mwana wa Azaria, mwana wa Sefania,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

kikuyu: mwana wa Tahathi, mwana wa Asiri, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora,
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

kikuyu: mwana wa Ishari, mwana wa Kohathi, mwana wa Lawi, mwana wa Israeli;
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

kikuyu: na msaidizi wa Hemani alikuwa Asafu, aliyesimama mkono wa kuume: Asafu mwana wa Berekia, mwana wa Shimea,
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

kikuyu: mwana wa Mikaeli, mwana wa Baaseya, mwana wa Malkiya,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

kikuyu: mwana wa Ethni, mwana wa Zera, mwana wa Adaya,
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

kikuyu: mwana wa Ethani, mwana wa Zima, mwana wa Shimei,
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

kikuyu: mwana wa Yahathi, mwana wa Gershoni, mwana wa Lawi.
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Na kutoka kwa walioshirikiana nao, Wamerari, mkono wake wa kushoto: Ethani mwana wa Kishi, mwana wa Abdi, mwana wa Maluki,
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

kikuyu: mwana wa Hashabia, mwana wa Amazia, mwana wa Hilkia,
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: mwana wa Amsi, mwana wa Bani, mwana wa Shemeri,
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

kikuyu: mwana wa Mahli, mwana wa Mushi, mwana wa Merari, mwana wa Lawi.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Ndugu zao wengine Walawi walipewa huduma nyingine za kuhudumia hema takatifu, nyumba ya Mungu.
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

kikuyu: Lakini Aroni na uzao wake ndio waliokuwa na wajibu wa kutoa sadaka katika madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa na kwenye madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba pamoja na yote yaliyofanyika pa Patakatifu, wakifanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya Israeli, sawasawa na yale yote aliyoagiza Mose mtumishi wa Mungu.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Aroni: Aroni akamzaa Eleazari, Eleazari akamzaa Finehasi, Finehasi akamzaa Abishua,
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

kikuyu: Abishua akamzaa Buki, Buki akamzaa Uzi, Uzi akamzaa Zerahia,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

kikuyu: Zerahia akamzaa Merayothi, Merayothi akamzaa Amaria, Amaria akamzaa Ahitubu,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

kikuyu: Ahitubu akamzaa Sadoki, Sadoki akamzaa Ahimaasi.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

kikuyu: Zifuatazo ni sehemu walizopewa ziwe nchi yao kwa ajili ya makazi yao (walipewa wazao wa Aroni waliotoka katika ukoo wa Wakohathi, kwa sababu kura ya kwanza iliwaangukia):
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

kikuyu: Walipewa Hebroni katika nchi ya Yuda pamoja na sehemu ya malisho inayouzunguka.
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

kikuyu: Lakini mashamba pamoja na vijiji vilivyouzunguka mji alipewa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune.
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wazao wa Aroni walipewa miji ifuatayo pamoja na eneo la malisho: Hebroni (mji wa makimbilio), Libna, Yatiri, Eshtemoa,
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Hileni, Debiri,
english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Ashani, Yuta na Beth-Shemeshi pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini walipewa Gibeoni, Geba, Alemethi na Anathothi, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho. Miji hii kumi na mitatu iligawanywa miongoni mwa koo za Wakohathi.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Wazao waliobaki wa Wakohathi walipewa miji kumi kutoka koo za nusu ya kabila la Manase.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Gershoni, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipewa miji kumi na mitatu kutoka kwa makabila ya Isakari, Asheri na Naftali kutoka sehemu ya kabila la Manase huko Bashani.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Merari, ukoo kwa ukoo walipewa miji kumi na miwili kutoka makabila ya Reubeni, Gadi na Zabuloni.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Waisraeli waliwapa Walawi miji hii pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Kutoka makabila ya Yuda, Simeoni na Benyamini walipewa miji iliyotajwa hapo juu.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya koo za Wakohathi walipewa kama nchi yao miji kutoka kabila la Efraimu.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Katika nchi ya vilima ya Efraimu walipewa Shekemu (mji wa makimbilio) na Gezeri,
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Yokmeamu, Beth-Horoni,
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Aiyaloni na Gath-Rimoni, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase, Waisraeli waliwapa koo za Wakohathi waliobaki miji ya Aneri na Bileamu pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

kikuyu: Wagershoni walipokea miji ifuatayo pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho: Katika nusu ya kabila la Manase: walipewa Golani katika Bashani na pia Ashtarothi.
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Kutoka kabila la Isakari walipokea Kedeshi, Daberathi,
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Ramothi na Anemu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Kutoka kabila la Asheri walipokea Mashali, Abdoni,
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Hukoki na Rehobu, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Kutoka kabila la Naftali walipokea Kedeshi katika Galilaya, Hamoni na Kiriathaimu pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Wamerari (Walawi waliobakia) walipokea miji ifuatayo: kutoka kabila la Zabuloni walipokea Yokneamu, Karta, Rimoni na Tabori pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Kutoka kabila la Reubeni, ngʼambo ya Yordani mashariki mwa Yeriko walipokea Bezeri ulioko jangwani, Yahasa,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Kedemothi na Mefaathi pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Na kutoka kabila la Gadi walipokea Ramothi huko Gileadi, Mahanaimu,
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Heshboni na Yazeri, pamoja na maeneo yake ya malisho.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Wana wa Isakari walikuwa: Tola, Pua, Yashubu na Shimroni; wote ni wanne.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

kikuyu: Wana wa Tola walikuwa: Uzi, Refaya, Yerieli, Yahmai, Ibsamu na Shemueli waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Daudi, wazao wa Tola walioorodheshwa kama wapiganaji katika ukoo wao walikuwa watu 22,600.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Uzi alikuwa: Izrahia. Wana wa Izrahia walikuwa: Mikaeli, Obadia, Yoeli na Ishia. Wote hawa watano walikuwa wakuu wao.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

kikuyu: Kulingana na ukoo wa jamaa zao, walikuwa na watu hodari wa vita wapatao 36,000, kwa sababu walikuwa na wanawake na watoto wengi.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

kikuyu: Jamaa ya watu waliokuwa wapiganaji hodari kutoka koo zote za Isakari, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika ukoo wao, jumla yao walikuwa 87,000.
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Wana watatu wa Benyamini walikuwa: Bela, Bekeri na Yediaeli.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

kikuyu: Wana wa Bela walikuwa: Esboni, Uzi, Uzieli, Yeremothi na Iri; walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao; wote ni watano. Watu wapiganaji walioorodheshwa katika ukoo wao walikuwa 22,034.
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

kikuyu: Wana wa Bekeri walikuwa: Zemira, Yoashi, Eliezeri, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremothi, Abiya, Anathothi na Alemethi. Hawa wote walikuwa wana wa Bekeri.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

kikuyu: Orodha ya ukoo wao iliyoandikwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa wapiganaji 20,200.
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Yediaeli alikuwa: Bilhani. Wana wa Bilhani walikuwa: Yeushi, Benyamini, Ehudi, Kenaana, Zethani, Tarshishi na Ahishahari.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

kikuyu: Hawa wana wote wa Yediaeli walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao. Kulikuwako wanaume wapiganaji 17,200 waliokuwa tayari kwenda vitani.
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

kikuyu: Washupimu na Wahupimu walikuwa wazao wa Iri. Wahushimu walikuwa wazao wa Aheri.
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

kikuyu: Wana wa Naftali walikuwa: Yahzieli, Guni, Yeseri na Shalumu; hao walikuwa wazao wa Bilha.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

kikuyu: Wana wa Manase walikuwa: Asirieli alikuwa mzao wake kutokana na suria wake wa Kiaramu. Huyu suria akamzaa Makiri baba wa Gileadi.
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Makiri akatwaa mke kutoka miongoni mwa Wahupimu na Washupimu. Jina la dada yake aliitwa Maaka. Mwana wa pili wa Makiri aliitwa Selofehadi, ambaye alikuwa na wasichana tu.
english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

kikuyu: Maaka mkewe Makiri akamzaa mwana aliyemwita Pereshi. Jina la nduguye lilikuwa Shereshi. Wana wa Pereshi walikuwa Ulamu na Rakemu.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Ulamu alikuwa: Bedani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Gileadi mwana wa Makiri, mwana wa Manase.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Dada yake aliyeitwa Hamolekethi aliwazaa Ish-Hodi, Abiezeri na Mahla.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

kikuyu: Wana wa Shemida walikuwa: Ahiani, Shekemu, Liki na Aniamu.
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

kikuyu: Wana wa Efraimu walikuwa: Shuthela, ambaye alimzaa Beredi, Beredi akamzaa Tahathi, Tahathi akazaa Eleada, Eleada akamzaa Tahathi,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

kikuyu: Tahathi akamzaa Zabadi, na Zabadi akamzaa Shuthela. Ezeri na Eleadi waliuawa na wenyeji wa Gathi walipokuwa wamekwenda huko kuwanyangʼanya mifugo yao.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

kikuyu: Baba yao Efraimu akawaombolezea kwa siku nyingi, na jamaa zake wakaja kumfariji.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

kikuyu: Kisha akakutana kimwili na mke wake tena, naye akachukua mimba, akamzalia mwana. Akamwita Beria, kwa sababu ya misiba iliyoipata nyumba yake.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

kikuyu: Beria alikuwa na binti jina lake Sheera. Huyu ndiye aliijenga miji ya Beth-Horoni ya Juu na Beth-Horoni ya Chini, pamoja na Uzen-Sheera.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

kikuyu: Beria akamzaa pia Refa, naye Refa akamzaa Reshefu, Reshefu akamzaa Tela, Tela akamzaa Tahani,
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

kikuyu: Tahani akamzaa Ladani, Ladani akamzaa Amihudi, Amihudi akamzaa Elishama,
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

kikuyu: Elishama akamzaa Nuni, Nuni akamzaa Yoshua.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

kikuyu: Nchi zao na makazi yao yalijumuisha Betheli na vijiji vilivyouzunguka, Naarani ilikuwa upande wa mashariki, Gezeri pamoja na vijiji vyake upande wa magharibi, pia Shekemu na vijiji vyake hadi kufikia Aya na vijiji vyake.
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

kikuyu: Katika mipaka ya Manase walikuwepo Beth-Shani, Taanaki, Megido na Dori pamoja na vijiji vyake. Wana wa Yosefu mwana wa Israeli waliishi katika miji hii.
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

kikuyu: Wana wa Asheri walikuwa: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi na Beria. Dada yao alikuwa Sera.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

kikuyu: Wana wa Beria walikuwa: Heberi na Malkieli, aliyekuwa baba yake Birzaithi.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

kikuyu: Heberi akawazaa Yafleti, Shomeri na Hothamu, na Shua dada yao.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

kikuyu: Wana wa Yafleti walikuwa: Pasaki, Bimhali na Ashvathi. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Yafleti.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

kikuyu: Wana wa Shemeri walikuwa: Ahi, Roga, Yehuba na Aramu.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

kikuyu: Wana wa Helemu ndugu yake walikuwa: Sofa, Imna, Sheleshi na Amali.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

kikuyu: Wana wa Sofa walikuwa: Sua, Harneferi, Shuali, Beri, Imra,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

kikuyu: Bezeri, Hodu, Shama, Shilsha, Ithrani na Beera.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

kikuyu: Wana wa Yetheri walikuwa: Yefune, Pispa na Ara.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

kikuyu: Wana wa Ula walikuwa: Ara, Hanieli na Risia.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

kikuyu: Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Asheri, viongozi wa jamaa zao, watu bora, mashujaa walio hodari na viongozi maarufu. Idadi ya watu waliokuwa tayari kwa vita, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika ukoo wao, walikuwa 26,000.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

kikuyu: Benyamini akamzaa: Bela mzaliwa wake wa kwanza, Ashbeli mwanawe wa pili, Ahara mwanawe wa tatu,
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

kikuyu: Noha mwanawe wa nne na Rafa mwanawe wa tano.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

kikuyu: Wana wa Bela walikuwa: Adari, Gera, Abihudi,
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

kikuyu: Abishua, Naamani, Ahoa,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

kikuyu: Gera, Shefufani na Huramu.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio wazao wa Ehudi, waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa za wale walioishi huko Geba na ambao walihamishiwa Manahathi:
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

kikuyu: Naamani, Ahiya na Gera. Gera alikuwa baba yao Uza na Ahihudi na ndiye aliwaongoza kwenda uhamishoni.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

kikuyu: Shaharaimu aliwazaa wana katika nchi ya Moabu baada ya kuwapa talaka wake zake wawili yaani, Hushimu na Baara.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

kikuyu: Kwa mkewe Hodeshi, akawazaa wana saba: Yobabu, Sibia, Mesha, Malkamu,
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

kikuyu: Yeuzi, Sakia na Mirma. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wanawe, viongozi wa jamaa zao.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Hushimu alimzalia: Abitubu na Elpaali.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

kikuyu: Wana wa Elpaali walikuwa: Eberi, Mishamu, Shemedi (aliyeijenga miji ya Ono na Lodi, pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka),
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

kikuyu: na Beria na Shema, waliokuwa viongozi wa zile jamaa zilizokuwa zinaishi katika mji wa Aiyaloni, na ambao waliwafukuza wenyeji wa Gathi.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kikuyu: Wana wa Beria walikuwa Ahio, Shashaki, Yeremothi,
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

kikuyu: Zebadia, Aradi, Ederi,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

kikuyu: Mikaeli, Ishpa, na Yoha.
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

kikuyu: Zebadia, Meshulamu, Hizki, Heberi,
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

kikuyu: Ishmerai, Izlia na Yobabu ndio waliokuwa wana wa Elpaali.
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

kikuyu: Yakimu, Zikri, Zabdi,
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

kikuyu: Elienai, Silethai, Elieli,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

kikuyu: Adaya, Beraya na Shimrathi walikuwa wana wa Shimei.
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

kikuyu: Wana wa Shashaki walikuwa Ishpani, Eberi, Elieli,
english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

kikuyu: Abdoni, Zikri, Hanani,
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

kikuyu: Hanania, Elamu, Anthothiya,
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

kikuyu: Ifdeya na Penueli.
english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

kikuyu: Shamsherai, Sheharia, Athalia,
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

kikuyu: Yaareshia, Eliya na Zikri walikuwa wana wa Yerohamu.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

kikuyu: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao wakuu, kama ilivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yeieli alikuwa baba yake Gibeoni naye aliishi huko Gibeoni. Mke wake aliitwa Maaka.
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

kikuyu: Mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

kikuyu: Gedori, Ahio, Zekeri,
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

kikuyu: na Miklothi ambaye alikuwa baba yake Shimea. Hawa pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Neri akamzaa Kishi, Kishi akamzaa Sauli, Sauli akamzaa Yonathani, Malki-Shua, Abinadabu na Esh-Baali.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: Yonathani akamzaa: Merib-Baali, naye Merib-Baali akamzaa Mika.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea na Ahazi.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Ahazi akamzaa Yehoada. Naye Yehoada akawazaa Alemethi, Azmawethi na Zimri, naye Zimri akamzaa Mosa.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Mosa akamzaa Binea, Binea akamzaa Rafa, na mwanawe huyo ni Eleasa, na mwanawe huyo ni Aseli.
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita; haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa wote ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Wana wa Esheki, nduguye Aseli, walikuwa: Mzaliwa wake wa kwanza alikuwa Ulamu, wa pili Yeushi na wa tatu Elifeleti.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

kikuyu: Wana wa Ulamu walikuwa mashujaa hodari walioweza kutumia upinde. Alikuwa na wana wengi na wajukuu, jumla yao 150. Hawa wote ndio walikuwa wazao wa Benyamini.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Waisraeli wote waliorodheshwa katika koo zilizoandikwa kwenye kitabu cha wafalme wa Israeli. Watu wa Yuda walichukuliwa mateka kwenda Babeli kwa sababu ya kukosa uaminifu kwa Mungu.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

kikuyu: Basi watu wa kwanza kurudi kukaa kwenye milki zao katika miji yao walikuwa baadhi ya Waisraeli, makuhani, Walawi na watumishi wa Hekalu.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

kikuyu: Wale waliotoka Yuda, Benyamini, Efraimu na Manase ambao waliishi Yerusalemu walikuwa:
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

kikuyu: Uthai mwana wa Amihudi, mwana wa Omri, mwana wa Imri, mwana wa Bani, wa wana wa Peresi, mwana wa Yuda.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

kikuyu: Wazao wa Washiloni waliorudi ni: Asaya mzaliwa wa kwanza na wanawe.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

kikuyu: Kwa wana wa Zera: Yeueli. Watu wa Yuda jumla yao walikuwa watu 690.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

kikuyu: Kwa Benyamini walikuwa: Salu mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Hodavia, mwana wa Hasenua;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: Ibneya mwana wa Yerohamu, Ela mwana wa Uzi, mwana wa Mikri; na Meshulamu mwana wa Shefatia, mwana wa Reueli, mwana wa Ibniya.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

kikuyu: Watu kutoka Benyamini kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao jumla yao ni 956. Watu hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Wa jamaa za makuhani walikuwa: Yedaya, Yehoyaribu na Yakini;
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

kikuyu: Azaria mwana wa Hilkia, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Sadoki, mwana wa Merayothi, mwana wa Ahitubu aliyekuwa afisa kiongozi wa nyumba ya Mungu.
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

kikuyu: Adaya mwana wa Yerohamu, mwana wa Pashuri, mwana wa Malkiya; Maasai, mwana wa Adieli, mwana wa Yahzera, mwana wa Meshulamu, mwana wa Meshilemithi, mwana wa Imeri.
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

kikuyu: Makuhani waliokuwa viongozi wa jamaa zao walikuwa 1,760. Walikuwa watu wenye uwezo, waliowajibika kuhudumu katika nyumba ya Mungu.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Jamaa za Walawi walikuwa: Shemaya, mwana wa Hashubu, mwana wa Azrikamu, mwana wa Hashabia, wa wana wa Merari.
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

kikuyu: Bakbakari, Hereshi, Galali na Matania mwana wa Mika, mwana wa Zikri, mwana wa Asafu.
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

kikuyu: Obadia mwana wa Shemaya, mwana wa Galali, mwana wa Yeduthuni. Berekia mwana wa Asa, mwana wa Elikana, ambao waliishi katika vijiji vya Wanetofathi.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

kikuyu: Mabawabu katika Hekalu la Bwana waliorudi walikuwa: Shalumu, Akubu, Talmoni, Ahimani na ndugu zao. Shalumu alikuwa mlinzi wao mkuu.
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

kikuyu: Walikuwa wamewekwa katika lango la mfalme lililokuwa upande wa mashariki, mpaka wakati huu. Hawa walikuwa mabawabu wa kutoka kwenye kambi ya Walawi.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

kikuyu: Shalumu mwana wa Kore, mwana wa Ebiasafu, mwana wa Kora, pamoja na mabawabu wenzake kutoka jamaa yake ya Kora waliwajibika kulinda malango ya Hema, kama vile baba zao walivyokuwa wamewajibika kulinda ingilio la Maskani ya Bwana.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

kikuyu: Hapo zamani Finehasi mwana wa Eleazari alikuwa kiongozi wa mabawabu, naye Bwana alikuwa pamoja naye:
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

kikuyu: Zekaria mwana wa Meshelemia alikuwa bawabu katika ingilio la Hema la Kukutania.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Jumla ya waliochaguliwa kuwa mabawabu katika sakafu za kupuria nafaka walikuwa watu 212. Waliandikishwa kwa koo zao kwenye vijiji vyao. Mabawabu hawa waliwekwa katika nafasi zao za kuaminiwa na Daudi pamoja na mwonaji Samweli.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

kikuyu: Wao na wazao wao walikuwa viongozi wa kulinda malango ya nyumba ya Bwana, nyumba iliyoitwa Hema.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

kikuyu: Mabawabu walikuwa pande zote nne: mashariki, magharibi, kaskazini na kusini.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

kikuyu: Ndugu zao katika vijiji vyao walikuwa wakija mara kwa mara na kuwasaidia katika kazi zao kwa vipindi mbalimbali vya siku saba.
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

kikuyu: Lakini mabawabu wanne wakuu, waliokuwa Walawi, walikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya vyumba na hazina katika nyumba ya Mungu.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

kikuyu: Walikesha mahali walipowekwa kuizunguka nyumba ya Mungu, kwa sababu iliwapasa kuilinda. Pia walitunza funguo kwa ajili ya kufungua mlango kila siku asubuhi.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

kikuyu: Baadhi yao walikuwa viongozi wa kutunza vifaa vilivyotumika katika huduma ndani ya Hekalu; walivihesabu kila vilipoingizwa ndani na kila vilipotolewa.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

kikuyu: Wengine walipangiwa kutunza mapambo na vifaa vingine vya patakatifu, pamoja na unga, divai, mafuta, uvumba na vikolezo.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

kikuyu: Lakini baadhi ya makuhani walifanya kazi ya kuchanganya vikolezo.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

kikuyu: Mlawi aliyeitwa Matithia, mwana mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Shalumu, wa ukoo wa Kora, alikabidhiwa wajibu kwa ajili ya kuoka mikate ya sadaka.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya ndugu zao wa ukoo wa Kohathi walikuwa viongozi wa kuandaa mikate ya Wonyesho kwa ajili ya kila Sabato, mikate iliyokuwa inawekwa mezani.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

kikuyu: Wale waliokuwa waimbaji, viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, waliishi katika vyumba vya Hekalu, nao hawakufanya shughuli nyingine yoyote kwa sababu iliwapasa kuwajibika kwa kazi hiyo usiku na mchana.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

kikuyu: Hawa wote walikuwa viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi, wakuu kama walivyoorodheshwa katika koo zao, nao waliishi Yerusalemu.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yeieli alikuwa baba yake Gibeoni naye aliishi huko Gibeoni. Mke wake aliitwa Maaka,
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

kikuyu: mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza alikuwa Abdoni, akafuatiwa na Suri, Kishi, Baali, Neri, Nadabu,
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

kikuyu: Gedori, Ahio, Zekaria na Miklothi.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

kikuyu: Miklothi akamzaa Shimeamu. Wao pia waliishi karibu na jamaa zao huko Yerusalemu.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Neri akamzaa Kishi, Kishi akamzaa Sauli. Sauli akamzaa Yonathani, Malki-Shua, Abinadabu na Esh-Baali.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: Yonathani akamzaa Merib-Baali, naye Merib-Baali akamzaa Mika.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Wana wa Mika walikuwa: Pithoni, Meleki, Tarea, na Ahazi.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Ahazi akamzaa Yara, Yara akawazaa Alemethi, Azmawethi na Zimri, naye Zimri akamzaa Mosa.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Mosa akamzaa Binea, Binea akamzaa Refaya, na mwanawe huyo ni Eleasa, na mwanawe huyo ni Aseli.
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Aseli alikuwa na wana sita, na haya ndiyo majina yao: Azrikamu, Bokeru, Ishmaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani. Hawa ndio waliokuwa wana wa Aseli.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Basi Wafilisti wakapigana na Israeli. Waisraeli wakawakimbia, na wengi wakauawa katika mlima Gilboa.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Wafilisti wakawafuatia kwa bidii Sauli na wanawe, wakawaua Yonathani, Abinadabu na Malki-Shua.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Mapigano yakawa makali kumzunguka Sauli na wakati wapiga mishale walipompata, wakamjeruhi.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Sauli akamwambia mbeba silaha wake, “Futa upanga wako unichome nao, la sivyo hawa watu wasiotahiriwa watakuja na kunidhalilisha.” Lakini mbeba silaha wake akaogopa sana wala hakuweza kufanya hivyo. Kwa hiyo Sauli akachukua upanga wake mwenyewe na kuuangukia.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: Mbeba silaha wake alipoona kwamba Sauli amekufa, naye pia akauangukia upanga wake akafa.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Sauli na wanawe watatu wakafa, pamoja na nyumba yake yote.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

kikuyu: Waisraeli wote waliokuwa bondeni walipoona kwamba jeshi limekimbia na kwamba Sauli na wanawe wamekufa, waliacha miji yao wakakimbia. Nao Wafilisti wakaja na kukaa humo.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Kesho yake Wafilisti walipokuja kuwavua maiti silaha, walimkuta Sauli na wanawe wameanguka katika Mlima Gilboa.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Wakamvua mavazi, wakachukua kichwa chake pamoja na silaha zake, wakawatuma wajumbe katika nchi yote ya Wafilisti kutangaza habari hizi miongoni mwa sanamu zao na watu wao.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

kikuyu: Waliweka silaha zake katika hekalu la miungu yao, wakatundika kichwa chake katika hekalu la Dagoni.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

kikuyu: Wakazi wote wa Yabeshi-Gileadi waliposikia yote Wafilisti waliyomtendea Sauli,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

kikuyu: mashujaa wao wote wakaondoka, wakautwaa mwili wa Sauli na miili ya wanawe, wakaileta Yabeshi. Wakaizika mifupa yao chini ya mti mkubwa huko Yabeshi, nao wakafunga kwa siku saba.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

kikuyu: Sauli alikufa kwa sababu hakuwa mwaminifu kwa Bwana. Hakulishika neno la Bwana, hata akataka shauri kwa mwaguzi kwa ajili ya uongozi,
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

kikuyu: hakumuuliza Bwana. Kwa hiyo Bwana alimuua, na ufalme akampa Daudi mwana wa Yese.
english: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Israeli yote walimjia Daudi kwa pamoja huko Hebroni wakamwambia, “Sisi ni nyama yako na damu yako.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

kikuyu: Zamani, wakati Sauli alikuwa mfalme, wewe ndiwe uliyeiongoza Israeli vitani, naye Bwana Mungu wako alikuambia, ‘Wewe utawachunga watu wangu Israeli, na utakuwa mtawala wao.’ ”
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

kikuyu: Wazee wote wa Israeli walipokuwa wamewasili kwa Mfalme Daudi huko Hebroni, alifanya mapatano nao huko Hebroni mbele za Bwana, nao wakamtia Daudi mafuta awe mfalme wa Israeli, sawasawa na Bwana alivyoahidi kupitia kwa Samweli.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

kikuyu: Daudi na Waisraeli wote wakaenda Yerusalemu (ndio Yebusi). Nao Wayebusi walioishi humo
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

kikuyu: wakamwambia Daudi, “Wewe hutaingia humu.” Hata hivyo, Daudi akaiteka ngome ya Sayuni, Mji wa Daudi.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

kikuyu: Daudi alikuwa amesema, “Yeyote aongozaye mashambulizi dhidi ya Wayebusi, atakuwa jemadari mkuu.” Yoabu mwana wa Seruya akawa wa kwanza kukwea, naye akawa mkuu.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

kikuyu: Daudi akafanya makao yake kwenye ngome, hivyo ukaitwa Mji wa Daudi.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

kikuyu: Akajenga mji pande zote, kuanzia kwenye mito hadi kwenye ukuta kuzunguka, wakati huo huo Yoabu akajenga sehemu zingine zilizobaki za Yerusalemu.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

kikuyu: Daudi akazidi kuwa na nguvu zaidi na zaidi, kwa sababu Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote alikuwa pamoja naye.
english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio waliokuwa wakuu wa mashujaa wa Daudi: wao pamoja na Israeli wote wakauimarisha ufalme wake ili kuenea katika nchi yote, kama Bwana alivyoahidi.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

kikuyu: Hii ndio orodha ya mashujaa wa Daudi: Yashobeamu, Mhakmoni, alikuwa mkuu wa maafisa; yeye aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300, ambao aliwaua katika pambano moja.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

kikuyu: Aliyefuata alikuwa Eleazari, mwana wa Dodai, Mwahohi, mmojawapo wa wale mashujaa watatu.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Huyo alikuwa pamoja na Daudi huko Pas-Damimu, wakati Wafilisti walikusanyika huko kwa ajili ya vita. Huko ambapo kulikuwa na shamba lililokuwa limejaa shayiri, vikosi vya Israeli vikawakimbia Wafilisti.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

kikuyu: Lakini Eleazari na Daudi wakasimama imara katikati ya lile shamba, nao wakalishindania na wakawaua Wafilisti. Naye Bwana akawapa ushindi mkubwa.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

kikuyu: Wakuu watatu miongoni mwa wale thelathini, walimwendea Daudi katika mwamba huko kwenye pango la Adulamu, wakati kikundi cha Wafilisti kilikuwa kimepiga kambi katika Bonde la Warefai.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Wakati huo Daudi alikuwa katika ngome, na kambi ya Wafilisti ilikuwa huko Bethlehemu.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

kikuyu: Daudi akatamani maji, akasema, “Laiti mtu angenipatia maji ya kunywa kutoka kisima kilichoko karibu na lango la Bethlehemu!”
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

kikuyu: Kwa hivyo wale watatu, wakapita katikati ya safu za Wafilisti, wakachota maji kutoka kwa kisima kilicho karibu na lango la Bethlehemu, wakamletea Daudi. Lakini yeye akakataa kuyanywa. Badala yake, aliyamimina mbele za Bwana.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

kikuyu: Akasema, “Mungu apishie mbali kwamba nifanye hivi! Je kweli, niinywe damu ya watu hawa waliohatarisha maisha yao?” Kwa sababu walihatarisha maisha yao kuyaleta yale maji, Daudi hakukubali kuyanywa. Huo ndio uliokuwa ujasiri wa wale mashujaa watatu.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

kikuyu: Abishai, ndugu yake Yoabu ndiye alikuwa kiongozi wa hao Watatu. Aliinua mkuki wake dhidi ya watu 300, ambao aliwaua, kwa hiyo naye akawa na sifa kama hao Watatu.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

kikuyu: Alitunukiwa heshima maradufu ya wale Watatu, akawa jemadari wao, ingawa hakuhesabiwa miongoni mwao.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

kikuyu: Benaya, mwana wa Yehoyada alikuwa mpiganaji hodari kutoka Kabseeli ambaye alifanya mambo makubwa ya ujasiri. Aliwaua mashujaa wawili waliokuwa hodari kuliko wote wa Moabu. Pia alishuka shimoni kulipokuwa na theluji na kumuua simba.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

kikuyu: Alimuua Mmisri aliyekuwa na urefu kama dhiraa tano. Ingawa Mmisri alikuwa na mkuki kama mti wa mfumaji mkononi mwake, Benaya alimwendea na rungu. Akamnyangʼanya Mmisri mkuki wake na kumuua nao.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

kikuyu: Haya yalikuwa mambo ya ushujaa ya Benaya mwana wa Yehoyada; naye pia alikuwa maarufu kama wale mashujaa watatu.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Yeye aliheshimiwa zaidi ya wale Thelathini, lakini hakujumuishwa miongoni mwa wale Watatu: Daudi akamweka kuwa kiongozi wa walinzi wake.
english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

kikuyu: Wale watu mashujaa walikuwa: Asaheli nduguye Yoabu, Elhanani mwana wa Dodo kutoka Bethlehemu,
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kikuyu: Shamothi Mharori, Helesi Mpeloni,
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

kikuyu: Ira mwana wa Ikeshi kutoka Tekoa, Abiezeri kutoka Anathothi,
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

kikuyu: Sibekai Mhushathi, Ilai Mwahohi,
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

kikuyu: Maharai Mnetofathi, Heledi mwana wa Baana, Mnetofathi,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

kikuyu: Itai mwana wa Ribai kutoka Gibea ya Benyamini, Benaya Mpirathoni,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

kikuyu: Hurai kutoka mabonde ya Gaashi, Abieli Mwaribathi,
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

kikuyu: Azmawethi Mbaharumi, Eliaba Mshaalboni,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

kikuyu: wana wa Hashemu Mgiloni, Yonathani mwana wa Shagee Mharari,
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

kikuyu: Ahiamu mwana wa Sakari Mharari, Elifale mwana wa Uru,
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

kikuyu: Heferi Mmekerathi, Ahiya Mpeloni,
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

kikuyu: Hezro Mkarmeli, Naarai mwana wa Ezbai,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

kikuyu: Yoeli nduguye Nathani, Mibhari mwana wa Hagri,
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

kikuyu: Seleki Mwamoni, Naharai Mbeerothi, mbeba silaha wa Yoabu mwana wa Seruya,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

kikuyu: Ira Mwithiri, Garebu Mwithiri,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

kikuyu: Uria Mhiti, Zabadi mwana wa Alai,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

kikuyu: Adina mwana wa Shiza Mreubeni, ambaye alikuwa mkuu wa Wareubeni, akiwa pamoja na watu thelathini,
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

kikuyu: Hanani mwana wa Maaka, Yoshafati Mmithni,
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

kikuyu: Uzia Mwashterathi, Shama na Yeieli wana wa Hothamu Mwaroeri,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

kikuyu: Yediaeli mwana wa Shimri, nduguye Yoha Mtizi,
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

kikuyu: Elieli Mmahawi, Yeribai na Yoshavia wana wa Elnaamu, Ithma Mmoabu,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

kikuyu: Elieli, na Obedi na Yaasieli Mmesobai.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio watu waliomjia Daudi huko Siklagi, wakati alikuwa amefukuzwa mbele ya Sauli mwana wa Kishi (walikuwa miongoni mwa mashujaa waliomsaidia Daudi vitani,
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

kikuyu: walikuwa na pinde na walikuwa na uwezo wa kupiga mishale au kutupa mawe kwa kombeo wakitumia mkono wa kushoto au wa kulia; hawa walikuwa ndugu zake Sauli kutoka kabila la Benyamini):
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Mkuu wao alikuwa Ahiezeri, na wa pili Yoashi, wote wana wa Shemaa Mgibeathi; pia Yezieli na Peleti wana wa Azmawethi; Beraka, Yehu Mwanathothi,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

kikuyu: na Ishmaya Mgibeoni, shujaa miongoni mwa wale Thelathini, ambaye alikuwa kiongozi wa wale Thelathini; Yeremia, Yahazieli, Yohanani, Yozabadi, Mgederathi,
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

kikuyu: Eluzai, Yeremothi, Bealia, Shemaria, Shefatia, Mharufi;
english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

kikuyu: Elikana, Ishia, Azareli, Yoezeri na Yashobeamu, wana wa Kora;
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

kikuyu: Yoela na Zebadia, wana wa Yerohamu, kutoka Gedori.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya Wagadi wakajitenga na kujiunga na Daudi katika ngome yake huko jangwani. Walikuwa mashujaa hodari, waliokuwa tayari kwa vita na wenye uwezo wa kutumia ngao na mkuki. Nyuso zao zilikuwa nyuso za simba na walikuwa na wepesi kama paa milimani.
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

kikuyu: Ezeri alikuwa mkuu wao, Obadia alikuwa wa pili katika uongozi, Eliabu wa tatu,
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

kikuyu: Mishmana wa nne, Yeremia wa tano,
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

kikuyu: Atai wa sita, Elieli wa saba,
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

kikuyu: Yohanani wa nane, Elzabadi wa tisa,
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

kikuyu: Yeremia wa kumi, na Makbanai wa kumi na moja.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

kikuyu: Hawa Wagadi walikuwa majemadari. Aliyekuwa wa mwisho kuliko wote aliweza kuongoza askari 100, na aliyekuwa na uweza zaidi ya wote aliongoza 1,000.
english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

kikuyu: Wao ndio walivuka Mto Yordani katika mwezi wa kwanza ukiwa umefurika hadi kwenye kingo zake zote na kusababisha watu wote waliokuwa wanaishi kwenye mabonde kukimbilia mashariki na wengine magharibi.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

kikuyu: Wabenyamini wengine na baadhi ya watu kutoka Yuda pia walikuja kwa Daudi katika ngome yake.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

kikuyu: Daudi akatoka nje kuwalaki na akawaambia, “Kama mmekuja kwangu kwa amani, kunisaidia, mimi niko tayari kuwaruhusu ninyi kuungana nami. Lakini kama mmekuja ili kunisaliti kwa adui zangu wakati mimi mikono yangu haina hatia, basi Mungu wa baba zetu aone na awahukumu.”
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

kikuyu: Kisha Roho akaja juu ya Amasai, mkuu wa wale Thelathini, naye akasema: “Sisi tu watu wako, ee Daudi! Nasi tuko pamoja na wewe, ee mwana wa Yese! Ushindi, naam, ushindi uwe kwako, pia ushindi kwa wale walio upande wako, kwa kuwa Mungu wako atakusaidia.” Kwa hiyo Daudi akawapokea na kuwafanya viongozi wa vikosi vyake vya uvamizi.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya watu kutoka kabila la Manase wakajiunga na Daudi wakati alikwenda pamoja na Wafilisti, kupigana na Sauli. (Daudi na watu wake hawakuwasaidia Wafilisti kwa sababu, baada ya ushauri, watawala wao walimrudisha. Wakasema, “Itatugharimu vichwa vyetu kama Daudi atatuasi na kurudi kwa Sauli bwana wake.”)
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

kikuyu: Daudi alipokwenda Siklagi, hawa ndio watu wa kabila la Manase waliojiunga naye: Adna, Yozabadi, Yediaeli, Mikaeli, Yozabadi, Elihu na Silethai, viongozi wa vikosi vya watu 1,000 katika kabila la Manase.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Walimsaidia Daudi dhidi ya makundi ya uvamizi, kwa kuwa wote walikuwa mashujaa hodari na walikuwa majemadari katika jeshi lake.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

kikuyu: Siku baada ya siku watu walikuja kumsaidia Daudi, mpaka akawa na jeshi kubwa, kama jeshi la Mungu.
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

kikuyu: Hawa ndio watu waliojiandaa kwa ajili ya vita waliokuja kwa Daudi huko Hebroni ili kumtwalia ufalme kutoka kwa Sauli, kama Bwana alivyokuwa amesema:
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: watu wa Yuda, wanaochukua ngao na mikuki walikuwa 6,800 wote wakiwa tayari kwa vita.
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

kikuyu: Watu wa Simeoni, mashujaa waliokuwa tayari kwa vita walikuwa 7,100.
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

kikuyu: Watu wa Lawi walikuwa 4,600,
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: pamoja na Yehoyada, kiongozi wa jamaa ya Aroni, aliyekuwa pamoja na watu 3,700,
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

kikuyu: na Sadoki, kijana shujaa na hodari, aliyekuwa pamoja na maafisa ishirini na wawili kutoka jamaa yake.
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

kikuyu: Watu wa Benyamini, ndugu zake Sauli, walikuwa 3,000; wengi wao walikuwa wameendelea kuwa waaminifu kwa Sauli mpaka wakati huo.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

kikuyu: Watu wa Efraimu, mashujaa hodari 20,800, watu waliokuwa maarufu katika koo zao.
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Watu wa nusu ya kabila la Manase, waliotajwa kwa majina ili waje kumweka Daudi kuwa mfalme, watu 18,000.
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

kikuyu: Watu wa Isakari, waliofahamu majira na kujua kile ambacho Israeli inapasa kufanya, walikuwa viongozi 200, pamoja na jamaa zao wote chini ya uongozi wao.
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

kikuyu: Watu wa Zabuloni, askari wenye uzoefu mkubwa walioandaliwa tayari kwa vita wakiwa na silaha za kila aina, ili kumsaidia Daudi kwa uaminifu thabiti, walikuwa 50,000.
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

kikuyu: Watu wa Naftali, maafisa 1,000, pamoja na watu 37,000 waliochukua ngao na mikuki.
english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Watu wa Dani 28,600 waliokuwa tayari kwa vita.
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Watu wa Asheri, askari 40,000 wenye uzoefu mkubwa waliondaliwa kwa ajili ya vita.
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

kikuyu: Na pia watu kutoka mashariki ya Yordani, watu wa Reubeni, Gadi na nusu ya kabila la Manase, wakiwa na kila aina ya silaha, watu 120,000.
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

kikuyu: Wote hawa walikuwa watu wapiganaji waliojitolea kutumika katika safu zao. Walikuja Hebroni wakiwa wameamua kikamilifu kumfanya Daudi mfalme juu ya Israeli yote. Waisraeli wengine wote walikuwa pia na nia hiyo moja ya kumfanya Daudi kuwa mfalme.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

kikuyu: Watu hawa wakakaa huko na Daudi siku tatu, wakila na kunywa, kwa sababu jamaa zao zilikuwa zimewapatia mahitaji yao.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

kikuyu: Pia, majirani zao hata wale walio mbali hadi Isakari, Zabuloni na Naftali, walikuja wakiwaletea vyakula walivyovibeba kwa punda, ngamia, nyumbu na maksai. Kulikuwepo na wingi wa unga, maandazi ya tini, maandazi ya zabibu kavu, divai, mafuta, ngʼombe na kondoo, kwa maana kulikuwa na furaha katika Israeli.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

kikuyu: Daudi alishauriana na kila afisa wake, majemadari wa maelfu na majemadari wa mamia.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

kikuyu: Ndipo Daudi akaliambia kusanyiko lote la Israeli, “Kama mkiona ni vyema, na kama ni mapenzi ya Bwana Mungu wetu, tupeleke ujumbe kwa ndugu zetu wengine walio mbali na walio karibu katika nchi yote ya Israeli, pia kwa makuhani na Walawi walio pamoja nao katika miji yao na katika sehemu zao za malisho yao, waje waungane na sisi.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

kikuyu: Sisi na tulirudishe Sanduku la Mungu wetu kwetu kwa maana hatukujali wakati wa utawala wa Sauli.”
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

kikuyu: Kusanyiko lote likakubaliana kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu ilionekana vyema kwa watu wote.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

kikuyu: Basi Daudi akawakusanya Waisraeli wote, kuanzia Mto Shihori ulioko Misri hadi Lebo-Hamathi, ili kulileta Sanduku la Mungu kutoka Kiriath-Yearimu.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

kikuyu: Daudi akiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wote wakaenda Baala ya Yuda (yaani Kiriath-Yearimu) kulipandisha Sanduku la Mungu Bwana, yeye anayeketi katika kiti cha enzi kati ya makerubi: Sanduku linaloitwa kwa Jina lake, kutoka huko.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

kikuyu: Wakalisafirisha Sanduku la Mungu kwa gari jipya la kukokotwa na maksai kutoka nyumba ya Abinadabu, Uza na Ahio wakiliongoza gari hilo.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

kikuyu: Daudi pamoja na Waisraeli wote walikuwa wanasifu kwa nguvu zao zote mbele za Mungu, kwa nyimbo na kwa vinubi, zeze, matari, matoazi na tarumbeta.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

kikuyu: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka wa Kidoni, Uza akaunyoosha mkono wake ili kulizuia Sanduku, kwa sababu maksai walijikwaa.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

kikuyu: Hasira ya Bwana ikawaka dhidi ya Uza, akampiga kwa sababu aliuweka mkono wake kwenye Sanduku. Kwa hiyo akafa pale mbele za Mungu.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

kikuyu: Ndipo Daudi akakasirika kwa sababu ghadhabu ya Bwana ilifurika dhidi ya Uza, mahali pale pakaitwa Peres-Uza hadi leo.
english: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

kikuyu: Siku ile Daudi akamwogopa Mungu naye akauliza. “Nitawezaje kulichukua Sanduku la Mungu kwangu?”
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

kikuyu: Hakulichukua hilo Sanduku akae nalo katika Mji wa Daudi. Badala yake, akalipeleka nyumbani kwa Obed-Edomu, Mgiti.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

kikuyu: Sanduku la Mungu likabaki pamoja na jamaa ya Obed-Edomu, nyumbani kwake kwa miezi mitatu, naye Bwana akaibariki nyumba yake pamoja na kila kitu alichokuwa nacho.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

kikuyu: Basi Hiramu mfalme wa Tiro akawatuma wajumbe kwa Daudi, wakiwa na magogo ya mierezi, waashi na maseremala ili kumjengea jumba la kifalme.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

kikuyu: Naye Daudi akatambua kwamba Bwana amemwimarisha kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli na kwamba ufalme wake umetukuzwa kwa ajili ya Israeli, watu wake.
english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: Huko Yerusalemu Daudi akaoa wake wengine zaidi na akawa baba wa wana na mabinti wengi.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo majina ya watoto waliozaliwa kwake huko: Shamua, Shobabu, Nathani, Solomoni,
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

kikuyu: Ibihari, Elishua, Elpeleti,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

kikuyu: Noga, Nefegi, Yafia,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: Elishama, Beeliada na Elifeleti.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Wafilisti waliposikia kuwa Daudi ametiwa mafuta kuwa mfalme wa Israeli yote, wakapanda na jeshi lao lote kwenda kumsaka, lakini Daudi akapata habari hizo, naye akatoka ili kwenda kukabiliana nao.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

kikuyu: Basi Wafilisti walikuwa wameingia na kushambulia Bonde la Warefai,
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu: “Je, niende kuwashambulia hao Wafilisti? Je, utawatia mikononi mwangu?” Bwana akamjibu, “Nenda, nitawatia mikononi mwako.”
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Daudi pamoja na watu wake wakakwea mpaka Baal-Perasimu, akawashinda huko. Akasema, “Kama maji yafurikavyo, Mungu amewafurikia adui zangu kwa kutumia mkono wangu.” Kwa hiyo mahali pale pakaitwa Baal-Perasimu.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Wafilisti walikuwa wameacha miungu yao huko, Daudi akaamuru iteketezwe kwa moto.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

kikuyu: Kwa mara nyingine Wafilisti wakavamia lile bonde;
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

kikuyu: hivyo Daudi akamuuliza Mungu tena, naye Mungu akamjibu, “Usiwapandie moja kwa moja, bali wazungukie na uwashambulie kutoka mbele ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

kikuyu: Mara usikiapo sauti ya kwenda juu ya hiyo miti ya miforosadi, hapo ndipo utoke upigane vita, kwa sababu hiyo itaonyesha kwamba Mungu amekutangulia ili kupiga jeshi la Wafilisti.”
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Daudi akafanya kama alivyoagizwa na Mungu, wakalipiga jeshi la Wafilisti kuanzia Gibeoni hadi Gezeri.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

kikuyu: Hivyo umaarufu wa Daudi ukaenea katika kila nchi, naye Bwana akayafanya mataifa yote kumwogopa Daudi.
