english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

kikuyu: Matendo yake yote ya nguvu na uwezo, pamoja na habari zote za ukuu wa Mordekai ambao mfalme alikuwa amemkuza, je, hayakuandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Umedi na Uajemi?
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

kikuyu: Mordekai Myahudi alikuwa wa pili kwa cheo kutoka Mfalme Ahasuero, naye alikuwa bora kabisa miongoni mwa Wayahudi, akipandishwa katika heshima ya juu na ndugu zake Wayahudi kwa sababu aliwatendea mema watu wake, na alizungumza kwa ajili ya ustawi wa Wayahudi wote.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

kikuyu: Katika nchi ya Usi paliishi mtu ambaye aliitwa Ayubu. Mtu huyu alikuwa hana hatia, naye alikuwa mkamilifu; alimcha Mungu na kuepukana na uovu.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

kikuyu: Alikuwa na wana saba na binti watatu,
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: naye alikuwa na kondoo elfu saba, ngamia elfu tatu, jozi mia tano za maksai, na punda mia tano, tena alikuwa na idadi kubwa ya watumishi. Alikuwa mtu mkuu sana miongoni mwa watu wa Mashariki.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

kikuyu: Wanawe walikuwa na desturi ya kufanya karamu katika nyumba zao kwa zamu, nao wangewaalika umbu zao watatu ili kula na kunywa pamoja nao.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

kikuyu: Wakati kipindi cha karamu kilimalizika, Ayubu angetuma waitwe na kuwafanyia utakaso. Angetoa dhabihu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa ajili ya kila mmoja wao asubuhi na mapema, akifikiri, “Pengine wanangu wametenda dhambi na kumlaani Mungu mioyoni mwao.” Hii ilikuwa ndiyo desturi ya kawaida ya Ayubu.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

kikuyu: Siku moja wana wa Mungu walikwenda kujionyesha mbele za Bwana. Shetani naye akaja pamoja nao.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Umetoka wapi?” Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Natoka kuzunguka pote duniani, nikitembea huku na huko humo.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Je, umemwangalia huyo mtumishi wangu Ayubu? Hakuna mtu mwingine duniani aliye kama yeye, asiye na hatia, ni mnyofu, mwenye kumcha Mungu, na kuepukana na uovu.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

kikuyu: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Je, Ayubu anamcha Mungu bure?
english: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

kikuyu: Je, wewe hukumjengea boma pande zote yeye na wa nyumbani mwake pamoja na kila kitu alicho nacho? Kazi za mikono yake umezibariki na hivyo makundi yake ya kondoo na mbuzi pamoja na ya wanyama yameenea katika nchi nzima.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

kikuyu: Lakini nyoosha mkono wako na kupiga kila kitu alicho nacho, naye kwa hakika atakulaani mbele za uso wako.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Vema sana, kwa hiyo, kila kitu alicho nacho kiko mikononi mwako, lakini juu ya huyo mtu mwenyewe usimguse hata kwa kidole.” Ndipo Shetani akatoka mbele za Bwana.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

kikuyu: Siku moja watoto wa Ayubu walipokuwa wakifanya karamu wakila na kunywa divai katika nyumba ya ndugu yao mkubwa,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: akaja mjumbe kwa Ayubu na kusema, “Maksai walikuwa wakilima na punda walikuwa wakilisha karibu nao,
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

kikuyu: Waseba wakawashambulia na kuchukua mifugo. Kisha wakawaua watumishi kwa upanga, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Moto wa Mungu ulishuka kutoka mbinguni na kuteketeza kondoo na watumishi, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wakaldayo waliunda vikosi vitatu vya uvamizi na kuwaangukia ngamia wako na kuwachukua wakaondoka nao. Wakawaua watumishi kwa upanga, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari.”
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Alipokuwa bado ananena, mjumbe mwingine akaja na kusema, “Wana wako na binti zako walipokuwa wakifanya karamu, wakila na kunywa divai katika nyumba ya ndugu yao mkubwa,
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: ghafula upepo wenye nguvu ukavuma kutoka jangwani, nao ukaipiga nyumba hiyo pembe zake nne. Ikawaangukia hao watoto nao wamekufa, nami ndimi peke yangu niliyenusurika kukuletea habari!”
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akasimama, akararua joho lake na kunyoa nywele zake. Kisha akaanguka chini katika kuabudu
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

kikuyu: na kusema: “Nilitoka tumboni mwa mama yangu uchi, nami nitaondoka uchi, Bwana alinipa, naye Bwana ameviondoa, jina la Bwana litukuzwe.”
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi kwa kumlaumu Mungu kwa kufanya ubaya.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

kikuyu: Siku nyingine wana wa Mungu walikuja kujionyesha mbele za Bwana. Shetani naye akaja pamoja nao kujionyesha mbele zake.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

kikuyu: Bwana akamuuliza Shetani, “Umetoka wapi?” Shetani akamjibu Bwana “Natoka kuzunguka pote duniani, nikitembea huku na huko humo.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Je, umemwangalia huyo mtumishi wangu Ayubu? Hakuna mtu mwingine duniani aliye kama yeye, mtu asiye na hatia, ni mnyofu, mwenye kumcha Mungu na kuepukana na uovu. Naye bado anadumisha uadilifu wake, ingawa ulinichochea dhidi yake, ili nimwangamize pasipo sababu.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

kikuyu: Shetani akamjibu Bwana, “Ngozi kwa ngozi! Mwanadamu atatoa vyote alivyo navyo kwa ajili ya uhai wake.
english: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

kikuyu: Lakini nyoosha mkono wako na kuipiga nyama yake na mifupa yake, naye kwa hakika atakulaani mbele za uso wako.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Shetani, “Vema sana, kwa hiyo, yeye yumo mikononi mwako, lakini lazima umwachie uhai wake.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

kikuyu: Basi Shetani akatoka mbele za Bwana naye akampiga Ayubu kwa majipu mabaya tangu nyayo za miguu yake hadi utosi wa kichwa.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akachukua kigae na kujikuna nacho huku akiketi kwenye majivu.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

kikuyu: Mke wake akamwambia, “Je, bado unashikamana na uadilifu wako? Mlaani Mungu nawe ukafe!”
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

kikuyu: Akamjibu, “Unazungumza kama vile ambavyo mwanamke mpumbavu yeyote angenena. Je, tupokee mema mikononi mwa Mungu, nasi tusipokee na udhia?” Katika mambo haya yote, Ayubu hakutenda dhambi katika kusema kwake.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

kikuyu: Basi marafiki watatu wa Ayubu, ndio Elifazi Mtemani, na Bildadi Mshuhi na Sofari Mnaamathi, waliposikia juu ya taabu yote iliyompata Ayubu, wakajipanga toka manyumbani mwao, nao wakakutana pamoja kwa makubaliano kwenda kumtuliza katika taabu hiyo na kumfariji.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

kikuyu: Walipomwona kwa mbali, ilikuwa vigumu kumtambua. Wakaanza kulia kwa sauti kubwa, wakayararua majoho yao na kujirushia mavumbi juu ya vichwa vyao.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

kikuyu: Kisha wakaketi chini kwenye udongo pamoja na Ayubu kwa siku saba usiku na mchana. Hakuna yeyote aliyesema naye neno, kwa sababu waliona jinsi mateso yake yalivyokuwa makubwa.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

kikuyu: Baada ya jambo hili, Ayubu akafumbua kinywa chake na kuilaani siku ya kuzaliwa kwake.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

kikuyu: Kisha akasema:
english: Job answered:

kikuyu: “Siku ya kuzaliwa kwangu na ipotelee mbali, nao usiku ule iliposemekana, ‘Mtoto wa kiume amezaliwa!’
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

kikuyu: Siku ile na iwe giza; Mungu juu na asiiangalie; nayo nuru isiiangazie.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

kikuyu: Giza na kivuli kikuu kiikalie tena; wingu na likae juu yake; weusi na uifunike nuru yake.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

kikuyu: Usiku ule na ushikwe na giza kuu; usihesabiwe katika siku za mwaka, wala usihesabiwe katika siku za mwezi wowote.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

kikuyu: Usiku ule na uwe tasa; sauti ya furaha na isisikike ndani yake.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

kikuyu: Wale wazilaanio siku wailaani hiyo siku, wale walio tayari kumwamsha Lewiathani.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

kikuyu: Nyota zake za alfajiri na ziwe giza; nao ungojee mwanga bila mafanikio, wala usiuone mwonzi wa kwanza wa mapambazuko,
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

kikuyu: kwa sababu huo usiku haukunifungia mlango wa tumbo la mama yangu, ili kuyaficha macho yangu kutokana na taabu.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

kikuyu: “Kwa nini sikuangamia wakati wa kuzaliwa? Kwa nini sikufa nilipokuwa ninatoka tumboni?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

kikuyu: Kwa nini pakawa na magoti ya kunipokea na matiti ili nipate kunyonyeshwa?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

kikuyu: Kwa maana sasa ningekuwa nimepumzika kwa amani. Ningekuwa nimelala na kupumzika
english: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

kikuyu: pamoja na wafalme na washauri wa dunia, waliojijengea mahali ambapo sasa ni magofu,
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

kikuyu: pamoja na watawala waliokuwa na dhahabu, waliozijaza nyumba zao kwa fedha.
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

kikuyu: Au kwa nini sikufichwa ardhini kama mtoto aliyezaliwa mfu, kama mtoto mchanga ambaye kamwe hakuuona mwanga?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

kikuyu: Huko waovu huacha kusumbua na huko waliochoka hupumzika.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

kikuyu: Wafungwa nao hufurahia utulivu wao, hawasikii tena sauti ya kukemea ya kiongozi wa watumwa.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

kikuyu: Wadogo na wakubwa wamo humo, na mtumwa ameachiwa huru kutoka kwa bwana wake.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

kikuyu: “Mbona nuru inawaangazia wale walio taabuni, na hao wenye uchungu kupewa uhai,
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

kikuyu: wale wanaotamani kifo ambacho hakiji, wale watafutao kufa zaidi ya kutafuta hazina iliyofichwa,
english: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

kikuyu: ambao hujawa na furaha, na hushangilia wafikapo kaburini?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

kikuyu: Kwa nini uhai hupewa mtu ambaye njia yake imefichika, ambaye Mungu amemzungushia boma?
english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

kikuyu: Kwa maana kulia kwangu kwa uchungu kwanijia badala ya chakula; kusononeka kwangu kunamwagika kama maji.
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

kikuyu: Lile nililokuwa naliogopa limenijia; lile nililokuwa ninalihofia limenipata.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

kikuyu: Sina amani, wala utulivu; sina pumziko, bali taabu tu.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: “Kama mtu akithubutu kuzungumza nawe, kutakukasirisha? Lakini ni nani awezaye kujizuia asiseme?
english: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

kikuyu: Fikiri jinsi ambavyo umewafundisha watu wengi, jinsi ambavyo umeitia nguvu mikono iliyokuwa dhaifu.
english: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

kikuyu: Maneno yako yamewategemeza wale waliojikwaa; umeyatia nguvu magoti yaliyokuwa dhaifu.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa hii taabu imekujia wewe, nawe unashuka moyo; imekupiga wewe, nawe unafadhaika.
english: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

kikuyu: Je, kumcha Mungu kwako hakupaswi kuwa ndiyo matumaini yako na njia zako kutokuwa na lawama ndilo taraja lako?
english: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

kikuyu: “Fikiri sasa: Ni mtu yupi asiye na hatia ambaye aliwahi kuangamia? Ni wapi wanyofu waliwahi kuangamizwa?
english: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

kikuyu: Kwa jinsi ambavyo mimi nimechunguza, wale walimao ubaya na wale hupanda uovu, huvuna hayo hayo hayo.
english: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

kikuyu: Kwa pumzi ya Mungu huangamizwa; kwa mshindo wa hasira zake huangamia.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

kikuyu: Simba anaweza kunguruma na kukoroma, lakini bado meno ya simba mkubwa huvunjika.
english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

kikuyu: Simba anaweza kuangamia kwa kukosa mawindo, nao wana wa simba jike hutawanyika.
english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: “Neno lililetwa kwangu kwa siri, masikio yangu yakasikia mnongʼono wake.
english: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

kikuyu: Katikati ya ndoto za kutia wasiwasi wakati wa usiku, hapo usingizi mzito uwapatapo wanadamu,
english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

kikuyu: hofu na kutetemeka kulinishika na kufanya mifupa yangu yote itetemeke.
english: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

kikuyu: Kuna roho aliyepita mbele ya uso wangu, nazo nywele za mwili wangu zikasimama.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

kikuyu: Yule roho akasimama, lakini sikuweza kutambua kilikuwa kitu gani. Umbo fulani lilisimama mbele ya macho yangu, kukawa na ukimya kisha nikasikia sauti:
english: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Je, binadamu aweza kuwa mwadilifu kuliko Mungu? Je, mtu aweza kuwa safi kuliko Muumba wake?
english: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

kikuyu: Kama Mungu hawaamini watumishi wake, kama yeye huwalaumu malaika zake kwa kukosea,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

kikuyu: ni mara ngapi zaidi wale waishio katika nyumba za udongo wa mfinyanzi, ambazo misingi yake ipo mavumbini, ambao wamepondwa kama nondo!
english: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

kikuyu: Kati ya mawio na machweo huvunjwa vipande vipande; bila yeyote kutambua, huangamia milele.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

kikuyu: Je, kamba za hema yao hazikungʼolewa, hivyo hufa bila hekima?’
english: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

kikuyu: “Ita kama unataka, lakini ni nani atakayekujibu? Ni yupi kati ya hao watakatifu utakayemgeukia?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

kikuyu: Kuweka uchungu moyoni humuua mpumbavu, nao wivu humchinja mjinga.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

kikuyu: Mimi mwenyewe nimemwona mpumbavu akistawi, lakini ghafula nyumba yake ikawa imelaaniwa.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

kikuyu: Watoto wake wako mbali na usalama, hushindwa mahakamani bila mtetezi.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

kikuyu: Wenye njaa huyala mavuno yake, wakiyatoa hata katikati ya miiba, nao wenye kiu huitamani sana mali yake.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

kikuyu: Kwa maana taabu haioti kutoka kwenye udongo, wala udhia hauchipui kutoka ardhini.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

kikuyu: Lakini mwanadamu huzaliwa ili kutaabika, kwa hakika kama cheche za moto zirukavyo kuelekea juu.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

kikuyu: “Lakini ingekuwa ni mimi, ningemlalamikia Mungu, ningeliweka shauri langu mbele zake.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

kikuyu: Yeye hutenda maajabu yasiyoweza kutambuliwa, miujiza isiyoweza kuhesabika.
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

kikuyu: Yeye huipa nchi mvua, huyapeleka maji kunyesha mashamba.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

kikuyu: Huwainua juu wanyonge, nao wale waombolezao huinuliwa wakawa salama.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

kikuyu: Huipinga mipango ya wenye hila, ili mikono yao isifikie ufanisi.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

kikuyu: Yeye huwanasa wenye hekima katika hila yao, nayo mipango ya wadanganyifu huifagilia mbali.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

kikuyu: Giza huwapata wakati wa mchana; wakati wa adhuhuri hupapasa kama vile usiku.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

kikuyu: Humwokoa mhitaji kutokana na upanga ulioko kinywani mwao; huwaokoa kutokana na makucha ya wenye nguvu.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo maskini analo tarajio, nao udhalimu hufumba kinywa chake.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

kikuyu: “Heri mtu yule ambaye Mungu humrudi; kwa hiyo usidharau adhabu yake Mwenyezi.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hutia jeraha, lakini pia huyafunga; huumiza, lakini mikono yake pia huponya.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

kikuyu: Kutoka majanga sita atakuokoa; naam, hata katika saba hakuna dhara litakalokupata wewe.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

kikuyu: Wakati wa njaa atakukomboa wewe na kifo, naye katika vita atakukomboa na pigo la upanga.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

kikuyu: Utalindwa kutokana na kichapo cha ulimi, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuogopa maangamizi yatakapokujia.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

kikuyu: Utayacheka maangamizo na njaa, wala hutakuwa na sababu ya kuwaogopa wanyama wakali wa mwituni.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa utakuwa na agano na mawe ya mashamba, nao wanyama wa mwitu watakuwa na amani nawe.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

kikuyu: Utajua ya kwamba hema lako li salama; utahesabu mali zako wala hutakuta chochote kilichopungua.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

kikuyu: Utajua ya kuwa watoto wako watakuwa wengi, nao wazao wako wengi kama majani ya nchi.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

kikuyu: Utaingia kaburini ukiwa na umri wa uzee mtimilifu, kama masuke ya ngano yakusanywapo kwa wakati wake.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

kikuyu: “Tumelichunguza hili, nalo ni kweli. Hivyo lisikie na ulitendee kazi.”
english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

kikuyu: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Laiti uchungu wangu ungeweza kupimwa, nayo taabu yangu yote ingewekwa kwenye mizani!
english: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hakika ingekuwa nzito kuliko mchanga wa bahari zote, kwa hiyo si ajabu maneno yangu yamekuwa ya haraka.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

kikuyu: Mishale ya Mwenyezi iko ndani yangu, roho yangu inakunywa sumu yake; vitisho vya Mungu vimejipanga dhidi yangu.
english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

kikuyu: Je, punda-mwitu hulia akiwa na majani, au ngʼombe dume hulia akiwa na chakula?
english: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

kikuyu: Je, chakula kisicho na ladha huliwa bila chumvi, au upo utamu katika ute mweupe wa yai?
english: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

kikuyu: Ninakataa kuvigusa; vyakula vya aina hii hunichukiza.
english: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

kikuyu: “Laiti ningepata haja yangu, kwamba Mungu angenijalia hilo nililotarajia,
english: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

kikuyu: kwamba Mungu angekuwa radhi kuniponda, kuuachia mkono wake na kunikatilia mbali!
english: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

kikuyu: Ndipo bado ningekuwa na hii faraja, furaha yangu katika maumivu makali: kwamba sikuwa nimeyakana maneno yake yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.
english: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

kikuyu: “Ninazo nguvu gani, hata niendelee kutumaini? Matazamio yangu ya mbele ni nini, hata niendelee kuwa mvumilivu?
english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

kikuyu: Je, mimi nina nguvu za jiwe? Je, mwili wangu ni shaba?
english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

kikuyu: Je, ninao uwezo wowote wa kujisaidia mimi mwenyewe, wakati ambapo mafanikio yamefukuziwa mbali nami?
english: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

kikuyu: “Mtu anayekata tamaa angetazamia moyo wa kujitoa wa rafiki zake, hata kama akiacha uchaji wa Mwenyezi.
english: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Lakini ndugu zangu sio wa kutegemewa, ni kama vijito vya msimu, ni kama vijito ambavyo hufurika
english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

kikuyu: wakati vimefunikwa barafu iyeyukayo, ambavyo hujazwa na theluji inayoyeyuka,
english: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

kikuyu: lakini hukauka majira ya ukame, na wakati wa hari hutoweka katika mikondo yake.
english: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

kikuyu: Misafara hugeuka kutoka njia zake; hukwea kwenda kwenye nchi ya ukiwa na kuangamia.
english: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

kikuyu: Misafara ya Tema inatafuta maji, wafanyabiashara wa Sheba wanaosafiri hutazama kwa matarajio.
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

kikuyu: Wamedhikika, kwa sababu walikuwa na matumaini; wanafika huko, lakini wanahuzunika kwa kukosa walichotarajia.
english: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

kikuyu: Sasa nanyi mmethibitika kwamba hamna msaada wowote; mnaona jambo la kutisha, nanyi mnaogopa.
english: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

kikuyu: Je, nimewahi kusema, ‘Toeni kitu kwa ajili yangu, au mnilipie fidia kutoka mali zenu,
english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

kikuyu: au niokoeni mikononi mwa adui, au nikomboeni kutoka makucha ya wasio na huruma’?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

kikuyu: “Nifundisheni, nami nitanyamaza kimya; nionyesheni nilikokosea.
english: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

kikuyu: Tazama yalivyo ya kuumiza maneno ya kweli! Lakini mabishano yenu yanathibitisha nini?
english: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

kikuyu: Je, mna maana ya kuyasahihisha ninayosema, na kuyafanya maneno ya mtu anayekata tamaa kama upepo?
english: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

kikuyu: Mngeweza hata kupiga kura kwa ajili ya yatima, na kubadilishana rafiki yenu na mali.
english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

kikuyu: “Lakini sasa kuweni na huruma mkaniangalie mimi. Je, ningeweza kusema uongo mbele zenu?
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

kikuyu: Tulizeni hasira, msiwe wadhalimu; angalieni tena, kwa maana nimehatarisha uadilifu wangu.
english: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

kikuyu: Je, pana uovu wowote midomoni mwangu? Je, kinywa changu hakiwezi kupambanua hila?
english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

kikuyu: “Je, mwanadamu hana kazi ngumu duniani? Siku zake si kama zile za mtu aliyeajiriwa?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

kikuyu: Kama mtumwa anavyovionea shauku vivuli vya jioni, au mtu aliyeajiriwa anavyoungojea mshahara wake,
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

kikuyu: ndivyo nilivyogawiwa miezi ya ubatili, nami nimeandikiwa huzuni usiku hata usiku.
english: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

kikuyu: Wakati nilalapo ninawaza, ‘Itachukua muda gani kabla sijaamka?’ Usiku huwa mrefu, nami najigeuzageuza hadi mapambazuko.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

kikuyu: Mwili wangu umevikwa mabuu na uchafu, ngozi yangu imetumbuka na kutunga usaha.
english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

kikuyu: “Siku zangu zinapita upesi kuliko mtande wa kufuma, nazo zinafikia mwisho wake bila matumaini.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

kikuyu: Kumbuka, Ee Mungu, maisha yangu ni kama pumzi; macho yangu kamwe hayataona tena raha.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

kikuyu: Lile jicho linaloniona sasa halitaniona tena; utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

kikuyu: Kama vile wingu liondokavyo na kutoweka, vivyo hivyo yeye ashukaye kaburini harudi tena.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

kikuyu: Kamwe harudi tena nyumbani mwake; wala mahali pake hapatamjua tena.
english: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

kikuyu: “Kwa hiyo sitanyamaza; nitanena kutokana na maumivu makuu ya roho yangu, nitalalama kwa uchungu wa nafsi yangu.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Je, mimi ni bahari, au mnyama mkubwa mno akaaye vilindini, hata uniweke chini ya ulinzi?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

kikuyu: Ninapofikiri kwamba kitanda changu kitanifariji, nacho kiti changu cha fahari kitapunguza malalamiko yangu,
english: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

kikuyu: ndipo wanitisha kwa ndoto na kunitia hofu kwa maono,
english: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

kikuyu: hivyo ninachagua kujinyonga na kufa, kuliko huu mwili wangu.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

kikuyu: Ninayachukia maisha yangu; nisingetamani kuendelea kuishi. Niache; siku zangu ni ubatili.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

kikuyu: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata umjali kiasi hiki, kwamba unamtia sana maanani,
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

kikuyu: kwamba unamwangalia kila asubuhi na kumjaribu kila wakati?
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

kikuyu: Je, hutaacha kamwe kunitazama, au kuniacha japo kwa kitambo kidogo tu?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

kikuyu: Ikiwa nimetenda dhambi, nimekufanyia nini, Ewe mlinzi wa wanadamu? Kwa nini umeniweka niwe shabaha yako? Je, nimekuwa mzigo kwako?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

kikuyu: Kwa nini husamehi makosa yangu na kuachilia dhambi zangu? Kwa kuwa hivi karibuni nitalala mavumbini; nawe utanitafuta, wala sitakuwepo.”
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

kikuyu: Kisha Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: “Hata lini wewe utasema mambo kama haya? Maneno yako ni kama upepo mkuu.
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

kikuyu: Je, Mungu hupotosha hukumu? Je, Mwenyezi hupotosha kile kilicho haki?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

kikuyu: Watoto wako walipomtenda dhambi, aliwapa adhabu ya dhambi yao.
english: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

kikuyu: Lakini ukimtafuta Mungu, nawe ukamsihi Mwenyezi,
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

kikuyu: ikiwa wewe ni safi na mnyofu, hata sasa atainuka mwenyewe kwa niaba yako, na kukurudisha katika mahali pako pa haki.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

kikuyu: Ijapokuwa mwanzo wako ulikuwa mdogo, lakini mwisho wako utakuwa wa mafanikio.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

kikuyu: “Ukaulize vizazi vilivyotangulia na uone baba zao walijifunza nini,
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa sisi tumezaliwa jana tu na hatujui lolote, nazo siku zetu duniani ni kama kivuli tu.
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

kikuyu: Je, hawatakufundisha na kukueleza? Je, hawataleta maneno kutoka kwenye kufahamu kwao?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

kikuyu: Je, mafunjo yaweza kumea mahali pasipo na matope? Matete yaweza kustawi bila maji?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

kikuyu: Wakati bado yanaendelea kukua kabla ya kukatwa, hunyauka haraka kuliko majani mengine.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

kikuyu: Huu ndio mwisho wa watu wote wanaomsahau Mungu; vivyo hivyo matumaini ya wasiomjali Mungu huangamia.
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

kikuyu: Lile analolitumainia huvunjika upesi; lile analolitegemea ni utando wa buibui.
english: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

kikuyu: Huutegemea utando wake, lakini hausimami; huungʼangʼania, lakini haudumu.
english: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

kikuyu: Yeye ni kama mti ulionyeshewa vizuri wakati wa jua, ukieneza machipukizi yake bustanini;
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

kikuyu: huifunganisha mizizi yake kwenye lundo la mawe, na kutafuta nafasi katikati ya mawe.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

kikuyu: Unapongʼolewa kutoka mahali pake, ndipo mahali pale huukana na kusema, ‘Mimi kamwe sikukuona.’
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

kikuyu: Hakika uhai wake hunyauka, na kutoka udongoni mimea mingine huota.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

kikuyu: “Hakika Mungu hamkatai mtu asiye na hatia, wala kuitia nguvu mikono ya mtenda mabaya.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

kikuyu: Bado atakijaza kinywa chako na kicheko, na midomo yako na kelele za shangwe.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

kikuyu: Adui zako watavikwa aibu, nazo hema za waovu hazitakuwepo tena.”
english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

kikuyu: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Naam, najua hili ni kweli. Lakini mwanadamu awezaje kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

kikuyu: Ingawa mtu angetaka kushindana naye, asingaliweza kumjibu Mungu hata mara moja miongoni mwa elfu moja.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

kikuyu: Hekima yake ni kubwa sana na ana uwezo mwingi mno. Ni nani aliyempinga naye akawa salama?
english: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

kikuyu: Aiondoa milima bila yenyewe kujua na kuipindua kwa hasira yake.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

kikuyu: Aitikisa dunia kutoka mahali pake na kuzifanya nguzo zake zitetemeke.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

kikuyu: Husema na jua, nalo likaacha kuangaza; naye huizima mianga ya nyota.
english: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

kikuyu: Yeye peke yake huzitandaza mbingu na kuyakanyaga mawimbi ya bahari.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

kikuyu: Yeye ndiye Muumba wa nyota za Dubu, na Orioni, Kilimia, na makundi ya nyota za kusini.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

kikuyu: Hutenda maajabu yasiyopimika, miujiza isiyoweza kuhesabiwa.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

kikuyu: Anapopita karibu nami, siwezi kumwona; apitapo mbele yangu, simtambui.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

kikuyu: Anapochukua kwa ghafula, ni nani awezaye kumzuia? Ni nani awezaye kumwambia, ‘Unafanya nini?’
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

kikuyu: Mungu hataizuia hasira yake; hata jeshi kubwa la Rahabu lenye nguvu linajikunyata miguuni pake.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

kikuyu: “Ni vipi basi mimi nitaweza kubishana naye? Nawezaje kupata maneno ya kuhojiana naye?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

kikuyu: Ingawa sikuwa na hatia, sikuweza kumjibu; ningeweza tu kumsihi Mhukumu wangu anihurumie.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

kikuyu: Hata kama ningemwita kwenye shauri, naye akakubali, siamini kama angenisikiliza.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

kikuyu: Yeye angeniangamiza kwa dhoruba na kuongeza majeraha yangu pasipo na sababu.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

kikuyu: Asingeniacha nipumue bali angenifunika kabisa na huzuni kuu.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

kikuyu: Kama ni suala la nguvu, yeye ni mwenye nguvu! Kama ni suala la haki, ni nani awezaye kumwita mahakamani?
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

kikuyu: Hata kama sikuwa na hatia, kinywa changu kingenihukumu; kama sikuwa na kosa, kingenitangaza kuwa mwenye hatia.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

kikuyu: “Ingawa mimi sina kosa, haileti tofauti katika nafsi yangu; nauchukia uhai wangu.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

kikuyu: Hayo yote ni sawa; ndiyo sababu nasema, ‘Yeye huwaangamiza wasio na makosa pamoja na waovu.’
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

kikuyu: Wakati pigo liletapo kifo cha ghafula, yeye hudhihaki kule kukata tamaa kwa yule asiye na kosa.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

kikuyu: Wakati nchi inapoangukia mikononi mwa waovu, yeye huwafunga macho mahakimu wake. Kama si yeye, basi ni nani?
english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

kikuyu: “Siku zangu zapita mbio kuliko mkimbiaji; zinapita upesi bila kuona furaha hata kidogo.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

kikuyu: Zinapita upesi kama mashua ya mafunjo, mfano wa tai ayashukiaye mawindo kwa ghafula.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

kikuyu: Kama nikisema, ‘Nitayasahau malalamiko yangu, nitabadili sura ya uso wangu na kutabasamu,’
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

kikuyu: bado ninahofia mateso yangu yote, kwa kuwa ninajua hutanihesabu kuwa sina hatia.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa nimeonekana mwenye hatia, kwa nini basi nitaabishwe bure?
english: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

kikuyu: Hata kama ningejiosha kwa sabuni na kutakasa mikono yangu kwa magadi,
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

kikuyu: wewe ungenitupa kwenye shimo la utelezi kiasi kwamba hata nguo zangu zingenichukia sana.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

kikuyu: “Yeye si mwanadamu kama mimi ili niweze kumjibu, ili kwamba tuweze kushindana naye mahakamani.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

kikuyu: Laiti angelikuwepo mtu wa kutupatanisha kati yetu, aweke mkono wake juu yetu sote wawili,
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

kikuyu: mtu angeliiondoa fimbo ya Mungu juu yangu, ili utisho wake usiendelee kunitia hofu.
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

kikuyu: Ndipo ningenena naye, bila kumwogopa, lakini kama ilivyo kwangu sasa, sitaweza.
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

kikuyu: “Nayachukia sana haya maisha yangu; kwa hiyo nitatoa malalamiko yangu kwa wazi bila kujizuia, nami nitanena kutokana na uchungu wa moyo wangu.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Nitamwambia Mungu: Usinihukumu, bali niambie una mashtaka gani dhidi yangu.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

kikuyu: Je, inakupendeza wewe kunionea, kuikataa kwa dharau kazi ya mikono yako, huku wewe ukitabasamu juu ya mipango ya waovu?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

kikuyu: Je, wewe una macho ya kimwili? Je, wewe huona kama mwanadamu aonavyo?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

kikuyu: Je, siku zako ni kama zile za mwanadamu, au miaka yako ni kama ile ya mtu,
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

kikuyu: ili kwamba utafute makosa yangu na kuichunguza dhambi yangu;
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

kikuyu: ingawa wajua kuwa mimi sina hatia, na hakuna awezaye kunitoa mkononi mwako?
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

kikuyu: “Mikono yako ndiyo iliyoniumba na kunifanya. Je, sasa utageuka na kuniangamiza?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

kikuyu: Kumbuka kuwa ulinifinyanga kama udongo wa mfinyanzi. Je, sasa utanifanya kuwa mavumbi tena?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

kikuyu: Je, wewe hukunimimina mimi kama maziwa, na kunigandisha kama jibini,
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

kikuyu: ukanivika ngozi na nyama, na kuniunga pamoja kwa mifupa na mishipa?
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

kikuyu: Umenipa uhai na kunitendea wema, katika uangalizi wako umeilinda roho yangu.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

kikuyu: “Lakini hili ndilo ulilolificha moyoni mwako, nami ninajua kuwa hili lilikuwa katika nia yako:
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

kikuyu: Kama nilifanya dhambi, ungekuwa umeniona, wala usingeacha kosa langu lipite bila kuadhibiwa.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Kama nina hatia, ole wangu! Hata kama ningekuwa sina hatia, siwezi kukiinua kichwa changu, kwa kuwa nimejawa na aibu, na kuzama katika mateso yangu.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

kikuyu: Kama nikiinua kichwa changu juu, unaninyatia kama simba, na kuonyesha tena uwezo wa kutisha dhidi yangu.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

kikuyu: Wewe waleta mashahidi wapya dhidi yangu na kuzidisha hasira yako juu yangu; nazo nguvu zako zinanijia wimbi moja baada ya jingine.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

kikuyu: “Kwa nini basi ulinitoa tumboni? Ninatamani ningekufa kabla jicho lolote halijaniona.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

kikuyu: Laiti nisingekuwako kamwe, au ningekuwa nimechukuliwa moja kwa moja kutoka tumboni kwenda kaburini!
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

kikuyu: Je, siku zangu chache si zimekaribia kuisha? Niachie ili niweze kupata muda mfupi wa kufurahi
english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

kikuyu: kabla sijaenda mahali ambapo hakuna kurudi tena, katika nchi ya giza na uvuli wa mauti,
english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

kikuyu: nchi ya giza kuu sana, yenye uvuli wa giza na machafuko, mahali ambapo hata nuru ni giza.”
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

kikuyu: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

kikuyu: “Je, maneno haya yote yapite bila kujibiwa? Je, huyu mnenaji athibitishwe kuwa na haki?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

kikuyu: Je, maneno yako ya upuzi yawafanye watu wanyamaze kimya? Je, mtu asikukemee unapofanya dhihaka?
english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

kikuyu: Unamwambia Mungu, ‘Imani yangu ni kamili nami ni safi mbele zako.’
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

kikuyu: Aha! Laiti kwamba Mungu angesema, kwamba angefungua midomo yake dhidi yako,
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

kikuyu: naye akufunulie siri za hekima, kwa kuwa hekima ya kweli ina pande mbili. Ujue hili: Mungu amesahau hata baadhi ya dhambi zako.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

kikuyu: “Je, waweza kujua siri za Mungu? Je, waweza kuyachunguza mambo yote kumhusu Mwenyezi?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

kikuyu: Ni juu mno kuliko mbingu: waweza kufanya nini? Kina chake ni kirefu kuliko kuzimu: wewe waweza kujua nini?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

kikuyu: Kipimo chake ni kirefu kuliko dunia, nacho ni kipana kuliko bahari.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

kikuyu: “Kama akija na kukufunga gerezani, na kuitisha mahakama, ni nani awezaye kumpinga?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

kikuyu: Hakika anawatambua watu wadanganyifu; naye aonapo uovu, je, haangalii?
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu aweza kuwa mwenye hekima, endapo mtoto wa punda-mwitu atazaliwa mwanadamu.
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

kikuyu: “Hata sasa ukiutoa moyo wako kwake na kumwinulia mikono yako,
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

kikuyu: ukiiondolea mbali ile dhambi iliyo mkononi mwako wala usiuruhusu uovu ukae hemani mwako,
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

kikuyu: ndipo utainua uso wako bila aibu; utasimama imara bila hofu.
english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

kikuyu: Hakika utaisahau taabu yako, utaikumbuka tu kama maji yaliyokwisha kupita.
english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

kikuyu: Maisha yako yatangʼaa kuliko adhuhuri, nalo giza litakuwa kama alfajiri.
english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

kikuyu: Utakuwa salama, kwa kuwa lipo tumaini; utatazama pande zote na kupumzika kwa salama.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

kikuyu: Utalala, wala hakuna atakayekuogofya, naam, wengi watajipendekeza kwako.
english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

kikuyu: Bali macho ya waovu hayataona, wokovu utawaepuka; tarajio lao litakuwa ni hangaiko la mtu anayekata roho.”
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Bila shaka ninyi ndio watu, nayo hekima itakoma mtakapokufa!
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi ninao ufahamu kama ninyi; mimi si duni kwenu. Ni nani asiyejua mambo haya yote?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

kikuyu: “Nimekuwa mtu wa kuchekwa na rafiki zangu, ingawa nilimwita Mungu naye akanijibu: mimi ni mtu wa kuchekwa tu, ingawa ni mwadilifu na nisiye na hatia!
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

kikuyu: Wanadamu wakiwa katika utulivu huwa na dharau kwa wale wenye msiba kana kwamba ndiyo haki ya wale ambao miguu yao inateleza.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

kikuyu: Hema za wanyangʼanyi hazisumbuliwi, wale wanaomghadhibisha Mungu wako salama: wale wamchukuao mungu wao mikononi mwao.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

kikuyu: “Lakini ulizeni wanyama, nao watawafundisha, au ndege wa angani, nao watawaambia;
english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

kikuyu: au zungumzeni na dunia, nayo itawafundisha, au acheni samaki wa baharini wawape taarifa.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

kikuyu: Ni nani miongoni mwa hawa wote asiyejua kwamba mkono wa Bwana ndio uliofanya hili?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

kikuyu: Mkononi mwake kuna uhai wa kila kiumbe, na pumzi ya wanadamu wote.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

kikuyu: Je, sikio haliyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

kikuyu: Je, hekima haipatikani katikati ya wazee? Je, maisha marefu hayaleti ufahamu?
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

kikuyu: “Hekima na nguvu ni vya Mungu; shauri na ufahamu ni vyake yeye.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

kikuyu: Kile anachokibomoa hakiwezi kujengeka tena; mtu aliyefungiwa naye hawezi kufunguliwa.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

kikuyu: Akizuia maji, huwa pana ukame; akiyaachia maji, huharibu nchi.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

kikuyu: Kwake kuna nguvu na ushindi; adanganywaye na adanganyaye, wote wawili ni wake.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

kikuyu: Yeye huwaondoa washauri wakiwa wametekwa nyara, naye huwapumbaza wanaotoa maamuzi.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

kikuyu: Huondoa pingu zilizofungwa na wafalme, na kuwafunga mishipi ya kiunoni.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

kikuyu: Huwaondoa makuhani wakiwa wametekwa nyara, na kuwaangusha waliojiimarisha muda mrefu.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

kikuyu: Hunyamazisha midomo ya washauri wanaoaminika, na kuondoa busara ya wazee.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

kikuyu: Huwamwagia dharau wanaoheshimika, na kuwavua silaha wenye nguvu.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

kikuyu: Hufunua mambo ya ndani ya gizani, na kuyaleta nuruni yale yaliyositirika sana.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Huyafanya mataifa yatukuke na kuyaangamiza; hufanya mataifa kuwa makubwa, naye huyatawanya.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

kikuyu: Huwaondolea viongozi wa nchi akili zao; huwapeleka watangetange nyikani pasipo na njia.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

kikuyu: Hupapasa gizani pasipokuwa na mwanga; huwafanya wapepesuke kama walevi.
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

kikuyu: “Macho yangu yameona hili lote, masikio yangu yamesikia na kulielewa.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

kikuyu: Hayo mnayoyajua mimi pia ninayajua; mimi si mtu duni kuliko ninyi.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

kikuyu: Lakini ninayo shauku ya kuzungumza na Mwenyezi na kuhojiana shauri langu na Mungu.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

kikuyu: Ninyi, hata hivyo, hunipakaza uongo; ninyi ni matabibu wasiofaa kitu, ninyi nyote!
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

kikuyu: Laiti wote mngenyamaza kimya! Kwa kuwa kwenu hilo lingekuwa hekima.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

kikuyu: Sikieni sasa hoja yangu; sikilizeni kusihi kwangu.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

kikuyu: Je, mtazungumza kwa uovu kwa niaba ya Mungu? Je, mtazungumza kwa udanganyifu kwa niaba yake?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

kikuyu: Mtamwonyesha upendeleo? Mtamtetea Mungu kwenye mashtaka yake?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

kikuyu: Je, ingekuwa vyema Mungu akiwahoji ninyi? Je, mngeweza kumdanganya kama ambavyo mngeweza kuwadanganya wanadamu?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

kikuyu: Hakika angewakemea kama mkiwapendelea watu kwa siri.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

kikuyu: Je, huo ukuu wake haungewatisha ninyi? Je, hofu yake isingewaangukia ninyi?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

kikuyu: Maneno yenu ni mithali za majivu; utetezi wenu ni ngome za udongo wa mfinyanzi.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

kikuyu: “Nyamazeni kimya nipate kusema; kisha na yanipate yatakayonipata.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

kikuyu: Kwa nini nijiweke mwenyewe kwenye hatari na kuyaweka maisha yangu mikononi mwangu?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

kikuyu: Ingawa ataniua, bado nitamtumaini; hakika nitazitetea njia zangu mbele zake.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

kikuyu: Naam, hili litanigeukia kuwa wokovu wangu, kwa maana hakuna mtu asiyemcha Mungu atakayethubutu kuja mbele yake!
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

kikuyu: Sikilizeni maneno yangu kwa makini; nayo masikio yenu yaingize kile nisemacho.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

kikuyu: Sasa kwamba nimekwisha kutayarisha mambo yangu, ninajua mimi nitahesabiwa kuwa na haki.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

kikuyu: Je, kuna yeyote anayeweza kuleta mashtaka dhidi yangu? Kama ndivyo, nitanyamaza kimya na nife.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

kikuyu: “Ee Mungu, unijalie tu mimi haya mambo mawili, nami sitajificha uso wako:
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

kikuyu: Ondoa mkono wako uwe mbali nami, nawe uache kuniogofya kwa hofu zako kuu.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

kikuyu: Niite kwenye shauri nami nitajibu, au niache niseme, nawe upate kujibu.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

kikuyu: Ni makosa na dhambi ngapi nilizotenda? Nionyeshe kosa langu na dhambi yangu.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

kikuyu: Kwa nini kuuficha uso wako na kunihesabu mimi kuwa adui yako?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

kikuyu: Je, utaliadhibu jani lipeperushwalo na upepo? Je, utayasaka makapi makavu?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa unaandika mambo machungu dhidi yangu na kunifanya nizirithi dhambi za ujana wangu.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

kikuyu: Umeifunga miguu yangu kwenye pingu. Unazichunga kwa makini njia zangu zote kwa kutia alama kwenye nyayo za miguu yangu.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

kikuyu: “Hivyo mwanadamu huangamia kama kitu kilichooza, kama vazi lililoliwa na nondo.
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

kikuyu: “Mwanadamu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke siku zake ni chache nazo zimejaa taabu.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

kikuyu: Huchanua kama ua kisha hunyauka; huwa kama kivuli kipitacho upesi, wala hadumu.
english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

kikuyu: Je, unamwekea jicho lako mtu kama huyo? Je, utamleta mbele yako katika hukumu?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

kikuyu: Ni nani awezaye kutoa kitu safi kutoka kitu najisi? Hakuna awezaye!
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

kikuyu: Siku za mwanadamu zimewekewa mpaka; umekwisha kutangaza idadi ya miezi yake na kuweka mpaka ambao hawezi kuuvuka.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

kikuyu: Hivyo angalia mbali umwache, hadi awe amekamilisha muda wake kama mtu aliyeajiriwa.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

kikuyu: “Kwa maana lipo tumaini kwa mti; kama ukikatwa utachipuka tena, nayo machipukizi yake mapya hayatakoma.
english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

kikuyu: Mizizi yake yaweza kuchakaa ardhini na kisiki chake kufa udongoni,
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

kikuyu: lakini kwa kupata dalili ya maji utachipua na kutoa machipukizi kama mche.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

kikuyu: Lakini mwanadamu hufa, na huo ndio mwisho wake; hutoa pumzi ya mwisho, naye hayuko tena!
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

kikuyu: Kama vile maji yatowekavyo katika bahari, au mkondo wa mto ukaushwavyo na kuwa mkavu,
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

kikuyu: ndivyo mwanadamu alalavyo chini asiamke; hadi mbingu zitakapokuwa hazipo tena, wanadamu hawataamka au kuamshwa kutoka kwenye usingizi wao.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

kikuyu: “Laiti kama ungenificha kaburini, na kunisitiri hadi hasira yako ipite! Laiti ungeniwekea wakati, na kisha ukanikumbuka!
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

kikuyu: Je, kama mtu akifa, aweza kuishi tena? Siku zote za kazi zangu ngumu nitangojea kufanywa upya kwangu.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

kikuyu: Utaniita nami nitakuitika; utakionea shauku kiumbe ambacho mikono yako ilikiumba.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Hakika ndipo utakapozihesabu hatua zangu, lakini hutazifuatia dhambi zangu.
english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

kikuyu: Makosa yangu yatafungiwa kwa lakiri kwenye mfuko, nawe utazifunika dhambi zangu.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

kikuyu: “Lakini kama mlima umomonyokavyo na kufikichika na kama vile mwamba uondolewavyo mahali pake,
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

kikuyu: kama maji yamalizavyo mawe, na mafuriko yachukuavyo udongo, ndivyo unavyoharibu tegemeo la mwanadamu.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

kikuyu: Humshinda mara moja kwa daima, naye hutoweka; waibadilisha sura yake na kumwondoa.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

kikuyu: Kama wanawe wakipewa heshima, yeye hafahamu; kama wakidharauliwa, yeye haoni.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

kikuyu: Yeye hasikii kingine isipokuwa maumivu ya mwili wake mwenyewe, naye huomboleza kwa ajili yake mwenyewe.”
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

kikuyu: Kisha Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: “Je, mtu mwenye hekima hujibu kwa mawazo matupu, au kujaza tumbo lake kwa upepo wenye joto wa mashariki?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

kikuyu: Je, aweza kubishana juu ya maneno yasiyofaa, kwa hotuba zisizo na maana?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

kikuyu: Lakini unadhoofisha hata uchaji wa Mungu na kuzuia ibada mbele za Mungu.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

kikuyu: Dhambi yako inasukuma kinywa chako, nawe umechagua ulimi wa hila.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

kikuyu: Kinywa chako mwenyewe kinakuhukumu, wala si changu; midomo yako mwenyewe inashuhudia dhidi yako.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

kikuyu: “Je, wewe ni mtu wa kwanza kuzaliwa? Ulizaliwa kabla ya vilima?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

kikuyu: Je, wewe husikiliza mashauri ya siri ya Mungu? Je, wewe unaizuia hekima iwe yako mwenyewe?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

kikuyu: Wewe unajua kitu gani tusichokijua sisi? Unafahamu kitu gani tusichokifahamu sisi?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

kikuyu: Wale wenye mvi na wazee wako upande wetu, watu ambao ni wazee hata kuliko baba yako.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

kikuyu: Je, faraja za Mungu hazikutoshi, au maneno yaliyosemwa kwako kwa upole si kitu?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

kikuyu: Kwa nini moyo wako unakudanganya, na kwa nini macho yako yanangʼaa,
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

kikuyu: ili kwamba upate kutoa hasira yako dhidi ya Mungu, na kumwaga maneno kama hayo kutoka kinywani mwako?
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

kikuyu: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani, hata aweze kuwa safi, au yeye aliyezaliwa na mwanamke, hata aweze kuwa mwadilifu?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

kikuyu: Kama Mungu hawaamini watakatifu wake, kama hata mbingu zenyewe si safi machoni pake,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

kikuyu: sembuse mwanadamu ambaye ni mwovu na mpotovu, ambaye hunywa uovu kama anywavyo maji!
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

kikuyu: “Nisikilize mimi nami nitakueleza, acha nikuambie yale niliyoyaona,
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

kikuyu: ambayo watu wenye hekima wameyanena, bila kuficha lolote walilopokea toka kwa baba zao
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

kikuyu: (wakati ambao wao peke yao ndio walipewa nchi, hakuna mgeni aliyepita miongoni mwao):
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu siku zake zote hupata mateso, miaka yote aliwekewa mkorofi.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

kikuyu: Sauti za kutisha hujaa masikioni mwake; katika kufanikiwa kwake, wanyangʼanyi humshambulia.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

kikuyu: Hukata tamaa kuokoka gizani; amewekwa kwa ajili ya upanga.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

kikuyu: Hutangatanga, akitafuta chakula; anajua kwamba siku ya giza iko karibu.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

kikuyu: Taabu na maumivu makuu vinamtia hofu; humshinda kama mfalme aliye tayari kwa vita,
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

kikuyu: kwa sababu amemkunjia Mungu ngumi yake na kujigamba dhidi ya Mwenyezi,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

kikuyu: kwa kiburi akishambulia dhidi ya Mungu akiwa na ngao nene, iliyo imara.
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

kikuyu: “Ingawa uso wake umefunikwa na mafuta kwa unene na kiuno chake kimevimba kwa kunenepa,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

kikuyu: ataishi katika miji ya magofu, na katika nyumba ambazo haziishi mwanadamu yeyote, nyumba zinazokuwa vifusi.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

kikuyu: Hatatajirika tena, nao utajiri wake hautadumu, wala mali zake hazitakuwa nyingi juu ya nchi.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

kikuyu: Hatatoka gizani; mwali wa moto utanyausha machipukizi yake, nayo pumzi ya kinywa cha Mungu itamwondolea mbali.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

kikuyu: Asijidanganye mwenyewe kutumainia ubatili, kwa kuwa hatapata malipo yoyote.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

kikuyu: Atakuwa amelipwa kikamilifu kabla ya wakati wake, nayo matawi yake hayatastawi.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

kikuyu: Atafanana na mzabibu uliopukutishwa matunda yake kabla hayajaiva, kama mzeituni unaodondosha maua yake.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa jamii ya wasiomcha Mungu watakuwa tasa, nao moto utateketeza hema za wale wanaopenda rushwa.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

kikuyu: Hutunga mimba ya madhara na kuzaa uovu; matumbo yao huumba udanganyifu.”
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

kikuyu: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Nimepata kusikia mambo mengi kama haya, nanyi nyote ni wafariji wenye kutaabisha!
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

kikuyu: Je, maneno yenu mengi yasiyo na maana hayana mwisho? Mna nini hata mwendelee kushindana kwa maneno?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

kikuyu: Mimi pia ningeweza kuzungumza kama ninyi, kama mngekuwa katika hali yangu; ningeweza kutoa hotuba nzuri dhidi yenu, na kuwatikisia ninyi kichwa changu.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

kikuyu: Lakini kinywa changu kingewatia moyo; faraja kutoka midomoni mwangu, ingewaletea nafuu.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

kikuyu: “Lakini kama nikisema, maumivu yangu bado hayatulizwi; nami kama nikijizuia, wala hayaondoki.
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, hakika umenichakaza; umewaangamiza kabisa watu wa nyumbani mwangu wote.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

kikuyu: Umenikunjakunja, nalo limekuwa ushahidi; nako kukonda kwangu kumeongezeka sana na kushuhudia dhidi yangu.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

kikuyu: Mungu amenishambulia na kunirarua katika hasira yake, na kunisagia meno yake; adui yangu hunikazia macho yake makali.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

kikuyu: Watu wamenifumbulia vinywa vyao kunidhihaki; hunipiga shavuni mwangu kwa dharau, na kuungana pamoja dhidi yangu.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

kikuyu: Mungu amenigeuzia kwa watu wabaya, na kunitupa katika makucha ya waovu.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

kikuyu: Mambo yote yalikuwa mazuri, lakini alinivunjavunja; amenikamata shingo na kuniponda. Amenifanya mimi kuwa shabaha yake;
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

kikuyu: wapiga upinde wake wananizunguka. Bila huruma, huchoma figo zangu, na kuimwaga nyongo yangu juu ya nchi.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

kikuyu: Huniponda tena na tena; hunishambulia kama shujaa wa vita.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

kikuyu: “Nimejishonea nguo ya gunia juu ya mwili wangu nami nimekizika kipaji cha uso wangu kwenye vumbi.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

kikuyu: Uso wangu umekuwa mwekundu kwa kulia, macho yangu yamepigwa na giza kuu.
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

kikuyu: Hata hivyo mikono yangu haijafanya jeuri, na maombi yangu ni safi.
english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

kikuyu: “Ee nchi, usiifunike damu yangu, nacho kilio changu kisinyamazishwe kamwe.
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

kikuyu: Hata sasa shahidi wangu yuko mbinguni; wakili wangu yuko juu.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

kikuyu: Mwombezi wangu ni rafiki yangu macho yangu yamwagapo machozi kwa Mungu;
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

kikuyu: kwa niaba ya mtu anamsihi Mungu kama mtu anavyosihi kwa ajili ya rafiki yake.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

kikuyu: “Ni miaka michache tu itapita kabla sijaenda safari ambayo sitarudi.
english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu umevunjika, siku zangu zimefupishwa, kaburi linaningojea.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

kikuyu: Hakika wenye mizaha wamenizunguka; macho yangu yamebaki kutazama uadui wao.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

kikuyu: “Ee Mungu, nipe dhamana unayodai. Ni nani mwingine atakayeweka dhamana kwa ajili yangu?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

kikuyu: Umezifunga akili zao zisipate ufahamu, kwa hiyo hutawaacha wapate ushindi.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

kikuyu: Kama mtu akiwashutumu rafiki zake ili apate ujira, macho ya watoto wake yatashindwa kuona.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

kikuyu: “Mungu amenifanya kitu cha dhihaka kwa kila mtu, mtu ambaye watu humtemea mate usoni.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

kikuyu: Macho yangu yamefifia kwa ajili ya majonzi; umbile langu lote ni kama kivuli.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

kikuyu: Watu wanyofu wanatishwa na hili; watu wasio na hatia wanasimama dhidi ya wasiomcha Mungu.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, waadilifu watazishika njia zao, nao wale wenye mikono safi wataendelea kupata nguvu.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

kikuyu: “Lakini ninyi njooni, ninyi nyote, jaribuni tena! Sitampata mtu mwenye hekima miongoni mwenu.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

kikuyu: Siku zangu zimepita, mipango yangu imevunjika, vivyo hivyo shauku za moyo wangu.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.
