kikuyu: Watu hawa hufanya usiku kuwa mchana, kwenye giza wao husema, ‘Mwanga u karibu.’
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

kikuyu: Kama nyumba pekee ninayoitarajia ni kaburi, kama nikikitandika kitanda changu gizani,
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

kikuyu: kama nikiuambia uharibifu, ‘Wewe u baba yangu,’ na kuliambia buu, ‘Wewe u mama yangu’ au ‘Dada yangu,’
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

kikuyu: liko wapi basi tarajio langu? Ni nani awezaye kuona tarajio lolote kwa ajili yangu?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

kikuyu: Je, litashuka chini hadi kwenye malango ya mauti? Je, tutashuka pamoja mavumbini?”
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

kikuyu: Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: “Je, ni lini utafika mwisho wa maneno haya? Uwe mwenye busara, nasi ndipo tutakapoweza kuongea.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

kikuyu: Kwa nini sisi tunafikiriwa kama wanyama, na kuonekana wajinga machoni pako?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

kikuyu: Wewe unayejirarua mwenyewe vipande vipande katika hasira yako, je, dunia iachwe kwa ajili yako wewe? Au ni lazima miamba iondolewe mahali pake?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

kikuyu: “Taa ya mwovu imezimwa, nao mwali wa moto wake umezimika.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

kikuyu: Mwanga hemani mwake umekuwa giza; taa iliyo karibu naye imezimika.
english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

kikuyu: Nguvu za hatua zake zimedhoofishwa; shauri lake baya litamwangusha.
english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

kikuyu: Miguu yake imemsukumia kwenye wavu, naye anatangatanga kwenye matundu ya wavu.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

kikuyu: Tanzi litamkamata kwenye kisigino; mtego utamshikilia kwa nguvu.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

kikuyu: Kitanzi kimefichwa ardhini kwa ajili yake; mtego uko kwenye njia yake.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

kikuyu: Vitisho vimemtia hofu kila upande, na adui zake humwandama kila hatua.
english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

kikuyu: Janga linamwonea shauku; maafa yako tayari kwa ajili yake aangukapo.
english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

kikuyu: Nayo yatakula sehemu ya ngozi yake; mzaliwa wa kwanza wa mauti atakula maungo yake.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

kikuyu: Atangʼolewa kutoka usalama wa hema lake, na kupelekwa kwa mfalme wa vitisho.
english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

kikuyu: Moto utakaa katika hema lake; moto wa kiberiti utamwagwa juu ya makao yake.
english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

kikuyu: Mizizi yake chini itakauka na matawi yake juu yatanyauka.
english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

kikuyu: Kumbukumbu lake litatoweka katika dunia, wala hatakuwa na jina katika nchi.
english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

kikuyu: Ameondolewa nuruni na kusukumiwa gizani, naye amefukuzwa mbali atoke duniani.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

kikuyu: Hana mtoto wala mzao miongoni mwa watu wake, wala aliyenusurika mahali alipoishi.
english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

kikuyu: Watu wa magharibi watashangaa yaliyompata; watu wa mashariki watapatwa na hofu.
english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

kikuyu: Hakika ndivyo yalivyo makao ya mtu mwovu; ndivyo palivyo mahali pake mtu asiyemjua Mungu.”
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Je, mtaendelea kunitesa mpaka lini, na kuniponda kwa maneno yenu?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

kikuyu: Mara kumi hizi mmenishutumu; bila aibu mnanishambulia.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

kikuyu: Kama ni kweli nimepotoka, kosa langu ninabaki kuhusika nalo mwenyewe.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

kikuyu: Kama kweli mngejitukuza wenyewe juu yangu, na kutumia unyonge wangu dhidi yangu,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

kikuyu: basi jueni kuwa Mungu amenitendea yaliyo mabaya, naye amekokota wavu wake kunizunguka.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

kikuyu: “Ingawa ninalia, ‘Nimetendewa mabaya!’ sipati jibu; ingawa ninaomba msaada, hakuna haki.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

kikuyu: Yeye ameizuia njia yangu hivyo siwezi kupita; ameyafunika mapito yangu na giza.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

kikuyu: Amenivua heshima yangu, na kuniondolea taji kichwani pangu.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

kikuyu: Amenibomoa kila upande hadi nimeisha; amelingʼoa tegemeo langu kama mti.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

kikuyu: Hasira yake imewaka juu yangu; amenihesabu kuwa miongoni mwa adui zake.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

kikuyu: Majeshi yake yananisogelea kwa nguvu; yamenizingira, yamepiga kambi kulizunguka hema langu.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

kikuyu: “Amewatenga ndugu zangu mbali nami; wale tunaojuana nao wamefarakana nami kabisa.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

kikuyu: Watu wa jamaa yangu wamekwenda mbali; rafiki zangu wamenisahau.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

kikuyu: Wageni wangu na watumishi wangu wa kike wananiona kama mgeni; wananitazama kama mgeni.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

kikuyu: Namwita mtumishi wangu, wala haitiki, ingawa namwomba kwa kinywa changu mwenyewe.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

kikuyu: Pumzi ya kinywa changu ni kinyaa kwa mke wangu; nimekuwa chukizo mno kwa ndugu zangu mwenyewe.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

kikuyu: Hata watoto wadogo hunidhihaki; ninapojitokeza, hunifanyia mzaha.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

kikuyu: Rafiki zangu wa moyoni wote wananichukia kabisa; wale niwapendao wamekuwa kinyume nami.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

kikuyu: Mimi nimebaki mifupa na ngozi tu; nimeponea nikiwa karibu kufa.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

kikuyu: “Nihurumieni, rafiki zangu, kuweni na huruma, kwa kuwa mkono wa Mungu umenipiga.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

kikuyu: Kwa nini mnanifuatia kama Mungu afanyavyo? Hamtosheki kamwe na mwili wangu?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

kikuyu: “Laiti maneno yangu yangewekwa kwenye kumbukumbu, laiti kwamba yangeandikwa kwenye kitabu,
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

kikuyu: kwamba yangechorwa kwenye risasi kwa kifaa cha chuma, au kuyachonga juu ya mwamba milele!
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

kikuyu: Ninajua kwamba Mkombozi wangu yu hai, naye kwamba mwishoni atasimama juu ya nchi.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

kikuyu: Nami baada ya ngozi yangu kuharibiwa, bado nikiwa na mwili huu nitamwona Mungu;
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

kikuyu: mimi nitamwona kwa macho yangu mwenyewe: mimi, wala si mwingine. Tazama jinsi moyo wangu unavyomtamani sana!
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

kikuyu: “Kama mkisema, ‘Tazama tutakavyomwinda, maadamu mzizi wa tatizo uko ndani yake,’
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

kikuyu: ninyi wenyewe uogopeni upanga, kwa kuwa ghadhabu italeta adhabu kwa upanga, nanyi ndipo mtakapojua kwamba kuna hukumu.”
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Sofari Mnaamathi akajibu:
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

kikuyu: “Mawazo yanayonisumbua yananisukuma kujibu, kwa sababu nimehangaika sana.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

kikuyu: Ninasikia makaripio ambayo yananivunjia heshima, nao ufahamu wangu unanisukuma kujibu.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

kikuyu: “Hakika unajua jinsi ilivyokuwa tangu zamani, tangu zamani mwanadamu alipowekwa duniani,
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

kikuyu: macheko ya mtu mwovu ni ya muda mfupi, nayo furaha ya wasiomcha Mungu hudumu kwa kitambo tu.
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

kikuyu: Ingawa kujikweza kwake hufikia mbinguni na kichwa chake hugusa mawingu,
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

kikuyu: ataangamia milele kama mavi yake mwenyewe. Wale waliomwona watauliza, ‘Yuko wapi?’
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

kikuyu: Kama ndoto hutoweka, wala hapatikani tena, amefukuziwa mbali kama maono ya usiku.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

kikuyu: Jicho lililomwona halitamwona tena; mahali pake hapatamwona tena.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

kikuyu: Watoto wake watalipa yote baba yao aliyowadhulumu maskini, nayo mikono yake itarudisha mali yote aliyonyangʼanya watu.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

kikuyu: Nguvu za ujana zilizoijaza mifupa yake, zitalala naye mavumbini.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

kikuyu: “Ingawa uovu ni mtamu kinywani mwake naye huuficha chini ya ulimi wake,
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

kikuyu: ingawa hawezi kukubali kuuachia uende, lakini huuweka kinywani mwake.
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

kikuyu: Hata hivyo chakula chake kitakuwa kichungu tumboni mwake, nacho kitakuwa sumu kali ya nyoka ndani yake.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

kikuyu: Atatema mali alizozimeza; Mungu atalifanya tumbo lake kuzitapika.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

kikuyu: Atanyonya sumu za majoka; meno ya nyoka mwenye sumu kali yatamuua.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

kikuyu: Hatafurahia vijito, mito inayotiririsha asali na siagi.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

kikuyu: Vile alivyovitaabikia atavirudisha bila kuvila; hatafurahia faida itokanayo na biashara yake.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa aliwaonea maskini na kuwaacha pasipo kitu; amenyangʼanya kwa nguvu nyumba asizozijenga.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

kikuyu: “Hakika hatakuwa na raha katika kutamani kwake sana; hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe kwa hazina zake.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

kikuyu: Hakuna chochote kitakachosalia kwa ajili yake ili ale; kufanikiwa kwake hakutadumu.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

kikuyu: Katikati ya wingi wa ustawi wake, dhiki itampata; taabu itamjia kwa nguvu zote.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

kikuyu: Atakapokuwa amelijaza tumbo lake, Mungu ataionyesha ghadhabu kali dhidi yake, na kumnyeshea mapigo juu yake.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

kikuyu: Ijapokuwa aikimbia silaha ya chuma, mshale wa shaba utamchoma.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

kikuyu: Atauchomoa katika mgongo wake, ncha ingʼaayo kutoka ini lake. Vitisho vitakuja juu yake;
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

kikuyu: giza nene linavizia hazina zake. Moto usiopepewa na mtu utamteketeza, na kuangamiza yaliyosalia nyumbani mwake.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

kikuyu: Mbingu zitaweka wazi hatia yake, nayo nchi itainuka kinyume chake.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

kikuyu: Mafuriko yataichukua nyumba yake, maji yaendayo kasi katika siku ya ghadhabu ya Mungu.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Hili ndilo fungu Mungu alilowagawia waovu, urithi uliowekwa kwa ajili yao na Mungu.”
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Yasikilizeni maneno yangu kwa makini; hii na iwe faraja mnayonipa mimi.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

kikuyu: Nivumilieni ninapozungumza, nami nikishazungumza, endeleeni kunidhihaki.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

kikuyu: “Je, kwani malalamiko yangu yanaelekezwa kwa mwanadamu? Kwa nini nisikose subira?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

kikuyu: Niangalieni mkastaajabu; mkaweke mkono juu ya vinywa vyenu.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

kikuyu: Ninapowaza juu ya hili, ninaogopa, nao mwili wangu unatetemeka.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

kikuyu: Kwa nini waovu wanaendelea kuishi, wakifikia umri wa uzee na kuendelea kuwa na nguvu?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

kikuyu: Huwaona watoto wao wakithibitika wakiwa wamewazunguka, wazao wao mbele za macho yao.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

kikuyu: Nyumba zao zi salama wala hakuna hofu; fimbo ya Mungu haiko juu yao.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

kikuyu: Madume yao ya ngʼombe huvyaza bila kushindwa kamwe; ngʼombe wao huzaa wala hawaharibu mimba.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

kikuyu: Huwatoa watoto wao nje kama kundi; wadogo wao huchezacheza.
english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

kikuyu: Huimba nyimbo kwa matari na kwa kinubi, nao huifurahia sauti ya filimbi.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

kikuyu: Huitumia miaka yao katika mafanikio nao hushuka kaburini kwa amani.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

kikuyu: Lakini humwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi!’ Hatuna haja ya kufahamu njia zako.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

kikuyu: Mwenyezi ni nani hata tumtumikie? Tutapata faida gani kumwomba?
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

kikuyu: Lakini kufanikiwa kwao hakupo mikononi mwao wenyewe, hivyo najitenga mbali na shauri la waovu.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: “Lakini ni mara ngapi taa ya waovu huzimwa? Ni mara ngapi maafa huwajia, yale yawapatayo ambayo Mungu huwapangia katika hasira yake?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

kikuyu: Ni mara ngapi huwa kama majani makavu mbele ya upepo, kama makapi yachukuliwayo na dhoruba?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

kikuyu: Imesemekana, ‘Mungu huiweka akiba adhabu ya mtu kwa ajili ya wanawe.’ Mungu na amlipe mtu mwenyewe, ili apate kulijua!
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

kikuyu: Macho yake mwenyewe na yaone maangamizi yake; yeye na ainywe ghadhabu ya Mwenyezi.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Kwani anajali nini kuhusu jamaa anayoiacha nyuma, miezi yake aliyopangiwa ifikapo mwisho?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

kikuyu: “Je, yuko mtu yeyote awezaye kumfundisha Mungu maarifa, iwapo yeye ndiye ahukumuye hata walio juu ya wote?
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja hufa akiwa na nguvu zake kamili, akiwa salama na mwenye raha kamili,
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

kikuyu: mwili wake ukiwa umenawiri, nayo mifupa yake ikiwa imejaa mafuta ndani yake.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

kikuyu: Mtu mwingine hufa katika uchungu wa nafsi, akiwa hajafurahia kamwe jambo lolote zuri.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

kikuyu: Hao wote hulala mavumbini, nao mabuu huwafunika wote.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

kikuyu: “Ninayajua kikamilifu yale mnayoyafikiri, mipango ambayo kwayo mngenitendea mabaya.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

kikuyu: Mwasema, ‘Iko wapi sasa nyumba ya huyo mtu mkuu, mahema ambayo watu waovu walikaa?’
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

kikuyu: Je, hamkuwahi kuwauliza hao wanaosafiri? Je, hamkutafakari taarifa zao:
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

kikuyu: kwamba mtu mwovu huepushwa kutoka siku ya maafa, kwamba huokolewa kutoka siku ya ghadhabu?
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

kikuyu: Ni nani hulaumu matendo yake mbele ya uso wake? Ni nani ampatilizaye kwa yale aliyoyatenda?
english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

kikuyu: Hupelekwa kaburini, nao ulinzi ukawekwa kwenye kaburi lake.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

kikuyu: Udongo ulio bondeni ni mtamu kwake; watu wote watamfuata, nao umati wa watu usiohesabika umemtangulia.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

kikuyu: “Hivyo ninyi mnawezaje kunifariji kwa upuzi wenu? Hakuna kilichosalia cha majibu yenu isipokuwa uongo!”
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Elifazi Mtemani akajibu:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: “Je, mwanadamu aweza kuwa wa faida kwa Mungu? Je, hata mtu mwenye hekima aweza kumfaidi?
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

kikuyu: Je, Mwenyezi angefurahia nini kama ungekuwa mwadilifu? Au je, yeye angepata faida gani kama njia zako zingekuwa kamilifu?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

kikuyu: “Je, ni kwa ajili ya utaua wako ndiyo maana anakukemea na kuleta mashtaka dhidi yako?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

kikuyu: Je, uovu wako si mkuu? Dhambi zako si hazina mwisho?
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

kikuyu: Umedai dhamana kwa ndugu zako bila sababu; umewavua watu nguo zao, ukawaacha uchi.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

kikuyu: Hukumpa maji aliyechoka, nawe ulimnyima chakula mwenye njaa,
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

kikuyu: ingawa ulikuwa mtu mwenye uwezo ukimiliki nchi: mtu uliyeheshimiwa, ukiishi ndani yake.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

kikuyu: Umewafukuza wajane mikono mitupu na kuzivunja nguvu za yatima.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

kikuyu: Ndiyo sababu mitego imekuzunguka pande zote, hatari ya ghafula inakutia hofu,
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

kikuyu: ndiyo sababu ni giza sana huwezi kuona, tena ndiyo sababu mafuriko ya maji yamekufunika.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

kikuyu: “Je, Mungu hayuko katika mbingu za juu? Juu kuliko nyota zilizo juu sana!
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

kikuyu: Hivyo wewe wasema, ‘Mungu anajua nini?’ Je, yeye huhukumu katika giza kama hilo?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

kikuyu: Mawingu mazito ni pazia lake, hivyo hatuoni sisi atembeapo juu ya anga la dunia.
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

kikuyu: Je, utaifuata njia ya zamani, ambayo watu waovu waliikanyaga?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

kikuyu: Waliondolewa kabla ya wakati wao, misingi yao ikachukuliwa na mafuriko.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

kikuyu: Walimwambia Mungu, ‘Tuache sisi! Huyo Mwenyezi aweza kutufanyia nini?’
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

kikuyu: Lakini ndiye alizijaza nyumba zao na vitu vizuri, hivyo ninajitenga mbali na mashauri ya waovu.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: “Wenye haki wanaona maangamizi yao na kufurahi, nao wasio na hatia huwadhihaki, wakisema,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

kikuyu: ‘Hakika adui zetu wameangamizwa, nao moto umeteketeza mali zao.’
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

kikuyu: “Mjue sana Mungu ili uwe na amani, ndipo mema yatakapokujia.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

kikuyu: Uyapokee mafundisho toka kinywani mwake, na maneno yake uyaweke moyoni mwako.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

kikuyu: Kama ukimrudia Mwenyezi, utarudishwa upya: Kama ukiuondoa uovu uwe mbali na hema lako,
english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

kikuyu: kama dhahabu yako ukiihesabu kama mavumbi, dhahabu yako ya Ofiri kama miamba ya mabondeni,
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

kikuyu: ndipo Mwenyezi atakuwa dhahabu yako, naye atakuwa fedha yako iliyo bora.
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

kikuyu: Hakika ndipo utakapojifurahisha kwa Mwenyezi, nawe utamwinulia Mungu uso wako.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

kikuyu: Utamwomba yeye, naye atakusikia, nawe utazitimiza nadhiri zako.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

kikuyu: Utakusudia jambo nalo litatendeka, nao mwanga utaangazia njia zako.
english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

kikuyu: Watu watakaposhushwa, nawe ukasema, ‘Wainue!’ ndipo atamwokoa aliyevunjika moyo.
english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

kikuyu: Atamwokoa hata yule ambaye ana hatia, ataokolewa kwa sababu ya usafi wa mikono yako.”
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Hata leo malalamiko yangu ni chungu; mkono wake ni mzito juu yangu hata nikiugua.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

kikuyu: Laiti ningefahamu mahali pa kumwona; laiti ningeweza kwenda mahali akaapo!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

kikuyu: Ningeliweka shauri langu mbele zake, na kukijaza kinywa changu na hoja.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

kikuyu: Ningejua kwamba angenijibu nini, na kuelewa lile ambalo angelisema.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

kikuyu: Je, angenipinga kwa nguvu nyingi? La, asingenigandamiza.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

kikuyu: Hapo mtu mwadilifu angeweka shauri lake mbele zake, nami ningeokolewa milele na mhukumu wangu.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

kikuyu: “Lakini nikienda mashariki, hayupo; nikienda magharibi, simpati.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

kikuyu: Anapokuwa kazini pande za kaskazini, simwoni; akigeukia kusini, nako simwoni hata kidogo.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

kikuyu: Lakini anaijua njia niiendeayo; akiisha kunijaribu, nitatoka kama dhahabu.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

kikuyu: Nyayo zangu zimefuata hatua zake kwa karibu; nimeishika njia yake bila kukengeuka.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

kikuyu: Sijaziacha amri zilizotoka midomoni mwake; nimeyathamini maneno ya kinywa chake kuliko chakula changu cha kila siku.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

kikuyu: “Lakini yeye husimama peke yake; ni nani awezaye kumpinga? Yeye hufanya lolote atakalo.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

kikuyu: Hutimiliza maagizo yake dhidi yangu, na bado anayo mipango mingi kama hiyo ambayo ameiweka akiba.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

kikuyu: Hiyo ndiyo sababu ninaingiwa na hofu mbele zake; nifikiriapo haya yote ninamwogopa.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

kikuyu: Mungu ameufanya moyo wangu kuzimia; yeye Mwenyezi amenitia hofu.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo sijanyamazishwa na giza, wala kwa giza nene linalofunika uso wangu.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

kikuyu: “Kwa nini Mwenyezi asiweke nyakati kwa ajili ya hukumu? Kwa nini wale wamjuao wazitafute siku kama hizo bila mafanikio?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

kikuyu: Watu husogeza mawe ya mpaka; huchunga makundi ya wanyama waliyonyangʼanya kwa nguvu.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

kikuyu: Huwanyangʼanya yatima punda wao, na kumchukua rehani fahali wa mjane.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

kikuyu: Humsukuma mhitaji kutoka njia, na kuwafanya maskini wote wa nchi kulazimika kujificha.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

kikuyu: Kama punda-mwitu jangwani, maskini huzunguka katika kazi zao za kutafuta chakula; mahali palipo jangwa huwapa chakula cha watoto wao.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

kikuyu: Hukusanya chakula mashambani na kuokota masazo katika mashamba ya mizabibu ya waovu.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kwa kukosa nguo, usiku kucha hukaa uchi; hawana chochote cha kujifunika baridi.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

kikuyu: Hutota kwa mvua za mlimani, nao huikumbatia miamba kwa ajili ya kukosa pa kujisitiri.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

kikuyu: Mtoto yatima hupokonywa matitini; mtoto wachanga wa maskini hunyakuliwa kwa ajili ya deni.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

kikuyu: Kwa kukosa nguo, hutembea uchi; hubeba miganda ya ngano, lakini huwa na njaa.
english: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

kikuyu: Hukamua zeituni katika mawe ya kusagia; hukanyaga mashinikizo, lakini wanaona kiu.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

kikuyu: Kilio cha huzuni cha wanaokufa kinapaa kutoka mjini, nazo nafsi za waliojeruhiwa zinalilia msaada. Lakini Mungu hamlaumu mtu yeyote kwa kutenda mabaya.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

kikuyu: “Wako wale wanaoiasi nuru, wasiofahamu njia zake wala hawakai katika mapito yake.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

kikuyu: Wakati mwanga wa mchana unapotoweka, muuaji huinuka naye huwaua maskini na mhitaji; wakati wa usiku hunyemelea kama mwizi.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

kikuyu: Jicho la mzinzi hungojea wakati wa giza, naye hufikiri, ‘Hakuna jicho litakaloniona,’ naye huuficha uso wake.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

kikuyu: Katika giza, huvunja majumba, lakini wakati wa mchana hujifungia ndani; hawataki kufanya lolote nuruni.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

kikuyu: Kwa wote hawa, giza nene ndiyo asubuhi yao; hujifanya rafiki na vitisho vya gizani.
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

kikuyu: “Lakini wao ni povu juu ya maji; sehemu yao juu ya nchi imelaaniwa, hivyo hakuna hata mmoja aendaye kwenye shamba la mizabibu.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

kikuyu: Kama vile joto na hari vinyakuavyo theluji iliyoyeyuka, ndivyo kuzimu kuwanyakuavyo waliotenda dhambi.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

kikuyu: Tumbo lililowazaa huwasahau, nao huwa karamu ya mabuu; watu waovu hawakumbukwi tena, lakini huvunjika kama mti.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

kikuyu: Huwafanya mawindo wanawake tasa na wasio na watoto, nao hawaonyeshi huruma kwa wajane.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

kikuyu: Lakini Mungu huwakokota wenye nguvu kwa uwezo wake; ingawa wamestawi, hawana hakika ya maisha.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

kikuyu: Aweza akawaacha wakapumzika wakijihisi salama, lakini macho yake yanaona njia zao.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

kikuyu: Kwa kitambo kidogo hutukuka, hatimaye hutoweka; hushushwa na kukusanywa kama wengine wote, hukatwa kama masuke ya nafaka.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

kikuyu: “Kama hili sivyo, ni nani awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwongo, na kuyafanya maneno yangu kuwa si kitu?”
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Bildadi Mshuhi akajibu:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: “Mamlaka na kuheshimiwa ni vyake Mungu; yeye huthibitisha amani katika mbingu juu.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

kikuyu: Je, majeshi yake yaweza kuhesabika? Ni nani asiyeangaziwa na nuru yake?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

kikuyu: Mtu awezaje kuwa mwadilifu mbele za Mungu? Awezaje mtu aliyezaliwa na mwanamke kuwa safi?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

kikuyu: Ikiwa hata mwezi sio mwangavu nazo nyota si safi machoni pake,
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

kikuyu: sembuse mtu ambaye ni funza: mwanadamu ambaye ni buu tu!”
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

kikuyu: Kisha Ayubu akajibu:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Tazama jinsi ulivyomsaidia mtu asiye na uwezo! Jinsi ulivyouokoa mkono ulio dhaifu!
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

kikuyu: Ni shauri gani ulilompa yeye asiye na hekima? Nayo ni busara gani kubwa uliyoonyesha!
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

kikuyu: Ni nani aliyekusaidia kutamka maneno hayo? Nayo ni roho ya nani iliyosema kutoka kinywani mwako?
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

kikuyu: “Wafu wako katika maumivu makuu, wale walio chini ya maji na wale waishio ndani yake.
english: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

kikuyu: Mauti iko wazi mbele za Mungu; Uharibifu haukufunikwa.
english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

kikuyu: Hutandaza anga la kaskazini mahali patupu; naye huiningʼiniza dunia mahali pasipo na kitu.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

kikuyu: Huyafungia maji kwenye mawingu yake, hata hivyo mawingu hayapasuki kwa uzito wake.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

kikuyu: Huufunika uso wa mwezi mpevu, akitandaza mawingu juu yake.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

kikuyu: Amechora mstari wa upeo juu ya uso wa maji, ameweka mpaka wa nuru na giza.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

kikuyu: Nguzo za mbingu nazo zatetemeka, zinatishika anapozikemea.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

kikuyu: Kwa nguvu zake aliisukasuka bahari; kwa hekima yake alimkata Rahabu vipande vipande.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

kikuyu: Aliisafisha anga kwa pumzi yake; kwa mkono wake alimchoma joka aendaye mbio.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

kikuyu: Haya ni mambo madogo tu katika matendo yake; tazama jinsi ulivyo mdogo mnongʼono tunaousikia kumhusu! Ni nani basi awezaye kuelewa ngurumo za nguvu zake?”
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akaendelea na hoja yake, akasema:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: “Hakika kama Mungu aishivyo, aliyeninyima haki yangu, Mwenyezi ambaye amenifanya nionje uchungu wa nafsi,
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

kikuyu: kwa muda wote nitakaokuwa na uhai ndani yangu, nayo pumzi ya Mungu ikiwa puani mwangu,
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

kikuyu: midomo yangu haitanena uovu, wala ulimi wangu hautatamka udanganyifu.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

kikuyu: Sitakubaliana nanyi kabisa kuwa mko sahihi; hadi nife, sitakana uadilifu wangu.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

kikuyu: Nitadumisha haki yangu wala sitaiacha; dhamiri yangu haitanisuta muda wote ninaoishi.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

kikuyu: “Watesi wangu wawe kama waovu, nao adui zangu wawe kama wasio haki!
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mtu asiyemcha Mungu analo tegemeo gani anapokatiliwa mbali, Mungu anapouondoa uhai wake?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

kikuyu: Je, Mungu husikiliza kilio chake, shida zimjiapo?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

kikuyu: Je, anaweza kumfurahia Mwenyezi? Je, atamwita Mungu nyakati zote?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

kikuyu: “Nitawafundisha juu ya uweza wa Mungu; njia za Mwenyezi sitazificha.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

kikuyu: Ninyi nyote mmeona hili wenyewe. Ni ya nini basi mazungumzo haya yasiyo na maana?
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

kikuyu: “Hili ndilo fungu ambalo Mungu humpa mtu mwovu, urithi ule mtu mdhalimu anapokea kutoka kwa Mwenyezi:
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Hata kama watoto wake watakuwa wengi kiasi gani, fungu lao ni kuuawa kwa upanga; wazao wake hawatakuwa kamwe na chakula cha kuwatosha.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Tauni itawazika wale watakaonusurika miongoni mwao, nao wajane wao hawatawaombolezea.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

kikuyu: Ajapokusanya fedha nyingi kama mavumbi, na mavazi kama malundo ya udongo wa mfinyanzi,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

kikuyu: yale yote mtu mwovu aliyojiwekea akiba, mwenye haki atayavaa, naye asiye na hatia ataigawanya fedha yake.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

kikuyu: Nyumba aijengayo ni kama utando wa buibui, kama kibanda alichotengeneza mlinzi.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

kikuyu: Yeye hulala akiwa tajiri, lakini ndiyo mara ya mwisho; afunguapo macho yake, yote yametoweka.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

kikuyu: Vitisho humjia kama mafuriko; dhoruba humkumba ghafula usiku.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

kikuyu: Upepo mkali wa mashariki humchukua, naye hutoweka; humzoa kutoka mahali pake.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

kikuyu: Humvurumisha bila huruma, huku akikimbia kasi kukwepa nguvu zake.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

kikuyu: Upepo humpigia makofi kwa dharau, na kumfukuza atoke mahali pake.
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

kikuyu: “Kuna machimbo ya fedha, na mahali dhahabu isafishwapo.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

kikuyu: Chuma hupatikana ardhini, nayo shaba huyeyushwa kutoka mawe ya madini.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

kikuyu: Mwanadamu hukomesha giza; huyatafuta hadi sehemu iliyo mbali, kwa ajili ya kuchimbua mawe yenye madini katika giza jeusi sana.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

kikuyu: Huchimba shimo jembamba mbali na makao ya watu, mahali paliposahaulika na nyayo za wanadamu; mbali na wanadamu huningʼinia na kupembea kwa kamba.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

kikuyu: Ardhi, ambako chakula hutoka, chini hugeuzwa kwa moto;
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

kikuyu: yakuti samawi hutoka katika miamba yake, nalo vumbi lake lina vipande vya dhahabu.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

kikuyu: Hakuna ndege awindaye aijuaye njia ile iliyofichika, wala hakuna jicho la mwewe lililoiona.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

kikuyu: Wanyama wa porini wanaotamba hawajawahi kupakanyaga, wala simba azungukaye huko.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

kikuyu: Mikono ya mwanadamu hushambulia miamba migumu sana, na kuiacha wazi mizizi ya milima.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

kikuyu: Hutoboa shimo refu la kupenya chini kwa chini kwenye miamba; macho yake huona hazina zake zote.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

kikuyu: Hutafuta vyanzo vya mito na kuvileta vitu vilivyofichika katika nuru.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

kikuyu: “Lakini hekima inaweza kupatikana wapi? Ufahamu unakaa wapi?
english: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Mwanadamu hatambui thamani yake; haiwezi kupatikana katika nchi ya walio hai.
english: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Kilindi husema, ‘Haiko ndani yangu’; bahari nayo husema, ‘Haiko pamoja nami.’
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

kikuyu: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi kuliko zote, wala thamani yake haiwezi kupimwa kwa fedha.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

kikuyu: Haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu ya Ofiri, kwa shohamu ya thamani kubwa au yakuti samawi ya thamani kubwa.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

kikuyu: Dhahabu wala mawe maangavu haviwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi hubadilishwa na vito vya dhahabu.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

kikuyu: Marijani na yaspi hazistahili kutajwa; thamani ya hekima ni zaidi ya akiki nyekundu.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

kikuyu: Yakuti manjano ipatikanayo Kushi haiwezi kulinganishwa nayo, wala haiwezi kununuliwa kwa dhahabu safi.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

kikuyu: “Ni wapi basi hekima itokako? Ufahamu hukaa wapi?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Imefichika machoni pa kila kitu kilicho hai, imesitiriwa hata kwa ndege wa angani.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Uharibifu na Mauti husema, ‘Ni uvumi wake tu uliotufikia masikioni mwetu.’
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

kikuyu: Mungu anaifahamu njia ya kuiendea hekima na ndiye peke yake anayefahamu inakokaa,
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

kikuyu: kwa maana yeye huitazama miisho ya dunia na huona kila kitu chini ya mbingu.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

kikuyu: Alipofanyiza nguvu za upepo na kuyapima maji,
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

kikuyu: alipofanya maagizo kwa ajili ya mvua na njia kwa ajili ya umeme wa radi,
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

kikuyu: ndipo alipoitazama hekima na kuikadiria thamani yake, akaithibitisha na kuihakikisha.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

kikuyu: Naye Mungu akamwambia mwanadamu, ‘Kumcha Bwana: hiyo ndiyo hekima, nako kujitenga na uovu ndio ufahamu.’ ”
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

kikuyu: Ayubu akaendelea na hoja yake, akasema:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: “Tazama jinsi ninavyoitamani miezi iliyopita, zile siku ambazo Mungu alikuwa akinilinda,
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

kikuyu: wakati taa yake iliniangazia kichwani changu, na kwa mwanga wake Mungu nikapita katikati ya giza!
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

kikuyu: Natamani siku zile nilizokuwa katika ustawi wangu, wakati urafiki wa Mungu wa ndani ulipoibariki nyumba yangu,
english: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

kikuyu: wakati Mwenyezi alikuwa pamoja nami, nao watoto wangu walikuwa wamenizunguka,
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

kikuyu: wakati njia yangu ilikuwa imenyweshewa siagi, nao mwamba ukanimiminia vijito vya mafuta ya zeituni.
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

kikuyu: “Wakati nilipokwenda kwenye lango la mji na kuketi katika kiwanja,
english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

kikuyu: vijana waliniona wakakaa kando, nao wazee walioketi wakasimama;
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

kikuyu: wakuu wakaacha kuzungumza na kuziba vinywa vyao kwa mikono yao;
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

kikuyu: wenye vyeo wakanyamazishwa, nazo ndimi zao zikagandamana na makaakaa ya vinywa vyao.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

kikuyu: Yeyote aliyenisikia alinena mema juu yangu, nao walioniona walinisifu,
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

kikuyu: kwa sababu nilimwokoa maskini aliyeomba msaada, naye yatima aliyekuwa hana wa kumsaidia.
english: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

kikuyu: Mtu aliyekuwa karibu kufa alinibariki, nami niliufanya moyo wa mjane kuimba.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

kikuyu: Niliivaa haki kama vazi langu; uadilifu ulikuwa joho langu na kilemba changu.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

kikuyu: Nilikuwa macho ya kipofu na miguu kwa kiwete.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

kikuyu: Nilikuwa baba kwa mhitaji; nilimtetea mgeni.
english: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Niliyavunja meno makali ya waovu, na kuwapokonya wahanga kwenye meno yao.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

kikuyu: “Nikafikiri, ‘Nitafia katika nyumba yangu mwenyewe, nazo siku zangu zitakuwa nyingi kama chembechembe za mchanga.
english: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

kikuyu: Mizizi yangu itafika mpaka kwenye maji, nao umande utakaa juu ya matawi yangu usiku kucha.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

kikuyu: Utukufu wangu utabakia kuwa mpya ndani yangu, upinde wangu daima utaendelea kuwa mpya mkononi mwangu.’
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

kikuyu: “Watu walinisikiliza kwa tumaini, wakingojea ushauri wangu kwa utulivu.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

kikuyu: Baada ya mimi kuzungumza, hawakusema zaidi; maneno yangu yaliingia masikioni mwao kwa makini.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

kikuyu: Waliningojea kama manyunyu ya mvua na kuyapokea maneno yangu kama ardhi inyonyavyo mvua ya vuli.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

kikuyu: Walipokata tamaa niliwaonyesha uso wa furaha; nuru ya uso wangu ilikuwa ya thamani kwao.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

kikuyu: Niliwachagulia njia na kukaa kama mkuu wao; niliishi kama mfalme katikati ya majeshi yake; nikawa kama yeye anayewafariji waombolezaji.
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

kikuyu: “Lakini sasa watu wadogo kwa umri kuniliko wananidhihaki, watu ambao baba zao ningekataa kwa dharau kuwaweka pamoja na mbwa wangu wa kulinda kondoo.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

kikuyu: Nguvu za mikono yao zingekuwa na faida gani kwangu, kwa kuwa nguvu zao zilikuwa zimewaishia?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

kikuyu: Wakiwa wamekonda kutokana na kupungukiwa na kwa njaa, walizurura usiku katika nchi kame iliyo ukiwa.
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

kikuyu: Katika vichaka walikusanya mimea ya chumvi, nacho chakula chao kilikuwa mizizi ya mti wa mfagio.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

kikuyu: Walifukuzwa mbali na watu wao, wakipigiwa kelele kama wevi.
english: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

kikuyu: Walilazimika kuishi katika mikondo ya vijito vilivyokauka, kwenye majabali na mahandaki.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

kikuyu: Kwenye vichaka walilia kama punda, na walijisongasonga pamoja kwenye vichaka.
english: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

kikuyu: Wao ni watoto wa wapumbavu wenye asili ya ubaya, waliofukuzwa watoke katika nchi.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

kikuyu: “Nao sasa wana wao wananidhihaki katika nyimbo; nimekuwa kitu cha dhihaka kwao.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

kikuyu: Wananichukia sana na kujitenga nami, wala hawasiti kunitemea mate usoni.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

kikuyu: Sasa kwa kuwa Mungu ameilegeza kamba ya upinde wangu na kunitesa, wamekuwa huru kunitendea waonavyo.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

kikuyu: Kuume kwangu kundi linashambulia; wao huitegea miguu yangu tanzi, na kunizingira.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

kikuyu: Huizuia njia yangu, nao hufanikiwa katika kuniletea maafa, nami sina yeyote wa kunisaidia.
english: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

kikuyu: Wananijia kama watu wapitao katika ufa mpana; katikati ya magofu huja na kunishambulia.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

kikuyu: Vitisho vimenifunika; heshima yangu imetoweshwa kama kwa upepo, salama yangu imetoweka kama wingu.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

kikuyu: “Sasa maisha yangu yamefikia mwisho; siku za mateso zimenikamata.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

kikuyu: Usiku mifupa yangu inachoma; maumivu yanayonitafuna hayatulii kamwe.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

kikuyu: Kwa uwezo wake mkuu Mungu huwa kwangu kama nguo; hushikamana nami kama ukosi wa vazi langu.
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

kikuyu: Yeye amenitupa kwenye matope, nami nimekuwa kama mavumbi na majivu.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

kikuyu: “Ee Bwana, ninakulilia wewe lakini hunijibu; ninasimama, nawe unanitazama tu.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

kikuyu: Wewe unanigeukia bila huruma; unanishambulia kwa nguvu za mkono wako.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

kikuyu: Unaninyakua na kunipeperusha kwa upepo; umenirusha huku na huko kwenye dhoruba kali.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

kikuyu: Ninajua utanileta mpaka kifoni, mahali ambapo wenye uhai wote wamewekewa.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

kikuyu: “Hakika hakuna yeyote amshambuliaye mhitaji, anapoomba msaada katika shida yake.
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

kikuyu: Je, sikulia kwa ajili ya wale waliokuwa katika taabu? Je, nafsi yangu haikusononeka kwa ajili ya maskini?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

kikuyu: Lakini nilipotazamia mema, mabaya yalinijia; nilipotafuta nuru, ndipo giza lilipokuja.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

kikuyu: Kusukwasukwa ndani yangu kamwe hakutulii; siku za mateso zinanikabili.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

kikuyu: Ninazunguka nikiwa nimeungua, lakini si kwa jua; ninasimama katika kusanyiko nikiomba msaada.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

kikuyu: Nimekuwa ndugu wa mbweha, rafiki wa mabundi.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

kikuyu: Ngozi yangu imekuwa nyeusi nayo inachunika; mifupa yangu inaungua kwa homa.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

kikuyu: Kinubi changu kimegeuka kuwa maombolezo, nayo filimbi yangu imekuwa sauti ya kilio.
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

kikuyu: “Nimefanya agano na macho yangu yasimtazame msichana kwa kumtamani.
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa fungu la mwanadamu ni gani kutoka kwa Mungu juu, urithi wake kutoka kwa Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Aliye juu?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

kikuyu: Je, si uharibifu kwa watu waovu, maangamizi kwa wale watendao mabaya?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

kikuyu: Je, yeye hazioni njia zangu na kuihesabu kila hatua yangu?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

kikuyu: “Kama nimeishi katika uongo au mguu wangu umekimbilia udanganyifu,
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

kikuyu: Mungu na anipime katika mizani za uaminifu, naye atajua kwamba sina hatia:
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

kikuyu: kama hatua zangu zimepotoka kutoka kwenye njia, kama moyo wangu umeongozwa na macho yangu, au kama mikono yangu imetiwa unajisi,
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

kikuyu: basi wengine na wale nilichokipanda, nayo yale yote niliyootesha na yangʼolewe.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

kikuyu: “Kama moyo wangu umeshawishiwa na mwanamke, au kama nimevizia mlangoni mwa jirani yangu,
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

kikuyu: basi mke wangu na asage nafaka ya mwanaume mwingine, nao wanaume wengine walale naye.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hilo lingekuwa aibu, naam, dhambi ya kuhukumiwa.
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

kikuyu: Ni moto uwakao kwa Uharibifu; ungekuwa umengʼoa mavuno yangu.
english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

kikuyu: “Kama ningewanyima haki watumishi wangu wanaume au vijakazi wangu, walipokuwa na manungʼuniko dhidi yangu,
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

kikuyu: nitafanya nini Mungu atakaponikabili? Nitamjibu nini nitakapoitwa kutoa hesabu?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

kikuyu: Je, yeye aliyeniumba tumboni mwa mama yangu, si ndiye aliwaumba? Je, si ni yeye huyo mmoja aliyetuumba sote ndani ya mama zetu?
english: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

kikuyu: “Ikiwa nimewanyima maskini haja zao, au kuyaacha macho ya wajane yadhoofike,
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

kikuyu: kama nimekula chakula changu mwenyewe, bila kuwashirikisha yatima;
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

kikuyu: lakini tangu ujana wangu nimemlea yatima kama ambavyo baba angefanya, nami tangu kuzaliwa kwangu nimewaongoza wajane:
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

kikuyu: kama nilimwona yeyote akiteseka kwa kukosa nguo, au mtu mhitaji asiye na mavazi
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

kikuyu: ambaye wala moyo wake haukunibariki kwa kumpatia joto kwa mavazi ya manyoya ya kondoo zangu,
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

kikuyu: na kama nimeinua mkono wangu dhidi ya yatima, nikijua kuwa nina ushawishi mahakamani,
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

kikuyu: basi mkono wangu na unyofoke toka begani mwangu, nao na uvunjike kutoka kiungio chake.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa niliogopa uharibifu kutoka kwa Mungu, nami kwa kuuogopa utukufu wake sikuweza kufanya mambo kama hayo.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

kikuyu: “Kama nimeweka tumaini langu kwenye dhahabu, au kuiambia dhahabu safi, ‘Wewe ndiwe salama yangu,’
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

kikuyu: kama nimefurahia wingi wa utajiri wangu, ustawi ambao mikono yangu ilikuwa imepata,
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

kikuyu: kama nimelitazama jua katika kungʼaa kwake au mwezi ukienda kwa fahari yake,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

kikuyu: hivyo moyo wangu kushawishiwa kwa siri, au kubusu mkono wangu kwa kuviheshimu,
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

kikuyu: basi hiyo pia ingekuwa dhambi ya kuhukumiwa, kwa kuwa ningekuwa si mwaminifu kwa Mungu aishiye juu sana.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

kikuyu: “Kama nimeshangilia msiba wa adui yangu, au kutazama kwa furaha taabu iliyomjia,
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

kikuyu: lakini sikuruhusu kinywa changu kufanya dhambi kwa kuomba laana dhidi ya maisha yake;
english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

kikuyu: kama watu wa nyumbani mwangu kamwe hawakusema, ‘Ni nani ambaye hajashibishwa na nyama ya Ayubu?’
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

kikuyu: Lakini hakuna mgeni aliyelala njiani, kwa maana mlango wangu ulikuwa wazi kwa msafiri;
english: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

kikuyu: kama nimeifunika dhambi yangu kama wanadamu wengine wafanyavyo, kwa kuficha hatia yangu moyoni mwangu,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

kikuyu: kwa sababu ya kuogopa umati wa watu, na hivyo kuwa na hofu ya kudharauliwa na jamaa, nikanyamaza kimya nisitoke nje ya mlango:
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

kikuyu: (“Laiti kama angekuwepo mtu wa kunisikia! Tazama sasa ninatia sahihi kwenye utetezi wangu: Mwenyezi na anijibu; mshtaki wangu na aweke mashtaka yake kwenye maandishi.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

kikuyu: Hakika ningeyavaa begani mwangu, ningeyavaa kama taji.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

kikuyu: Ningempa hesabu ya kila hatua yangu, ningemwendea kama mwana wa mfalme.)
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

kikuyu: “Kama nchi yangu inalia dhidi yangu, na mifereji yake yote imelowana kwa machozi,
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

kikuyu: kama nimekula mazao yake bila malipo, au kuvunja mioyo ya wapangaji wake,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

kikuyu: basi miiba na iote badala ya ngano, na magugu badala ya shayiri.” Mwisho wa maneno ya Ayubu.
english: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

kikuyu: Basi watu hawa watatu wakaacha kumjibu Ayubu, kwa kuwa alikuwa mwadilifu machoni pake mwenyewe.
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Lakini Elihu mwana wa Barakeli, wa kabila la Buzi wa jamaa ya Ramu, akamkasirikia sana Ayubu, kwa sababu ya kujihesabia haki mwenyewe badala ya Mungu.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

kikuyu: Pia aliwakasirikia hao rafiki watatu wa Ayubu, kwa sababu hawakuweza kupata njia ya kuthibitisha ya kuwa hayo maneno ya Ayubu hayakuwa ya kweli, nao bado walikuwa wamemlaumu.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

kikuyu: Basi Elihu alikuwa amesubiri kwanza waongee na Ayubu kwa sababu walikuwa na umri mkubwa kumliko yeye.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

kikuyu: Lakini alipoona watu hao watatu hawakuwa na kitu zaidi cha kusema, hasira yake ikaamka.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Basi Elihu mwana wa Barakeli wa kabila la Buzi akasema: “Mimi ni mdogo kwa umri, nanyi ni wazee; ndiyo sababu niliogopa, sikuthubutu kuwaambia kile ninachojua.
english: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

kikuyu: Nilifikiri, ‘Yafaa umri useme, nao wingi wa miaka ungefundisha hekima.’
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

kikuyu: Lakini ni Roho iliyoko ndani ya mwanadamu, pumzi ya Mwenyezi, ndiyo impayo yeye ufahamu.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

kikuyu: Sio wazee peke yao walio na hekima, sio wenye umri mkubwa peke yao wanaofahamu lililo sawa.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

kikuyu: “Kwa hiyo nasema: Nisikilizeni mimi; mimi nami nitawaambia lile ninalojua.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

kikuyu: Nilingojea mlipokuwa mnaongea, nilizisikiliza hoja zenu; mlipokuwa mkitafuta maneno ya kusema,
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

kikuyu: niliwasikiliza kwa makini. Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyethibitisha kwamba Ayubu amekosa; hakuna hata mmoja wenu aliyeweza kujibu hoja zake.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

kikuyu: Msiseme, ‘Tumepata hekima; Mungu na amthibitishe kuwa mwongo, wala si mwanadamu.’
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

kikuyu: Lakini Ayubu hajayapanga maneno yake dhidi yangu, nami sitamjibu kwa kutumia hoja zenu.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

kikuyu: “Wametiwa hofu na hawana la zaidi la kusema; maneno yamewaishia.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

kikuyu: Je, ningoje sasa kwa sababu wamekuwa kimya, kwa vile sasa wanasimama bila kuwa na la kujibu?
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

kikuyu: Mimi nami nitakuwa na la kusema; mimi nami nitasema lile nilijualo.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa nimejawa na maneno, nayo Roho iliyomo ndani yangu yanisukuma;
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

kikuyu: ndani yangu niko kama chupa iliyojazwa divai, kama kiriba kipya cha divai kilicho tayari kupasuka.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

kikuyu: Ni lazima niseme ili niweze kutulia; ni lazima nifumbue midomo yangu nipate kujibu.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

kikuyu: Sitampendelea mtu yeyote, wala sitajipendekeza kwa mtu yeyote;
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa kama ningekuwa stadi wa kujipendekeza, Muumba wangu angeniondolea mbali kwa upesi.
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

kikuyu: “Lakini Ayubu, sasa, sikiliza maneno yangu; zingatia kila kitu nitakachosema.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

kikuyu: Karibu nitafungua kinywa changu; maneno yangu yapo katika ncha ya ulimi wangu.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

kikuyu: Maneno yangu yanatoka katika moyo mnyofu; midomo yangu hunena kwa uaminifu yale niyajuayo.
english: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

kikuyu: Roho wa Mungu ameniumba; pumzi ya Mwenyezi hunipa uhai.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

kikuyu: Unijibu basi, kama unaweza; jiandae kunikabili mimi.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

kikuyu: Mimi ni kama wewe mbele za Mungu; mimi pia nimetolewa kwenye udongo.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

kikuyu: Huna sababu ya kuniogopa, wala mkono wangu haupaswi kukulemea.
english: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

kikuyu: “Lakini umesema nikiwa ninakusikia, nami nilisikia maneno yenyewe:
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Mimi ni safi na sina dhambi; mimi ni safi na sina hatia.
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

kikuyu: Lakini bado Mungu amepata dosari kwangu, naye ananiona kama adui yake.
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

kikuyu: Ananifunga miguu kwa pingu, tena anaziangalia njia zangu zote kwa karibu.’
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

kikuyu: “Lakini mimi ninakuambia, katika jambo hili wewe una makosa, kwa maana Mungu ni mkuu kuliko mwanadamu.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

kikuyu: Kwa nini unamlalamikia kwamba yeye hamjibu mwanadamu?
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Mungu husema, wakati huu kwa njia moja, au wakati mwingine kwa njia nyingine, ingawa mwanadamu anaweza asielewe.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

kikuyu: Mungu husema na mwanadamu katika ndoto, katika maono ya usiku, wakati usingizi mzito uwaangukiapo wanadamu wasinziapo vitandani mwao,
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

kikuyu: anaweza akasemea masikioni mwao, na kuwatia hofu kwa maonyo,
english: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

kikuyu: ili kumgeuza mtu kutoka kwenye kutenda mabaya na kumwepusha na kiburi,
english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

kikuyu: kuiokoa nafsi yake na shimo, uhai wake usiangamizwe kwa upanga.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

kikuyu: Mtu anaweza kutiwa adabu kwa maumivu kitandani mwake, kwa dhiki za mfululizo katika mifupa yake,
english: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

kikuyu: kiasi kwamba maisha yake yenyewe yanakataa chakula nayo nafsi yake ikakichukia kabisa hata chakula kizuri.
english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

kikuyu: Nyama ya mwili wake huisha kwa kukonda, nayo mifupa yake ambayo mwanzoni ilikuwa imefichika, sasa inatokeza nje.
english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

kikuyu: Nafsi yake inakaribia kaburi, nao uhai wake karibu na wajumbe wa kifo.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

kikuyu: “Kama bado kuna malaika upande wake kama mtetezi, mmoja miongoni mwa elfu, wa kumwambia mwanadamu lililo jema kwake,
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

kikuyu: kumwonea huruma na kusema, ‘Mwokoe asije akatumbukia shimoni; nimepata ukombozi kwa ajili yake’:
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

kikuyu: ndipo nyama ya mwili wake hufanywa mpya kama ya mtoto; hurudishwa upya kama siku za ujana wake.
english: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

kikuyu: Humwomba Mungu, akapata kibali kwake, huuona uso wa Mungu na kushangilia kwa furaha; Mungu humrudisha katika hali yake ya uadilifu.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

kikuyu: Ndipo huja mbele za watu na kusema, ‘Nilitenda dhambi na kupotosha kilichokuwa haki, lakini sikuadhibiwa kama nilivyostahili.
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

kikuyu: Alinikomboa nafsi yangu nisitumbukie shimoni, nami nitaishi ili kuufurahia mwanga.’
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

kikuyu: “Mungu hufanya haya yote kwa mwanadamu; mara mbili hata mara tatu,
english: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

kikuyu: ili aigeuze nafsi yake toka shimoni, ili nuru ya uzima imwangazie.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

kikuyu: “Ayubu, zingatia, nisikilize mimi; nyamaza, nami nitanena.
english: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

kikuyu: Kama unalo lolote la kusema, unijibu; sema, kwa maana ninataka uonekane huna hatia.
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

kikuyu: Lakini kama huna la kusema, basi nisikilize mimi; nyamaza, nami nitakufundisha hekima.”
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

kikuyu: Kisha Elihu akasema:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: “Sikieni maneno yangu, enyi watu wenye hekima; nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye maarifa.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa sikio huyajaribu maneno kama vile ulimi uonjavyo chakula.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

kikuyu: Tujichagulie wenyewe yaliyo sawa, nasi tujifunze pamoja yaliyo mema.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

kikuyu: “Ayubu anasema, ‘Mimi sina hatia, lakini Mungu ameninyima haki yangu.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

kikuyu: Ingawa niko sawa, ninaonekana mwongo; nami ingawa sina kosa, kidonda changu hakiponi.’
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

kikuyu: Ni mtu gani aliye kama Ayubu, anywaye dharau kama maji?
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

kikuyu: Ashirikianaye na watenda mabaya na kuchangamana na watu waovu.
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa anasema, ‘Haimfaidi mwanadamu kitu chochote anapojitahidi kumpendeza Mungu.’
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

kikuyu: “Hivyo nisikilizeni mimi, ninyi watu wenye ufahamu. Kamwe Mungu hatendi uovu, Mwenyezi hafanyi kosa.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

kikuyu: Humlipa mwanadamu kwa ajili ya lile alilotenda; huleta juu yake kile ambacho matendo yake yanastahili.
english: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

kikuyu: Ni jambo lisiloweza kufikiriwa kwamba Mungu angefanya makosa, kwamba Mwenyezi angepotosha hukumu.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

kikuyu: Je, ni nani aliyemtawaza juu ya dunia? Ni nani aliyemweka kuwa mwangalizi wa ulimwengu wote?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

kikuyu: Kama lilikuwa kusudi la Mungu, naye akaiondoa Roho yake na pumzi yake,
english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

kikuyu: wanadamu wote wangeliangamia kwa pamoja, na mtu angerudi mavumbini.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

kikuyu: “Kama ninyi mnaufahamu, sikieni hili; sikilizeni hili nisemalo.
english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

kikuyu: Je, yeye aichukiaye haki aweza kutawala? Je, utamhukumu mwenye haki, Aliye na Nguvu Zote?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

kikuyu: Je, si ni yeye awaambiaye wafalme, ‘Ninyi hamfai kitu,’ nao watu mashuhuri, ‘Ninyi ni waovu,’
english: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

kikuyu: yeye asiyependelea wakuu, wala haonyeshi upendeleo kwa matajiri kuliko maskini, kwa kuwa wote ni kazi ya mikono yake?
english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

kikuyu: Wanakufa ghafula, usiku wa manane; watu wanatikiswa nao hupita; wenye nguvu huondolewa bila mkono wa mwanadamu.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

kikuyu: “Macho yake yanazitazama njia za wanadamu; anaona kila hatua yao.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

kikuyu: Hakuna mahali penye giza nene, wala uvuli mkubwa, ambapo watenda mabaya wanaweza kujificha.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

kikuyu: Mungu hana haja ya kumchunguza mtu sana, ili apate kuja mbele zake kwa hukumu.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.
