kikuyu: Bila kuuliza huwapondaponda wenye nguvu nyingi na kuwaweka wengine mahali pao.
english: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu huyaangalia matendo yao yote, huwaondoa usiku, nao wakaangamia.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

kikuyu: Anawaadhibu kwa ajili ya uovu wao mahali ambapo kila mmoja ataweza kuwaona,
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

kikuyu: kwa sababu wameacha kumfuata Mungu, nao hawakuiheshimu njia yake hata moja.
english: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

kikuyu: Wamesababisha kilio cha maskini kifike mbele zake, hivyo akasikia kilio cha wahitaji.
english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Lakini kama akinyamaza kimya, ni nani awezaye kumhukumu? Kama akiuficha uso wake, ni nani awezaye kumwona? Ikiwa ni taifa au mtu mmoja, kwake ni sawa,
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

kikuyu: ili kumzuia mtu mwovu kutawala, au wale ambao huwategea watu mitego.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

kikuyu: “Kama mwanadamu akimwambia Mungu, ‘Nimekosa lakini sitatenda dhambi tena.
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

kikuyu: Nifundishe nisichoweza kuona; kama nimekukosea, sitafanya hivyo tena.’
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

kikuyu: Je basi, Mungu atakulipa kwa masharti yako, wakati wewe umekataa kutubu? Yakupasa wewe uamue, wala si mimi; sasa niambie lile ulijualo.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

kikuyu: “Wanadamu wenye ufahamu husema, wenye hekima wanaonisikia huniambia,
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

kikuyu: ‘Ayubu huongea bila maarifa; maneno yake hayana busara.’
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

kikuyu: Laiti Ayubu angejaribiwa hadi kikomo cha mwisho, kwa sababu anajibu kama mtu mwovu!
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

kikuyu: Kwenye dhambi yake huongeza uasi; kwa dharau hupiga makofi miongoni mwetu, na kuzidisha maneno yake dhidi ya Mungu.”
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Elihu akasema:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: “Je, unadhani hili ni haki? Wewe unasema, ‘Nina haki mbele za Mungu.’
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

kikuyu: Bado unamuuliza, ‘Ni faida gani nimepata, na imenifaidi nini kwa kutokutenda dhambi?’
english: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

kikuyu: “Ningependa nikujibu wewe pamoja na marafiki zako walio pamoja nawe.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

kikuyu: Tazama juu mbinguni ukaone; yaangalie mawingu yaliyo juu sana juu yako.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

kikuyu: Je, ukitenda dhambi, inamdhuruje Mungu? Kama dhambi zako zikiwa nyingi, hilo linamfanyia nini Mungu?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

kikuyu: Kama wewe ni mwadilifu, unampa nini, au yeye anapokea nini mkononi kwako?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

kikuyu: Uovu wako unamdhuru tu mtu mwingine kama wewe, nayo haki yako inawafaa wanadamu tu.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

kikuyu: “Wanadamu hulia kwa kulemewa na mateso; huomba msaada kutoka mkono wenye nguvu.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

kikuyu: Lakini hakuna asemaye, ‘Yuko wapi Mungu Muumba wangu, yeye anifanyaye niimbe usiku,
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

kikuyu: yeye atufundishaye sisi zaidi kuliko wanyama wa dunia, na kutufanya wenye hekima kuliko ndege wa angani?’
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

kikuyu: Yeye hajibu wakati watu waliapo kwa sababu ya kiburi cha watu waovu.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

kikuyu: Naam, Mungu hasikilizi maombi yao ya ubatili; Mwenyezi hayazingatii.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

kikuyu: Si zaidi sana kwamba hatakusikiliza wewe usemapo humwoni, tena ya kwamba shauri lako liko mbele zake na wewe lazima umngojee,
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

kikuyu: pia zaidi, kwamba hasira yake kamwe haiadhibu wala haangalii uovu hata kidogo?
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

kikuyu: Hivyo Ayubu hufumbua kinywa chake kwa maneno yasiyo na maana; anaongea maneno mengi bila maarifa.”
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

kikuyu: Elihu akaendelea kusema:
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

kikuyu: “Nivumilie kidogo zaidi nami nitakuonyesha kwamba yako mengi zaidi ya kusemwa kwa ajili ya Mungu.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

kikuyu: Ninayapata maarifa yangu kutoka mbali, nami nitamhesabia haki Muumba wangu.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

kikuyu: Uwe na hakika kwamba maneno yangu si ya uongo; mmoja aliye mkamilifu katika maarifa yuko pamoja na wewe.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

kikuyu: “Mungu ni mwenye nguvu, lakini hamdharau mwanadamu; ni mwenye nguvu, naye ni thabiti katika shauri lake.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

kikuyu: Hawaachi waovu waendelee kuishi, bali huwapa walioteswa haki yao.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

kikuyu: Yeye haondoi macho yake kwa wenye haki; huwaketisha penye viti vya enzi pamoja na wafalme na kuwatukuza milele.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa watu wamefungwa kwenye minyororo, wakiwa wameshikiliwa na kamba za mateso,
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

kikuyu: huwaonyesha yale waliyoyatenda, kwamba wametenda dhambi kwa majivuno.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

kikuyu: Huwafanya wao kusikia maonyo, na huwaagiza kutubu uovu wao.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

kikuyu: Kama wakitii na kumtumikia, wataishi siku zao zilizobaki katika mafanikio, na miaka yao katika utoshelevu.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

kikuyu: Lakini wasiposikiliza, wataangamia kwa upanga, nao watakufa pasipo maarifa.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

kikuyu: “Wasiomcha Mungu moyoni mwao huficha chuki; hata anapowafunga, hawamwombi msaada.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

kikuyu: Wanakufa wangali vijana, miongoni mwa wanaume hanithi wa mahali pa kuabudia miungu.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

kikuyu: Bali wao wanaoteseka huwaokoa katika mateso yao, na kuzungumza nao katika dhiki zao.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

kikuyu: “Yeye anakubembeleza utoke katika mataya ya dhiki, ili kukuweka mahali palipo na nafasi mbali na kizuizi, hadi kwenye meza yako ya faraja iliyojaa vyakula vizuri.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa umelemewa na hukumu kwa ajili ya uovu; hukumu na haki vimekukamata.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

kikuyu: Uwe mwangalifu ili yeyote asikushawishi kwa utajiri; usipotoshwe kwa fungu kubwa la rushwa.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

kikuyu: Je, utajiri wako hata nguvu zako nyingi vinaweza kukusaidia usiingie kwenye dhiki?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

kikuyu: Usiutamani usiku uje, ili uwaburute watu mbali na nyumba zao.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

kikuyu: Jihadhari usigeukie uovu, ambao unaupenda zaidi kuliko mateso.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

kikuyu: “Mungu ametukuzwa katika nguvu zake. Ni nani aliye mwalimu kama yeye?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

kikuyu: Ni nani aliyemwelekeza katika njia zake, au kumwambia, ‘Wewe umetenda yasiyo sawa’?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

kikuyu: Kumbuka kuzitukuza kazi zake, ambazo watu wamezisifu katika wimbo.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

kikuyu: Wanadamu wote wameiona; watu wanaikazia macho kwa mbali.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi Mungu alivyo mkuu, kupita ufahamu wetu! Hesabu ya miaka yake haitafutiki.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

kikuyu: “Yeye huvuta juu matone ya maji, ayachujayo kama mvua kutoka kwenye vijito;
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

kikuyu: mawingu huangusha chini maji yake, nayo mvua nyingi huwanyeshea wanadamu.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

kikuyu: Ni nani ajuaye jinsi ayatandazavyo mawingu, jinsi angurumavyo kutoka hemani mwake.
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi anavyotandaza umeme wa radi kumzunguka, naye huvifunika vilindi vya bahari.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo atawalavyo mataifa, na kuwapa chakula kwa wingi.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

kikuyu: Huujaza mkono wake kwa umeme wa radi, na kuuagiza kulenga shabaha yake.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

kikuyu: Ngurumo zake hutangaza dhoruba inayokuja; hata mifugo hujulisha kukaribia kwake.
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

kikuyu: “Kwa hili moyo wangu unatetemeka, nao unaruka kutoka mahali pake.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Sikiliza! Sikiliza ngurumo ya sauti yake, sauti ya ngurumo itokayo kinywani mwake.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Huuachilia umeme wake wa radi chini ya mbingu yote na kuupeleka hata miisho ya dunia.
english: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Baada ya hayo huja sauti ya ngurumo yake; Mungu hunguruma kwa sauti yake ya fahari. Wakati sauti yake ingurumapo tena, huuachilia umeme wake wa radi.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Mungu hunguruma kwa namna za ajabu; yeye hutenda mambo makuu kupita ufahamu wetu.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

kikuyu: Huiambia theluji, ‘Anguka juu ya dunia,’ nayo manyunyu ya mvua, ‘Uwe mvua ya nguvu.’
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

kikuyu: Ili wanadamu wote aliowaumba wapate kujua kazi zake, yeye humzuilia kila mtu shughuli zake.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

kikuyu: Wanyama hujificha; hubakia kwenye mapango yao.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

kikuyu: Dhoruba hutoka katika chumba chake, baridi hutoka katika upepo uendao kasi.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

kikuyu: Pumzi ya Mungu hutoa barafu, eneo kubwa la maji huganda.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

kikuyu: Huyasheheneza mawingu kwa maji, naye husambaza umeme wake wa radi kupitia hayo.
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

kikuyu: Nayo mawingu huzungukazunguka pande zote kwa amri yake, juu ya uso wa dunia yote, kufanya lolote ayaamuruyo.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

kikuyu: Huleta mawingu ili kuadhibu wanadamu, au kuinyeshea dunia yake na kuonyesha upendo wake.
english: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

kikuyu: “Ayubu, sikiliza hili; nyamaza na uyafikiri maajabu ya Mungu.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

kikuyu: Je, unajua jinsi Mungu anavyoyaongoza mawingu, na kufanya umeme wake wa radi utoe mwanga?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

kikuyu: Je, wajua jinsi mawingu yanavyokaa yakiwa yametulia, hayo maajabu yake yeye aliye mkamilifu katika maarifa?
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

kikuyu: Wewe unayeshindwa na joto katika nguo zako wakati nchi imenyamazishwa kimya bila upepo wa kusini,
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

kikuyu: je, waweza kuungana naye katika kuzitandaza anga, zilizo ngumu kama kioo cha shaba ya kuyeyushwa?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

kikuyu: “Tuambieni yatupasayo kumwambia; hatuwezi kutayarisha shauri letu kwa sababu ya ujinga wetu.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

kikuyu: Je, aambiwe kwamba nataka kuongea? Je, yuko mtu ambaye angeomba kumezwa?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

kikuyu: Basi hakuna awezaye kulitazama jua, jinsi linavyongʼaa angani, upepo ukishafagia mawingu.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

kikuyu: Kutoka kaskazini yeye huja na fahari kuu; Mungu huja katika utukufu wa kutisha.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

kikuyu: Yeye Mwenyezi hatuwezi kumfikia, naye ametukuzwa katika uweza; katika hukumu zake na haki yake kuu, hataonea.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, wanadamu mheshimuni, kwa kuwa yeye hamstahi yeyote anayejidhania kuwa ana hekima.”
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

kikuyu: Kisha Bwana akamjibu Ayubu kutoka upepo wa kisulisuli. Akasema:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

kikuyu: “Nani huyu atiaye mashauri yangu giza kwa maneno yasiyo na maarifa?
english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

kikuyu: Jikaze kama mwanaume; nitakuuliza swali, nawe unijibu.
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

kikuyu: “Ulikuwa wapi nilipoweka misingi ya dunia? Niambie, kama unafahamu.
english: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

kikuyu: Ni nani aliyeweka alama vipimo vyake? Hakika wewe unajua! Ni nani aliyenyoosha kamba ya kupimia juu yake?
english: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

kikuyu: Je, misingi yake iliwekwa juu ya nini, au ni nani aliyeweka jiwe la pembeni,
english: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

kikuyu: wakati nyota za asubuhi zilipoimba pamoja, na malaika wote walipokuwa wakipiga kelele kwa furaha?
english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

kikuyu: “Ni nani aliyeifungia bahari milango ilipopasuka kutoka tumbo,
english: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

kikuyu: nilipoyafanya mawingu kuwa vazi lake, na kuyafungia katika giza nene,
english: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

kikuyu: nilipoamuru mipaka yake, na kuiweka milango yake na makomeo mahali pake,
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

kikuyu: niliposema, ‘Unaweza kufika mpaka hapa wala si zaidi; hapa ndipo mawimbi yako yenye kiburi yatakapokomea’?
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

kikuyu: “Umepata kuiamrisha asubuhi ipambazuke, au kuyaonyesha mapambazuko mahali pake,
english: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

kikuyu: yapate kushika miisho ya dunia, na kuwakungʼuta waovu waliomo?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

kikuyu: Dunia hubadilika kama udongo wa mfinyanzi chini ya lakiri; sura yake hukaa kama ile ya vazi.
english: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

kikuyu: Waovu huzuiliwa nuru yao, nao mkono wao ulioinuliwa huvunjwa.
english: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

kikuyu: “Je, umepata kufika kwenye chemchemi za bahari? Au kutembea mahali pa ndani pa vilindi?
english: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

kikuyu: Umewahi kuonyeshwa malango ya mauti? Umewahi kuiona milango ya uvuli wa mauti?
english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

kikuyu: Je, wewe unafahamu ukubwa wa dunia? Niambie kama unajua haya yote.
english: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

kikuyu: “Njia ya kufika kwenye makao ya nuru ni ipi? Nako maskani mwa giza ni wapi?
english: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

kikuyu: Je, unaweza kuvirudisha kwenye makao yake? Unajua njia za kufika maskani mwake?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

kikuyu: Hakika unajua, kwa kuwa ulikuwa umeshazaliwa! Kwani umeishi miaka mingi!
english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

kikuyu: “Je, umeshawahi kuingia katika ghala za theluji, au kuona ghala za mvua ya mawe,
english: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

kikuyu: ambazo nimeziweka akiba kwa ajili ya wakati wa taabu, na kwa ajili ya wakati wa vita na mapigano?
english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

kikuyu: Ni ipi njia iendayo mahali umeme wa radi unapotawanyiwa, au mahali upepo wa mashariki unaposambaziwa juu ya dunia?
english: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

kikuyu: Ni nani aliyepasua mifereji kwa ajili ya maji mengi ya mvua yaendayo kasi na njia ya umeme wa radi,
english: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

kikuyu: ili kusababisha mvua kunyeshea mahali pasipokaliwa na mtu, jangwa lisilo na yeyote ndani yake,
english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

kikuyu: ili kuitosheleza nchi ya ukiwa na jangwa, na majani yaanze kumea ndani yake?
english: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

kikuyu: Je, mvua ina baba? Ni nani baba azaaye matone ya umande?
english: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

kikuyu: Barafu inatoka tumbo la nani? Ni nani azaaye ukungu kutoka mbinguni,
english: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

kikuyu: wakati maji yawapo magumu kama jiwe, wakati uso wa vilindi vya maji unapoganda?
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

kikuyu: “Je, waweza kuufunga mnyororo wa Kilimia? Waweza kulegeza kamba za Orioni?
english: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

kikuyu: Waweza kuyaongoza makundi ya nyota kwa majira yake, au kuongoza Dubu na watoto wake?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

kikuyu: Je, unajua sheria zinazotawala mbingu? Waweza kuweka utawala wa Mungu duniani?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

kikuyu: “Waweza kuiinua sauti yako mpaka mawinguni, na kujifunika mwenyewe na gharika ya maji?
english: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

kikuyu: Je, wewe hutuma umeme wa radi kwenye njia zake? Je, hutoa taarifa kwako kukuambia, ‘Sisi tuko hapa’?
english: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

kikuyu: Ni nani aliyeujalia moyo hekima au kuzipa akili ufahamu?
english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

kikuyu: Nani mwenye hekima ya kuyahesabu mawingu? Ni nani awezaye kuinamisha magudulia ya mbinguni
english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

kikuyu: wakati mavumbi yawapo magumu, na mabonge ya udongo kushikamana pamoja?
english: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

kikuyu: “Je, utamwindia simba jike mawindo, na kuwashibisha simba wenye njaa
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

kikuyu: wakati wao wamejikunyata mapangoni mwao, au wakivizia kichakani?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

kikuyu: Ni nani ampaye kunguru chakula wakati makinda yake yanamlilia Mungu, yakizungukazunguka kwa ajili ya kukosa chakula?
english: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

kikuyu: “Je, wajua ni wakati gani mbuzi wa mlimani wanapozaa? Je, watambua ni wakati gani kulungu jike azaapo mtoto wake?
english: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

kikuyu: Je, waweza kuhesabu miezi hadi wazaapo? Je, unajua majira yao ya kuzaa?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

kikuyu: Wao hujiinamisha na kuzaa watoto wao; utungu wa kuzaa unakoma.
english: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

kikuyu: Watoto wao hustawi na kuongezeka nguvu nyikani; huenda zao wala hawarudi tena.
english: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

kikuyu: “Ni nani aliyemwachia punda-mwitu awe huru? Ni nani aliyezifungua kamba zake?
english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

kikuyu: Nimempa nchi isiyokaliwa na watu kuwa masikani yake, nchi ya chumvi kuwa makao yake.
english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

kikuyu: Huzicheka ghasia za mji, wala hasikii kelele za mwendesha gari.
english: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

kikuyu: Huzunguka vilimani kwa ajili ya malisho na kutafuta kila kitu kibichi.
english: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

kikuyu: “Je, nyati atakubali kukutumikia? Atakaa karibu na hori lako usiku?
english: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

kikuyu: Je, waweza kumfungia kwenye matuta kwa kamba? Je, atalima mabonde nyuma yako?
english: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

kikuyu: Je, utamtumainia kwa ajili ya nguvu zake nyingi? Utamwachia yeye kazi zako nzito?
english: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

kikuyu: Utaweza kumwamini akuletee nafaka yako nyumbani kutoka shambani na kuikusanya kwenye sakafu yako ya kupuria?
english: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

kikuyu: “Mbuni hupigapiga mabawa yake kwa furaha, lakini hayawezi kulinganishwa na mabawa na manyoya ya korongo.
english: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

kikuyu: Huyataga mayai yake juu ya ardhi, na kuyaacha yapate joto mchangani,
english: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

kikuyu: bila kujali kuwa mguu waweza kuyaponda, kwamba baadhi ya wanyama wa porini wanaweza kuyakanyaga.
english: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

kikuyu: Yeye huyafanyia makinda yake ukatili kama vile si yake; hajali kwamba taabu yake inaweza ikawa bure,
english: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa Mungu hakumjalia hekima, wala hakumpa fungu la akili njema.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

kikuyu: Lakini akunjuapo mabawa yake kukimbia, humcheka farasi pamoja na yeye aliyempanda.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

kikuyu: “Je, wewe humpa farasi nguvu au kuivika shingo yake manyoya marefu?
english: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

kikuyu: Je, wewe humfanya farasi aruke kama nzige, akistaajabisha kwa tishio la mlio wake wa majivuno?
english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

kikuyu: Huparapara bila woga, akizifurahia nguvu zake, husonga mbele kukabiliana na silaha.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

kikuyu: Huicheka hofu, haogopi chochote, wala haukimbii upanga.
english: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

kikuyu: Podo hutoa sauti kando yake, pamoja na mkuki unaongʼaa na fumo.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

kikuyu: Bila woga na kwa ghadhabu huimeza nchi, wala tarumbeta iliapo yeye hawezi kusimama.
english: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

kikuyu: Asikiapo sauti ya baragumu yeye hulia, ‘Aha!’ Hunusa harufu ya vita toka mbali, sauti ya mtoa amri na ukelele wa vita.
english: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

kikuyu: “Je, mwewe huruka kwa hekima yako na kuyakunjua mabawa yake kuelekea kusini?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

kikuyu: Je, tai hupaa juu kwa amri yako na kujenga kiota chake mahali pa juu?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

kikuyu: Huishi juu ya miamba mirefu na kukaa huko usiku; majabali yenye ncha kali ndiyo ngome yake.
english: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

kikuyu: Kutoka huko hutafuta chakula chake; macho yake hukiona kutoka mbali.
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

kikuyu: Makinda yake hujilisha damu, na pale palipo na machinjo, ndipo yeye alipo.”
english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

kikuyu: Bwana akamwambia Ayubu:
english: Moreover the LORD answered Job,

kikuyu: “Je, mwenye kushindana na Mwenyezi aweza kumsahihisha? Mwenye kumlaumu Mungu na ajibu.”
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akamjibu Bwana:
english: Then Job answered the LORD,

kikuyu: “Mimi sistahili kabisa: ninawezaje kukujibu wewe? Nauweka mkono wangu juu ya kinywa changu.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

kikuyu: Nimesema mara moja, lakini sina jibu; naam, nimesema mara mbili, lakini sitasema tena.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana akasema na Ayubu kutoka upepo wa kisulisuli:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

kikuyu: “Jikaze kama mwanaume; nitakuuliza maswali, nawe yakupasa unijibu.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

kikuyu: “Je, utabatilisha hukumu yangu? Utanilaumu mimi ili kujihesabia haki mwenyewe?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

kikuyu: Je, una mkono kama wa Mungu, nawe waweza kutoa sauti ya ngurumo kama yake?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

kikuyu: Basi jivike mwenyewe utukufu na fahari, nawe uvae heshima na enzi.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Fungulia ukali wa ghadhabu yako, mtafute kila mwenye kiburi umshushe,
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

kikuyu: mwangalie kila mtu mwenye kiburi na umnyenyekeze, waponde waovu mahali wasimamapo.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

kikuyu: Wazike wote mavumbini pamoja; wafunge nyuso zao kaburini.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

kikuyu: Ndipo mimi mwenyewe nitakukubalia kuwa mkono wako mwenyewe wa kuume unaweza kukuokoa.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

kikuyu: “Mwangalie mnyama aitwaye Behemothi, niliyemuumba kama nilivyokuumba wewe, anayekula majani kama ngʼombe.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

kikuyu: Tazama basi nguvu alizo nazo kwenye viuno vyake, uwezo alio nao kwenye misuli ya tumbo lake!
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

kikuyu: Mkia wake hutikisika kama mwerezi; mishipa ya mapaja yake imesukwa pamoja.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

kikuyu: Mifupa yake ni bomba za shaba, maungo yake ni kama fito za chuma.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

kikuyu: Yeye ni wa kwanza miongoni mwa kazi za Mungu, lakini Muumba wake anaweza kumsogelea kwa upanga wake.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

kikuyu: Vilima humletea yeye mazao yake, nao wanyama wote wa porini hucheza karibu naye.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

kikuyu: Hulala chini ya mimea ya yungiyungi, katika maficho ya matete kwenye matope.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

kikuyu: Hiyo mimea ya yungiyungi humficha kwenye vivuli vyake; miti mirefu karibu na kijito humzunguka.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

kikuyu: Wakati mto ufurikapo, yeye hapati mshtuko wa hofu; yeye yu salama, hata kama Yordani ingefurika hadi kwenye kinywa chake.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

kikuyu: Je, mtu yeyote anaweza kumkamata yeye akiwa macho, au kumnasa kwa mtego na kutoboa pua yake?
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

kikuyu: “Je, waweza kumvua Lewiathani kwa ndoano ya samaki, au kufunga ulimi wake kwa kamba?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

kikuyu: Waweza kupitisha kamba puani mwake, au kutoboa taya lake kwa kulabu?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

kikuyu: Je, ataendelea kukuomba umhurumie? Atasema nawe maneno ya upole?
english: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

kikuyu: Je, atafanya agano nawe ili umtwae awe mtumishi wako maisha yake yote?
english: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

kikuyu: Je, utamfuga na kumfanya rafiki kama ndege, au kumfunga kamba kwa ajili ya wasichana wako?
english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

kikuyu: Je, wafanyabiashara watabadilishana bidhaa kwa ajili yake? Watamgawanya miongoni mwa wafanyao biashara?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

kikuyu: Je, waweza kuijaza ngozi yake kwa vyuma vyenye ncha kali, au kichwa chake kwa mkuki wa kuvulia samaki?
english: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

kikuyu: Kama ukiweka mkono wako juu yake, utavikumbuka hivyo vita na kamwe hutarudia tena!
english: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

kikuyu: Tumaini lolote la kumtiisha ni kujidanganya; kule kumwona tu kunamwangusha mtu chini.
english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

kikuyu: Hakuna yeyote aliye mkali athubutuye kumchokoza. Ni nani basi awezaye kusimama dhidi yangu?
english: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

kikuyu: Ni nani mwenye madai dhidi yangu ili nipate kumlipa? Kila kitu kilicho chini ya mbingu ni mali yangu.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

kikuyu: “Sitashindwa kunena juu ya maungo yake, nguvu zake na umbo lake zuri.
english: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

kikuyu: Ni nani awezaye kumvua gamba lake la nje? Ni nani awezaye kumsogelea na lijamu?
english: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

kikuyu: Nani athubutuye kuufungua mlango wa kinywa chake, kilichozungukwa na meno yake ya kutisha pande zote?
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

kikuyu: Mgongo wake una safu za ngao zilizoshikamanishwa imara pamoja;
english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

kikuyu: kila moja iko karibu sana na mwenzake, wala hakuna hewa iwezayo kupita kati yake.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

kikuyu: Zimeunganishwa imara kila moja na nyingine; zimengʼangʼaniana pamoja wala haziwezi kutenganishwa.
english: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

kikuyu: Akipiga chafya mwanga humetameta; macho yake ni kama mionzi ya mapambazuko.
english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

kikuyu: Mienge iwakayo humiminika kutoka kinywani mwake; cheche za moto huruka nje.
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

kikuyu: Moshi hufuka kutoka puani mwake, kama kutoka kwenye chungu kinachotokota kwa moto wa matete.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

kikuyu: Pumzi yake huwasha makaa ya mawe, nayo miali ya moto huruka kutoka kinywani mwake.
english: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Nguvu hukaa katika shingo yake; utisho hutangulia mbele yake.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

kikuyu: Mikunjo ya nyama yake imeshikamana imara pamoja; iko imara na haiwezi kuondolewa.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Kifua chake ni kigumu kama mwamba, kigumu kama jiwe la chini la kusagia.
english: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

kikuyu: Ainukapo, mashujaa wanaogopa; hurudi nyuma mbele yake anapokwenda kwa kishindo.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

kikuyu: Upanga unaomfikia haumdhuru, wala mkuki au mshale wala fumo.
english: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

kikuyu: Chuma hukiona kama unyasi, na shaba kama mti uliooza.
english: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

kikuyu: Mishale haimfanyi yeye akimbie; mawe ya kombeo kwake ni kama makapi.
english: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

kikuyu: Rungu kwake huwa kama kipande cha jani kavu; hucheka sauti za kugongana kwa mkuki.
english: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

kikuyu: Sehemu zake za chini kwenye tumbo zina menomeno na mapengo kama vigae vya chungu, zikiacha mburuzo kwenye matope kama chombo chenye meno cha kupuria.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

kikuyu: Huvisukasuka vilindi kama sufuria kubwa ichemkayo, na kukoroga bahari kama chungu cha marhamu.
english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

kikuyu: Anapopita nyuma yake huacha mkondo unaometameta; mtu angedhani vilindi vilikuwa na mvi.
english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

kikuyu: Hakuna chochote duniani kinacholingana naye: yeye ni kiumbe kisicho na woga.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

kikuyu: Yeye huwatazama chini wale wote wenye kujivuna; yeye ni mfalme juu ya wote wenye kiburi.”
english: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Ayubu akamjibu Bwana:
english: Then Job answered the LORD:

kikuyu: “Ninajua ya kuwa unaweza kufanya mambo yote, wala hakuna mpango wako unaoweza kuzuilika.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

kikuyu: Uliuliza, ‘Ni nani huyu afichaye mashauri yangu bila maarifa?’ Hakika nilisema juu ya mambo niliyokuwa siyaelewi, mambo ya ajabu mno kwangu mimi kuyajua.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

kikuyu: “Ulisema, ‘Sikiliza sasa, nami nitanena; nitakuuliza swali, nawe yakupasa kunijibu.’
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

kikuyu: Masikio yangu yalikuwa yamesikia habari zako, lakini sasa macho yangu yamekuona.
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo najidharau mwenyewe, na kutubu katika mavumbi na majivu.”
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

kikuyu: Baada ya Bwana kusema mambo haya yote na Ayubu, akamwambia Elifazi Mtemani, “Nina hasira juu yako na juu ya rafiki zako wawili, kwa sababu hamkusema yaliyo sawa kwa habari yangu, kama alivyosema mtumishi wangu Ayubu.
english: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

kikuyu: Basi sasa chukueni mafahali saba na kondoo dume saba mkamwendee mtumishi wangu Ayubu nanyi mkatoe sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa ajili yenu wenyewe. Mtumishi wangu Ayubu ataomba kwa ajili yenu, nami nitayakubali maombi yake ili nisiwatendee sawasawa na upumbavu wenu. Ninyi hamkusema yaliyo sawa kwa habari yangu, kama alivyosema mtumishi wangu Ayubu.”
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Elifazi Mtemani, Bildadi Mshuhi, na Sofari Mnaamathi wakafanya kama Bwana alivyowaambia; naye Bwana akayakubali maombi ya Ayubu.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.

kikuyu: Baada ya Ayubu kuwaombea rafiki zake, Bwana akamwondoa kwenye uteka, akamfanikisha tena naye akampa mara mbili ya vile alivyokuwa navyo hapo mwanzoni.
english: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

kikuyu: Ndipo ndugu zake wote waume kwa wake na kila mtu aliyemfahamu mwanzoni, wakaja wakala pamoja naye katika nyumba yake. Wakamfariji na kumtuliza moyo juu ya taabu yote Bwana aliyoileta juu yake, nao kila mmoja akampa kipande cha fedha na pete ya dhahabu.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

kikuyu: Bwana akaibariki sehemu ya mwisho ya maisha ya Ayubu kuliko ile ya kwanza. Alikuwa na kondoo elfu kumi na nne, ngamia elfu sita, jozi za mafahali elfu moja, na punda wa kike elfu moja.
english: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

kikuyu: Tena alikuwa na wana saba na binti watatu.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Binti wa kwanza aliitwa Yemima, wa pili Kesia na wa tatu Keren-Hapuki.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

kikuyu: Hapakuwepo mahali popote katika nchi ile yote palipopatikana wanawake wazuri kama binti za Ayubu; naye baba yao akawapa urithi pamoja na ndugu zao.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

kikuyu: Baada ya hili Ayubu akaishi miaka 140; akawaona wanawe na wana wa wanawe hata kizazi cha nne.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

kikuyu: Hivyo Ayubu akafa, akiwa mzee aliyekuwa ameshiba siku.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

kikuyu: Heri mtu yule ambaye haendi katika shauri la watu waovu, wala hasimami katika njia ya wenye dhambi, au kuketi katika baraza la wenye mizaha.
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

kikuyu: Bali huifurahia sheria ya Bwana, naye huitafakari hiyo sheria usiku na mchana.
english: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kikuyu: Mtu huyo ni kama mti uliopandwa kando ya vijito vya maji, ambao huzaa matunda kwa majira yake na majani yake hayanyauki. Lolote afanyalo hufanikiwa.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

kikuyu: Sivyo walivyo waovu! Wao ni kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo waovu hawatastahimili hukumu, wala wenye dhambi katika kusanyiko la wenye haki.
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana huziangalia njia za mwenye haki, bali njia ya waovu itaangamia.
english: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

kikuyu: Kwa nini mataifa wanashauriana kufanya mabaya, na kabila za watu kula njama bure?
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Wafalme wa dunia wanajipanga na watawala wanajikusanya pamoja dhidi ya Bwana na dhidi ya Mpakwa Mafuta wake.
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

kikuyu: Wanasema, “Tuvunje minyororo yao na kuvitupilia mbali vifungo vyao.”
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

kikuyu: Yeye atawalaye mbinguni hucheka, Bwana huwadharau.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

kikuyu: Kisha huwakemea katika hasira yake na kuwaogopesha katika ghadhabu yake, akisema,
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

kikuyu: “Nimemtawaza Mfalme wangu juu ya Sayuni, mlima wangu mtakatifu.”
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

kikuyu: Nitatangaza amri ya Bwana: Yeye aliniambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu, leo mimi nimekuzaa.
english: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

kikuyu: Niombe, nami nitayafanya mataifa kuwa urithi wako, miisho ya dunia kuwa milki yako.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

kikuyu: Utawatawala kwa fimbo ya chuma na kuwavunjavunja kama chombo cha mfinyanzi.”
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, ninyi wafalme, kuweni na hekima; mwonyeke, enyi watawala wa dunia.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

kikuyu: Mtumikieni Bwana kwa hofu na mshangilie kwa kutetemeka.
english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

kikuyu: Mbusu Mwana, asije akakasirika nawe ukaangamizwa katika njia yako, kwa maana hasira yake inaweza kuwaka ghafula. Heri wote wanaomkimbilia.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Alipomkimbia mwanawe Absalomu. Ee Bwana, tazama adui zangu walivyo wengi! Ni wengi kiasi gani wanaoinuka dhidi yangu!
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Wengi wanasema juu yangu, “Mungu hatamwokoa.”
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, ni ngao pande zote; umeniwekea utukufu na kuinua kichwa changu.
english: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

kikuyu: Ninamlilia Bwana kwa sauti kuu, naye ananijibu kutoka mlima wake mtakatifu.
english: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

kikuyu: Ninajilaza na kupata usingizi; naamka tena, kwa maana Bwana hunitegemeza.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

kikuyu: Sitaogopa makumi elfu ya adui, wanaojipanga dhidi yangu kila upande.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, amka! Niokoe, Ee Mungu wangu! Wapige adui zangu wote kwenye taya, vunja meno ya waovu.
english: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wokovu watoka kwa Bwana. Baraka yako na iwe juu ya watu wako.
english: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za muziki. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nijibu nikuitapo, Ee Mungu wangu mwenye haki! Nipumzishe katika shida zangu; nirehemu, usikie ombi langu.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

kikuyu: Enyi watu, mtabadilisha utukufu wangu kuwa aibu mpaka lini? Mtapenda udanganyifu na kufuata miungu ya uongo mpaka lini?
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

kikuyu: Fahamuni hakika kwamba Bwana amewatenga wale wamchao kwa ajili yake; Bwana atanisikia nimwitapo.
english: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

kikuyu: Katika hasira yako, usitende dhambi. Mkiwa vitandani mwenu, mtulie kimya mkiichunguza mioyo yenu.
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

kikuyu: Toeni dhabihu zilizo haki; mtegemeeni Bwana.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Wengi wanauliza, “Ni nani awezaye kutuonyesha jema lolote?” Ee Bwana, tuangazie nuru ya uso wako.
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

kikuyu: Wewe umejaza moyo wangu kwa furaha kubwa kuliko watu waliopata nafaka na divai kwa wingi.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

kikuyu: Nitajilaza chini na kulala kwa amani, kwa kuwa wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana, waniwezesha kukaa kwa salama.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa filimbi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, tegea sikio maneno yangu, uangalie kupiga kite kwangu.
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

kikuyu: Sikiliza kilio changu ili unisaidie, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, kwa maana kwako ninaomba.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

kikuyu: Asubuhi, unasikia sauti yangu, Ee Bwana; asubuhi naleta haja zangu mbele zako, na kusubiri kwa matumaini.
english: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

kikuyu: Wewe si Mungu unayefurahia uovu, kwako mtu mwovu hataishi.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

kikuyu: Wenye kiburi hawawezi kusimama mbele yako, unawachukia wote watendao mabaya.
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Unawaangamiza wasemao uongo. Bwana huwachukia wamwagao damu na wadanganyifu.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi, kwa rehema zako kuu, nitakuja katika nyumba yako, kwa unyenyekevu, nitasujudu kuelekea Hekalu lako takatifu.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

kikuyu: Niongoze katika haki yako, Ee Bwana, kwa sababu ya adui zangu, nyoosha njia yako mbele yangu.
english: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

kikuyu: Hakuna neno kinywani mwao linaloweza kuaminika, mioyo yao imejaa maangamizi. Koo lao ni kaburi lililo wazi, kwa ndimi zao, wao hunena udanganyifu.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

kikuyu: Uwatangaze kuwa wenye hatia, Ee Mungu! Hila zao ziwe anguko lao wenyewe. Wafukuzie mbali kwa sababu ya dhambi zao nyingi, kwa kuwa wamekuasi wewe.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

kikuyu: Lakini wote wakimbiliao kwako na wafurahi, waimbe kwa shangwe daima. Ueneze ulinzi wako juu yao, ili wale wapendao jina lako wapate kukushangilia.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

kikuyu: Kwa hakika, Ee Bwana, unawabariki wenye haki, unawazunguka kwa wema wako kama ngao.
english: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za muziki. Mtindo wa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, usinikemee katika hasira yako, wala usiniadhibu katika ghadhabu yako.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

kikuyu: Unirehemu Bwana, kwa maana nimedhoofika; Ee Bwana, uniponye, kwa maana mifupa yangu ina maumivu makali.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu ina uchungu mwingi. Mpaka lini, Ee Bwana, mpaka lini?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

kikuyu: Geuka Ee Bwana, unikomboe, uniokoe kwa sababu ya fadhili zako.
english: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu anayekukumbuka akiwa amekufa. Ni nani awezaye kukusifu akiwa kuzimu?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

kikuyu: Nimechakaa kwa kulia kwa huzuni; usiku kucha nafurikisha kitanda changu kwa machozi; nimelowesha viti vyangu vya fahari kwa machozi.
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

kikuyu: Macho yangu yamedhoofika kwa kuhuzunika, yamedhoofika kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

kikuyu: Kaeni mbali nami, ninyi nyote mtendao mabaya, kwa maana Bwana amesikia kulia kwangu.
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

kikuyu: Bwana amesikia kilio changu kwa huruma, Bwana amekubali sala yangu.
english: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

kikuyu: Adui zangu wote wataaibika na kufadhaika, watarudi nyuma kwa aibu ya ghafula.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

kikuyu: Ombolezo la Daudi kwa Bwana kwa sababu ya Kushi, Mbenyamini. Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, ninakukimbilia wewe, uniokoe na kunikomboa na wote wanaonifuatia,
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

kikuyu: la sivyo watanirarua kama simba na kunichana vipande vipande, asiwepo wa kuniokoa.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, kama nimetenda haya na kuna hatia mikononi mwangu,
english: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

kikuyu: au ikiwa nimemtenda uovu aliye na amani nami, au nimemnyangʼanya adui yangu pasipo sababu,
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

kikuyu: basi adui anifuatie na kunipata, auponde uhai wangu ardhini na kunilaza mavumbini.
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

kikuyu: Amka kwa hasira yako, Ee Bwana, inuka dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu. Amka, Mungu wangu, uamue haki.
english: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

kikuyu: Kusanyiko la watu na likuzunguke. Watawale kutoka juu.
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

kikuyu: Bwana na awahukumu kabila za watu. Nihukumu Ee Bwana, kwa kadiri ya haki yangu, kwa kadiri ya uadilifu wangu, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.
english: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu mwenye haki, uchunguzaye mawazo na mioyo, komesha ghasia za waovu na ufanye wenye haki waishi kwa amani.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

kikuyu: Ngao langu ni Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, awaokoaye wanyofu wa moyo.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Mungu ni mwamuzi mwenye haki, Mungu aghadhibikaye kila siku.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

kikuyu: Kama hakutuhurumia, atanoa upanga wake, ataupinda na kuufunga uzi upinde wake.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

kikuyu: Ameandaa silaha zake kali, ameweka tayari mishale yake ya moto.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

kikuyu: Yeye aliye na mimba ya uovu na achukuaye mimba ya ghasia huzaa uongo.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

kikuyu: Yeye achimbaye shimo na kulifukua hutumbukia katika shimo alilochimba mwenyewe.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

kikuyu: Ghasia azianzishazo humrudia mwenyewe, ukatili wake humrudia kichwani.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

kikuyu: Nitamshukuru Bwana kwa ajili ya haki yake, na nitaliimbia sifa jina la Bwana Aliye Juu Sana.
english: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote! Umeuweka utukufu wako juu ya mbingu.
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

kikuyu: Midomoni mwa watoto wachanga na wanyonyao umeamuru sifa, kwa sababu ya watesi wako, kumnyamazisha adui na mlipiza kisasi.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Nikiziangalia mbingu zako, kazi ya vidole vyako, mwezi na nyota, ulizoziratibisha,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

kikuyu: mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata unamfikiria, binadamu ni nani hata unamjali?
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Umemfanya chini kidogo kuliko viumbe wa mbinguni, ukamvika taji ya utukufu na heshima.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Umemfanya mtawala juu ya kazi za mikono yako; umeweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

kikuyu: Mifugo na makundi yote pia, naam, na wanyama wa kondeni,
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

kikuyu: ndege wa angani na samaki wa baharini, naam, kila kiogeleacho katika njia za bahari.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, Bwana wetu, tazama jinsi lilivyo tukufu jina lako duniani mwote!
english: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa muth-labeni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nitakutukuza kwa moyo wangu wote, nitayasimulia matendo yako yote ya ajabu.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

kikuyu: Nitafurahi na kushangilia ndani yako. Nitaliimbia sifa jina lako, Ewe Uliye Juu Sana.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

kikuyu: Adui zangu wamerudi nyuma, wamejikwaa na kuangamia mbele zako.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

kikuyu: Kwa maana umetetea haki yangu na msimamo wangu; umeketi kwenye kiti chako cha enzi, ukihukumu kwa haki.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

kikuyu: Umekemea mataifa na kuwaangamiza waovu; umeyafuta majina yao milele na milele.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Uharibifu usiokoma umempata adui, umeingʼoa miji yao; hata kumbukumbu lao limetoweka.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

kikuyu: Bwana anatawala milele, ameweka kiti chake cha enzi apate kuhukumu.
english: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

kikuyu: Mungu atahukumu ulimwengu kwa haki, atatawala mataifa kwa haki.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

kikuyu: Bwana ni kimbilio la watu wanaoonewa, ni ngome imara wakati wa shida.
english: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

kikuyu: Wote wanaolijua jina lako watakutumaini wewe, kwa maana wewe Bwana, hujawaacha kamwe wakutafutao.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Bwana sifa, amefanywa mtawala Sayuni, tangazeni miongoni mwa mataifa, yale aliyoyatenda.
english: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeye alipizaye kisasi cha damu hukumbuka, hapuuzi kilio cha wanaoonewa.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi walivyo wengi adui zangu wanaonitesa! Nihurumie, uniinue kutoka malango ya mauti,
english: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

kikuyu: ili niweze kutangaza sifa zako katika malango ya Binti Sayuni na huko niushangilie wokovu wako.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Mataifa wameanguka kwenye shimo walilolichimba, miguu yao imenaswa kwenye wavu waliouficha.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

kikuyu: Bwana anajulikana kwa haki yake, waovu wamenaswa katika kazi za mikono yao.
english: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

kikuyu: Waovu wataishia kuzimu, naam, mataifa yote wanaomsahau Mungu.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

kikuyu: Lakini mhitaji hatasahaulika siku zote, wala matumaini ya walioonewa hayatapotea.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, inuka, usimwache binadamu ashinde. Mataifa na yahukumiwe mbele zako.
english: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wapige kwa hofu, mataifa na yajue kuwa wao ni watu tu.
english: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

kikuyu: Kwa nini, Ee Bwana, unasimama mbali? Kwa nini unajificha wakati wa shida?
english: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

kikuyu: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu humtesa maskini, waovu na wanaswe katika hila wanazozitunga.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

kikuyu: Hujivunia tamaa za moyo wake; humbariki mlafi na kumtukana Bwana.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

kikuyu: Katika kiburi chake, mwovu hamtafuti Mungu, katika mawazo yake yote hakuna nafasi ya Mungu.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

kikuyu: Njia zake daima hufanikiwa; hujivuna na amri zako ziko mbali naye, huwacheka kwa dharau adui zake wote.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

kikuyu: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Hakuna kitakachonitikisa, daima nitakuwa na furaha, kamwe sitakuwa na shida.”
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

kikuyu: Kinywa chake kimejaa laana, uongo na vitisho; shida na ubaya viko chini ya ulimi wake.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

kikuyu: Huvizia karibu na vijiji; kutoka mafichoni huwanasa wasio na hatia, akivizia wapitaji.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

kikuyu: Huvizia kama simba aliye mawindoni; huvizia kumkamata mnyonge, huwakamata wanyonge na kuwaburuza katika wavu wake.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

kikuyu: Mateka wake hupondwa, huzimia; wanaanguka katika nguvu zake.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

kikuyu: Anajisemea mwenyewe, “Mungu amesahau, huficha uso wake na haoni kabisa.”
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

kikuyu: Inuka Bwana! Inua mkono wako, Ee Mungu. Usiwasahau wanyonge.
english: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

kikuyu: Kwa nini mtu mwovu anamtukana Mungu? Kwa nini anajiambia mwenyewe, “Hataniita nitoe hesabu?”
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, unaona shida na huzuni, umekubali kuyapokea mkononi mwako. Mhanga anajisalimisha kwako, wewe ni msaada wa yatima.
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

kikuyu: Vunja mkono wa mtu mwovu na mbaya, mwite atoe hesabu ya maovu yake ambayo yasingejulikana.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

kikuyu: Bwana ni Mfalme milele na milele, mataifa wataangamia watoke nchini mwake.
english: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

kikuyu: Unasikia, Ee Bwana, shauku ya wanaoonewa, wewe huwatia moyo, na kusikiliza kilio chao,
english: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

kikuyu: ukiwatetea yatima na walioonewa, ili mwanadamu, ambaye ni udongo, asiogopeshe tena.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Kwa Bwana ninakimbilia, unawezaje basi kuniambia: “Ruka kama ndege kwenye mlima wako.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

kikuyu: Hebu tazama, waovu wanapinda pinde zao, huweka mishale kwenye uzi wake, wakiwa gizani ili kuwapiga wale wanyofu wa moyo.
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Wakati misingi imeharibiwa, mwenye haki anaweza kufanya nini?”
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

kikuyu: Bwana yuko ndani ya Hekalu lake takatifu; Bwana yuko kwenye kiti chake cha enzi mbinguni. Huwaangalia wana wa watu, macho yake yanawajaribu.
english: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

kikuyu: Bwana huwajaribu wenye haki, lakini waovu na wanaopenda jeuri, nafsi yake huwachukia.
english: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

kikuyu: Atawanyeshea waovu makaa ya moto mkali na kiberiti kinachowaka, upepo wenye joto kali ndio fungu lao.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwenye haki, yeye hupenda haki. Wanyofu watauona uso wake.
english: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana tusaidie, kwa kuwa wacha Mungu wametoweka; waaminifu wametoweka miongoni mwa wanadamu.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Kila mmoja humwambia jirani yake uongo; midomo yao ya hila huzungumza kwa udanganyifu.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

kikuyu: Bwana na akatilie mbali midomo yote ya hila na kila ulimi uliojaa majivuno,
english: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

kikuyu: ule unaosema, “Kwa ndimi zetu tutashinda; midomo ni mali yetu, bwana wetu ni nani?”
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

kikuyu: “Kwa sababu ya uonevu wa wanyonge na kulia kwa uchungu kwa wahitaji, nitainuka sasa,” asema Bwana. “Nitawalinda kutokana na wale wenye nia mbaya juu yao.”
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

kikuyu: Maneno ya Bwana ni safi, kama fedha iliyosafishwa katika tanuru, iliyosafishwa mara saba.
english: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, utatuweka salama na kutulinda na kizazi hiki milele.
english: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

kikuyu: Watu waovu huenda wakiringa kila mahali wakati ambapo yule aliye mbaya sana ndiye anayeheshimiwa miongoni mwa watu.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpaka lini, Ee Bwana? Je, utanisahau milele? Utanificha uso wako mpaka lini?
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Nitapambana na mawazo yangu mpaka lini, na kila siku kuwa na majonzi moyoni mwangu? Adui zangu watanishinda mpaka lini?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

kikuyu: Nitazame, unijibu, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu. Yatie nuru macho yangu, ama sivyo nitalala usingizi wa mauti.
english: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

kikuyu: Adui yangu atasema, “Nimemshinda,” nao adui zangu watashangilia nitakapoanguka.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

kikuyu: Lakini ninategemea upendo wako usiokoma; moyo wangu unashangilia katika wokovu wako.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

kikuyu: Nitamwimbia Bwana, kwa kuwa amekuwa mwema kwangu.
english: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, “Hakuna Mungu.” Wameharibika, matendo yao ni maovu kabisa; hakuna hata mmoja atendaye mema.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Bwana anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.
english: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

kikuyu: Wote wamepotoka, wameharibika wote pamoja, hakuna atendaye mema. Naam, hakuna hata mmoja!
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Bwana?
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

kikuyu: Wako hapo, wameingiwa na hofu kuu, maana Mungu yupo pamoja na wenye haki.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Ninyi watenda mabaya mnakwamisha mipango ya maskini, bali Bwana ndiye kimbilio lao.
english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

kikuyu: Laiti wokovu wa Israeli ungalikuja kutoka Sayuni! Wakati Bwana arejeshapo wafungwa wa watu wake, Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana, ni nani awezaye kukaa katika Hekalu lako? Nani awezaye kuishi katika mlima wako mtakatifu?
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

kikuyu: Ni yule aendaye pasipo mawaa, atendaye yaliyo haki, asemaye kweli toka moyoni mwake,
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

kikuyu: na hana masingizio ulimini mwake, asiyemtenda jirani yake vibaya, na asiyemsingizia mwenzake,
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

kikuyu: ambaye humdharau mtu mbaya, lakini huwaheshimu wale wamwogopao Bwana, yule atunzaye kiapo chake hata kama anaumia.
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

kikuyu: Yeye akopeshaye fedha yake bila riba, na hapokei rushwa dhidi ya mtu asiye na hatia. Mtu afanyaye haya kamwe hatatikisika.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

kikuyu: Utenzi wa Daudi. Ee Mungu, uniweke salama, kwa maana kwako nimekimbilia.
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Nilimwambia Bwana, “Wewe ndiwe Bwana wangu; pasipo wewe sina jambo jema.”
english: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

kikuyu: Kwa habari ya watakatifu walioko duniani, ndio walio wa fahari ambao ninapendezwa nao.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

kikuyu: Huzuni itaongezeka kwa wale wanaokimbilia miungu mingine. Sitazimimina sadaka zao za damu au kutaja majina yao midomoni mwangu.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

kikuyu: Bwana umeniwekea fungu langu na kikombe changu; umeyafanya mambo yangu yote yawe salama.
english: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

kikuyu: Alama za mipaka zimeniangukia mahali pazuri, hakika nimepata urithi mzuri.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

kikuyu: Nitamsifu Bwana ambaye hunishauri, hata wakati wa usiku moyo wangu hunifundisha.
english: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

kikuyu: Nimemweka Bwana mbele yangu daima. Kwa sababu yuko mkono wangu wa kuume, sitatikisika.
english: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu unafurahia, na ulimi wangu unashangilia; mwili wangu nao utapumzika salama,
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

kikuyu: kwa maana hutaniacha kaburini, wala hutamwacha Mtakatifu Wako kuona uharibifu.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

kikuyu: Umenijulisha njia ya uzima; utanijaza na furaha mbele zako, pamoja na furaha za milele katika mkono wako wa kuume.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

kikuyu: Sala ya Daudi. Sikia, Ee Bwana, kusihi kwangu kwa haki, sikiliza kilio changu. Tega sikio kwa ombi langu, halitoki kwenye midomo ya udanganyifu.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

kikuyu: Hukumu yangu na itoke kwako, macho yako na yaone yale yaliyo haki.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

kikuyu: Ingawa unauchunguza moyo wangu na kunikagua usiku, ingawa umenijaribu, hutaona chochote. Nimeamua kwamba kinywa changu hakitatenda dhambi.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

kikuyu: Kuhusu matendo ya wanadamu: kwa neno la midomo yako, nimejiepusha na njia za wenye jeuri.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

kikuyu: Hatua zangu zimeshikamana na njia zako; nyayo zangu hazikuteleza.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, ninakuita, kwa kuwa utanijibu, nitegee sikio lako na usikie ombi langu.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

kikuyu: Uonyeshe ajabu ya upendo wako mkuu, wewe uokoaye kwa mkono wako wa kuume wale wanaokukimbilia kutokana na adui zao.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

kikuyu: Nilinde kama mboni ya jicho lako, unifiche chini ya kivuli cha mbawa zako
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
