kikuyu: kutokana na waovu wanaonishambulia, kutokana na adui wauaji wanaonizunguka.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

kikuyu: Huifunga mioyo yao iliyo migumu, vinywa vyao hunena kwa majivuno.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

kikuyu: Wamenifuatia nyayo zangu, sasa wamenizingira, wakiwa macho, waniangushe chini.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

kikuyu: Wamefanana na simba mwenye njaa awindaye, kama simba mkubwa anyemeleaye mafichoni.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

kikuyu: Inuka, Ee Bwana, pambana nao, uwaangushe, niokoe kutokana na waovu kwa upanga wako.
english: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, mkono wako uniokoe na watu wa jinsi hii, kutokana na watu wa ulimwengu huu ambao fungu lao liko katika maisha haya. Na wapate adhabu ya kuwatosha. Watoto wao na wapate zaidi ya hayo, hukumu na iendelee kwa watoto wa watoto wao.
english: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

kikuyu: Na mimi katika haki nitauona uso wako, niamkapo, nitaridhika kwa kuona sura yako.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi mtumishi wa Bwana aliyomwimbia Bwana wakati Bwana alipomwokoa mikononi mwa adui zake wote, na pia mkononi mwa Sauli. Alisema hivi: Nakupenda wewe, Ee Bwana, nguvu yangu.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwamba wangu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, Mungu wangu ni mwamba, ambaye kwake ninakimbilia. Yeye ni ngao yangu na pembe ya wokovu wangu, ngome yangu.
english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

kikuyu: Ninamwita Bwana anayestahili kusifiwa, nami ninaokolewa kutoka kwa adui zangu.
english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

kikuyu: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, mafuriko ya maangamizi yalinilemea.
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

kikuyu: Kamba za kuzimu zilinizunguka, mitego ya mauti ilinikabili.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

kikuyu: Katika shida yangu nalimwita Bwana, nilimlilia Mungu wangu anisaidie. Kutoka hekaluni mwake alisikia sauti yangu, kilio changu kikafika mbele zake, masikioni mwake.
english: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

kikuyu: Dunia ilitetemeka na kutikisika, misingi ya milima ikatikisika, vilitetemeka kwa sababu alikuwa amekasirika.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

kikuyu: Moshi ukapanda kutoka puani mwake, moto uteketezao ukatoka kinywani mwake, makaa ya moto yawakayo yakatoka ndani mwake.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

kikuyu: Akazipasua mbingu akashuka chini, mawingu meusi yalikuwa chini ya miguu yake.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

kikuyu: Alipanda juu ya kerubi akaruka, akapaa juu kwa mbawa za upepo.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Alifanya giza kuwa kitu chake cha kujifunika, hema lake kumzunguka, mawingu meusi ya mvua ya angani.
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

kikuyu: Kutokana na mwanga wa uwepo wake mawingu yalisogea, ikanyesha mvua ya mawe na umeme wa radi.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Bwana alinguruma kutoka mbinguni, sauti ya Aliye Juu Sana ilisikika.
english: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Aliipiga mishale yake na kutawanya adui, naam, umeme mwingi wa radi na kuwafukuza.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

kikuyu: Mabonde ya bahari yalifunuliwa, na misingi ya dunia ikawa wazi kwa kukaripia kwako, Ee Bwana, kwa uvumi wa pumzi kutoka puani mwako.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

kikuyu: Alinyoosha mkono kutoka juu na kunishika; alinitoa kutoka kilindi cha maji makuu.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

kikuyu: Aliniokoa kutoka adui wangu mwenye nguvu nyingi, kutoka adui zangu waliokuwa na nguvu nyingi kuliko mimi.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

kikuyu: Walinikabili siku ya msiba wangu, lakini Bwana alikuwa msaada wangu.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

kikuyu: Alinileta nje mahali penye nafasi tele, akaniokoa kwa kuwa alipendezwa nami.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

kikuyu: Bwana alinitendea sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu amenilipa.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nimezishika njia za Bwana; sijatenda ubaya nikamwacha Mungu wangu.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

kikuyu: Sheria zake zote zi mbele yangu, wala sijayaacha maagizo yake.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

kikuyu: Nimekuwa sina hatia mbele zake, nami nimejilinda nisitende dhambi.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Bwana amenilipa sawasawa na uadilifu wangu; sawasawa na usafi wa mikono yangu machoni pake.
english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

kikuyu: Kwa yeye aliye mwaminifu, unajionyesha kuwa mwaminifu, kwa asiye na hatia, unajionyesha kutokuwa na hatia.
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

kikuyu: Kwa aliye mtakatifu, unajionyesha kuwa mtakatifu, lakini kwa aliyepotoka, unajionyesha kuwa mkaidi.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

kikuyu: Wewe huwaokoa wanyenyekevu, lakini huwashusha wenye kiburi.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

kikuyu: Wewe, Ee Bwana, unaifanya taa yangu iendelee kuwaka; Mungu wangu hulifanya giza langu kuwa mwanga.
english: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

kikuyu: Kwa msaada wako naweza kushinda jeshi, nikiwa pamoja na Mungu wangu nitaweza kuruka ukuta.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

kikuyu: Kuhusu Mungu, njia yake ni kamilifu, neno la Bwana halina dosari. Yeye ni ngao kwa wote wanaokimbilia kwake.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ni nani aliye Mungu zaidi ya Bwana? Ni nani aliye Mwamba isipokuwa Mungu wetu?
english: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

kikuyu: Mungu ndiye anivikaye nguvu na kufanya njia yangu kuwa kamilifu.
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

kikuyu: Huifanya miguu yangu kama miguu ya kulungu, huniwezesha kusimama mahali palipo juu.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

kikuyu: Huifundisha mikono yangu kupigana vita; mikono yangu inaweza kupinda upinde wa shaba.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

kikuyu: Hunipa ngao yako ya ushindi, nao mkono wako wa kuume hunitegemeza, unajishusha chini ili kuniinua.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

kikuyu: Huyapanua mapito yangu, ili miguu yangu isiteleze.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Niliwafuatia adui zangu na nikawapata, sikurudi nyuma mpaka walipoangamizwa.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

kikuyu: Niliwaseta hata hawakuweza kuinuka tena; walianguka chini ya miguu yangu.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

kikuyu: Ulinivika nguvu kwa ajili ya kupigana vita; uliwafanya adui zangu wasujudu miguuni pangu.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

kikuyu: Uliwafanya adui zangu wageuke na kukimbia, nami nikawaangamiza adui zangu.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

kikuyu: Walipiga yowe, lakini hapakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa; walimlilia Bwana, lakini hakuwajibu.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

kikuyu: Niliwaponda kama mavumbi yanayopeperushwa na upepo; niliwamwaga nje kama tope barabarani.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Umeniokoa kutokana na mashambulizi ya watu; umenifanya kuwa kiongozi wa mataifa, watu ambao sikuwajua wananitumikia.
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

kikuyu: Mara wanisikiapo hunitii, wageni hunyenyekea mbele yangu.
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

kikuyu: Wote wanalegea, wanatoka katika ngome zao wakitetemeka.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

kikuyu: Bwana yu hai! Sifa ni kwa Mwamba wangu! Atukuzwe Mungu Mwokozi wangu!
english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

kikuyu: Yeye ndiye Mungu anilipiziaye kisasi, awatiishaye mataifa chini yangu,
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

kikuyu: aniokoaye na adui zangu. Uliniinua juu ya adui zangu; uliniokoa toka kwa watu wajeuri.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nitakusifu katikati ya mataifa, Ee Bwana; nitaliimbia sifa jina lako.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

kikuyu: Humpa mfalme wake ushindi mkuu, huonyesha fadhili zake kwa mpakwa mafuta wake, kwa Daudi na wazao wake milele.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Mbingu zinatangaza utukufu wa Mungu, anga zahubiri kazi ya mikono yake.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

kikuyu: Siku baada ya siku zinatoa habari, usiku baada ya usiku zinatangaza maarifa.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

kikuyu: Hakuna msemo wala lugha, ambapo sauti zao hazisikiki.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

kikuyu: Sauti yao imeenea duniani pote, nayo maneno yao yameenea hadi miisho ya ulimwengu. Katika mbingu amepiga hema kwa ajili ya jua,
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

kikuyu: linafanana na bwana arusi akitoka chumbani mwake, kama shujaa afurahiavyo kukamilisha kushindana kwake.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

kikuyu: Huchomoza upande mmoja wa mbingu, na kufanya mzunguko wake hadi upande mwingine. Hakuna kilichojificha joto lake.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

kikuyu: Sheria ya Bwana ni kamilifu, ikihuisha nafsi. Shuhuda za Bwana ni za kuaminika, zikimpa mjinga hekima.
english: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

kikuyu: Maagizo ya Bwana ni kamili, nayo hufurahisha moyo. Amri za Bwana huangaza, zatia nuru machoni.
english: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana ni utakatifu, nako kwadumu milele. Amri za Bwana ni za hakika, nazo zina haki.
english: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

kikuyu: Ni za thamani kuliko dhahabu, kuliko dhahabu iliyo safi sana, ni tamu kuliko asali, kuliko asali kutoka kwenye sega.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

kikuyu: Kwa hizo mtumishi wako anaonywa, katika kuzishika kuna thawabu kubwa.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

kikuyu: Ni nani awezaye kutambua makosa yake? Nisamehe makosa yangu nisiyoyajua.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

kikuyu: Mlinde mtumishi wako na dhambi za makusudi, nazo zisinitawale. Ndipo nitakapokuwa sina lawama, wala sitakuwa na hatia ya kosa kubwa.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

kikuyu: Maneno ya kinywa changu na mawazo ya moyo wangu, yapate kibali mbele zako, Ee Bwana, Mwamba wangu na Mkombozi wangu.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana na akujibu unapokuwa katika dhiki, jina la Mungu wa Yakobo na liwe kinga yako.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

kikuyu: Na akutumie msaada kutoka patakatifu na akupatie msaada kutoka Sayuni.
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

kikuyu: Na azikumbuke dhabihu zako zote, na azikubali sadaka zako za kuteketezwa.
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

kikuyu: Na akujalie haja ya moyo wako, na aifanikishe mipango yako yote.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

kikuyu: Tutashangilia kwa furaha utakaposhinda, tutainua bendera zetu kwa jina la Mungu wetu. Bwana na akupe haja zako zote.
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

kikuyu: Sasa nafahamu kuwa Bwana humwokoa mpakwa mafuta wake, humjibu kutoka mbingu yake takatifu kwa nguvu za wokovu wa mkono wake wa kuume.
english: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

kikuyu: Wengine wanatumaini magari ya vita, na wengine farasi, bali sisi tutalitumainia jina la Bwana, Mungu wetu.
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Wao wameshushwa chini na kuanguka, bali sisi tunainuka na kusimama imara.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, mwokoe mfalme! Tujibu tunapokuita!
english: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, mfalme huzifurahia nguvu zako. Tazama jinsi ilivyo kuu furaha yake kwa ushindi unaompa!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

kikuyu: Umempa haja ya moyo wake na hukumzuilia maombi ya midomo yake.
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Ulimkaribisha kwa baraka tele na kumvika taji ya dhahabu safi kichwani pake.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

kikuyu: Alikuomba maisha, nawe ukampa, wingi wa siku milele na milele.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

kikuyu: Kutokana na ushindi uliompa, utukufu wake ni mkubwa, umeweka juu yake fahari na utukufu.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

kikuyu: Hakika umempa baraka za milele, umemfanya awe na furaha kwa shangwe ya uwepo wako.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mfalme anamtumaini Bwana; kwa upendo usiokoma wa Aliye Juu Sana hatatikiswa.
english: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Mkono wako utawashika adui zako wote, mkono wako wa kuume utawakamata adui zako.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

kikuyu: Wakati utakapojitokeza utawafanya kama tanuru ya moto. Katika ghadhabu yake Bwana atawameza, moto wake utawateketeza.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

kikuyu: Utawaangamiza wazao wao kutoka duniani, uzao wao kutoka wanadamu.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Ingawa watapanga mabaya dhidi yako na kutunga hila, hawawezi kufanikiwa,
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa utawafanya wakimbie utakapowalenga usoni pao kwa mshale kutoka kwenye upinde wako.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, utukuzwe katika nguvu zako, tutaimba na kusifu nguvu zako.
english: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa utenzi wa “Kulungu wa Alfajiri.” Zaburi ya Daudi. Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha? Kwa nini uko mbali hivyo kuniokoa? Mbali hivyo na maneno ya kuugua kwangu?
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

kikuyu: Ee Mungu wangu, ninalia mchana, lakini hunijibu, hata usiku, sinyamazi.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo umesimikwa katika kiti cha enzi kama Uliye Mtakatifu; wewe ni sifa ya Israeli.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

kikuyu: Kwako wewe baba zetu waliweka tumaini lao, walikutumaini nawe ukawaokoa.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

kikuyu: Walikulilia wewe na ukawaokoa, walikutegemea wewe nao hawakuaibika.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

kikuyu: Mimi ni mnyoo wala si mwanadamu, wanaume wamenibeza, na watu wamenidharau.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

kikuyu: Wote wanionao hunidhihaki, hunivurumishia matusi, wakitikisa vichwa vyao:
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

kikuyu: Husema, “Anamtegemea Bwana, basi Bwana na amwokoe. Amkomboe basi, kwa maana anapendezwa naye.”
english: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

kikuyu: Hata hivyo ulinitoa tumboni, ukanifanya nikutegemee, hata nilipokuwa ninanyonya matiti ya mama yangu.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

kikuyu: Nimekabidhiwa kwako tangu kuzaliwa, toka tumboni mwa mama yangu umekuwa Mungu wangu.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

kikuyu: Usiwe mbali nami, kwa maana shida iko karibu na hakuna wa kunisaidia.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

kikuyu: Mafahali wengi wamenizunguka, mafahali wa Bashani wenye nguvu wamenizingira.
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

kikuyu: Simba wangurumao wanaorarua mawindo yao hupanua vinywa vyao dhidi yangu.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

kikuyu: Nimemiminwa kama maji, mifupa yangu yote imetoka katika viungo vyake. Moyo wangu umegeuka kuwa nta, umeyeyuka ndani yangu.
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

kikuyu: Nguvu zangu zimekauka kama kigae, ulimi wangu umegandamana na kaakaa la kinywa changu, kwa sababu umenilaza katika mavumbi ya kifo.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

kikuyu: Mbwa wamenizunguka, kundi la watu waovu limenizingira, wametoboa mikono yangu na miguu yangu.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

kikuyu: Naweza kuhesabu mifupa yangu yote, watu wananikodolea macho na kunisimanga.
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

kikuyu: Wanagawana nguo zangu wao kwa wao, na vazi langu wanalipigia kura.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, usiwe mbali. Ee Nguvu yangu, uje haraka unisaidie.
english: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

kikuyu: Okoa maisha yangu na upanga, uhai wangu wa thamani kutoka nguvu za mbwa.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

kikuyu: Niokoe kutoka kinywani mwa simba, niokoe kutoka pembe za mafahali mwitu.
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

kikuyu: Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu, katika kusanyiko nitakusifu wewe.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

kikuyu: Ninyi ambao mnamcha Bwana, msifuni! Ninyi nyote wazao wote wa Yakobo, mheshimuni yeye! Mcheni yeye, ninyi wazao wote wa Israeli!
english: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

kikuyu: Kwa maana hakupuuza wala kudharau mateso ya aliyeonewa; hakumficha uso wake bali alisikiliza kilio chake ili amsaidie.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

kikuyu: Kwako wewe hutoka kiini cha sifa zangu katika kusanyiko kubwa, nitatimiza nadhiri zangu mbele ya wale wakuchao wewe.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

kikuyu: Maskini watakula na kushiba, wale wamtafutao Bwana watamsifu: mioyo yenu na iishi milele!
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

kikuyu: Miisho yote ya dunia itakumbuka na kumgeukia Bwana, nazo jamaa zote za mataifa watasujudu mbele zake,
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

kikuyu: kwa maana ufalme ni wa Bwana naye hutawala juu ya mataifa.
english: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

kikuyu: Matajiri wote wa dunia watasherehekea na kuabudu. Wote waendao mavumbini watapiga magoti mbele yake, wote ambao hawawezi kudumisha uhai wao.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

kikuyu: Wazao wa baadaye watamtumikia yeye; vizazi vijavyo vitajulishwa habari za Bwana.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

kikuyu: Watatangaza haki yake kwa watu ambao hawajazaliwa bado, kwa maana yeye ametenda hili.
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana ndiye mchungaji wangu, sitapungukiwa na kitu.
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

kikuyu: Hunilaza katika malisho ya majani mabichi, kando ya maji matulivu huniongoza,
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

kikuyu: hunihuisha nafsi yangu. Huniongoza katika njia za haki kwa ajili ya jina lake.
english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: Hata kama nikipita katikati ya bonde la uvuli wa mauti, sitaogopa mabaya, kwa maana wewe upo pamoja nami; fimbo yako na mkongojo wako vyanifariji.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

kikuyu: Waandaa meza mbele yangu machoni pa adui zangu. Umenipaka mafuta kichwani pangu, kikombe changu kinafurika.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

kikuyu: Hakika wema na upendo vitanifuata siku zote za maisha yangu, nami nitakaa nyumbani mwa Bwana milele.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Dunia ni mali ya Bwana, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake, ulimwengu, na wote waishio ndani yake,
english: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: maana aliiwekea misingi yake baharini na kuifanya imara juu ya maji.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

kikuyu: Nani awezaye kuupanda mlima wa Bwana? Ni nani awezaye kusimama patakatifu pake?
english: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

kikuyu: Ni yule mwenye mikono safi na moyo mweupe, yule ambaye hakuinulia sanamu nafsi yake au kuapa kwa kitu cha uongo.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

kikuyu: Huyo atapokea baraka kutoka kwa Bwana, na hukumu ya haki kutoka kwa Mungu Mwokozi wake.
english: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

kikuyu: Hiki ndicho kizazi cha wale wamtafutao, wale wautafutao uso wako, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Inueni vichwa vyenu, enyi malango, inukeni enyi milango ya kale, ili mfalme wa utukufu apate kuingia.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Ni nani huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni Bwana aliye na nguvu na uweza, ni Bwana aliye hodari katika vita.
english: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

kikuyu: Inueni vichwa vyenu, enyi malango, viinueni juu enyi milango ya kale, ili Mfalme wa utukufu apate kuingia.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Ni nani yeye, huyu Mfalme wa utukufu? Ni Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote; yeye ndiye Mfalme wa utukufu.
english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nainua nafsi yangu,
english: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: ni wewe ninayekutumainia, Ee Mungu wangu. Usiniache niaibike, wala usiache adui zangu wakanishinda.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

kikuyu: Kamwe hakuna hata mmoja anayekutegemea atakayeaibishwa, bali wataaibishwa wafanyao hila bila sababu.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

kikuyu: Nionyeshe njia zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe mapito yako,
english: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

kikuyu: niongoze katika kweli yako na kunifundisha, kwa maana wewe ni Mungu Mwokozi wangu, nalo tumaini langu liko kwako wakati wote.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

kikuyu: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, rehema zako kuu na upendo, kwa maana zimekuwepo tangu zamani.
english: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

kikuyu: Usizikumbuke dhambi za ujana wangu wala njia zangu za uasi, sawasawa na upendo wako unikumbuke, kwa maana wewe ni mwema, Ee Bwana.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwema na mwenye adili, kwa hiyo huwafundisha wenye dhambi njia zake.
english: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

kikuyu: Huwaongoza wanyenyekevu katika haki, naye huwafundisha njia yake.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

kikuyu: Njia zote za Bwana ni za upendo na uaminifu kwa wale wanaoshika shuhuda za agano lake.
english: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, unisamehe uovu wangu, ijapokuwa ni mwingi.
english: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

kikuyu: Ni nani basi, mtu yule anayemcha Bwana? Atamfundisha katika njia atakayoichagua kwa ajili yake.
english: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

kikuyu: Mtu huyo atafanikiwa maishani mwake, nao wazao wake watairithi nchi.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

kikuyu: Siri ya Bwana iko kwa wale wamchao, yeye huwajulisha agano lake.
english: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

kikuyu: Macho yangu humwelekea Bwana daima, kwa kuwa yeye peke yake ndiye ataitoa miguu yangu kutoka mtego.
english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

kikuyu: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kwa maana mimi ni mpweke na mwenye kuteseka.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

kikuyu: Shida za moyo wangu zimeongezeka, niokoe katika dhiki yangu.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

kikuyu: Uangalie mateso na shida zangu na uniondolee dhambi zangu zote.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

kikuyu: Tazama adui zangu walivyo wengi, pia uone jinsi wanavyonichukia vikali!
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

kikuyu: Uyalinde maisha yangu na uniokoe, usiniache niaibike, kwa maana nimekukimbilia wewe.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Uadilifu na uaminifu vinilinde, kwa sababu tumaini langu ni kwako.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, wakomboe Israeli, katika shida zao zote!
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nithibitishe katika haki, maana nimeishi maisha yasiyo na lawama; nimemtumainia Bwana bila kusitasita.
english: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, unijaribu, unipime, uuchunguze moyo wangu na mawazo yangu;
english: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

kikuyu: kwa maana upendo wako uko mbele yangu daima, nami natembea siku zote katika kweli yako.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

kikuyu: Siketi pamoja na watu wadanganyifu, wala siandamani na wanafiki,
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

kikuyu: ninachukia kusanyiko la watenda mabaya na ninakataa kuketi pamoja na waovu.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

kikuyu: Ninanawa mikono yangu kwa kuwa sina hatia, naikaribia madhabahu yako, Ee Bwana,
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

kikuyu: nikitangaza sifa yako kwa sauti kubwa, huku nikisimulia matendo yako ya ajabu.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, naipenda nyumba yako mahali unakoishi, mahali ambapo utukufu wako hukaa.
english: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

kikuyu: Usiiondoe nafsi yangu pamoja na watenda dhambi, wala uhai wangu pamoja na wamwagao damu,
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

kikuyu: ambao mikononi mwao kuna mipango miovu, ambao mikono yao ya kuume imejaa rushwa.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

kikuyu: Bali mimi ninaishi maisha yasiyo na lawama; nikomboe na unihurumie.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

kikuyu: Miguu yangu imesimama katika uwanja tambarare; katika kusanyiko kuu nitamsifu Bwana.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana ni nuru yangu na wokovu wangu, nimwogope nani? Bwana ni ngome ya uzima wangu, nimhofu nani?
english: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

kikuyu: Waovu watakaposogea dhidi yangu ili wanile nyama yangu, adui zangu na watesi wangu watakaponishambulia, watajikwaa na kuanguka.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

kikuyu: Hata jeshi linizunguke pande zote, moyo wangu hautaogopa; hata vita vitokee dhidi yangu, hata hapo nitakuwa na ujasiri.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

kikuyu: Jambo moja ninamwomba Bwana, hili ndilo ninalolitafuta: niweze kukaa nyumbani mwa Bwana siku zote za maisha yangu, niutazame uzuri wa Bwana na kumtafuta hekaluni mwake.
english: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa siku ya shida, atanihifadhi salama katika maskani yake, atanificha uvulini mwa hema yake na kuniweka juu kwenye mwamba.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

kikuyu: Kisha kichwa changu kitainuliwa juu ya adui zangu wanaonizunguka. Katika maskani yake nitatoa dhabihu kwa kelele za shangwe; nitamwimbia Bwana na kumsifu.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

kikuyu: Isikie sauti yangu nikuitapo, Ee Bwana, unihurumie na unijibu.
english: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu unasema kuhusu wewe, “Utafute uso wake!” Uso wako, Bwana “Nitautafuta.”
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

kikuyu: Usinifiche uso wako, usimkatae mtumishi wako kwa hasira; wewe umekuwa msaada wangu. Usinikatae wala usiniache, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wangu.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

kikuyu: Hata kama baba yangu na mama wakiniacha, Bwana atanipokea.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

kikuyu: Nifundishe njia yako, Ee Bwana, niongoze katika njia iliyonyooka kwa sababu ya watesi wangu.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Usiniachilie kwa nia za adui zangu, kwa maana mashahidi wa uongo wameinuka dhidi yangu, wakipumua ujeuri.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

kikuyu: Nami bado nina tumaini hili: nitauona wema wa Bwana katika nchi ya walio hai.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Mngojee Bwana, uwe hodari na mwenye moyo mkuu, nawe, umngojee Bwana.
english: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ninakuita wewe, Ee Bwana, Mwamba wangu; usiwe kwangu kama kiziwi. Kwa sababu ukinyamaza nitafanana na walioshuka shimoni.
english: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Sikia kilio changu unihurumie ninapokuita kwa ajili ya msaada, niinuapo mikono yangu kuelekea Patakatifu pa Patakatifu pako.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

kikuyu: Usiniburute pamoja na waovu, pamoja na hao watendao mabaya, ambao huzungumza na jirani zao maneno mazuri, lakini mioyoni mwao wameficha chuki.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

kikuyu: Walipe sawasawa na matendo yao, sawasawa na matendo yao maovu; walipe sawasawa na kazi za mikono yao, uwalipe wanavyostahili.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hawaheshimu kazi za Bwana, na yale ambayo mikono yake imetenda, atawabomoa na kamwe hatawajenga tena.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

kikuyu: Bwana asifiwe, kwa maana amesikia kilio changu nikimwomba anihurumie.
english: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Bwana ni nguvu zangu na ngao yangu, moyo wangu umemtumaini yeye, nami nimesaidiwa. Moyo wangu unarukaruka kwa furaha nami nitamshukuru kwa wimbo.
english: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

kikuyu: Bwana ni nguvu ya watu wake, ngome ya wokovu kwa mpakwa mafuta wake.
english: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

kikuyu: Waokoe watu wako na uubariki urithi wako; uwe mchungaji wao na uwabebe milele.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Mpeni Bwana, enyi mashujaa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake; mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Bwana iko juu ya maji; Mungu wa utukufu hupiga radi, Bwana hupiga radi juu ya maji makuu.
english: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Bwana ina nguvu; sauti ya Bwana ni tukufu.
english: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Bwana huvunja mierezi; Bwana huvunja vipande vipande mierezi ya Lebanoni.
english: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Hufanya Lebanoni irukaruke kama ndama, Sirioni urukaruke kama mwana nyati.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Bwana hupiga kwa miali ya umeme wa radi.
english: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Bwana hutikisa jangwa; Bwana hutikisa Jangwa la Kadeshi.
english: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

kikuyu: Sauti ya Bwana huzalisha ayala, na huuacha msitu wazi. Hekaluni mwake wote wasema, “Utukufu!”
english: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

kikuyu: Bwana huketi akiwa ametawazwa juu ya gharika; Bwana ametawazwa kuwa Mfalme milele.
english: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

kikuyu: Bwana huwapa watu wake nguvu; Bwana huwabariki watu wake kwa kuwapa amani.
english: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

kikuyu: Utenzi wa kuweka wakfu hekalu. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakutukuza wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa umeniinua kutoka vilindi, na hukuacha adui zangu washangilie juu yangu.
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu, nilikuita unisaidie na wewe umeniponya.
english: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, umenitoa Kuzimu, umeniokoa nisishuke kwenye shimo la mauti.
english: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Bwana, enyi watakatifu wake; lisifuni jina lake takatifu.
english: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

kikuyu: Kwa maana hasira yake ni ya muda mfupi, bali upendo wake hudumu siku zote. Inawezekana kilio kiwepo usiku kucha, lakini asubuhi kukawa na furaha.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

kikuyu: Nilipofanikiwa nilisema, “Sitatikiswa kamwe.”
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uliponijalia, uliuimarisha mlima wangu, lakini ulipouficha uso wako nilifadhaika.
english: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

kikuyu: Kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, niliita, kwa Bwana niliomba rehema:
english: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

kikuyu: “Kuna faida gani katika kuangamia kwangu? Katika kushuka kwangu shimoni? Je, mavumbi yatakusifu? Je, yatatangaza uaminifu wako?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, unisikie na kunihurumia, Ee Bwana, uwe msaada wangu.”
english: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

kikuyu: Uligeuza maombolezo yangu kuwa kucheza, ulinivua nguo za gunia ukanivika shangwe,
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

kikuyu: ili moyo wangu uweze kukusifu na usikae kimya. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru milele.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe, kwa haki yako uniokoe.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

kikuyu: Nitegee sikio lako, uje uniokoe haraka; uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, ngome imara ya kuniokoa.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa wewe ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu, uniongoze na kunilinda kwa ajili ya jina lako.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

kikuyu: Uniepushe na mtego niliotegewa, maana wewe ndiwe kimbilio langu.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

kikuyu: Ninaikabidhi roho yangu mikononi mwako, unikomboe Ee Bwana, uliye Mungu wa kweli.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

kikuyu: Ninawachukia wale wanaongʼangʼania sanamu batili; mimi ninamtumaini Bwana.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Nitafurahia na kushangilia upendo wako, kwa kuwa uliona mateso yangu na ulijua maumivu ya nafsi yangu.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

kikuyu: Hukunikabidhi kwa adui yangu bali umeiweka miguu yangu mahali penye nafasi.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana unihurumie, kwa kuwa niko kwenye shida; macho yangu yanafifia kwa huzuni, nafsi yangu na mwili wangu kwa sikitiko.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

kikuyu: Maisha yangu yamedhoofika kwa majonzi, naam, miaka yangu kwa kulia kwa maumivu makali; nguvu zangu zinaisha kwa ajili ya mateso, na mifupa yangu inachakaa.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote, nimedharauliwa kabisa na jirani zangu, hata kwa rafiki zangu nimekuwa tisho, wale wanionao barabarani hunikimbia.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

kikuyu: Nimesahaulika miongoni mwao kama mtu aliyekufa, nimekuwa kama chombo cha mfinyanzi kilichovunjika.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nimesikia maneno niliyosingiziwa na wengi; vitisho viko pande zote; kwa kuwa wamefanya mashauri dhidi yangu, na kula njama kuniua.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe peke yako, Ee Bwana; nimesema, “Wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu.”
english: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

kikuyu: Siku za maisha yangu ziko mikononi mwako, uniokoe mikononi mwa adui zangu na wale wanifuatiao.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

kikuyu: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako, uniokoe kwa ajili ya upendo wako usiokoma.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Usiniache niaibike, Ee Bwana, kwa maana nimekulilia wewe, bali waovu waaibishwe na kunyamazishwa Kuzimu.
english: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

kikuyu: Midomo yao isemayo uongo na inyamazishwe, kwa maana kwa kiburi na dharau wao husema kwa majivuno dhidi ya wenye haki.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi ulivyo mkuu wema wako, uliowawekea akiba wakuchao, ambao huwapa wale wakukimbiliao machoni pa watu.
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

kikuyu: Unawahifadhi katika uvuli wa uwepo wako kutokana na hila za wanadamu; katika makao yako huwaweka salama kutokana na ndimi za mashtaka.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

kikuyu: Atukuzwe Bwana, kwa kuwa amenionyesha upendo wake wa ajabu nilipokuwa katika mji uliozingirwa.
english: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

kikuyu: Katika hofu yangu nilisema, “Nimekatiliwa mbali na macho yako!” Hata hivyo ulisikia kilio changu ukanihurumia nilipokuita unisaidie.
english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

kikuyu: Mpendeni Bwana ninyi watakatifu wake wote! Bwana huwahifadhi waaminifu, lakini wenye kiburi huwalipiza kikamilifu.
english: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

kikuyu: Kuweni hodari na mjipe moyo, ninyi nyote mnaomtumaini Bwana.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Funzo. Heri mtu yule ambaye amesamehewa makosa yake, ambaye dhambi zake zimefunikwa.
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

kikuyu: Heri mtu yule ambaye Bwana hamhesabii dhambi, na ambaye rohoni mwake hamna udanganyifu.
english: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

kikuyu: Niliponyamaza, mifupa yangu ilichakaa kwa kulia kwa maumivu makali mchana kutwa.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

kikuyu: Usiku na mchana mkono wako ulinilemea, nguvu zangu zilinyonywa kama vile katika joto la kiangazi.
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

kikuyu: Kisha nilikujulisha dhambi yangu wala sikuficha uovu wangu. Nilisema, “Nitaungama makosa yangu kwa Bwana.” Ndipo uliponisamehe hatia ya dhambi yangu.
english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo kila mtu mcha Mungu akuombe wakati unapopatikana, hakika maji makuu yatakapofurika hayatamfikia yeye.
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

kikuyu: Wewe ndiwe mahali pangu pa kujificha, utaniepusha na taabu na kunizunguka kwa nyimbo za wokovu.
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

kikuyu: Nitakufundisha na kukuonyesha njia utakayoiendea; nitakushauri na kukuangalia.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

kikuyu: Usiwe kama farasi au nyumbu wasio na akili, ambao ni lazima waongozwe kwa lijamu na hatamu la sivyo hawatakukaribia.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu ana taabu nyingi, bali upendo usio na kikomo wa Bwana unamzunguka mtu anayemtumaini.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

kikuyu: Shangilieni katika Bwana na mfurahi, enyi wenye haki! Imbeni, nyote mlio wanyofu wa moyo!
english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa furaha, enyi wenye haki; kusifu kunawapasa wanyofu wa moyo.
english: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana kwa kinubi, mwimbieni sifa kwa zeze la nyuzi kumi.
english: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni wimbo mpya; pigeni kwa ustadi, na mpaze sauti za shangwe.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

kikuyu: Maana neno la Bwana ni haki na kweli, ni mwaminifu kwa yote atendayo.
english: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

kikuyu: Bwana hupenda uadilifu na haki; dunia imejaa upendo wake usiokoma.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

kikuyu: Kwa neno la Bwana mbingu ziliumbwa, jeshi lao la angani kwa pumzi ya kinywa chake.
english: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

kikuyu: Ameyakusanya maji ya bahari kama kwenye chungu; vilindi vya bahari ameviweka katika ghala.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

kikuyu: Dunia yote na imwogope Bwana, watu wote wa dunia wamche.
english: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, na ikawa, aliamuru na ikasimama imara.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

kikuyu: Bwana huzuia mipango ya mataifa, hupinga makusudi ya mataifa.
english: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

kikuyu: Lakini mipango ya Bwana inasimama imara milele, makusudi ya moyo wake kwa vizazi vyote.
english: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

kikuyu: Heri taifa ambalo Bwana ni Mungu wao, watu ambao aliwachagua kuwa urithi wake.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Kutoka mbinguni Bwana hutazama chini na kuwaona wanadamu wote;
english: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

kikuyu: kutoka maskani mwake huwaangalia wote wakaao duniani:
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

kikuyu: yeye ambaye huumba mioyo yao wote, ambaye huangalia kila kitu wanachokitenda.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

kikuyu: Hakuna mfalme aokokaye kwa ukubwa wa jeshi lake; hakuna shujaa aokokaye kwa wingi wa nguvu zake.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

kikuyu: Farasi ni tumaini la bure kwa wokovu, licha ya nguvu zake nyingi, hawezi kuokoa.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

kikuyu: Lakini macho ya Bwana yako kwa wale wamchao, kwa wale tumaini lao liko katika upendo wake usio na kikomo,
english: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

kikuyu: ili awaokoe na mauti, na kuwahifadhi wakati wa njaa.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

kikuyu: Sisi tunamngojea Bwana kwa matumaini, yeye ni msaada wetu na ngao yetu.
english: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

kikuyu: Mioyo yetu humshangilia, kwa maana tunalitumainia jina lake takatifu.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

kikuyu: Upendo wako usio na mwisho ukae juu yetu, Ee Bwana, tunapoliweka tumaini letu kwako.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi, alipojifanya mwendawazimu mbele ya Abimeleki, ambaye alimfukuza, naye akaondoka. Nitamtukuza Bwana nyakati zote, sifa zake zitakuwa midomoni mwangu siku zote.
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu itajisifu katika Bwana, walioonewa watasikia na wafurahi.
english: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

kikuyu: Mtukuzeni Bwana pamoja nami, naam, na tulitukuze jina lake pamoja.
english: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

kikuyu: Nilimtafuta Bwana naye akanijibu, akaniokoa kwenye hofu zangu zote.
english: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

kikuyu: Wale wamtazamao hutiwa nuru, nyuso zao hazifunikwi na aibu kamwe.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

kikuyu: Maskini huyu alimwita Bwana, naye akamsikia, akamwokoa katika taabu zake zote.
english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Malaika wa Bwana hufanya kituo akiwazunguka wale wamchao, naye huwaokoa.
english: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

kikuyu: Onjeni mwone kwamba Bwana ni mwema, heri mtu yule anayemkimbilia.
english: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

kikuyu: Mcheni Bwana enyi watakatifu wake, kwa maana wale wamchao hawapungukiwi na chochote.
english: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

kikuyu: Wana simba wenye nguvu hutindikiwa na kuona njaa, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana hawatakosa kitu chochote kilicho chema.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

kikuyu: Njooni, watoto wangu, mnisikilize, nitawafundisha kumcha Bwana.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Yeyote kati yenu anayependa uzima na kutamani kuziona siku nyingi njema,
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

kikuyu: basi auzuie ulimi wake na mabaya, na midomo yake kutokana na kusema uongo.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

kikuyu: Aache uovu, atende mema, aitafute amani na kuifuatilia.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

kikuyu: Macho ya Bwana huwaelekea wenye haki, na masikio yake yako makini kusikiliza kilio chao.
english: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

kikuyu: Uso wa Bwana uko kinyume na watendao maovu, ili kufuta kumbukumbu lao duniani.
english: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

kikuyu: Wenye haki hulia, naye Bwana huwasikia, huwaokoa katika taabu zao zote.
english: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

kikuyu: Bwana yu karibu na waliovunjika moyo, na huwaokoa waliopondeka roho.
english: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

kikuyu: Mwenye haki ana mateso mengi, lakini Bwana humwokoa nayo yote,
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

kikuyu: huhifadhi mifupa yake yote, hata mmoja hautavunjika.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

kikuyu: Ubaya utamuua mtu mwovu, nao adui za mwenye haki watahukumiwa.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Bwana huwakomboa watumishi wake, yeyote anayemkimbilia yeye hatahukumiwa kamwe.
english: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, pingana na wale wanaopingana nami, upigane na hao wanaopigana nami.
english: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

kikuyu: Chukua ngao na kigao. Inuka unisaidie.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

kikuyu: Inua mkuki wako na fumo lako dhidi ya hao wanaonifuatia. Iambie nafsi yangu, “Mimi ni wokovu wako.”
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

kikuyu: Wafedheheshwe na waaibishwe wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu. Wanaofanya shauri kuniangamiza warudishwe nyuma kwa hofu.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

kikuyu: Wawe kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo, malaika wa Bwana akiwafukuza.
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

kikuyu: Njia yao na iwe giza na ya utelezi, malaika wa Bwana akiwafuatilia.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

kikuyu: Kwa vile walinifichia wavu wao bila sababu, na bila sababu wamenichimbia shimo,
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

kikuyu: maafa na yawapate ghafula: wavu walionifichia na uwatege wenyewe, na waanguke katika shimo hilo, kwa maangamizo yao.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

kikuyu: Ndipo nafsi yangu itashangilia katika Bwana na kuufurahia wokovu wake.
english: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

kikuyu: Nitapaza sauti yangu nikisema, “Ni nani aliye kama wewe, Ee Bwana? Wewe huwaokoa maskini kutokana na wale walio na nguvu kuliko wao, maskini na mhitaji kutokana na wanaowanyangʼanya!”
english: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

kikuyu: Mashahidi wakatili wanainuka, wananiuliza mambo nisiyoyajua.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

kikuyu: Wananilipa baya kwa jema na kuiacha nafsi yangu ukiwa.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

kikuyu: Lakini walipokuwa wagonjwa, nilivaa nguo ya gunia na nikajinyenyekesha kwa kufunga. Maombi yangu yaliponirudia bila kujibiwa,
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

kikuyu: niliendelea kuomboleza kama vile wao ni rafiki au ndugu. Niliinamisha kichwa chini kwa huzuni kama ninayemwombolezea mama yangu.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

kikuyu: Lakini nilipojikwaa, walikusanyika kwa shangwe; washambuliaji walijikusanya dhidi yangu bila mimi kujua. Walinisingizia pasipo kukoma.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

kikuyu: Kama watu wasiomcha Mungu, wamenidhihaki, wamenisagia meno.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, utatazama mpaka lini? Niokoe maisha yangu na maangamizi yao, uhai wangu wa thamani kutokana na simba hawa.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

kikuyu: Nami nitakushukuru mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa, nitakusifu katikati ya watu wengi.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

kikuyu: Usiwaache wale wanaonisimanga, wale ambao ni adui zangu bila sababu; usiwaache wale ambao ni adui zangu bila sababu wakonyeze jicho kwa hila.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

kikuyu: Hawazungumzi kwa amani, bali wanatunga mashtaka ya uongo dhidi ya wale wanaoishi kwa utulivu katika nchi.
english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

kikuyu: Hunifumbulia vinywa vyao wakisema, “Aha! Aha! Kwa macho yetu wenyewe tumeliona.”
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, umeona hili, usiwe kimya. Usiwe mbali nami, Ee Bwana.
english: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Amka, inuka unitetee! Unipiganie Mungu wangu na Bwana wangu.
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

kikuyu: Nihukumu kwa haki yako, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, sawasawa na haki yako; usiwaache wakusimange.
english: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

kikuyu: Usiwaache wafikiri, “Aha, hili ndilo tulilotaka!” Au waseme, “Tumemmeza.”
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

kikuyu: Wote wanaofurahia dhiki yangu waaibishwe na wachanganyikiwe; hao wanaojiinua dhidi yangu wavikwe aibu na dharau.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

kikuyu: Wale wanaofurahia hukumu yangu ya haki wapige kelele za shangwe na furaha; hebu waseme siku zote, “Bwana atukuzwe, ambaye amefurahia mafanikio ya mtumishi wake.”
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

kikuyu: Ulimi wangu utanena haki yako na sifa zako mchana kutwa.
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi mtumishi wa Bwana. Kuna neno moyoni mwangu kuhusu hali ya dhambi ya mwovu. Hakuna hofu ya Mungu mbele ya macho yake.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa machoni pake mwenyewe hujisifu mno hata hawezi kugundua au kuichukia dhambi yake.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

kikuyu: Maneno ya kinywa chake ni maovu na ya udanganyifu, ameacha kuwa mwenye hekima na kutenda mema.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

kikuyu: Hata kitandani mwake hupanga hila mbaya, hujitia katika njia ya dhambi na hakatai lililo baya.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

kikuyu: Upendo wako, Ee Bwana, unafika hadi mbinguni, uaminifu wako hadi kwenye anga.
english: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Haki yako ni kama milima mikubwa, hukumu zako ni kama kilindi kikuu. Ee Bwana, wewe huwahifadhi mwanadamu na mnyama.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

kikuyu: Upendo wako usiokoma ni wa thamani mno! Watu wakuu na wadogo hujificha uvulini wa mbawa zako.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Wanajifurahisha katika wingi nyumbani mwako, nawe utawanywesha katika mto wa furaha zako.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

kikuyu: Kuwa pamoja nawe ni kijito cha uzima, katika nuru yako twaona nuru.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

kikuyu: Dumisha upendo wako kwa wale wanaokujua wewe, haki yako kwa wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Mguu wa mwenye kiburi usije dhidi yangu, wala mkono wa mwovu usinifukuze.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

kikuyu: Angalia jinsi watenda mabaya walivyoanguka: wametupwa chini, hawawezi kuinuka!
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Usisumbuke kwa ajili ya watendao maovu, wala usiwaonee wivu watendao mabaya,
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

kikuyu: kwa maana kama majani watanyauka mara, kama mimea ya kijani watakufa mara.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

kikuyu: Mtumaini Bwana na utende yaliyo mema; Kaa katika nchi ukafurahie malisho salama.
english: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

kikuyu: Jifurahishe katika Bwana naye atakupa haja za moyo wako.
english: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

kikuyu: Mkabidhi Bwana njia yako, mtumaini yeye, naye atatenda hili:
english: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

kikuyu: Yeye atafanya haki yako ingʼae kama mapambazuko, na hukumu ya shauri lako kama jua la adhuhuri.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

kikuyu: Tulia mbele za Bwana na umngojee kwa uvumilivu; usisumbuke watu wanapofanikiwa katika njia zao, wanapotekeleza mipango yao miovu.
english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

kikuyu: Epuka hasira na uache ghadhabu, usihangaike: itakuongoza tu kutenda uovu.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

kikuyu: Kwa maana waovu watakatiliwa mbali, bali wale wanaomtumaini Bwana watairithi nchi.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

kikuyu: Bado kitambo kidogo, nao waovu hawataonekana, ingawa utawatafuta, hawataonekana.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

kikuyu: Bali wanyenyekevu watairithi nchi na wafurahie amani tele.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

kikuyu: Waovu hula njama dhidi ya wenye haki na kuwasagia meno,
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

kikuyu: bali Bwana huwacheka waovu, kwa sababu anajua siku yao inakuja.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

kikuyu: Waovu huchomoa upanga na kupinda upinde, ili wawaangushe maskini na wahitaji, kuwachinja wale ambao njia zao ni nyofu.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

kikuyu: Lakini panga zao zitachoma mioyo yao wenyewe, na pinde zao zitavunjwa.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

kikuyu: Bora kidogo walicho nacho wenye haki kuliko wingi wa mali wa waovu wengi;
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

kikuyu: kwa maana nguvu za waovu zitavunjwa, lakini Bwana humtegemeza mwenye haki.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

kikuyu: Bwana anazifahamu siku za wanyofu, na urithi wao utadumu milele.
english: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

kikuyu: Siku za maafa hawatanyauka, siku za njaa watafurahia wingi wa vitu.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

kikuyu: Lakini waovu wataangamia: Adui za Bwana watakuwa kama uzuri wa mashamba, watatoweka, watatoweka kama moshi.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

kikuyu: Waovu hukopa na hawalipi, bali wenye haki hutoa kwa ukarimu.
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

kikuyu: Wale wanaobarikiwa na Bwana watairithi nchi, bali wale anaowalaani watakatiliwa mbali.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Kama Bwana akipendezwa na njia ya mtu, yeye huimarisha hatua zake,
english: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

kikuyu: ajapojikwaa, hataanguka, kwa maana Bwana humtegemeza kwa mkono wake.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

kikuyu: Nilikuwa kijana na sasa ni mzee, lakini sijaona kamwe wenye haki wameachwa au watoto wao wakiombaomba chakula.
english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

kikuyu: Wakati wote ni wakarimu na hukopesha bila masharti. Watoto wao watabarikiwa.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

kikuyu: Acha ubaya na utende wema, nawe utaishi katika nchi milele.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Bwana huwapenda wenye haki naye hatawaacha waaminifu wake. Watalindwa milele, lakini uzao wa waovu utakatiliwa mbali.
english: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Wenye haki watairithi nchi, na kuishi humo milele.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

kikuyu: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutamka hekima, nao ulimi wake huzungumza lililo haki.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

kikuyu: Sheria ya Mungu wake imo moyoni mwake; nyayo zake hazitelezi.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

kikuyu: Watu waovu huvizia wenye haki, wakitafuta kuwaua;
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

kikuyu: lakini Bwana hatawaacha mikononi mwao wala hatawaacha wahukumiwe kuwa wakosa wanaposhtakiwa.
english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

kikuyu: Mngojee Bwana, na uishike njia yake. Naye atakutukuza uirithi nchi, waovu watakapokatiliwa mbali, utaliona hilo.
english: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

kikuyu: Nimemwona mtu mwovu na mkatili akistawi kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni,
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

kikuyu: lakini alitoweka mara na hakuonekana, ingawa nilimtafuta, hakupatikana.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

kikuyu: Watafakari watu wasio na hatia, wachunguze watu wakamilifu, kuna mafanikio kwa mtu apendaye amani.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

kikuyu: Lakini watenda dhambi wote wataangamizwa, mafanikio yao yatakatiliwa mbali.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Wokovu wa wenye haki hutoka kwa Bwana, yeye ni ngome yao wakati wa shida.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

kikuyu: Bwana huwasaidia na kuwaokoa, huwaokoa kutoka kwa waovu na kuwahifadhi, kwa maana wanamkimbilia.
english: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Maombi. Ee Bwana, usinikemee katika hasira yako, wala kuniadhibu katika ghadhabu yako.
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mishale yako imenichoma, na mkono wako umenishukia.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

kikuyu: Hakuna afya mwilini mwangu kwa sababu ya ghadhabu yako, mifupa yangu haina uzima kwa sababu ya dhambi zangu.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

kikuyu: Maovu yangu yamenifunika kama mzigo usiochukulika.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

kikuyu: Majeraha yangu yameoza na yananuka, kwa sababu ya upumbavu wa dhambi zangu.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

kikuyu: Nimeinamishwa chini na kushushwa sana, mchana kutwa nazunguka nikiomboleza.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

kikuyu: Viuno vyangu vimejaa maumivu yaunguzayo, hakuna afya mwilini mwangu.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

kikuyu: Nimedhoofika na kupondwa kabisa, nasononeka kwa maumivu makuu ya moyoni.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, yote ninayoyaonea shauku yako wazi mbele zako, kutamani kwangu sana hakufichiki mbele zako.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu unapigapiga, nguvu zangu zimeniishia; hata macho yangu yametiwa giza.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

kikuyu: Rafiki na wenzangu wananikwepa kwa sababu ya majeraha yangu; majirani zangu wanakaa mbali nami.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

kikuyu: Wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu wanatega mitego yao, wale ambao wangetaka kunidhuru huongea juu ya maangamizi yangu; hufanya shauri la hila mchana kutwa.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

kikuyu: Mimi ni kama mtu kiziwi, asiyeweza kusikia, ni kama bubu, asiyeweza kufungua kinywa chake,
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: nimekuwa kama mtu asiyesikia, ambaye kinywa chake hakiwezi kutoa jibu.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninakungojea wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, utajibu.
english: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa nilisema, “Usiwaache wafurahie, wala wasijitukuze juu yangu mguu wangu unapoteleza.”
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

kikuyu: Kwa maana ninakaribia kuanguka, na maumivu yangu yananiandama siku zote.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

kikuyu: Naungama uovu wangu, ninataabishwa na dhambi yangu.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

kikuyu: Wengi ni wale ambao ni adui zangu hodari, wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi.
