english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

kikuyu: Wanaolipa maovu kwa wema wangu hunisingizia ninapofuata lililo jema.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, usiniache, usiwe mbali nami, Ee Mungu wangu.
english: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mwokozi wangu, uje upesi kunisaidia.
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nilisema, “Nitaziangalia njia zangu na kuuzuia ulimi wangu usije ukatenda dhambi; nitaweka lijamu kinywani mwangu wakati wote waovu wanapokuwa karibu nami.”
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

kikuyu: Lakini niliponyamaza kimya na kutulia, hata pasipo kusema lolote jema, uchungu wangu uliongezeka.
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu ulipata moto ndani yangu, nilipotafakari, moto uliwaka, ndipo nikasema kwa ulimi wangu:
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

kikuyu: “Ee Bwana, nijulishe mwisho wa maisha yangu na hesabu ya siku zangu; nijalie kujua jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita upesi.
english: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

kikuyu: Umefanya maisha yangu mafupi kama pumzi; muda wangu wa kuishi ni kama hauna thamani kwako. Maisha ya kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi.
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: Hakika kila binadamu ni kama njozi aendapo huku na huko: hujishughulisha na mengi lakini ni ubatili; anakusanya mali nyingi, wala hajui ni nani atakayeifaidi.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

kikuyu: “Lakini sasa Bwana, nitafute nini? Tumaini langu ni kwako.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

kikuyu: Niokoe kutoka kwenye makosa yangu yote, usinifanye kuwa dhihaka ya wapumbavu.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

kikuyu: Nilinyamaza kimya, sikufumbua kinywa changu, kwa sababu wewe ndiwe uliyetenda hili.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

kikuyu: Niondolee mjeledi wako, nimeshindwa kwa mapigo ya mkono wako.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

kikuyu: Unakemea na kuadhibu wanadamu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao; unaharibu utajiri wao kama nondo aharibuvyo: kila mwanadamu ni kama pumzi tu.
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: “Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, usikie kilio changu unisaidie, usiwe kiziwi kwa kulia kwangu. Kwani mimi ninaishi na wewe kama mgeni, kama walivyokuwa baba zangu wote,
english: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

kikuyu: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Nilimngoja Bwana kwa saburi, naye akaniinamia, akasikia kilio changu.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

kikuyu: Akanipandisha kutoka shimo la uharibifu, kutoka matope na utelezi; akaiweka miguu yangu juu ya mwamba na kunipa mahali imara pa kusimama.
english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

kikuyu: Akaweka wimbo mpya kinywani mwangu, wimbo wa sifa kwa Mungu wetu. Wengi wataona na kuogopa na kuweka tumaini lao kwa Bwana.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Heri mtu yule amfanyaye Bwana kuwa tumaini lake, asiyewategemea wenye kiburi, wale wenye kugeukia miungu ya uongo.
english: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, umefanya mambo mengi ya ajabu. Mambo uliyopanga kwa ajili yetu hakuna awezaye kukuhesabia; kama ningesema na kuyaelezea, yangekuwa mengi mno kuyaelezea.
english: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

kikuyu: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuvitaka, lakini umefungua masikio yangu; sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za dhambi hukuzihitaji.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

kikuyu: Ndipo niliposema, “Mimi hapa, nimekuja: imeandikwa kunihusu katika kitabu.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu wangu, natamani kuyafanya mapenzi yako; sheria yako iko ndani ya moyo wangu.”
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

kikuyu: Nimehubiri haki katika kusanyiko kubwa, sikufunga mdomo wangu, Ee Bwana, kama ujuavyo.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

kikuyu: Sikuficha haki yako moyoni mwangu; ninasema juu ya uaminifu wako na wokovu wako. Sikuficha upendo wako na kweli yako mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, usizuilie huruma zako, upendo wako na kweli yako daima vinilinde.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

kikuyu: Kwa maana taabu zisizo na hesabu zimenizunguka, dhambi zangu zimenikamata, hata nisiweze kuona. Zimekuwa nyingi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, nao moyo unazimia ndani yangu.
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uwe radhi kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.
english: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Wote wanaotafuta kuuondoa uhai wangu, waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa; wote wanaotamani kuangamizwa kwangu, warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

kikuyu: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” wafadhaishwe na iwe aibu yao.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Lakini wote wakutafutao washangilie na kukufurahia, wale wapendao wokovu wako siku zote waseme, “Bwana atukuzwe!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

kikuyu: Lakini bado mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Bwana na anifikirie. Wewe ndiwe msaada wangu na Mwokozi wangu; Ee Mungu wangu, usikawie.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Heri mtu yule anayemjali mnyonge, Bwana atamwokoa wakati wa shida.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

kikuyu: Bwana atamlinda na kuyahifadhi maisha yake, atambariki katika nchi na hatamwacha katika tamaa ya adui zake.
english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

kikuyu: Bwana atamtegemeza awapo mgonjwa kitandani, atamwinua kutoka kitandani mwake.
english: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

kikuyu: Nilisema, “Ee Bwana nihurumie, niponye, maana nimekutenda dhambi wewe.”
english: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

kikuyu: Adui zangu wanasema kwa hila, “Lini atakufa, na jina lake litokomee kabisa.”
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

kikuyu: Kila anapokuja mtu kunitazama, huzungumza uongo, huku moyo wake hukusanya masingizio; kisha huondoka na kuyasambaza huku na huko.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

kikuyu: Adui zangu wote hunongʼonezana dhidi yangu, hao huniwazia mabaya sana, wakisema,
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

kikuyu: “Ugonjwa mbaya sana umempata, kamwe hatainuka tena kitandani mwake.”
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

kikuyu: Hata rafiki yangu wa karibu niliyemwamini, yule aliyekula chakula changu ameniinulia kisigino chake.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, nihurumie, ukaniinue tena, ili niweze kuwalipiza kisasi.
english: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

kikuyu: Najua kwamba wapendezwa nami, kwa kuwa adui yangu hanishindi.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

kikuyu: Katika uadilifu wangu unanitegemeza na kuniweka kwenye uwepo wako milele.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Utenzi wa wana wa Kora. Kama vile ayala aoneavyo shauku vijito vya maji, ndivyo nafsi yangu ikuoneavyo shauku, Ee Mungu.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu inamwonea Mungu kiu, Mungu aliye hai. Ni lini nitaweza kwenda kukutana na Mungu?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

kikuyu: Machozi yangu yamekuwa chakula changu usiku na mchana, huku watu wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Mambo haya nayakumbuka ninapoimimina nafsi yangu: Jinsi nilivyokuwa nikienda na umati wa watu, nikiongoza maandamano kuelekea kwenye nyumba ya Mungu, kwa kelele za shangwe na za shukrani katikati ya umati uliosherehekea.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

kikuyu: Mungu wangu. Nafsi yangu inasononeka ndani yangu; kwa hiyo nitakukumbuka kutoka nchi ya Yordani, katika vilele vya Hermoni, kutoka Mlima Mizari.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

kikuyu: Kilindi huita kilindi, katika ngurumo za maporomoko ya maji yako; mawimbi yako yote pamoja na viwimbi vimepita juu yangu.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

kikuyu: Mchana Bwana huelekeza upendo wake, usiku wimbo wake uko nami: maombi kwa Mungu wa uzima wangu.
english: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

kikuyu: Ninamwambia Mungu Mwamba wangu, “Kwa nini umenisahau? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?”
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

kikuyu: Mifupa yangu inateseka kwa maumivu makali adui zangu wanaponidhihaki, wakiniambia mchana kutwa, “Yuko wapi Mungu wako?”
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu, Mwokozi wangu na Mungu wangu.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu unihukumu, nitetee dhidi ya taifa lisilomcha Mungu, niokoe na watu wadanganyifu na waovu.
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

kikuyu: Wewe ni Mungu ngome yangu. Kwa nini umenikataa? Kwa nini niendelee kuomboleza, nikiwa nimeonewa na adui?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

kikuyu: Tuma hima nuru yako na kweli yako na viniongoze; vinilete mpaka mlima wako mtakatifu, mpaka mahali unapoishi.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

kikuyu: Ndipo nitakwenda madhabahuni pa Mungu, kwa Mungu, furaha yangu na shangwe yangu. Nitakusifu kwa kinubi, Ee Mungu, Mungu wangu.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, kwa nini unasononeka? Kwa nini unafadhaika hivyo ndani yangu? Weka tumaini lako kwa Mungu, kwa sababu bado nitamsifu Mwokozi wangu na Mungu wangu.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Utenzi wa wana wa Kora. Ee Mungu, tumesikia kwa masikio yetu, baba zetu wametueleza yale uliyotenda katika siku zao, siku za kale.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

kikuyu: Kwa mkono wako uliwafukuza mataifa na ukawapanda baba zetu, uliangamiza mataifa na kuwastawisha baba zetu.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

kikuyu: Sio kwa upanga wao waliipata nchi, wala si mkono wao uliwapatia ushindi; ilikuwa ni kitanga cha mkono wako wa kuume, na nuru ya uso wako, kwa kuwa uliwapenda.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

kikuyu: Wewe ni mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, unayeamuru ushindi kwa Yakobo.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

kikuyu: Kwa uwezo wako tunawasukuma nyuma watesi wetu; kwa jina lako tunawakanyaga adui zetu.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

kikuyu: Siutumaini upinde wangu, upanga wangu hauniletei ushindi;
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

kikuyu: bali wewe unatupa ushindi juu ya adui zetu, unawaaibisha watesi wetu.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

kikuyu: Katika Mungu wetu tunajivuna mchana kutwa, nasi tutalisifu jina lako milele.
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa umetukataa na kutudhili, wala huendi tena na jeshi letu.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

kikuyu: Umetufanya turudi nyuma mbele ya adui, nao watesi wetu wametuteka nyara.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

kikuyu: Umetuacha tutafunwe kama kondoo na umetutawanya katika mataifa.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

kikuyu: Umewauza watu wako kwa fedha kidogo, wala hukupata faida yoyote kwa mauzo yao.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

kikuyu: Umetufanya lawama kwa jirani zetu, dharau na dhihaka kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Umetufanya kuwa mithali miongoni mwa mataifa, mataifa hutikisa vichwa vyao.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

kikuyu: Fedheha yangu iko mbele yangu mchana kutwa, na uso wangu umejaa aibu tele,
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

kikuyu: kwa ajili ya dhihaka ya wale wanaonilaumu na kunitukana, kwa sababu ya adui, ambaye anatamani kulipiza kisasi.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Hayo yote yametutokea, ingawa tulikuwa hatujakusahau wala hatujaenda kinyume na agano lako.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

kikuyu: Mioyo yetu ilikuwa haijarudi nyuma; nyayo zetu zilikuwa hazijaiacha njia yako.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

kikuyu: Lakini ulituponda na kutufanya makao ya mbweha, na ukatufunika kwa giza nene.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Kama tungalikuwa tumelisahau jina la Mungu wetu au kunyooshea mikono yetu kwa mungu mgeni,
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

kikuyu: je, Mungu hangaligundua hili, kwa kuwa anazijua siri za moyo?
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo kwa ajili yako tunauawa mchana kutwa; tumehesabiwa kama kondoo wa kuchinjwa.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

kikuyu: Amka, Ee Bwana! Kwa nini unalala? Zinduka! Usitukatae milele.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

kikuyu: Kwa nini unauficha uso wako na kusahau taabu na mateso yetu?
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

kikuyu: Tumeshushwa hadi mavumbini, miili yetu imegandamana na ardhi.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

kikuyu: Inuka na utusaidie, utukomboe kwa sababu ya upendo wako usio na mwisho.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa utenzi wa “Yungiyungi.” Utenzi wa wana wa Kora. Wimbo wa arusi. Moyo wangu umesisimuliwa na jambo jema ninapomsimulia mfalme mabeti yangu; ulimi wangu ni kalamu ya mwandishi stadi.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

kikuyu: Wewe ni bora kuliko watu wengine wote na midomo yako imepakwa neema, kwa kuwa Mungu amekubariki milele.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

kikuyu: Jifunge upanga wako pajani mwako, ee mwenye nguvu, jivike fahari na utukufu.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

kikuyu: Katika fahari yako, songa mbele kwa ushindi, kwa ajili ya kweli, unyenyekevu na haki, mkono wako wa kuume na uonyeshe matendo ya kutisha.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

kikuyu: Mishale yako mikali na ichome mioyo ya adui za mfalme, mataifa na yaanguke chini ya nyayo zako.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, kiti chako cha enzi kitadumu milele na milele, fimbo ya utawala wa haki itakuwa fimbo ya utawala wa ufalme wako.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

kikuyu: Unaipenda haki na kuchukia uovu; kwa hiyo Mungu, Mungu wako, amekuweka juu ya wenzako, kwa kukupaka mafuta ya furaha.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

kikuyu: Mavazi yako yote yana harufu nzuri ya manemane, udi na mdalasini; kutoka kwenye majumba ya kifalme yaliyopambwa kwa pembe za ndovu, sauti za vinanda vya nyuzi zinakufanya ufurahi.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

kikuyu: Binti za wafalme ni miongoni mwa wanawake wako waheshimiwa; kuume kwako yupo bibi arusi malkia aliyevaa dhahabu ya Ofiri.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

kikuyu: Sikiliza, ewe binti, fikiri na utege sikio: Sahau watu wako na nyumba ya baba yako.
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

kikuyu: Mfalme ameshangazwa na uzuri wako; mheshimu, kwa kuwa yeye ni bwana wako.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

kikuyu: Binti wa Tiro atakuletea zawadi, watu wenye utajiri watatafuta upendeleo wako.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

kikuyu: Utukufu wote una binti mfalme katika chumba chake; vazi lake limefumwa kwa nyuzi za dhahabu.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

kikuyu: Anaongozwa kwa mfalme, akiwa amevalia mavazi yaliyotariziwa, mabikira wenzake wanamfuata na wanaletwa kwako.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

kikuyu: Wanaingizwa ndani kwa shangwe na furaha, na kuingia katika jumba la mfalme.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

kikuyu: Wana wenu watachukua nafasi za baba zenu, mtawafanya wakuu katika nchi yote.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

kikuyu: Nitadumisha kumbukumbu lako katika vizazi vyote, kwa hiyo mataifa watakusifu milele na milele.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Mtindo wa alamothi. Mungu kwetu sisi ni kimbilio na nguvu, msaada utakaoonekana tele wakati wa mateso.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo hatutaogopa, hata kama dunia ikiondolewa nayo milima ikiangukia moyoni mwa bahari.
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

kikuyu: Hata kama maji yake yatanguruma na kuumuka, milima nayo ikitetemeka kwa mawimbi yake.
english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

kikuyu: Kuna mto ambao vijito vyake vinaufurahisha mji wa Mungu, mahali patakatifu ambako Aliye Juu Sana anaishi.
english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

kikuyu: Mungu yuko katikati yake, hautaanguka, Mungu atausaidia asubuhi na mapema.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

kikuyu: Mataifa yanafanya ghasia, falme zinaanguka, Yeye huinua sauti yake, dunia ikayeyuka.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

kikuyu: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote yu pamoja nasi, Mungu wa Yakobo ni ngome yetu.
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Njooni mkaone kazi za Bwana jinsi alivyofanya ukiwa katika nchi.
english: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

kikuyu: Anakomesha vita hata miisho ya dunia, anakata upinde na kuvunjavunja mkuki, anateketeza ngao kwa moto.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

kikuyu: “Tulieni, mjue ya kwamba mimi ndimi Mungu; nitatukuzwa katikati ya mataifa, nitatukuzwa katika dunia.”
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

kikuyu: Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote yu pamoja nasi; Mungu wa Yakobo ni ngome yetu.
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Pigeni makofi, enyi mataifa yote, mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

kikuyu: Jinsi gani alivyo wa kutisha, Bwana Aliye Juu Sana, Mfalme mkuu juu ya dunia yote!
english: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

kikuyu: Ametiisha mataifa chini yetu watu wengi chini ya miguu yetu.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

kikuyu: Alituchagulia urithi wetu, fahari ya Yakobo, aliyempenda.
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

kikuyu: Mungu amepaa kwa kelele za shangwe, Bwana kwa sauti za tarumbeta.
english: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Mungu sifa, imbeni sifa, mwimbieni sifa Mfalme wetu, imbeni sifa.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Mungu ni mfalme wa dunia yote, mwimbieni zaburi za sifa.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

kikuyu: Mungu anatawala juu ya mataifa, Mungu ameketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi kitakatifu.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

kikuyu: Wakuu wa mataifa wanakusanyika kama watu wa Mungu wa Abrahamu, kwa kuwa wafalme wa dunia ni mali ya Mungu; yeye ametukuka sana.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

kikuyu: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Bwana ni mkuu, anayestahili kusifiwa sana, katika mji wa Mungu wetu, mlima wake mtakatifu.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

kikuyu: Ni mzuri katika kuinuka kwake juu sana, furaha ya dunia yote. Kama vilele vya juu sana vya Safoni ni Mlima Sayuni, mji wa Mfalme Mkuu.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Mungu yuko katika ngome zake; amejionyesha mwenyewe kuwa ngome yake.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

kikuyu: Wakati wafalme walipounganisha nguvu, waliposonga mbele pamoja,
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

kikuyu: walimwona nao wakashangaa, wakakimbia kwa hofu.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

kikuyu: Kutetemeka kuliwashika huko, maumivu kama ya mwanamke mwenye utungu wa kuzaa.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

kikuyu: Uliwaangamiza kama meli za Tarshishi zilizovunjwa na upepo wa mashariki.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

kikuyu: Kama tulivyokuwa tumesikia, ndivyo tulivyoona katika mji wa Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, katika mji wa Mungu wetu: Mungu ataufanya uwe salama milele.
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, hekaluni mwako tunatafakari upendo wako usiokoma.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, kama jina lako lilivyo, sifa zako zinafika hadi miisho ya dunia, mkono wako wa kuume umejazwa na haki.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

kikuyu: Mlima Sayuni unashangilia, vijiji vya Yuda vinafurahi kwa sababu ya hukumu zako.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

kikuyu: Tembeeni katika Sayuni, uzungukeni mji, hesabuni minara yake;
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

kikuyu: yatafakarini vyema maboma yake, angalieni ngome zake, ili mpate kusimulia habari zake kwa kizazi kijacho.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa huyu Mungu ni Mungu wetu milele na milele; atakuwa kiongozi wetu hata mwisho.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Sikieni haya, enyi mataifa yote, sikilizeni, ninyi wote mkaao dunia hii.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

kikuyu: Wakubwa kwa wadogo, matajiri na maskini pamoja:
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

kikuyu: Kinywa changu kitasema maneno ya hekima, usemi wa moyo wangu utatoa ufahamu.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

kikuyu: Nitatega sikio langu nisikilize mithali, nitafafanua kitendawili kwa zeze:
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

kikuyu: Kwa nini niogope siku mbaya zinapokuja, wakati wadanganyifu waovu wanaponizunguka,
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

kikuyu: wale wanaotegemea mali zao na kujivunia utajiri wao mwingi?
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

kikuyu: Hakuna mwanadamu awaye yote awezaye kuukomboa uhai wa mwingine, au kumpa Mungu fidia kwa ajili yake.
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

kikuyu: Fidia ya uhai ni gharama kubwa, hakuna malipo yoyote yanayotosha,
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

kikuyu: ili kwamba aishi milele na asione uharibifu.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

kikuyu: Wote wanaona kwamba watu wenye hekima hufa; wajinga na wapumbavu vivyo hivyo huangamia na kuwaachia wengine mali zao.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

kikuyu: Makaburi yao yatabaki kuwa nyumba zao za milele, makao yao vizazi vyote; ingawa walikuwa na mashamba na kuyaita kwa majina yao.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

kikuyu: Lakini mwanadamu, licha ya utajiri wake, hadumu; anafanana na mnyama aangamiaye.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo hatima ya wale wanaojitumainia wenyewe, pia ya wafuasi wao, waliothibitisha misemo yao.
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

kikuyu: Kama kondoo, wamewekewa kwenda kaburini, nacho kifo kitawala. Wanyofu watawatawala asubuhi, maumbile yao yataozea kaburini, mbali na majumba yao makubwa ya fahari.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

kikuyu: Lakini Mungu atakomboa uhai wangu na kaburi, hakika atanichukua kwake.
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

kikuyu: Usitishwe mtu anapotajirika, fahari ya nyumba yake inapoongezeka,
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

kikuyu: kwa maana hatachukua chochote atakapokufa, fahari yake haitashuka pamoja naye.
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

kikuyu: Ingawa alipokuwa akiishi alijihesabu kuwa heri, na wanadamu wanakusifu unapofanikiwa,
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

kikuyu: atajiunga na kizazi cha baba zake, ambao hawataona kamwe nuru ya uzima.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

kikuyu: Mwanadamu mwenye utajiri bila ufahamu ni kama wanyama waangamiao.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Asafu. Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, Bwana, asema na kuiita dunia, tangu mawio ya jua hadi mahali pake liendapo kutua.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

kikuyu: Kutoka Sayuni, penye uzuri mkamilifu, Mungu anaangaza.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

kikuyu: Mungu wetu anakuja na hatakaa kimya, moto uteketezao unamtangulia, akiwa amezungukwa na tufani kali.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

kikuyu: Anaziita mbingu zilizo juu, na nchi, ili aweze kuwahukumu watu wake:
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

kikuyu: “Nikusanyieni watu wangu waliowekwa wakfu, waliofanya agano nami kwa dhabihu.”
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

kikuyu: Nazo mbingu zinatangaza haki yake, kwa maana Mungu mwenyewe ni hakimu.
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

kikuyu: “Sikieni, enyi watu wangu, nami nitasema, ee Israeli, nami nitashuhudia dhidi yenu: Mimi ndimi Mungu, Mungu wenu.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

kikuyu: Sikukemei kwa sababu ya dhabihu zako, au sadaka zako za kuteketezwa, ambazo daima ziko mbele zangu.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

kikuyu: Sina haja ya fahali wa banda lako, au mbuzi wa zizi lako.
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kila mnyama wa msituni ni wangu, na pia makundi ya mifugo juu ya vilima elfu.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

kikuyu: Ninamjua kila ndege mlimani, nao viumbe wa kondeni ni wangu.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

kikuyu: Kama ningekuwa na njaa, nisingewaambia ninyi, kwa maana ulimwengu ni wangu, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

kikuyu: Je, mimi hula nyama ya mafahali au kunywa damu ya mbuzi?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

kikuyu: Toa sadaka za shukrani kwa Mungu, timiza nadhiri zako kwake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana,
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

kikuyu: na uniite siku ya taabu; nami nitakuokoa, nawe utanitukuza.”
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

kikuyu: Lakini kwake mtu mwovu, Mungu asema: “Una haki gani kunena sheria zangu au kuchukua agano langu midomoni mwako?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

kikuyu: Unachukia mafundisho yangu na kuyatupa maneno yangu nyuma yako.
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

kikuyu: Unapomwona mwizi, unaungana naye, unapiga kura yako pamoja na wazinzi.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

kikuyu: Unakitumia kinywa chako kwa mabaya na kuuongoza ulimi wako kwa hila.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

kikuyu: Wanena daima dhidi ya ndugu yako na kumsingizia mwana wa mama yako.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

kikuyu: Mambo haya unayafanya, nami nimekaa kimya, ukafikiri Mimi nami ni kama wewe. Lakini nitakukemea na kuweka mashtaka mbele yako.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

kikuyu: “Yatafakarini haya, ninyi mnaomsahau Mungu, ama sivyo nitawararua vipande vipande, wala hapatakuwepo na yeyote wa kuwaokoa:
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Atoaye dhabihu za shukrani ananiheshimu mimi, naye aiandaa njia yake ili nimwonyeshe wokovu wa Mungu.”
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Baada ya kukemewa na nabii Nathani kwa kuzini na Bathsheba. Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa kadiri ya upendo wako usiokoma, kwa kadiri ya huruma yako kuu, uyafute makosa yangu.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

kikuyu: Unioshe na uovu wangu wote na unitakase dhambi yangu.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ninajua makosa yangu, na dhambi yangu iko mbele yangu daima.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

kikuyu: Dhidi yako, wewe peke yako, nimetenda dhambi na kufanya yaliyo mabaya machoni pako, ili uthibitike kuwa wa kweli unenapo, na kuwa na haki utoapo hukumu.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

kikuyu: Hakika mimi nilizaliwa mwenye dhambi, mwenye dhambi tangu nilipotungwa mimba kwa mama yangu.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

kikuyu: Hakika wewe wapendezwa na kweli itokayo moyoni, ndani sana ya moyo wangu wanifundisha hekima.
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

kikuyu: Nioshe kwa hisopo, nami nitakuwa safi, unisafishe, nami nitakuwa mweupe kuliko theluji.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

kikuyu: Unipe kusikia furaha na shangwe, mifupa uliyoiponda na ifurahi.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

kikuyu: Ufiche uso wako usizitazame dhambi zangu, na uufute uovu wangu wote.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, uniumbie moyo safi, uifanye upya roho ya uthabiti ndani yangu.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

kikuyu: Usinitupe kutoka mbele zako wala kuniondolea Roho wako Mtakatifu.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

kikuyu: Unirudishie tena furaha ya wokovu wako, unipe roho ya utii, ili initegemeze.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

kikuyu: Ndipo nitakapowafundisha wakosaji njia zako, na wenye dhambi watakugeukia wewe.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, Mungu uniokoaye, niokoe na hatia ya kumwaga damu, nao ulimi wangu utaimba juu ya haki yako.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, fungua midomo yangu, na kinywa changu kitatangaza sifa zako.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

kikuyu: Wewe hupendezwi na dhabihu, au ningaliileta, hufurahii sadaka za kuteketezwa.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

kikuyu: Bali dhabihu za Mungu ni roho iliyovunjika, moyo uliovunjika wenye toba, Ee Mungu, hutaudharau.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

kikuyu: Kwa wema wa radhi yako uifanye Sayuni istawi, ukazijenge upya kuta za Yerusalemu.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Hapo ndipo kutakapokuwa na dhabihu za haki, sadaka nzima za kuteketezwa za kukupendeza sana, pia mafahali watatolewa madhabahuni mwako.
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Utenzi wa Daudi. Baada ya Doegi, Mwedomu kumwendea Sauli na kumjulisha kuwa: “Daudi amekwenda nyumbani kwa Ahimeleki.” Ewe jitu, mbona unajivunia ubaya? Kwa nini unajivuna mchana kutwa, wewe ambaye ni fedheha mbele za Mungu?
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

kikuyu: Ulimi wako hupanga mashauri mabaya ya maangamizi. Ni kama wembe mkali, ninyi mfanyao hila.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

kikuyu: Unapenda mabaya kuliko mema, uongo kuliko kusema kweli.
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Unapenda kila neno lenye kudhuru, ewe ulimi wenye hila!
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Hakika Mungu atakushusha chini kwa maangamizi ya milele: atakunyakua na kukuondoa kwa nguvu kutoka hema yako, atakungʼoa kutoka nchi ya walio hai.
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

kikuyu: Wenye haki wataona na kuogopa, watamcheka, wakisema,
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

kikuyu: “Huyu ni yule mtu ambaye hakumfanya Mungu kuwa ngome yake, bali alitumainia wingi wa utajiri wake, na akawa hodari kwa kuwaangamiza wengine!”
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Lakini mimi ni kama mti wa mzeituni unaostawi katika nyumba ya Mungu, nautegemea upendo wa Mungu usiokoma milele na milele.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

kikuyu: Nitakusifu milele kwa yale uliyoyatenda, nitatumaini jina lako, kwa kuwa jina lako ni jema. Nitakusifu mbele ya watakatifu wako.
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa mahalathi. Utenzi wa Daudi. Mpumbavu anasema moyoni mwake, “Hakuna Mungu.” Wameharibika, na njia zao ni za uovu kabisa, hakuna hata mmoja atendaye mema.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Mungu anawachungulia wanadamu chini kutoka mbinguni aone kama wako wenye akili, wowote wanaomtafuta Mungu.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

kikuyu: Kila mmoja amegeukia mbali, wameharibika wote pamoja, hakuna atendaye mema. Naam, hakuna hata mmoja!
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Je, watendao mabaya kamwe hawatajifunza: wale ambao huwala watu wangu kama watu walavyo mkate, hao ambao hawamwiti Mungu?
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

kikuyu: Hapo waliingiwa na hofu kuu, ambapo hapakuwa cha kutetemesha. Mungu alitawanya mifupa ya wale waliokushambulia; uliwaaibisha, kwa sababu Mungu aliwadharau.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

kikuyu: Laiti wokovu wa Israeli ungalikuja kutoka Sayuni! Wakati Mungu arejeshapo wafungwa wa watu wake, Yakobo na ashangilie, Israeli na afurahi!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Na ala za nyuzi za uimbaji. Utenzi wa Daudi. Wakati Wazifu walimwendea Sauli na kumjulisha, “Je, Daudi hajifichi miongoni mwetu?” Ee Mungu uniokoe kwa jina lako, unifanyie hukumu kwa uwezo wako.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, sikia maombi yangu, usikilize maneno ya kinywa changu.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Wageni wananishambulia, watu wakatili wanayatafuta maisha yangu, watu wasiomjali Mungu.
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

kikuyu: Hakika Mungu ni msaada wangu, Bwana ndiye anayenitegemeza.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

kikuyu: Mabaya na yawarudie wale wanaonisingizia, kwa uaminifu wako uwaangamize.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

kikuyu: Nitakutolea dhabihu za hiari; Ee Bwana, nitalisifu jina lako kwa kuwa ni vyema.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ameniokoa katika shida zangu zote, na macho yangu yamewatazama adui zangu kwa ushindi.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Na ala za uimbaji. Utenzi wa Daudi. Ee Mungu, sikiliza maombi yangu, wala usidharau hoja yangu.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

kikuyu: Nisikie na unijibu. Mawazo yangu yananisumbua na nimehangaishwa
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

kikuyu: kwa sauti ya adui, kwa kukaziwa macho na waovu, kwa sababu wananiletea mateso juu yangu na kunitukana kwa hasira zao.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu umejaa uchungu, hofu ya kifo imenishambulia.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Woga na kutetemeka vimenizunguka, hofu kuu imenigharikisha.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

kikuyu: Nilisema, “Laiti ningekuwa na mbawa za njiwa! Ningeruka niende mbali kupumzika.
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

kikuyu: Ningalitorokea mbali sana na kukaa jangwani,
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

kikuyu: ningaliharakisha kwenda mahali pa salama, mbali na tufani kali na dhoruba.”
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uwatahayarishe waovu na uwachanganyishie semi zao, maana nimeona jeuri na ugomvi mjini.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

kikuyu: Usiku na mchana wanazunguka juu ya kuta zake, uovu na dhuluma vimo ndani yake.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

kikuyu: Nguvu za uharibifu zinatenda kazi mjini, vitisho na uongo haviondoki mitaani mwake.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

kikuyu: Kama aliyenitukana ni adui yangu, ningevumilia, kama mtu mwovu angejiinua dhidi yangu, ningejificha asinione.
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

kikuyu: Kumbe ni wewe, mwenzangu, mshiriki na rafiki yangu wa karibu,
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

kikuyu: ambaye awali tulifurahia ushirika mzuri, tulipokuwa tukienda na umati hekaluni mwa Mungu.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

kikuyu: Kifo na kiwajie adui zangu ghafula, na washuke kuzimu wangali hai, kwa maana uovu upo ndani yao.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

kikuyu: Lakini ninamwita Mungu, naye Bwana huniokoa.
english: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

kikuyu: Jioni, asubuhi na adhuhuri ninalia kwa huzuni, naye husikia sauti yangu.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

kikuyu: Huniokoa nikawa salama katika vita vilivyopangwa dhidi yangu, ingawa watu wengi hunipinga.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

kikuyu: Mungu anayemiliki milele, atawasikia na kuwaadhibu, watu ambao hawabadilishi njia zao, wala hawana hofu ya Mungu.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

kikuyu: Mwenzangu hushambulia rafiki zake, naye huvunja agano lake.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

kikuyu: Mazungumzo yake ni laini kama siagi, hata hivyo vita vimo moyoni mwake. Maneno yake ni mororo kuliko mafuta, hata hivyo ni upanga mkali uliofutwa.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

kikuyu: Mtwike Bwana fadhaa zako, naye atakutegemeza, hatamwacha kamwe mwenye haki wake aanguke.
english: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, utawashusha waovu katika shimo la uharibifu. Wenye kiu ya kumwaga damu na wenye hila, hawataishi nusu ya siku zao. Lakini mimi ninakutumaini wewe.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Njiwa mkimya wa mbali.” Utenzi wa Daudi. Baada ya kukamatwa na Wafilisti huko Gathi. Ee Mungu unihurumie, maana watu wananifuatia vikali; mchana kutwa wanazidisha mashambulizi yao.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

kikuyu: Wasingiziaji wangu wananifuatia mchana kutwa, wengi wananishambulia kwa kiburi chao.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

kikuyu: Wakati ninapoogopa, nitakutumaini wewe.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

kikuyu: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Mungu ninatumaini; sitaogopa. Mwanadamu apatikanaye na kufa, atanitenda nini?
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

kikuyu: Mchana kutwa wanayageuza maneno yangu, siku zote wanapanga shauri la kunidhuru.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

kikuyu: Wananifanyia hila, wanajificha, wanatazama hatua zangu, wakiwa na shauku ya kuutoa uhai wangu.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

kikuyu: Wasiepuke kwa vyovyote, Ee Mungu, katika hasira yako yaangushe mataifa.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

kikuyu: Andika maombolezo yangu, orodhesha machozi yangu katika gombo lako: je, haya hayapo katika kumbukumbu zako?
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

kikuyu: Ndipo adui zangu watarudi nyuma ninapoita msaada. Kwa hili nitajua kwamba Mungu yuko upande wangu.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

kikuyu: Katika Mungu, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu, katika Bwana, ambaye neno lake ninalisifu,
english: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

kikuyu: katika Mungu ninatumaini, sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, nina nadhiri kwako, nitakutolea wewe sadaka zangu za shukrani.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa umeniokoa toka kwenye mauti na miguu yangu kwenye kujikwaa, ili niweze kuenenda mbele za Mungu katika nuru ya uzima.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Utenzi wa Daudi. Baada ya kumponyoka Sauli pangoni. Unihurumie, Ee Mungu, unihurumie, kwa maana nafsi yangu inakukimbilia. Chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako nitakimbilia mpaka maafa yapite.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

kikuyu: Namlilia Mungu Aliye Juu Sana, Mungu atimizaye makusudi yake kwangu.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

kikuyu: Hutumana kutoka mbinguni na kuniokoa, akiwakemea wale wanaonifuatilia vikali; Mungu huutuma upendo wake na uaminifu wake.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

kikuyu: Niko katikati ya simba, nimelala katikati ya wanyama wenye njaa kuu: watu ambao meno yao ni mikuki na mishale, ambao ndimi zao ni panga kali.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

kikuyu: Waliitegea miguu yangu nyavu, nikainamishwa chini na dhiki. Wamechimba shimo katika njia yangu, lakini wametumbukia humo wao wenyewe.
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, moyo wangu ni thabiti; nitaimba na kusifu kwa moyo wangu wote.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Amka, nafsi yangu! Amka, kinubi na zeze! Nitayaamsha mapambazuko.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaimba habari zako, katikati ya jamaa za watu.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

kikuyu: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu, waenea hadi mbinguni, uaminifu wako unazifikia anga.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu mbinguni, utukufu wako na uwe duniani pote.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Utenzi wa Daudi. Enyi watawala, je, kweli mwanena kwa haki? Je, mnahukumu kwa unyofu miongoni mwa watu?
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

kikuyu: La, mioyoni mwenu mnatunga udhalimu, na mikono yenu hupima jeuri duniani.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

kikuyu: Waovu ni wapotovu tangu kuzaliwa kwao, toka tumboni mwa mama zao ni wakaidi na husema uongo.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

kikuyu: Sumu yao ni kama sumu ya nyoka, kama ile ya fira ambaye ameziba masikio yake,
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

kikuyu: ambaye hatasikia sauti ya kutumbuiza ya mwaguzi, hata kama mganga angecheza kwa ustadi kiasi gani.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, yavunje meno katika vinywa vyao; Ee Bwana, vunja meno makali ya hao simba!
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

kikuyu: Na watoweke kama maji yapitayo kwa kasi, wavutapo pinde zao, mishale yao na iwe butu.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

kikuyu: Kama konokono ayeyukavyo akitembea, kama mtoto aliyezaliwa akiwa mfu, wasilione jua.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

kikuyu: Kabla vyungu vyenu havijapata moto wa kuni za miiba, zikiwa mbichi au kavu, waovu watakuwa wamefagiliwa mbali.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

kikuyu: Wenye haki watafurahi waonapo wakilipizwa kisasi, watakapochovya nyayo zao katika damu ya waovu.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

kikuyu: Ndipo wanadamu watasema, “Hakika utulivu wa wenye haki bado una thawabu, hakika kuna Mungu ahukumuye dunia.”
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Utenzi wa Daudi. Wakati Sauli alipotuma wapelelezi nyumbani mwa Daudi ili wamuue. Ee Mungu, uniokoe na adui zangu, unilinde kutokana na hao wanaoinuka dhidi yangu.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Uniponye na watu watendao mabaya, uniokoe kutokana na wamwagao damu.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

kikuyu: Tazama wanavyonivizia! Watu wakali wananifanyia hila, ingawa Ee Bwana, mimi sijakosea wala kutenda dhambi.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

kikuyu: Sijatenda kosa; hata hivyo wako tayari kunishambulia. Inuka unisaidie, uone hali yangu mbaya!
english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mungu wa Israeli! Zinduka uyaadhibu mataifa yote, usionyeshe huruma kwa wasaliti.
english: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

kikuyu: Hurudi wakati wa jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

kikuyu: Tazama yale wanayotema kutoka vinywa vyao, hutema upanga kutoka midomo yao, nao husema, “Ni nani atakayetusikia?”
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Bwana, uwacheke; unayadharau mataifa hayo yote.
english: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

kikuyu: Ee nguvu yangu, ninakutazama wewe, wewe, Ee Mungu, ndiwe ngome yangu,
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

kikuyu: Mungu wangu unipendaye. Mungu atanitangulia, naye atanifanya niwachekelee wale wanaonisingizia.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

kikuyu: Lakini usiwaue, Ee Bwana, ngao yetu, au sivyo watu wangu watasahau. Katika uwezo wako wafanye watangetange na uwashushe chini.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya dhambi za vinywa vyao, kwa ajili ya maneno ya midomo yao, waache wanaswe katika kiburi chao. Kwa ajili ya laana na uongo wanaotamka,
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

kikuyu: wateketeze katika ghadhabu, wateketeze hadi wasiwepo tena. Ndipo itakapofahamika katika miisho ya dunia kwamba Mungu anatawala juu ya Yakobo.
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Hurudi jioni, wakibweka kama mbwa, wakiuzurura mji.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

kikuyu: Wanatangatanga wakitafuta chakula, wasipotosheka hubweka kama mbwa.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi nitaziimba nguvu zako, asubuhi nitaimba juu ya upendo wako; kwa maana wewe ndiwe ngome yangu na kimbilio langu wakati wa shida.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

kikuyu: Ee uliye Nguvu zangu, ninakuimbia sifa. Wewe, Ee Mungu, ndiwe ngome yangu, Mungu unipendaye.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Shushani Eduthi.” Utenzi wa Daudi wa kufundisha. Wakati alipopigana na Waaramu kutoka Aramu-Naharaimu na Aramu-Soba, naye Yoabu akarudi nyuma na kuwaua Waedomu 12,000 katika Bonde la Chumvi. Ee Mungu, umetukataa na kutokea ghafula juu yetu, umekasirika: sasa turejeshe upya!
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

kikuyu: Umetetemesha nchi na kuipasua; uiponye mavunjiko yake, kwa maana inatetemeka.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

kikuyu: Umewaonyesha watu wako nyakati za kukata tamaa; umetunywesha mvinyo unaotuyumbisha.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

kikuyu: Kwa wale wanaokucha wewe, umewainulia bendera, ili iweze kutwekwa dhidi ya upinde.
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Mungu amenena kutoka patakatifu pake: “Nitaigawa Shekemu kwa ushindi na kulipima Bonde la Sukothi.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Gileadi ni yangu na Manase ni yangu; Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Moabu ni sinia langu la kunawia, juu ya Edomu natupa kiatu changu; nashangilia kwa kushindwa kwa Ufilisti.”
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Ni nani atakayenipeleka hadi mji wenye ngome? Ni nani atakayeniongoza hadi nifike Edomu?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, si ni wewe uliyetukataa sisi, na hutoki tena na majeshi yetu?
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

kikuyu: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Kwa msaada wa Mungu tutapata ushindi, naye atawaponda adui zetu.
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za uimbaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, sikia kilio changu, usikilize maombi yangu.
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

kikuyu: Kutoka miisho ya dunia ninakuita, ninaita huku moyo wangu unadhoofika; uniongoze kwenye mwamba ule ulio juu kuliko mimi.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa umekuwa kimbilio langu, ngome imara dhidi ya adui.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

kikuyu: Natamani kukaa hemani mwako milele, na kukimbilia chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako.
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, kwa kuwa umesikia nadhiri zangu, umenipa urithi wa wale wanaoliogopa jina lako.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

kikuyu: Mwongezee mfalme siku za maisha yake, miaka yake kwa vizazi vingi.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

kikuyu: Yeye na atawazwe kwenye kiti cha enzi mbele za Mungu milele; amuru upendo wako na uaminifu wako vimlinde.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

kikuyu: Ndipo daima nitaliimbia sifa jina lako na kuzitimiza nadhiri zangu siku baada ya siku.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Daudi. Kwa Mungu peke yake nafsi yangu inapata pumziko; wokovu wangu watoka kwake.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

kikuyu: Yeye peke yake ndiye mwamba wangu na wokovu wangu; yeye ni ngome yangu, sitatikisika kamwe.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

kikuyu: Mtamshambulia mtu hata lini? Je, ninyi nyote mtamtupa chini, ukuta huu ulioinama na uzio huu unaotikisika?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

kikuyu: Walikusudia kikamilifu kumwangusha toka mahali pake pa fahari; wanafurahia uongo. Kwa vinywa vyao hubariki, lakini ndani ya mioyo yao hulaani.
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, upumzike, kwa Mungu peke yake, tumaini langu latoka kwake.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

kikuyu: Yeye peke yake ndiye mwamba wangu na wokovu wangu; ndiye ngome yangu, sitatikisika.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

kikuyu: Wokovu wangu na heshima yangu viko kwa Mungu, ndiye mwamba wangu wenye nguvu na kimbilio langu.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

kikuyu: Enyi watu, mtumainini yeye wakati wote, miminieni mioyo yenu kwake, kwa kuwa Mungu ni kimbilio letu.
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

kikuyu: Binadamu wa ngazi ya chini ni pumzi tu, nao wa ngazi ya juu ni uongo tu; wakipimwa kwenye mizani, si chochote; wote kwa pamoja ni pumzi tu.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

kikuyu: Usitumainie vya udhalimu wala usijivune kwa vitu vya wizi; ingawa utajiri wako utaongezeka, usiviwekee moyo wako.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

kikuyu: Jambo moja Mungu amelisema, mambo mawili nimeyasikia: kwamba, Ee Mungu, wewe una nguvu,
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

kikuyu: na kwamba, Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye upendo. Hakika utampa kila mtu thawabu kwa kadiri ya alivyotenda.
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Wakati alipokuwa katika Jangwa la Yuda. Ee Mungu, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nakutafuta kwa moyo wote; nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu, mwili wangu unakuonea wewe shauku, katika nchi kame na iliyochoka mahali ambapo hapana maji.
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

kikuyu: Nimekuona katika mahali patakatifu na kuuona uwezo wako na utukufu wako.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu upendo wako ni bora kuliko uhai, midomo yangu itakuadhimisha.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

kikuyu: Nitakusifu siku zote za maisha yangu, na kwa jina lako nitainua mikono yangu.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu itatoshelezwa kama kwa wingi wa vyakula; kwa midomo iimbayo kinywa changu kitakusifu wewe.
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

kikuyu: Kitandani mwangu ninakukumbuka wewe, ninawaza juu yako makesha yote ya usiku.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu wewe ndiwe msaada wangu, chini ya uvuli wa mbawa zako naimba.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu inaambatana nawe, mkono wako wa kuume hunishika.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

kikuyu: Wale wanaotafuta uhai wangu wataharibiwa, watakwenda chini kwenye vilindi vya dunia.
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

kikuyu: Watatolewa wafe kwa upanga, nao watakuwa chakula cha mbweha.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

kikuyu: Bali mfalme atafurahi katika Mungu, wale wote waapao kwa jina la Mungu watamsifu, bali vinywa vya waongo vitanyamazishwa.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, unisikie ninapoeleza lalamiko langu, uyahifadhi maisha yangu kutokana na vitisho vya adui.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

kikuyu: Unifiche kutokana na shauri la siri la waovu, kutokana na zile kelele za kundi la watenda mabaya.
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

kikuyu: Wananoa ndimi zao kama panga na kuelekeza maneno yao kama mishale ya kufisha.
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

kikuyu: Hurusha mishale kutoka kwenye mavizio kwa mtu asiye na hatia, humrushia ghafula bila woga.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

kikuyu: Kila mmoja humtia moyo mwenzake katika mipango mibaya; huzungumza juu ya kuficha mitego yao, nao husema, “Ni nani ataiona?”
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

kikuyu: Hufanya shauri baya la dhuluma na kusema, “Tumebuni mpango mkamilifu!” Hakika nia na moyo wa mwanadamu vina hila.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

kikuyu: Bali Mungu atawapiga kwa mishale, nao ghafula wataangushwa.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

kikuyu: Atageuza ndimi zao wenyewe dhidi yao na kuwaleta kwenye maangamizi; wote wawaonao watatikisa vichwa vyao kwa dharau.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

kikuyu: Wanadamu wote wataogopa, watatangaza kazi za Mungu na kutafakari yale aliyoyatenda.
english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

kikuyu: Wenye haki na wafurahi katika Bwana, na wakimbilie kwake; wanyofu wote wa moyo na wamsifu yeye!
english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Wimbo. Ee Mungu, sifa zakungojea katika Sayuni; kwako wewe nadhiri zetu zitatimizwa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

kikuyu: Ewe usikiaye maombi, kwako wewe watu wote watakuja.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

kikuyu: Tulipokuwa tumefunikwa kabisa na dhambi, wewe ulisamehe makosa yetu.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

kikuyu: Heri wale uliowachagua na kuwaleta karibu ili waishi katika nyua zako! Tunashibishwa kwa mema ya nyumba yako, mema ya Hekalu lako takatifu.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

kikuyu: Unatujibu kwa matendo ya kushangaza ya haki, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, tumaini la miisho yote ya duniani na la bahari zilizo mbali sana,
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

kikuyu: uliyeumba milima kwa uwezo wako, ukiwa umejivika nguvu,
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

kikuyu: uliyenyamazisha dhoruba za bahari, ngurumo za mawimbi yake, na ghasia za mataifa.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

kikuyu: Wale wanaoishi mbali sana wanaogopa maajabu yako, kule asubuhi ipambazukiapo na kule jioni inakofifilia umeziita nyimbo za furaha.
english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

kikuyu: Waitunza nchi na kuinyeshea, waitajirisha kwa wingi. Vijito vya Mungu vimejaa maji ili kuwapa watu nafaka, kwa maana wewe umeviamuru.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

kikuyu: Umeilowesha mifereji yake na kusawazisha kingo zake; umeilainisha kwa manyunyu na kuibariki mimea yake.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

kikuyu: Umeuvika mwaka taji ya baraka, magari yako yanafurika kwa wingi.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

kikuyu: Mbuga za majani za jangwani umezineemesha; vilima vimevikwa furaha.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

kikuyu: Penye nyanda za malisho pamejaa makundi ya wanyama, na mabonde yamepambwa kwa mavuno; vyote vinashangilia kwa furaha na kuimba.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Wimbo. Zaburi. Mpigieni Mungu kelele za shangwe, dunia yote!
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

kikuyu: Imbeni utukufu wa jina lake; mpeni sifa zake kwa utukufu!
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

kikuyu: Mwambieni Mungu, “Jinsi gani yalivyo ya kutisha matendo yako! Uwezo wako ni mkuu mno kiasi kwamba adui wananyenyekea mbele zako.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

kikuyu: Dunia yote yakusujudia, wanakuimbia wewe sifa, wanaliimbia sifa jina lako.”
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

kikuyu: Njooni mwone yale Mungu aliyoyatenda, mambo ya kutisha aliyoyatenda miongoni mwa wanadamu!
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

kikuyu: Alifanya bahari kuwa nchi kavu, wakapita kati ya maji kwa miguu, njooni, tumshangilie.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

kikuyu: Yeye hutawala kwa uwezo wake milele, macho yake huangalia mataifa yote: waasi wasithubutu kujiinua dhidi yake.
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

kikuyu: Enyi mataifa, msifuni Mungu wetu, sauti ya sifa yake isikike,
english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,
