kikuyu: ameyahifadhi maisha yetu na kuizuia miguu yetu kuteleza.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, wewe ulitujaribu, ukatusafisha kama fedha.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

kikuyu: Umetuingiza kwenye nyavu na umetubebesha mizigo mizito migongoni mwetu.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

kikuyu: Uliwaruhusu watu watukalie vichwani, tulipita kwenye moto na kwenye maji, lakini ulituleta kwenye nchi iliyojaa utajiri tele.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

kikuyu: Nitakuja hekaluni mwako na sadaka za kuteketezwa na kukutimizia nadhiri zangu:
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

kikuyu: nadhiri ambazo midomo yangu iliahidi na nilizotamka kwa kinywa changu nilipokuwa katika shida.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

kikuyu: Nitakutolea dhabihu za wanyama wanono na sadaka za kondoo dume, nitakutolea mafahali na mbuzi.
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

kikuyu: Njooni msikilize ninyi nyote mnaomcha Mungu, nami niwaambie aliyonitendea.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

kikuyu: Nilimlilia kwa kinywa changu, sifa zake zilikuwa katika ulimi wangu.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

kikuyu: Kama ningekuwa nimeyaficha maovu moyoni mwangu, Bwana asingekuwa amenisikiliza;
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

kikuyu: lakini hakika Mungu amenisikiliza na amesikia sauti yangu katika maombi.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

kikuyu: Sifa apewe Mungu, ambaye hakulikataa ombi langu wala kunizuilia upendo wake!
english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Na ala za nyuzi za muziki. Zaburi. Wimbo. Mungu aturehemu na kutubariki, na kutuangazia nuru za uso wake,
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

kikuyu: ili njia zako zijulikane duniani, wokovu wako katikati ya mataifa yote.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, mataifa na wakusifu, mataifa yote na wakusifu.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Mataifa yote wafurahi na kuimba kwa shangwe, kwa kuwa unatawala watu kwa haki na kuongoza mataifa ya dunia.
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, mataifa na wakusifu, mataifa yote na wakusifu.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Ndipo nchi itatoa mazao yake, naye Mungu, Mungu wetu, atatubariki.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

kikuyu: Mungu atatubariki na miisho yote ya dunia itamcha yeye.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Wimbo. Mungu na ainuke, watesi wake watawanyike, adui zake na wakimbie mbele zake.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

kikuyu: Kama vile moshi upeperushwavyo na upepo, vivyo hivyo uwapeperushe mbali, kama vile nta iyeyukavyo kwenye moto, vivyo hivyo waovu na waangamie mbele za Mungu.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

kikuyu: Bali wenye haki na wafurahi, washangilie mbele za Mungu, wafurahi na kushangilia.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Mungu, liimbieni sifa jina lake, mtukuzeni yeye aendeshwaye juu ya mawingu: jina lake ni Bwana, furahini mbele zake.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

kikuyu: Baba wa yatima, mtetezi wa wajane, ni Mungu katika makao yake matakatifu.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

kikuyu: Mungu huwaweka wapweke katika jamaa, huwaongoza wafungwa wakiimba, bali waasi huishi katika nchi kame.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, ulipowatangulia watu wako, ulipopita nyikani,
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

kikuyu: dunia ilitikisika, mbingu zikanyesha mvua, mbele za Mungu, Yule wa Sinai, mbele za Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, ulinyesha mvua nyingi na kuiburudisha ardhi iliyokuwa imechoka.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, watu wako waliishi huko, nawe kwa wingi wa utajiri wako uliwapa maskini mahitaji yao.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

kikuyu: Bwana alitangaza neno, waliolitangaza neno hilo walikuwa kundi kubwa:
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

kikuyu: “Wafalme na majeshi walikimbia upesi, watu waliobaki kambini waligawana nyara.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

kikuyu: Hata ulalapo katikati ya mioto ya kambini, mabawa ya njiwa wangu yamefunikwa kwa fedha, manyoya yake kwa dhahabu ingʼaayo.”
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

kikuyu: Wakati Mwenyezi alipowatawanya wafalme katika nchi, ilikuwa kama theluji iliyoanguka juu ya Salmoni.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

kikuyu: Milima ya Bashani ni milima iliyotukuka, milima ya Bashani ina vilele vilivyochongoka.
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

kikuyu: Enyi milima yenye vilele vilivyochongoka, kwa nini mnakazia macho kwa wivu, katika mlima Mungu anaochagua kutawala, ambako Bwana mwenyewe ataishi milele?
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

kikuyu: Magari ya Mungu ni makumi ya maelfu, na maelfu ya maelfu; Bwana amekuja kutoka Sinai hadi katika patakatifu pake.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Ulipopanda juu, uliteka mateka, ukapokea vipawa kutoka kwa wanadamu, hata kutoka kwa wale walioasi, ili wewe, Ee Bwana Mungu, upate kuishi huko.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

kikuyu: Sifa apewe Bwana, Mungu Mwokozi wetu, ambaye siku kwa siku hutuchukulia mizigo yetu.
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

kikuyu: Mungu wetu ni Mungu aokoaye, Bwana Mwenyezi hutuokoa na kifo.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

kikuyu: Hakika Mungu ataponda vichwa vya adui zake, vichwa vya hao waendao katika njia za dhambi.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

kikuyu: Bwana alisema, “Nitawarudisha kutoka Bashani; nitawarudisha kutoka vilindi vya bahari,
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

kikuyu: ili uweze kuchovya miguu yako katika damu ya adui zako, huku ndimi za mbwa wako zikiwa na fungu lake.”
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, maandamano yako yameonekana, maandamano ya Mungu wangu, Mfalme wangu, yakielekea patakatifu pake.
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Mbele wako waimbaji, baada yao wapiga vinanda, pamoja nao wako wanawali wakipiga matari.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

kikuyu: Msifuni Mungu katika kusanyiko kubwa, msifuni Bwana katika kusanyiko la Israeli.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

kikuyu: Liko kabila dogo la Benyamini likiwaongoza, wakifuatwa na kundi kubwa la watawala wa Yuda, hatimaye watawala wa Zabuloni na Naftali.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, amuru uwezo wako, Ee Mungu tuonyeshe nguvu zako, kama ulivyofanya hapo awali.
english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya Hekalu lako Yerusalemu wafalme watakuletea zawadi.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

kikuyu: Mkemee mnyama aliyeko kwenye manyasi, kundi la mafahali katikati ya ndama za mataifa. Na walete minara ya madini ya fedha wakinyenyekea. Tawanya mataifa yapendayo vita.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

kikuyu: Wajumbe watakuja kutoka Misri, Kushi atajisalimisha kwa Mungu.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Mungu, enyi falme za dunia, mwimbieni Bwana sifa,
english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

kikuyu: mwimbieni sifa yeye apandaye mbingu za kale zilizo juu, yeye angurumaye kwa sauti kuu.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

kikuyu: Tangazeni uwezo wa Mungu, ambaye fahari yake iko juu ya Israeli, ambaye uwezo wake uko katika anga.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, wewe unatisha katika mahali patakatifu pako, Mungu wa Israeli huwapa watu wake uwezo na nguvu. Mungu Asifiwe!
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Yungiyungi.” Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, niokoe, kwa maana maji yamenifika shingoni.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

kikuyu: Ninazama kwenye vilindi vya matope, pasipo mahali pa kukanyaga, Nimefika kwenye maji makuu, mafuriko yamenigharikisha.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

kikuyu: Nimechoka kwa kuomba msaada, koo langu limekauka. Macho yangu yanafifia, nikimtafuta Mungu wangu.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

kikuyu: Wale wanaonichukia bila sababu ni wengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu; wengi ni adui kwangu bila sababu, wale wanaotafuta kuniangamiza. Ninalazimishwa kurudisha kitu ambacho sikuiba.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, wewe unajua upumbavu wangu, wala hatia yangu haikufichika kwako.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ewe Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, wakutumainio wasiaibishwe kwa ajili yangu; wakutafutao wasifedheheshwe kwa ajili yangu, Ee Mungu wa Israeli.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nimestahimili dharau kwa ajili yako, aibu imefunika uso wangu.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

kikuyu: Nimekuwa mgeni kwa ndugu zangu, mgeni kwa wana wa mama yangu mwenyewe.
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa wivu wa nyumba yako unanila, matukano ya wale wanaokutukana yameniangukia.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Ninapolia na kufunga, lazima nivumilie matusi.
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

kikuyu: Ninapovaa nguo ya gunia, watu hunidharau.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

kikuyu: Wale wanaoketi mlangoni wananisimanga, nimekuwa wimbo wa walevi.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

kikuyu: Lakini Ee Bwana, ninakuomba, kwa wakati ukupendezao; katika upendo wako mkuu, Ee Mungu, unijibu kwa wokovu wako wa hakika.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

kikuyu: Uniokoe katika matope, usiniache nizame; niokoe na hao wanichukiao, kutoka kwenye vilindi vya maji.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

kikuyu: Usiache mafuriko yanigharikishe au vilindi vinimeze, au shimo lifumbe kinywa chake juu yangu.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, unijibu, kwa wema wa upendo wako; kwa huruma zako nyingi unigeukie.
english: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

kikuyu: Usimfiche mtumishi wako uso wako, uharakishe kunijibu, kwa sababu niko katika shida.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

kikuyu: Njoo karibu uniokoe, nikomboe kwa sababu ya adui zangu.
english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Unajua jinsi ninavyodharauliwa, kufedheheshwa na kuaibishwa, adui zangu wote unawajua.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

kikuyu: Dharau zimenivunja moyo na nimekata tamaa, nimetafuta wa kunihurumia, lakini sikumpata, wa kunituliza, lakini sikumpata.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

kikuyu: Waliweka nyongo katika chakula changu na walinipa siki nilipokuwa na kiu.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

kikuyu: Meza iliyoandaliwa mbele yao na iwe mtego, nayo iwe upatilizo na tanzi.
english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

kikuyu: Macho yao yatiwe giza ili wasiweze kuona, nayo migongo yao iinamishwe daima.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

kikuyu: Uwamwagie ghadhabu yako, hasira yako kali na iwapate.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

kikuyu: Mahali pao na pawe ukiwa, wala asiwepo yeyote atakayeishi katika mahema yao.
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa wanawatesa wale uliowajeruhi, na kuzungumza juu ya maumivu ya wale uliowaumiza.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

kikuyu: Walipize uovu juu ya uovu, usiwaache washiriki katika wokovu wako.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

kikuyu: Wafutwe kutoka kitabu cha uzima na wasiorodheshwe pamoja na wenye haki.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

kikuyu: Mimi niko katika maumivu na dhiki; Ee Mungu, wokovu wako na unihifadhi.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

kikuyu: Nitalisifu jina la Mungu kwa wimbo, nami nitamtukuza kwa kumtolea shukrani.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Hili litampendeza Bwana kuliko ngʼombe dume, zaidi ya fahali akiwa na pembe na kwato zake.
english: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

kikuyu: Maskini wataona na kufurahi: ninyi mnaomtafuta Mungu, mioyo yenu na iishi!
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

kikuyu: Bwana huwasikia wahitaji wala hadharau watu wake waliotekwa.
english: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

kikuyu: Mbingu na dunia zimsifu, bahari na vyote viendavyo ndani yake,
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

kikuyu: kwa maana Mungu ataiokoa Sayuni na kuijenga tena miji ya Yuda. Kisha watu watafanya makao yao humo na kuimiliki,
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

kikuyu: watoto wa watumishi wake watairithi na wale wote walipendao jina lake wataishi humo.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Maombi. Ee Mungu, ufanye haraka kuniokoa; Ee Bwana, njoo hima unisaidie.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Wale wanaotafuta kuuondoa uhai wangu, waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa; wote wanaotamani kuangamizwa kwangu, warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

kikuyu: Wale waniambiao, “Aha! Aha!” warudi nyuma kwa sababu ya aibu yao.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Lakini wote wakutafutao washangilie na kukufurahia, wale wapendao wokovu wako siku zote waseme, “Mungu na atukuzwe!”
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

kikuyu: Lakini bado mimi ni maskini na mhitaji; Ee Mungu, unijie haraka. Wewe ndiwe msaada wangu na mwokozi wangu; Ee Bwana, usikawie.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe.
english: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Kwa haki yako uniponye na kuniokoa, unitegee sikio lako uniokoe.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

kikuyu: Uwe kwangu mwamba wa kimbilio, mahali nitakapokimbilia kila wakati; toa amri ya kuniokoa, kwa kuwa wewe ni mwamba wangu na ngome yangu.
english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu wangu uniokoe kutoka kwenye mkono wa mwovu, kutoka kwenye makucha ya watu wabaya na wakatili.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa umekuwa tumaini langu, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, tegemeo langu tangu ujana wangu.
english: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

kikuyu: Tangu kuzaliwa nimekutegemea wewe, ulinitoa tumboni mwa mama yangu. Nitakusifu wewe daima.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

kikuyu: Nimekuwa kama kioja kwa wengi, lakini wewe ni kimbilio langu imara.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

kikuyu: Kinywa changu kimejazwa sifa zako, nikitangaza utukufu wako mchana kutwa.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

kikuyu: Usinitupe wakati wa uzee, wala usiniache nguvu zangu zinapopungua.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

kikuyu: Kwa maana adui zangu wananisengenya, wale wanaonivizia kuniua wafanya hila.
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

kikuyu: Wanasema, “Mungu amemwacha, mkimbilieni mkamkamate, kwani hakuna wa kumwokoa.”
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, usiwe mbali nami, njoo haraka kunisaidia, Ee Mungu wangu.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

kikuyu: Washtaki wangu na waangamie kwa aibu, wale wanaotaka kunidhuru na wafunikwe kwa dharau na fedheha.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi, nitatumaini siku zote, nitakusifu zaidi na zaidi.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

kikuyu: Kinywa changu kitasimulia haki yako, wokovu wako mchana kutwa, ingawa sifahamu kipimo chake.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, nitakuja na kutangaza matendo yako makuu, nitatangaza haki yako, yako peke yako.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, umenifundisha tangu ujana wangu, hadi leo ninatangaza matendo yako ya ajabu.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, usiniache, hata niwapo mzee wa mvi, mpaka nitangaze uwezo wako kwa kizazi kijacho, nguvu zako kwa wote watakaokuja baadaye.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, haki yako imefika juu katika mbingu, wewe ambaye umefanya mambo makuu. Ee Mungu, ni nani aliye kama wewe?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

kikuyu: Ingawa umenifanya nipate taabu, nyingi na chungu, utanihuisha tena, kutoka vilindi vya dunia utaniinua tena.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Utaongeza heshima yangu na kunifariji tena.
english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu wangu, nitakusifu kwa kinubi kwa ajili ya uaminifu wako; Ee Uliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli, nitakuimbia sifa kwa zeze.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Midomo yangu itapaza sauti kwa furaha ninapokuimbia sifa, mimi, ambaye umenikomboa.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

kikuyu: Ulimi wangu utasimulia matendo yako ya haki mchana kutwa, kwa maana wale waliotaka kunidhuru, wameaibishwa na kufadhaishwa.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Solomoni. Ee Mungu, mjalie mfalme aamue kwa haki yako, mwana wa mfalme kwa haki yako.
english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

kikuyu: Atawaamua watu wako kwa haki, watu wako walioonewa kwa haki.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

kikuyu: Milima italeta mafanikio kwa watu, vilima tunda la haki.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

kikuyu: Atawatetea walioonewa miongoni mwa watu na atawaokoa watoto wa wahitaji, ataponda mdhalimu.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

kikuyu: Atadumu kama jua lidumuvyo, kama mwezi, vizazi vyote.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Atakuwa kama mvua inyeshayo juu ya shamba lililofyekwa, kama manyunyu yanyeshayo ardhi.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

kikuyu: Katika siku zake wenye haki watastawi; mafanikio yatakuwepo mpaka mwezi utakapokoma.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

kikuyu: Atatawala kutoka bahari hadi bahari na kutoka Mto mpaka miisho ya dunia.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Makabila ya jangwani watamsujudia, na adui zake wataramba mavumbi.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

kikuyu: Wafalme wa Tarshishi na wa pwani za mbali watamletea kodi; wafalme wa Sheba na Seba watampa zawadi.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

kikuyu: Wafalme wote watamsujudia na mataifa yote yatamtumikia.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

kikuyu: Kwa maana atamwokoa mhitaji anayemlilia, aliyeonewa asiye na wa kumsaidia.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

kikuyu: Atawahurumia wanyonge na wahitaji na kuwaokoa wahitaji kutoka mauti.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

kikuyu: Atawaokoa kutoka uonevu na ukatili, kwani damu yao ni ya thamani machoni pake.
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

kikuyu: Aishi maisha marefu! Na apewe dhahabu ya Sheba. Watu wamwombee daima na kumbariki mchana kutwa.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

kikuyu: Nafaka ijae tele katika nchi yote, juu ya vilele vya vilima na istawi. Tunda lake na listawi kama Lebanoni, listawi kama majani ya kondeni.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

kikuyu: Jina lake na lidumu milele, na lidumu kama jua. Mataifa yote yatabarikiwa kupitia kwake, nao watamwita aliyebarikiwa.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

kikuyu: Bwana Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli, apewe sifa, yeye ambaye peke yake hutenda mambo ya ajabu.
english: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

kikuyu: Jina lake tukufu lisifiwe milele, ulimwengu wote ujae utukufu wake.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Huu ndio mwisho wa maombi ya Daudi mwana wa Yese.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Asafu. Hakika Mungu ni mwema kwa Israeli, kwa wale ambao mioyo yao ni safi.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

kikuyu: Bali kwangu mimi, miguu yangu ilikuwa karibu kuteleza; nilikuwa karibu mguu wangu kuachia uliposimama.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

kikuyu: Kwa maana niliwaonea wivu wenye kujivuna nilipoona kufanikiwa kwa waovu.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

kikuyu: Wao hawana taabu, miili yao ina afya na nguvu.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

kikuyu: Hawapati shida zinazowataabisha watu wengine, wala hawapati mapigo kama wanadamu wengine.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo kiburi ni mkufu wao, wamejivika jeuri.
english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

kikuyu: Uovu hutoka katika mioyo yao iliyokufa ganzi, majivuno maovu kutoka mioyoni mwao hauna kikomo.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

kikuyu: Hudhihaki na kusema kwa ukorofi, katika majivuno yao wanatishia kutesa.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

kikuyu: Vinywa vyao huweka madai hata kwa mbingu, nazo ndimi zao humiliki duniani.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo watu wao huwageukia na kunywa maji tele.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

kikuyu: Wanasema, “Mungu awezaje kujua? Je, Yeye Aliye Juu Sana anayo maarifa?”
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo walivyo waovu: siku zote hawajali, wanaongezeka katika utajiri.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

kikuyu: Hakika nimeuweka moyo wangu safi bure, ni bure nimenawa mikono yangu nisiwe na hatia.
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

kikuyu: Mchana kutwa nimetaabika, nimeadhibiwa kila asubuhi.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

kikuyu: Kama ningesema, “Nitasema hivi,” ningelikuwa nimewasaliti watoto wako.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

kikuyu: Nilipojaribu kuelewa haya yote, yalikuwa magumu kwangu kuelewa.
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

kikuyu: Mpaka nilipoingia patakatifu pa Mungu, ndipo nilipotambua mwisho wao.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

kikuyu: Hakika unawaweka mahali pa utelezi, unawaangusha chini kwa uharibifu.
english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi wanavyoangamizwa ghafula, wanatoweshwa kabisa na vitisho!
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

kikuyu: Kama ndoto mtu aamkapo, hivyo wakati uinukapo, Ee Bwana, utawatowesha kama ndoto.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

kikuyu: Wakati moyo wangu ulipohuzunishwa, na roho yangu ilipotiwa uchungu,
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

kikuyu: nilikuwa mpumbavu na mjinga, nilikuwa mnyama mkatili mbele yako.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo niko pamoja nawe siku zote, umenishika mkono wangu wa kuume.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

kikuyu: Unaniongoza kwa shauri lako, hatimaye utaniingiza katika utukufu.
english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

kikuyu: Nani niliye naye mbinguni ila wewe? Dunia haina chochote ninachokitamani ila wewe.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

kikuyu: Mwili na moyo wangu vyaweza kushindwa, bali Mungu ni nguvu ya moyo wangu na fungu langu milele.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

kikuyu: Wale walio mbali nawe wataangamia, unawaangamiza wote wasio waaminifu kwako.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

kikuyu: Lakini kwangu mimi, ni vyema kuwa karibu na Mungu. Nimemfanya Bwana Mwenyezi kimbilio langu; nami nitayasimulia matendo yako yote.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

kikuyu: Utenzi wa Asafu. Ee Mungu, mbona umetukataa milele? Mbona hasira yako inatoka moshi juu ya kondoo wa malisho yako?
english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

kikuyu: Kumbuka watu uliowanunua zamani, kabila la urithi wako, ambao uliwakomboa: Mlima Sayuni, ambamo uliishi.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

kikuyu: Geuza hatua zako kuelekea magofu haya ya kudumu, uharibifu wote huu ambao adui ameuleta pale patakatifu.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Adui zako wamenguruma pale ulipokutana nasi, wanaweka bendera zao kama alama.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

kikuyu: Walifanya kama watu wanaotumia mashoka kukata kichaka cha miti.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

kikuyu: Walivunjavunja milango yote iliyonakshiwa kwa mashoka na vishoka vyao.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

kikuyu: Waliteketeza kabisa mahali pako patakatifu, wakayanajisi makao ya Jina lako.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

kikuyu: Walisema mioyoni mwao, “Tutawaponda kabisa!” Walichoma kila mahali ambapo Mungu aliabudiwa katika nchi.
english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

kikuyu: Hatukupewa ishara za miujiza; hakuna manabii waliobaki, hakuna yeyote kati yetu ajuaye hali hii itachukua muda gani.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, mtesi atakudhihaki mpaka lini? Je, adui watalitukana jina lako milele?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

kikuyu: Kwa nini unazuia mkono wako, mkono wako wa kuume? Uutoe kutoka makunjo ya vazi lako na uwaangamize!
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Mungu, ni mfalme wangu tangu zamani, unaleta wokovu duniani.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

kikuyu: Ni wewe uliyeigawanya bahari kwa uweza wako; ulivunja vichwa vya wanyama wakubwa wa kutisha katika maji.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

kikuyu: Ni wewe uliyeponda vichwa vya Lewiathani nawe ukamtoa kama chakula kwa viumbe vya jangwani.
english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

kikuyu: Ni wewe uliyefungua chemchemi na vijito, ulikausha mito ambayo ilikuwa ikitiririka daima.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

kikuyu: Mchana ni wako, nao usiku ni wako pia, uliziweka jua na mwezi.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

kikuyu: Ni wewe uliyeiweka mipaka yote ya dunia, ulifanya kiangazi na masika.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, kumbuka jinsi mtesi alivyokudhihaki, jinsi watu wapumbavu walivyolitukana jina lako.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

kikuyu: Usiukabidhi uhai wa njiwa wako kwa wanyama wakali wa mwitu; usisahau kabisa uhai wa watu wako wanaoteseka milele.
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

kikuyu: Likumbuke agano lako, maana mara kwa mara mambo ya jeuri yamejaa katika sehemu za giza nchini.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

kikuyu: Usiruhusu walioonewa warudi nyuma kwa aibu; maskini na wahitaji hebu walisifu jina lako.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

kikuyu: Inuka, Ee Mungu, ujitetee; kumbuka jinsi wapumbavu wanavyokudhihaki mchana kutwa.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

kikuyu: Usipuuze makelele ya watesi wako, ghasia za adui zako, zinazoinuka mfululizo.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Usiharibu!” Zaburi ya Asafu. Wimbo. Ee Mungu, tunakushukuru, tunakushukuru wewe, kwa kuwa jina lako li karibu; watu husimulia matendo yako ya ajabu.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Unasema, “Ninachagua wakati maalum; ni mimi nihukumuye kwa haki.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

kikuyu: Wakati dunia na watu wake wote inapotetemeka, ni mimi ninayezishikilia nguzo zake imara.
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kikuyu: Kwa wale wenye majivuno ninasema, ‘Msijisifu tena,’ kwa wale waovu, ‘Msiinue pembe zenu.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

kikuyu: Msiinue pembe zenu dhidi ya mbingu; msiseme kwa shingo zilizonyooshwa.’ ”
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

kikuyu: Hakuna yeyote atokaye mashariki wala magharibi au kutoka jangwani awezaye kumkweza mwanadamu.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

kikuyu: Bali Mungu ndiye ahukumuye: Humshusha huyu na kumkweza mwingine.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

kikuyu: Mkononi mwa Bwana kuna kikombe kilichojaa mvinyo unaotoka povu uliochanganywa na vikolezo; huumimina, nao waovu wote wa dunia hunywa mpaka tone la mwisho.
english: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

kikuyu: Bali mimi, nitatangaza hili milele; nitaimba sifa kwa Mungu wa Yakobo.
english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Nitazikatilia mbali pembe za waovu wote, bali pembe za wenye haki zitainuliwa juu.
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Kwa ala za nyuzi za muziki. Zaburi ya Asafu. Wimbo. Katika Yuda, Mungu anajulikana, jina lake ni kuu katika Israeli.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

kikuyu: Hema lake liko Salemu, makao yake katika Sayuni.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

kikuyu: Huko alivunja mishale imetametayo, ngao na panga, silaha za vita.
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

kikuyu: Wewe unangʼaa kwa mwanga, mwenye fahari zaidi ya milima yenye utajiri wa wanyama pori.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

kikuyu: Mashujaa hulala wametekwa nyara, hulala usingizi wao wa mwisho; hakuna hata mmoja wa watu wa vita anayeweza kuinua mikono yake.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

kikuyu: Kwa kukemea kwako, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo, farasi na gari la vita vilikaa kimya.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

kikuyu: Wewe peke yako ndiye wa kuogopwa. Ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele yako unapokasirika?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

kikuyu: Kutoka mbinguni ulitamka hukumu, nayo nchi ikaogopa, ikawa kimya:
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

kikuyu: wakati wewe, Ee Mungu, ulipoinuka kuhukumu, kuwaokoa wote walioonewa katika nchi.
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Hakika ghadhabu yako dhidi ya wanadamu inakuletea sifa, na masalia ya ghadhabu yako unajifunga mshipi.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

kikuyu: Wekeni nadhiri kwa Bwana Mungu wenu na kuzitimiza; nchi zote za jirani na walete zawadi kwa Yule astahiliye kuogopwa.
english: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

kikuyu: Huvunja roho za watawala; anaogopwa na wafalme wa dunia.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Asafu. Nilimlilia Mungu ili anisaidie, nilimlilia Mungu ili anisikie.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

kikuyu: Nilipokuwa katika taabu, nilimtafuta Bwana, usiku nilinyoosha mikono bila kuchoka na nafsi yangu ilikataa kufarijika.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, nilikukumbuka wewe, nikalia kwa huzuni; nikatafakari, roho yangu ikadhoofika.
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

kikuyu: Ulizuia macho yangu kufumba; nilikuwa nasumbuka, nikashindwa kusema.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

kikuyu: Nilitafakari juu ya siku zilizopita, miaka mingi iliyopita,
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

kikuyu: nilikumbuka nilivyoimba nyimbo usiku. Moyo wangu ulitafakari na roho yangu ikauliza:
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

kikuyu: “Je, Bwana atakataa milele? Je, hatatenda mema tena?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

kikuyu: Je, upendo wake usio na mwisho umetoweka milele? Je, ahadi yake imekoma nyakati zote?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

kikuyu: Je, Mungu amesahau kuwa na huruma? Je, katika hasira amezuia huruma yake?”
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

kikuyu: Ndipo nikawaza, “Huu ndio udhaifu wangu: lakini nitakumbuka miaka ya mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Juu Sana.”
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

kikuyu: Nitayakumbuka matendo ya Bwana; naam, nitaikumbuka miujiza yako ya zamani.
english: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

kikuyu: Nitazitafakari kazi zako zote na kuyawaza matendo yako makuu.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, njia zako ni takatifu. Ni mungu yupi aliye mkuu kama Mungu wetu?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

kikuyu: Wewe ndiwe Mungu utendaye miujiza, umeonyesha uwezo wako katikati ya mataifa.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu umewakomboa watu wako, uzao wa Yakobo na Yosefu.
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

kikuyu: Maji yalikuona, Ee Mungu, maji yalikuona yakakimbia, vilindi vilitetemeka.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

kikuyu: Mawingu yalimwaga maji, mbingu zikatoa ngurumo kwa radi, mishale yako ikametameta huku na huko.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

kikuyu: Ngurumo yako ilisikika katika upepo wa kisulisuli, umeme wako wa radi ukaangaza dunia, nchi ikatetemeka na kutikisika.
english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

kikuyu: Njia yako ilipita baharini, mapito yako kwenye maji makuu, ingawa nyayo zako hazikuonekana.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

kikuyu: Uliongoza watu wako kama kundi kwa mkono wa Mose na Aroni.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Utenzi wa Asafu. Enyi watu wangu, sikieni mafundisho yangu, sikilizeni maneno ya kinywa changu.
english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Nitafungua kinywa changu kwa mafumbo, nitazungumza mambo yaliyofichika, mambo ya kale:
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

kikuyu: yale ambayo tuliyasikia na kuyajua, yale ambayo baba zetu walituambia.
english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

kikuyu: Hatutayaficha kwa watoto wao; tutakiambia kizazi kijacho matendo yastahiliyo sifa ya Bwana, uweza wake, na maajabu aliyoyafanya.
english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

kikuyu: Aliagiza amri kwa Yakobo na akaweka sheria katika Israeli, ambazo aliwaamuru baba zetu wawafundishe watoto wao,
english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

kikuyu: ili kizazi kijacho kizijue, pamoja na watoto ambao watazaliwa, nao pia wapate kuwaeleza watoto wao.
english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

kikuyu: Ndipo wangeweka tumaini lao kwa Mungu, nao wasingesahau matendo yake, bali wangalizishika amri zake.
english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Ili wasifanane na baba zao, waliokuwa kizazi cha ukaidi na uasi, ambao roho zao hazikuwa na uaminifu kwake, ambao roho zao hazikumwamini.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

kikuyu: Watu wa Efraimu, ingawa walijifunga pinde, walikimbia siku ya vita.
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Hawakulishika agano la Mungu na walikataa kuishi kwa sheria yake.
english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

kikuyu: Walisahau aliyokuwa ameyatenda, maajabu aliyokuwa amewaonyesha.
english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

kikuyu: Alitenda miujiza machoni mwa baba zao, huko Soani, katika nchi ya Misri.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

kikuyu: Aliigawanya bahari akawapitisha, alifanya maji yasimame imara kama ukuta.
english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

kikuyu: Aliwaongoza kwa wingu mchana na kwa nuru kutoka kwenye moto usiku kucha.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

kikuyu: Alipasua miamba jangwani na akawapa maji tele kama bahari,
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

kikuyu: alitoa vijito kutoka kwenye jabali lililochongoka, akayafanya maji yatiririke kama mito.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

kikuyu: Lakini waliendelea kutenda dhambi dhidi yake, wakiasi jangwani dhidi ya Aliye Juu Sana.
english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

kikuyu: Kwa makusudi walimjaribu Mungu, wakidai vyakula walivyovitamani.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

kikuyu: Walinena dhidi ya Mungu, wakisema, “Je, Mungu aweza kuandaa meza jangwani?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Alipopiga mwamba, maji yalitoka kwa nguvu, vijito vikatiririka maji mengi. Lakini je, aweza kutupa chakula pia? Je, anaweza kuwapa watu wake nyama?”
english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

kikuyu: Bwana alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, moto wake ukawa dhidi ya Yakobo, na ghadhabu yake ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli,
english: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa hawakumwamini Mungu, wala kuutumainia ukombozi wake.
english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo alitoa amri kwa anga zilizo juu na kufungua milango ya mbingu,
english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

kikuyu: akawanyeshea mana ili watu wale; aliwapa nafaka ya mbinguni.
english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

kikuyu: Watu walikula mkate wa malaika, akawatumia chakula chote ambacho wangeliweza kula.
english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

kikuyu: Aliachia upepo wa mashariki kutoka kwenye mbingu na kuuongoza upepo wa kusini kwa uwezo wake.
english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

kikuyu: Aliwanyeshea nyama kama mavumbi, ndege warukao kama mchanga wa pwani.
english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

kikuyu: Aliwafanya washuke ndani ya kambi yao, kuzunguka mahema yao yote.
english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

kikuyu: Walikula na kusaza, kwa maana alikuwa amewapa kile walichotamani.
english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

kikuyu: Kabla hawajamaliza kula walichokitamani, hata kilipokuwa kingali bado vinywani mwao,
english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

kikuyu: hasira ya Mungu ikawaka juu yao, akawaua wale waliokuwa na nguvu zaidi miongoni mwao, akiwaangusha vijana wa Israeli.
english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

kikuyu: Licha ya haya yote, waliendelea kutenda dhambi, licha ya maajabu yake, hawakuamini.
english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo akamaliza siku zao katika ubatili na miaka yao katika vitisho.
english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

kikuyu: Kila mara Mungu alipowaua baadhi yao, waliosalia walimtafuta, walimgeukia tena kwa shauku.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

kikuyu: Walikumbuka kwamba Mungu alikuwa Mwamba wao, kwamba Mungu Aliye Juu Sana alikuwa Mkombozi wao.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

kikuyu: Lakini walimdanganya kwa vinywa vyao, wakisema uongo kwa ndimi zao,
english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

kikuyu: mioyo yao haikuwa thabiti kwake, wala hawakuwa waaminifu katika agano lake.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo alikuwa na huruma, alisamehe maovu yao na hakuwaangamiza. Mara kwa mara alizuia hasira yake, wala hakuchochea ghadhabu yake yote.
english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

kikuyu: Alikumbuka kwamba wao walikuwa nyama tu, upepo upitao ambao haurudi.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

kikuyu: Mara ngapi walimwasi jangwani na kumhuzunisha nyikani!
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

kikuyu: Walimjaribu Mungu mara kwa mara, wakamkasirisha yeye Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Hawakukumbuka uwezo wake, siku aliyowakomboa kutoka kwa mtesi,
english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

kikuyu: siku aliyoonyesha ishara zake za ajabu huko Misri, maajabu yake huko Soani.
english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

kikuyu: Aligeuza mito yao kuwa damu, hawakuweza kunywa maji kutoka vijito vyao.
english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

kikuyu: Aliwapelekea makundi ya mainzi yakawala, na vyura wakawaharibu.
english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

kikuyu: Aliruhusu tunutu kuharibu mimea yao, mazao yao kwa nzige.
english: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

kikuyu: Aliharibu mizabibu yao kwa mvua ya mawe na mikuyu yao kwa mvua iliyochangamana na theluji.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

kikuyu: Aliwaachia mifugo yao mvua ya mawe, akayapiga makundi ya wanyama wao kwa radi.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

kikuyu: Aliwafungulia hasira yake kali, ghadhabu yake, hasira na uadui, na kundi la malaika wa kuharibu.
english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

kikuyu: Aliitengenezea njia hasira yake, hakuwaepusha na kifo, bali aliwaachia tauni.
english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

kikuyu: Aliwapiga wazaliwa wote wa kwanza wa Misri, matunda ya kwanza ya ujana katika mahema ya Hamu.
english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

kikuyu: Lakini aliwatoa watu wake kama kundi, akawaongoza kama kondoo kupitia jangwani.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

kikuyu: Aliwaongoza salama, wala hawakuogopa, bali bahari iliwameza adui zao.
english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

kikuyu: Hivyo akawaleta hadi kwenye mpaka wa nchi yake takatifu, hadi nchi ya vilima ambayo mkono wake wa kuume ulikuwa umeitwaa.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

kikuyu: Aliyafukuza mataifa mbele yao, na kuwagawia nchi zao kama urithi, aliwakalisha makabila ya Israeli katika makao yao.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Lakini wao walimjaribu Mungu, na kuasi dhidi ya Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, wala hawakuzishika sheria zake.
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

kikuyu: Kama baba zao, hawakuwa thabiti wala waaminifu, wakawa wasioweza kutegemewa kama upinde wenye kasoro.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

kikuyu: Wakamkasirisha Mungu kwa mahali pao pa juu pa kuabudia miungu, wakachochea wivu wake kwa sanamu zao.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

kikuyu: Wakati Mungu alipowasikia, alikasirika sana, akamkataa Israeli kabisa.
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

kikuyu: Akaiacha hema ya Shilo, hema aliyokuwa ameiweka katikati ya wanadamu.
english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

kikuyu: Akalipeleka Sanduku la nguvu zake utumwani, utukufu wake mikononi mwa adui.
english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

kikuyu: Aliachia watu wake wauawe kwa upanga, akaukasirikia sana urithi wake.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

kikuyu: Moto uliwaangamiza vijana wao, na wanawali wao hawakuimbiwa nyimbo za arusi,
english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

kikuyu: makuhani wao waliuawa kwa upanga, wala wajane wao hawakuweza kulia.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

kikuyu: Ndipo Bwana alipoamka kama vile kuamka usingizini, kama vile mtu aamkavyo kutoka kwenye bumbuazi la mvinyo.
english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

kikuyu: Aliwapiga na kuwashinda adui zake, akawatia katika aibu ya milele.
english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

kikuyu: Ndipo alipozikataa hema za Yosefu, hakulichagua kabila la Efraimu,
english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

kikuyu: lakini alilichagua kabila la Yuda, Mlima Sayuni, ambao aliupenda.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

kikuyu: Alijenga patakatifu pake kama vilele, kama dunia ambayo aliimarisha milele.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

kikuyu: Akamchagua Daudi mtumishi wake na kumtoa kwenye mazizi ya kondoo.
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

kikuyu: Kutoka kuchunga kondoo alimleta kuwa mchungaji wa watu wake Yakobo, wa Israeli urithi wake.
english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

kikuyu: Naye Daudi aliwachunga kwa uadilifu wa moyo, kwa mikono ya ustadi aliwaongoza.
english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Asafu. Ee Mungu, mataifa yameuvamia urithi wako, wamelinajisi Hekalu lako takatifu, wameifanya Yerusalemu kuwa magofu.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

kikuyu: Wametoa maiti za watumishi kuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na nyama ya watakatifu wako kwa wanyama wa nchi.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Wamemwaga damu kama maji kuzunguka Yerusalemu yote, wala hakuna yeyote wa kuwazika.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

kikuyu: Tumekuwa kitu cha aibu kwa jirani zetu, cha dharau na mzaha kwa wale wanaotuzunguka.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Je, wewe utakasirika milele? Wivu wako utawaka kama moto hadi lini?
english: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

kikuyu: Mwaga ghadhabu yako kwa mataifa yasiyokukubali, juu ya falme za hao wasioliitia jina lako,
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

kikuyu: kwa maana wamemrarua Yakobo na kuharibu nchi ya makao yake.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

kikuyu: Usituhesabie dhambi za baba zetu, huruma yako na itujie hima, kwa maana tu wahitaji mno.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, utusaidie, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa jina lako; tuokoe na kutusamehe dhambi zetu kwa ajili ya jina lako.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

kikuyu: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wenu?” Mbele ya macho yetu, dhihirisha kati ya mataifa kwamba unalipiza kisasi damu iliyomwagwa ya watumishi wako.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

kikuyu: Kilio cha huzuni cha wafungwa kifike mbele zako; kwa nguvu za mkono wako hifadhi wale waliohukumiwa kufa.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

kikuyu: Walipize jirani zetu mara saba vifuani mwao aibu walizovurumisha juu yako, Ee Bwana.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

kikuyu: Ndipo sisi watu wako, kondoo wa malisho yako, tutakusifu milele; toka kizazi hadi kizazi tutasimulia sifa zako.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa “Yungiyungi za Agano.” Zaburi ya Asafu. Ee Mchungaji wa Israeli tusikie, wewe umwongozaye Yosefu kama kundi; wewe uketiye katika kiti cha enzi katikati ya makerubi, angaza
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

kikuyu: mbele ya Efraimu, Benyamini na Manase. Uamshe nguvu zako, uje utuokoe.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, uturejeshe, utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, hata lini hasira yako itawaka na kufoka moshi dhidi ya maombi ya watu wako?
english: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

kikuyu: Umewalisha kwa mkate wa machozi, umewafanya wanywe machozi bakuli tele.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

kikuyu: Tumekuwa chanzo cha ugomvi kwa jirani zetu, na adui zetu wanatudhihaki.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, nasi tuweze kuokolewa.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Ulileta mzabibu kutoka Misri, ukawafukuza mataifa, ukaupanda.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

kikuyu: Uliandaa shamba kwa ajili yake, mizizi ikawa imara, ukajaza nchi.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

kikuyu: Milima ilifunikwa kwa kivuli chake, matawi yake yakafunika mierezi mikubwa.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

kikuyu: Matawi yake yalienea mpaka Baharini, machipukizi yake mpaka kwenye Mto.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

kikuyu: Mbona umebomoa kuta zake ili wote wapitao karibu wazichume zabibu zake?
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

kikuyu: Nguruwe mwitu wanauharibu na wanyama wa kondeni hujilisha humo.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

kikuyu: Turudie, Ee Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote! Tazama chini kutoka mbinguni na uone! Linda mzabibu huu,
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

kikuyu: mche ulioupanda kwa mkono wako wa kuume, mwana uliyemlea kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Mzabibu wako umekatwa, umechomwa moto, unapowakemea, watu wako huangamia.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

kikuyu: Mkono wako na utulie juu ya mtu aliyeko mkono wako wa kuume, mwana wa mtu uliyemlea kwa ajili yako mwenyewe.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Ndipo hatutakuacha tena, utuhuishe, nasi tutaliitia jina lako.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, uturejeshe; utuangazie uso wako, ili tuweze kuokolewa.
english: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya Asafu. Mwimbieni kwa furaha, Mungu aliye nguvu yetu; mpigieni kelele za shangwe Mungu wa Yakobo!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

kikuyu: Anzeni wimbo, pigeni matari, pigeni kinubi na zeze kwa sauti nzuri.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

kikuyu: Pigeni baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume wakati wa Mwandamo wa Mwezi, na wakati wa mwezi mpevu, katika siku ya Sikukuu yetu;
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

kikuyu: hii ni amri kwa Israeli, agizo la Mungu wa Yakobo.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Aliiweka iwe kama sheria kwa Yosefu alipotoka dhidi ya Misri, huko tulikosikia lugha ambayo hatukuielewa.
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Asema, “Nimeondoa mzigo mabegani mwao; mikono yao iliwekwa huru kutoka kwenye kikapu.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

kikuyu: Katika shida yako uliniita nami nikakuokoa, nilikujibu katika mawingu yenye ngurumo; nilikujaribu katika maji ya Meriba.
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

kikuyu: “Enyi watu wangu, sikieni, nami nitawaonya: laiti kama mngenisikiliza, ee Israeli!
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

kikuyu: Hamtakuwa na mungu mgeni miongoni mwenu; msimsujudie mungu wa kigeni.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

kikuyu: Mimi ni Bwana Mungu wako, niliyekutoa nchi ya Misri. Panua sana kinywa chako nami nitakijaza.
english: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

kikuyu: “Lakini watu wangu hawakutaka kunisikiliza; Israeli hakutaka kunitii.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

kikuyu: Basi niliwaacha katika ukaidi wa mioyo yao wafuate mashauri yao wenyewe.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

kikuyu: “Laiti kama watu wangu wangalinisikiliza, kama Israeli wangalifuata njia zangu,
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

kikuyu: ningaliwatiisha adui zao kwa haraka, na kuugeuza mkono wangu dhidi ya watesi wao!
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

kikuyu: Wale wanaomchukia Bwana wangalinyenyekea mbele zake, na adhabu yao ingedumu milele.
english: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

kikuyu: Bali ninyi mngalilishwa ngano iliyo bora, na kuwatosheleza kwa asali itokayo kwenye mwamba.”
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Asafu. Mungu anaongoza kusanyiko kuu, anatoa hukumu miongoni mwa “miungu”:
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

kikuyu: “Hata lini utaendelea kuwatetea wasio haki na kuonyesha upendeleo kwa waovu?
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

kikuyu: Teteeni wanyonge na yatima, tunzeni haki za maskini na walioonewa.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

kikuyu: Mwokoeni mnyonge na mhitaji, wakomboeni kutoka mkononi mwa mwovu.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

kikuyu: “Hawajui lolote, hawaelewi lolote. Wanatembea gizani; misingi yote ya dunia imetikisika.
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

kikuyu: “Nilisema, ‘Ninyi ni “miungu”; ninyi nyote ni wana wa Aliye Juu Sana.’
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

kikuyu: Lakini mtakufa kama wanadamu wa kawaida; mtaanguka kama mtawala mwingine yeyote.”
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, inuka uihukumu nchi, kwa kuwa mataifa yote ni urithi wako.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

kikuyu: Wimbo. Zaburi ya Asafu. Ee Mungu, usinyamaze kimya, usinyamaze, Ee Mungu, usitulie.
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

kikuyu: Tazama watesi wako wanafanya fujo, jinsi adui zako wanavyoinua vichwa vyao.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

kikuyu: Kwa hila, wanafanya shauri dhidi ya watu wako, wanafanya shauri baya dhidi ya wale unaowapenda.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

kikuyu: Wanasema, “Njooni, tuwaangamize kama taifa, ili jina la Israeli lisikumbukwe tena.”
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

kikuyu: Kwa nia moja wanapanga mashauri mabaya pamoja, wanafanya muungano dhidi yako,
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

kikuyu: mahema ya Edomu na Waishmaeli, ya Wamoabu na Wahagari,
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

kikuyu: Gebali, Amoni na Amaleki, Ufilisti, pamoja na watu wa Tiro.
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

kikuyu: Hata Ashuru wameungana nao kuwapa nguvu wazao wa Loti.
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

kikuyu: Uwatendee kama vile ulivyowatendea Midiani, na kama vile ulivyowatendea Sisera na Yabini hapo kijito cha Kishoni,
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

kikuyu: ambao waliangamia huko Endori na wakawa kama takataka juu ya nchi.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

kikuyu: Wafanye wakuu wao kama Orebu na Zeebu, watawala wao kama Zeba na Salmuna,
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

kikuyu: ambao walisema, “Na tumiliki nchi ya malisho ya Mungu.”
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

kikuyu: Ee Mungu wangu, wapeperushe kama mavumbi ya kisulisuli, kama makapi yapeperushwayo na upepo.
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

kikuyu: Kama vile moto uteketezavyo msitu au mwali wa moto unavyounguza milima,
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

kikuyu: wafuatilie kwa tufani yako na kuwafadhaisha kwa dhoruba yako.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

kikuyu: Funika nyuso zao kwa aibu ili watu walitafute jina lako, Ee Bwana.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

kikuyu: Wao na waaibishwe na kufadhaishwa milele, na waangamie kwa aibu.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

kikuyu: Hebu wajue kwamba wewe, ambaye jina lako ni Bwana, kwamba wewe peke yako ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana ya dunia yote.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa gitithi. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, makao yako yapendeza kama nini!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu inatamani sana, naam, hata kuona shauku, kwa ajili ya nyua za Bwana; moyo wangu na mwili wangu vinamlilia Mungu Aliye Hai.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

kikuyu: Hata shomoro amejipatia makao, mbayuwayu amejipatia kiota mahali awezapo kuweka makinda yake: mahali karibu na madhabahu yako, Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

kikuyu: Heri wale wanaokaa nyumbani mwako, wanaokusifu wewe daima.
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

kikuyu: Heri wale ambao nguvu zao ziko kwako, na njia ziendazo Sayuni zimo mioyoni mwao.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

kikuyu: Wanapopita katika Bonde la Baka, hulifanya mahali pa chemchemi, pia mvua za vuli hulijaza kwa madimbwi.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

kikuyu: Huendelea toka nguvu hadi nguvu, hadi kila mmoja afikapo mbele za Mungu huko Sayuni.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mungu Mwenye Nguvu Zote, sikia maombi yangu; nisikilize, Ee Mungu wa Yakobo.
english: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, uitazame ngao yetu, mtazame kwa wema mpakwa mafuta wako.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

kikuyu: Siku moja katika nyua zako ni bora kuliko siku elfu mahali pengine; afadhali ningekuwa bawabu katika nyumba ya Mungu wangu kuliko kukaa katika mahema ya waovu.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni jua na ngao, Bwana hutoa wema na heshima; hakuna kitu chema anachowanyima wale ambao hawana hatia.
english: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, heri ni mtu yule anayekutumaini wewe.
english: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Ee Bwana, ulionyesha wema kwa nchi yako. Ulimrejeshea Yakobo baraka zake.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

kikuyu: Ulisamehe uovu wa watu wako, na kufunika dhambi zao zote.
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Uliweka kando ghadhabu yako yote na umegeuka na kuiacha hasira yako kali.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu, uturejeshe tena, nawe uiondoe chuki yako juu yetu.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

kikuyu: Je, utatukasirikia milele? Utaendeleza hasira yako kwa vizazi vyote?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

kikuyu: Je, hutatuhuisha tena, ili watu wako wakufurahie?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

kikuyu: Utuonyeshe upendo wako usiokoma, Ee Bwana, utupe wokovu wako.
english: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

kikuyu: Nitasikiliza lile atakalosema Mungu aliye Bwana; anaahidi amani kwa watu wake, watakatifu wake: lakini nao wasirudie upumbavu.
english: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

kikuyu: Hakika wokovu wake uko karibu na wale wamchao, ili utukufu wake udumu katika nchi yetu.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

kikuyu: Upendo na uaminifu hukutana pamoja, haki na amani hubusiana.
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

kikuyu: Uaminifu huchipua kutoka nchi, haki hutazama chini kutoka mbinguni.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

kikuyu: Naam, hakika Bwana atatoa kilicho chema, nayo nchi yetu itazaa mavuno yake.
english: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

kikuyu: Haki itatangulia mbele yake na kutengeneza njia kwa ajili ya hatua zake.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

kikuyu: Maombi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, sikia na unijibu, kwa maana mimi ni maskini na mhitaji.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

kikuyu: Linda maisha yangu, kwa maana nimejiweka kwako, wewe ni Mungu wangu, mwokoe mtumishi wako anayekutumaini.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, nihurumie mimi, kwa maana ninakuita mchana kutwa.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

kikuyu: Mpe mtumishi wako furaha, kwa kuwa kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, ninainua nafsi yangu.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwema na mwenye kusamehe, umejaa upendo kwa wote wakuitao.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, sikia maombi yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie.
english: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya shida yangu nitakuita, kwa maana wewe utanijibu.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, katikati ya miungu hakuna kama wewe, hakuna matendo ya kulinganishwa na yako.
