english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, mataifa yote uliyoyafanya yatakuja na kuabudu mbele zako; wataliletea utukufu jina lako.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wewe ni mkuu, na unafanya mambo ya ajabu; wewe peke yako ndiwe Mungu.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, nifundishe njia yako, nami nitakwenda katika kweli yako; nipe moyo usiositasita, ili niweze kulicha jina lako.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana wangu, nitakusifu kwa moyo wote; nitaliadhimisha jina lako milele.
english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

kikuyu: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu kwangu; umeniokoa kutoka kwenye vilindi vya kaburi.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, wenye majivuno wananishambulia; kundi la watu wakatili linatafuta uhai wangu: watu wasiokuheshimu wewe.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, ni Mungu wa huruma na neema, si mwepesi wa hasira, bali ni mwingi wa upendo na uaminifu.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

kikuyu: Nigeukie na unihurumie; mpe mtumishi wako nguvu zako, mwokoe mwana wa mtumishi wako wa kike.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

kikuyu: Nipe ishara ya wema wako, ili adui zangu waione nao waaibishwe, kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umenisaidia na kunifariji.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Wimbo. Ameuweka msingi wake katika mlima mtakatifu;
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

kikuyu: Bwana anayapenda malango ya Sayuni kuliko makao yote ya Yakobo.
english: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

kikuyu: Mambo matukufu yanasemwa juu yako, ee mji wa Mungu:
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

kikuyu: “Nitaweka kumbukumbu ya Rahabu na Babeli miongoni mwa wale wanaonikubali mimi: Ufilisti pia na Tiro, pamoja na Kushi, nami nitasema, ‘Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.’ ”
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

kikuyu: Kuhusu Sayuni itasemwa hivi, “Huyu na yule walizaliwa humo, naye Aliye Juu Sana mwenyewe atamwimarisha.”
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

kikuyu: Bwana ataandika katika orodha ya mataifa: “Huyu alizaliwa Sayuni.”
english: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

kikuyu: Watakapokuwa wanapiga vinanda wataimba, “Chemchemi zangu zote ziko kwako.”
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

kikuyu: Wimbo. Zaburi ya wana wa Kora. Kwa mwimbishaji. Mtindo wa mahalathi leanothi. Utenzi wa Hemani Mwezrahi. Ee Bwana, Mungu uniokoaye, nimelia mbele zako usiku na mchana.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

kikuyu: Maombi yangu yafike mbele zako, utegee kilio changu sikio lako.
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nafsi yangu imejaa taabu, na maisha yangu yanakaribia kaburi.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

kikuyu: Nimehesabiwa miongoni mwa wale waendao shimoni, niko kama mtu asiye na nguvu.
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

kikuyu: Nimetengwa pamoja na wafu, kama waliochinjwa walalao kaburini, ambao huwakumbuki tena, ambao wamekatiliwa mbali na uangalizi wako.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

kikuyu: Umenitupa katika shimo lenye kina kirefu sana, katika vina vya giza nene.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

kikuyu: Ghadhabu yako imekuwa nzito juu yangu, umenigharikisha kwa mawimbi yako yote.
english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

kikuyu: Umenitenga na rafiki zangu wa karibu na kunifanya chukizo kwao. Nimezuiliwa, wala siwezi kutoroka;
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

kikuyu: nuru ya macho yangu imefifia kwa ajili ya huzuni. Ee Bwana, ninakuita kila siku, ninakunyooshea wewe mikono yangu.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

kikuyu: Je, wewe huwaonyesha wafu maajabu yako? Je, wale waliokufa huinuka na kukusifu?
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

kikuyu: Je, upendo wako hutangazwa kaburini, uaminifu wako katika Uharibifu?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

kikuyu: Je, maajabu yako hujulikana mahali pa giza, au matendo yako ya haki katika nchi ya usahaulifu?
english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

kikuyu: Lakini ninakulilia wewe, Ee Bwana, unisaidie; asubuhi maombi yangu huja mbele zako.
english: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, kwa nini unanikataa na kunificha uso wako?
english: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Tangu ujana wangu nimeteseka, nikakaribia kifo; nimepatwa na hofu zako, nami nimekata tamaa.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

kikuyu: Ghadhabu yako imepita juu yangu; hofu zako zimeniangamiza.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

kikuyu: Mchana kutwa zinanizunguka kama mafuriko; zimenimeza kabisa.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

kikuyu: Umeniondolea marafiki na wapendwa wangu; giza limekuwa ndilo rafiki yangu wa karibu kuliko wote.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: Utenzi wa Ethani Mwezrahi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo mkuu wa Bwana milele; kwa kinywa changu nitajulisha uaminifu wako ujulikane kwa vizazi vyote.
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Nitatangaza kuwa upendo wako unasimama imara milele na uaminifu wako umeuthibitisha mbinguni.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

kikuyu: Ulisema, “Nimefanya agano na mteule wangu, nimemwapia mtumishi wangu Daudi,
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

kikuyu: ‘Nitaimarisha uzao wako milele na kudumisha ufalme wako kwa vizazi vyote.’ ”
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, mbingu zinayasifu maajabu yako, uaminifu wako pia katika kusanyiko la watakatifu.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ni nani katika mbingu anayeweza kulinganishwa na Bwana? Ni nani miongoni mwa viumbe vya mbinguni aliye kama Bwana?
english: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

kikuyu: Katika kusanyiko la watakatifu, Mungu huogopwa sana, anahofiwa kuliko wote wanaomzunguka.
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote, ni nani aliye kama wewe? Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye nguvu, na uaminifu wako unakuzunguka.
english: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

kikuyu: Wewe unatawala bahari yenye msukosuko; wakati mawimbi yake yanapoinuka, wewe unayatuliza.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

kikuyu: Wewe ulimponda Rahabu kama mmojawapo wa waliochinjwa; kwa mkono wako wenye nguvu, uliwatawanya adui zako.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

kikuyu: Mbingu ni zako, nayo nchi pia ni yako, uliuwekea ulimwengu msingi pamoja na vyote vilivyomo.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

kikuyu: Uliumba kaskazini na kusini; Tabori na Hermoni wanaliimbia jina lako kwa furaha.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

kikuyu: Mkono wako umejaa uwezo; mkono wako una nguvu, mkono wako wa kuume umetukuzwa.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

kikuyu: Haki na hukumu ndio msingi wa kiti chako cha enzi; upendo na uaminifu vinakutangulia.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

kikuyu: Heri ni wale ambao wamejifunza kukusifu kwa shangwe, wanaotembea katika mwanga wa uwepo wako, Ee Bwana.
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

kikuyu: Wanashangilia katika jina lako mchana kutwa, wanafurahi katika haki yako.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa wewe ni utukufu na nguvu yao, kwa wema wako unatukuza pembe yetu.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: Naam, ngao yetu ni mali ya Bwana, na mfalme wetu mali ya Aliye Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
english: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Ulizungumza wakati fulani katika maono, kwa watu wako waaminifu, ukasema: “Nimeweka nguvu kwa shujaa, nimemwinua kijana miongoni mwa watu.
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

kikuyu: Nimemwona Daudi, mtumishi wangu, na nimemtia mafuta yangu matakatifu.
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

kikuyu: Kitanga changu kitamtegemeza, hakika mkono wangu utamtia nguvu.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

kikuyu: Hakuna adui atakayemtoza ushuru, hakuna mtu mwovu atakayemwonea.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

kikuyu: Nitawaponda adui zake mbele zake na kuwaangamiza watesi wake.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

kikuyu: Upendo wangu mkamilifu utakuwa pamoja naye, kwa Jina langu pembe yake itatukuzwa.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: Nitauweka mkono wake juu ya bahari, mkono wake wa kuume juu ya mito.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

kikuyu: Naye ataniita kwa sauti, ‘Wewe ni Baba yangu, Mungu wangu, Mwamba na Mwokozi wangu.’
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

kikuyu: Nitamteua pia awe mzaliwa wangu wa kwanza, aliyetukuka kuliko wafalme wote wa dunia.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Nitadumisha upendo wangu kwake milele, na agano langu naye litakuwa imara.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

kikuyu: Nitaudumisha uzao wake milele, kiti chake cha enzi kama mbingu zinavyodumu.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

kikuyu: “Kama wanae wataacha amri yangu na wasifuate sheria zangu,
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

kikuyu: kama wakihalifu maagizo yangu na kutoshika amri zangu,
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

kikuyu: nitaadhibu dhambi yao kwa fimbo, uovu wao kwa kuwapiga,
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

kikuyu: lakini sitauondoa upendo wangu kwake, wala sitausaliti uaminifu wangu kamwe.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

kikuyu: Mimi sitavunja agano langu wala sitabadili lile ambalo midomo yangu imelitamka.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

kikuyu: Mara moja na kwa milele, nimeapa kwa utakatifu wangu, nami sitamdanganya Daudi:
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

kikuyu: kwamba uzao wake utaendelea milele, na kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu mbele zangu kama jua;
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

kikuyu: kitaimarishwa milele kama mwezi, shahidi mwaminifu angani.”
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe umemkataa, umemdharau, umemkasirikia sana mpakwa mafuta wako.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

kikuyu: Umelikana agano lako na mtumishi wako, na umeinajisi taji yake mavumbini.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

kikuyu: Umebomoa kuta zake zote, na ngome zake zote umezifanya kuwa magofu.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

kikuyu: Wote wapitao karibu wamemnyangʼanya mali zake; amekuwa dharau kwa jirani zake.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

kikuyu: Umeutukuza mkono wa kuume wa adui zake, umewafanya watesi wake wote washangilie.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

kikuyu: Umegeuza makali ya upanga wake, na hukumpa msaada katika vita.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

kikuyu: Umeikomesha fahari yake, na kukiangusha kiti chake cha enzi.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

kikuyu: Umezifupisha siku za ujana wake, umemfunika kwa vazi la aibu.
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

kikuyu: Hata lini, Ee Bwana? Utajificha milele? Ghadhabu yako itawaka kama moto hata lini?
english: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

kikuyu: Kumbuka jinsi maisha yangu yanavyopita haraka. Ni kwa ubatili kiasi gani umemuumba mwanadamu!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

kikuyu: Ni mtu gani awezaye kuishi na asione kifo, au kujiokoa mwenyewe kutoka nguvu za kaburi?
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uko wapi upendo wako mkuu wa mwanzoni, ambao katika uaminifu wako ulimwapia Daudi?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

kikuyu: Bwana kumbuka jinsi mtumishi wako amesimangwa, jinsi ninavyovumilia moyoni mwangu dhihaka za mataifa yote,
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

kikuyu: dhihaka ambazo kwazo adui zako wamenisimanga, Ee Bwana, ambazo kwazo wamesimanga kila hatua ya mpakwa mafuta wako.
english: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana milele!
english: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

kikuyu: Maombi ya Mose, mtu wa Mungu. Bwana, wewe umekuwa makao yetu katika vizazi vyote.
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

kikuyu: Kabla ya kuzaliwa milima au hujaumba dunia na ulimwengu, wewe ni Mungu tangu milele hata milele.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

kikuyu: Huwarudisha watu mavumbini, ukisema, “Rudini mavumbini, enyi wanadamu.”
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwako miaka elfu ni kama siku moja iliyokwisha pita, au kama kesha la usiku.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

kikuyu: Unawatowesha wanadamu katika usingizi wa kifo, nao ni kama majani machanga ya asubuhi:
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

kikuyu: ingawa asubuhi yanachipua, ifikapo jioni huwa yamenyauka na kukauka.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

kikuyu: Tumeangamizwa kwa hasira yako na tumetishwa kwa ghadhabu yako.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

kikuyu: Umeyaweka maovu yetu mbele yako, dhambi zetu za siri katika nuru ya uwepo wako.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

kikuyu: Tumeishi siku zetu zote chini ya ghadhabu yako, tunamaliza miaka yetu kwa kuomboleza.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

kikuyu: Siku zetu za kuishi ni miaka sabini, au miaka themanini ikiwa tuna nguvu, lakini yote ni ya shida na taabu, nazo zapita haraka, nasi twatoweka.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

kikuyu: Ni nani ajuaye nguvu za hasira yako? Kwa maana ghadhabu yako ni kubwa kama hofu tunayopaswa kuwa nayo kwako.
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

kikuyu: Tufundishe kuzihesabu siku zetu vizuri, ili tujipatie moyo wa hekima.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uwe na huruma! Utakawia hata lini? Wahurumie watumishi wako.
english: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

kikuyu: Tushibishe asubuhi kwa upendo wako usiokoma, ili tuweze kuimba kwa shangwe na kufurahi siku zetu zote.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

kikuyu: Utufurahishe kulingana na siku ulizotuadhibu, kulingana na miaka tuliyotaabika.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

kikuyu: Matendo yako na yaonekane kwa watumishi wako, utukufu wako kwa watoto wao.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

kikuyu: Wema wa Bwana Mungu wetu uwe juu yetu; uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu: naam, uzithibitishe kazi za mikono yetu.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

kikuyu: Yeye akaaye mahali pa salama pake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana, atadumu katika uvuli wake Mwenyezi.
english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Nitasema kumhusu Bwana, “Yeye ndiye kimbilio langu na ngome yangu, Mungu wangu, ambaye ninamtumaini.”
english: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

kikuyu: Hakika yeye ataniokoa na mtego wa mwindaji, na maradhi ya kuambukiza ya kuua.
english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

kikuyu: Atakufunika kwa manyoya yake, chini ya mbawa zake utapata kimbilio, uaminifu wake utakuwa ngao na kinga yako.
english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

kikuyu: Hutaogopa vitisho vya usiku, wala mshale urukao mchana,
english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

kikuyu: wala maradhi ya kuambukiza yanayonyemelea gizani, wala tauni iharibuyo adhuhuri.
english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

kikuyu: Ijapo watu elfu wataangukia kando yako, kumi elfu mkono wako wa kuume, lakini haitakukaribia wewe.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

kikuyu: Utatazama tu kwa macho yako na kuona adhabu ya waovu.
english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kama ukimfanya Aliye Juu Sana kuwa makao yako: naam, Bwana ambaye ni kimbilio langu,
english: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

kikuyu: basi hakuna madhara yatakayokupata wewe, hakuna maafa yataikaribia hema yako.
english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa atawaagiza malaika zake kwa ajili yako, wakulinde katika njia zako zote.
english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

kikuyu: Mikononi mwao watakuinua, ili usijikwae mguu wako kwenye jiwe.
english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

kikuyu: Utawakanyaga simba na nyoka wakali, simba mkubwa na nyoka utawaponda kwa miguu.
english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

kikuyu: Bwana asema, “Kwa kuwa ananipenda, nitamwokoa; nitamlinda, kwa kuwa analikiri Jina langu.
english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

kikuyu: Ataniita, nami nitamjibu; nitakuwa pamoja naye katika taabu, nitamwokoa na kumheshimu.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

kikuyu: Kwa siku nyingi nitamshibisha na kumwonyesha wokovu wangu.”
english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

kikuyu: Zaburi. Wimbo wa siku ya Sabato. Ni vyema kumshukuru Bwana na kuliimbia jina lako, Ee Uliye Juu Sana,
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

kikuyu: kuutangaza upendo wako asubuhi, na uaminifu wako wakati wa usiku,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

kikuyu: kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi na kwa sauti ya kinubi.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, kwa kuwa matendo yako yamenifurahisha, nitaziimba kwa shangwe kazi za mikono yako.
english: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, tazama jinsi yalivyo makuu matendo yako, tazama jinsi yalivyo ya kina mawazo yako!
english: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

kikuyu: Mjinga hafahamu, mpumbavu haelewi,
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

kikuyu: ingawa waovu huchipua kama majani na wote watendao mabaya wanastawi, wataangamizwa milele.
english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

kikuyu: Bali wewe, Ee Bwana, utatukuzwa milele.
english: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, hakika adui zako, hakika adui zako wataangamia. Wote watendao mabaya watatawanyika.
english: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

kikuyu: Umeitukuza pembe yangu kama ile ya nyati dume, mafuta mazuri yamemiminwa juu yangu.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

kikuyu: Macho yangu yamewaona adui zangu wakishindwa, masikio yangu yamesikia maangamizi ya adui zangu waovu.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Wenye haki watastawi kama mtende, watakuwa kama mwerezi wa Lebanoni,
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

kikuyu: waliopandwa katika nyumba ya Bwana, watastawi katika nyua za Mungu wetu.
english: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

kikuyu: Wakati wa uzee watakuwa bado wanazaa matunda, watakuwa wabichi tena wamejaa nguvu,
english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

kikuyu: wakitangaza, “Bwana ni mkamilifu; yeye ni Mwamba wangu, na ndani yake hamna uovu.”
english: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

kikuyu: Bwana anatawala, amejivika utukufu; Bwana amejivika utukufu tena amejivika nguvu. Dunia imewekwa imara, haitaondoshwa.
english: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Kiti chako cha enzi kimekuwa thabiti tangu zamani; wewe umekuwako tangu milele.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

kikuyu: Bahari zimeinua, Ee Bwana, bahari zimeinua sauti zake; bahari zimeinua sauti za mawimbi yake.
english: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

kikuyu: Yeye ni mkuu kuliko ngurumo ya maji makuu, ni mkuu kuliko mawimbi ya bahari: Bwana aishiye juu sana ni mkuu.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, sheria zako ni imara; utakatifu umepamba nyumba yako pasipo mwisho.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ulipizaye kisasi, Ee Mungu ulipizaye kisasi, uangaze sasa.
english: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

kikuyu: Ee Mhukumu wa dunia, inuka, uwalipize wenye kiburi kama wanavyostahili.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

kikuyu: Hata lini, waovu, Ee Bwana, hata lini waovu watashangilia?
english: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

kikuyu: Wanamimina maneno ya kiburi, watenda mabaya wote wamejaa majivuno.
english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wanawaponda watu wako, wanawaonea urithi wako.
english: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

kikuyu: Wanamchinja mjane na mgeni, na kuwaua yatima.
english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

kikuyu: Nao husema, “Bwana haoni, Mungu wa Yakobo hafahamu.”
english: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

kikuyu: Sikizeni, enyi wajinga miongoni mwa watu; enyi wapumbavu, lini mtakuwa na hekima?
english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

kikuyu: Je, aliyeweka sikio asisikie? Aliyeumba jicho asione?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

kikuyu: Je, anayeadhibisha mataifa asiadhibu? Je, awafundishaye wanadamu asiwe na maarifa?
english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

kikuyu: Bwana anajua mawazo ya mwanadamu; anajua kwamba ni ubatili.
english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, heri mtu anayeadhibishwa na wewe, mtu unayemfundisha kwa sheria yako,
english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

kikuyu: unampa utulivu siku za shida, mpaka shimo litakapokuwa limechimbwa kwa ajili ya mwovu.
english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Bwana hatawakataa watu wake, hatauacha urithi wake.
english: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

kikuyu: Hukumu itasimamishwa tena kwenye haki, wote walio na mioyo minyofu wataifuata.
english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

kikuyu: Ni nani atakayeinuka dhidi ya mwovu kwa ajili yangu? Ni nani atakayenikinga dhidi ya watenda maovu?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

kikuyu: Kama Bwana asingelinisaidia upesi, ningelikuwa ninaishi katika ukimya wa kifo.
english: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

kikuyu: Niliposema, “Mguu wangu unateleza,” Ee Bwana, upendo wako ulinishikilia.
english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

kikuyu: Wakati wasiwasi ulipokuwa mwingi ndani yangu, faraja yako ilinipa furaha nafsini mwangu.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

kikuyu: Je, kiti cha utawala wa udhalimu kitajiunga nawe, ule utawala uletao taabu kutokana na sheria zake?
english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

kikuyu: Huungana kuwashambulia wenye haki, kuwahukumu kufa wasio na hatia.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana amekuwa ngome yangu, na Mungu wangu amekuwa mwamba ninaoukimbilia.
english: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

kikuyu: Yeye atawalipa kwa ajili ya dhambi zao na atawaangamiza kwa ajili ya maovu yao; Bwana Mungu wetu atawaangamiza.
english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

kikuyu: Njooni, tumwimbie Bwana kwa furaha; tumfanyie kelele za shangwe Mwamba wa wokovu wetu.
english: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

kikuyu: Tuje mbele zake kwa shukrani, tumtukuze kwa vinanda na nyimbo.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni Mungu mkuu, mfalme mkuu juu ya miungu yote.
english: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

kikuyu: Mkononi mwake mna vilindi vya dunia, na vilele vya milima ni mali yake.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

kikuyu: Bahari ni yake, kwani ndiye aliifanya, na mikono yake iliumba nchi kavu.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

kikuyu: Njooni, tusujudu, tumwabudu, tupige magoti mbele za Bwana Muumba wetu,
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

kikuyu: kwa maana yeye ndiye Mungu wetu, na sisi ni watu wa malisho yake, kondoo chini ya utunzaji wake. Kama mkiisikia sauti yake leo,
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

kikuyu: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya kule Meriba, kama mlivyofanya siku ile kule Masa jangwani,
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

kikuyu: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima, ingawa walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

kikuyu: Kwa miaka arobaini nilikasirikia kizazi kile, nikasema, “Hawa ni taifa ambalo mioyo yao imepotoka, nao hawajazijua njia zangu.”
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

kikuyu: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya; mwimbieni Bwana dunia yote.
english: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Bwana, lisifuni jina lake; tangazeni wokovu wake siku baada ya siku.
english: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

kikuyu: Tangazeni utukufu wake katikati ya mataifa, matendo yake ya ajabu miongoni mwa mataifa yote.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Bwana ni mkuu mwenye kustahili kusifiwa kuliko wote; yeye ni wa kuogopwa kuliko miungu yote.
english: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa ni sanamu, lakini Bwana aliziumba mbingu.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

kikuyu: Fahari na enzi viko mbele yake; nguvu na utukufu vimo patakatifu pake.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

kikuyu: Mpeni Bwana, enyi jamaa za mataifa, mpeni Bwana utukufu na nguvu.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Mpeni Bwana utukufu unaostahili jina lake; leteni sadaka na mje katika nyua zake.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

kikuyu: Mwabuduni Bwana katika uzuri wa utakatifu wake; dunia yote na itetemeke mbele zake.
english: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

kikuyu: Katikati ya mataifa semeni, “Bwana anatawala.” Ulimwengu ameuweka imara, hauwezi kusogezwa; atawahukumu watu kwa uadilifu.
english: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Mbingu na zishangilie, nchi na ifurahi; bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake;
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

kikuyu: mashamba na yashangilie, pamoja na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake. Kisha miti yote ya msituni itaimba kwa furaha;
english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

kikuyu: itaimba mbele za Bwana kwa maana anakuja, anakuja kuihukumu dunia. Ataihukumu dunia kwa haki, na mataifa katika kweli yake.
english: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

kikuyu: Bwana anatawala, nchi na ifurahi, visiwa vyote vishangilie.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

kikuyu: Mawingu na giza nene vinamzunguka, haki na hukumu ndio msingi wa kiti chake cha enzi.
english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

kikuyu: Moto hutangulia mbele zake na huteketeza adui zake pande zote.
english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

kikuyu: Umeme wake wa radi humulika dunia, nchi huona na kutetemeka.
english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

kikuyu: Milima huyeyuka kama nta mbele za Bwana, mbele za Bwana wa dunia yote.
english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Mbingu zinatangaza haki yake, na mataifa yote huona utukufu wake.
english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

kikuyu: Wote waabuduo sanamu waaibishwa, wale wajisifiao sanamu: mwabuduni yeye, enyi miungu yote!
english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

kikuyu: Sayuni husikia na kushangilia, vijiji vya Yuda vinafurahi kwa sababu ya hukumu zako, Ee Bwana.
english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, ndiwe Uliye Juu Sana kuliko dunia yote; umetukuka sana juu ya miungu yote.
english: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

kikuyu: Wale wanaompenda Bwana na wauchukie uovu, kwa maana yeye hulinda maisha ya waaminifu wake na kuwaokoa kutoka mkononi mwa mwovu.
english: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

kikuyu: Nuru huangaza wenye haki na furaha kwa watu wanyofu wa moyo.
english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Furahini katika Bwana, ninyi mlio wenye haki, lisifuni jina lake takatifu.
english: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

kikuyu: Zaburi. Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, kwa maana ametenda mambo ya ajabu; kitanga chake cha kuume na mkono wake mtakatifu umemfanyia wokovu.
english: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

kikuyu: Bwana ameufanya wokovu wake ujulikane na amedhihirisha haki yake kwa mataifa.
english: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: Ameukumbuka upendo wake na uaminifu wake kwa nyumba ya Israeli; miisho yote ya dunia imeuona wokovu wa Mungu wetu.
english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

kikuyu: Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote, ipaze sauti kwa nyimbo za shangwe na vinanda;
english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

kikuyu: mwimbieni Bwana kwa kinubi, kwa kinubi na sauti za kuimba,
english: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

kikuyu: kwa tarumbeta na mvumo wa baragumu za pembe za kondoo dume: shangilieni kwa furaha mbele za Bwana, aliye Mfalme.
english: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

kikuyu: Bahari na ivume na kila kiliomo ndani yake, dunia na wote wakaao ndani yake.
english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

kikuyu: Mito na ipige makofi, milima na iimbe pamoja kwa furaha,
english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

kikuyu: vyote na viimbe mbele za Bwana, kwa maana yuaja kuhukumu dunia. Atahukumu dunia kwa haki na mataifa kwa haki.
english: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Bwana anatawala, mataifa na yatetemeke; anakalia kiti cha enzi katikati ya makerubi, dunia na itikisike.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mkuu katika Sayuni; ametukuzwa juu ya mataifa yote.
english: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

kikuyu: Wanalisifu jina lako ambalo ni kuu na la kuogopwa: yeye ni mtakatifu!
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Mfalme ni mwenye nguvu na hupenda haki, wewe umethibitisha adili; katika Yakobo umefanya yaliyo haki na sawa.
english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

kikuyu: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, na mkaabudu katika mahali pa kuwekea miguu yake; yeye ni mtakatifu.
english: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Mose na Aroni walikuwa miongoni mwa makuhani wake, Samweli alikuwa miongoni mwa walioliitia jina lake; walimwita Bwana, naye aliwajibu.
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

kikuyu: Alizungumza nao kutoka nguzo ya wingu; walizishika sheria zake na amri alizowapa.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wetu, ndiwe uliyewajibu, kwa Israeli ulikuwa Mungu mwenye kusamehe, ingawa uliadhibu matendo yao mabaya.
english: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

kikuyu: Mtukuzeni Bwana Mungu wetu, mwabuduni kwenye mlima wake mtakatifu, kwa maana Bwana Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu.
english: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

kikuyu: Zaburi ya shukrani. Mpigieni Bwana kelele za shangwe, dunia yote.
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

kikuyu: Mwabuduni Bwana kwa furaha; njooni mbele zake kwa nyimbo za shangwe.
english: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

kikuyu: Jueni kwamba Bwana ndiye Mungu. Yeye ndiye alituumba, sisi tu mali yake; sisi tu watu wake, kondoo wa malisho yake.
english: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

kikuyu: Ingieni malangoni mwake kwa shukrani na katika nyua zake kwa kusifu, mshukuruni yeye na kulisifu jina lake.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana ni mwema na upendo wake wadumu milele; uaminifu wake unadumu kwa vizazi vyote.
english: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitaimba juu ya upendo wako na haki yako; kwako wewe, Ee Bwana, nitaimba sifa.
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Nitazingatia kuishi maisha yasiyo na lawama: utakuja kwangu lini? Nitatembea nyumbani mwangu kwa moyo usio na lawama.
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

kikuyu: Sitaweka mbele ya macho yangu kitu kiovu. Ninayachukia matendo ya watu wasio na imani; hawatashikamana nami.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

kikuyu: Moyo wa ukaidi utakuwa mbali nami; nitajitenga na kila ubaya.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

kikuyu: Kila amsingiziaye jirani yake kwa siri, huyo nitamnyamazisha; mwenye macho ya dharau na moyo wa kiburi huyo sitamvumilia.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

kikuyu: Macho yangu yatawaelekea waaminifu katika nchi, ili waweze kuishi pamoja nami; yeye ambaye moyo wake hauna lawama atanitumikia.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

kikuyu: Mdanganyifu hatakaa nyumbani mwangu, yeye asemaye kwa uongo hatasimama mbele yangu.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

kikuyu: Kila asubuhi nitawanyamazisha waovu wote katika nchi; nitamkatilia mbali kila mtenda mabaya kutoka mji wa Bwana.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

kikuyu: Maombi ya mtu aliyechoka. Anapoteseka na kumimina malalamiko yake kwa Bwana. Ee Bwana, usikie maombi yangu, kilio changu cha kuomba msaada kikufikie.
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

kikuyu: Usinifiche uso wako ninapokuwa katika shida. Unitegee sikio lako, ninapoita, unijibu kwa upesi.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa siku zangu zinatoweka kama moshi, mifupa yangu inaungua kama kaa la moto.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu umefifia na kunyauka kama jani, ninasahau kula chakula changu.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya kusononeka kwangu kwa uchungu, nimebakia ngozi na mifupa.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

kikuyu: Nimekuwa kama bundi wa jangwani, kama bundi kwenye magofu.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

kikuyu: Nilalapo sipati usingizi, nimekuwa kama ndege mpweke kwenye paa la nyumba.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

kikuyu: Mchana kutwa adui zangu hunidhihaki, wale wanaonizunguka hutumia jina langu kama laana.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

kikuyu: Ninakula majivu kama chakula changu na nimechanganya kinywaji changu na machozi
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

kikuyu: kwa sababu ya ghadhabu yako kuu, kwa maana umeniinua na kunitupa kando.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

kikuyu: Siku zangu ni kama kivuli cha jioni, ninanyauka kama jani.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana, umeketi katika kiti chako cha enzi milele, sifa zako za ukuu zaendelea vizazi vyote.
english: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

kikuyu: Utainuka na kuihurumia Sayuni, kwa maana ni wakati wa kumwonyesha wema; wakati uliokubalika umewadia.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mawe yake ni ya thamani kwa watumishi wako, vumbi lake lenyewe hulionea huruma.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

kikuyu: Mataifa wataogopa jina la Bwana, wafalme wote wa dunia watauheshimu utukufu wako.
english: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana ataijenga tena Sayuni na kutokea katika utukufu wake.
english: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

kikuyu: Ataitikia maombi ya mtu mkiwa, wala hatadharau hoja yao.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

kikuyu: Hili na liandikwe kwa ajili ya kizazi kijacho, ili taifa litakaloumbwa baadaye waweze kumsifu Bwana:
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

kikuyu: “Bwana alitazama chini kutoka patakatifu pake palipo juu, kutoka mbinguni alitazama dunia,
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

kikuyu: kusikiliza vilio vya uchungu vya wafungwa na kuwaweka huru wale waliohukumiwa kufa.”
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo jina la Bwana latangazwa huko Sayuni na sifa zake katika Yerusalemu,
english: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: wakati mataifa na falme zitakapokusanyika ili kumwabudu Bwana.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

kikuyu: Katika kuishi kwangu alivunja nguvu zangu, akafupisha siku zangu.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

kikuyu: Ndipo niliposema: “Ee Mungu wangu, usinichukue katikati ya siku zangu; miaka yako inaendelea vizazi vyote.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Hapo mwanzo uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Hizi zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu, zote zitachakaa kama vazi. Utazibadilisha kama nguo nazo zitaondoshwa.
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, U yeye yule, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

kikuyu: Watoto wa watumishi wako wataishi mbele zako; wazao wao wataimarishwa mbele zako.”
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana. Vyote vilivyomo ndani yangu vilihimidi jina lake takatifu.
english: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana, wala usisahau wema wake wote,
english: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

kikuyu: akusamehe dhambi zako zote, akuponya magonjwa yako yote,
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

kikuyu: aukomboa uhai wako na kaburi, akuvika taji ya upendo na huruma,
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

kikuyu: atosheleza mahitaji yako kwa vitu vyema, ili ujana wako uhuishwe kama wa tai.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

kikuyu: Bwana hutenda haki, naye huwapa hukumu ya haki wote wanaoonewa.
english: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

kikuyu: Alijulisha Mose njia zake, na wana wa Israeli matendo yake.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwingi wa huruma na mwenye neema; si mwepesi wa hasira, bali amejaa upendo.
english: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

kikuyu: Yeye hatalaumu siku zote, wala haweki hasira yake milele,
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

kikuyu: yeye hatutendei kulingana na dhambi zetu wala hatupatilizi kwa kadiri ya maovu yetu.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

kikuyu: Kama vile mbingu zilivyo juu ya dunia sana, ndivyo wema wake ulivyo mwingi kwa wanaomcha;
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

kikuyu: kama mashariki ilivyo mbali na magharibi, ndivyo Mungu alivyoziweka dhambi zetu mbali nasi.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

kikuyu: Kama baba alivyo na huruma kwa watoto wake, ndivyo Bwana anavyowahurumia wale wanaomcha;
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa anajua tulivyoumbwa, anakumbuka kwamba sisi tu mavumbi.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

kikuyu: Kuhusu mwanadamu, siku zake ni kama majani, anachanua kama ua la shambani;
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

kikuyu: upepo huvuma juu yake nalo hutoweka, mahali pake hapalikumbuki tena.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

kikuyu: Lakini kutoka milele hata milele upendo wa Bwana uko kwa wale wamchao, nayo haki yake kwa watoto wa watoto wao:
english: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

kikuyu: kwa wale walishikao agano lake na kukumbuka kuyatii mausia yake.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

kikuyu: Bwana ameweka imara kiti chake cha enzi mbinguni, ufalme wake unatawala juu ya vyote.
english: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

kikuyu: Mhimidini Bwana, enyi malaika zake, ninyi mlio mashujaa mnaozitii amri zake, ninyi mnaotii neno lake.
english: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

kikuyu: Mhimidini Bwana, ninyi jeshi lake lote la mbinguni, ninyi watumishi wake mnaofanya mapenzi yake.
english: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

kikuyu: Mhimidini Bwana, kazi zake zote kila mahali katika milki yake. Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana.
english: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, umhimidi Bwana. Ee Bwana Mungu wangu, wewe ni mkuu sana, umejivika utukufu na enzi.
english: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Amejifunika katika nuru kama vile kwa vazi, amezitandaza mbingu kama hema
english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

kikuyu: na kuziweka nguzo za orofa yake juu ya maji. Huyafanya mawingu kuwa gari lake, na hupanda kwenye mbawa za upepo.
english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Huzifanya pepo kuwa wajumbe wake, miali ya moto watumishi wake.
english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

kikuyu: Ameiweka dunia kwenye misingi yake, haiwezi kamwe kuondoshwa.
english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

kikuyu: Uliifunika kwa kilindi kama kwa vazi, maji yalisimama juu ya milima.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa kukemea kwako maji yalikimbia, kwa sauti ya radi yako yakatoroka,
english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

kikuyu: yakapanda milima, yakateremka mabondeni, hadi mahali pale ulipoyakusudia.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

kikuyu: Uliyawekea mpaka ambao hayawezi kuuvuka, kamwe hayataifunika dunia tena.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

kikuyu: Huzifanya chemchemi zimwage maji mabondeni, hutiririka kati ya milima.
english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

kikuyu: Huwapa maji wanyama wote wa kondeni, punda-mwitu huzima kiu yao.
english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

kikuyu: Ndege wa angani hufanya viota kando ya maji, huimba katikati ya matawi.
english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

kikuyu: Huinyeshea milima kutoka orofa zake, dunia inatoshelezwa kwa matunda ya kazi yake.
english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

kikuyu: Huyafanya majani ya mifugo yaote, na mimea kwa watu kulima, wajipatie chakula kutoka ardhini:
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

kikuyu: divai ya kuufurahisha moyo wa mwanadamu, mafuta kwa ajili ya kungʼarisha uso wake, na mkate wa kutia mwili nguvu.
english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

kikuyu: Miti ya Bwana inanyeshewa vizuri, mierezi ya Lebanoni aliyoipanda.
english: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

kikuyu: Humo ndege hufanya viota vyao, korongo ana nyumba yake kwenye msunobari.
english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

kikuyu: Milima mirefu ni makao ya mbuzi-mwitu, majabali ni kimbilio la pelele.
english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

kikuyu: Mwezi hugawanya majira, na jua hutambua wakati wake wa kutua.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

kikuyu: Unaleta giza, kunakuwa usiku, wanyama wote wa mwituni huzurura.
english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

kikuyu: Simba hunguruma kwa mawindo yao, na kutafuta chakula chao kutoka kwa Mungu.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

kikuyu: Jua huchomoza, nao huondoka, hurudi na kulala katika mapango yao.
english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

kikuyu: Kisha mwanadamu huenda kazini mwake, katika kazi yake mpaka jioni.
english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, jinsi matendo yako yalivyo mengi! Kwa hekima ulizifanya zote, dunia imejaa viumbe vyako.
english: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

kikuyu: Pale kuna bahari, kubwa na yenye nafasi tele, imejaa viumbe visivyo na idadi, vitu vyenye uhai vikubwa na vidogo.
english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

kikuyu: Huko meli huenda na kurudi, pia Lewiathani, uliyemuumba acheze ndani yake.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

kikuyu: Hawa wote wanakutazamia wewe, uwape chakula chao kwa wakati wake.
english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Wakati unapowapa, wanakikusanya, unapofumbua mkono wako, wao wanashibishwa mema.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

kikuyu: Unapoficha uso wako, wanapata hofu, unapoondoa pumzi yao, wanakufa na kurudi mavumbini.
english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

kikuyu: Unapopeleka Roho wako, wanaumbwa, nawe huufanya upya uso wa dunia.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

kikuyu: Utukufu wa Bwana na udumu milele, Bwana na azifurahie kazi zake:
english: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

kikuyu: yeye aitazamaye dunia, nayo ikatetemeka, aigusaye milima, nayo ikatoa moshi.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

kikuyu: Nitamwimbia Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitaimba sifa kwa Mungu wangu muda wote ninaoishi.
english: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

kikuyu: Kutafakari kwangu na kumpendeze yeye, ninapofurahi katika Bwana.
english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

kikuyu: Lakini wenye dhambi na watoweke katika dunia na waovu wasiwepo tena. Ee nafsi yangu, msifu Bwana. Msifuni Bwana.
english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Bwana, liitieni jina lake, wajulisheni mataifa yale aliyoyatenda.
english: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni yeye, mwimbieni yeye sifa, waambieni matendo yake yote ya ajabu.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Lishangilieni jina lake takatifu, mioyo ya wale wamtafutao Bwana na ifurahi.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

kikuyu: Mtafuteni Bwana na nguvu zake, utafuteni uso wake siku zote.
english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kikuyu: Kumbuka matendo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya, miujiza yake na hukumu alizozitamka,
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: enyi wazao wa Abrahamu mtumishi wake, enyi wana wa Yakobo, wateule wake.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Yeye ndiye Bwana Mungu wetu, hukumu zake zimo duniani pote.
english: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

kikuyu: Hulikumbuka agano lake milele, neno ambalo aliamuru, kwa vizazi elfu,
english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: agano alilolifanya na Abrahamu, kiapo alichomwapia Isaki.
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

kikuyu: Alilithibitisha kwa Yakobo kuwa amri, kwa Israeli liwe agano la milele:
english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: “Nitakupa wewe nchi ya Kanaani kuwa sehemu utakayoirithi.”
english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wachache kwa idadi, wachache sana na wageni ndani yake,
english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: walitangatanga kutoka taifa moja hadi jingine, kutoka ufalme mmoja hadi mwingine.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Hakuruhusu mtu yeyote awaonee; kwa ajili yao aliwakemea wafalme, akisema:
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: “Msiwaguse niliowatia mafuta; msiwadhuru manabii wangu.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

kikuyu: Akaiita njaa juu ya nchi na kuharibu chakula chao chote,
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

kikuyu: naye akatuma mtu mbele yao, Yosefu, aliyeuzwa kama mtumwa.
english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

kikuyu: Walichubua miguu yake kwa minyororo, shingo yake ilifungwa kwa chuma,
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

kikuyu: hadi yale aliyotangulia kusema yalipotimia, hadi neno la Bwana lilipomthibitisha.
english: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

kikuyu: Mfalme alituma watu wakamfungua, mtawala wa watu alimwachia huru.
english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

kikuyu: Alimfanya mkuu wa nyumba yake, mtawala juu ya vyote alivyokuwa navyo,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

kikuyu: kuwaelekeza wakuu wa mfalme apendavyo na kuwafundisha wazee wake hekima.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

kikuyu: Kisha Israeli akaingia Misri, Yakobo akaishi kama mgeni katika nchi ya Hamu.
english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Bwana aliwafanya watu wake kuzaana sana, akawafanya kuwa wengi sana kuliko adui zao,
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

kikuyu: ndiye aliigeuza mioyo yao iwachukie watu wake, wakatenda hila dhidi ya watumishi wake.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

kikuyu: Akamtuma Mose mtumishi wake, pamoja na Aroni, aliyemchagua.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: Walifanya ishara zake za ajabu miongoni mwao, miujiza yake katika nchi ya Hamu.
english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Alituma giza na nchi ikajaa giza, kwani si walikuwa wameyaasi maneno yake?
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

kikuyu: Aligeuza maji yao kuwa damu, ikasababisha samaki wao kufa.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

kikuyu: Nchi yao ilijaa vyura tele, ambao waliingia hadi kwenye vyumba vya kulala vya watawala wao.
english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

kikuyu: Alisema, yakaja makundi ya mainzi, na viroboto katika nchi yao yote.
english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

kikuyu: Alibadilisha mvua yao ikawa mvua ya mawe, yenye umeme wa radi nchini yao yote,
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

kikuyu: akaharibu mizabibu yao na miti ya tini, na akaangamiza miti ya nchi yao.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

kikuyu: Alisema, nzige wakaja, tunutu wasio na idadi,
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

kikuyu: wakala kila jani katika nchi yao, wakala mazao ya ardhi yao.
english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

kikuyu: Kisha akawaua wazaliwa wote wa kwanza katika nchi yao, matunda ya kwanza ya ujana wao wote.
english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

kikuyu: Akawatoa Israeli katika nchi wakiwa na fedha na dhahabu nyingi, wala hakuna hata mmoja kutoka kabila zao aliyejikwaa.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

kikuyu: Misri ilifurahi walipoondoka, kwa sababu hofu ya Israeli ilikuwa imewaangukia.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Alitandaza wingu kama kifuniko, na moto kuwamulikia usiku.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

kikuyu: Waliomba, naye akawaletea kware, akawashibisha kwa mkate wa mbinguni.
english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

kikuyu: Alipasua mwamba, maji yakabubujika, yakatiririka jangwani kama mto.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

kikuyu: Kwa maana alikumbuka ahadi yake takatifu, aliyompa Abrahamu mtumishi wake.
english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

kikuyu: Aliwatoa watu wake kwa furaha, wateule wake kwa kelele za shangwe,
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

kikuyu: akawapa nchi za mataifa, wakawa warithi wa mali wengine walikuwa wameitaabikia:
english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

kikuyu: alifanya haya ili wayashike mausia yake na kuzitii sheria zake. Msifuni Bwana.
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
english: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Ni nani awezaye kusimulia matendo makuu ya Bwana au kutangaza kikamilifu sifa zake?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

kikuyu: Heri wale wanaodumisha haki, ambao daima wanafanya yaliyo mema.
english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, unikumbuke unapowatendea mema watu wako, uwe msaada wangu unapowaokoa,
english: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

kikuyu: ili niweze kufurahia mafanikio ya wateule wako, niweze kushiriki katika furaha ya taifa lako, na kuungana na urithi wako katika kukusifu.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

kikuyu: Tumetenda dhambi, kama vile baba zetu walivyotenda, tumekosa na tumetenda uovu.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Wakati baba zetu walipokuwa Misri, hawakuzingatia maajabu yako, wala hawakukumbuka wingi wa fadhili zako, bali waliasi kando ya bahari, Bahari ya Shamu.
english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo aliwaokoa kwa ajili ya jina lake, ili apate kudhihirisha uweza wake mkuu.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

kikuyu: Alikemea Bahari ya Shamu, nayo ikakauka, akawaongoza katika vilindi vyake kama vile jangwani.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

kikuyu: Aliwaokoa mikononi mwa adui; kutoka mikononi mwa adui aliwakomboa.
english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Maji yaliwafunika adui zao, hakunusurika hata mmoja.
english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

kikuyu: Ndipo walipoamini ahadi zake, nao wakaimba sifa zake.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

kikuyu: Lakini mara walisahau aliyowatendea, wala hawakungojea shauri lake.
english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

kikuyu: Jangwani walitawaliwa na tamaa zao, walimjaribu Mungu nyikani.
english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo aliwapa kile walichoomba, lakini akatuma juu yao ugonjwa wa kudhoofisha.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

kikuyu: Kambini walimwonea wivu Mose, na pia Aroni aliyekuwa amewekwa wakfu kwa Bwana.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

kikuyu: Ardhi ilifunguka ikawameza Dathani, ikawazika Abiramu na kundi lake.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

kikuyu: Moto uliwaka katikati ya wafuasi wao, mwali wa moto uliwateketeza waovu.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

kikuyu: Huko Horebu walitengeneza ndama, na kuabudu sanamu ya kusubu kwa chuma.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

kikuyu: Waliubadilisha Utukufu wao kwa sanamu ya fahali, ambaye hula majani.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

kikuyu: Walimsahau Mungu aliyewaokoa, aliyekuwa ametenda mambo makuu huko Misri,
english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

kikuyu: miujiza katika nchi ya Hamu na mambo ya kutisha huko Bahari ya Shamu.
english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo alisema kwamba angewaangamiza: kama Mose mteule wake, asingesimama kati yao na Mungu kuizuia ghadhabu yake kuwaangamiza.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

kikuyu: Kisha waliidharau ile nchi nzuri, hawakuiamini ahadi yake.
english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

kikuyu: Walinungʼunika ndani ya mahema yao, wala hawakumtii Bwana.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo akaapa kwa mkono ulioinuliwa kwamba atawafanya waanguke jangwani,
english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

kikuyu: kuwatawanya wazao wao waanguke miongoni mwa mataifa, na kuwatawanya katika nchi zote.
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

kikuyu: Walijifunga nira na Baali wa Peori, wakala dhabihu zilizotolewa kwa miungu isiyo na uhai.
english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

kikuyu: Waliichochea hasira ya Bwana, wakamkasirisha kwa matendo yao maovu, nayo tauni ikazuka katikati yao.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

kikuyu: Lakini Finehasi alisimama na kuingilia kati, nayo tauni ikazuiliwa.
english: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

kikuyu: Hili likahesabiwa kwake haki, kwa vizazi visivyo na mwisho vijavyo.
english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

kikuyu: Kwenye maji ya Meriba, walimkasirisha Bwana, janga likampata Mose kwa sababu yao;
english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

kikuyu: kwa maana walimwasi Roho wa Mungu, na maneno yasiyofaa yakatoka midomoni kwa Mose.
english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

kikuyu: Hawakuyaangamiza yale mataifa kama Bwana alivyowaagiza,
english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

kikuyu: bali walijichanganya na mataifa na wakazikubali desturi zao.
english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

kikuyu: Waliabudu sanamu zao, zikawa mtego kwao.
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

kikuyu: Wakawatoa wana wao na binti zao dhabihu kwa mashetani.
english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

kikuyu: Walimwaga damu isiyo na hatia, damu za wana wao na binti zao, ambao waliwatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu za Kanaani, nayo nchi ikanajisika kwa damu zao.
english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

kikuyu: Wakajinajisi wenyewe kwa yale waliyotenda; kwa matendo yao wenyewe wakajifanyia ukahaba.
english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Bwana akawakasirikia watu wake na akauchukia sana urithi wake.
english: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

kikuyu: Akawakabidhi kwa mataifa na adui zao wakawatawala.
english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

kikuyu: Adui zao wakawaonea na kuwatia chini ya mamlaka yao.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

kikuyu: Mara nyingi aliwaokoa lakini walikuwa wamezama kwenye uasi, nao wakajiharibu katika dhambi zao.
english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

kikuyu: Lakini akaangalia mateso yao wakati aliposikia kilio chao;
english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

kikuyu: kwa ajili yao akakumbuka agano lake, na kutokana na upendo wake mkuu akapooza hasira yake.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Akawafanya wahurumiwe na wote waliowashikilia mateka.
english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mungu wetu, tuokoe. Tukusanye tena kutoka kwa mataifa, ili tuweze kulishukuru jina lako takatifu, na kushangilia katika sifa zako.
english: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

kikuyu: Atukuzwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele na hata milele. Watu wote na waseme, “Amen!” Msifuni Bwana.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa yeye ni mwema, upendo wake wadumu milele.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Waliokombolewa wa Bwana na waseme hivi, wale aliowaokoa kutoka mkono wa adui,
english: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

kikuyu: wale aliowakusanya kutoka nchi mbalimbali, kutoka mashariki na magharibi, kutoka kaskazini na kusini.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

kikuyu: Baadhi yao walitangatanga jangwani, hawakuona njia ya kuwafikisha mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

kikuyu: Walikuwa na njaa na kiu, nafsi zao zikadhoofika.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

kikuyu: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Akawaongoza kwa njia iliyo sawa hadi mji ambao wangeweza kuishi.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

kikuyu: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu,
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: kwa maana yeye humtosheleza mwenye kiu, na kumshibisha mwenye njaa kwa vitu vyema.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

kikuyu: Wengine walikaa gizani na katika huzuni kuu, wafungwa wakiteseka katika minyororo,
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

kikuyu: kwa sababu walikuwa wameasi dhidi ya maneno ya Mungu na kudharau shauri la Aliye Juu Sana.
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

kikuyu: Aliwatumikisha kwa kazi ngumu; walijikwaa na hapakuwepo yeyote wa kuwasaidia.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

kikuyu: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Akawatoa katika giza na huzuni kuu na akavunja minyororo yao.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

kikuyu: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu,
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: kwa kuwa yeye huvunja malango ya shaba na kukata mapingo ya chuma.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

kikuyu: Wengine wakawa wapumbavu kutokana na uasi wao, wakapata mateso kwa sababu ya uovu wao.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

kikuyu: Wakachukia kabisa vyakula vyote, wakakaribia malango ya mauti.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

kikuyu: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawaokoa kutoka taabu yao.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Akalituma neno lake na kuwaponya, akawaokoa kutoka maangamizo yao.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

kikuyu: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu.
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Na watoe dhabihu za kushukuru, na wasimulie matendo yake kwa nyimbo za furaha.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

kikuyu: Wengine walisafiri baharini kwa meli, walikuwa wafanyabiashara kwenye maji makuu.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

kikuyu: Waliziona kazi za Bwana, matendo yake ya ajabu kilindini.
