english: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

kikuyu: Kwa maana alisema na kuamsha tufani iliyoinua mawimbi juu.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

kikuyu: Yakainuka juu mbinguni, yakashuka chini hadi vilindini, katika hatari hii ujasiri wao uliyeyuka.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

kikuyu: Walipepesuka na kuyumbayumba kama walevi, ujanja wao ukafikia ukomo.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

kikuyu: Ndipo walipomlilia Bwana katika shida yao, naye akawatoa kwenye taabu yao.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

kikuyu: Akatuliza dhoruba kwa mnongʼono, mawimbi ya bahari yakatulia.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

kikuyu: Walifurahi ilipokuwa shwari, naye akawaongoza hadi bandari waliyoitamani.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

kikuyu: Basi na wamshukuru Bwana kwa upendo wake usiokoma, na kwa matendo yake ya ajabu kwa wanadamu.
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

kikuyu: Na wamtukuze yeye katika kusanyiko la watu, na wamsifu katika baraza la wazee.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

kikuyu: Yeye aligeuza mito kuwa jangwa, chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo kuwa ardhi yenye kiu,
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

kikuyu: nchi izaayo ikawa ya chumvi isiyofaa, kwa sababu ya uovu wa wale walioishi humo.
english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Aligeuza jangwa likawa madimbwi ya maji, nayo ardhi kame kuwa chemchemi za maji zitiririkazo;
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

kikuyu: aliwaleta wenye njaa wakaishi humo, nao wakajenga mji wangeweza kuishi.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: Walilima mashamba na kupanda mizabibu, nayo ikazaa matunda mengi,
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

kikuyu: Mungu aliwabariki, hesabu yao ikaongezeka sana, wala hakuruhusu mifugo yao kupungua.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

kikuyu: Kisha hesabu yao ilipungua, na walinyenyekeshwa kwa kuonewa, maafa na huzuni.
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye huwamwagia dharau wakuu, aliwafanya watangetange nyikani isiyo na njia.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

kikuyu: Lakini yeye aliwainua wahitaji katika taabu zao, na kuongeza jamaa zao kama makundi ya kondoo.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

kikuyu: Wanyofu wataona na kufurahi, lakini waovu wote watafunga vinywa vyao.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

kikuyu: Yeyote aliye na hekima, ayasikie mambo haya, na atafakari upendo mkuu wa Bwana.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

kikuyu: Wimbo. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, moyo wangu ni thabiti; nitaimba na kusifu kwa moyo wangu wote.
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

kikuyu: Amka, kinubi na zeze! Nitayaamsha mapambazuko.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, katikati ya mataifa; nitaimba habari zako, katikati ya jamaa za watu.
english: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

kikuyu: Kwa maana upendo wako ni mkuu, ni juu kuliko mbingu; uaminifu wako unazifikia anga.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, utukuzwe juu ya mbingu, utukufu wako na uenee duniani kote.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Tuokoe na utusaidie kwa mkono wako wa kuume, ili wale uwapendao wapate kuokolewa.
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Mungu amenena kutoka patakatifu pake: “Nitaigawa Shekemu kwa ushindi na kulipima Bonde la Sukothi.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Gileadi ni yangu, Manase ni yangu, Efraimu ni kofia yangu ya chuma, nayo Yuda ni fimbo yangu ya utawala.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Moabu ni sinia langu la kunawia, juu ya Edomu natupa kiatu changu; nashangilia kwa kushindwa kwa Ufilisti.”
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Ni nani atakayenipeleka hadi mji wenye ngome? Ni nani atakayeniongoza hadi nifike Edomu?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, si ni wewe uliyetukataa sisi, na hutoki tena na majeshi yetu?
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

kikuyu: Tuletee msaada dhidi ya adui, kwa maana msaada wa mwanadamu haufai kitu.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Kwa msaada wa Mungu tutapata ushindi, naye atawaponda adui zetu.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Mungu, ambaye ninakusifu, usiwe kimya,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

kikuyu: kwa maana watu waovu na wadanganyifu wamefungua vinywa vyao dhidi yangu; wasema dhidi yangu kwa ndimi za udanganyifu.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

kikuyu: Wamenizunguka kwa maneno ya chuki, wananishambulia bila sababu.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

kikuyu: Wanachonilipa badala ya urafiki wangu ni kunishtaki, lakini mimi ninawaombea.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

kikuyu: Wananilipiza mabaya kwa mema, chuki badala ya urafiki wangu.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

kikuyu: Agiza mtu mwovu ampinge, mshtaki asimame mkono wake wa kuume.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

kikuyu: Anapohukumiwa, apatikane na hatia, nayo maombi yake yamhukumu.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

kikuyu: Siku zake za kuishi na ziwe chache, nafasi yake ya uongozi ichukuliwe na mtu mwingine.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

kikuyu: Watoto wake na waachwe yatima, mke wake na awe mjane.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

kikuyu: Watoto wake na watangetange wakiomba, na wafukuzwe kwenye magofu ya nyumba zao.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

kikuyu: Mtu anayemdai na ateke vyote alivyo navyo, matunda ya kazi yake yatekwe nyara na wageni.
english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

kikuyu: Asiwepo mtu yeyote wa kumtendea mema wala wa kuwahurumia yatima wake.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

kikuyu: Uzao wake na ukatiliwe mbali, majina yao yafutike katika kizazi kifuatacho.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

kikuyu: Maovu ya baba zake na yakumbukwe mbele za Bwana, dhambi ya mama yake isifutwe kamwe.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

kikuyu: Dhambi zao na zibaki daima mbele za Bwana, ili apate kukatilia mbali kumbukumbu lao duniani.
english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

kikuyu: Kwa maana kamwe hakuweza kutenda wema, bali alimfukuza mnyonge na mhitaji, aliwafanyia jeuri wahitaji na waliovunjika moyo.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

kikuyu: Alipenda kulaani, nayo laana ikampata; hakupenda kubariki, kwa hiyo baraka na ikae mbali naye.
english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

kikuyu: Alivaa kulaani kama vazi lake, nayo laana ikamwingia mwilini mwake kama maji, kwenye mifupa yake kama mafuta.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

kikuyu: Na iwe kama joho alilozungushiwa, kama mshipi aliofungiwa daima.
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

kikuyu: Haya na yawe malipo ya Bwana kwa washtaki wangu, kwa wale wanaoninenea mabaya.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, unitendee wema kwa ajili ya jina lako, uniokoe kwa wema wa pendo lako.
english: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

kikuyu: Maana mimi ni maskini na mhitaji, moyo wangu umejeruhiwa ndani yangu.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

kikuyu: Ninafifia kama kivuli cha jioni, nimerushwa-rushwa kama nzige.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

kikuyu: Magoti yangu yamelegea kwa kufunga, mwili wangu umedhoofika na kukonda.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

kikuyu: Nimekuwa kitu cha kudharauliwa kwa washtaki wangu, wanionapo, hutikisa vichwa vyao.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, Mungu wangu nisaidie, niokoe sawasawa na upendo wako.
english: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

kikuyu: Watu na wafahamu kuwa ni mkono wako, kwamba wewe, Ee Bwana, umetenda hili.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

kikuyu: Wanaweza kulaani, lakini wewe utabariki, watakaposhambulia wataaibishwa, lakini mtumishi wako atashangilia.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

kikuyu: Washtaki wangu watavikwa fedheha, na kufunikwa na aibu kama joho.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

kikuyu: Kwa kinywa changu nitamtukuza sana Bwana, katika umati mkubwa nitamsifu.
english: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

kikuyu: Kwa maana husimama mkono wa kuume wa mhitaji, kuokoa maisha yake kutoka kwa wale wanaomhukumu.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Bwana amwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, mpaka nitakapowafanya adui zako kuwa mahali pa kuweka miguu yako.”
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

kikuyu: Bwana ataeneza fimbo yako ya utawala yenye nguvu kutoka Sayuni; utatawala katikati ya adui zako.
english: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

kikuyu: Askari wako watajitolea kwa hiari katika siku yako ya vita. Ukiwa umevikwa fahari takatifu, kutoka tumbo la mapambazuko utapokea umande wa ujana wako.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

kikuyu: Bwana ameapa, naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
english: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Bwana yuko mkono wako wa kuume, atawaponda wafalme siku ya ghadhabu yake.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Atawahukumu mataifa, akilundika mizoga na kuwaponda watawala wa dunia nzima.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Atakunywa maji katika kijito kando ya njia, kwa hiyo atainua kichwa chake juu.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Nitamtukuza Bwana kwa moyo wangu wote, katika baraza la wanyofu na katika kusanyiko.
english: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

kikuyu: Kazi za Bwana ni kuu, wote wanaopendezwa nazo huzitafakari.
english: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

kikuyu: Kazi zake zimejaa fahari na utukufu, haki yake hudumu daima.
english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Amefanya maajabu yake yakumbukwe, Bwana ni mwenye neema na huruma.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

kikuyu: Huwapa chakula wale wanaomcha, hulikumbuka agano lake milele.
english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

kikuyu: Amewaonyesha watu wake uwezo wa kazi zake, akiwapa nchi za mataifa mengine.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

kikuyu: Kazi za mikono yake ni za uaminifu na haki, mausia yake yote ni ya kuaminika.
english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

kikuyu: Zinadumu milele na milele, zikifanyika kwa uaminifu na unyofu.
english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

kikuyu: Aliwapa watu wake ukombozi, aliamuru agano lake milele: jina lake ni takatifu na la kuogopwa.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha hekima, wote wanaozifuata amri zake wana busara. Sifa zake zadumu milele.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Heri mtu yule amchaye Bwana, mtu yule apendezwaye sana na amri zake.
english: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

kikuyu: Watoto wake watakuwa wenye uwezo katika nchi, kizazi cha watu waadilifu kitabarikiwa.
english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

kikuyu: Nyumbani mwake kuna mali na utajiri, haki yake hudumu milele.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Hata gizani nuru humzukia mtu mwadilifu, yule mwenye rehema, huruma na haki.
english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

kikuyu: Mema yatamjia mtu yule aliye mkarimu na mwenye kukopesha bila riba, anayefanya mambo yake kwa haki.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

kikuyu: Hakika hatatikisika kamwe, mtu mwenye haki atakumbukwa milele.
english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

kikuyu: Hataogopa habari mbaya, moyo wake ni thabiti, ukimtegemea Bwana.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

kikuyu: Moyo wake ni salama, hatakuwa na hofu, mwishoni ataona ushindi dhidi ya adui zake.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

kikuyu: Ametawanya vipawa vyake kwa ukarimu akawapa maskini; haki yake hudumu milele; pembe yake itatukuzwa kwa heshima.
english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu ataona na kuchukizwa, atasaga meno yake na kutoweka, kutamani kwa mtu mwovu kutaishia patupu.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Enyi watumishi wa Bwana msifuni, lisifuni jina la Bwana.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Jina la Bwana na lisifiwe, sasa na hata milele.
english: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Kuanzia mawio ya jua hadi machweo yake, jina la Bwana linapaswa kusifiwa.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

kikuyu: Bwana ametukuka juu ya mataifa yote, utukufu wake juu ya mbingu.
english: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

kikuyu: Ni nani aliye kama Bwana Mungu wetu, Yeye ambaye ameketi juu kwenye kiti cha enzi,
english: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

kikuyu: ambaye huinama atazame chini aone mbingu na nchi?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

kikuyu: Huwainua maskini kutoka mavumbini, na kuwanyanyua wahitaji kutoka kwenye jalala,
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

kikuyu: huwaketisha pamoja na wakuu, pamoja na wakuu wa watu wake.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

kikuyu: Humjalia mwanamke tasa kutulia nyumbani mwake, akiwa mama watoto mwenye furaha. Msifuni Bwana.
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Wakati Israeli walipotoka Misri, nyumba ya Yakobo kutoka kwa watu wa lugha ngeni,
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

kikuyu: Yuda alifanywa makao matakatifu ya Mungu, Israeli akawa milki yake.
english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

kikuyu: Bahari ilitazama ikakimbia, Yordani ulirudi nyuma,
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

kikuyu: milima ilirukaruka kama kondoo dume, vilima kama wana-kondoo.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

kikuyu: Ee bahari, ni nini kilichokufanya ukakimbia, nawe, ee Yordani, ukarudi nyuma,
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

kikuyu: enyi milima mkarukaruka kama kondoo dume, enyi vilima, kama wana-kondoo?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

kikuyu: Ee dunia, tetemeka mbele za Bwana, mbele za Mungu wa Yakobo,
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

kikuyu: aliyegeuza mwamba kuwa dimbwi la maji, mwamba mgumu kuwa chemchemi za maji.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

kikuyu: Sio kwetu sisi, Ee Bwana, sio kwetu sisi, bali utukufu ni kwa jina lako, kwa sababu ya upendo na uaminifu wako.
english: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

kikuyu: Kwa nini mataifa waseme, “Yuko wapi Mungu wao?”
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

kikuyu: Mungu wetu yuko mbinguni, naye hufanya lolote limpendezalo.
english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

kikuyu: Lakini sanamu zao ni za fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kusema, zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona;
english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

kikuyu: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, zina pua, lakini haziwezi kunusa;
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

kikuyu: zina mikono, lakini haziwezi kupapasa, zina miguu, lakini haziwezi kutembea; wala koo zao haziwezi kutoa sauti.
english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

kikuyu: Wale wanaozitengeneza watafanana nazo, vivyo hivyo wale wote wanaozitumainia.
english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
english: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Ee nyumba ya Aroni, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
english: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Ninyi mnaomcha, mtumainini Bwana, yeye ni msaada na ngao yao.
english: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Bwana anatukumbuka na atatubariki: ataibariki nyumba ya Israeli, ataibariki nyumba ya Aroni,
english: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

kikuyu: atawabariki wale wanaomcha Bwana, wadogo kwa wakubwa.
english: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

kikuyu: Bwana na awawezeshe kuongezeka, ninyi na watoto wenu.
english: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

kikuyu: Mbarikiwe na Bwana Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
english: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Mbingu zilizo juu sana ni mali ya Bwana, lakini dunia amempa mwanadamu.
english: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

kikuyu: Sio wafu wanaomsifu Bwana, wale washukao mahali pa kimya,
english: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

kikuyu: bali ni sisi tunaomtukuza Bwana, sasa na hata milele. Msifuni Bwana.
english: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Ninampenda Bwana kwa maana amesikia sauti yangu; amesikia kilio changu ili anihurumie.
english: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu amenitegea sikio lake, nitamwita siku zote za maisha yangu.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

kikuyu: Kamba za mauti zilinizunguka, maumivu makuu ya kuzimu yalinipata, nikalemewa na taabu na huzuni.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

kikuyu: Ndipo nikaliitia jina la Bwana: “Ee Bwana, niokoe!”
english: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwenye neema na haki, Mungu wetu ni mwingi wa huruma.
english: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

kikuyu: Bwana huwalinda wanyenyekevu, nilipokuwa katika shida kubwa, aliniokoa.
english: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

kikuyu: Ee nafsi yangu, tulia tena, kwa kuwa Bwana amekuwa mwema kwako.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa wewe, Ee Bwana, umeniokoa nafsi yangu na mauti, macho yangu kutokana na machozi, miguu yangu kutokana na kujikwaa,
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

kikuyu: ili niweze kutembea mbele za Bwana, katika nchi ya walio hai.
english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Niliamini, kwa hiyo nilisema, “Mimi nimeteseka sana.”
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

kikuyu: Katika taabu yangu nilisema, “Wanadamu wote ni waongo.”
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

kikuyu: Nimrudishie Bwana nini kwa wema wake wote alionitendea?
english: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

kikuyu: Nitakiinua kikombe cha wokovu na kulitangaza jina la Bwana.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Nitazitimiza nadhiri zangu kwa Bwana mbele za watu wake wote.
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

kikuyu: Kifo cha watakatifu kina thamani machoni pa Bwana.
english: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, hakika mimi ni mtumishi wako, mimi ni mtumishi wako, mwana wa mjakazi wako; umeniweka huru toka katika minyororo yangu.
english: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

kikuyu: Nitakutolea dhabihu ya kukushukuru na kuliita jina la Bwana.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Nitazitimiza nadhiri zangu kwa Bwana mbele za watu wake wote,
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,

kikuyu: katika nyua za nyumba ya Bwana, katikati yako, ee Yerusalemu. Msifuni Bwana.
english: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana, enyi mataifa yote; mtukuzeni yeye, enyi watu wote.
english: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa upendo wake kwetu ni mkuu, uaminifu wa Bwana unadumu milele. Msifuni Bwana.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Israeli na aseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Nyumba ya Aroni na iseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Wote wamchao Bwana na waseme sasa: “Upendo wake wadumu milele.”
english: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Wakati wa maumivu yangu makuu nilimlilia Bwana, naye akanijibu kwa kuniweka huru.
english: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

kikuyu: Bwana yuko pamoja nami, sitaogopa. Mwanadamu anaweza kunitenda nini?
english: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Bwana yuko pamoja nami, yeye ni msaidizi wangu. Nitawatazama adui zangu wakiwa wameshindwa.
english: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

kikuyu: Ni bora kumkimbilia Bwana kuliko kumtumainia mwanadamu.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

kikuyu: Ni bora kumkimbilia Bwana kuliko kuwatumainia wakuu.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

kikuyu: Mataifa yote yalinizunguka, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Walinizunguka pande zote, lakini kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

kikuyu: Walinizunguka kama kundi la nyuki, lakini walikufa haraka kama miiba iteketeayo; kwa jina la Bwana naliwakatilia mbali.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Nilisukumwa nyuma karibu kuanguka, lakini Bwana alinisaidia.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

kikuyu: Bwana ni nguvu yangu na wimbo wangu, yeye amefanyika wokovu wangu.
english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

kikuyu: Sauti za shangwe na ushindi zinavuma hemani mwa wenye haki: “Mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umetenda mambo makuu!
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

kikuyu: Mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umeinuliwa juu, mkono wa kuume wa Bwana umetenda mambo makuu!”
english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

kikuyu: Sitakufa, bali nitaishi, nami nitatangaza yale Bwana aliyoyatenda.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

kikuyu: Bwana ameniadhibu vikali, lakini hakuniacha nife.
english: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

kikuyu: Nifungulie malango ya haki, nami nitaingia na kumshukuru Bwana.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

kikuyu: Hili ni lango la Bwana ambalo wenye haki wanaweza kuliingia.
english: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

kikuyu: Nitakushukuru, kwa kuwa ulinijibu, umekuwa wokovu wangu.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

kikuyu: Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni.
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

kikuyu: Bwana ametenda hili, nalo ni la kushangaza machoni petu.
english: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo siku Bwana aliyoifanya, tushangilie na kufurahi ndani yake.
english: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, tuokoe, Ee Bwana, utujalie mafanikio.
english: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

kikuyu: Heri yule ajaye kwa jina la Bwana. Kutoka nyumba ya Bwana tunakubariki.
english: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Bwana ndiye Mungu, naye ametuangazia nuru yake. Mkiwa na matawi mkononi, unganeni kwenye maandamano ya sikukuu hadi kwenye pembe za madhabahu.
english: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakushukuru, wewe ni Mungu wangu, nitakutukuza.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Bwana kwa kuwa ni mwema; upendo wake wadumu milele.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Heri wale walio waadilifu katika njia zao, wanaoenenda katika sheria ya Bwana.
english: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: Heri wale wanaozishika shuhuda zake, wamtafutao kwa moyo wao wote.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

kikuyu: Wasiofanya lolote lililo baya, wanaoenenda katika njia zake.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Umetoa maagizo yako ili tuyatii kwa ukamilifu.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

kikuyu: Laiti mwenendo wangu ungekuwa imara katika kuyatii maagizo yako!
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

kikuyu: Hivyo mimi sitaaibishwa ninapozingatia amri zako zote.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

kikuyu: Nitakusifu kwa moyo mnyofu ninapojifunza sheria zako za haki.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

kikuyu: Nitayatii maagizo yako; usiniache kabisa.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

kikuyu: Kijana aifanye njia yake kuwa safi jinsi gani? Ni kwa kutii, akilifuata neno lako.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

kikuyu: Ninakutafuta kwa moyo wangu wote, usiniache niende mbali na amri zako.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Nimelificha neno lako moyoni mwangu ili nisikutende dhambi.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

kikuyu: Sifa ni zako, Ee Bwana, nifundishe maagizo yako.
english: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Kwa midomo yangu nitasimulia sheria zote zinazotoka katika kinywa chako.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

kikuyu: Ninafurahia kufuata sheria zako kama mtu afurahiaye mali nyingi.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

kikuyu: Ninatafakari maagizo yako na kuziangalia njia zako.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

kikuyu: Ninafurahia maagizo yako, wala sitalipuuza neno lako.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

kikuyu: Mtendee mema mtumishi wako, nami nitaishi; nitalitii neno lako.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

kikuyu: Yafungue macho yangu nipate kuona mambo ya ajabu katika sheria yako.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

kikuyu: Mimi ni mgeni duniani, usinifiche amri zako.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu inataabika kwa shauku kubwa juu ya sheria zako wakati wote.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

kikuyu: Unawakemea wenye majivuno, waliolaaniwa waendao mbali na amri zako.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Niondolee dharau na dhihaka, kwa kuwa ninazishika sheria zako.
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

kikuyu: Ingawa watawala huketi pamoja na kunisingizia, mtumishi wako atatafakari juu ya maagizo yako.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

kikuyu: Sheria zako ni furaha yangu, nazo ni washauri wangu.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

kikuyu: Nimelazwa chini mavumbini, yahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

kikuyu: Nilikueleza njia zangu ukanijibu, nifundishe sheria zako.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Nijulishe mafundisho ya mausia yako, nami nitatafakari maajabu yako.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu imechakazwa kwa huzuni, uniimarishe sawasawa na neno lako.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

kikuyu: Niepushe na njia za udanganyifu, kwa neema unifundishe sheria zako.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

kikuyu: Nimechagua njia ya kweli, nimekaza moyo wangu katika sheria zako.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

kikuyu: Nimengʼangʼania sheria zako, Ee Bwana, usiniache niaibishwe.
english: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Nakimbilia katika njia ya maagizo yako, kwa kuwa umeuweka moyo wangu huru.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, nifundishe kuyafuata maagizo yako, nami nitayashika mpaka mwisho.
english: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

kikuyu: Nipe ufahamu, nami nitaishika sheria yako na kuitii kwa moyo wangu wote.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

kikuyu: Niongoze kwenye njia ya amri zako, kwa kuwa huko napata furaha.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

kikuyu: Ugeuze moyo wangu kuelekea sheria zako, na siyo kwenye mambo ya ubinafsi.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

kikuyu: Geuza macho yangu kutoka kwenye mambo yasiyofaa, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na neno lako.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

kikuyu: Mtimizie mtumishi wako ahadi yako, ili upate kuogopwa.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

kikuyu: Niondolee aibu ninayoiogopa, kwa kuwa sheria zako ni njema.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi ninavyoonea shauku mausia yako! Hifadhi maisha yangu katika haki yako.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, upendo wako usiokoma unijie, wokovu wako sawasawa na ahadi yako,
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

kikuyu: ndipo nitakapomjibu anayenidhihaki, kwa kuwa ninalitumainia neno lako.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

kikuyu: Usilinyakue neno la kweli kutoka kinywani mwangu, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika amri zako.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

kikuyu: Nitaitii amri yako daima, naam, milele na milele.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

kikuyu: Nitatembea nikiwa huru, kwa kuwa nimejifunza mausia yako.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Nitasema sheria zako mbele za wafalme wala sitaaibishwa,
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa ninazifurahia amri zako kwa sababu ninazipenda.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

kikuyu: Ninaziinulia amri zako ambazo ninazipenda mikono yangu, nami ninatafakari juu ya maagizo yako.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

kikuyu: Kumbuka neno lako kwa mtumishi wako, kwa sababu umenipa tumaini.
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

kikuyu: Faraja yangu katika mateso yangu ni hii: Ahadi yako inahifadhi maisha yangu.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

kikuyu: Wenye majivuno wamenisimanga bila kuchoka, hata hivyo sitaiacha sheria yako.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninazikumbuka sheria zako za zamani, nazo zinanifariji.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

kikuyu: Nimeshikwa sana na ghadhabu kwa ajili ya waovu, ambao wameacha sheria yako.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

kikuyu: Maagizo yako ni kiini cha nyimbo zangu popote ninapoishi.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wakati wa usiku ninalikumbuka jina lako, nami nitatii sheria yako.
english: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

kikuyu: Hili limekuwa zoezi langu: nami ninayatii mausia yako.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wewe ni fungu langu, nimeahidi kuyatii maneno yako.
english: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

kikuyu: Nimetafuta uso wako kwa moyo wangu wote, nihurumie sawasawa na ahadi yako.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

kikuyu: Nimezifikiri njia zangu na nimeelekeza hatua zangu katika mausia yako.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

kikuyu: Nitafanya haraka bila kuchelewa kuzitii amri zako.
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

kikuyu: Hata waovu wanifunge kwa kamba, sitasahau sheria yako.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru kwa sababu ya sheria zako za haki.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Mimi ni rafiki kwa wale wote wakuchao, kwa wote wanaofuata mausia yako.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, dunia imejaa upendo wako, nifundishe maagizo yako.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH

kikuyu: Mtendee wema mtumishi wako Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.

kikuyu: Nifundishe maarifa na uamuzi mzuri, kwa kuwa ninaamini amri zako.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

kikuyu: Kabla sijapata shida nilipotea njia, lakini sasa ninalitii neno lako.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

kikuyu: Wewe ni mwema, unalotenda ni jema, nifundishe maagizo yako.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Ingawa wenye majivuno wamenisingizia uongo, nitafuata mausia yako kwa moyo wangu wote.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

kikuyu: Mioyo yao ni katili na migumu, bali mimi napendezwa na sheria yako.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

kikuyu: Ilikuwa vyema mimi kupata shida ili nipate kujifunza maagizo yako.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

kikuyu: Sheria inayotoka kinywani mwako ina thamani kubwa kwangu kuliko maelfu ya vipande vya fedha na dhahabu.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

kikuyu: Mikono yako ilinifanya na kuniumba, nipe ufahamu niweze kujifunza amri zako.
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

kikuyu: Wakuchao wafurahie wanaponiona, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninajua kwamba sheria zako ni za haki, katika uaminifu wako umeniadhibu.
english: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

kikuyu: Upendo wako usiokoma uwe faraja yangu, sawasawa na ahadi yako kwa mtumishi wako.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

kikuyu: Huruma yako na inijie ili nipate kuishi, kwa kuwa naifurahia sheria yako.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Wenye majivuno na waaibishwe kwa kunikosea mimi bila sababu, lakini mimi nitatafakari juu ya mausia yako.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

kikuyu: Wale wakuchao na wanigeukie mimi, hao ambao wanazielewa sheria zako.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

kikuyu: Moyo wangu usiwe na lawama katika kutii maagizo yako, ili nisiaibishwe.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu inazimia kwa kutamani wokovu wako, lakini nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Macho yangu yamefifia, nikingoja ahadi yako; ninasema, “Utanifajiri lini?”
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

kikuyu: Ingawa nimekuwa kama kiriba kwenye moshi, bado sijasahau maagizo yako.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

kikuyu: Mtumishi wako itampasa angoje mpaka lini? Ni lini utawaadhibu washtaki wangu?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

kikuyu: Wenye majivuno wananichimbia mashimo, kinyume na sheria yako.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

kikuyu: Amri zako zote ni za kuaminika; unisaidie, kwa sababu watu wananishtaki bila sababu.
english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

kikuyu: Walikaribia kabisa kunifuta kutoka uso wa dunia, lakini sijaacha mausia yako.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

kikuyu: Yahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na upendo wako, nami nitatii sheria za kinywa chako.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, neno lako ni la milele, linasimama imara mbinguni.
english: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

kikuyu: Uaminifu wako unaendelea kwa vizazi vyote, umeiumba dunia, nayo inadumu.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

kikuyu: Sheria zako zinadumu hadi leo, kwa kuwa vitu vyote vinakutumikia.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

kikuyu: Kama nisingefurahia sheria yako, ningeangamia katika taabu zangu.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

kikuyu: Sitasahau mausia yako kamwe, kwa maana kwayo umehifadhi maisha yangu.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

kikuyu: Uniokoe, kwa maana mimi ni wako, kwa kuwa nimetafuta mausia yako.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Waovu wanangojea kuniangamiza, bali mimi ninatafakari sheria zako.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

kikuyu: Katika ukamilifu wote ninaona mna kikomo, lakini amri zako hazina mpaka.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

kikuyu: Aha! Tazama, sheria yako naipenda mno ajabu. Ninaitafakari mchana kutwa.
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

kikuyu: Amri zako zimenipa hekima zaidi kuliko adui zangu, kwa kuwa nimezishika daima.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

kikuyu: Nina akili zaidi kuliko walimu wangu wote, kwa kuwa ninatafakari juu ya sheria zako.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

kikuyu: Nina ufahamu zaidi kuliko wazee, kwa kuwa ninayatii mausia yako.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

kikuyu: Nimezuia miguu yangu isiende kwenye kila njia mbaya, ili niweze kutii neno lako.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

kikuyu: Sijaziacha sheria zako, kwa kuwa umenifundisha wewe mwenyewe.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi maneno yako yalivyo matamu kwangu, matamu kuliko asali katika kinywa changu!
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

kikuyu: Ninapata ufahamu kutoka mausia yako, kwa hiyo ninachukia kila njia ya upotovu.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

kikuyu: Neno lako ni taa ya miguu yangu na mwanga katika njia yangu.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

kikuyu: Nimeapa na nimethibitisha, kwamba nitafuata sheria zako za haki.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Nimeteseka sana, uhifadhi maisha yangu, Ee Bwana, sawasawa na neno lako.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, pokea sifa za hiari za kinywa changu, nifundishe sheria zako.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

kikuyu: Ingawa maisha yangu yako hatarini siku zote, sitasahau sheria yako.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Waovu wamenitegea mtego, lakini sijayakiuka maagizo yako.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

kikuyu: Sheria zako ni urithi wangu milele, naam ni furaha ya moyo wangu.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

kikuyu: Nimekusudia moyoni mwangu kuyafuata maagizo yako mpaka mwisho.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

kikuyu: Ninachukia watu wa nia mbili, lakini ninapenda sheria yako.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

kikuyu: Wewe ni kimbilio langu na ngao yangu, nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mtendao mabaya, ili niweze kushika amri za Mungu wangu!
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

kikuyu: Nihifadhi sawasawa na ahadi yako, nami nitaishi; usiache matumaini yangu yakavunjwa.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

kikuyu: Nitegemeze, nami nitaokolewa, nami daima nitayaheshimu maagizo yako.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

kikuyu: Unawakataa wote wanaoyaasi maagizo yako, kwa maana udanganyifu wao ni bure.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

kikuyu: Waovu wa nchi unawatupa kama takataka, kwa hivyo nazipenda sheria zako.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

kikuyu: Mwili wangu unatetemeka kwa kukuogopa wewe, ninaziogopa sheria zako.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

kikuyu: Nimetenda yaliyo haki na sawa, usiniache mikononi mwa watesi wangu.
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

kikuyu: Mhakikishie mtumishi wako usalama, usiache wenye kiburi wanionee.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

kikuyu: Macho yangu yamefifia, yakitazamia wokovu wako, na kuitazamia ahadi yako ya kweli.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

kikuyu: Mfanyie mtumishi wako kulingana na upendo wako na unifundishe maagizo yako.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Mimi ni mtumishi wako; nipe ufahamu ili niweze kuelewa sheria zako.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wakati wako wa kutenda umewadia, kwa kuwa sheria yako inavunjwa.
english: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu nazipenda amri zako zaidi ya dhahabu, naam, zaidi ya dhahabu safi,
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

kikuyu: na kwa sababu naona maagizo yako yote ni adili, nachukia kila njia potovu.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

kikuyu: Sheria zako ni za ajabu, hivyo ninazitii.
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

kikuyu: Kuingia kwa maneno yako kunaleta nuru, kunampa mjinga ufahamu.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

kikuyu: Nimefungua kinywa changu na kuhema, nikitamani amri zako.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

kikuyu: Nigeukie na unihurumie, kama uwafanyiavyo siku zote wale wanaolipenda jina lako.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

kikuyu: Ongoza hatua zangu kulingana na neno lako, usiache dhambi yoyote initawale.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

kikuyu: Niokoe na uonevu wa wanadamu, ili niweze kutii mausia yako.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Mwangazie mtumishi wako uso wako na unifundishe amri zako.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Chemchemi za machozi zinatiririka kutoka machoni yangu, kwa kuwa sheria yako haifuatwi.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, wewe ni mwenye haki, sheria zako ni sahihi.
english: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.

kikuyu: Sheria ulizoziweka ni za haki, ni za kuaminika kikamilifu.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

kikuyu: Jitihada yangu imenidhoofisha, kwa kuwa adui zangu wanayapuuza maneno yako.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

kikuyu: Ahadi zako zimejaribiwa kikamilifu, mtumishi wako anazipenda.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

kikuyu: Ingawa ni mdogo na ninadharauliwa, sisahau mausia yako.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

kikuyu: Haki yako ni ya milele, na sheria yako ni kweli.
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

kikuyu: Shida na dhiki zimenipata, lakini amri zako ni furaha yangu.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kikuyu: Sheria zako ni sahihi milele, hunipa ufahamu ili nipate kuishi.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninakuita kwa moyo wangu wote, nami nitayatii maagizo yako.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

kikuyu: Ninakuita; niokoe nami nitazishika sheria zako.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

kikuyu: Ninaamka asubuhi na mapema na kukuomba msaada; nimeweka tumaini langu katika neno lako.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

kikuyu: Sikufumba macho yangu usiku kucha, ili niweze kutafakari juu ya ahadi zako.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

kikuyu: Usikie sauti yangu sawasawa na upendo wako, Ee Bwana, uyahifadhi maisha yangu, sawasawa na sheria zako.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Wale wanaopanga mipango miovu wako karibu nami, lakini wako mbali na sheria yako.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, hata hivyo wewe u karibu, na amri zako zote ni za kweli.
english: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

kikuyu: Tangu zamani nimejifunza kutoka shuhuda zako kwamba umezithibitisha ili zidumu milele.
english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

kikuyu: Yaangalie mateso yangu, uniokoe, kwa kuwa sijasahau sheria yako.
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Nitetee katika hali hii yangu na unikomboe, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na ahadi yako.
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

kikuyu: Wokovu uko mbali na waovu, kwa kuwa hawatafuti maagizo yako.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, huruma zako ni kuu, uyahifadhi maisha yangu sawasawa na sheria zako.
english: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Adui wanaonitesa ni wengi, lakini mimi sitaziacha sheria zako.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

kikuyu: Ninawatazama wasioamini kwa chuki, kwa kuwa hawalitii neno lako.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi ninavyopenda mausia yako; Ee Bwana, uyahifadhi maisha yangu, sawasawa na upendo wako.
english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Maneno yako yote ni kweli, sheria zako zote za haki ni za milele.
english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

kikuyu: Watawala wamenitesa bila sababu, lakini moyo wangu unatetemeka kwa neno lako.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

kikuyu: Nafurahia ahadi zako kama mtu aliyepata mateka mengi.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

kikuyu: Ninachukia na kuchukizwa sana na uongo, lakini napenda sheria yako.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

kikuyu: Ninakusifu mara saba kwa siku, kwa ajili ya sheria zako za haki.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Wanaopenda sheria yako wana amani tele, wala hakuna kitu kinachoweza kuwakwaza.
english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninangojea wokovu wako, nami ninafuata amri zako,
english: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

kikuyu: Ninazitii sheria zako, kwa sababu ninazipenda mno.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

kikuyu: Nimetii mausia yako na sheria zako, kwa kuwa njia zangu zote zinajulikana kwako.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, kilio changu na kifike mbele zako, nipe ufahamu sawasawa na neno lako.
english: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.

kikuyu: Maombi yangu na yafike mbele zako, niokoe sawasawa na ahadi yako.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

kikuyu: Midomo yangu na ibubujike sifa, kwa kuwa unanifundisha maagizo yako.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Ulimi wangu na uimbe kuhusu neno lako, kwa kuwa amri zako zote ni za haki.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

kikuyu: Mkono wako uwe tayari kunisaidia, kwa kuwa nimechagua mausia yako.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninatamani wokovu wako, na sheria yako ni furaha yangu.
english: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Nijalie kuishi ili nipate kukusifu, na sheria zako zinitegemeze.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

kikuyu: Nimetangatanga kama kondoo aliyepotea. Mtafute mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa sijasahau amri zako.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Katika dhiki yangu namwita Bwana, naye hunijibu.
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uniokoe kutoka midomo ya uongo na ndimi za udanganyifu.
english: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Atakufanyia nini, au akufanyie nini zaidi, ewe ulimi mdanganyifu?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

kikuyu: Atakuadhibu kwa mishale mikali ya shujaa, kwa makaa yanayowaka ya mti wa mretemu.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

kikuyu: Ole wangu kwa kuwa naishi Mesheki, kwamba naishi katikati ya hema za Kedari!
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

kikuyu: Nimeishi muda mrefu mno miongoni mwa wale wanaochukia amani.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

kikuyu: Mimi ni mtu wa amani; lakini ninaposema, wao wanataka vita.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Nayainua macho yangu nitazame vilima, msaada wangu utatoka wapi?
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

kikuyu: Msaada wangu hutoka kwa Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
english: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Hatauacha mguu wako uteleze, yeye akulindaye hatasinzia,
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

kikuyu: hakika, yeye alindaye Israeli hatasinzia wala hatalala usingizi.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

kikuyu: Bwana anakulinda, Bwana ni uvuli wako mkono wako wa kuume,
english: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

kikuyu: jua halitakudhuru mchana, wala mwezi wakati wa usiku.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

kikuyu: Bwana atakukinga na madhara yote, atayalinda maisha yako,
english: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

kikuyu: Bwana atakulinda unapoingia na unapotoka, tangu sasa na hata milele.
english: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Nilishangilia pamoja na wale walioniambia, “Twende nyumbani ya Bwana.”
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

kikuyu: Ee Yerusalemu, miguu yetu imesimama malangoni mwako.
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

kikuyu: Yerusalemu imejengwa vyema kama mji ambao umeshikamanishwa pamoja.
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

kikuyu: Huko ndiko makabila hukwea, makabila ya Bwana, kulisifu jina la Bwana kulingana na maagizo waliopewa Israeli.
english: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Huko viti vya enzi vya hukumu hukaa, viti vya enzi vya nyumba ya Daudi.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

kikuyu: Omba kwa ajili ya amani ya Yerusalemu: “Wote wakupendao na wawe salama.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

kikuyu: Amani na iwepo ndani ya kuta zako na usalama ndani ya ngome zako.”
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya ndugu zangu na marafiki, nitasema, “Amani iwe ndani yako.”
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya nyumba ya Bwana Mungu wetu, nitatafuta mafanikio yako.
english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Ninayainua macho yangu kwako, kwako wewe ambaye kiti chako cha enzi kiko mbinguni.
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

kikuyu: Kama vile macho ya watumwa yatazamavyo mkono wa bwana wao, kama vile macho ya mtumishi wa kike yatazamavyo mkono wa bibi yake, ndivyo macho yetu yamtazamavyo Bwana Mungu wetu, mpaka atakapotuhurumia.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

kikuyu: Uturehemu, Ee Bwana, uturehemu, kwa maana tumevumilia dharau nyingi.
english: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

kikuyu: Tumevumilia dhihaka nyingi kutoka kwa wenye kiburi, dharau nyingi kutoka kwa wenye majivuno.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu; Israeli na aseme sasa:
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

kikuyu: kama Bwana asingalikuwa upande wetu, wakati watu walipotushambulia,
english: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

kikuyu: wakati hasira yao ilipowaka dhidi yetu, wangalitumeza tungali hai,
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

kikuyu: mafuriko yangalitugharikisha, maji mengi yangalitufunika,
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: maji yaendayo kasi yangalituchukua.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: Bwana asifiwe, yeye ambaye hakuruhusu turaruliwe kwa meno yao.
english: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

kikuyu: Tumeponyoka kama ndege kutoka mtego wa mwindaji; mtego umevunjika, nasi tukaokoka.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

kikuyu: Msaada wetu ni katika jina la Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia.
english: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wale wamtumainio Bwana ni kama mlima Sayuni, ambao hauwezi kutikisika, bali wadumu milele.
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

kikuyu: Kama milima inavyozunguka Yerusalemu, ndivyo Bwana anavyowazunguka watu wake sasa na hata milele.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Fimbo ya waovu haitadumu juu ya nchi waliopewa wenye haki, ili wenye haki wasije wakatumia mikono yao kutenda ubaya.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, watendee mema walio wema, wale walio wanyofu wa moyo.
english: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

kikuyu: Bali wale wanaogeukia njia zilizopotoka, Bwana atawafukuza pamoja na watenda mabaya. Amani iwe juu ya Israeli.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Bwana alipowarejeza mateka Sayuni, tulikuwa kama watu walioota ndoto.
english: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

kikuyu: Vinywa vyetu vilijaa kicheko, ndimi zetu zilijaa nyimbo za shangwe. Ndipo iliposemwa miongoni mwa mataifa, “Bwana amewatendea mambo makuu.”
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

kikuyu: Bwana ametutendea mambo makuu, nasi tumejaa furaha.
english: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, turejeshee watu wetu waliotekwa, kama vijito katika Negebu.
english: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

kikuyu: Wapandao kwa machozi watavuna kwa nyimbo za shangwe.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

kikuyu: Yeye azichukuaye mbegu zake kwenda kupanda, huku akilia, atarudi kwa nyimbo za shangwe, akichukua miganda ya mavuno yake.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Solomoni. Bwana asipoijenga nyumba, wajengao hufanya kazi bure. Bwana asipoulinda mji, walinzi wakesha bure.
english: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

kikuyu: Mnajisumbua bure kuamka mapema na kuchelewa kulala, mkitaabikia chakula: kwa maana yeye huwapa usingizi wapenzi wake.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

kikuyu: Wana ni urithi utokao kwa Bwana, watoto ni zawadi kutoka kwake.
english: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

kikuyu: Kama mishale mikononi mwa shujaa ndivyo walivyo wana awazaao mtu katika ujana wake.
english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

kikuyu: Heri mtu ambaye podo lake limejazwa nao. Hawataaibishwa wanaposhindana na adui zao langoni.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Heri ni wale wote wamchao Bwana, waendao katika njia zake.
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

kikuyu: Utakula matunda ya kazi yako; baraka na mafanikio vitakuwa vyako.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

kikuyu: Mke wako atakuwa kama mzabibu uzaao ndani ya nyumba yako; wana wako watakuwa kama machipukizi ya mizeituni kuizunguka meza yako.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

kikuyu: Hivyo ndivyo atakavyobarikiwa mtu amchaye Bwana.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Bwana na akubariki kutoka Sayuni siku zote za maisha yako, na uone mafanikio ya Yerusalemu,
english: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

kikuyu: nawe ujaliwe kuishi uone watoto wa watoto wako. Amani iwe juu ya Israeli.
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wamenionea mno tangu ujana wangu; Israeli na aseme sasa:
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

kikuyu: wamenionea mno tangu ujana wangu, lakini bado hawajanishinda.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

kikuyu: Wakulima wamelima mgongo wangu, na kufanya mifereji yao mirefu.
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana ni mwenye haki; amenifungua toka kamba za waovu.
english: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

kikuyu: Wale wote waichukiao Sayuni na warudishwe nyuma kwa aibu.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

kikuyu: Wawe kama majani juu ya paa, ambayo hunyauka kabla hayajakua;
english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

kikuyu: kwa hayo mvunaji hawezi kujaza vitanga vyake, wala akusanyaye kujaza mikono yake.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

kikuyu: Wale wapitao karibu na wasiseme, “Baraka ya Bwana iwe juu yako; tunakubariki katika jina la Bwana.”
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Kutoka vilindini ninakulilia, Ee Bwana.
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, sikia sauti yangu. Masikio yako na yawe masikivu kwa kilio changu unihurumie.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Kama wewe, Ee Bwana, ungeweka kumbukumbu ya dhambi, Ee Bwana, ni nani angeliweza kusimama?
english: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

kikuyu: Lakini kwako kuna msamaha, kwa hiyo wewe unaogopwa.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

kikuyu: Namngojea Bwana, nafsi yangu inangojea, katika neno lake naweka tumaini langu.
english: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

kikuyu: Nafsi yangu inamngojea Bwana kuliko walinzi waingojeavyo asubuhi, naam, kuliko walinzi waingojeavyo asubuhi.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

kikuyu: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana, maana kwa Bwana kuna upendo usiokoma, na kwake kuna ukombozi kamili.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

kikuyu: Yeye mwenyewe ataikomboa Israeli kutoka dhambi zao zote.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Moyo wangu hauna kiburi, Ee Bwana, macho yangu hayajivuni; sijishughulishi na mambo makuu kunizidi wala mambo ya ajabu mno kwangu.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

kikuyu: Lakini nimetuliza na kunyamazisha nafsi yangu; kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya na mama yake, kama mtoto aliyeachishwa kunyonya ndivyo ilivyo nafsi iliyoko ndani yangu.
english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

kikuyu: Ee Israeli, mtumaini Bwana tangu sasa na hata milele.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Ee Bwana, mkumbuke Daudi na taabu zote alizozistahimili.
english: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,

kikuyu: Aliapa kiapo kwa Bwana na akaweka nadhiri kwa Yule Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo:
english: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

kikuyu: “Sitaingia nyumbani mwangu au kwenda kitandani mwangu:
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

kikuyu: sitaruhusu usingizi katika macho yangu, wala kope zangu kusinzia,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

kikuyu: mpaka nitakapompatia Bwana mahali, makao kwa ajili ya Yule Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo.”
english: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

kikuyu: Tulisikia habari hii huko Efrathi, tulikutana nayo katika mashamba ya Yaara:
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

kikuyu: “Twendeni kwenye makao yake, na tuabudu kwenye kiti cha kuwekea miguu yake;
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

kikuyu: inuka, Ee Bwana, uje mahali pako pa kupumzikia, wewe na Sanduku la nguvu zako.
english: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

kikuyu: Makuhani wako na wavikwe haki, watakatifu wako na waimbe kwa furaha.”
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya Daudi mtumishi wako, usimkatae mpakwa mafuta wako.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Bwana alimwapia Daudi kiapo, kiapo cha uhakika ambacho hatakitangua: “Nitamweka mmoja wa wazao wako mwenyewe katika kiti chako cha enzi,
english: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

kikuyu: kama wanao watashika Agano langu na sheria ninazowafundisha, ndipo wana wao watarithi kiti chako cha enzi milele na milele.”
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana ameichagua Sayuni, amepaonea shauku pawe maskani yake:
english: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

kikuyu: “Hapa ni mahali pangu pa kupumzika milele na milele; hapa ndipo nitakapoketi nikitawala, kwa sababu nimepaonea shauku:
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

kikuyu: Nitambariki kwa kumpa mahitaji tele: nitashibisha maskini wake kwa chakula.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

kikuyu: Nitawavika makuhani wake wokovu, nao watakatifu wake watadumu wakiimba kwa furaha.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

kikuyu: “Hapa nitamchipushia Daudi pembe, na kuweka taa kwa ajili ya masiya wangu.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

kikuyu: Adui zake nitawavika aibu, bali taji kichwani pake itangʼaa sana.”
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Wa Daudi. Tazama jinsi ilivyo vyema na kupendeza wakati ndugu wanapoishi pamoja katika umoja!
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

kikuyu: Ni kama mafuta ya thamani yaliyomiminwa kichwani, yakitiririka kwenye ndevu, yakitiririka kwenye ndevu za Aroni, mpaka kwenye upindo wa mavazi yake.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

kikuyu: Ni kama vile umande wa Hermoni unavyoanguka juu ya Mlima Sayuni. Kwa maana huko ndiko Bwana alikoamuru baraka yake, naam, hata uzima milele.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa kwenda juu. Msifuni Bwana, ninyi nyote watumishi wa Bwana, ninyi mnaotumika usiku ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana.
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

kikuyu: Inueni mikono yenu katika pale patakatifu na kumsifu Bwana.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Naye Bwana, Muumba wa mbingu na dunia, awabariki kutoka Sayuni.
english: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Lisifuni jina la Bwana, msifuni, enyi watumishi wa Bwana,
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

kikuyu: ninyi ambao mnatumika ndani ya nyumba ya Bwana, katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu wetu.
english: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana, kwa kuwa Bwana ni mwema, liimbieni sifa jina lake, kwa maana hilo lapendeza.
english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana amemchagua Yakobo kuwa wake mwenyewe, Israeli kuwa mali yake ya thamani.
english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

kikuyu: Ninajua ya kuwa Bwana ni mkuu, kwamba Bwana wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu yote.
english: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

kikuyu: Bwana hufanya lolote apendalo, mbinguni na duniani, katika bahari na vilindi vyake vyote.
english: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

kikuyu: Hufanya mawingu kupanda kutoka miisho ya dunia; hupeleka umeme wa radi pamoja na mvua na huleta upepo kutoka ghala zake.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

kikuyu: Alimuua mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa wanadamu na wanyama.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

kikuyu: Alipeleka ishara zake na maajabu katikati yako, ee Misri, dhidi ya Farao na watumishi wake wote.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

kikuyu: Aliyapiga mataifa mengi, na akaua wafalme wenye nguvu:
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

kikuyu: Mfalme Sihoni na Waamori, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani na wafalme wote wa Kanaani:
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

kikuyu: akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, urithi kwa watu wake Israeli.
