english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, jina lako ladumu milele, kumbukumbu za fahari zako, Ee Bwana, kwa vizazi vyote.
english: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Maana Bwana atawathibitisha watu wake, na kuwahurumia watumishi wake.
english: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

kikuyu: Sanamu za mataifa ni fedha na dhahabu, zilizotengenezwa kwa mikono ya wanadamu.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kusema, zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona;
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

kikuyu: zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia, wala hakuna pumzi katika vinywa vyao.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

kikuyu: Wale wanaozitengeneza watafanana nazo, vivyo hivyo wale wote wanaozitumainia.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Ee nyumba ya Israeli, msifuni Bwana; ee nyumba ya Aroni, msifuni Bwana;
english: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: ee nyumba ya Lawi, msifuni Bwana; ninyi mnaomcha, msifuni Bwana.
english: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana kutoka Sayuni, msifuni yeye aishiye Yerusalemu. Msifuni Bwana.
english: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Bwana, kwa kuwa ni mwema. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Mungu wa miungu. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Bwana wa mabwana: Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kwake yeye pekee atendaye maajabu makuu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ambaye kwa ufahamu wake aliziumba mbingu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ambaye aliitandaza dunia juu ya maji, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ambaye aliumba mianga mikubwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Jua litawale mchana, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Mwezi na nyota vitawale usiku, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kwake yeye aliyemuua mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Na kuwatoa Israeli katikati yao, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kwa mkono wenye nguvu ulionyooshwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kwake yeye aliyeigawa Bahari ya Shamu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Na kuwapitisha Israeli katikati yake, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Lakini alimfagia Farao na jeshi lake katika Bahari ya Shamu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Kwake yeye aliyewaongoza watu wake katika jangwa, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ambaye aliwapiga wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Naye aliwaua wafalme wenye nguvu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Akatoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Urithi kwa Israeli mtumishi wake, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Aliyetukumbuka katika unyonge wetu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Alituweka huru toka adui zetu, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Ambaye humpa chakula kila kiumbe. Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Mshukuruni Mungu wa mbinguni, Fadhili zake zadumu milele.
english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Kando ya mito ya Babeli tuliketi, tukaomboleza tulipokumbuka Sayuni.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

kikuyu: Kwenye miti ya huko tulitundika vinubi vyetu,
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

kikuyu: kwa maana huko hao waliotuteka walitaka tuwaimbie nyimbo, watesi wetu walidai nyimbo za furaha; walisema, “Tuimbieni wimbo mmoja kati ya nyimbo za Sayuni!”
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

kikuyu: Tutaimbaje nyimbo za Bwana, tukiwa nchi ya kigeni?
english: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

kikuyu: Nikikusahau wewe, ee Yerusalemu, basi mkono wangu wa kuume na usahau ujuzi wake.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

kikuyu: Ulimi wangu ushikamane na kaakaa la kinywa changu kama sitakukumbuka wewe, kama nisipokufikiri Yerusalemu kuwa furaha yangu kubwa.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

kikuyu: Kumbuka, Ee Bwana, walichokifanya Waedomu, siku ile Yerusalemu ilipoanguka. Walisema, “Bomoa, Bomoa mpaka kwenye misingi yake!”
english: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

kikuyu: Ee binti Babeli, uliyehukumiwa kuangamizwa, heri yeye atakayekulipiza wewe kwa yale uliyotutenda sisi:
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

kikuyu: yeye ambaye atawakamata watoto wako wachanga na kuwaponda juu ya miamba.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa moyo wangu wote, mbele ya “miungu” nitaimba sifa zako.
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: Nitasujudu nikielekea Hekalu lako takatifu, nami nitalisifu jina lako kwa ajili ya upendo wako na uaminifu, kwa kuwa umelikuza jina lako na neno lako juu ya vitu vyote.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

kikuyu: Nilipoita, ulinijibu; ulinifanya jasiri na mwenye moyo hodari.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

kikuyu: Wafalme wote wa dunia wakusifu wewe Ee Bwana, wakati wanaposikia maneno ya kinywa chako.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: Wao na waimbe kuhusu njia za Bwana, kwa maana utukufu wa Bwana ni mkuu.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

kikuyu: Ingawa Bwana yuko juu, humwangalia mnyonge, bali mwenye kiburi yeye anamjua kutokea mbali.
english: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

kikuyu: Nijapopita katikati ya shida, wewe unayahifadhi maisha yangu, unanyoosha mkono wako dhidi ya hasira ya adui zangu, kwa mkono wako wa kuume unaniokoa.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

kikuyu: Bwana atatimiza kusudi lake kwangu, Ee Bwana, upendo wako wadumu milele: usiziache kazi za mikono yako.
english: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, umenichunguza na kunijua.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

kikuyu: Unajua ninapoketi na ninapoinuka; unatambua mawazo yangu tokea mbali.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

kikuyu: Unafahamu kutoka kwangu na kulala kwangu; unaelewa njia zangu zote.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

kikuyu: Kabla neno halijafika katika ulimi wangu, wewe walijua kikamilifu, Ee Bwana.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

kikuyu: Umenizunguka nyuma na mbele; umeweka mkono wako juu yangu.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

kikuyu: Maarifa haya ni ya ajabu mno kwangu, ni ya juu sana kwangu kuyafikia.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

kikuyu: Niende wapi nijiepushe na Roho yako? Niende wapi niukimbie uso wako?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

kikuyu: Kama nikienda juu mbinguni, wewe uko huko; nikifanya vilindi kuwa kitanda changu, wewe uko huko.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

kikuyu: Kama nikipanda juu ya mbawa za mapambazuko, kama nikikaa pande za mbali za bahari,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

kikuyu: hata huko mkono wako utaniongoza, mkono wako wa kuume utanishika kwa uthabiti.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

kikuyu: Kama nikisema, “Hakika giza litanificha na nuru inayonizunguka iwe usiku,”
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

kikuyu: hata giza halitakuwa giza kwako, usiku utangʼaa kama mchana, kwa kuwa giza ni kama nuru kwako.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wewe ndiwe uliyeumba utu wangu wa ndani; uliniunga pamoja tumboni mwa mama yangu.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Ninakusifu kwa sababu nimeumbwa kwa namna ya ajabu na ya kutisha; kazi zako ni za ajabu, ninajua hayo kikamilifu.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

kikuyu: Umbile langu halikufichika kwako, nilipoumbwa mahali pa siri. Nilipoungwa pamoja kwa ustadi katika vilindi vya nchi,
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: macho yako yaliniona kabla mwili wangu haujakamilika. Siku zangu zote ulizonipangia ziliandikwa katika kitabu chako kabla haijakuwepo hata moja.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi yalivyo ya thamani mawazo yako kwangu, Ee Mungu! Jinsi jumla yake ilivyo kubwa!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

kikuyu: Kama ningezihesabu, zingekuwa nyingi kuliko mchanga. Niamkapo, bado niko pamoja nawe.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

kikuyu: Laiti ungewachinja waovu, Ee Mungu! Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi wamwaga damu!
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

kikuyu: Wanazungumza juu yako wakiwa na kusudi baya, adui zako wanatumia vibaya jina lako.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, je, nisiwachukie wanaokuchukia? Nisiwachukie sana wanaoinuka dhidi yako?
english: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

kikuyu: Sina kitu zaidi ya chuki dhidi yao, ninawahesabu ni adui zangu.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, nichunguze, uujue moyo wangu, nijaribu na ujue mawazo yangu.
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

kikuyu: Uone kama kuna njia iletayo machukizo ndani yangu, uniongoze katika njia ya milele.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

kikuyu: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, niokoe, kutoka kwa watu waovu; nilinde na watu wenye jeuri,
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

kikuyu: ambao hupanga mipango mibaya mioyoni mwao, na kuchochea vita siku zote.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

kikuyu: Wao hufanya ndimi zao kali kama za nyoka, sumu ya nyoka iko midomoni mwao.
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, niepushe na mikono ya waovu; nilinde na watu wenye jeuri wanaopanga kunikwaza miguu yangu.
english: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

kikuyu: Wenye kiburi wameficha mtego wa kuninasa, wametandaza kamba za wavu wao, wametega mitego kwenye njia yangu.
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, ninakuambia, “Wewe ni Mungu wangu.” Ee Bwana, usikie kilio changu na kunihurumia.
english: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, Mwokozi wangu mwenye nguvu, unikingaye kichwa changu siku ya vita:
english: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, usiwape waovu matakwa yao, usiache mipango yao ikafanikiwa, wasije wakajisifu.
english: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

kikuyu: Vichwa vya wanaonizunguka vifunikwe na shida zinazosababishwa na midomo yao.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

kikuyu: Makaa ya mawe ya moto na yawaangukie! Na watupwe motoni, katika mashimo ya matope, wasiinuke tena kamwe.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

kikuyu: Wasingiziaji wasifanikiwe katika nchi; maafa na yawawinde watu wenye jeuri.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

kikuyu: Najua kwamba Bwana huwapatia maskini haki, na kuitegemeza njia ya mhitaji.
english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

kikuyu: Hakika wenye haki watalisifu jina lako, na waadilifu wataishi mbele zako.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, ninakuita wewe, uje kwangu hima. Sikia sauti yangu ninapokuita.
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

kikuyu: Maombi yangu na yafike mbele zako kama uvumba; kuinua mikono yangu juu na kuwe kama dhabihu ya jioni.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, weka mlinzi kinywani mwangu, weka ulinzi mlangoni mwa midomo yangu.
english: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

kikuyu: Usiuache moyo wangu uvutwe katika jambo baya, nisije nikashiriki katika matendo maovu pamoja na watu watendao mabaya, wala nisije nikala vyakula vyao vya anasa.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye haki na anipige: ni jambo la huruma; na anikemee: ni mafuta kichwani mwangu. Kichwa changu hakitalikataa. Hata hivyo, maombi yangu daima ni kinyume cha watenda mabaya,
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

kikuyu: watawala wao watatupwa chini kutoka kwenye majabali, waovu watajifunza kwamba maneno yangu yalikuwa kweli.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

kikuyu: Watasema, “Kama mtu anavyolima na kuvunja ardhi, ndivyo mifupa yetu imetawanywa kwenye mlango wa kaburi.”
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

kikuyu: Lakini nimekaza macho yangu kwako, Ee Bwana Mwenyezi, ndani yako nimekimbilia, usiniache nife.
english: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

kikuyu: Niepushe na mitego waliyonitegea, kutokana na mitego iliyotegwa na watenda mabaya.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Waovu na waanguke kwenye nyavu zao wenyewe, wakati mimi ninapita salama.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

kikuyu: Utenzi wa Daudi. Alipokuwa pangoni. Maombi. Namlilia Bwana kwa sauti, nainua sauti yangu kwa Bwana anihurumie.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

kikuyu: Namimina malalamiko yangu mbele zake, mbele zake naeleza shida zangu.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

kikuyu: Wakati roho yangu inapozimia ndani yangu, wewe ndiwe unajua njia zangu. Katika njia ninayopita watu wameniwekea mtego.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

kikuyu: Tazama kuume kwangu na uone, hakuna hata mmoja anayejihusisha nami. Sina kimbilio, hakuna anayejali maisha yangu.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, nakulilia wewe, nasema, “Wewe ni kimbilio langu, fungu langu katika nchi ya walio hai.”
english: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

kikuyu: Sikiliza kilio changu, kwa sababu mimi ni mhitaji sana; niokoe na wale wanaonifuatilia, kwa kuwa wamenizidi nguvu.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

kikuyu: Nifungue kutoka kifungo changu, ili niweze kulisifu jina lako. Ndipo wenye haki watanizunguka, kwa sababu ya wema wako kwangu.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, sikia sala yangu, sikiliza kilio changu unihurumie; katika uaminifu na haki yako njoo unisaidie.
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

kikuyu: Usimhukumu mtumishi wako, kwa kuwa hakuna mtu anayeishi aliye mwenye haki mbele zako.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

kikuyu: Adui hunifuatilia, hunipondaponda chini; hunifanya niishi gizani kama wale waliokufa zamani.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo roho yangu inazimia ndani yangu, moyo wangu ndani yangu unakata tamaa.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

kikuyu: Nakumbuka siku za zamani; natafakari juu ya kazi zako zote, naangalia juu ya kazi ambazo mikono yako imezifanya.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Nanyoosha mikono yangu kwako, nafsi yangu inakuonea kiu kama ardhi kame.
english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, unijibu haraka, roho yangu inazimia. Usinifiche uso wako, ama sivyo nitafanana na wale washukao shimoni.
english: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Asubuhi uniletee neno la upendo wako usiokoma, kwa kuwa nimeweka tumaini langu kwako. Nionyeshe njia nitakayoiendea, kwa kuwa kwako nainua nafsi yangu.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, uniokoe na adui zangu, kwa kuwa nimejificha kwako.
english: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

kikuyu: Nifundishe kufanya mapenzi yako, kwa maana wewe ndiwe Mungu wangu, Roho wako mwema na aniongoze katika nchi tambarare.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, kwa ajili ya jina lako, hifadhi maisha yangu, kwa haki yako nitoe katika taabu.
english: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

kikuyu: Kwa upendo wako usiokoma, nyamazisha adui zangu; waangamize watesi wangu wote, kwa kuwa mimi ni mtumishi wako.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

kikuyu: Zaburi ya Daudi. Sifa ni kwa Bwana Mwamba wangu, aifundishaye mikono yangu vita, na vidole vyangu kupigana.
english: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

kikuyu: Yeye ni Mungu wangu wa upendo na boma langu, ngome yangu na mwokozi wangu, ngao yangu ninayemkimbilia, ambaye huwatiisha mataifa chini yangu.
english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, mwanadamu ni nini hata umjali, Binadamu ni nini hata umfikirie?
english: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

kikuyu: Mwanadamu ni kama pumzi, siku zake ni kama kivuli kinachopita.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, pasua mbingu zako, ushuke, gusa milima ili itoe moshi.
english: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

kikuyu: Peleka umeme uwatawanye adui, lenga mishale yako uwashinde.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

kikuyu: Nyoosha mkono wako kutoka juu, nikomboe na kuniokoa kutoka maji makuu, kutoka mikononi mwa wageni
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

kikuyu: ambao vinywa vyao vimejaa uongo, na mikono yao ya kuume ni midanganyifu.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Ee Mungu, nitakuimbia wimbo mpya, kwa zeze yenye nyuzi kumi nitakuimbia,
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: kwa Yule awapaye wafalme ushindi, ambaye humwokoa Daudi, mtumishi wake kutokana na upanga hatari.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

kikuyu: Nikomboe na uniokoe kutoka mikononi mwa wageni ambao vinywa vyao vimejaa uongo, na mikono yao ya kuume ni midanganyifu.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Kisha wana wetu wakati wa ujana wao watakuwa kama mimea iliyotunzwa vizuri, binti zetu watakuwa kama nguzo zilizoviringwa kurembesha jumba la kifalme.
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

kikuyu: Ghala zetu zitajazwa aina zote za mahitaji. Kondoo zetu watazaa kwa maelfu, kwa makumi ya maelfu katika mashamba yetu;
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

kikuyu: maksai wetu watakokota mizigo mizito. Hakutakuwa na kubomoka kuta, hakuna kuchukuliwa mateka, wala kilio cha taabu katika barabara zetu.
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

kikuyu: Heri watu ambao hili ni kweli; heri wale ambao Bwana ni Mungu wao.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

kikuyu: Wimbo wa Sifa. Wa Daudi. Nitakutukuza wewe, Mungu wangu Mfalme, nitalisifu jina lako milele na milele.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Kila siku nitakusifu na kulitukuza jina lako milele na milele.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mkuu, anayestahili kusifiwa sana, ukuu wake haupimiki.
english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Kizazi kimoja kitasifia kazi zako kwa kizazi kingine, watasimulia matendo yako makuu.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

kikuyu: Watasema juu ya utukufu wa fahari ya ukuu wako, nami nitatafakari juu ya kazi zako za ajabu.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Watasimulia uwezo wa kazi zako za kutisha, nami nitatangaza matendo yako makuu.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

kikuyu: Wataadhimisha wema wako mwingi, na wataimba kwa shangwe juu ya haki yako.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwenye neema na mwingi wa huruma, si mwepesi wa hasira, bali ni mwingi wa upendo.
english: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwema kwa wote, ana huruma kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
english: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

kikuyu: Ee Bwana, vyote ulivyovifanya vitakusifu, watakatifu wako watakutukuza.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

kikuyu: Watasimulia utukufu wa ufalme wako na kusema juu ya ukuu wako,
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

kikuyu: ili watu wote wajue matendo yako makuu na utukufu wa fahari ya ufalme wako.
english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

kikuyu: Ufalme wako ni ufalme wa milele, mamlaka yako hudumu vizazi vyote. Bwana ni mwaminifu kwa ahadi zake zote na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

kikuyu: Bwana huwategemeza wote waangukao, na huwainua wote waliolemewa na mizigo yao.
english: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

kikuyu: Macho yao wote yanakutazama wewe, nawe huwapa chakula chao wakati wake.
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Waufumbua mkono wako, watosheleza haja ya kila kitu kilicho hai.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

kikuyu: Bwana ni mwenye haki katika njia zake zote, na mwenye upendo kwa vyote alivyovifanya.
english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

kikuyu: Bwana yu karibu na wote wamwitao, karibu na wote wamwitao kwa uaminifu.
english: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

kikuyu: Huwatimizia wamchao matakwa yao, husikia kilio chao na kuwaokoa.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

kikuyu: Bwana huwalinda wote wampendao, bali waovu wote atawaangamiza.
english: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

kikuyu: Kinywa changu kitazinena sifa za Bwana. Kila kiumbe na kilisifu jina lake takatifu milele na milele.
english: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana! Ee nafsi yangu, umsifu Bwana,
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

kikuyu: Nitamsifu Bwana maisha yangu yote; nitamwimbia Mungu wangu sifa wakati wote niishipo.
english: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

kikuyu: Usiweke tumaini lako kwa wakuu, kwa wanadamu ambao hufa, ambao hawawezi kuokoa.
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

kikuyu: Roho yao itokapo hurudi mavumbini, siku hiyo hiyo mipango yao yote hukoma.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

kikuyu: Heri yeye ambaye Mungu wa Yakobo ni msaada wake, ambaye tumaini lake ni katika Bwana, Mungu wake,
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

kikuyu: Muumba wa mbingu na nchi, na bahari na vyote vilivyomo ndani yake: Bwana anayedumu kuwa mwaminifu milele na milele.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

kikuyu: Naye huwapatia haki walioonewa na kuwapa wenye njaa chakula. Bwana huwaweka wafungwa huru,
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

kikuyu: Bwana huwafumbua vipofu macho, Bwana huwainua waliolemewa na mizigo yao, Bwana huwapenda wenye haki.
english: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

kikuyu: Bwana huwalinda wageni na kuwategemeza yatima na wajane, lakini hupinga njia za waovu.
english: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

kikuyu: Bwana atamiliki milele, Mungu wako, ee Sayuni, kwa vizazi vyote. Msifuni Bwana.
english: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Tazama jinsi ilivyo vyema kumwimbia Mungu wetu sifa, jinsi inavyopendeza na kustahili kumsifu yeye!
english: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

kikuyu: Bwana hujenga Yerusalemu, huwakusanya Israeli walio uhamishoni.
english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

kikuyu: Anawaponya waliovunjika mioyo na kuvifunga vidonda vyao.
english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

kikuyu: Huzihesabu nyota na huipa kila moja jina lake.
english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

kikuyu: Bwana wetu ni mkuu na mwenye uwezo mwingi, ufahamu wake hauna kikomo.
english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

kikuyu: Bwana huwahifadhi wanyenyekevu lakini huwashusha waovu mpaka mavumbini.
english: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

kikuyu: Mwimbieni Bwana kwa shukrani, mpigieni Mungu wetu kinubi.
english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

kikuyu: Yeye huzifunika anga kwa mawingu, huinyeshea ardhi mvua, na kuzifanya nyasi kuota juu ya vilima.
english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

kikuyu: Huwapa chakula mifugo na pia makinda ya kunguru yanapolia.
english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

kikuyu: Furaha yake haipo katika nguvu za farasi, wala furaha yake kwenye miguu ya mwanadamu.
english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

kikuyu: Bwana hupendezwa na wale wamchao, wale wanaoweka tumaini lao katika upendo wake usiokoma.
english: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

kikuyu: Mtukuze Bwana, ee Yerusalemu, msifu Mungu wako, ee Sayuni,
english: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

kikuyu: kwa maana huimarisha makomeo ya malango yako na huwabariki watu wako walio ndani yako.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

kikuyu: Huwapa amani mipakani mwenu na kukushibisha kwa ngano safi kabisa.
english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

kikuyu: Hutuma amri yake duniani, neno lake hukimbia kasi.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

kikuyu: Anatandaza theluji kama sufu na kutawanya umande kama majivu.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

kikuyu: Huvurumisha mvua yake ya mawe kama changarawe. Ni nani awezaye kustahimili ukali wa baridi yake?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

kikuyu: Hutuma neno lake na kuviyeyusha, huvumisha upepo wake, nayo maji hutiririka.
english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

kikuyu: Amemfunulia Yakobo neno lake, sheria zake na maagizo yake kwa Israeli.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

kikuyu: Hajafanya hivyo kwa taifa lingine lolote, hawazijui sheria zake. Msifuni Bwana.
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Bwana kutoka mbinguni, msifuni juu vileleni.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

kikuyu: Msifuni, enyi malaika wake wote, msifuni yeye, enyi jeshi lake lote la mbinguni.
english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

kikuyu: Msifuni yeye, enyi jua na mwezi, msifuni yeye, enyi nyota zote zingʼaazo.
english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

kikuyu: Msifuni yeye, enyi mbingu zilizo juu sana, na ninyi maji juu ya anga.
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

kikuyu: Vilisifu jina la Bwana kwa maana aliamuru navyo vikaumbwa.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

kikuyu: Aliviweka mahali pake milele na milele, alitoa amri ambayo haibadiliki milele.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

kikuyu: Mtukuzeni Bwana kutoka duniani, ninyi viumbe vikubwa vya baharini na vilindi vyote vya bahari,
english: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

kikuyu: umeme wa radi na mvua ya mawe, theluji na mawingu, pepo za dhoruba zinazofanya amri zake,
english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

kikuyu: ninyi milima na vilima vyote, miti ya matunda na mierezi yote,
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

kikuyu: wanyama wa mwituni na mifugo yote, viumbe vidogo na ndege warukao,
english: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

kikuyu: wafalme wa dunia na mataifa yote, ninyi wakuu na watawala wote wa dunia,
english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

kikuyu: wanaume vijana na wanawali, wazee na watoto.
english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

kikuyu: Wote na walisifu jina la Bwana, kwa maana jina lake pekee limetukuka, utukufu wake uko juu ya nchi na mbingu.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: Amewainulia watu wake pembe, sifa ya watakatifu wake wote, ya Israeli, watu walio karibu na moyo wake. Msifuni Bwana.
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo mpya, sifa zake katika kusanyiko la watakatifu.
english: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

kikuyu: Israeli na washangilie katika Muumba wao, watu wa Sayuni na wafurahi katika Mfalme wao.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

kikuyu: Na walisifu jina lake kwa kucheza na wampigie muziki kwa matari na kinubi.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana anapendezwa na watu wake, anawavika wanyenyekevu taji ya wokovu.
english: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

kikuyu: Watakatifu washangilie katika heshima hii, na waimbe kwa shangwe vitandani mwao.
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

kikuyu: Sifa za Mungu na ziwe vinywani mwao na upanga ukatao kuwili mikononi mwao,
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

kikuyu: ili walipize mataifa kisasi na adhabu juu ya mataifa,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

kikuyu: wawafunge wafalme wao kwa minyororo, wakuu wao kwa pingu za chuma,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

kikuyu: ili kuwafanyia hukumu iliyoandikwa dhidi yao. Huu ndio utukufu wa watakatifu wake wote. Msifuni Bwana.
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Msifuni Bwana. Msifuni Mungu katika patakatifu pake, msifuni katika mbingu zake kuu.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

kikuyu: Msifuni kwa matendo yake makuu, msifuni kwa kadiri ya wingi wa ukuu wake.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

kikuyu: Msifuni kwa mvumo wa tarumbeta, msifuni kwa kinubi na zeze,
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

kikuyu: msifuni kwa matari na kucheza, msifuni kwa kinanda cha nyuzi na filimbi,
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

kikuyu: msifuni kwa matoazi yaliayo, msifuni kwa matoazi yavumayo sana.
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

kikuyu: Kila chenye pumzi na kimsifu Bwana. Msifuni Bwana!
english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Mithali za Solomoni mwana wa Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli:
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

kikuyu: Kwa kupata hekima na nidhamu; kwa kufahamu maneno ya busara;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

kikuyu: kwa kujipatia nidhamu na busara, kufanya lililo sawa, haki na bila kupendelea;
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

kikuyu: huwapa busara wajinga, maarifa na akili kwa vijana;
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

kikuyu: wenye hekima na wasikilize nao waongeze elimu yao, wenye kupambanua na wapate mwongozo;
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

kikuyu: kwa kufahamu mithali na mifano, misemo na vitendawili vya wenye hekima.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha maarifa, lakini wapumbavu hudharau hekima na adabu.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, sikiliza mwongozo wa baba yako, wala usiyaache mafundisho ya mama yako.
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

kikuyu: Hayo yatakuwa taji la maua la neema kichwani pako, na mkufu wa kuipamba shingo yako.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, kama wenye dhambi wakikushawishi, usikubaliane nao.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

kikuyu: Kama wakisema, “Twende tufuatane; tukamvizie mtu na kumwaga damu, njoo tukavizie nafsi isiyo na hatia;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

kikuyu: tuwameze wakiwa hai kama kaburi, wakiwa wazima kama wale wanaotumbukia shimoni.
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Tutapata aina zote za vitu vya thamani na kujaza nyumba zetu kwa nyara.
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

kikuyu: Njoo ushirikiane nasi, vitu vyote tutakavyopata tutagawana.”
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

kikuyu: Mwanangu, usiandamane nao. Usiweke mguu wako katika njia zao,
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa miguu yao hukimbilia kwenye dhambi, ni wepesi kumwaga damu.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

kikuyu: Tazama ni jinsi gani ilivyo kazi bure kutandaza wavu wakati ndege wote wanakuona!
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

kikuyu: Watu hawa huvizia kumwaga damu yao wenyewe; hujivizia tu wenyewe!
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

kikuyu: Huu ndio mwisho wa wote ambao wanajipatia mali kwa hila; huuondoa uhai wa wale wenye mali.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

kikuyu: Hekima huita kwa sauti kuu barabarani, hupaza sauti yake kwenye viwanja vikubwa;
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

kikuyu: kwenye makutano ya barabara za mji zenye makelele mengi hupaza sauti, kwenye malango ya mji hutoa hotuba yake:
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

kikuyu: “Enyi wajinga, mtangʼangʼania ujinga wenu hadi lini? Mpaka lini wenye mizaha watafurahia mizaha, na wapumbavu kuchukia maarifa?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

kikuyu: Kama mngekuwa mmeitikia karipio langu, ningekuwa nimemimina roho yangu kwenu na kuwafahamisha maneno yangu.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa kuwa mlinikataa nilipowaita na hakuna yeyote aliyekubali niliponyoosha mkono wangu,
english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

kikuyu: kwa kuwa mliyapuuza mashauri yangu yote na hamkukubali karipio langu,
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

kikuyu: mimi nami nitawacheka katika maafa yenu, nitawadhihaki wakati janga litawapata:
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

kikuyu: wakati janga litawapata kama tufani, wakati maafa yatawazoa kama upepo wa kisulisuli, wakati dhiki na taabu zitawalemea.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

kikuyu: “Ndipo watakaponiita lakini sitawajibu; watanitafuta lakini hawatanipata.
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa walichukia maarifa, wala hawakuchagua kumcha Bwana,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa hawakukubali mashauri yangu, na kukataa maonyo yangu,
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

kikuyu: watakula matunda ya njia zao, na watashibishwa matunda ya hila zao.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ukaidi wa wajinga utawaua, nako kuridhika kwa wajinga kutawaangamiza.
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

kikuyu: Lakini yeyote anisikilizaye ataishi kwa usalama, atatulia, bila kuwa na hofu ya madhara.”
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

kikuyu: Mwanangu, kama utayakubali maneno yangu na kuyaweka akiba maagizo yangu ndani mwako,
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

kikuyu: kutega sikio lako kwenye hekima na kuweka moyo wako katika ufahamu,
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

kikuyu: na kama ukiita busara na kuita kwa sauti ufahamu,
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

kikuyu: na kama utaitafuta kama fedha na kuitafuta sana kama hazina iliyofichwa,
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

kikuyu: ndipo utakapoelewa kumcha Bwana na kupata maarifa ya Mungu.
english: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Bwana hutoa hekima, na kinywani mwake hutoka maarifa na ufahamu.
english: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

kikuyu: Anahifadhi ushindi kwa ajili ya mwadilifu, yeye ni ngao kwa wale wasio na lawama,
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa hulinda mwenendo wa mwenye haki na kuhifadhi njia ya waaminifu wake.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

kikuyu: Ndipo utafahamu lipi lililo kweli na haki na sawa: yaani kila njia nzuri.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

kikuyu: Kwa maana hekima itaingia moyoni mwako, nayo maarifa yataifurahisha nafsi yako.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

kikuyu: Busara itakuhifadhi na ufahamu utakulinda.
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

kikuyu: Hekima itakuokoa kutoka njia za waovu, kutoka kwa watu ambao maneno yao yamepotoka,
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

kikuyu: wale waachao mapito yaliyonyooka wakatembea katika njia za giza,
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

kikuyu: wale wapendao kutenda mabaya na kufurahia upotovu wa ubaya,
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

kikuyu: ambao mapito yao yamepotoka na ambao ni wapotovu katika njia zao.
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

kikuyu: Itakuokoa pia kutokana na mwanamke kahaba, kutokana na mke aliyepotoka mwenye maneno ya kushawishi kutenda ubaya,
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

kikuyu: aliyemwacha mwenzi wa ujana wake na kupuuza agano alilofanya mbele ya Mungu.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

kikuyu: Kwa maana nyumba yake huelekea kwenye kifo na mapito yake kwenye roho za waliokufa.
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Hakuna yeyote aendaye kwake akarudi, au kufikia mapito ya uzima.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

kikuyu: Hivyo utatembea katika njia za watu wema na kushikamana na mapito ya wenye haki.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wanyofu wataishi katika nchi, nao wasio na lawama watabakia ndani yake.
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

kikuyu: Bali waovu watakatiliwa mbali kutoka nchi, nao wasio waaminifu watangʼolewa kutoka humo.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, usisahau mafundisho yangu, bali zitunze amri zangu moyoni mwako,
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa zitakuongezea miaka mingi ya maisha yako na kukuletea mafanikio.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

kikuyu: Usiache kamwe upendo na uaminifu vitengane nawe; vifunge shingoni mwako, viandike katika ubao wa moyo wako.
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Ndipo utapata kibali na jina zuri mbele za Mungu na mwanadamu.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

kikuyu: Mtumaini Bwana kwa moyo wako wote wala usizitegemee akili zako mwenyewe;
english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

kikuyu: katika njia zako zote mkiri yeye, naye atayanyoosha mapito yako.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

kikuyu: Usiwe mwenye hekima machoni pako mwenyewe; mche Bwana ukajiepushe na uovu.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

kikuyu: Hii itakuletea afya mwilini mwako, na mafuta kwenye mifupa yako.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

kikuyu: Mheshimu Bwana kwa mali zako na kwa malimbuko ya mazao yako yote;
english: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

kikuyu: ndipo ghala zako zitakapojaa hadi kufurika, viriba vyako vitafurika kwa mvinyo mpya.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, usiidharau adhabu ya Bwana na usichukie kukaripiwa naye,
english: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

kikuyu: kwa sababu Bwana huwaadibisha wale awapendao, kama vile baba afanyavyo kwa mwana apendezwaye naye.
english: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

kikuyu: Heri mtu yule aonaye hekima, mtu yule apataye ufahamu,
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

kikuyu: kwa maana hekima ana faida kuliko fedha na mapato yake ni bora kuliko ya dhahabu safi.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

kikuyu: Hekima ana thamani kuliko marijani; hakuna chochote unachokitamani kinachoweza kulinganishwa naye.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

kikuyu: Maisha marefu yako katika mkono wake wa kuume; katika mkono wake wa kushoto kuna utajiri na heshima.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

kikuyu: Njia zake zinapendeza, mapito yake yote ni amani.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

kikuyu: Yeye ni mti wa uzima kwa wale wanaomkumbatia; wale wamshikao watabarikiwa.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

kikuyu: Kwa hekima Bwana aliiweka misingi ya dunia, kwa ufahamu aliziweka mbingu mahali pake;
english: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

kikuyu: kwa maarifa yake vilindi viligawanywa, nayo mawingu yanadondosha umande.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, hifadhi maamuzi mema na busara, usiache vitoke machoni pako;
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

kikuyu: ndipo vitakapokuwa uzima nafsini mwako na pambo la neema shingoni mwako.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

kikuyu: Kisha utaenda katika njia yako salama, wala mguu wako hautajikwaa;
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

kikuyu: ulalapo, hautaogopa; ulalapo usingizi wako utakuwa mtamu.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

kikuyu: Usiogope maafa ya ghafula au maangamizi yanayowapata waovu,
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

kikuyu: kwa kuwa Bwana atakuwa tumaini lako na kuepusha mguu wako kunaswa katika mtego.
english: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

kikuyu: Usizuie wema kwa wale wanaostahili ikiwa katika uwezo wako kutenda.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

kikuyu: Usimwambie jirani yako, “Njoo baadaye, nitakupa kesho”: wakati wewe unacho kitu kile karibu nawe.
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

kikuyu: Usifanye hila ya kumdhuru jirani yako, ambaye anaishi karibu na wewe akikuamini.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

kikuyu: Usimshtaki mtu bila sababu, wakati hajakutenda dhara lolote.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

kikuyu: Usimwonee wivu mtu mwenye jeuri wala kuchagua njia yake iwayo yote,
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa Bwana humchukia mtu mpotovu, lakini siri yake iko kwa mwenye haki.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

kikuyu: Laana ya Bwana i juu ya nyumba ya mwovu, lakini yeye huibariki nyumba ya mwenye haki.
english: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Huwadhihaki wale wanaodhihaki, lakini huwapa neema wale wanyenyekevu.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

kikuyu: Wenye hekima hurithi heshima, bali huwaaibisha wapumbavu.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

kikuyu: Sikilizeni wanangu, mafundisho ya baba yenu; sikilizeni kwa makini na mpate ufahamu.
english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

kikuyu: Ninawapa mafundisho ya maana, kwa hiyo msiyaache mafundisho yangu.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

kikuyu: Nilipokuwa mvulana mdogo katika nyumba ya baba yangu, ningali mchanga na mtoto pekee kwa mama yangu,
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

kikuyu: baba alinifundisha akisema, “Yashike maneno yangu yote kwa moyo wako wote; yashike maagizo yangu na wewe utaishi.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

kikuyu: Pata hekima, pata ufahamu; usiyasahau maneno yangu wala usiyaache.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Usimwache hekima naye atakuweka salama; mpende, naye atakulinda.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

kikuyu: Hekima ni bora kuliko vitu vyote; kwa hiyo jipe hekima. Hata ikikugharimu vyote ulivyo navyo, pata ufahamu.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

kikuyu: Mstahi, naye atakukweza; mkumbatie, naye atakuheshimu.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

kikuyu: Atakuvika shada la neema kichwani mwako na kukupa taji ya utukufu.”
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

kikuyu: Sikiliza mwanangu, kubali ninachokuambia, nayo miaka ya maisha yako itakuwa mingi.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

kikuyu: Ninakuongoza katika njia ya hekima na kukuongoza katika mapito yaliyonyooka.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

kikuyu: Utembeapo, hatua zako hazitazuiliwa; ukimbiapo, hutajikwaa.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

kikuyu: Mkamate sana elimu, usimwache aende zake; mshike, maana yeye ni uzima wako.
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

kikuyu: Usiuweke mguu wako katika njia ya waovu wala usitembee katika njia ya watu wabaya.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

kikuyu: Epukana nayo, usisafiri katika njia hiyo; achana nayo, na uelekee njia yako.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hawawezi kulala mpaka watende uovu; wanashindwa hata kusinzia mpaka wamwangushe mtu.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

kikuyu: Wanakula mkate wa uovu, na kunywa mvinyo wa jeuri.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

kikuyu: Njia ya wenye haki ni kama nuru ya kwanza ya mapambazuko, ambayo hungʼaa zaidi na zaidi mpaka mchana mkamilifu.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

kikuyu: Lakini njia ya waovu ni kama giza nene; hawajui kinachowafanya wajikwae.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, yasikilize kwa makini yale ninayokuambia; sikiliza kwa makini maneno yangu.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

kikuyu: Usiruhusu yaondoke machoni pako, yahifadhi ndani ya moyo wako;
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

kikuyu: kwa sababu ni uzima kwa wale wanaoyapata na afya kwa mwili wote wa mwanadamu.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya yote, linda moyo wako, kuliko yote uyalindayo, maana ndiko zitokako chemchemi za uzima.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

kikuyu: Epusha kinywa chako na ukaidi; weka mazungumzo machafu mbali na midomo yako.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

kikuyu: Macho yako na yatazame mbele, kaza macho yako moja kwa moja mbele yako.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

kikuyu: Sawazisha mapito ya miguu yako na njia zako zote ziwe zimethibitika.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

kikuyu: Usigeuke kulia wala kushoto; epusha mguu wako na ubaya.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, sikiliza kwa makini hekima yangu, sikiliza vizuri maneno yangu ya busara,
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

kikuyu: ili uweze kutunza busara na midomo yako ihifadhi maarifa.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

kikuyu: Kwa maana midomo ya mwanamke kahaba hudondoza asali, na maneno ya kinywa chake ni laini kuliko mafuta;
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

kikuyu: lakini mwisho wake ni mchungu kama nyongo, mkali kama upanga ukatao kuwili.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

kikuyu: Miguu yake hushuka kuelekea kwenye kifo; hatua zake huelekea moja kwa moja kaburini.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

kikuyu: Yeye hafikiri juu ya njia ya uzima; njia zake zimepotoka, lakini yeye hajui.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

kikuyu: Sasa basi wanangu, nisikilizeni; msiache ninalowaambia.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Njia zenu ziwe mbali naye, msiende karibu na mlango wa nyumba yake,
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

kikuyu: usije ukatoa nguvu zako nzuri kwa wengine na miaka yako kwa aliye mkatili,
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

kikuyu: wageni wasije wakasherehekea utajiri wako na jitihada yako ikatajirisha nyumba ya mwanaume mwingine.
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

kikuyu: Mwishoni mwa maisha yako utalia kwa uchungu, wakati nyama na mwili wako vimechakaa.
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

kikuyu: Utasema, “Tazama jinsi gani nilivyochukia adhabu! Tazama jinsi moyo wangu ulivyodharau maonyo!
english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

kikuyu: Sikuwatii walimu wangu wala kuwasikiliza wakufunzi wangu.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

kikuyu: Nimefika ukingoni mwa maangamizi kabisa katikati ya kusanyiko lote.”
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

kikuyu: Kunywa maji kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe, maji yanayotiririka kutoka kwenye kisima chako mwenyewe.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

kikuyu: Je, chemchemi zako zifurike katika barabara za mji na vijito vyako vya maji viwanjani?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

kikuyu: Na viwe vyako mwenyewe, kamwe visishirikishwe wageni.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

kikuyu: Chemchemi yako na ibarikiwe na umfurahie mke wa ujana wako.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

kikuyu: Kulungu jike apendaye, kulungu mzuri: matiti yake na yakutosheleze siku zote, nawe utekwe daima na upendo wake.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

kikuyu: Kwa nini mwanangu, utekwe na mwanamke kahaba? Kwa nini ukumbatie kifua cha mke wa mwanaume mwingine?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

kikuyu: Kwa maana njia za mtu ni wazi kabisa mbele za Bwana, naye huyapima mapito yake yote.
english: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

kikuyu: Matendo mabaya ya mtu mwovu humnasa yeye mwenyewe; kamba za dhambi yake humkamata kwa nguvu.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

kikuyu: Atakufa kwa kukosa nidhamu, akipotoshwa kwa upumbavu wake mwenyewe.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, kama umekuwa mdhamini wa jirani yako, ikiwa umeshika mikono kwa kuweka ahadi kwa ajili ya mwingine,
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

kikuyu: kama umetegwa na ulichosema, umenaswa kwa maneno ya kinywa chako,
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: basi fanya hivi mwanangu, ili ujiweke huru, kwa kuwa umeanguka mikononi mwa jirani yako: Nenda ukajinyenyekeshe kwake; msihi jirani yako!
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

kikuyu: Usiruhusu usingizi machoni pako, usiruhusu kope zako zisinzie.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

kikuyu: Jiweke huru, kama swala mkononi mwa mwindaji, kama ndege kutoka kwenye mtego wa mwindaji.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

kikuyu: Ewe mvivu, mwendee mchwa; zitafakari njia zake ukapate hekima!
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeye hana msimamizi, wala mwangalizi, au mtawala,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

kikuyu: lakini hujiwekea akiba wakati wa kiangazi na hukusanya chakula chake wakati wa mavuno.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

kikuyu: Ewe mvivu, utalala hata lini? Utaamka lini kutoka usingizi wako?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

kikuyu: Bado kulala kidogo, kusinzia kidogo, bado kukunja mikono kidogo upate kupumzika:
english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

kikuyu: hivyo umaskini utakuja juu yako kama mnyangʼanyi, na kupungukiwa kutakujia kama mtu mwenye silaha.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

kikuyu: Mtu mbaya sana na mlaghai, ambaye huzungukazunguka na maneno ya upotovu,
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

kikuyu: ambaye anakonyeza kwa jicho lake, anayetoa ishara kwa miguu yake na kuashiria kwa vidole vyake,
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

kikuyu: ambaye hupanga ubaya kwa udanganyifu moyoni mwake: daima huchochea fitina.
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo maafa yatamkumba ghafula; ataangamizwa mara, pasipo msaada.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

kikuyu: Kuna vitu sita anavyovichukia Bwana, naam, viko saba vilivyo chukizo kwake:
english: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kikuyu: macho ya kiburi, ulimi udanganyao, mikono imwagayo damu isiyo na hatia,
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

kikuyu: moyo uwazao mipango miovu, miguu iliyo myepesi kukimbilia uovu,
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

kikuyu: shahidi wa uongo ambaye humwaga uongo, na mtu ambaye huchochea fitina kati ya ndugu.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, zishike amri za baba yako, wala usiyaache mafundisho ya mama yako.
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

kikuyu: Yafunge katika moyo wako daima, yakaze kuizunguka shingo yako.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

kikuyu: Wakati utembeapo, yatakuongoza; wakati ulalapo, yatakulinda; wakati uamkapo, yatazungumza nawe.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

kikuyu: Kwa maana amri hizi ni taa, mafundisho haya ni mwanga na maonyo ya maadili ni njia ya uzima,
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

kikuyu: yakikulinda na mwanamke aliyepotoka, kutokana na maneno laini ya mwanamke aliyepotoka.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

kikuyu: Moyo wako usitamani uzuri wake wala macho yake yasikuteke,
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

kikuyu: kwa maana kahaba atakufanya uwe maskini, hata ukose kipande cha mkate, naye mwanamke mzinzi huwinda maisha yako hasa.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

kikuyu: Je, mtu aweza kuchotea moto kwenye paja lake bila nguo zake kuungua?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

kikuyu: Je, mtu aweza kutembea juu ya makaa ya moto yanayowaka bila miguu yake kuungua?
english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

kikuyu: Ndivyo alivyo mtu alalaye na mke wa mwanaume mwingine; hakuna yeyote amgusaye huyo mwanamke ambaye hataadhibiwa.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Watu hawamdharau mwizi kama akiiba kukidhi njaa yake wakati ana njaa.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

kikuyu: Pamoja na hayo, kama akikamatwa, lazima alipe mara saba, ingawa inamgharimu utajiri wote wa nyumba yake.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

kikuyu: Lakini mwanaume aziniye na mwanamke hana akili kabisa; yeyote afanyaye hivyo hujiangamiza mwenyewe.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

kikuyu: Mapigo na aibu ni fungu lake na aibu yake haitafutika kamwe;
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

kikuyu: kwa maana wivu huamsha ghadhabu ya mume, naye hataonyesha huruma alipizapo kisasi.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

kikuyu: Hatakubali fidia yoyote; atakataa malipo, hata yakiwa makubwa kiasi gani.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, shika maneno yangu na kuzihifadhi amri zangu ndani yako.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

kikuyu: Shika amri zangu nawe utaishi; linda mafundisho yangu kama mboni ya jicho lako.
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

kikuyu: Yafunge katika vidole vyako; yaandike katika kibao cha moyo wako.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Mwambie hekima, “Wewe ni dada yangu,” uite ufahamu jamaa yako;
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

kikuyu: watakuepusha na mwanamke mzinzi, kutokana na mwanamke mpotovu na maneno yake ya kubembeleza.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

kikuyu: Kwenye dirisha la nyumba yangu nilitazama nje kupitia upenyo kwenye mwimo wa dirisha.
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

kikuyu: Niliona miongoni mwa wajinga, nikagundua miongoni mwa wanaume vijana, kijana asiye na akili.
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

kikuyu: Alikuwa akishuka njiani karibu na pembe ya kwake, akielekea kwenye nyumba ya huyo mwanamke
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

kikuyu: wakati wa machweo, jua likipungua nuru yake, giza la usiku lilipokuwa likiingia.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

kikuyu: Ndipo huyo mwanamke akatoka kumlaki, hali amevaa kama kahaba akiwa na nia ya udanganyifu.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

kikuyu: (Ni mwanamke mwenye makelele na mkaidi, miguu yake haitulii nyumbani;
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

kikuyu: mara kwenye barabara za mji, mara kwenye viwanja vikubwa, kwenye kila pembe huvizia.)
english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

kikuyu: Huyo mwanamke alimkumbatia kijana na kumbusu, na kwa uso usio na haya akamwambia:
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

kikuyu: “Nina sadaka za amani nyumbani; leo nimetimiza nadhiri zangu.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nimetoka nje kukulaki; nimekutafuta na nimekupata!
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

kikuyu: Nimetandika kitanda changu kwa kitani za rangi kutoka Misri.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

kikuyu: Nimetia manukato kitanda changu kwa manemane, udi na mdalasini.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

kikuyu: Njoo, tuzame katika mapenzi mpaka asubuhi; tujifurahishe wenyewe kwa mapenzi!
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

kikuyu: Mume wangu hayupo nyumbani; amekwenda safari ya mbali.
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

kikuyu: Amechukua mkoba uliojazwa fedha na hatakuwepo nyumbani karibuni.”
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

kikuyu: Kwa maneno laini yule mwanamke akampotosha; alimshawishi kwa maneno yake laini.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

kikuyu: Mara huyo kijana alimfuata yule mwanamke kama fahali aendaye machinjoni, kama kulungu aingiaye kwenye kitanzi,
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

kikuyu: mpaka mshale umchome ini lake, kama ndege anayenaswa kwenye mtego, bila kujua itamgharimu maisha yake.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

kikuyu: Sasa basi wanangu, nisikilizeni; sikilizeni kwa makini nisemalo.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Usiruhusu moyo wako ugeukie njia za huyo mwanamke, wala usitangetange katika mapito yake.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

kikuyu: Aliowaangusha ni wengi; aliowachinja ni kundi kubwa.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

kikuyu: Nyumba yake ni njia kuu iendayo kaburini, ielekeayo chini kwenye vyumba vya mauti.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

kikuyu: Je, hekima haitani? Je, ufahamu hapazi sauti?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

kikuyu: Juu ya miinuko karibu na njia, penye njia panda, ndipo asimamapo;
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

kikuyu: kando ya malango yaelekeayo mjini, kwenye maingilio, hulia kwa sauti kubwa, akisema:
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

kikuyu: “Ni ninyi wanaume, ninaowaita; ninapaza sauti yangu kwa wanadamu wote.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

kikuyu: Ninyi ambao ni wajinga, pateni akili; ninyi mlio wapumbavu, pateni ufahamu.
english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

kikuyu: Sikilizeni, kwa maana nina mambo muhimu ya kusema; ninafungua midomo yangu kusema lililo sawa.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

kikuyu: Kinywa changu husema lililo kweli, kwa maana midomo yangu huchukia uovu.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

kikuyu: Maneno yote ya kinywa changu ni haki; hakuna mojawapo lililopotoka wala ukaidi.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

kikuyu: Kwa wenye kupambanua yote ni sahihi; hayana kasoro kwa wale wenye maarifa.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

kikuyu: Chagua mafundisho yangu badala ya fedha, maarifa badala ya dhahabu safi,
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

kikuyu: kwa maana hekima ina thamani kuliko marijani na hakuna chochote unachohitaji kinacholingana naye.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

kikuyu: “Mimi hekima, nakaa pamoja na busara; ninamiliki maarifa na busara.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana ni kuchukia uovu; ninachukia kiburi na majivuno, tabia mbaya na mazungumzo potovu.
english: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

kikuyu: Ushauri na hukumu sahihi ni vyangu; nina ufahamu na nina nguvu.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

kikuyu: Kwa msaada wangu wafalme hutawala na watawala hutunga sheria zilizo za haki,
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

kikuyu: kwa msaada wangu wakuu hutawala, na wenye vyeo wote watawalao dunia.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

kikuyu: Nawapenda wale wanipendao, na wale wanitafutao kwa bidii wataniona.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

kikuyu: Utajiri na heshima viko kwangu, utajiri udumuo na mafanikio.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

kikuyu: Tunda langu ni bora kuliko dhahabu safi; kile nitoacho hupita fedha iliyo bora.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

kikuyu: Natembea katika njia ya unyofu katika mapito ya haki,
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

kikuyu: nawapa utajiri wale wanipendao na kuzijaza hazina zao.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

kikuyu: “Bwana aliniumba mwanzoni mwa kazi yake, kabla ya matendo yake ya zamani;
english: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

kikuyu: niliteuliwa tangu milele, tangu mwanzoni, kabla ya dunia kuumbwa.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

kikuyu: Wakati hazijakuwepo bahari, nilikwishazaliwa, wakati hazijakuwepo chemchemi zilizojaa maji;
