english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

kikuyu: kabla milima haijawekwa mahali pake, kabla vilima havijakuwepo, nilikwishazaliwa,
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

kikuyu: kabla hajaumba dunia wala mashamba yake au vumbi lolote la dunia.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

kikuyu: Nilikuwepo alipoziweka mbingu mahali pake, wakati alichora mstari wa upeo wa macho juu ya uso wa kilindi,
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

kikuyu: wakati aliweka mawingu juu na kuziweka imara chemchemi za bahari,
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

kikuyu: wakati aliiwekea bahari mpaka wake ili maji yasivunje agizo lake, na wakati aliweka misingi ya dunia.
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

kikuyu: Wakati huo nilikuwa fundi stadi kando yake. Nilijazwa na furaha siku baada ya siku, nikifurahi daima mbele zake,
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

kikuyu: nikifurahi katika dunia yake yote nami nikiwafurahia wanadamu.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

kikuyu: “Basi sasa wanangu, nisikilizeni; heri wale wanaozishika njia zangu.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

kikuyu: Sikilizeni mafundisho yangu mwe na hekima; msiyapuuze.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

kikuyu: Heri mtu yule anisikilizaye mimi, akisubiri siku zote malangoni mwangu, akingoja kwenye vizingiti vya mlango wangu.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeyote anipataye mimi amepata uzima na kujipatia kibali kutoka kwa Bwana.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

kikuyu: Lakini yeyote ashindwaye kunipata hujiumiza mwenyewe; na wote wanichukiao mimi hupenda mauti.”
english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

kikuyu: Hekima amejenga nyumba yake; amechonga nguzo zake saba.
english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

kikuyu: Ameandaa nyama na kuchanganya divai yake; pia ameandaa meza yake.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

kikuyu: Amewatuma watumishi wake wa kike, naye huita kutoka mahali pa juu sana pa mji.
english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

kikuyu: Anawaambia wale wasio na akili, “Wote ambao ni wajinga na waje hapa!
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Njooni, mle chakula changu na mnywe divai niliyoichanganya.
english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

kikuyu: Acheni njia zenu za ujinga nanyi mtaishi; tembeeni katika njia ya ufahamu.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

kikuyu: “Yeyote anayemkosoa mwenye mzaha hukaribisha matukano; yeyote anayekemea mtu mwovu hupatwa na matusi.
english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

kikuyu: Usimkemee mwenye mzaha la sivyo atakuchukia; mkemee mwenye hekima naye atakupenda.
english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

kikuyu: Mfundishe mtu mwenye hekima naye atakuwa na hekima zaidi; mfundishe mtu mwadilifu naye atazidi kufundishika.
english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

kikuyu: “Kumcha Bwana ndicho chanzo cha hekima, na kumjua Aliye Mtakatifu ni ufahamu.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwa msaada wangu siku zako zitakuwa nyingi, na miaka itaongezwa katika maisha yako.
english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

kikuyu: Kama wewe una hekima, hekima yako itakupa tuzo; kama wewe ni mtu wa mzaha, wewe mwenyewe ndiwe utateseka.”
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

kikuyu: Mwanamke aitwaye Mpumbavu ana kelele; hana adabu na hana maarifa.
english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

kikuyu: Huketi kwenye mlango wa nyumba yake, juu ya kiti katika mahali pa juu sana pa mji,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

kikuyu: akiita wale wapitao karibu, waendao moja kwa moja kwenye njia yao.
english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

kikuyu: Anawaambia wale wasio na akili, “Wote ambao ni wajinga na waje hapa ndani!”
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: “Maji yaliyoibiwa ni matamu; chakula kinacholiwa sirini ni kitamu!”
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

kikuyu: Lakini hawajui hata kidogo kuwa wafu wako humo, kwamba wageni wake huyo mwanamke wako katika vilindi vya kuzimu.
english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

kikuyu: Mithali za Solomoni: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, lakini mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa mama yake.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

kikuyu: Hazina zilizopatikana kwa njia mbaya hazifai, lakini uadilifu huokoa kutoka mautini.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Bwana hawaachi waadilifu kukaa njaa, lakini hupinga tamaa ya mtu mwovu.
english: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

kikuyu: Mikono mivivu hufanya mtu kuwa maskini lakini mikono yenye bidii huleta utajiri.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

kikuyu: Yeye akusanyaye mazao wakati wa kiangazi ni mwana mwenye hekima, lakini yeye alalaye wakati wa mavuno ni mwana mwenye kuaibisha.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

kikuyu: Baraka huwa taji kichwani mwa mwenye haki, lakini jeuri hufunika kinywa cha mwovu.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Kumbukumbu ya mwenye haki itakuwa baraka, lakini jina la mwovu litaoza.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

kikuyu: Mwenye hekima moyoni hupokea maagizo, lakini mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Mtu mwadilifu hutembea salama, lakini mtu aendaye katika njia zilizopotoka atagunduliwa.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

kikuyu: Yeye akonyezaye kwa nia mbaya husababisha huzuni, naye mpumbavu apayukaye huangamia.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Kinywa cha mwenye haki ni chemchemi ya uzima, lakini jeuri hufunika kinywa cha mwovu.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Chuki huchochea faraka, lakini upendo husitiri mabaya yote.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

kikuyu: Hekima hupatikana katika midomo ya wenye kupambanua, lakini fimbo ni kwa ajili ya mgongo wake asiye na ufahamu.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Wenye hekima huhifadhi maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hualika maangamizi.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

kikuyu: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, bali ufukara ni maangamizi ya maskini.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

kikuyu: Ujira wa wenye haki huwaletea uzima, lakini mapato ya waovu huwaletea adhabu.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

kikuyu: Anayekubali kuadibishwa yuko katika njia ya uzima, lakini yeyote anayepuuza maonyo hupotosha wengine.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

kikuyu: Yeye afichaye chuki yake ana midomo ya uongo, na yeyote anayeeneza uchonganishi ni mpumbavu.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

kikuyu: Wakati maneno ni mengi, dhambi haikosekani, lakini yeye ambaye huzuia ulimi wake ni mwenye busara.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

kikuyu: Ulimi wa mwenye haki ni fedha iliyo bora, bali moyo wa mwovu una thamani ndogo.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

kikuyu: Midomo ya mwenye haki hulisha wengi, lakini wapumbavu hufa kwa kukosa ufahamu.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

kikuyu: Baraka ya Bwana hutajirisha, wala haichanganyi huzuni.
english: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu hufurahia tabia mbaya, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu hupendezwa na hekima.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

kikuyu: Kile anachoogopa mwovu ndicho kitakachompata; kile anachoonea shauku mwenye haki atapewa.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

kikuyu: Tufani inapopita, waovu hutoweka, lakini wenye haki husimama imara milele.
english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

kikuyu: Kama siki ilivyo kwa meno na moshi kwa macho, ndivyo alivyo mvivu kwa wale waliomtuma.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana huongeza urefu wa maisha, lakini miaka ya mwovu inafupishwa.
english: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

kikuyu: Tarajio la mwenye haki ni furaha, bali matumaini ya mwovu huwa si kitu.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Njia ya Bwana ni kimbilio kwa wenye haki, lakini ni maangamizi ya wale watendao mabaya.
english: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Kamwe wenye haki hawataondolewa, bali waovu hawatasalia katika nchi.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

kikuyu: Kinywa cha mwenye haki hutoa hekima, bali ulimi wa upotovu utakatwa.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

kikuyu: Midomo ya wenye haki inajua kile kinachofaa, bali kinywa cha mwovu hujua kile kilichopotoka tu.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

kikuyu: Bwana huchukia sana mizani za udanganyifu, bali vipimo sahihi ni furaha yake.
english: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

kikuyu: Kiburi kinapokuja, ndipo huja aibu, bali unyenyekevu huja na hekima.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

kikuyu: Uadilifu wa wenye haki huwaongoza, bali wasio waaminifu huharibiwa na hila yao.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

kikuyu: Utajiri haufaidi kitu katika siku ya ghadhabu, bali haki huokoa kutoka mautini.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Haki ya wasio na lawama, huwatengenezea njia iliyonyooka, bali waovu huangushwa kwa uovu wao wenyewe.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

kikuyu: Haki ya wanyofu huwaokoa, bali wasio waaminifu hunaswa na tamaa mbaya.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

kikuyu: Wakati mtu mwovu anapokufa, matumaini yake hutoweka; yote aliyoyatazamia kutokana na nguvu zake huwa si kitu.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye haki huokolewa kutoka taabu, naye mtu mwovu huingia humo badala yake.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

kikuyu: Kwa kinywa chake mtu asiyemwamini Mungu humwangamiza jirani yake, bali kwa maarifa mwenye haki huokolewa.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

kikuyu: Wakati mwenye haki anapofanikiwa, mji hufurahi; mwovu atowekapo, kuna kelele za furaha.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

kikuyu: Kutokana na baraka ya mtu mnyofu mji hukwezwa, bali kwa kinywa cha mwovu mji huharibiwa.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Mtu asiye na akili humdharau jirani yake, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu huuzuia ulimi wake.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

kikuyu: Masengenyo husaliti tumaini, bali mtu mwaminifu hutunza siri.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

kikuyu: Pasipo ushauri wa hekima taifa huanguka, bali washauri wengi hufanya ushindi uwe wa hakika.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

kikuyu: Yeye amdhaminiye mgeni hakika atateseka, bali yeyote akataaye kuunga mkono dhamana ni salama.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

kikuyu: Mwanamke mwenye moyo wa huruma hupata heshima, bali wanaume wakorofi hupata mali tu.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

kikuyu: Mwenye huruma hujinufaisha mwenyewe, bali mkatili hujiletea taabu mwenyewe.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu hupata ujira wa udanganyifu, bali yeye apandaye haki huvuna tuzo ya uhakika.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye haki kweli kweli hupata uzima, bali yeye afuatiliaye ubaya huendea kifo chake.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

kikuyu: Bwana huwachukia sana watu wenye moyo wa upotovu, bali hupendezwa na wale ambao njia zao hazina lawama.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

kikuyu: Uwe na hakika na hili: Waovu hawataepuka kuadhibiwa, bali wenye haki watakuwa huru.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

kikuyu: Kama pete ya dhahabu katika pua ya nguruwe ndivyo alivyo mwanamke mzuri ambaye hana busara.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

kikuyu: Shauku ya mwenye haki huishia tu kwenye mema, bali tumaini la mwovu huishia tu kwenye ghadhabu.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

kikuyu: Kuna mtu atoaye kwa ukarimu, hata hivyo hupata zaidi, mwingine huzuia, lakini huwa maskini.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

kikuyu: Mtu mkarimu atastawi; yeye awaburudishaye wengine ataburudishwa mwenyewe.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

kikuyu: Watu humlaani mtu awanyimae watu nafaka, bali baraka itamkalia kichwani kama taji yeye aliye radhi kuiuza.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

kikuyu: Yeye atafutaye mema hupata ukarimu, bali ubaya huja kwake yeye autafutaye.
english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

kikuyu: Yeyote ategemeaye utajiri wake ataanguka, bali mwenye haki atastawi kama jani bichi.
english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

kikuyu: Yeye aletaye taabu kwa jamaa yake atarithi tu upepo, naye mpumbavu atakuwa mtumishi wa wenye hekima.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

kikuyu: Tunda la mwenye haki ni mti wa uzima, naye mwenye hekima huvuta roho za watu.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

kikuyu: Kama wenye haki watapokea ujira wao duniani, si zaidi sana yule asiyemcha Mungu na mwenye dhambi?
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

kikuyu: Yeyote apendaye kuadibishwa hupenda maarifa, bali yeye achukiaye kuonywa ni mpumbavu.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

kikuyu: Mtu mwema hupata kibali kutoka kwa Bwana, bali Bwana humhukumu mwenye hila.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

kikuyu: Mtu hathibitiki kutokana na uovu, bali mwenye haki hataondolewa.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Mke mwenye tabia nzuri ni taji ya mumewe, bali aaibishaye ni kama uozo katika mifupa ya mumewe.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

kikuyu: Mipango ya mtu mwadilifu ni ya haki, bali ushauri wa mwovu ni udanganyifu.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

kikuyu: Maneno ya waovu huotea kumwaga damu, bali maneno ya waadilifu huwaokoa.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

kikuyu: Watu waovu huondolewa na kutoweka, bali nyumba ya mwenye haki husimama imara.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

kikuyu: Mtu husifiwa kulingana na hekima yake, bali watu wenye akili zilizopotoka hudharauliwa.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

kikuyu: Heri mtu wa hali ya chini mwenye mtumishi, kuliko kujifanya mtu wa hali ya juu nawe huna chakula.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye haki hujali mahitaji ya mnyama wake, bali matendo ya huruma ya mwovu ni ukatili.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

kikuyu: Yeye alimaye shamba lake atakuwa na chakula tele, bali yeye afuataye mambo ya upuzi hana akili.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Waovu hutamani mateka ya watu wabaya, bali shina la mwenye haki hustawi.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu hunaswa kwa mazungumzo yake ya dhambi, bali mwenye haki huepuka taabu.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

kikuyu: Kutokana na tunda la midomo yake mtu hujazwa na mambo mema, hakika kama ilivyo kazi ya mikono yake humtunza.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

kikuyu: Njia ya mpumbavu huonekana sawa machoni pake mwenyewe, bali mtu mwenye hekima husikiliza ushauri.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu huonyesha kuudhika kwake mara moja, bali mtu wa busara hupuuza matukano.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

kikuyu: Shahidi wa kweli hutoa ushuhuda wa kuaminika, bali shahidi wa uongo husema uongo.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

kikuyu: Maneno ya kipumbavu huchoma kama upanga, bali ulimi wa mwenye hekima huleta uponyaji.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

kikuyu: Midomo isemayo kweli hudumu milele, bali ulimi wa uongo hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

kikuyu: Upo udanganyifu katika mioyo ya wale ambao hupanga mabaya, bali kuna furaha kwa wale wanaoleta amani.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

kikuyu: Hakuna dhara linalompata mwenye haki, bali waovu wana taabu nyingi.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

kikuyu: Bwana anachukia sana midomo idanganyayo, bali hufurahia watu ambao ni wa kweli.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye busara hujihifadhia maarifa yeye mwenyewe, bali moyo wa wapumbavu hububujika upumbavu.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

kikuyu: Mikono yenye bidii itatawala, bali uvivu huishia katika kazi za utumwa.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

kikuyu: Moyo wa wasiwasi humlemea mtu, bali neno la huruma humfurahisha.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye haki ni mwangalifu katika urafiki, bali njia ya waovu huwapotosha.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

kikuyu: Mtu mvivu haoki mawindo yake, bali mtu mwenye bidii ana mali za thamani.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

kikuyu: Katika njia ya haki kuna uzima; katika mapito hayo kuna maisha ya milele.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

kikuyu: Mwana mwenye hekima husikia mafundisho ya babaye, bali mwenye dharau hasikilizi maonyo.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

kikuyu: Kutoka tunda la midomo yake mtu hufurahia mambo mema, bali wasio waaminifu wanatamani sana jeuri.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

kikuyu: Yeye alindaye midomo yake hulinda nafsi yake, bali yeye asemaye kwa haraka ataangamia.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

kikuyu: Mvivu hutamani sana na hapati kitu, bali nafsi ya mwenye bidii hutoshelezwa kikamilifu.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

kikuyu: Mwenye haki huchukia uongo, bali waovu huleta aibu na fedheha.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

kikuyu: Haki humlinda mtu mwadilifu, bali uovu humwangusha mwenye dhambi.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja hujifanya tajiri, kumbe hana chochote; mwingine hujifanya maskini, kumbe ana utajiri mwingi.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

kikuyu: Utajiri wa mtu waweza kukomboa maisha yake, bali mtu maskini hasikii kitisho.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

kikuyu: Nuru ya mwenye haki hungʼaa sana, bali taa ya mwovu itazimwa.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

kikuyu: Kiburi huzalisha magomvi tu, bali hekima hupatikana kwa wale wanaozingatia ushauri.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

kikuyu: Fedha isiyo ya halali hupungua, bali yeye akusanyaye fedha kidogo kidogo huongezeka.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

kikuyu: Kilichotarajiwa kikikawia kuja moyo huugua, bali tumaini lililotimizwa ni mti wa uzima.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

kikuyu: Yeye anayedharau mafundisho anajiletea maangamizi, bali yeye anayeheshimu agizo hupewa tuzo.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

kikuyu: Mafundisho ya mwenye busara ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Ufahamu mzuri hupata upendeleo, bali njia ya asiye mwaminifu ni ngumu.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

kikuyu: Kila mwenye busara hutenda kwa maarifa, bali mpumbavu hudhihirisha upumbavu wake.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

kikuyu: Mjumbe mwovu huanguka kwenye taabu, bali mjumbe mwaminifu huleta uponyaji.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

kikuyu: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hupata umaskini na aibu, bali yeye anayekubali maonyo huheshimiwa.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

kikuyu: Tarajio lililotimizwa ni tamu kwa nafsi, bali wapumbavu huchukia sana kuacha ubaya.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

kikuyu: Yeye atembeaye na mwenye hekima atapata hekima, bali rafiki wa mpumbavu hupata madhara.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

kikuyu: Balaa humwandama mtenda dhambi, bali mafanikio ni thawabu kwa mwenye haki.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

kikuyu: Mtu mwema huwaachia wana wa wanawe urithi, bali mali ya wenye dhambi imehifadhiwa kwa ajili ya wenye haki.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

kikuyu: Shamba la mtu maskini laweza kuzalisha chakula kingi, bali dhuluma hukifutilia mbali.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

kikuyu: Yeye aizuiaye fimbo yake hampendi mwanawe, bali yeye ampendaye huwa mwangalifu kumwadibisha.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

kikuyu: Mwenye haki hula mpaka akaridhisha moyo wake, bali tumbo la mwovu hutaabika kwa njaa.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

kikuyu: Mwanamke mwenye hekima huijenga nyumba yake, bali mpumbavu huibomoa nyumba yake kwa mikono yake mwenyewe.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye njia zake ni nyofu humcha Bwana, bali yeye ambaye njia zake zimepotoka humdharau Mungu.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

kikuyu: Mazungumzo ya mpumbavu huleta fimbo mgongoni mwake, bali mwenye hekima hulindwa na maneno ya midomo yake.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

kikuyu: Pale ambapo hakuna mafahali, hori ni tupu, bali kutokana na nguvu za fahali huja mavuno mengi.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

kikuyu: Shahidi mwaminifu hadanganyi, bali shahidi wa uongo humimina uongo.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

kikuyu: Mwenye mzaha huitafuta hekima na haipati, bali maarifa huja kwa urahisi kwa anayepambanua.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

kikuyu: Kaa mbali na mtu mpumbavu, kwa maana hutapata maarifa katika midomo yake.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

kikuyu: Hekima ya mwenye busara ni kufikiria njia zake, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu ni udanganyifu.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

kikuyu: Wapumbavu hudhihaki kujirekebisha kutoka dhambi, bali wema hupatikana miongoni mwa wanyofu.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

kikuyu: Kila moyo hujua uchungu wake wenyewe, wala hakuna yeyote awezaye kushiriki furaha yake.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

kikuyu: Nyumba ya mwovu itaangamizwa, bali hema la mnyofu litastawi.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

kikuyu: Iko njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa kwa mtu, bali mwisho wake huelekeza mautini.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Hata katika kicheko moyo waweza kuuma, nayo furaha yaweza kuishia katika majonzi.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

kikuyu: Wasio na imani watapatilizwa kikamilifu kwa ajili ya njia zao, naye mtu mwema atapewa thawabu kwa ajili ya njia yake.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

kikuyu: Mtu mjinga huamini kila kitu, bali mwenye busara hufikiria hatua zake.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye hekima humcha Bwana na kuepuka mabaya, bali mpumbavu hukasirika kwa hamaki na uzembe.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

kikuyu: Mtu anayekasirika kwa haraka hufanya mambo ya upumbavu, naye mtu wa hila huchukiwa.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

kikuyu: Mjinga hurithi upumbavu, bali wenye busara huvikwa maarifa kichwani kama taji.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

kikuyu: Watu wabaya watasujudu mbele ya watu wema, nao waovu kwenye malango ya wenye haki.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

kikuyu: Maskini huepukwa hata na majirani zao, bali matajiri wana marafiki wengi.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

kikuyu: Yeye anayemdharau jirani yake hutenda dhambi, bali amebarikiwa yeye aliye na huruma kwa mhitaji.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

kikuyu: Je, wale wanaopanga ubaya hawapotoki? Bali wale wanaopanga kilicho chema hupata upendo na uaminifu.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

kikuyu: Kazi zote zinazofanywa kwa bidii huleta faida, bali mazungumzo matupu huelekea umaskini tu.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

kikuyu: Utajiri wa wenye hekima ni taji yao, bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu huzaa upumbavu.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

kikuyu: Shahidi wa kweli huokoa maisha, bali shahidi wa uongo ni mdanganyifu.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

kikuyu: Yeye amchaye Bwana ana ngome salama, na kwa watoto wake itakuwa kimbilio.
english: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana ni chemchemi ya uzima, ili kumwepusha mtu na mitego ya mauti.
english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Wingi wa watu ni utukufu wa mfalme, bali pasipo watu mkuu huangamia.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye subira ana ufahamu mwingi, bali anayekasirika haraka huonyesha upumbavu.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

kikuyu: Moyo wenye amani huupa mwili uzima, bali wivu huozesha mifupa.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

kikuyu: Yeye amwoneaye maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wao, bali yeyote anayemhurumia mhitaji humheshimu Mungu.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

kikuyu: Waovu huangamizwa kwa matendo yao maovu, bali hata katika kifo wenye haki hupata kimbilio.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

kikuyu: Hekima hukaa katika moyo wa mwenye ufahamu bali haijulikani miongoni mwa wapumbavu.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

kikuyu: Haki huinua taifa, bali dhambi ni aibu kwa watu wote.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

kikuyu: Mfalme hupendezwa na mtumishi mwenye hekima, bali ghadhabu yake humwangukia mtumishi mwenye kuaibisha.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

kikuyu: Jawabu la upole hugeuza ghadhabu, bali neno liumizalo huchochea hasira.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

kikuyu: Ulimi wa mwenye hekima husifu maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hufoka upumbavu.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

kikuyu: Macho ya Bwana yako kila mahali, yakiwaangalia waovu na wema.
english: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

kikuyu: Ulimi uletao uponyaji ni mti wa uzima, bali ulimi udanganyao huponda roho.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu hubeza maonyo ya baba yake, bali yeyote akubaliye maonyo huonyesha busara.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

kikuyu: Nyumba ya mwenye haki ina hazina kubwa, bali mapato ya waovu huwaletea taabu.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

kikuyu: Midomo ya mwenye hekima hueneza maarifa, bali sivyo ilivyo mioyo ya wapumbavu.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

kikuyu: Bwana huchukia sana dhabihu za waovu, bali maombi ya wanyofu humfurahisha Mungu.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

kikuyu: Bwana huchukia sana njia ya waovu, bali huwapenda wale wafuatao haki.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

kikuyu: Adhabu kali humngoja yeye aachaye njia; yeye achukiaye maonyo atakufa.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

kikuyu: Mauti na Uharibifu viko wazi mbele za Bwana: je, si zaidi sana mioyo ya wanadamu!
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

kikuyu: Mwenye mzaha huchukia maonyo; hatataka shauri kwa mwenye hekima.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

kikuyu: Moyo wenye furaha hufanya uso uchangamke, bali maumivu ya moyoni huponda roho.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

kikuyu: Moyo wa mwenye ufahamu hutafuta maarifa, bali kinywa cha mpumbavu hujilisha upumbavu.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

kikuyu: Siku zote za wanaoonewa ni za taabu, bali moyo mchangamfu una karamu ya kudumu.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

kikuyu: Afadhali kuwa na kidogo pamoja na kumcha Bwana, kuliko mali nyingi pamoja na ghasia.
english: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

kikuyu: Afadhali chakula cha mboga mahali palipo na upendo kuliko nyama ya ndama iliyonona pamoja na chuki.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

kikuyu: Mtu mwepesi wa hasira huchochea ugomvi, bali mtu mvumilivu hutuliza ugomvi.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

kikuyu: Njia ya mvivu imezibwa na miiba, bali njia ya mwenye haki ni barabara kuu.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

kikuyu: Mwana mwenye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali mtu mpumbavu humdharau mama yake.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

kikuyu: Upumbavu humfurahisha mtu ambaye hana akili, bali mtu mwenye ufahamu hushika njia iliyonyooka.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

kikuyu: Mipango hushindwa kufanikiwa kwa ajili ya kukosa ushauri, bali kukiwa na washauri wengi hufanikiwa.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

kikuyu: Mtu hupata furaha katika kutoa jibu linalofaa: je, ni zuri namna gani neno lililotoka kwa wakati wake!
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

kikuyu: Mapito ya uzima huelekea juu kwa ajili ya wenye hekima kumwepusha asiende chini kaburini.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

kikuyu: Bwana hubomoa nyumba ya mtu mwenye kiburi, bali huilinda mipaka ya mjane isiguswe.
english: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

kikuyu: Bwana huchukia sana mawazo ya mwovu, bali mawazo ya wale walio safi humfurahisha yeye.
english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye tamaa huletea jamaa yake taabu, bali yeye achukiaye rushwa ataishi.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

kikuyu: Moyo wa mwenye haki hupima majibu yake, bali kinywa cha mwovu hufoka ubaya.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

kikuyu: Bwana yuko mbali na waovu, bali husikia maombi ya wenye haki.
english: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

kikuyu: Mtazamo wa tabasamu huleta furaha moyoni, nazo habari njema huipa mifupa afya.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

kikuyu: Yeye asikilizaye maonyo yatoayo uzima atakuwa miongoni mwa wenye hekima.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

kikuyu: Yeye anayedharau maonyo hujidharau mwenyewe, bali yeyote anayekubali maonyo hupata ufahamu.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana humfundisha mtu hekima, nao unyenyekevu huja kabla ya heshima.
english: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

kikuyu: Mipango ya moyoni ni ya mwanadamu, bali jibu la ulimi hutoka kwa Bwana.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Njia zote za mtu huonekana safi machoni pake mwenyewe, bali makusudi hupimwa na Bwana.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

kikuyu: Mkabidhi Bwana lolote ufanyalo, nayo mipango yako itafanikiwa.
english: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

kikuyu: Bwana hufanya kila kitu kwa kusudi lake mwenyewe; hata waovu kwa siku ya maangamizi.
english: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

kikuyu: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wenye kiburi cha moyo. Uwe na hakika kwa hili: Hawataepuka kuadhibiwa.
english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Kwa upendo na uaminifu uovu huondolewa; kwa kumcha Bwana mtu hujiepusha na ubaya.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

kikuyu: Njia za mtu zinapompendeza Bwana, huwafanya hata adui zake waishi naye kwa amani.
english: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

kikuyu: Afadhali kitu kidogo pamoja na haki kuliko mapato mengi pamoja na udhalimu.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

kikuyu: Moyo wa mtu huifikiri njia yake, bali Bwana huelekeza hatua zake.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

kikuyu: Midomo ya mfalme huzungumza kwa hekima ya kiungu, wala kinywa chake hakipotoshi haki.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

kikuyu: Vipimo na mizani za halali hutoka kwa Bwana; mawe yote ya kupimia yaliyo katika mfuko ameyafanya yeye.
english: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

kikuyu: Wafalme huchukia sana kutenda maovu, kwa maana kiti cha ufalme hufanywa imara kwa njia ya haki.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

kikuyu: Wafalme hufurahia midomo ya uaminifu; humthamini mtu asemaye kweli.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

kikuyu: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni mjumbe wa mauti, bali mtu mwenye hekima ataituliza.
english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

kikuyu: Uso wa mfalme ungʼaapo, inamaanisha uhai; upendeleo wake ni kama wingu la mvua wakati wa vuli.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

kikuyu: Ni bora kiasi gani kupata hekima kuliko dhahabu, kuchagua ufahamu kuliko fedha!
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

kikuyu: Njia kuu ya wanyofu huepuka ubaya; yeye aichungaye njia yake, huchunga maisha yake.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

kikuyu: Kiburi hutangulia maangamizi, roho ya majivuno hutangulia maanguko.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali kuwa mnyenyekevu katika roho miongoni mwa walioonewa kuliko kugawana nyara pamoja na wenye kiburi.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

kikuyu: Yeyote anayekubali mafundisho hustawi, tena amebarikiwa yeye anayemtumaini Bwana.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Wenye hekima moyoni huitwa wenye ufahamu, na maneno ya kupendeza huchochea mafundisho.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

kikuyu: Ufahamu ni chemchemi ya uzima kwa wale walio nao, bali upumbavu huleta adhabu kwa wapumbavu.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

kikuyu: Moyo wa mtu mwenye hekima huongoza kinywa chake, na midomo yake huchochea mafundisho.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

kikuyu: Maneno ya kupendeza ni kama sega la asali, ni matamu kwa nafsi na uponyaji kwenye mifupa.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

kikuyu: Iko njia ionekanayo kuwa sawa kwa mtu, bali mwisho wake huelekeza mautini.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Shauku ya mfanyakazi humhimiza kufanya kazi; njaa yake humsukuma aendelee.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

kikuyu: Mtu mbaya kabisa hupanga mabaya, maneno yake ni kama moto uunguzao.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

kikuyu: Mtu mpotovu huchochea ugomvi, nayo maongezi ya upuzi hutenganisha marafiki wa karibu.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

kikuyu: Mtu mkali humvuta jirani yake na kumwongoza katika mapito yale mabaya.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

kikuyu: Yeye akonyezaye kwa jicho lake anapanga upotovu; naye akazaye midomo yake amenuia mabaya.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

kikuyu: Mvi ni taji ya utukufu; hupatikana kwa maisha ya uadilifu.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali mtu mstahimilivu kuliko shujaa, mtu anayeitawala hasira yake kuliko yule autekaye mji.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

kikuyu: Kura hupigwa kwa siri, lakini kila uamuzi wake hutoka kwa Bwana.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Afadhali kula ukoko mkavu ukiwa na amani na utulivu kuliko kukaa kwenye nyumba ya karamu kukiwa na magomvi.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

kikuyu: Mtumishi mwenye hekima atatawala juu ya mwana aaibishaye, naye atashirikiana katika urithi kama mmoja wa hao ndugu.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

kikuyu: Kalibu ni kwa ajili ya fedha na tanuru ni kwa ajili ya dhahabu, bali Bwana huujaribu moyo.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu husikiliza midomo mibaya; mwongo husikiliza kwa makini ulimi wa madhara.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

kikuyu: Yeye anaye mdhihaki maskini huonyesha dharau kwa Muumba wake; yeyote afurahiaye maafa hataepuka kuadhibiwa.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Wana wa wana ni taji la wazee, nao wazazi ni fahari ya watoto wao.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

kikuyu: Midomo yenye uwezo wa ushawishi haimfai mpumbavu: je, ni mibaya kiasi gani zaidi midomo ya uongo kwa mtawala!
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

kikuyu: Kipawa ni kama kito cha thamani machoni pake yeye aliye nacho; kokote kigeukiapo, hufanikiwa.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

kikuyu: Yeye anayesamehe kosa hudumisha upendo, bali yeyote arudiaye jambo hutenganisha marafiki wa karibu.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

kikuyu: Karipio humwingia sana mtu mwenye kutambua kuliko mapigo mia kwa mpumbavu.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

kikuyu: Mtu mbaya hupenda kuasi tu; mjumbe asiye na huruma atatumwa dhidi yake.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali ukutane na dubu aliyenyangʼanywa watoto wake, kuliko mpumbavu katika upumbavu wake.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtu atalipa baya kwa jema, kamwe ubaya hautaondoka katika nyumba yake.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

kikuyu: Kuanzisha ugomvi ni kama kutoboa bwawa la maji; kwa hiyo acha jambo hilo kabla mabishano hayajaanza.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

kikuyu: Yeye asemaye kuwa asiye na haki ana haki, naye asemaye kuwa mwenye haki hana haki: Bwana huwachukia sana wote wawili.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Fedha ina faida gani mikononi mwa mpumbavu, wakati yeye hana haja ya kupata hekima?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

kikuyu: Rafiki hupenda wakati wote naye ndugu amezaliwa kwa ajili ya wakati wa shida.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

kikuyu: Mtu mjinga hupana mkono ili kuweka rehani, naye huweka dhamana kwa jirani yake.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

kikuyu: Yeye apendaye ugomvi apenda dhambi; naye ainuaye sana lango lake hutafuta uharibifu.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye moyo mpotovu hawezi kufanikiwa; naye ambaye ulimi wake ni mdanganyifu huanguka kwenye taabu.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Kuwa na mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni; hakuna furaha kwa baba wa mpumbavu.
english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

kikuyu: Moyo wenye furaha ni dawa nzuri, bali roho iliyopondeka hukausha mifupa.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu hukubali rushwa kwa siri ili kupotosha njia ya haki.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

kikuyu: Mtu wa ufahamu huitazama hekima, lakini macho ya mpumbavu huhangaika hadi kwenye miisho ya dunia.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Mwana mpumbavu huleta huzuni kwa baba yake na uchungu kwa yeye aliyemzaa.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

kikuyu: Si vizuri kumwadhibu mtu asiye na hatia, au kuwapiga sana maafisa kwa ajili ya uadilifu wao.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye maarifa hutumia maneno kwa kujizuia, naye mtu mwenye ufahamu ana moyo wa utulivu.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

kikuyu: Hata mtu mpumbavu hudhaniwa kuwa na hekima kama akinyamaza, na mwenye ufahamu kama akiuzuia ulimi wake.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

kikuyu: Mtu ajitengaye na wengine hufuata matakwa yake mwenyewe; hupiga vita kila shauri jema.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu hafurahii ufahamu, bali hufurahia kutangaza maoni yake mwenyewe.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

kikuyu: Wakati uovu unapokuja, dharau huja pia, pamoja na aibu huja lawama.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

kikuyu: Maneno ya kinywa cha mwanadamu ni kina cha maji, bali chemchemi ya hekima ni kijito kinachobubujika.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

kikuyu: Sio vizuri kumpendelea mtu mwovu, au kumnyima haki asiye na hatia.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

kikuyu: Midomo ya mpumbavu humletea ugomvi na kinywa chake hualika kipigo.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

kikuyu: Kinywa cha mpumbavu ni uharibifu wake na midomo yake ni mtego kwa nafsi yake.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

kikuyu: Maneno ya mchongezi ni kama chakula kitamu; huingia sehemu za ndani sana za mtu.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

kikuyu: Mtu aliye mlegevu katika kazi yake ni ndugu na yule anayeharibu.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

kikuyu: Jina la Bwana ni ngome imara, wenye haki huikimbilia na kuwa salama.
english: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

kikuyu: Mali ya tajiri ni mji wake wenye ngome, wanaudhania kuwa ukuta usioweza kurukwa.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

kikuyu: Kabla ya anguko moyo wa mtu hujaa kiburi, bali unyenyekevu hutangulia heshima.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

kikuyu: Yeye ajibuye kabla ya kusikiliza, huo ni upumbavu wake na aibu yake.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

kikuyu: Roho ya mtu itastahimili katika ugonjwa bali roho iliyovunjika ni nani awezaye kuistahimili?
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

kikuyu: Moyo wa mwenye ufahamu hujipatia maarifa, masikio ya mwenye hekima huyatafuta maarifa.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

kikuyu: Zawadi humfungulia njia mtoaji, nayo humleta mbele ya wakuu.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

kikuyu: Yeye aliye wa kwanza kuleta mashtaka huonekana sahihi, hadi mwingine ajitokezapo na kumuuliza maswali.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

kikuyu: Kupiga kura hukomesha mashindano na kutenganisha wapinzani wakuu wanaopingana.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

kikuyu: Ndugu aliyechukizwa ni mgumu kuridhika kuliko mji uliozungushiwa ngome, nayo mabishano ni kama malango ya ngome yenye makomeo.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

kikuyu: Tumbo la mtu litajaa kutokana na tunda la kinywa chake, atashibishwa mavuno yanayotokana na midomo yake.
english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

kikuyu: Mauti na uzima viko katika uwezo wa ulimi, nao waupendao watakula matunda yake.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

kikuyu: Apataye mke apata kitu chema naye ajipatia kibali kwa Bwana.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

kikuyu: Mtu maskini huomba kuhurumiwa bali tajiri hujibu kwa ukali.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye marafiki wengi wanaweza kumharibu, bali yuko rafiki aambatanaye na mtu kwa karibu kuliko ndugu.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

kikuyu: Afadhali mtu maskini ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama, kuliko mpumbavu ambaye midomo yake imepotoka.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

kikuyu: Sio vizuri kuwa na juhudi bila maarifa, wala kufanya haraka na kuikosa njia.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

kikuyu: Upumbavu wa mtu mwenyewe huharibu maisha yake hata hivyo moyo wake humkasirikia Bwana.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

kikuyu: Mali huleta marafiki wengi, bali rafiki wa mtu maskini humwacha.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

kikuyu: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo hataachwa huru.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

kikuyu: Wengi hujipendekeza kwa mtawala na kila mmoja ni rafiki wa mtu atoaye zawadi.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

kikuyu: Mtu maskini huepukwa na ndugu zake wote: Je, marafiki zake watamkwepa kiasi gani! Ingawa huwafuata kwa kuwasihi, hawapatikani popote.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

kikuyu: Yeye apataye hekima huipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, yeye ahifadhiye ufahamu hustawi.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

kikuyu: Shahidi wa uongo hataacha kuadhibiwa, naye amwagaye uongo ataangamia.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

kikuyu: Haistahili mpumbavu kuishi katika anasa, itakuwa vibaya kiasi gani kwa mtumwa kuwatawala wakuu.
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

kikuyu: Hekima ya mtu humpa uvumilivu, ni kwa utukufu wake kusamehe makosa.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

kikuyu: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama mngurumo wa simba, bali wema wake ni kama umande juu ya nyasi.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

kikuyu: Mwana mpumbavu ni maangamizi ya babaye, naye mke mgomvi ni kama kutonatona kusikoisha.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

kikuyu: Nyumba na mali hurithiwa kutoka kwa wazazi, bali mke mwenye busara hutoka kwa Bwana.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Uvivu huleta usingizi mzito, naye mtu mzembe huona njaa.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye hutii mafundisho huulinda uhai wake, bali yeye anayezidharau njia zake atakufa.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

kikuyu: Yeye amhurumiaye maskini humkopesha Bwana, naye atamtuza kwa aliyotenda.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

kikuyu: Mrudi mwanao, kwa maana katika hiyo kuna tumaini, usiwe mshirika katika mauti yake.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye kukasirika haraka ni lazima atapata adhabu yake, kama utamwokoa, itakubidi kufanya hivyo tena.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

kikuyu: Sikiliza mashauri na ukubali mafundisho, nawe mwishoni utakuwa na hekima.
english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

kikuyu: Kuna mipango mingi ndani ya moyo wa mtu, lakini kusudi la Bwana ndilo litakalosimama.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

kikuyu: Lile mtu alionealo shauku ni upendo usio na mwisho, afadhali kuwa maskini kuliko kuwa mwongo.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

kikuyu: Kumcha Bwana huongoza kwenye uzima, kisha mtu hupumzika akiwa ameridhika, bila kuguswa na shida.
english: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

kikuyu: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, lakini hawezi hata kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake!
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

kikuyu: Mpige mwenye mzaha, naye mjinga atajifunza busara, mkemee mwenye ufahamu naye atapata maarifa.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

kikuyu: Yeye amwibiaye baba yake na kumfukuza mama yake ni mwana aletaye aibu na fedheha.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, ukiacha kusikiliza mafundisho, utatangatanga mbali na maneno ya maarifa.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Shahidi mla rushwa hudhihaki hukumu na kinywa cha mtu mwovu humeza ubaya kwa upesi.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

kikuyu: Adhabu zimeandaliwa kwa ajili ya wenye dhihaka na mapigo kwa ajili ya migongo ya wapumbavu.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

kikuyu: Mvinyo ni mdhihaki na kileo ni mgomvi; yeyote apotoshwaye navyo hana hekima.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

kikuyu: Ghadhabu ya mfalme ni kama ngurumo ya simba; yeye amkasirishaye hupoteza uhai wake.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

kikuyu: Ni kwa heshima ya mtu kujitenga ugomvi, bali kila mpumbavu ni mwepesi kugombana.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

kikuyu: Mvivu halimi kwa majira; kwa hiyo wakati wa mavuno hutazama lakini hapati chochote.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

kikuyu: Makusudi ya moyo wa mwanadamu ni maji yenye kina, lakini mtu mwenye ufahamu huyachota.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

kikuyu: Watu wengi hujidai kuwa na upendo usiokoma, bali mtu mwaminifu ni nani awezaye kumpata?
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye haki huishi maisha yasiyo na lawama, wamebarikiwa watoto wake baada yake.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

kikuyu: Wakati mfalme aketipo katika kiti chake cha enzi kuhukumu, hupepeta ubaya wote kwa macho yake.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

kikuyu: Ni nani awezaye kusema, “Nimeuweka moyo wangu safi; mimi ni safi na sina dhambi?”
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

kikuyu: Mawe ya kupimia yaliyo tofauti na vipimo tofauti, Bwana huchukia vyote viwili.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Hata mtoto hujulikana kwa matendo yake, kama tabia yake ni safi na adili.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

kikuyu: Masikio yasikiayo na macho yaonayo, Bwana ndiye alivifanya vyote viwili.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

kikuyu: Usiupende usingizi la sivyo utakuwa maskini, uwe macho nawe utakuwa na chakula cha akiba.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: “Haifai, haifai!” asema mnunuzi, kisha huondoka akijisifia ununuzi wake.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

kikuyu: Dhahabu kunayo, na marijani kwa wingi, lakini midomo inenayo maarifa ni kito cha thamani kilicho adimu.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

kikuyu: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

kikuyu: Chakula kilichopatikana kwa hila ni kitamu kwa mwanadamu, bali huishia na kinywa kilichojaa changarawe.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

kikuyu: Fanya mipango kwa kutafuta mashauri, ukipigana vita, tafuta maelekezo.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

kikuyu: Maneno ya kusengenya husababisha kutokuaminika, kwa hiyo mwepuke mtu anayezungumza kupita kiasi.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtu atamlaani baba yake au mama yake, taa yake itazimwa katika giza nene.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

kikuyu: Urithi upatikanao haraka mwanzoni, hautabarikiwa mwishoni.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

kikuyu: Usiseme, “Nitakulipiza kwa ajili ya kosa hili!” Mngojee Bwana, naye atakuokoa.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

kikuyu: Bwana anachukia sana mawe ya kupimia ya udanganyifu, nazo mizani zisizo halali hazimpendezi.
english: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

kikuyu: Hatua za mtu huongozwa na Bwana. Anawezaje basi mtu yeyote kuelewa njia yake mwenyewe?
english: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

kikuyu: Ni mtego kwa mtu kuweka wakfu kitu kwa haraka na baada ya kitambo kidogo kufikiria tena nadhiri zake.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

kikuyu: Mfalme mwenye hekima hupepeta waovu, hulipitisha gurudumu la kupuria juu yao.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

kikuyu: Taa ya Bwana huchunguza roho ya mwanadamu, huchunguza utu wake wa ndani.
english: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

kikuyu: Upendo na uaminifu humweka mfalme salama, kwa njia ya upendo, kiti chake cha enzi huwa salama.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

kikuyu: Utukufu wa vijana ni nguvu zao, mvi ni fahari ya uzee.
english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

kikuyu: Mapigo na majeraha huusafisha ubaya, nayo michapo hutakasa utu wa ndani.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Moyo wa mfalme uko katika mkono wa Bwana; huuongoza kama mkondo wa maji, popote apendapo.
english: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

kikuyu: Njia zote za mwanadamu huonekana sawa kwake, bali Bwana huupima moyo.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

kikuyu: Kufanya yaliyo sawa na haki inakubalika zaidi kwa Bwana kuliko dhabihu.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

kikuyu: Macho ya kudharau na moyo wa kiburi, ambavyo ni taa ya waovu, vyote ni dhambi!
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

kikuyu: Mipango ya mwenye bidii huelekeza kwenye faida, kama vile kwa hakika pupa huelekeza kwenye umaskini.
english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

kikuyu: Mali iliyopatikana kwa ulimi wa uongo ni mvuke upitao upesi na mtego wa kufisha.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

kikuyu: Jeuri ya waovu itawaburuta mbali, kwa kuwa wanakataa kufanya yaliyo sawa.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

kikuyu: Njia ya mwenye hatia ni ya upotovu, bali tabia ya mtu asiye na hatia ni nyofu.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali kuishi pembeni mwa paa la nyumba, kuliko kuishi nyumba moja na mke mgomvi.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu hutamani sana ubaya, jirani yake hapati huruma kutoka kwake.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

kikuyu: Wakati mwenye mzaha ameadhibiwa, mjinga hupata hekima; wakati mtu mwenye hekima afundishwapo, hupata maarifa.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

kikuyu: Mwenye Haki huyajua yanayotendeka katika nyumba za waovu, naye atawaangamiza waovu.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

kikuyu: Mtu akiziba masikio asisikie kilio cha maskini, yeye pia atalia, wala hatajibiwa.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

kikuyu: Zawadi itolewayo kwa siri hutuliza hasira na rushwa iliyofichwa kwenye nguo hutuliza ghadhabu kali.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

kikuyu: Wakati haki imetendeka, huleta furaha kwa wenye haki, bali kitisho kwa watenda mabaya.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Mtu anayepotea kutoka mapito ya ufahamu, hupumzika katika kundi la waliokufa.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Mtu apendaye anasa atakuwa maskini, yeyote apendaye mvinyo na mafuta kamwe hatakuwa tajiri.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

kikuyu: Waovu huwa fidia kwa ajili ya wenye haki, nao wasio waaminifu kwa ajili ya wanyofu.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali kuishi jangwani kuliko kuishi na mke mgomvi na mkorofi.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

kikuyu: Katika nyumba ya mwenye hekima kuna akiba ya vyakula vizuri na mafuta, lakini mtu mpumbavu hutafuna vyote alivyo navyo.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

kikuyu: Yeye afuatiaye haki na upendo hupata uzima, mafanikio na heshima.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye hekima huushambulia mji wa wenye nguvu, na kuangusha ngome wanazozitegemea.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

kikuyu: Yeye alindaye kinywa chake na ulimi wake hujilinda na maafa.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye kiburi na majivuno, “Mdhihaki” ndilo jina lake; hutenda mambo kwa kiburi kilichozidi.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

kikuyu: Kutamani sana kwa mvivu kutakuwa kifo chake, kwa sababu mikono yake haitaki kufanya kazi.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

kikuyu: Mchana kutwa hutamani zaidi, lakini mnyofu hutoa pasipo kuzuia.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

kikuyu: Dhabihu ya mtu mwovu ni chukizo, si zaidi sana itolewapo kwa nia mbaya!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

kikuyu: Shahidi wa uongo ataangamia, bali maneno ya mwenye kusikia yatadumu.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu ana uso wa ushupavu, bali mtu mnyofu huzifikiria njia zake.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

kikuyu: Hakuna hekima, wala akili, wala mpango unaoweza kufaulu dhidi ya Bwana.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

kikuyu: Farasi huandaliwa kwa ajili ya siku ya vita, bali ushindi huwa kwa Bwana.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

kikuyu: Heri kuchagua jina jema kuliko utajiri mwingi, kuheshimiwa ni bora kuliko fedha au dhahabu.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

kikuyu: Tajiri na maskini wanafanana kwa hili: Bwana ni Muumba wao wote.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye busara huona hatari na kujificha, bali mjinga huendelea mbele kama kipofu nayo ikamtesa.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: Unyenyekevu na kumcha Bwana huleta utajiri, heshima na uzima.
english: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

kikuyu: Katika mapito ya waovu kuna miiba na mitego, bali yeye ailindaye nafsi yake hukaa mbali nayo.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

kikuyu: Mfundishe mtoto njia impasayo kuiendea, naye hataiacha hata akiwa mzee.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

kikuyu: Matajiri huwatawala maskini naye akopaye ni mtumwa wa akopeshaye.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

kikuyu: Yeye aupandaye uovu huvuna taabu, nayo fimbo ya ghadhabu yake itaangamizwa.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Mtu mkarimu yeye mwenyewe atabarikiwa kwa kuwa hushiriki chakula chake na maskini.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

kikuyu: Mfukuze mwenye dhihaka, na mvutano utatoweka; ugomvi na matukano vitakoma.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

kikuyu: Yeye apendaye moyo safi na yeye ambaye maneno yake ni ya neema, mfalme atakuwa rafiki yake.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

kikuyu: Macho ya Bwana hulinda maarifa, bali huyapinga maneno ya asiye mwaminifu.
english: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

kikuyu: Mvivu husema, “Yuko simba nje!” au, “Nitauawa katika mitaa!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

kikuyu: Kinywa cha mwanamke kahaba ni shimo refu; yeye aliye chini ya ghadhabu ya Bwana atatumbukia ndani yake.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.

kikuyu: Upumbavu umefungwa ndani ya moyo wa mtoto, bali fimbo ya adhabu itaufukuzia mbali naye.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

kikuyu: Yeye amwoneaye maskini ili kujiongezea mali, naye ampaye tajiri zawadi, wote huwa maskini.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

kikuyu: Tega sikio na usikie misemo ya wenye hekima, elekeza moyo wako kwenye yale nifundishayo,
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

kikuyu: kwa maana inapendeza unapoyahifadhi moyoni mwako na kuwa nayo yote tayari midomoni mwako.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

kikuyu: Ili tumaini lako liwe katika Bwana, hata wewe, ninakufundisha leo.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.

kikuyu: Je, sijakuandikia misemo thelathini, misemo ya mashauri na maarifa,
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

kikuyu: kukufundisha maneno ya kweli na ya kuaminika, ili uweze kutoa majibu sahihi kwake yeye aliyekutuma?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

kikuyu: Usiwadhulumu maskini kwa sababu ni maskini, wala kumdhulumu mhitaji mahakamani,
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

kikuyu: kwa sababu Bwana atalichukua shauri lao naye atawateka wao waliowateka.
english: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

kikuyu: Usifanye urafiki na mtu mwenye hasira ya haraka, usishirikiane na yule aliye mwepesi kukasirika,
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

kikuyu: la sivyo utajifunza njia zake na kujiingiza mwenyewe kwenye mtego.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

kikuyu: Usiwe mwenye kupana mikono katika rehani, au kuweka dhamana kwa ajili ya madeni.
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

kikuyu: Kama ukikosa njia ya kulipa, kitanda chako kitachukuliwa ukiwa umekilalia.
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

kikuyu: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani lililowekwa na baba zako.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

kikuyu: Je, unamwona mtu stadi katika kazi yake? Atahudumu mbele ya wafalme; hatahudumu mbele ya watu duni.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

kikuyu: Uketipo kula chakula na mtawala, angalia vyema kile kilicho mbele yako,
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

kikuyu: na utie kisu kooni mwako kama ukiwa mlafi.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

kikuyu: Usitamani vyakula vyake vitamu kwa kuwa chakula hicho ni cha hila.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

kikuyu: Usijitaabishe ili kuupata utajiri, uwe na hekima kuonyesha kujizuia.
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

kikuyu: Kufumba na kufumbua utajiri hutoweka, huwa kama umepata mabawa ghafula, ukaruka na kutoweka angani kama tai.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

kikuyu: Usile chakula cha mtu mchoyo, usitamani vyakula vyake vitamu,
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

kikuyu: kwa maana yeye ni aina ya mtu ambaye kila mara anafikiri juu ya gharama. Anakuambia, “Kula na kunywa,” lakini moyo wake hauko pamoja nawe.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

kikuyu: Utatapika kile kidogo ulichokula, nawe utakuwa umepoteza bure maneno yako ya kumsifu.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

kikuyu: Usizungumze na mpumbavu, kwa maana atadhihaki hekima ya maneno yako.
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
