kikuyu: Usisogeze jiwe la mpaka wa zamani wala kunyemelea kwenye mashamba ya yatima,
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa Mtetezi wao ni mwenye nguvu, atalichukua shauri lao dhidi yako.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

kikuyu: Elekeza moyo wako kwenye mafundisho na masikio yako kwenye maneno ya maarifa.
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Usimnyime mtoto adhabu, ukimwadhibu kwa fimbo, hatakufa.
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

kikuyu: Mwadhibu kwa fimbo na kuiokoa nafsi yake kutoka mautini.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, kama moyo wako una hekima, basi moyo wangu utafurahi,
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

kikuyu: utu wangu wa ndani utafurahi, wakati midomo yako itakapozungumza lililo sawa.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

kikuyu: Usiuruhusu moyo wako kuwaonea wivu wenye dhambi, bali kila mara uwe na bidii katika kumcha Bwana.
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

kikuyu: Hakika kuna tumaini la baadaye kwa ajili yako, nalo tarajio lako halitakatiliwa mbali.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Sikiliza, mwanangu na uwe na hekima, weka moyo wako kwenye njia iliyo sawa.
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

kikuyu: Usiwe miongoni mwa wanywao mvinyo, au wale walao nyama kwa pupa,
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

kikuyu: kwa maana walevi na walafi huwa maskini, nako kusinzia huwavika matambara.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

kikuyu: Msikilize baba yako, aliyekuzaa, wala usimdharau mama yako atakapokuwa mzee.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

kikuyu: Nunua kweli wala usiiuze, pata hekima, adabu na ufahamu.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

kikuyu: Baba wa mwenye haki ana furaha kubwa, naye aliye na mwana mwenye hekima humfurahia.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

kikuyu: Baba yako na mama yako na wafurahi, mama aliyekuzaa na ashangilie!
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

kikuyu: Mwanangu, nipe moyo wako, macho yako na yafuate njia zangu,
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

kikuyu: kwa maana kahaba ni shimo refu na mwanamke mpotovu ni kisima chembamba.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

kikuyu: Kama mnyangʼanyi, hungojea akivizia, naye huzidisha wasio waaminifu miongoni mwa wanaume.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

kikuyu: Ni nani mwenye ole? Ni nani mwenye huzuni? Ni nani mwenye ugomvi? Ni nani mwenye malalamiko? Ni nani aliye na majeraha yasiyo na sababu? Ni nani mwenye macho mekundu?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

kikuyu: Ni hao wakaao sana kwenye mvinyo, hao waendao kuonja mabakuli ya mvinyo uliochanganywa.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

kikuyu: Usiukodolee macho mvinyo wakati ukiwa mwekundu, wakati unapometameta kwenye bilauri, wakati ushukapo taratibu!
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

kikuyu: Mwishowe huuma kama nyoka na kutia sumu yake kama nyoka mwenye sumu.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

kikuyu: Macho yako yataona mambo mageni na moyo wako kuwazia mambo yaliyopotoka.
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

kikuyu: Utakuwa kama alalaye katikati ya bahari, alalaye juu ya kamba ya merikebu.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

kikuyu: Utasema, “Wamenipiga lakini sikuumia! Wamenichapa, lakini sisikii! Nitaamka lini ili nikanywe tena?”
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

kikuyu: Usiwaonee wivu watu waovu, usitamani ushirika nao;
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

kikuyu: kwa maana mioyo yao hupanga mambo ya jeuri, nayo midomo yao husema juu ya kuleta madhara.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

kikuyu: Kwa hekima nyumba hujengwa, nayo kwa njia ya ufahamu huimarishwa
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

kikuyu: kwa njia ya maarifa vyumba vyake hujazwa vitu vya thamani na vya kupendeza.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye hekima ana uwezo mkubwa, naye mtu mwenye maarifa huongeza nguvu,
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

kikuyu: kwa kufanya vita unahitaji uongozi na kwa ushindi washauri wengi.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

kikuyu: Hekima i juu mno kwa mpumbavu, katika kusanyiko langoni hana lolote la kusema.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

kikuyu: Yeye apangaye mabaya atajulikana kama mtu wa hila.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

kikuyu: Mipango ya upumbavu ni dhambi, watu huchukizwa na mwenye dhihaka.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

kikuyu: Ukikata tamaa wakati wa taabu, jinsi gani nguvu zako ni kidogo!
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

kikuyu: Okoa wale wanaoongozwa kwenye kifo; wazuie wote wanaojikokota kuelekea machinjoni.
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

kikuyu: Kama mkisema, “Lakini hatukujua lolote kuhusu hili,” je, yule apimaye mioyo halitambui hili? Je, yule awalindaye maisha yenu halijui hili? Je, hatamlipa kila mtu kulingana na aliyotenda?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

kikuyu: Ule asali mwanangu, kwa kuwa ni nzuri; asali kutoka kwenye sega ni tamu kwa kuonja.
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

kikuyu: Ujue pia kwamba hekima ni tamu kwa nafsi yako, kama ukiipata, kuna matumaini kwako ya siku zijazo, nalo tumaini lako halitakatiliwa mbali.
english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Usivizie kama haramia afanyavyo ili kuyashambulia makao ya mwenye haki, wala usiyavamie makazi yake,
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

kikuyu: Kwa maana ingawa mtu mwenye haki huanguka mara saba, huinuka tena, lakini waovu huangushwa chini na maafa.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

kikuyu: Usitazame kwa kufurahia adui yako aangukapo; wakati ajikwaapo, usiruhusu moyo wako ushangilie.
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

kikuyu: Bwana asije akaona na kuchukia akaiondoa ghadhabu yake mbali naye.
english: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

kikuyu: Usikasirike kwa sababu ya watu wabaya wala usiwaonee wivu waovu,
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

kikuyu: kwa maana mtu mbaya hana tumaini la siku zijazo, nayo taa ya waovu itazimwa.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, mche Bwana na mfalme, wala usijiunge na waasi,
english: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

kikuyu: kwa maana hao wawili watatuma maangamizi ya ghafula juu yao, naye ni nani ajuaye maafa wawezayo kuleta?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

kikuyu: Hii pia ni misemo ya wenye hekima: Kuonyesha upendeleo katika hukumu si vyema:
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

kikuyu: Yeyote amwambiaye mwenye hatia, “Wewe huna hatia,” Kabila zitamlaani na mataifa yatamkana.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

kikuyu: Bali itakuwa vyema kwa wale watakaowatia hatiani wenye hatia, nazo baraka tele zitawajilia juu yao.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

kikuyu: Jawabu la uaminifu ni kama busu la midomoni.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

kikuyu: Maliza kazi zako za nje, nawe uweke mashamba yako tayari, baada ya hayo, jenga nyumba yako.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

kikuyu: Usishuhudie dhidi ya jirani yako bila sababu, au kutumia midomo yako kudanganya.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

kikuyu: Usiseme, “Nitamtenda kama alivyonitenda mimi; nitamlipiza mtu yule kwa kile alichonitendea.”
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

kikuyu: Nilipita karibu na shamba la mvivu, karibu na shamba la mizabibu la mtu asiye na akili,
english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

kikuyu: miiba ilikuwa imeota kila mahali, ardhi ilikuwa imefunikwa na magugu, na ukuta wa mawe ulikuwa umebomoka.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

kikuyu: Nikatafakari moyoni mwangu lile nililoliona, nami nikajifunza somo kutokana na niliyoyaona:
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

kikuyu: Bado kulala kidogo, kusinzia kidogo, bado kukunja mikono kidogo upate kupumzika:
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

kikuyu: hivyo umaskini utakuja juu yako kama mnyangʼanyi, na kupungukiwa kutakujia kama mtu mwenye silaha.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

kikuyu: Hizi ni mithali zaidi za Solomoni, zilizonakiliwa na watu wa Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda:
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

kikuyu: Ni Utukufu wa Mungu kuficha jambo, bali ni utukufu wa wafalme kuchunguza jambo.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

kikuyu: Kama mbingu zilivyo juu na nchi ilivyo chini, ndivyo ambavyo mioyo ya wafalme haichunguziki.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

kikuyu: Ondoa takataka kwenye madini ya fedha, nako ndani yake kutatokea chombo cha mfua fedha.
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

kikuyu: Ondoa waovu mbele ya mfalme, nacho kiti chake cha enzi kitaimarishwa kwa njia ya haki.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

kikuyu: Usijikweze mwenyewe mbele ya mfalme, wala usidai nafasi miongoni mwa watu wakuu;
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

kikuyu: ni afadhali yeye akuambie, “Njoo huku juu,” kuliko yeye kukuaibisha mbele ya mkuu. Kile ulichokiona kwa macho yako
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

kikuyu: usiharakishe kukipeleka mahakamani, maana utafanya nini mwishoni kama jirani yako atakuaibisha?
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

kikuyu: Kama ukifanya shauri na jirani yako, usisaliti siri ya mtu mwingine,
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

kikuyu: ama yeye aisikiaye aweza kukuaibisha na kamwe sifa yako mbaya haitaondoka.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

kikuyu: Neno lisemwalo kwa wakati ufaao ni kama matunda ya mtofaa ya dhahabu yaliyowekwa kwenye vijalizo vya fedha.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

kikuyu: Kama vile kipuli cha dhahabu au pambo la dhahabu safi, ndivyo lilivyo karipio la mtu mwenye hekima kwa sikio lisikilizalo.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

kikuyu: Kama vile ubaridi wa theluji wakati wa mavuno ndivyo alivyo mjumbe mwaminifu kwa wale wamtumao, huburudisha roho za bwana zake.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

kikuyu: Kama vile mawingu na upepo pasipo mvua ndivyo alivyo mtu ajisifuye kwa zawadi ambazo hatoi.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

kikuyu: Kwa njia ya uvumilivu mtawala aweza kushawishiwa, nao ulimi laini waweza kuvunja mfupa.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

kikuyu: Ukipata asali, kula kiasi tu cha kukutosha, ukila zaidi, utatapika.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

kikuyu: Ingiza mguu wako nyumbani kwa jirani yako mara chache, ukizidisha, atakukinai na atakuchukia.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

kikuyu: Kama vile rungu au upanga au mshale mkali ndivyo alivyo mtu atoaye ushuhuda wa uongo dhidi ya jirani yake.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

kikuyu: Kama vile jino bovu au mguu uliolemaa, ndivyo ilivyo kumtegemea mtu asiye mwaminifu wakati wa shida.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

kikuyu: Kama vile avuaye mavazi siku ya baridi, au kama siki iliyomwagwa juu ya magadi, ndivyo alivyo yeye amuimbiaye nyimbo mtu mwenye moyo mzito.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

kikuyu: Kama adui yako ana njaa, mpe chakula ale; kama ana kiu, mpe maji anywe.
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

kikuyu: Kwa kufanya hivyo, unaweka makaa ya moto yanayowaka kichwani pake, naye Bwana atakupa thawabu.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

kikuyu: Kama vile upepo wa kaskazini uletavyo mvua, ndivyo ulimi usingiziao uletavyo uso wa hasira.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali kuishi pembeni mwa paa la nyumba, kuliko kuishi nyumba moja na mke mgomvi.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Kama vile maji baridi kwa nafsi iliyochoka ndivyo zilivyo habari njema kutoka nchi ya mbali.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

kikuyu: Kama vile chemchemi iliyotibuliwa matope au kisima kilichotiwa taka ndivyo alivyo mtu mwenye haki akishiriki na waovu.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

kikuyu: Si vyema kula asali nyingi sana, wala si heshima kujitafutia heshima yako mwenyewe.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

kikuyu: Kama vile mji ambao kuta zake zimebomoka ndivyo alivyo mtu ambaye hawezi kujitawala mwenyewe.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

kikuyu: Kama theluji wakati wa kiangazi au mvua wakati wa mavuno, ndivyo asivyostahili heshima mpumbavu.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

kikuyu: Kama shomoro apigapigavyo mabawa yake au mbayuwayu katika kuruka kwake kasi, ndivyo ilivyo laana isiyo na sababu haimpati mtu.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

kikuyu: Mjeledi kwa farasi, lijamu kwa punda, nayo fimbo kwa migongo ya wapumbavu!
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

kikuyu: Usimjibu mpumbavu sawasawa na upumbavu wake, ama wewe mwenyewe utakuwa kama yeye.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

kikuyu: Mjibu mpumbavu sawasawa na upumbavu wake, ama atakuwa mwenye hekima machoni pake mwenyewe.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Kama vile ilivyo kujikata miguu au kunywa hasara, ndivyo ilivyo kutuma ujumbe kwa mkono wa mpumbavu.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

kikuyu: Kama miguu ya kiwete inavyoningʼinia ndivyo ilivyo mithali katika kinywa cha mpumbavu.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Kama kufunga jiwe kwenye kombeo, ndivyo ilivyo kumpa mpumbavu heshima.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

kikuyu: Kama mwiba kwenye mkono wa mlevi ndivyo ilivyo mithali kinywani mwa mpumbavu.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Kama mpiga upinde ambaye hujeruhi ovyo, ndivyo alivyo yeye aajiriye mpumbavu au yeyote apitaye njiani.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

kikuyu: Kama mbwa ayarudiavyo matapiko yake, ndivyo mpumbavu arudiavyo upumbavu wake.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

kikuyu: Je, unamwona mtu ajionaye mwenye hekima machoni pake mwenyewe? Liko tumaini zaidi kwa mpumbavu kuliko kwake.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Mvivu husema, “Yuko simba barabarani, simba mkali anazunguka mitaa!”
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

kikuyu: Kama vile mlango ugeukavyo kwenye bawaba zake, ndivyo mvivu ajigeuzavyo kitandani mwake.
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

kikuyu: Mtu mvivu hutumbukiza mkono wake kwenye sahani, naye huchoka kuupeleka kwenye kinywa chake.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

kikuyu: Mtu mvivu ni mwenye hekima machoni pake mwenyewe, kuliko watu saba wawezao kujibu kwa busara.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

kikuyu: Kama yeye amkamataye mbwa kwa masikio, ndivyo alivyo mtu apitaye njiani na kujiingiza kwenye ugomvi usiomhusu.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

kikuyu: Kama mtu mwendawazimu atupaye vijinga vya moto au mishale ya kufisha,
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

kikuyu: ndivyo alivyo mtu amdanganyaye jirani yake na kusema, “Nilikuwa nikifanya mzaha tu!”
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

kikuyu: Bila kuni moto huzimika; pasipo uchongezi ugomvi humalizika.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

kikuyu: Kama makaa juu ya makaa yanayowaka, na kama kuni kwenye moto, ndivyo alivyo mtu mgomvi kwa kuchochea ugomvi.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

kikuyu: Maneno ya mchongezi ni kama chakula kitamu; huingia sehemu za ndani sana za mtu.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Kama rangi ingʼaayo iliyopakwa kwenye vyombo vya udongo ndivyo ilivyo midomo laini pamoja na moyo mbaya.
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye nia ya kudhuru wengine hujificha kwa maneno ya midomo yake, lakini moyoni mwake huficha udanganyifu.
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

kikuyu: Ingawa maneno yake huvutia, usimwamini, kwa maana machukizo saba hujaza moyo wake.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

kikuyu: Nia yake ya kudhuru wengine inaweza kufichwa na udanganyifu, lakini uovu wake utafichuliwa kwenye kusanyiko.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

kikuyu: Kama mtu akichimba shimo, atatumbukia ndani yake, kama mtu akivingirisha jiwe, litamrudia.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

kikuyu: Ulimi wa uongo, huwachukia wale unaowaumiza, nacho kinywa cha kujipendekeza hutenda uharibifu.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

kikuyu: Usijisifu kwa ajili ya kesho, kwa kuwa hujui ni nini kitakachozaliwa kwa siku moja.
english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

kikuyu: Mwache mwingine akusifu, wala si kinywa chako mwenyewe; mtu mwingine afanye hivyo na si midomo yako mwenyewe.
english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

kikuyu: Jiwe ni zito na mchanga ni mzigo, lakini kukasirishwa na mpumbavu ni kuzito kuliko vyote viwili.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

kikuyu: Hasira ni ukatili na ghadhabu kali ni gharika, lakini ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele ya wivu?
english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

kikuyu: Afadhali karipio la wazi kuliko upendo uliofichika.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

kikuyu: Majeraha kutoka kwa rafiki yaonyesha uaminifu, bali kubusu kwa adui ni kwingi sana.
english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

kikuyu: Yeye aliyeshiba huchukia kabisa asali, bali kwa mwenye njaa hata kile kilicho kichungu kwake ni kitamu.
english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

kikuyu: Kama ndege atangatangavyo mbali na kiota chake, ndivyo alivyo mtu atangatangaye mbali na nyumbani mwake.
english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

kikuyu: Manukato na uvumba huleta furaha moyoni, nao uzuri wa rafiki huchipuka kutoka kwenye ushauri wake wa uaminifu.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

kikuyu: Usimwache rafiki yako wala rafiki wa baba yako, tena usiende nyumbani mwa ndugu yako wakati umepatwa na maafa. Bora jirani wa karibu kuliko ndugu aliye mbali.
english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

kikuyu: Mwanangu, uwe na hekima, nawe ulete furaha moyoni mwangu, ndipo nitakapoweza kumjibu yeyote anitendaye kwa dharau.
english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye busara huona hatari na kujificha, bali mjinga huendelea mbele nayo ikamtesa.
english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: Chukua vazi la yule awekaye dhamana kwa ajili ya mgeni; lishikilie iwe dhamana kama anafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya mwanamke mpotovu.
english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

kikuyu: Kama mtu akimbariki jirani yake kwa sauti kuu asubuhi na mapema, itahesabiwa kama ni laana.
english: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

kikuyu: Mke mgomvi ni kama matone yasiyokoma ya siku ya mvua.
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

kikuyu: Kumzuia yeye ni kama kuuzuia upepo au kukamata mafuta kwa kiganja cha mkono.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

kikuyu: Kama vile chuma kinoavyo chuma, ndivyo mtu amnoavyo mwenzake.
english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

kikuyu: Yeye autunzaye mtini atakula tunda lake, naye amtunzaye bwana wake ataheshimiwa.
english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

kikuyu: Kama uso uonekanavyo kwenye maji, ndivyo hivyo moyo wa mtu humwonyesha alivyo.
english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

kikuyu: Kuzimu na Uharibifu havishibi kadhalika macho ya mwanadamu.
english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

kikuyu: Kalibu ni kwa ajili ya fedha na tanuru kwa ajili ya dhahabu, bali mtu hupimwa kwa sifa azipokeazo.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

kikuyu: Hata ukimtwanga mpumbavu kwenye kinu, ukimtwanga kama nafaka kwa mchi, hutauondoa upumbavu wake.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

kikuyu: Hakikisha kuwa unajua hali ya makundi yako ya kondoo na mbuzi, angalia kwa bidii ngʼombe zako.
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa utajiri haudumu milele, nayo taji haidumu vizazi vyote.
english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

kikuyu: Wakati majani makavu yameondolewa na mapya yamechipua, nayo majani toka milimani yamekusanywa,
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

kikuyu: wana-kondoo watakupatia mavazi na mbuzi thamani ya shamba.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

kikuyu: Utakuwa na maziwa mengi ya mbuzi kukulisha wewe na jamaa yako, na kuwalisha watumishi wako wa kike.
english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

kikuyu: Mtu mwovu hukimbia ingawa hakuna yeyote anayemfukuza, bali wenye haki ni wajasiri kama simba.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

kikuyu: Wakati nchi inapokuwa na uasi, inakuwa na viongozi wengi, bali mwenye ufahamu na maarifa hudumisha utaratibu.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

kikuyu: Mtu maskini amwoneaye yeye aliye maskini zaidi ni kama mvua ya dhoruba isiyosaza mazao.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

kikuyu: Wale waiachao sheria huwasifu waovu, bali wale waishikao sheria huwapinga.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

kikuyu: Watu wabaya hawaelewi haki, bali wale wamtafutao Bwana wanaielewa kikamilifu.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

kikuyu: Afadhali maskini ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama kuliko tajiri ambaye njia zake ni potovu.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

kikuyu: Yeye ashikaye sheria ni mwana mwenye ufahamu, bali rafiki wa walafi humwaibisha baba yake.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

kikuyu: Yeye aongezaye utajiri wake kwa riba kubwa mno hukusanya kwa ajili ya mwingine, ambaye atawahurumia maskini.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote akikataa kusikia sheria, hata maombi yake ni chukizo.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye humwongoza mwenye haki kwenye mapito mabaya, ataanguka kwenye mtego wake mwenyewe, bali wasio na lawama watapokea urithi mwema.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

kikuyu: Mtu tajiri anaweza kuwa na hekima machoni pake mwenyewe, bali mtu maskini mwenye ufahamu atamfichua.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

kikuyu: Mwenye haki ashindapo, kuna furaha kubwa, bali waovu watawalapo, watu hujificha.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

kikuyu: Yeye afichaye dhambi zake hatafanikiwa, bali yeyote aziungamaye na kuziacha hupata rehema.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

kikuyu: Amebarikiwa mtu ambaye siku zote humcha Bwana, bali yeye afanyaye moyo wake kuwa mgumu huangukia kwenye taabu.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Kama simba angurumaye au dubu ashambuliaye, ndivyo alivyo mtu mwovu atawalaye wanyonge.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

kikuyu: Mtawala dhalimu hana akili, bali yeye achukiaye mapato ya udhalimu atafurahia maisha marefu.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye kusumbuliwa na hatia ya kuua atakuwa mtoro mpaka kufa; mtu yeyote na asimsaidie.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye mwenendo wake hauna lawama hulindwa salama, bali yeye ambaye njia zake ni potovu ataanguka ghafula.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

kikuyu: Yeye alimaye shamba lake atakuwa na chakula tele, bali yule afuataye mambo ya upuzi atakuwa na umaskini wa kumtosha.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

kikuyu: Mtu mwaminifu atabarikiwa sana, bali yeye atamaniye kupata utajiri kwa haraka hataacha kuadhibiwa.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

kikuyu: Kuonyesha upendeleo si vizuri, hata hivyo mtu atafanya kosa kwa kipande cha mkate.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

kikuyu: Mtu mchoyo ana tamaa ya kupata utajiri, naye hana habari kuwa umaskini unamngojea.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

kikuyu: Yeye amkemeaye mtu mwishoni hupata kibali zaidi, kuliko mwenye maneno ya kusifu isivyostahili.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

kikuyu: Yeye amwibiaye babaye au mamaye na kusema, “Si kosa,” yeye ni mwenzi wa yule aharibuye.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye tamaa huchochea fitina, bali yule amtegemeaye Bwana atafanikiwa.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

kikuyu: Yeye ajitumainiaye mwenyewe ni mpumbavu, bali yeye atembeaye katika hekima hulindwa salama.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

kikuyu: Yeye ampaye maskini hatapungukiwa na kitu chochote, bali yeye awafumbiaye maskini macho hupata laana nyingi.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

kikuyu: Wakati waovu watawalapo, watu huenda mafichoni, bali waovu wanapoangamia, wenye haki hufanikiwa.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

kikuyu: Mtu anayeendelea kuwa na shingo ngumu baada ya maonyo mengi, ataangamia ghafula, wala hapati dawa.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

kikuyu: Wenye haki wanapostawi, watu hufurahi; waovu watawalapo, watu hulia kwa huzuni.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

kikuyu: Mtu apendaye hekima huleta furaha kwa baba yake, bali aambatanaye na makahaba hutapanya mali yake.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

kikuyu: Kwa haki mfalme huipa nchi uthabiti, bali mfalme aliye na tamaa ya rushwa huiangamiza.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

kikuyu: Yeyote amsifuye jirani yake isivyostahili, anautandaza wavu kuitega miguu yake.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

kikuyu: Mtu mbaya hutegwa na dhambi yake mwenyewe bali mwenye haki huweza kuimba na kufurahi.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

kikuyu: Mwenye haki hujali haki kwa ajili ya maskini, bali mwovu hajishughulishi na hilo.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

kikuyu: Wenye mzaha huuchochea mji, bali watu wenye hekima hugeuzia mbali hasira.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

kikuyu: Kama mwenye hekima akienda mahakamani na mpumbavu, mpumbavu hukasirika na kudhihaki, wala hakuna amani.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

kikuyu: Watu wamwagao damu humchukia mtu mwadilifu na hutafuta kumuua mtu mnyofu.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu huonyesha hasira yake yote, bali mwenye hekima hujizuia.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

kikuyu: Kama mtawala akisikiliza uongo, maafisa wake wote huwa waovu.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

kikuyu: Mtu maskini na mtu anayeonea wanafanana kwa jambo hili: Bwana hutia nuru macho yao wote wawili.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

kikuyu: Kama mfalme akiwaamua maskini kwa haki, kiti chake cha enzi kitakuwa thabiti siku zote.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

kikuyu: Fimbo ya maonyo hutia hekima, bali mtoto aliyeachiwa bila maonyo humwaibisha mama yake.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

kikuyu: Wakati waovu wanapostawi, pia dhambi vivyo hivyo, lakini wenye haki wataliona anguko lao.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

kikuyu: Mrudi mwanao, naye atakupa amani, atakufurahisha nafsi yako.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

kikuyu: Mahali pasipo na ufunuo, watu kujizuia, bali ana heri mtu yule aishikaye sheria.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

kikuyu: Mtumishi hawezi kuonywa kwa maneno matupu, ajapoelewa, hataitikia.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

kikuyu: Je, unamwona mtu azungumzaye kwa haraka? Kuna matumaini zaidi kwa mpumbavu kuliko yeye.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Kama mtu akimdekeza mtumishi wake tangu ujanani, atamletea sikitiko mwishoni.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye hasira huchochea ugomvi, naye mtu mwenye hasira ya haraka hutenda dhambi nyingi.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

kikuyu: Kiburi cha mtu humshusha, bali mtu mwenye roho ya unyenyekevu hupata heshima.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

kikuyu: Anayekubaliana na mwizi ni adui wa nafsi yake mwenyewe; huapishwa lakini hathubutu kushuhudia.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

kikuyu: Kuwaogopa watu huwa ni mtego, bali yeyote amtumainiaye Bwana atakuwa salama.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

kikuyu: Wengi hutafuta kusikilizwa na mtawala, bali mtu hupata haki kutoka kwa Bwana.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

kikuyu: Mwenye haki huwachukia sana wasio waaminifu; waovu huwachukia sana wenye haki.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

kikuyu: Misemo ya Aguri mwana wa Yake, usia: Huyu mtu alimwambia Ithieli, naam, kwa Ithieli na kwa Ukali:
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

kikuyu: “Mimi ni mjinga kuliko wanadamu wote; sina ufahamu wa kibinadamu.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

kikuyu: Sijajifunza hekima, wala sina maarifa ya kumjua yeye Aliye Mtakatifu.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

kikuyu: Ni nani ameshapanda mbinguni na kushuka? Ni nani ameshakusanya upepo kwenye vitanga vya mikono yake? Ni nani ameshafungia maji kwenye nguo yake? Ni nani ameimarisha miisho yote ya dunia? Jina lake ni nani, na mwanawe anaitwa nani? Niambie kama unajua!
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

kikuyu: “Kila neno la Mungu ni kamilifu; yeye ni ngao kwa wale wanaomkimbilia.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Usiongeze kwenye maneno yake, ama atakukemea na kukuthibitisha kuwa mwongo.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

kikuyu: “Ninakuomba vitu viwili, Ee Bwana; usininyime kabla sijafa:
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

kikuyu: Uutenge mbali nami udanganyifu na uongo; usinipe umaskini wala utajiri, bali unipe chakula cha kunitosha kila siku.
english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

kikuyu: Nisije nikawa na vingi vya kuzidi nikakukana na kusema, ‘Bwana ni nani?’ Au nisije nikawa maskini nikaiba, nami nikaliaibisha jina la Mungu wangu.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

kikuyu: “Usimchongee mtumishi kwa bwana wake, asije akakulaani, ukapatilizwa kwalo.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

kikuyu: “Wako watu wale ambao huwalaani baba zao na wala hawawabariki mama zao;
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

kikuyu: wale ambao ni safi machoni pao wenyewe kumbe hawakuoshwa uchafu wao;
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

kikuyu: wale ambao daima macho yao ni ya kiburi, ambao kutazama kwao ni kwa dharau;
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

kikuyu: wale ambao meno yao ni panga na ambao mataya yao yamewekwa visu kuwaangamiza maskini katika nchi, na wahitaji kutoka miongoni mwa wanadamu.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

kikuyu: “Mruba anao binti wawili waliao, ‘Nipe! Nipe!’ “Kuna vitu vitatu visivyotosheka kamwe, naam, viko vinne visivyosema, ‘Yatosha!’:
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

kikuyu: Ni kaburi, tumbo lisilozaa, nchi isiyoshiba maji kamwe, na moto, usiosema kamwe, ‘Yatosha!’
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

kikuyu: “Jicho lile limdhihakilo baba, lile linalodharau kumtii mama, litangʼolewa na kunguru wa bondeni, litaliwa na tai.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

kikuyu: “Kuna vitu vitatu vinavyonishangaza sana, naam, vinne nisivyovielewa:
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

kikuyu: Ni mwendo wa tai katika anga, mwendo wa nyoka juu ya mwamba, mwendo wa meli katika maji makuu ya bahari, nao mwendo wa mtu pamoja na msichana.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

kikuyu: “Huu ndio mwendo wa mwanamke mzinzi, hula akapangusa kinywa chake na kusema, ‘Sikufanya chochote kibaya.’
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

kikuyu: “Kwa mambo matatu nchi hutetemeka, naam, kwa mambo manne haiwezi kuvumilia:
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

kikuyu: Mtumwa awapo mfalme, mpumbavu ashibapo chakula,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

kikuyu: mwanamke asiyependwa aolewapo, naye mtumishi wa kike achukuapo nafasi ya bibi yake.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

kikuyu: “Vitu vinne duniani vilivyo vidogo, lakini vina akili nyingi sana:
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

kikuyu: Mchwa ni viumbe wenye nguvu ndogo, hata hivyo hujiwekea akiba ya chakula chao wakati wa kiangazi.
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

kikuyu: Pelele ni viumbe vyenye uwezo mdogo hata hivyo hujitengenezea nyumba zao kwenye miamba.
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

kikuyu: Nzige hawana mfalme, hata hivyo huenda pamoja vikosi vikosi.
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

kikuyu: Mjusi anaweza kushikwa kwa mkono, hata hivyo huonekana katika majumba ya kifalme.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

kikuyu: “Viko vitu vitatu ambavyo vinapendeza katika mwendo wao, naam, vinne ambavyo hutembea kwa mwendo wa madaha:
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

kikuyu: simba, mwenye nguvu miongoni mwa wanyama, asiyerudi nyuma kwa chochote;
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

kikuyu: jogoo atembeaye kwa maringo, pia beberu, naye mfalme pamoja na jeshi lake lililomzunguka.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa umefanya upumbavu na ukajitukuza mwenyewe, au kama umepanga mabaya, basi funika mdomo wako na mkono wako.
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama vile kusukasuka maziwa hutoa siagi, na pia kule kufinya pua hutoa damu, kadhalika kuchochea hasira hutokeza ugomvi.”
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

kikuyu: Misemo ya Mfalme Lemueli, usia wa mama yake aliyomfundisha:
english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

kikuyu: “Ee mwanangu, ee mwana wa tumbo langu, ee mwana wa nadhiri zangu,
english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

kikuyu: Usitumie nguvu zako kwa wanawake, uhodari wako kwa wale wanaowaharibu wafalme.
english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

kikuyu: “Ee Lemueli, haifai wafalme, haifai wafalme kunywa mvinyo, haifai watawala kutamani sana kileo,
english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

kikuyu: wasije wakanywa na kusahau vile sheria inavyoamuru na kuwanyima haki zao wote walioonewa.
english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

kikuyu: Wape kileo wale wanaoangamia, mvinyo wale walio na uchungu,
english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

kikuyu: Wanywe na kusahau umaskini wao na wasikumbuke taabu yao tena.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

kikuyu: “Sema kwa ajili ya wale wasioweza kujisemea, kwa ajili ya haki za wote walioachwa ukiwa.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

kikuyu: Sema na uamue kwa haki, tetea haki za maskini na wahitaji.”
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

kikuyu: Mke mwenye sifa nzuri, ni nani awezaye kumpata? Yeye ni wa thamani sana kuliko marijani.
english: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

kikuyu: Mume wake anamwamini kikamilifu wala hakosi kitu chochote cha thamani.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

kikuyu: Humtendea mumewe mema, wala si mabaya, siku zote za maisha yake.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

kikuyu: Huchagua sufu na kitani naye hufanya kazi kwa mikono yenye bidii.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

kikuyu: Yeye ni kama meli za biashara akileta chakula chake kutoka mbali.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

kikuyu: Yeye huamka kungali bado giza huwapa jamaa yake chakula na mafungu kwa watumishi wake wa kike.
english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

kikuyu: Huangalia shamba na kulinunua, kutokana na mapato yake hupanda shamba la mizabibu.
english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

kikuyu: Hufanya kazi zake kwa nguvu, mikono yake ina nguvu kwa ajili ya kazi zake.
english: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

kikuyu: Huona kwamba biashara yake ina faida, wala taa yake haizimiki usiku.
english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

kikuyu: Huweka mikono yake kwenye pia, navyo vidole vyake hushikilia kijiti chenye uzi.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

kikuyu: Huwanyooshea maskini mikono yake na kuwakunjulia wahitaji vitanga vyake.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

kikuyu: Theluji ishukapo, hana hofu kwa ajili ya watu wa nyumbani mwake, kwa maana wote wamevikwa nguo za kutia joto.
english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

kikuyu: Hutengeneza mazulia ya urembo ya kufunika kitanda chake, yeye huvaa kitani safi na urujuani.
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

kikuyu: Mume wake anaheshimiwa kwenye lango la mji, aketipo miongoni mwa wazee wa nchi.
english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

kikuyu: Hutengeneza mavazi ya kitani na kuyauza, naye huwauzia wafanyabiashara mishipi.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

kikuyu: Amevikwa nguvu na heshima, anaweza kucheka bila kuwa na hofu kwa siku zijazo.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

kikuyu: Huzungumza kwa hekima na mafundisho ya kuaminika yapo ulimini mwake.
english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

kikuyu: Huangalia mambo ya nyumbani mwake wala hali chakula cha uvivu.
english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

kikuyu: Watoto wake huamka na kumwita aliyebarikiwa, mumewe pia humsifu, akisema:
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

kikuyu: “Wanawake wengi hufanya vitu vyenye sifa nzuri, lakini wewe umewapita wote.”
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

kikuyu: Kujipamba ili kuvutia ni udanganyifu na uzuri unapita upesi, bali mwanamke anayemcha Bwana atasifiwa.
english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

kikuyu: Mpe thawabu anayostahili, nazo kazi zake na zimletee sifa kwenye lango la mji.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

kikuyu: Maneno ya Mhubiri, mwana wa Daudi, mfalme huko Yerusalemu:
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

kikuyu: “Ubatili mtupu! Ubatili mtupu!” Mhubiri anasema. “Ubatili mtupu! Kila kitu ni ubatili.”
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

kikuyu: Mwanadamu anafaidi nini kutokana na kazi yake yote anayotaabikia chini ya jua?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: Vizazi huja na vizazi hupita, lakini dunia inadumu milele.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

kikuyu: Jua huchomoza na jua huzama, nalo huharakisha kurudi mawioni.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

kikuyu: Upepo huvuma kuelekea kusini na kugeukia kaskazini, hurudia mzunguko huo huo, daima ukirudia njia yake.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

kikuyu: Mito yote hutiririka baharini, hata hivyo bahari kamwe haijai. Mahali mito inapotoka, huko hurudi tena.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

kikuyu: Vitu vyote vinachosha, zaidi kuliko mtu anavyoweza kusema. Jicho kamwe halitosheki kutazama, wala sikio halishibi kusikia.
english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

kikuyu: Kile kilichokuwepo kitakuwepo tena, kile kilichofanyika kitafanyika tena, hakuna kilicho kipya chini ya jua.
english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

kikuyu: Kuna kitu chochote ambacho mtu anaweza kusema, “Tazama! Kitu hiki ni kipya”? Kilikuwepo tangu zamani za kale, kilikuwepo kabla ya wakati wetu.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

kikuyu: Hakuna kumbukumbu ya watu wa zamani, hata na wale ambao hawajaja bado hawatakumbukwa na wale watakaofuata baadaye.
english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

kikuyu: Mimi, Mhubiri, nilikuwa mfalme wa Israeli katika Yerusalemu.
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nilitumia muda wangu wote kujifunza na kuvumbua kwa hekima yote yanayofanyika chini ya mbingu. Jinsi gani Mungu ameweka mzigo mzito juu ya wanadamu!
english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

kikuyu: Nimeshaona mambo yote yanayotendeka chini ya jua, hayo yote ni ubatili, hii ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Kilichopindika hakiwezi kunyooshwa, kile ambacho hakipo haiwezekani kukihesabu.
english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

kikuyu: Niliwaza mwenyewe, “Tazama, nimekua na kuongezeka katika hekima kuliko yeyote aliyewahi kutawala Yerusalemu kabla yangu. Nimekuwa na uzoefu mkubwa wa hekima na maarifa.”
english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

kikuyu: Ndipo nilipojitahidi kufahamu kutofautisha hekima, wazimu na upumbavu, lakini nikatambua hata hili nalo ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hekima nyingi huleta huzuni kubwa; maarifa yanapoongezeka, masikitiko yanaongezeka.
english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

kikuyu: Nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Haya basi, nitakujaribu kwa anasa nione ni lipi lililo jema.” Lakini hilo nalo likaonekana ni ubatili.
english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

kikuyu: Nikasema, “Kicheko nacho ni upumbavu. Nayo matokeo ya anasa ni nini?”
english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

kikuyu: Nikajaribu kujifurahisha kwa mvinyo na kukumbatia upumbavu, huku bado akili yangu inaniongoza kwa hekima. Nilitaka kuona ni lipi bora watu wafanye kwa siku chache wanazoishi chini ya mbingu.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

kikuyu: Nikafanya miradi mikubwa: Nikajijengea majumba na kulima mashamba ya mizabibu.
english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

kikuyu: Nikatengeneza bustani na viwanja vya starehe nikaotesha huko kila aina ya miti ya matunda.
english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

kikuyu: Nikajenga mabwawa ya kukusanya maji ya kunyweshea hii miti iliyokuwa inastawi vizuri.
english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

kikuyu: Nikanunua watumwa wa kiume na wa kike na watumwa wengine walizaliwa nyumbani mwangu. Pia nilikuwa na makundi ya ngʼombe, kondoo na mbuzi kuliko mtu yeyote aliyewahi kuishi Yerusalemu kabla yangu.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nikajikusanyia fedha na dhahabu, hazina za wafalme na za majimbo. Nikajipatia waimbaji wanaume na wanawake, nazo nyumba za masuria: vitu ambavyo moyo wa mwanadamu hufurahia.
english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

kikuyu: Nikawa maarufu sana kuliko mtu mwingine yeyote aliyepata kuishi Yerusalemu kabla yangu. Katika haya yote bado nikawa nina hekima.
english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

kikuyu: Sikujinyima kitu chochote ambacho macho yangu yalikitamani, hakuna anasa ambayo niliunyima moyo wangu. Moyo wangu ulifurahia kazi zangu zote, hii ilikuwa thawabu ya kazi zangu zote.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo nilipokuja kuangalia yote ambayo mikono yangu ilikuwa imefanya na yale niliyotaabika kukamilisha, kila kitu kilikuwa ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo; hapakuwa na faida yoyote chini ya jua.
english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

kikuyu: Kisha nikageuza mawazo yangu kufikiria hekima, wazimu na upumbavu. Ni nini zaidi mtu anayetawala baada ya mfalme anachoweza kufanya ambacho hakijafanywa?
english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

kikuyu: Nikaona kuwa hekima ni bora kuliko upumbavu, kama vile nuru ilivyo bora kuliko giza.
english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye hekima ana macho katika kichwa chake, lakini mpumbavu anatembea gizani; lakini nikaja kuona kwamba wote wawili hatima yao inafanana.
english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

kikuyu: Kisha nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Hatima ya mpumbavu itanipata mimi pia. Nitafaidi nini basi kwa kuwa na hekima?” Nikasema moyoni mwangu, “Hili nalo ni ubatili.”
english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwa mtu mwenye hekima, kama ilivyo kwa mpumbavu, hatakumbukwa kwa muda mrefu, katika siku zijazo wote watasahaulika. Kama vile ilivyo kwa mpumbavu, mtu mwenye hekima pia lazima atakufa!
english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nikachukia maisha, kwa sababu kazi inayofanyika chini ya jua ilikuwa masikitiko kwangu. Yote hayo ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Nikachukia kila kitu nilichokuwa nimetaabikia chini ya jua, kwa sababu ni lazima nimwachie yule ajaye baada yangu.
english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

kikuyu: Nani ajuaye kama atakuwa ni mtu mwenye hekima au mpumbavu? Lakini hata hivyo yeye ndiye atakayetawala kazi zote ambazo nimemiminia juhudi na ustadi chini ya jua. Hili nalo ni ubatili.
english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo moyo wangu ukaanza kukata tamaa juu ya kazi yangu yote niliyoifanya kwa taabu chini ya jua.
english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mtu anaweza kufanya kazi yake kwa hekima, maarifa na ustadi, kisha analazimika kuacha vyote alivyo navyo kwa mtu mwingine ambaye hajavifanyia kazi. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili tena ni balaa kubwa.
english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

kikuyu: Mtu atapata nini kwa taabu yote na kuhangaika kwa bidii katika kazi anayotaabikia chini ya jua?
english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: Siku zake zote kazi yake ni maumivu na masikitiko, hata usiku akili yake haipati mapumziko. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Hakuna kitu bora anachoweza kufanya mtu zaidi ya kula na kunywa na kuridhika katika kazi yake. Hili nalo pia, ninaona, latokana na mkono wa Mungu,
english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

kikuyu: kwa sababu pasipo yeye, ni nani awezaye kula na kufurahi?
english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

kikuyu: Kwa yule mtu anayempendeza Mungu, Mungu humpa hekima, maarifa na furaha, bali kwa mwenye dhambi Mungu humpa kazi ya kukusanya na kuhifadhi utajiri ili Mungu ampe yule anayempenda. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Kuna wakati kwa ajili ya kila jambo, nayo majira kwa kila tendo chini ya mbingu:
english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

kikuyu: wakati wa kuzaliwa na wakati wa kufa, wakati wa kupanda na wakati wa kungʼoa yaliyopandwa,
english: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

kikuyu: wakati wa kuua na wakati wa kuponya, wakati wa kubomoa, na wakati wa kujenga,
english: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

kikuyu: wakati wa kulia na wakati wa kucheka, wakati wa kuomboleza na wakati wa kucheza,
english: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

kikuyu: wakati wa kutawanya mawe na wakati wa kukusanya mawe, wakati wa kukumbatia na wakati wa kutokumbatia,
english: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

kikuyu: wakati wa kutafuta na wakati wa kupoteza, wakati wa kuweka na wakati wa kutupa,
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

kikuyu: wakati wa kurarua na wakati wa kushona, wakati wa kunyamaza na wakati wa kuzungumza,
english: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

kikuyu: wakati wa kupenda na wakati wa kuchukia, wakati wa vita na wakati wa amani.
english: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

kikuyu: Mfanyakazi anapata faida gani kutokana na taabu yake?
english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

kikuyu: Nimeona mzigo Mungu alioweka juu ya wanadamu.
english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

kikuyu: Amefanya kila kitu kiwe kizuri kwa wakati wake. Pia ameiweka hiyo milele katika mioyo ya wanadamu, wala hawawezi kutambua kwa kina yale ambayo Mungu amefanya tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

kikuyu: Ninajua kwamba hakuna kitu bora kwa wanadamu kuliko kuwa na furaha na kutenda mema wakati wanapoishi.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

kikuyu: Tena ni karama ya Mungu kila mtu apate kula na kunywa na kujiburudisha kwa mema katika kazi yake yote.
english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

kikuyu: Ninajua kwamba kila kitu anachokifanya Mungu kitadumu milele, hakuna kinachoweza kuongezwa au kupunguzwa. Mungu hufanya hivyo ili watu wamche yeye.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

kikuyu: Chochote kilichopo kilishakuwepo, na kitakachokuwepo kimekwishakuwepo kabla; naye Mungu huyaita yale yaliyopita yarudi tena.
english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

kikuyu: Pia nikaona kitu kingine tena chini ya jua: Mahali pa kutolea hukumu, uovu ulikuwepo, mahali pa kupatia haki, uovu ulikuwepo.
english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

kikuyu: Nikafikiri moyoni mwangu, “Mungu atawaleta hukumuni wote wawili wenye haki na waovu, kwa maana kutakuwako na wakati kwa ajili ya kila jambo, wakati kwa ajili ya kila tendo.”
english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

kikuyu: Pia nikafikiri, “Kuhusu wanadamu, Mungu huwajaribu ili wajione kwamba wao ni kama wanyama.
english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

kikuyu: Hatima ya mwanadamu ni kama ile ya wanyama; wote wana mwisho unaofanana: Jinsi anavyokufa mnyama, ndivyo anavyokufa mwanadamu. Wote wana pumzi inayofanana; mwanadamu hana cha zaidi kuliko mnyama. Kila kitu ni ubatili.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

kikuyu: Wote huenda mahali panapofanana; wote hutoka mavumbini, mavumbini wote hurudi.
english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

kikuyu: Ni nani ajuaye kama roho ya mtu huenda juu na roho ya mnyama hushuka chini ardhini?”
english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nikaona kwamba hakuna kitu kilicho bora zaidi kwa mwanadamu kuliko kuifurahia kazi yake, kwa sababu hilo ndilo fungu lake. Kwa maana ni nani awezaye kumrudisha ili aje kuona kile kitakachotendeka baada yake?
english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

kikuyu: Nikatazama tena nikaona uonevu wote uliokuwa unafanyika chini ya jua: Nikaona machozi ya walioonewa, wala hawana wa kuwafariji; uwezo ulikuwa upande wa wale wanaowaonea, wala hawana wa kuwafariji.
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

kikuyu: Nami nikasema kwamba wafu, waliokwisha kufa, wana furaha kuliko watu walio hai, ambao bado wanaishi.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

kikuyu: Lakini aliye bora kuliko hao wawili ni yule ambaye hajazaliwa bado, ambaye hajaona ule uovu unaofanyika chini ya jua.
english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

kikuyu: Tena nikaona kuwa kazi zote na mafanikio yote huchipuka kutokana na wivu wa mtu kwa jirani yake. Hili nalo ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

kikuyu: Mpumbavu hukunja mikono yake na kujiangamiza mwenyewe.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

kikuyu: Afadhali konzi moja pamoja na utulivu kuliko konzi mbili pamoja na taabu na kukimbiza upepo.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Tena nikaona kitu kingine kilicho ubatili chini ya jua:
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

kikuyu: Kulikuwepo mwanadamu aliye peke yake, hakuwa na mwana wala ndugu. Hapakuwa na mwisho wa kazi yake, hata hivyo macho yake hayakutosheka na utajiri wake. Aliuliza, “Ninajitaabisha hivi kwa ajili ya nani, nami kwa nini ninajinyima kufurahia?” Hili pia ni ubatili, ni shughuli yenye taabu!
english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

kikuyu: Wawili ni afadhali kuliko mmoja, kwa sababu wana malipo mazuri kwa kazi yao:
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

kikuyu: Kama mmoja akianguka, mwenzake atamwinua. Lakini ni jambo la kuhuzunisha kwa mtu yule aangukaye naye hana wa kumwinua!
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

kikuyu: Pia, kama wawili wakilala pamoja watapashana joto. Lakini ni vipi mtu aweza kujipasha joto mwenyewe?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

kikuyu: Ingawa mtu mmoja aweza kushindwa, watu wawili wanaweza kumkabili adui na kumshinda. Kamba ya nyuzi tatu haikatiki kwa urahisi.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

kikuyu: Afadhali kijana maskini mwenye hekima kuliko mfalme mzee mpumbavu ambaye hajui tena kupokea maonyo.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

kikuyu: Kijana huyo angeweza kutokea gerezani akapata ufalme, au angeweza kuwa amezaliwa katika umaskini kwenye huo ufalme.
english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

kikuyu: Nikaona kwamba wote walioishi na kutembea chini ya jua walimfuata kijana, aliyepokea ufalme.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

kikuyu: Hapakuwa na kikomo cha watu wote aliowatawala. Lakini wale waliokuja baadaye hawakufurahia kazi ya yule aliyepokea ufalme. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Linda hatua zako uendapo katika nyumba ya Mungu. Karibia usikilize kuliko kutoa dhabihu ya wapumbavu, ambao hawajui kuwa wanafanya kosa.
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

kikuyu: Usiwe mwepesi kuzungumza, usiwe na haraka katika moyo wako kuzungumza lolote mbele za Mungu. Mungu yuko mbinguni nawe uko duniani, kwa hiyo maneno yako na yawe machache.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

kikuyu: Kama vile ndoto huja wakati kuna shughuli nyingi, ndivyo yalivyo mazungumzo ya mpumbavu wakati kuna maneno mengi.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

kikuyu: Wakati unapomwekea Mungu nadhiri, usikawie kuitimiza. Yeye hafurahii wapumbavu; timiza nadhiri yako.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

kikuyu: Ni afadhali usiweke nadhiri kuliko kuiweka na usiitimize.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

kikuyu: Usiruhusu kinywa chako kukuingiza dhambini. Tena usijitetee mbele ya huyo mjumbe wa hekaluni, ukisema, “Niliweka nadhiri kwa makosa.” Kwa nini Mungu akasirike kwa ajili ya yale unayosema na kuiharibu kazi ya mikono yako?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

kikuyu: Kuota ndoto kwingi na maneno mengi ni ubatili. Kwa hiyo simama katika kicho cha Mungu.
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

kikuyu: Kama ukiona maskini wanaonewa katika nchi, hukumu na haki vikipotoshwa, usishangazwe na mambo hayo, kwa maana afisa mmoja anaangaliwa na aliye juu yake zaidi na juu ya hao wawili kuna wengine walio juu zaidi yao.
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

kikuyu: Mafanikio ya nchi ni kwa ajili ya wote, hata mfalme mwenyewe hufaidi kutoka mashambani.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

kikuyu: Yeyote apendaye fedha kamwe hatosheki na fedha; yeyote apendaye utajiri kamwe hatosheki na kipato chake. Hili nalo pia ni ubatili.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Mali ikiongezeka, ndivyo walaji wanavyoongezeka. Hii nayo inamfaidia nini mwenye mali isipokuwa ni kushibisha macho yake?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

kikuyu: Usingizi wa kibarua ni mtamu, awe amekula kidogo au kingi, lakini wingi wa mali humnyima tajiri usingizi.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

kikuyu: Nimeshaona uovu mzito chini ya jua: Utajiri uliolimbikizwa kwa kujinyima na kuleta madhara kwa mwenye mali,
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

kikuyu: au utajiri uliopotea kwa bahati mbaya, hivyo kwamba wakati akiwa na mwana hakuna chochote kilichobaki kwa ajili yake.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

kikuyu: Mtu hutoka tumboni mwa mama yake uchi, naye jinsi alivyokuja vivyo hivyo huondoka. Hachukui chochote kutokana na kazi yake ambacho anaweza kukibeba mkononi mwake.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

kikuyu: Hili nalo ni baya la kusikitisha: Kama vile mtu ajavyo, vivyo hivyo huondoka, naye anapata faida gani, maadamu hutaabika kwa ajili ya upepo?
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

kikuyu: Siku zake zote hula gizani, pamoja na fadhaa kubwa, mateso na hasira.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

kikuyu: Ndipo nikatambua kwamba ni vyema na sahihi kwa mtu kula na kunywa na kutosheka katika kazi yake ngumu chini ya jua katika siku chache za maisha yake Mungu alizompa, kwa maana hili ndilo fungu lake.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya yote, Mungu anapompa mtu yeyote utajiri na milki, humwezesha kuvifurahia, kukubali fungu lake na kuwa na furaha katika kazi yake, hii ni karama ya Mungu.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

kikuyu: Mara chache mtu huzifikiri siku za maisha yake, kwa sababu Mungu humfanya ashikwe na furaha ya moyoni.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

kikuyu: Nimeona ubaya mwingine chini ya jua, nao unalemea sana wanadamu:
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

kikuyu: Mungu humpa mwanadamu utajiri, mali na heshima, hivyo hakukosa chochote moyo wake unachokitamani. Lakini Mungu hamwezeshi kuvifurahia, badala yake mgeni ndiye anayevifurahia. Hili ni ubatili, ni ubaya unaosikitisha.
english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

kikuyu: Mtu anaweza kuwa na watoto mia moja naye akaishi miaka mingi, lakini haidhuru kuwa ataishi muda mrefu kiasi gani, kama hawezi kufurahia mafanikio yake na kwamba hapati mazishi ya heshima, ninasema afadhali mtoto aliyezaliwa akiwa amekufa kuliko yeye.
english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

kikuyu: Kuzaliwa kwake hakuna maana, huondokea gizani na gizani jina lake hufunikwa.
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

kikuyu: Ingawa hakuwahi kuliona jua wala kujua kitu chochote, yeye ana pumziko zaidi kuliko mtu huyo,
english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

kikuyu: Hata kama huyo mtu ataishi miaka elfu mara mbili na zaidi, lakini akashindwa kufurahia mafanikio yake, je, wote hawaendi sehemu moja?
english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

kikuyu: Juhudi zote za binadamu ni kwa ajili ya kinywa chake, hata hivyo hamu yake kamwe haitoshelezwi.
english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

kikuyu: Mtu mwenye hekima ana faida gani zaidi ya mpumbavu? Mtu maskini anapata faida gani kwa kujua jinsi ya kujistahi mbele ya watu wengine?
english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

kikuyu: Ni bora kile ambacho jicho linakiona kuliko hamu isiyotoshelezwa. Hili nalo ni ubatili, ni kukimbiza upepo.
english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Lolote lililopo limekwisha kupewa jina, naye mwanadamu alivyo ameshajulikana; hakuna mtu awezaye kushindana na mwenye nguvu kuliko yeye.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

kikuyu: Maneno yanavyokuwa mengi, ndivyo yanavyokosa maana, Je, hilo linamfaidia vipi yeyote?
