english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

kikuyu: Mvua ikanyesha, mafuriko yakaja, nao upepo ukavuma ukaipiga hiyo nyumba, nayo ikaanguka kwa kishindo kikubwa.”
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipomaliza kusema maneno haya, makutano ya watu wakashangazwa sana na mafundisho yake,
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

kikuyu: kwa sababu alifundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wao wa sheria.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

kikuyu: Yesu aliposhuka kutoka mlimani, makutano makubwa ya watu yakamfuata.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma akaja na kupiga magoti mbele yake, akasema, “Bwana, kama ukitaka, unaweza kunitakasa.”
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Yesu akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa yule mtu, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!” Mara yule mtu akatakasika ukoma wake.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akamwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote. Lakini nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na utoe sadaka aliyoamuru Mose, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipoingia Kapernaumu, jemadari mmoja alimjia, kumwomba msaada,
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

kikuyu: akisema, “Bwana, mtumishi wangu amelala nyumbani na amepooza, tena ana maumivu makali ya kutisha.”
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Nitakuja na kumponya.”
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

kikuyu: Lakini yule jemadari akamwambia, “Bwana, mimi sistahili wewe kuingia chini ya dari yangu. Lakini sema neno tu, naye mtumishi wangu atapona.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mimi mwenyewe ni mtu niliyewekwa chini ya mamlaka, nikiwa na askari chini yangu. Nikimwambia huyu, ‘Nenda,’ yeye huenda; na mwingine nikimwambia, ‘Njoo,’ yeye huja. Nikimwambia mtumishi wangu, ‘Fanya hivi,’ yeye hufanya.”
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: Yesu aliposikia maneno haya, alishangaa, akawaambia wale waliomfuata, “Amin, nawaambia, hata katika Israeli sijapata kuona yeyote mwenye imani kubwa namna hii.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

kikuyu: Ninawaambia kwamba wengi watatoka mashariki na magharibi, nao wataketi karamuni pamoja na Abrahamu, Isaki na Yakobo katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni.
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

kikuyu: Lakini warithi wa Ufalme watatupwa katika giza la nje, ambako kutakuwako kilio na kusaga meno.”
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule jemadari, “Nenda na iwe kwako sawasawa na imani yako.” Naye yule mtumishi akapona saa ile ile.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

kikuyu: Yesu alipoingia nyumbani kwa Petro, alimkuta mama mkwe wa Petro amelala kitandani, akiwa ana homa.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

kikuyu: Akamgusa mkono wake na homa ikamwacha, naye akainuka na kuanza kumhudumia.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

kikuyu: Jioni ile, wakamletea watu wengi waliopagawa na pepo wachafu, naye akawatoa wale pepo wachafu kwa neno lake, na kuwaponya wagonjwa wote.
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

kikuyu: Haya yalifanyika ili litimie lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kwamba: “Mwenyewe alitwaa udhaifu wetu na alichukua magonjwa yetu.”
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipoona makutano mengi wamemzunguka, aliwaamuru wanafunzi wake wavuke mpaka ngʼambo ya ziwa.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

kikuyu: Kisha mwalimu mmoja wa sheria akamjia Yesu na kumwambia, “Mwalimu, nitakufuata kokote uendako.”
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

kikuyu: Naye Yesu akamjibu, “Mbweha wana mapango, nao ndege wa angani wana viota, lakini Mwana wa Adamu hana mahali pa kulaza kichwa chake.”
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Mwanafunzi mwingine akamwambia, “Bwana, niruhusu kwanza nikamzike baba yangu.”
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Nifuate, uwaache wafu wawazike wafu wao.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

kikuyu: Naye alipoingia kwenye mashua, wanafunzi wake wakamfuata.
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: Ghafula, kukainuka dhoruba kali baharini hata mashua ikaanza kufunikwa na mawimbi, lakini Yesu alikuwa amelala usingizi.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumwamsha, wakisema, “Bwana, tuokoe! Tunazama!”
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

kikuyu: Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnaogopa, enyi wa imani haba?” Kisha akaamka na kukemea dhoruba na mawimbi, nako kukawa shwari kabisa.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Wale watu wakashangaa, wakisema, “Ni mtu wa namna gani huyu? Hata upepo na mawimbi vinamtii!”
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: Walipofika ngʼambo katika nchi ya Wagerasi, watu wawili waliopagawa na pepo wachafu walitoka makaburini nao wakakutana naye. Watu hawa walikuwa wakali mno kiasi kwamba hakuna mtu aliyeweza kupita njia ile.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

kikuyu: Wakapiga kelele, “Una nini nasi, Mwana wa Mungu? Umekuja hapa kututesa kabla ya wakati ulioamriwa?”
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

kikuyu: Mbali kidogo kutoka pale walipokuwa, kulikuwa na kundi kubwa la nguruwe wakilisha.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

kikuyu: Wale pepo wachafu wakamsihi Yesu, “Ukitutoa humu, turuhusu twende kwenye lile kundi la nguruwe.”
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Nendeni!” Hivyo wakatoka na kuwaingia wale nguruwe, nalo kundi lote likateremka gengeni kwa kasi, likaingia katika ziwa na kufa ndani ya maji.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

kikuyu: Wale watu waliokuwa wakiwachunga hao nguruwe wakakimbia wakaingia mjini, wakaeleza yote kuhusu yale yaliyowatokea wale waliokuwa wamepagawa na pepo wachafu.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

kikuyu: Kisha watu wote wa mji huo wakatoka kwenda kukutana na Yesu. Nao walipomwona wakamsihi aondoke kwenye nchi yao.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

kikuyu: Yesu akaingia kwenye chombo, akavuka na kufika katika mji wa kwao.
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

kikuyu: Wakati huo huo wakamletea mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amelazwa kwenye mkeka. Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, jipe moyo mkuu. Dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya jambo hili, baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema mioyoni mwao, “Huyu mtu anakufuru!”
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akiyafahamu mawazo yao, akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza maovu mioyoni mwenu?
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

kikuyu: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kusema, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uende’?
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

kikuyu: Lakini, ili mpate kujua kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Ndipo akamwambia yule aliyepooza, “Inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Yule mtu akasimama, akaenda nyumbani kwake.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

kikuyu: Makutano walipoyaona haya, wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, wakamtukuza Mungu ambaye alikuwa ametoa mamlaka kama haya kwa wanadamu.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akienda kutoka huko, alimwona mtu mmoja jina lake Mathayo akiwa ameketi forodhani mahali pa kutoza ushuru. Yesu akamwambia, “Nifuate.” Mathayo akaondoka, akamfuata.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula ndani ya nyumba ya Mathayo, watoza ushuru wengi na “wenye dhambi” wakaja kula pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

kikuyu: Mafarisayo walipoona mambo haya, wakawauliza wanafunzi wake, “Kwa nini Mwalimu wenu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, lakini wale walio wagonjwa ndio wanaohitaji tabibu.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Nendeni mkajifunze maana ya maneno haya: ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu.’ Kwa maana sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.”
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wa Yohana Mbatizaji wakaja na kumuuliza Yesu, “Imekuwaje kwamba sisi na Mafarisayo tunafunga, lakini wanafunzi wako hawafungi?”
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Wageni wa bwana arusi wawezaje kuomboleza wakati angali pamoja nao? Wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Hapo ndipo watakapofunga.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

kikuyu: “Hakuna mtu anayeshonea kiraka kipya kwenye nguo iliyochakaa, kwa maana kile kiraka kitachanika kutoka kwenye hiyo nguo, nayo hiyo nguo itachanika zaidi.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Wala watu hawaweki divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Kama wakifanya hivyo, viriba vitapasuka nayo divai itamwagika, navyo viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya, na hivyo divai na viriba huwa salama.”
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akiwaambia mambo haya, mara akaingia kiongozi wa sinagogi akapiga magoti mbele yake, akamwambia, “Binti yangu amekufa sasa hivi. Lakini njoo uweke mkono wako juu yake, naye atakuwa hai.”
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

kikuyu: Yesu akaondoka akafuatana naye, nao wanafunzi wake pia wakaandamana naye.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

kikuyu: Wakati huo huo, mwanamke mmoja, ambaye alikuwa na ugonjwa wa kutokwa damu kwa muda wa miaka kumi na miwili, akaja nyuma ya Yesu, akagusa upindo wa vazi lake,
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

kikuyu: kwa maana alisema moyoni mwake, “Kama nikigusa tu vazi lake, nitaponywa.”
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Yesu akageuka, naye alipomwona akamwambia, “Binti, jipe moyo mkuu, imani yako imekuponya.” Naye yule mwanamke akapona kuanzia saa ile ile.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

kikuyu: Yesu alipofika nyumbani kwa yule kiongozi wa sinagogi na kuwaona waombolezaji wakipiga filimbi za maombolezo na watu wengi wakipiga kelele,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

kikuyu: akawaambia, “Ondokeni! Kwa maana binti huyu hakufa, bali amelala.” Wakamcheka kwa dhihaka.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

kikuyu: Lakini watu walipokwisha kutolewa nje, akaingia mle ndani na kumshika yule binti mkono, naye akaamka.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

kikuyu: Habari hizi zikaenea katika maeneo yale yote.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akiondoka mahali pale, vipofu wawili wakamfuata wakipiga kelele kwa nguvu na kusema, “Mwana wa Daudi, tuhurumie!”
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

kikuyu: Alipoingia mle nyumbani wale vipofu wakamjia. Naye Yesu akawauliza, “Mnaamini kwamba ninaweza kufanya jambo hili?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo, Bwana.”
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akagusa macho yao na kusema, “Iwe kwenu sawasawa na imani yenu.”
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

kikuyu: Macho yao yakafunguka. Yesu akawaonya vikali, akisema, “Angalieni mtu yeyote asijue kuhusu jambo hili.”
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

kikuyu: Lakini wao wakaenda na kueneza habari zake katika eneo lile lote.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wanatoka, mtu mmoja aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu na ambaye hakuweza kuongea aliletwa kwa Yesu.
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

kikuyu: Yule pepo mchafu alipotolewa, yule mtu aliyekuwa bubu akaongea. Ule umati wa watu ukastaajabu na kusema, “Jambo kama hili kamwe halijapata kuonekana katika Israeli.”
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

kikuyu: Lakini Mafarisayo wakasema, “Huyo anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa mkuu wa pepo wachafu.”
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

kikuyu: Yesu akazunguka katika miji yote na vijiji vyote, akifundisha katika masinagogi yao, akihubiri habari njema za Ufalme, na akiponya kila ugonjwa na kila aina ya maradhi.
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: Alipoona makutano, aliwahurumia kwa sababu walikuwa wanasumbuka bila msaada, kama kondoo wasiokuwa na mchungaji.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

kikuyu: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mavuno ni mengi lakini watendakazi ni wachache.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo mwombeni Bwana wa mavuno, ili apeleke watendakazi katika shamba lake la mavuno.”
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, naye akawapa mamlaka juu ya pepo wachafu, ili waweze kuwatoa na kuponya kila ugonjwa na maradhi ya kila aina.
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo majina ya hao mitume kumi na wawili: wa kwanza, Simoni aitwaye Petro, na Andrea nduguye; Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye;
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

kikuyu: Filipo, na Bartholomayo; Tomaso, na Mathayo mtoza ushuru; Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, na Thadayo;
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

kikuyu: Simoni Mkananayo, na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

kikuyu: Hawa kumi na wawili, Yesu aliwatuma akawaagiza: “Msiende miongoni mwa watu wa Mataifa, wala msiingie mji wowote wa Wasamaria.
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: Lakini afadhali mshike njia kuwaendea kondoo wa nyumba ya Israeli waliopotea.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Wakati mnapokwenda, hubirini mkisema, ‘Ufalme wa Mbinguni umekaribia.’
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

kikuyu: Ponyeni wagonjwa, fufueni wafu, takaseni wenye ukoma, toeni pepo wachafu. Mmepata bure, toeni bure.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

kikuyu: Msichukue dhahabu, wala fedha, wala shaba kwenye vifuko vyenu.
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

kikuyu: Msichukue mkoba wa safari, wala kanzu mbili, wala jozi ya pili ya viatu, wala fimbo, kwa maana mtendakazi anastahili posho yake.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

kikuyu: “Mji wowote au kijiji chochote mtakapoingia, tafuteni humo mtu anayestahili, nanyi kaeni kwake mpaka mtakapoondoka.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

kikuyu: Mkiingia kwenye nyumba, itakieni amani.
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

kikuyu: Kama nyumba hiyo inastahili, amani yenu na iwe juu yake. La sivyo, amani yenu na iwarudie ninyi.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote hatawakaribisha ninyi, wala kusikiliza maneno yenu, kungʼuteni mavumbi kutoka kwenye miguu yenu mtakapokuwa mnatoka kwenye nyumba hiyo au mji huo.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa miji ya Sodoma na Gomora kustahimili katika hukumu kuliko mji huo.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

kikuyu: “Tazama, ninawatuma kama kondoo katikati ya mbwa mwitu. Kwa hiyo mwe werevu kama nyoka na wapole kama hua.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

kikuyu: “Jihadharini na wanadamu; kwa maana watawapeleka katika mabaraza yao na kuwapiga kwenye masinagogi yao.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

kikuyu: Nanyi mtaburutwa mbele ya watawala na wafalme kwa ajili yangu, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao na kwa watu wa Mataifa.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

kikuyu: Lakini watakapowapeleka humo, msisumbuke kufikiria mtakalosema, kwa maana mtapewa la kusema wakati huo.
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu si ninyi mtakaokuwa mkinena, bali ni Roho wa Baba yenu atakayekuwa akinena kupitia kwenu.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

kikuyu: “Ndugu atamsaliti ndugu yake ili auawe, naye baba atamsaliti mtoto wake. Watoto nao wataasi dhidi ya wazazi wao na kusababisha wauawe.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Wakiwatesa katika mji mmoja, kimbilieni mji mwingine. Amin, amin nawaambia, hamtamaliza miji yote ya Israeli kabla Mwana wa Adamu kuja.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

kikuyu: “Mwanafunzi hawezi kumzidi mwalimu wake, wala mtumishi hamzidi bwana wake.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

kikuyu: Yatosha mwanafunzi kuwa kama mwalimu wake, na mtumishi kuwa kama bwana wake. Ikiwa mkuu wa nyumba ameitwa Beelzebuli,je, si watawaita zaidi wale wa nyumbani mwake!
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

kikuyu: “Kwa hiyo msiwaogope hao, kwa maana hakuna kilichofichika ambacho hakitafunuliwa, wala hakuna siri ambayo haitajulikana.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: Ninalowaambia gizani, ninyi lisemeni mchana peupe. Na lile mnalosikia likinongʼonwa masikioni mwenu, lihubirini juu ya nyumba.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

kikuyu: Msiwaogope wale wauao mwili lakini hawawezi kuua roho. Afadhali mwogopeni yeye awezaye kuiangamiza roho na mwili katika jehanamu.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

kikuyu: Je, shomoro wawili hawauzwi kwa senti moja tu? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeanguka chini pasipo Baba yenu kujua.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

kikuyu: Hata nywele za vichwa vyenu zote zimehesabiwa.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

kikuyu: Hivyo msiogope; kwa maana ninyi ni wa thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: “Kila mtu atakayenikiri mbele ya watu, mimi nami nitamkiri yeye mbele za Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Lakini yeyote atakayenikana mimi mbele ya watu, mimi nami nitamkana mbele za Baba yangu aliye mbinguni.”
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: “Msidhani kwamba nimekuja kuleta amani duniani. Sikuja kuleta amani bali upanga.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nimekuja kumfitini “ ‘mtu na babaye, binti na mamaye, mkwe na mama mkwe wake;
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

kikuyu: nao adui za mtu watakuwa ni wale watu wa nyumbani kwake.’
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

kikuyu: “Yeyote ampendaye baba yake au mama yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu. Yeyote ampendaye mwanawe au binti yake kuliko anavyonipenda mimi, hastahili kuwa wangu.
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Tena yeyote asiyeuchukua msalaba wake na kunifuata, hastahili kuwa wangu.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeyote anayetaka kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, lakini yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake kwa ajili yangu atayapata.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: “Mtu yeyote atakayewapokea ninyi atakuwa amenipokea mimi, na yeyote atakayenipokea mimi atakuwa amempokea yeye aliyenituma.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote anayempokea nabii kwa kuwa ni nabii atapokea thawabu ya nabii, naye mtu anayempokea mwenye haki kwa kuwa ni mwenye haki atapokea thawabu ya mwenye haki.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

kikuyu: Kama yeyote akimpa hata kikombe cha maji baridi mmoja wa hawa wadogo kwa kuwa ni mwanafunzi wangu, amin, nawaambia, hataikosa thawabu yake.”
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

kikuyu: Baada ya Yesu kumaliza kutoa maagizo kwa wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, aliondoka hapo akaenda kufundisha na kuhubiri katika miji yao.
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

kikuyu: Yohana aliposikia akiwa gerezani mambo ambayo Kristo alikuwa akiyafanya, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: ili wakamuulize, “Wewe ndiye yule aliyekuwa aje, au tumngojee mwingine?”
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Rudini mkamwambie Yohana yale mnayosikia na kuyaona:
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

kikuyu: Vipofu wanapata kuona, viwete wanatembea, wenye ukoma wanatakaswa, viziwi wanasikia, wafu wanafufuliwa, na maskini wanahubiriwa habari njema.
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Amebarikiwa mtu yule asiyechukizwa na mimi.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

kikuyu: Wale wanafunzi wa Yohana walipokuwa wanaondoka, Yesu akaanza kusema na makutano kuhusu Yohana Mbatizaji. Akawauliza, “Mlipokwenda kule nyikani, mlikwenda kuona nini? Je, ni unyasi ukipeperushwa na upepo?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Kama sivyo, mlikwenda kuona nini basi? Mtu aliyevaa mavazi ya kifahari? La hasha, watu wanaovaa mavazi ya kifahari wako katika majumba ya wafalme.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

kikuyu: Basi mlikwenda kuona nini? Mlikwenda kumwona nabii? Naam, nawaambia, yeye ni zaidi ya nabii.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: Huyu ndiye ambaye habari zake zimeandikwa: “ ‘Tazama nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako.’
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, miongoni mwa wale waliozaliwa na wanawake, hajatokea mtu aliye mkuu kuliko Yohana Mbatizaji. Lakini aliye mdogo kabisa katika Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni mkuu kuliko Yohana.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

kikuyu: Tangu siku za Yohana Mbatizaji hadi sasa, Ufalme wa Mbinguni hupatikana kwa nguvu, nao wenye nguvu wanauteka.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

kikuyu: Kwa maana manabii wote na Sheria walitabiri mpaka wakati wa Yohana.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mko tayari kukubali hilo, yeye ndiye yule Eliya ambaye manabii walikuwa wamesema angekuja.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

kikuyu: Yeye aliye na masikio, na asikie.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: “Lakini kizazi hiki nikifananishe na nini? Kinafanana na watoto waliokaa sokoni wakiwaita wenzao na kuwaambia,
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

kikuyu: “ ‘Tuliwapigia filimbi, lakini hamkucheza; tuliwaimbia nyimbo za maombolezo, lakini hamkuomboleza.’
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

kikuyu: Kwa maana Yohana Mbatizaji alikuja, alikuwa hali wala hanywi, nao wanasema, ‘Yeye ana pepo mchafu.’
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Mwana wa Adamu alikuja akila na kunywa, nao wanasema, ‘Tazameni huyu mlafi na mlevi, rafiki wa watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi.” ’ Lakini hekima huthibitishwa kuwa kweli kwa matendo yake.”
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akaanza kushutumu miji ambamo alifanya miujiza yake mingi kuliko kwingine, kwa maana watu wake hawakutubu.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

kikuyu: “Ole wako, Korazini! Ole wako Bethsaida! Kwa maana kama miujiza iliyofanyika kwenu, ingefanyika Tiro na Sidoni, miji hiyo ingekuwa imetubu zamani kwa kuvaa magunia na kujipaka majivu.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Lakini nawaambia, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Tiro na Sidoni kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu, kuliko ninyi.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

kikuyu: Nawe Kapernaumu, je, utainuliwa hadi mbinguni? La hasha, utashushwa mpaka kuzimu.Miujiza iliyofanyika kwako ingefanyika huko Sodoma, mji huo ungalikuwepo hadi leo.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

kikuyu: Lakini nakuambia kwamba, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwa Sodoma kustahimili katika siku ya hukumu kuliko wewe.”
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo Yesu alisema, “Nakuhimidi Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na nchi, kwa kuwa umewaficha mambo haya wenye hekima na wenye elimu, nawe ukawafunulia watoto wadogo.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

kikuyu: Naam, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo ilivyokupendeza.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

kikuyu: “Nimekabidhiwa vitu vyote na Baba yangu: Hakuna mtu amjuaye Mwana ila Baba, wala hakuna amjuaye Baba ila Mwana na yeyote ambaye Mwana anapenda kumfunulia.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

kikuyu: “Njooni kwangu, ninyi nyote mnaotaabika na kulemewa na mizigo, nami nitawapumzisha.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

kikuyu: Jifungeni nira yangu, mjifunze kutoka kwangu, kwa maana mimi ni mpole na mnyenyekevu wa moyo, nanyi mtapata raha nafsini mwenu.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nira yangu ni laini na mzigo wangu ni mwepesi.”
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo Yesu alipitia kwenye mashamba ya nafaka siku ya Sabato. Wanafunzi wake walikuwa na njaa, nao wakaanza kuvunja masuke ya nafaka na kuyala.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

kikuyu: Lakini Mafarisayo walipoona jambo hili, wakamwambia, “Tazama! Wanafunzi wako wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato.”
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hamjasoma alichofanya Daudi na wenzake walipokuwa na njaa?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

kikuyu: Aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, akala mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, yeye na wenzake, jambo ambalo halikuwa halali kwao kufanya, isipokuwa makuhani peke yao.
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

kikuyu: Au hamjasoma katika Sheria kwamba siku ya Sabato makuhani huvunja sheria ya Sabato Hekaluni lakini hawahesabiwi kuwa na hatia?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

kikuyu: Nawaambia wazi kwamba, yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Hekalu yupo hapa.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

kikuyu: Kama mngekuwa mmejua maana ya maneno haya, ‘Nataka rehema, wala si dhabihu,’ msingewalaumu watu wasio na hatia,
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

kikuyu: kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Yesu akaondoka mahali hapo, akaingia ndani ya sinagogi lao,
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

kikuyu: na huko alikuwepo mtu aliyepooza mkono. Wakitafuta sababu ya kumshtaki Yesu, wakamuuliza, “Je, ni halali kuponya siku ya Sabato?”
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Ni nani miongoni mwenu, mwenye kondoo wake ambaye huyo kondoo akitumbukia shimoni siku ya Sabato hatamtoa?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

kikuyu: Mtu ana thamani kubwa kuliko kondoo. Kwa hiyo ni halali kutenda mema siku ya Sabato.”
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

kikuyu: Ndipo akamwambia yule mtu, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa ukawa mzima kama ule mwingine.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

kikuyu: Lakini Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, wakafanya shauri baya juu ya Yesu jinsi watakavyoweza kumuua.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu alipoyatambua mawazo yao, akaondoka mahali hapo. Watu wengi wakamfuata, naye akawaponya wagonjwa wao wote,
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

kikuyu: akiwakataza wasiseme yeye ni nani.
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

kikuyu: Hii ilikuwa ili litimie lile neno lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii Isaya kusema:
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: “Tazama mtumishi wangu niliyemchagua, mpendwa wangu, ninayependezwa naye. Nitaweka Roho wangu juu yake, naye atatangaza haki kwa mataifa.
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

kikuyu: Hatagombana wala hatapiga kelele, wala hakuna atakayesikia sauti yake njiani.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

kikuyu: Mwanzi uliopondeka hatauvunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima, mpaka atakapoifanya haki ishinde.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

kikuyu: Katika Jina lake mataifa wataweka tumaini lao.”
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

kikuyu: Kisha wakamletea mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na alikuwa kipofu na bubu. Yesu akamponya, hata akaweza kusema na kuona.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

kikuyu: Watu wote wakashangaa na kusema, “Je, yawezekana huyu ndiye Mwana wa Daudi?”
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

kikuyu: Lakini Mafarisayo waliposikia jambo hili wakasema, “Mtu huyu anatoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa Beelzebuli, mkuu wa pepo wachafu.”
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakiwaza, hivyo akawaambia, “Kila ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe huangamia. Hali kadhalika kila mji au watu wa nyumba moja waliogawanyika dhidi yao wenyewe hawawezi kusimama.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

kikuyu: Kama Shetani akimtoa Shetani, atakuwa amegawanyika yeye mwenyewe. Basi ufalme wake utawezaje kusimama?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

kikuyu: Nami kama natoa pepo wachafu kwa nguvu za Beelzebuli, watu wenu je, wao hutoa pepo wachafu kwa uwezo wa nani? Hivyo basi, wao ndio watakaowahukumu.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mimi ninatoa pepo wachafu kwa Roho wa Mungu, basi Ufalme wa Mungu umekuja juu yenu.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

kikuyu: “Au tena, mtu awezaje kuingia katika nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu? Akishamfunga, ndipo hakika anaweza kuteka nyara mali zake.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: “Mtu asiyekuwa pamoja nami yu kinyume nami, na mtu ambaye hakusanyi pamoja nami, hutawanya.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nawaambia, kila dhambi na kufuru watu watasamehewa, lakini mtu atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote atakayesema neno dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa, lakini yeyote anenaye neno dhidi ya Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa, iwe katika ulimwengu huu au katika ulimwengu ujao.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

kikuyu: “Ufanye mti kuwa mzuri, nayo matunda yake yatakuwa mazuri. Au ufanye mti kuwa mbaya, na matunda yake yatakuwa mabaya. Kwa maana mti hutambulika kwa matunda yake.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

kikuyu: Enyi uzao wa nyoka! Mnawezaje kunena mambo mema, wakati ninyi ni waovu? Kwa maana kinywa cha mtu huyanena yale yaliyoujaza moyo wake.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

kikuyu: Mtu mwema hutoa yaliyo mema kutoka hazina ya mambo mema yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake, naye mtu mwovu hutoa yaliyo maovu kutoka hazina ya mambo maovu yaliyohifadhiwa ndani yake.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

kikuyu: Lakini nawaambia, katika siku ya hukumu watu watatoa hesabu kuhusu kila neno lisilo maana walilonena.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwa maneno yako utahesabiwa haki, na kwa maneno yako utahukumiwa.”
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

kikuyu: Kisha baadhi ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunataka kuona ishara kutoka kwako.”
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

kikuyu: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Kizazi kiovu na cha uzinzi kinaomba ishara! Lakini hakitapewa ishara yoyote isipokuwa ile ishara ya nabii Yona.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama vile Yona alivyokuwa ndani ya tumbo la nyangumikwa siku tatu, usiku na mchana, vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu atakuwa katika moyo wa nchi siku tatu, usiku na mchana.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

kikuyu: Siku ya hukumu watu wa Ninawi watasimama pamoja na kizazi hiki na kukihukumu; kwa maana wao walitubu waliposikia mahubiri ya Yona. Na tazama, hapa yupo yeye aliye mkuu kuliko Yona.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: Malkia wa Kusini atasimama wakati wa hukumu na kukihukumu kizazi hiki. Kwa kuwa yeye alikuja kutoka miisho ya dunia ili kuisikiliza hekima ya Solomoni. Na hapa yupo aliye mkuu kuliko Solomoni.”
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: “Pepo mchafu amtokapo mtu, hutangatanga katika sehemu zisizo na maji akitafuta mahali pa kupumzika, lakini hapati.
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

kikuyu: Ndipo husema, ‘Nitarudi kwenye nyumba yangu nilikotoka.’ Naye arudipo huikuta ile nyumba ikiwa tupu, imefagiliwa na kupangwa vizuri.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

kikuyu: Kisha huenda na kuwaleta pepo wachafu wengine saba wabaya kuliko yeye mwenyewe, nao huingia na kukaa humo. Nayo hali ya mwisho ya yule mtu huwa ni mbaya kuliko ile ya kwanza. Ndivyo itakavyokuwa kwa kizazi hiki kiovu.”
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

kikuyu: Wakati alikuwa angali anazungumza na makutano, mama yake na ndugu zake wakasimama nje wakitaka kuongea naye.
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

kikuyu: Ndipo mtu mmoja akamwambia, “Tazama, mama yako na ndugu zako wamesimama nje, wanataka kuongea na wewe.”
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

kikuyu: Lakini yeye akamjibu na kumwambia yule mtu, “Mama yangu ni nani, nao ndugu zangu ni nani?”
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

kikuyu: Akawanyooshea mkono wanafunzi wake, akasema, “Hawa hapa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu!
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeyote afanyaye mapenzi ya Baba yangu wa mbinguni, huyo ndiye ndugu yangu, na dada yangu na mama yangu.”
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Siku iyo hiyo Yesu akatoka nje ya nyumba, akaketi kando ya bahari.
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

kikuyu: Umati mkubwa mno wa watu ukakusanyika kumzunguka, hata ikabidi aingie katika chombo na kuketi humo, nao watu wote wakawa wamesimama ukingoni mwa bahari.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

kikuyu: Ndipo akawaambia mambo mengi kwa mifano, akisema: “Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

kikuyu: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

kikuyu: Lakini jua lilipozidi, mimea ikanyauka na kukauka kwa kuwa mizizi yake haikuwa na kina.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

kikuyu: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo miiba hiyo ikakua, ikaisonga hiyo mimea.
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

kikuyu: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri ambapo zilitoa mazao, nyingine mara mia moja, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara thelathini.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

kikuyu: Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakamwendea, wakamuuliza, “Kwa nini unasema na watu kwa mifano?”
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

kikuyu: Akawajibu, “Ninyi mmepewa kuzifahamu siri za Ufalme wa Mbinguni, lakini wao hawajapewa.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yule aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo sababu nasema nao kwa mifano: “Ingawa wanatazama, hawaoni; wanasikiliza, lakini hawasikii, wala hawaelewi.
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

kikuyu: Kwao unatimia ule unabii wa Isaya aliposema: “ ‘Hakika mtasikiliza lakini hamtaelewa; na pia mtatazama lakini hamtaona.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mioyo ya watu hawa imekuwa migumu; hawasikii kwa masikio yao, na wamefumba macho yao. Wasije wakaona kwa macho yao, na wakasikiliza kwa masikio yao, wakaelewa kwa mioyo yao, na kugeuka nami nikawaponya.’
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

kikuyu: Lakini heri macho yenu kwa sababu yanaona, na heri masikio yenu kwa sababu yanasikia.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, manabii wengi na wenye haki walitamani kuona yale mnayoyaona lakini hawakuyaona, na walitamani kusikia yale mnayoyasikia lakini hawakuyasikia.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

kikuyu: “Sikilizeni basi maana ya ule mfano wa mpanzi:
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote anaposikia neno la Ufalme naye asilielewe, yule mwovu huja na kunyakua kile kilichopandwa moyoni mwake. Hii ndiyo ile mbegu iliyopandwa kando ya njia.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

kikuyu: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye sehemu yenye mawe ni mtu yule ambaye hulisikia neno na mara hulipokea kwa furaha.
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

kikuyu: Lakini kwa kuwa hana mizizi yenye kina ndani yake, lile neno hudumu kwa muda mfupi tu. Kisha dhiki au mateso yanapoinuka kwa ajili ya lile neno, yeye mara huchukizwa.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

kikuyu: Ile mbegu iliyopandwa katika miiba ni yule mtu alisikiaye neno, lakini masumbufu ya maisha haya na udanganyifu wa mali hulisonga lile neno na kulifanya lisizae matunda.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Lakini ile mbegu iliyopandwa kwenye udongo mzuri ni yule mtu ambaye hulisikia neno na kulielewa. Naye hakika huzaa matunda, akizaa mara mia, au mara sitini, au mara thelathini ya mbegu iliyopandwa.”
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unaweza kufananishwa na mtu aliyepanda mbegu nzuri katika shamba lake.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

kikuyu: Lakini wakati kila mtu alipokuwa amelala, adui yake akaja na kupanda magugu katikati ya ngano, akaenda zake.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

kikuyu: Ngano ilipoota na kutoa masuke, magugu nayo yakatokea.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

kikuyu: “Watumishi wa yule mwenye shamba wakamjia na kumwambia, ‘Bwana, si tulipanda mbegu nzuri shambani mwako? Basi, magugu yametoka wapi?’
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

kikuyu: “Akawajibu, ‘Adui ndiye alifanya jambo hili.’ “Wale watumishi wakamuuliza, ‘Je, unataka twende tukayangʼoe?’
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

kikuyu: “Lakini akasema, ‘Hapana, msiyangʼoe, kwa maana wakati mkingʼoa magugu mnaweza mkangʼoa na ngano pamoja nayo.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

kikuyu: Acheni ngano na magugu vikue vyote pamoja mpaka wakati wa mavuno. Wakati huo nitawaambia wavunaji wayakusanye magugu kwanza, wayafunge matita matita ili yachomwe moto; kisha wakusanye ngano na kuileta ghalani mwangu.’ ”
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

kikuyu: Akawaambia mfano mwingine, akasema, “Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama punje ya haradali, ambayo mtu aliichukua, akaipanda shambani mwake.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

kikuyu: Ingawa mbegu hiyo ni ndogo kuliko mbegu zote, lakini inapokua ni mmea mkubwa kuliko yote ya bustanini, nao huwa mti mkubwa, hadi ndege wa angani wanakuja na kutengeneza viota katika matawi yake.”
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia mfano mwingine, “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na chachu ambayo mwanamke aliichukua akaichanganya katika kiasi kikubwa cha unga mpaka wote ukaumuka.”
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Yesu alinena mambo haya yote kwa makutano kwa mifano. Wala hakuwaambia lolote pasipo mfano.
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

kikuyu: Hii ilikuwa ili kutimiza lile lililonenwa kwa kinywa cha nabii aliposema: “Nitafungua kinywa changu niseme nao kwa mifano; nitahubiri mambo yaliyofichika tangu kuumbwa kwa misingi ya ulimwengu.”
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akaagana na makutano, akaingia nyumbani. Wanafunzi wake wakamjia wakamwambia, “Tueleze maana ya ule mfano wa magugu shambani.”
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Aliyepanda mbegu nzuri ni Mwana wa Adamu.
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

kikuyu: Shamba ni ulimwengu na mbegu nzuri ni wana wa Ufalme. Magugu ni wana wa yule mwovu.
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

kikuyu: Yule adui aliyepanda magugu ni ibilisi. Mavuno ni mwisho wa dunia, nao wavunaji ni malaika.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

kikuyu: “Kama vile magugu yangʼolewavyo na kuchomwa motoni, ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Adamu atawatuma malaika zake, nao watakusanya kutoka Ufalme wake kila kitu kinachosababisha dhambi na watenda maovu wote.
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

kikuyu: Nao watawatupa katika tanuru la moto ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

kikuyu: Ndipo wenye haki watangʼaa kama jua katika Ufalme wa Baba yao. Yeye aliye na masikio, na asikie.
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: “Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na hazina iliyofichwa shambani, ambayo mtu mmoja alipoiona akaificha tena. Kisha katika furaha yake, akaenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo, akalinunua lile shamba.”
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

kikuyu: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni unafanana na mfanyabiashara aliyekuwa akitafuta lulu safi.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

kikuyu: Alipoipata lulu moja ya thamani kubwa, alikwenda akauza vyote alivyokuwa navyo akainunua.”
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

kikuyu: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama wavu wa kuvua samaki uliotupwa baharini ukavua samaki wa kila aina.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

kikuyu: Ulipojaa, wavuvi wakavuta pwani, wakaketi na kukusanya samaki wazuri kuwaweka kwenye vyombo safi, lakini wale samaki wabaya wakawatupa.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

kikuyu: Hivi ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa mwisho wa dunia. Malaika watakuja na kuwatenganisha watu waovu na watu wenye haki.
english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

kikuyu: Nao watawatupa hao waovu katika tanuru la moto ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.”
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Yesu akauliza, “Je, mmeyaelewa haya yote?” Wakamjibu, “Ndiyo.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Basi kila mwalimu wa sheria aliyefundishwa elimu ya Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama mwenye nyumba anayetoa kutoka ghala yake mali mpya na mali ya zamani.”
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipomaliza kutoa mifano hii, akaondoka.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

kikuyu: Alipofika mji wa kwao, akawafundisha watu katika sinagogi lao. Nao wakastaajabu, wakauliza, “Mtu huyu amepata wapi hekima hii na uwezo huu wa kufanya miujiza?”
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

kikuyu: “Huyu si yule mwana wa seremala? Mama yake si yeye aitwaye Maria, nao ndugu zake si Yakobo, Yosefu, Simoni na Yuda?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

kikuyu: Nao dada zake wote, hawako hapa pamoja nasi? Mtu huyu amepata wapi basi mambo haya yote?”
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

kikuyu: Wakachukizwa naye. Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nabii hakosi heshima, isipokuwa katika nchi yake na nyumbani kwake.”
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Naye hakufanya miujiza mingi huko kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

kikuyu: Wakati huo, Mfalme Herode, mtawala wa Galilaya, alisikia habari za Yesu,
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

kikuyu: akawaambia watumishi wake, “Huyu ni Yohana Mbatizaji; amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu! Hii ndiyo sababu nguvu za kutenda miujiza zinafanya kazi ndani yake.”
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

kikuyu: Herode alikuwa amemkamata Yohana, akamfunga na kumweka gerezani kwa sababu ya Herodia, mke wa Filipo, ndugu yake,
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa Yohana alikuwa amemwambia Herode: “Si halali kwako kuwa na huyo mwanamke.”
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

kikuyu: Herode alitaka sana kumuua Yohana, lakini akaogopa watu, kwa maana walimtambua kuwa ni nabii.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

kikuyu: Katika siku ya kuadhimisha sikukuu ya kuzaliwa kwa Herode, binti wa Herodia alicheza mbele ya watu waliohudhuria, akamfurahisha sana Herode,
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

kikuyu: kiasi kwamba aliahidi kwa kiapo kumpa huyo binti chochote angeomba.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

kikuyu: Huyo binti, akiwa amechochewa na mama yake, akasema, “Nipe kichwa cha Yohana Mbatizaji kwenye sinia.”
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Mfalme akasikitika, lakini kwa sababu ya viapo alivyoapa mbele ya wageni, akaamuru kwamba apatiwe ombi lake.
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

kikuyu: Hivyo akaagiza Yohana Mbatizaji akatwe kichwa mle gerezani.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

kikuyu: Kichwa chake kikaletwa kwenye sinia, akapewa yule binti, naye akampelekea mama yake.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wa Yohana wakaja na kuuchukua mwili wake kwenda kuuzika. Kisha wakaenda wakamwambia Yesu.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesu aliposikia yaliyokuwa yametukia, aliondoka kwa chombo akaenda mahali pasipo na watu ili awe peke yake. Lakini watu walipopata habari, wakamfuata kwa miguu kupitia nchi kavu kutoka miji.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

kikuyu: Yesu alipofika kando ya bahari, aliona makutano makubwa ya watu, akawahurumia na akawaponya wagonjwa wao.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

kikuyu: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake walienda kwake, wakamwambia, “Mahali hapa ni nyikani, na muda sasa umekwisha. Waage makutano ili waende zao vijijini wakajinunulie chakula.”
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Hakuna sababu ya wao kuondoka. Ninyi wapeni chakula.”
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

kikuyu: Wakamjibu, “Tuna mikate mitano na samaki wawili tu.”
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Nileteeni hivyo vitu hapa.”
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

kikuyu: Yesu akaagiza makutano wakae chini kwenye nyasi. Akaichukua ile mikate mitano na wale samaki wawili, akainua macho yake akatazama mbinguni, akavibariki na kuimega ile mikate. Kisha akawapa wanafunzi, nao wanafunzi wakawagawia makutano.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Wote wakala, wakashiba. Nao wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

kikuyu: Idadi ya watu waliokula walikuwa wanaume wapatao 5,000, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: Mara Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake waingie kwenye mashua watangulie kwenda ngʼambo ya bahari, wakati yeye alikuwa akiwaaga wale makutano.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

kikuyu: Baada ya kuwaaga, akaenda zake mlimani peke yake kuomba. Jioni ilipofika, Yesu alikuwa huko peke yake.
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

kikuyu: Wakati huo ile mashua ilikuwa mbali kutoka nchi kavu ikisukwasukwa na mawimbi, kwa sababu upepo ulikuwa wa mbisho.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

kikuyu: Wakati wa zamu ya nne ya usiku, Yesu akawaendea wanafunzi wake akiwa anatembea juu ya maji.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake walipomwona akitembea juu ya maji, waliingiwa na hofu kuu, wakasema, “Ni mzimu.” Wakapiga yowe kwa kuogopa.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

kikuyu: Lakini mara Yesu akasema nao, akawaambia, “Jipeni moyo! Ni mimi. Msiogope.”
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Petro akamjibu, “Bwana, ikiwa ni wewe, niambie nije kwako nikitembea juu ya maji.”
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Njoo.” Basi Petro akatoka kwenye chombo, akatembea juu ya maji kumwelekea Yesu.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

kikuyu: Lakini alipoona upepo mkali aliingiwa na hofu, naye akaanza kuzama, huku akipiga kelele, “Bwana, niokoe!”
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

kikuyu: Mara Yesu akaunyoosha mkono wake na kumshika, akamwambia, “Wewe mwenye imani haba, kwa nini uliona shaka?”
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

kikuyu: Nao walipoingia ndani ya mashua, upepo ukakoma.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

kikuyu: Ndipo wote waliokuwa ndani ya ile mashua wakamwabudu Yesu, wakisema, “Hakika, wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.”
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Walipokwisha kuvuka, wakafika nchi ya Genesareti.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: Watu wa eneo lile walipomtambua Yesu, walipeleka habari sehemu zote za jirani. Watu wakamletea wagonjwa wao wote,
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

kikuyu: wakamsihi awaruhusu wagonjwa waguse tu pindo la vazi lake, nao wote waliomgusa, wakaponywa.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

kikuyu: Ndipo baadhi ya Mafarisayo na walimu wa sheria wakamjia Yesu kutoka Yerusalemu na kumuuliza,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: “Mbona wanafunzi wako wanakiuka mapokeo ya wazee? Kwa maana wao hawanawi mikono yao kabla ya kula!”
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Mbona ninyi mnavunja amri ya Mungu kwa ajili ya mapokeo yenu?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mungu alisema, ‘Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,’ na, ‘Yeyote amtukanaye baba yake au mama yake, na auawe.’
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Lakini ninyi mwafundisha kwamba mtu akimwambia baba yake au mama yake, ‘Kile ambacho ningeweza kukusaidia kimewekwa wakfu kwa Mungu,’
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

kikuyu: basi hana tena sababu ya kumheshimu baba yake nacho. Basi kwa ajili ya mafundisho yenu mnavunja amri ya Mungu.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

kikuyu: Ninyi wanafiki! Isaya alikuwa sawa alipotabiri juu yenu kwamba:
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

kikuyu: “ ‘Watu hawa huniheshimu kwa midomo yao, lakini mioyo yao iko mbali nami.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Huniabudu bure; nayo mafundisho yao ni maagizo ya wanadamu tu.’ ”
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

kikuyu: Yesu akaita ule umati wa watu, akawaambia, “Sikilizeni na mwelewe:
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

kikuyu: kinachomfanya mtu kuwa najisi mbele za Mungu si kile kiingiacho kinywani mwake, bali ni kile kitokacho kinywani mwake.”
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

kikuyu: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakamjia na kumuuliza, “Je, unajua kwamba Mafarisayo walichukizwa sana waliposikia yale uliyosema?”
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

kikuyu: Akawajibu, “Kila pando ambalo Baba yangu wa mbinguni hakulipanda, litangʼolewa.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

kikuyu: Waacheni; wao ni viongozi vipofu, wanaoongoza vipofu. Kama kipofu akimwongoza kipofu mwenzake, wote wawili watatumbukia shimoni.”
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

kikuyu: Petro akasema, “Tueleze maana ya huu mfano.”
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawauliza, “Je, bado ninyi hamfahamu?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

kikuyu: Je, hamwelewi kwamba chochote kiingiacho kinywani huenda tumboni, na hatimaye hutolewa nje kikiwa uchafu?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

kikuyu: Lakini kitokacho kinywani hutoka moyoni, na hiki ndicho kimtiacho mtu unajisi.
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ndani ya moyo hutoka mawazo mabaya, uuaji, uzinzi, uasherati, wizi, ushahidi wa uongo na masingizio.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo yamtiayo mtu unajisi; lakini kula bila kunawa mikono hakumtii mtu unajisi.”
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

kikuyu: Yesu aliondoka mahali pale, akaenda sehemu za Tiro na Sidoni.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

kikuyu: Mwanamke mmoja Mkanaani aliyeishi sehemu jirani na hizo akaja kwake akilia, akasema, “Nihurumie, Ee Bwana, Mwana wa Daudi! Binti yangu amepagawa na pepo mchafu, na anateseka sana.”
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu hakumjibu neno. Hivyo wanafunzi wake wakamwendea na kumsihi sana, wakisema, “Mwambie aende zake, kwa maana anaendelea kutupigia kelele.”
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Nimetumwa tu kwa ajili ya kondoo wa Israeli waliopotea.”
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Lakini yule mwanamke akaja, akapiga magoti mbele ya Yesu, akasema, “Bwana, nisaidie!”
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Si haki kuchukua chakula cha watoto na kuwatupia mbwa.”
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Ndiyo, Bwana, lakini hata mbwa hula makombo yanayoanguka kutoka kwenye meza za bwana zao.”
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, imani yako ni kubwa! Iwe kwako kama unavyotaka.” Naye binti yake akapona tangu saa ile.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

kikuyu: Yesu akaondoka na kwenda kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya. Kisha akapanda mlimani, akaketi huko.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

kikuyu: Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia, wakiwaleta vilema, vipofu, viwete, bubu na wengine wengi, wakawaweka miguuni pake; naye akawaponya.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

kikuyu: Hao watu wakashangaa walipoona bubu wakisema, vilema wakipona, viwete wakitembea na vipofu wakiona, wakamtukuza Mungu wa Israeli.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Ninauhurumia huu umati wa watu, kwa sababu sasa wamekuwa pamoja nami kwa muda wa siku tatu, na hawana chakula chochote. Nami sipendi kuwaaga wakiwa na njaa, wasije wakazimia njiani.”
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakasema, “Tutapata wapi mikate ya kutosha kuwalisha umati huu wa watu mkubwa namna hii, nasi tuko nyikani?”
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawauliza, “Mnayo mikate mingapi?” Wakamjibu, “Tunayo mikate saba na visamaki vichache.”
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia ule umati wa watu waketi chini.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

kikuyu: Kisha akachukua ile mikate saba na wale samaki, naye akiisha kumshukuru Mungu, akavimega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, nao wakawapa ule umati wa watu.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Wote wakala na kushiba. Baadaye wanafunzi wakakusanya vipande vilivyosalia, wakajaza vikapu saba.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Idadi ya watu walikuwa wanaume 4,000, bila kuhesabu wanawake na watoto.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: Baada ya kuaga ule umati wa watu, Yesu aliingia katika mashua, akaenda sehemu za Magadani.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

kikuyu: Mafarisayo na Masadukayo wakamjia Yesu na kumjaribu kwa kumwomba awaonyeshe ishara kutoka mbinguni.
