english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Watu wawili watakuwa shambani, naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga pamoja, naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: “Basi kesheni, kwa sababu hamjui ni siku gani atakapokuja Bwana wenu.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

kikuyu: Lakini fahamuni jambo hili: Kama mwenye nyumba angejua ni wakati gani wa usiku ambao mwizi atakuja, angekesha na hangekubali nyumba yake kuvunjwa.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo ninyi pia hamna budi kuwa tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu atakuja saa msiyotazamia.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

kikuyu: “Ni nani basi aliye mtumishi mwaminifu na mwenye busara, ambaye bwana wake amemweka kusimamia watumishi wengine katika nyumba yake, ili awape chakula chao kwa wakati unaofaa?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

kikuyu: Heri mtumishi yule ambaye bwana wake atakaporudi atamkuta akifanya hivyo.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa mali yake yote.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Lakini kama huyo mtumishi ni mwovu, naye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Bwana wangu atakawia muda mrefu,’
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

kikuyu: kisha akaanza kuwapiga watumishi wenzake, na kula na kunywa pamoja na walevi.
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

kikuyu: Basi bwana wa mtumishi huyo atakuja siku asiyodhani na saa asiyoijua.
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

kikuyu: Atamkata vipande vipande na kumweka katika sehemu moja pamoja na wanafiki, mahali ambako kutakuwa ni kulia na kusaga meno.
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

kikuyu: “Wakati huo, Ufalme wa Mbinguni utakuwa kama wanawali kumi waliochukua taa zao na kwenda kumlaki bwana arusi.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

kikuyu: Watano wao walikuwa wapumbavu na watano walikuwa wenye busara.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

kikuyu: Wale wapumbavu walichukua taa zao lakini hawakuchukua mafuta ya akiba,
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

kikuyu: lakini wale wenye busara walichukua taa zao na mafuta ya akiba kwenye vyombo.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

kikuyu: Bwana arusi alipokawia kuja wale wanawali wote wakasinzia na kulala.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

kikuyu: “Usiku wa manane pakawa na kelele: ‘Tazameni, huyu hapa bwana arusi! Tokeni nje mkamlaki!’
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

kikuyu: “Ndipo wale wanawali wote wakaamka na kuzitengeneza taa zao.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

kikuyu: Wale wapumbavu wakawaambia wale wenye busara, ‘Tupatieni mafuta yenu kidogo; taa zetu zinazimika.’
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

kikuyu: “Lakini wale wenye busara wakawajibu, ‘Sivyo, hayatutoshi sisi na ninyi pia. Afadhali mwende kwa wauzao mkajinunulie mafuta yenu.’
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

kikuyu: “Nao walipokuwa wakienda kununua mafuta, bwana arusi akafika. Wale wanawali waliokuwa tayari wakaingia ndani pamoja naye kwenye karamu ya arusi na mlango ukafungwa.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

kikuyu: “Baadaye wale wanawali wengine nao wakaja, wakaita, ‘Bwana! Bwana! Tufungulie mlango!’
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

kikuyu: “Lakini yeye bwana arusi akawajibu, ‘Amin, amin nawaambia, siwajui ninyi!’
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

kikuyu: “Kwa hiyo kesheni, kwa sababu hamjui siku wala saa.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

kikuyu: “Tena, Ufalme wa Mbinguni ni kama mtu aliyetaka kusafiri, naye akawaita watumishi wake na kuweka mali yake kwenye uangalizi wao.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

kikuyu: Mmoja akampa talantatano, mwingine talanta mbili, na mwingine talanta moja. Kila mmoja alipewa kwa kadiri ya uwezo wake. Kisha yeye akasafiri.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

kikuyu: Yule aliyepewa talanta tano akaenda mara moja akafanya nazo biashara akapata talanta nyingine tano zaidi.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

kikuyu: Yule aliyepewa talanta mbili akafanya vivyo hivyo, akapata nyingine mbili zaidi.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

kikuyu: Lakini yule mtumishi aliyekuwa amepokea talanta moja, alikwenda akachimba shimo ardhini na kuificha ile fedha ya bwana wake.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

kikuyu: “Baada ya muda mrefu, yule bwana wa wale watumishi akarudi na kufanya hesabu nao.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

kikuyu: Yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta tano akaja, akaleta nyingine tano zaidi. Akasema, ‘Bwana uliweka kwenye uangalizi wangu talanta tano. Tazama, nimepata faida ya talanta tano zaidi.’
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: “Bwana wake akamwambia, ‘Umefanya vizuri sana, mtumishi mwema na mwaminifu! Umekuwa mwaminifu kwa vitu vichache; nami nitakuweka kuwa msimamizi wa vitu vingi. Njoo ushiriki katika furaha ya bwana wako!’
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: “Yule mwenye talanta mbili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, uliweka kwenye uangalizi wangu talanta mbili. Tazama nimepata hapa talanta mbili zaidi.’
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri sana, mtumishi mwema na mwaminifu. Umekuwa mwaminifu kwa vitu vichache; nami nitakuweka kuwa msimamizi wa vitu vingi. Njoo ushiriki katika furaha ya bwana wako!’
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: “Kisha yule mtumishi aliyepokea talanta moja akaja, akasema, ‘Bwana, nilijua kwamba wewe ni mtu mgumu, unayevuna mahali usipopanda na kukusanya mahali usipotawanya mbegu.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo niliogopa, nikaenda, nikaificha talanta yako ardhini. Tazama, hii hapa ile iliyo mali yako.’
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

kikuyu: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Wewe mtumishi mwovu na mvivu! Ulijua kwamba ninavuna mahali nisipopanda na kukusanya mahali nisipotawanya mbegu.
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Vyema basi, ingekupasa kuweka fedha yangu kwa watoa riba, ili nirudipo, nichukue ile iliyo yangu na faida yake.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

kikuyu: “ ‘Basi mnyangʼanyeni hiyo talanta, mkampe yule mwenye talanta kumi.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kila mtu aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa navyo tele. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata kile alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

kikuyu: Nanyi mtupeni huyo mtumishi asiyefaa nje, kwenye giza, mahali ambako kutakuwa na kilio na kusaga meno.’
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

kikuyu: “Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja katika utukufu wake na malaika wote watakatifu pamoja naye, ndipo atakapoketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha utukufu wake.
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

kikuyu: Mataifa yote watakusanyika mbele zake, naye atawatenga kama mchungaji anavyotenga kondoo na mbuzi.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

kikuyu: Atawaweka kondoo upande wake wa kuume, na mbuzi upande wake wa kushoto.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

kikuyu: “Ndipo Mfalme atawaambia wale walioko upande wake wa kuume, ‘Njooni, ninyi mliobarikiwa na Baba yangu; urithini Ufalme ulioandaliwa kwa ajili yenu tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

kikuyu: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa mkanipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu mkaninywesha, nilikuwa mgeni mkanikaribisha,
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

kikuyu: nilikuwa uchi mkanivika, nilikuwa mgonjwa mkanitunza, nami nilikuwa kifungoni mkaja kunitembelea.’
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

kikuyu: “Ndipo wale wenye haki watakapomjibu, ‘Bwana, ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa tukakulisha, au ukiwa na kiu tukakunywesha?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

kikuyu: Lini tulikuona ukiwa mgeni tukakukaribisha, au ukiwa uchi tukakuvika?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

kikuyu: Tena ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgonjwa tukakutunza, au ukiwa kifungoni tukakutembelea?’
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

kikuyu: “Naye Mfalme atawajibu, ‘Amin nawaambia, kwa jinsi mlivyomtendea mmojawapo wa hawa ndugu zangu walio wadogo, mlinitendea mimi.’
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

kikuyu: “Kisha atawaambia wale walio upande wake wa kushoto, ‘Ondokeni kwangu, ninyi mliolaaniwa, nendeni kwenye moto wa milele ulioandaliwa kwa ajili ya ibilisi na malaika zake.
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

kikuyu: Kwa maana nilikuwa na njaa hamkunipa chakula, nilikuwa na kiu hamkuninywesha,
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

kikuyu: nilikuwa mgeni nanyi hamkunikaribisha, nilikuwa uchi hamkunivika, nilikuwa mgonjwa hamkunitunza, na nilikuwa gerezani nanyi hamkuja kunitembelea.’
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

kikuyu: “Ndipo wao pia watajibu, ‘Bwana ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa au kiu, au ukiwa mgeni au uchi, au ukiwa mgonjwa na kifungoni na hatukukuhudumia?’
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

kikuyu: “Naye atawajibu, ‘Amin nawaambia, kwa jinsi ambavyo hamkumtendea mmojawapo wa hawa ndugu zangu walio wadogo, hamkunitendea mimi.’
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

kikuyu: “Ndipo hawa watakapoingia kwenye adhabu ya milele, lakini wale wenye haki wataingia katika uzima wa milele.”
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipomaliza kusema hayo yote, akawaambia wanafunzi wake,
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: “Kama mnavyojua, baada ya siku mbili itakuwa Pasaka, naye Mwana wa Adamu atasalitiwa ili asulubiwe.”
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

kikuyu: Basi viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu wakakusanyika katika jumba la utawala la kuhani mkuu, jina lake Kayafa.
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

kikuyu: Wakafanya shauri ili kumkamata Yesu kwa siri na kumuua.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

kikuyu: Lakini wakasema, “Isiwe wakati wa Sikukuu, kusitokee ghasia miongoni mwa watu.”
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

kikuyu: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani mwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

kikuyu: naye mwanamke mmoja akamjia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya thamani kubwa; akayamimina kichwani mwa Yesu alipokuwa ameketi mezani kula chakula.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

kikuyu: Lakini wanafunzi wake walipoona hayo wakakasirika, wakasema, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

kikuyu: Manukato haya yangeuzwa kwa bei kubwa, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.”
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

kikuyu: Yesu, akijua jambo hili, akawaambia, “Mbona mnamsumbua huyu mwanamke? Yeye amenitendea jambo zuri sana.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

kikuyu: Alipomiminia haya manukato kwenye mwili wangu, amefanya hivyo ili kuniandaa kwa ajili ya maziko yangu.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, mahali popote ulimwenguni ambapo hii Injili itahubiriwa, jambo hili alilolitenda huyu mwanamke litatajwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Kisha mmojawapo wa wale kumi na wawili, aitwaye Yuda Iskariote, alikwenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

kikuyu: na kuuliza, “Mtanipa nini nikimtia Yesu mikononi mwenu?” Wakamlipa vipande thelathini vya fedha.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

kikuyu: Tangu wakati huo Yuda akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti Yesu.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

kikuyu: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, wanafunzi walimjia Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Akajibu, “Nendeni kwa mtu fulani huko mjini, mkamwambie, ‘Mwalimu asema hivi: Saa yangu imekaribia. Nitaiadhimisha Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi wangu katika nyumba yako.’ ”
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

kikuyu: Hivyo wanafunzi wakafanya kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaelekeza, nao wakaandaa Pasaka.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu alikuwa ameketi mezani pamoja na wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

kikuyu: Nao walipokuwa wakila, Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Wakahuzunika sana, wakaanza kumuuliza mmoja baada ya mwingine, “Je, ni mimi Bwana?”
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Yule aliyechovya mkono wake katika bakuli pamoja nami ndiye atakayenisaliti.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu. Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa!”
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yuda, yule mwenye kumsaliti, akasema, “Je, ni mimi Rabi?” Yesu akajibu, “Naam, wewe mwenyewe umesema.”
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wanakula, Yesu akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, akisema, “Twaeni, mle; huu ndio mwili wangu.”
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

kikuyu: Kisha akakitwaa kikombe, akashukuru, akawapa, akisema, “Nyweni nyote katika kikombe hiki.
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo damu yangu ya Agano, imwagikayo kwa ajili ya wengi kwa ondoleo la dhambi.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

kikuyu: Lakini ninawaambia, tangu sasa sitakunywa tena katika uzao huu wa mzabibu, hadi siku ile nitakapounywa mpya pamoja nanyi katika Ufalme wa Baba yangu.”
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Walipokwisha kuimba wimbo, wakatoka wakaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Usiku huu, ninyi nyote mtaniacha, kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo wa hilo kundi watatawanyika.’
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: Petro akajibu, “Hata kama wote watakuacha, kamwe mimi sitakuacha.”
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akasisitiza, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wanafunzi wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akaenda pamoja na wanafunzi wake mpaka kwenye bustani iitwayo Gethsemane, akawaambia, “Kaeni hapa, nami niende kule nikaombe.”
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

kikuyu: Akamchukua Petro pamoja na wale wana wawili wa Zebedayo, akaanza kuhuzunika na kufadhaika.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe pamoja nami.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

kikuyu: Akaenda mbele kidogo, akaanguka kifudifudi, akaomba akisema, “Baba yangu, kama inawezekana, kikombe hiki na kiniondokee. Lakini si kama nipendavyo mimi, bali kama upendavyo wewe.”
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: Kisha akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawakuta wamelala. Akamuuliza Petro, “Je, ninyi hamkuweza kukesha pamoja nami hata kwa saa moja?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

kikuyu: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Akaenda tena mara ya pili na kuomba, “Baba yangu, kama haiwezekani kikombe hiki kiniepuke nisikinywe, basi mapenzi yako yafanyike.”
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

kikuyu: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

kikuyu: Hivyo akawaacha akaenda zake tena mara ya tatu na kuomba akisema maneno yale yale.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Kisha akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Bado mmelala na kupumzika? Tazameni, saa imefika ambapo Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Inukeni, twende zetu! Tazameni, msaliti wangu yuaja!”
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, akafika. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati mkubwa wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

kikuyu: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni.”
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

kikuyu: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kumsalimu, “Salamu, Rabi!” Akambusu.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Rafiki, fanya kile ulichokuja kufanya hapa.” Kisha wale watu wakasogea mbele, wakamkamata Yesu.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

kikuyu: Ghafula mmoja wa wale waliokuwa na Yesu alipoona hivyo, akaushika upanga wake, akauchomoa na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Rudisha upanga wako mahali pake, kwa maana wote watumiao upanga watakufa kwa upanga.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

kikuyu: Je, unadhani siwezi kumwomba Baba yangu naye mara moja akaniletea zaidi ya majeshi kumi na mawili ya malaika?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

kikuyu: Lakini je, yale Maandiko yanayotabiri kwamba ni lazima itendeke hivi yatatimiaje?”
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

kikuyu: Wakati huo, Yesu akawaambia ule umati wa watu, “Je, mmekuja na panga na marungu kunikamata kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi? Siku kwa siku niliketi Hekaluni nikifundisha, mbona hamkunikamata?
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

kikuyu: Lakini haya yote yametukia ili maandiko ya manabii yapate kutimia.” Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha na kukimbia.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

kikuyu: Wale waliokuwa wamemkamata Yesu wakampeleka kwa Kayafa, kuhani mkuu, mahali ambapo walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee walikuwa wamekusanyika.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akamfuata kwa mbali hadi uani kwa kuhani mkuu. Akaingia ndani, akaketi pamoja na walinzi ili aone litakalotukia.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

kikuyu: Viongozi wa makuhani na Baraza la Wayahudi lote wakatafuta ushahidi wa uongo dhidi ya Yesu ili wapate kumuua.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

kikuyu: Lakini hawakupata jambo lolote, ingawa mashahidi wengi wa uongo walijitokeza. Hatimaye wakajitokeza mashahidi wawili wa uongo
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

kikuyu: na kusema, “Huyu mtu alisema, ‘Ninaweza kulivunja Hekalu la Mungu na kulijenga tena kwa siku tatu.’ ”
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

kikuyu: Kisha kuhani mkuu akasimama na kumwambia Yesu, “Je, wewe hutajibu? Ni ushahidi gani hawa watu wanauleta dhidi yako?”
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akakaa kimya. Ndipo kuhani mkuu akamwambia, “Nakuapisha mbele za Mungu aliye hai. Tuambie kama wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.”
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umenena. Lakini ninawaambia nyote: Siku za baadaye, mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Ndipo kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake na kusema, “Amekufuru! Tuna haja gani tena ya mashahidi zaidi? Tazama, sasa ninyi mmesikia hayo makufuru.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

kikuyu: Uamuzi wenu ni gani?” Wakajibu, “Anastahili kufa.”
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

kikuyu: Kisha wakamtemea mate usoni na wengine wakampiga ngumi. Wengine wakampiga makofi
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

kikuyu: na kusema, “Tutabirie, wewe Kristo! Ni nani aliyekupiga?”
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

kikuyu: Wakati huu Petro alikuwa amekaa nje uani. Mtumishi mmoja wa kike akamjia na kumwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu wa Galilaya.”
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akakana mbele yao wote akisema, “Sijui hilo usemalo.”
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

kikuyu: Alipotoka nje kufika kwenye lango, mtumishi mwingine wa kike alimwona, akawaambia watu waliokuwepo, “Huyu mtu alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Akakana tena kwa kiapo akisema, “Mimi simjui huyo!”
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

kikuyu: Baada ya muda mfupi, wale waliokuwa wamesimama pale wakamwendea Petro, wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana usemi wako ni kama wao.”
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Petro akaanza kujilaani na kuwaapia, “Mimi simjui mtu huyo!” Papo hapo jogoo akawika.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno Yesu alilokuwa amesema: “Kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.” Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Asubuhi na mapema, viongozi wa makuhani wote na wazee wa watu wakafanya shauri pamoja dhidi ya Yesu ili kumuua.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

kikuyu: Wakamfunga, wakampeleka na kumkabidhi kwa Pilato, ambaye alikuwa mtawala wa Kirumi.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

kikuyu: Yuda, ambaye alikuwa amemsaliti Yesu, alipoona kuwa Yesu amehukumiwa, akajuta na akarudisha vile vipande thelathini vya fedha alivyopewa na viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wa watu.
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

kikuyu: Akasema, “Nimetenda dhambi, kwa maana nimeisaliti damu isiyo na hatia.” Wakamjibu, “Hilo latuhusu nini sisi? Ni shauri yako.”
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

kikuyu: Basi Yuda akavitupa vile vipande vya fedha ndani ya Hekalu akaondoka akaenda kujinyonga.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

kikuyu: Wale viongozi wa makuhani wakazichukua zile fedha wakasema, “Si halali kuchanganya fedha hizi na sadaka kwa sababu hizi ni fedha zenye damu.”
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo baada ya kushauriana, waliamua kuzitumia kununulia shamba la mfinyanzi, liwe mahali pa kuzikia wageni.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo sababu lile shamba likaitwa Shamba la Damu hadi leo.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

kikuyu: Ndipo likatimia lile lililonenwa na nabii Yeremia, kwamba, “Walichukua vile vipande thelathini vya fedha, thamani aliyopangiwa na watu wa Israeli,
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

kikuyu: wakanunulia shamba la mfinyanzi, kama vile Bwana alivyoniagiza.”
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo Yesu akiwa amesimama mbele ya mtawala, mtawala akamuuliza, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akasema, “Wewe wasema hivyo.”
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na wazee walipomshtaki, hakujibu neno.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

kikuyu: Ndipo Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, husikii ni mambo mangapi wanayokushtaki nayo?”
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu hakumjibu hata kwa shtaka moja, kiasi kwamba mtawala alishangaa sana.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

kikuyu: Basi ilikuwa ni desturi ya mtawala kumfungua mfungwa mmoja aliyechaguliwa na umati wa watu wakati wa sikukuu.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

kikuyu: Wakati huo alikuwepo mfungwa mmoja mwenye sifa mbaya, aliyeitwa Baraba.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

kikuyu: Hivyo umati wa watu walipokusanyika, Pilato akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafungulie nani, Baraba au Yesu yeye aitwaye Kristo?”
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Pilato akiwa ameketi kwenye kiti cha hukumu, mkewe akampelekea ujumbe huu: “Usiwe na jambo lolote juu ya mtu huyu asiye na hatia, kwa kuwa leo nimeteseka sana katika ndoto kwa sababu yake.”
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

kikuyu: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani na wazee wakaushawishi ule umati wa watu kwamba waombe Baraba afunguliwe, naye Yesu auawe.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

kikuyu: Mtawala akawauliza tena, “Ni yupi kati ya hawa wawili mnayetaka niwafungulie?” Wakajibu, “Baraba.”
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

kikuyu: Pilato akawaambia, “Basi nifanye nini na huyu Yesu aitwaye Kristo?” Wakajibu wote, “Msulubishe!”
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Pilato akauliza, “Kwa nini? Amefanya kosa gani?” Lakini wao wakazidi kupiga kelele, wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Pilato alipoona kwamba hawezi kufanya lolote, lakini badala yake ghasia zilikuwa zinaanza, akachukua maji, akanawa mikono yake mbele ya ule umati wa watu, akasema, “Sina hatia juu ya damu ya mtu huyu, hili ni jukumu lenu!”
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

kikuyu: Watu wote wakajibu, “Damu yake na iwe juu yetu na juu ya watoto wetu!”
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

kikuyu: Basi akawafungulia Baraba. Lakini baada ya kuamuru Yesu achapwe mijeledi, akamtoa ili asulubishwe.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

kikuyu: Kisha askari wa mtawala wakampeleka Yesu kwenye Praitorio na wakakusanya kikosi kizima cha askari kumzunguka.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

kikuyu: Wakamvua nguo zake na kumvika vazi la rangi nyekundu, kisha
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

kikuyu: wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakaiweka kichwani pake. Wakamwekea fimbo katika mkono wake wa kuume, na wakapiga magoti mbele zake na kumdhihaki, wakisema, “Salamu, mfalme wa Wayahudi!”
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Wakamtemea mate, wakachukua ile fimbo wakampiga kichwani tena na tena.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

kikuyu: Baada ya kumdhihaki, wakamvua lile joho, wakamvika tena nguo zake. Kisha wakampeleka ili wakamsulubishe.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wakienda, wakakutana na mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

kikuyu: Wakafika mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

kikuyu: Hapo wakampa Yesu divai iliyochanganywa na nyongo ili anywe; lakini alipoionja, akakataa kuinywa.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

kikuyu: Walipokwisha kumsulubisha wakagawana mavazi yake kwa kuyapigia kura. [Hili lilifanyika ili litimie lile neno lililonenwa na nabii, “Waligawa nguo zangu miongoni mwao na vazi langu wakalipigia kura.”]
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

kikuyu: Kisha wakaketi, wakamchunga.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

kikuyu: Juu ya kichwa chake, kwenye msalaba, wakaandika shtaka lake hivi: Huyu ni Yesu, Mfalme wa Wayahudi.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Wanyangʼanyi wawili walisulubiwa pamoja naye, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wa kushoto.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

kikuyu: Watu waliokuwa wakipita njiani wakamtukana huku wakitikisa vichwa vyao
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

kikuyu: na kusema, “Wewe ambaye utalivunja Hekalu na kulijenga kwa siku tatu, jiokoe mwenyewe basi! Kama wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu, shuka kutoka msalabani.”
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee wakamdhihaki wakisema,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

kikuyu: “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe! Yeye ni Mfalme wa Israeli! Ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, nasi tutamwamini.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

kikuyu: Anamwamini Mungu, basi Mungu na amwokoe sasa kama anamtaka, kwa maana alisema, ‘Mimi ni Mwana wa Mungu.’ ”
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

kikuyu: Hata wale wanyangʼanyi waliosulubiwa pamoja naye wakamtukana vivyo hivyo.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

kikuyu: Tangu saa sita hadi saa tisa giza liliifunika nchi yote.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Ilipofika saa tisa, Yesu akapaza sauti akalia, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (maana yake, “Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha?”)
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama pale waliposikia hayo, wakasema, “Anamwita Eliya.”
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Ghafula mmoja wao akaenda mbio na kuleta sifongo, akaichovya kwenye siki, akaiweka kwenye mwanzi na akampa Yesu ili anywe.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

kikuyu: Wengine wakasema, “Basi mwacheni. Hebu tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumwokoa.”
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipolia tena kwa sauti kuu, akaitoa roho yake.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

kikuyu: Wakati huo huo pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili, kuanzia juu hadi chini. Dunia ikatetemeka na miamba ikapasuka.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

kikuyu: Makaburi yakafunguka na miili ya watakatifu waliokuwa wamekufa ikafufuliwa.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

kikuyu: Wakatoka makaburini, na baada ya Yesu kufufuka, waliingia kwenye Mji Mtakatifu na kuwatokea watu wengi.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

kikuyu: Basi yule jemadari na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye wakimlinda Yesu walipoona lile tetemeko na yale yote yaliyokuwa yametukia, waliogopa, wakasema, “Hakika huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Walikuwako wanawake huko wakiangalia kwa mbali. Hawa walikuwa wamemfuata Yesu tangu Galilaya ili kushughulikia mahitaji yake.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

kikuyu: Miongoni mwao walikuwepo Maria Magdalene, na Maria mama yao Yakobo na Yosefu, na mama yao wana wa Zebedayo.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

kikuyu: Ilipofika jioni, alifika mtu mmoja tajiri kutoka Arimathaya aitwaye Yosefu, ambaye pia alikuwa mwanafunzi wa Yesu.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

kikuyu: Akamwendea Pilato ili kumwomba mwili wa Yesu. Pilato akaamuru apewe.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

kikuyu: Yosefu akauchukua mwili wa Yesu, akaufunga katika kitambaa cha kitani safi,
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

kikuyu: na kuuweka katika kaburi lake mwenyewe jipya, alilokuwa amelichonga kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kubwa katika ingilio la kaburi, akaenda zake.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

kikuyu: Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikuwepo mahali pale, wakiwa wameketi mkabala na kaburi.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

kikuyu: Kesho yake, yaani siku iliyofuata ile ya Maandalizi ya Sabato, viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakamwendea Pilato
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

kikuyu: na kusema, “Bwana, tumekumbuka kwamba yule mdanganyifu wakati alikuwa bado hai alisema, ‘Baada ya siku tatu nitafufuka.’
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo uamuru kaburi lilindwe kwa uthabiti mpaka baada ya siku tatu. La sivyo, wanafunzi wake wanaweza kuja kuuiba mwili wake na kuwaambia watu kwamba amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu. Udanganyifu huu wa mwisho utakuwa mbaya kuliko ule wa kwanza.”
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Pilato akawaambia, “Ninyi mnao askari walinzi. Nendeni, liwekeeni ulinzi kadri mwezavyo.”
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wakaenda na walinzi ili kulilinda kaburi kwa uthabiti, wakatia muhuri kwenye lile jiwe na kuweka ulinzi.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

kikuyu: Baada ya Sabato, alfajiri mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma, Maria Magdalene na yule Maria mwingine walikwenda kulitazama kaburi.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

kikuyu: Ghafula, pakawa na tetemeko kubwa la ardhi, kwa sababu malaika wa Bwana alishuka kutoka mbinguni, akaenda penye kaburi, akalivingirisha lile jiwe na kulikalia.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

kikuyu: Sura ya huyo malaika ilikuwa kama umeme, na mavazi yake yalikuwa meupe kama theluji.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

kikuyu: Wale walinzi wa kaburi walimwogopa sana, wakatetemeka hata wakawa kama wafu.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

kikuyu: Yule malaika akawaambia wale wanawake, “Msiogope, kwa maana ninajua kuwa mnamtafuta Yesu aliyesulubiwa.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

kikuyu: Hayupo hapa, kwa kuwa amefufuka, kama vile alivyosema. Njooni mpatazame mahali alipokuwa amelazwa.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

kikuyu: Kisha nendeni upesi mkawaambie wanafunzi wake kwamba, ‘Amefufuka kutoka kwa wafu, naye awatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona. Sasa nimekwisha kuwaambia.’ ”
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

kikuyu: Hivyo wale wanawake wakaondoka pale kaburini wakiwa wamejawa na hofu, bali wakiwa na furaha nyingi. Wakaenda mbio kuwaeleza wanafunzi wake habari hizo.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

kikuyu: Ghafula, Yesu akakutana nao, akasema, “Salamu!” Wale wanawake wakamkaribia, wakaishika miguu yake, wakamwabudu.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Msiogope. Nendeni mkawaambie ndugu zangu waende Galilaya, ndiko watakakoniona.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

kikuyu: Wakati wale wanawake walikuwa njiani wakienda, baadhi ya wale askari waliokuwa wakilinda kaburi walienda mjini na kuwaeleza viongozi wa makuhani kila kitu kilichokuwa kimetukia.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

kikuyu: Baada ya viongozi wa makuhani kukutana na wazee na kutunga hila, waliwapa wale askari kiasi kikubwa cha fedha
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

kikuyu: wakiwaambia, “Inawapasa mseme, ‘Wanafunzi wake walikuja wakati wa usiku na kumwiba sisi tulipokuwa tumelala.’
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

kikuyu: Kama habari hizi zikimfikia mtawala, sisi tutamwondolea mashaka nanyi hamtapata tatizo lolote.”
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wale askari wakazipokea hizo fedha nao wakafanya kama walivyoelekezwa. Habari hii imeenea miongoni mwa Wayahudi mpaka leo.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

kikuyu: Basi wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja wakaenda hadi Galilaya kwenye ule mlima ambao Yesu alikuwa amewaagiza.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

kikuyu: Walipomwona, wakamwabudu; lakini baadhi yao wakaona shaka.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

kikuyu: Yesu akawajia na kusema, “Nimepewa mamlaka yote mbinguni na duniani.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii, enendeni mkawafanye mataifa yote kuwa wanafunzi, mkiwabatiza kwa Jina la Baba na la Mwana na la Roho Mtakatifu,
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: nanyi wafundisheni kuyashika mambo yote niliyowaamuru ninyi. Hakika mimi niko pamoja nanyi siku zote, hadi mwisho wa nyakati.”
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

kikuyu: Mwanzo wa Injili ya Yesu Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu.
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

kikuyu: Kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha nabii Isaya: “Tazama, nitamtuma mjumbe wangu mbele yako, atakayetengeneza njia mbele yako”:
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

kikuyu: “sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani. ‘Itengenezeni njia ya Bwana, yanyoosheni mapito yake.’ ”
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

kikuyu: Yohana alikuja, akibatiza huko nyikani, akihubiri ubatizo wa toba kwa ajili ya msamaha wa dhambi.
english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

kikuyu: Watu kutoka Uyahudi wote na sehemu zote za Yerusalemu walikuwa wakimwendea. Nao wakaziungama dhambi zao, akawabatiza katika Mto Yordani.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Yohana alivaa mavazi yaliyotengenezwa kwa singa za ngamia na mkanda wa ngozi kiunoni mwake. Chakula chake kilikuwa nzige na asali ya mwitu.
english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: Naye alihubiri akisema, “Baada yangu atakuja yeye aliye na uwezo kuniliko mimi, ambaye sistahili hata kuinama na kulegeza kamba za viatu vyake.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

kikuyu: Mimi nawabatiza kwa maji, lakini yeye atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu.”
english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo Yesu akaja kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya, naye akabatizwa na Yohana katika Mto Yordani.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akitoka ndani ya maji, aliona mbingu zikifunguka na Roho akishuka juu yake kama hua.
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

kikuyu: Nayo sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, “Wewe ni Mwanangu mpendwa; nami nimependezwa nawe sana.”
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo huo, Roho akamwongoza Yesu kwenda nyikani,
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

kikuyu: naye akawa huko nyikani kwa muda wa siku arobaini, akijaribiwa na Shetani. Alikaa na wanyama wa mwituni, nao malaika wakamhudumia.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

kikuyu: Baada ya Yohana kukamatwa na kutiwa gerezani, Yesu aliingia Galilaya akaanza kuhubiri habari njema ya Mungu,
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

kikuyu: akisema, “Wakati umewadia, Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia. Tubuni na kuiamini Habari Njema.”
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akitembea kando ya Bahari ya Galilaya, aliwaona Simoni na Andrea nduguye wakizitupa nyavu zao baharini, kwa kuwa wao walikuwa wavuvi.
english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Njooni, nifuateni nami nitawafanya mwe wavuvi wa watu.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

kikuyu: Mara wakaacha nyavu zao, wakamfuata.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

kikuyu: Alipokwenda mbele kidogo, akamwona Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo na Yohana nduguye, wakiwa kwenye mashua yao wakizitengeneza nyavu zao.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

kikuyu: Papo hapo akawaita, nao wakamwacha Zebedayo baba yao kwenye mashua pamoja na watumishi wa kuajiriwa, nao wakamfuata Yesu.
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

kikuyu: Wakaenda mpaka Kapernaumu. Ilipofika siku ya Sabato, mara Yesu akaingia sinagogi, akaanza kufundisha.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

kikuyu: Watu wakashangaa sana kwa mafundisho yake, kwa maana aliwafundisha kama yeye aliye na mamlaka, wala si kama walimu wa sheria.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

kikuyu: Wakati huo huo katika sinagogi lao palikuwa na mtu aliyekuwa amepagawa na pepo mchafu,
english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

kikuyu: naye akapiga kelele akisema, “Tuna nini nawe, Yesu wa Nazareti? Je, umekuja kutuangamiza? Ninakujua wewe ni nani. Wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu!”
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akamkemea, akamwambia, “Nyamaza kimya! Nawe umtoke!”
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

kikuyu: Yule pepo mchafu akamtikisatikisa huyo mtu kwa nguvu, kisha akamtoka akipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

kikuyu: Watu wote wakashangaa, hata wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Haya ni mambo gani? Ni mafundisho mapya, tena yenye mamlaka! Anaamuru hata pepo wachafu, nao wanamtii!”
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

kikuyu: Sifa zake zikaanza kuenea haraka katika eneo lote la karibu na Galilaya.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

kikuyu: Mara walipotoka katika sinagogi, walikwenda pamoja na Yakobo na Yohana hadi nyumbani kwa Simoni na Andrea.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

kikuyu: Mama mkwe wa Simoni alikuwa kitandani, ana homa, nao wakamweleza Yesu habari zake.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

kikuyu: Hivyo Yesu akamwendea, akamshika mkono na kumwinua. Kisha homa ikamwacha, naye akaanza kuwahudumia.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

kikuyu: Jioni ile baada ya jua kutua, watu wakamletea Yesu wagonjwa wote na waliopagawa na pepo wachafu.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

kikuyu: Mji wote ukakusanyika mbele ya nyumba hiyo.
english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaponya watu wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa ya aina mbalimbali. Akawatoa pepo wachafu wengi, lakini hakuwaacha hao pepo wachafu waseme, kwa sababu walimjua yeye ni nani.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

kikuyu: Alfajiri na mapema sana kulipokuwa bado kuna giza, Yesu akaamka, akaondoka, akaenda mahali pa faragha ili kuomba.
english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

kikuyu: Simoni na wenzake wakaenda kumtafuta,
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

kikuyu: nao walipomwona, wakamwambia, “Kila mtu anakutafuta!”
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Twendeni mahali pengine kwenye vijiji jirani, ili niweze kuhubiri huko pia, kwa sababu hicho ndicho nilichokuja kukifanya.”
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo akazunguka Galilaya kote, akihubiri katika masinagogi yao na kutoa pepo wachafu.
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja mwenye ukoma alimjia Yesu, akamwomba akipiga magoti, akamwambia, “Ukitaka, waweza kunitakasa.”
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Yesu, akiwa amejawa na huruma, akanyoosha mkono wake akamgusa, akamwambia, “Nataka. Takasika!”
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

kikuyu: Mara ukoma ukamtoka, naye akatakasika.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

kikuyu: Baada ya Yesu kumwonya vikali, akamruhusu aende zake
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

kikuyu: akimwambia, “Hakikisha humwambii mtu yeyote habari hizi, bali nenda ukajionyeshe kwa kuhani, na ukatoe sadaka alizoagiza Mose kwa utakaso wako, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.”
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Lakini yule mtu akaenda akaanza kutangaza habari za kuponywa kwake waziwazi. Kwa hiyo, Yesu hakuweza tena kuingia katika miji waziwazi lakini alikaa sehemu zisizo na watu. Hata hivyo watu wakamfuata huko kutoka kila upande.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

kikuyu: Baada ya siku kadhaa Yesu alirudi Kapernaumu, watu wakasikia kwamba amerudi nyumbani.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

kikuyu: Hivyo watu wengi wakakusanyika kiasi kwamba hapakubaki nafasi yoyote hata mlangoni! Naye akawahubiria Neno.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

kikuyu: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wakaja wakamletea Yesu mtu aliyepooza, akiwa amebebwa na watu wanne.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa walikuwa hawawezi kumfikisha kwa Yesu kwa ajili ya umati wa watu, walitoboa tundu kwenye paa mahali pale alipokuwa Yesu, wakamshusha yule aliyepooza kwa kitanda alichokuwa amelalia.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

kikuyu: Yesu alipoiona imani yao, alimwambia yule mtu aliyepooza, “Mwanangu, dhambi zako zimesamehewa.”
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Basi baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa wameketi huko wakawaza mioyoni mwao,
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

kikuyu: “Kwa nini mtu huyu anasema hivi? Huyu anakufuru! Ni nani awezaye kusamehe dhambi isipokuwa Mungu peke yake?”
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

kikuyu: Mara moja Yesu akatambua rohoni mwake kile walichokuwa wanawaza mioyoni mwao, naye akawaambia, “Kwa nini mnawaza hivyo mioyoni mwenu?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

kikuyu: Je, ni lipi lililo rahisi zaidi: kumwambia huyu aliyepooza, ‘Umesamehewa dhambi zako,’ au kusema, ‘Inuka, uchukue mkeka wako, uende’?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

kikuyu: Lakini ili mpate kujua ya kwamba Mwana wa Adamu anayo mamlaka duniani kusamehe dhambi…” Yesu akamwambia yule aliyepooza,
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

kikuyu: “Nakuambia, inuka, chukua mkeka wako, uende nyumbani kwako.”
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Yule mtu aliyekuwa amepooza akasimama, akachukua mkeka wake, akatembea machoni pao wote! Jambo hili likawashangaza wote, wakamtukuza Mungu, wakisema, “Hatujapata kuona jambo kama hili kamwe!”
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

kikuyu: Yesu akaenda tena kandokando ya Bahari ya Galilaya. Umati mkubwa wa watu ukamfuata, naye akaanza kuwafundisha.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa akitembea, akamwona Lawi mwana wa Alfayo ameketi forodhani mahali pa kutoza ushuru, akamwambia, “Nifuate.” Lawi akaondoka, akamfuata Yesu.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akila chakula nyumbani mwa Lawi, watoza ushuru wengi pamoja na “wenye dhambi” walikuwa wakila pamoja naye na wanafunzi wake, kwa maana kulikuwa na watu wengi waliokuwa wakimfuata.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria waliokuwa Mafarisayo walipomwona akila pamoja na watoza ushuru na “wenye dhambi,” wakawauliza wanafunzi wake: “Mbona Yesu anakula pamoja na watoza ushuru na ‘wenye dhambi’?”
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Yesu aliposikia haya akawaambia, “Watu wenye afya hawahitaji tabibu, bali walio wagonjwa. Sikuja kuwaita wenye haki, bali wenye dhambi.”
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Basi wanafunzi wa Yohana pamoja na Mafarisayo walikuwa wakifunga. Baadhi ya watu wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza, “Mbona wanafunzi wa Yohana na wa Mafarisayo hufunga lakini wanafunzi wako hawafungi?”
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Wageni wa bwana arusi wawezaje kufunga wakati angali pamoja nao? Wakati bwana arusi bado yuko pamoja nao, hawawezi kufunga.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

kikuyu: Lakini wakati utafika ambapo bwana arusi ataondolewa kwao. Siku hiyo ndipo watakapofunga.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

kikuyu: “Hakuna mtu ashoneaye kiraka cha nguo mpya kwenye nguo iliyochakaa. Akifanya hivyo, kile kiraka kipya kitachanika kutoka ile nguo iliyochakaa, nayo itachanika zaidi.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Wala hakuna mtu awekaye divai mpya kwenye viriba vikuukuu. Akifanya hivyo, ile divai mpya itavipasua hivyo viriba, nayo hiyo divai itamwagika na viriba vitaharibika. Lakini divai mpya huwekwa kwenye viriba vipya.”
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

kikuyu: Siku moja ya Sabato, Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakipita katikati ya mashamba ya nafaka. Walipokuwa wakitembea, wanafunzi wake wakaanza kuvunja masuke.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

kikuyu: Mafarisayo wakamwambia, “Tazama, mbona wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa siku ya Sabato?”
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hamjasoma kamwe alivyofanya Daudi wakati yeye na wenzake walikuwa na njaa, wakahitaji chakula?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

kikuyu: Daudi aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, wakati Abiathari alikuwa kuhani mkuu, akaila ile mikate iliyowekwa wakfu, ambayo ni halali kuliwa na makuhani peke yao. Naye pia akawapa wenzake.”
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Sabato ilifanyika kwa ajili ya mwanadamu, lakini si mwanadamu kwa ajili ya Sabato.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Hivyo, Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana wa Sabato.”
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Yesu akaingia tena ndani ya sinagogi, na huko palikuwa na mtu aliyepooza mkono.
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

kikuyu: Wakawa wanamwangalia waone kama atamponya siku ya Sabato, ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia yule mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Njoo hapa mbele ya watu wote.”
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Je, ni lipi lililo halali siku ya Sabato: Ni kutenda mema au kutenda mabaya? Ni kuokoa maisha au kuua?” Lakini wao wakanyamaza kimya.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

kikuyu: Yesu akawatazama pande zote kwa hasira, akahuzunika sana kwa ajili ya ugumu wa mioyo yao. Akamwambia yule mtu mwenye mkono uliopooza, “Nyoosha mkono wako.” Akaunyoosha, nao ukaponywa kabisa!
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

kikuyu: Kisha Mafarisayo wakatoka nje, nao wakaanza kufanya shauri la kumuua Yesu wakiwa na Maherode.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake wakaondoka huko wakaenda baharini, nao umati mkubwa wa watu kutoka Galilaya ukamfuata.
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

kikuyu: Waliposikia mambo yote aliyokuwa akiyafanya, umati mkubwa wa watu ukamjia kutoka Uyahudi, Yerusalemu, Idumaya, na ngʼambo ya Yordani, pamoja na wale wa sehemu za karibu na Tiro na Sidoni.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya umati mkubwa wa watu, aliwaambia wanafunzi wake waweke tayari mashua ndogo kwa ajili yake, ili kuwazuia watu kumsonga.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa alikuwa amewaponya wagonjwa wengi, wale wenye magonjwa walikuwa wanasukumana ili wapate kumgusa.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

kikuyu: Kila mara pepo wachafu walipomwona, walianguka chini mbele yake na kupiga kelele wakisema, “Wewe ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu.”
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Lakini aliwaonya wasimseme yeye ni nani.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

kikuyu: Yesu akapanda mlimani na kuwaita wale aliowataka, nao wakamjia.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

kikuyu: Akawachagua kumi na wawili, ambao aliwaita mitume, ili wapate kuwa pamoja naye, na awatume kwenda kuhubiri
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

kikuyu: na kuwa na mamlaka ya kutoa pepo wachafu.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

kikuyu: Hawa ndio wale kumi na wawili aliowachagua: Simoni (ambaye alimwita Petro);
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

kikuyu: Yakobo mwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana nduguye (ambao aliwaita Boanerge, maana yake Wana wa Ngurumo);
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

kikuyu: Andrea, Filipo, Bartholomayo, Mathayo, Tomaso, Yakobo mwana wa Alfayo, Thadayo, Simoni Mkananayo,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

kikuyu: na Yuda Iskariote aliyemsaliti Yesu.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu aliporudi nyumbani, umati wa watu ukakusanyika tena, kiasi kwamba yeye na wanafunzi wake hawakuweza kula chakula.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

kikuyu: Ndugu zake walipopata habari wakaja ili kumchukua kwa maana watu walikuwa wakisema, “Amerukwa na akili.”
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

kikuyu: Walimu wa sheria walioteremka kutoka Yerusalemu walisema, “Amepagawa na Beelzebuli! Anatoa pepo wachafu kwa kutumia mkuu wa pepo wachafu!”
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

kikuyu: Basi Yesu akawaita na kuzungumza nao kwa mifano akasema: “Shetani awezaje kumtoa Shetani?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

kikuyu: Kama ufalme ukigawanyika dhidi yake wenyewe, ufalme huo hauwezi kusimama.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

kikuyu: Nayo nyumba kama ikigawanyika dhidi yake yenyewe, nyumba hiyo haiwezi kusimama.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

kikuyu: Naye Shetani kama akijipinga mwenyewe na awe amegawanyika, hawezi kusimama bali mwisho wake umewadia.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kuingia kwenye nyumba ya mtu mwenye nguvu na kuteka nyara mali zake asipomfunga kwanza yule mwenye nguvu. Ndipo ataweza kuteka nyara mali zake.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, dhambi zote na makufuru yote ya wanadamu watasamehewa.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

kikuyu: Lakini yeyote anayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa kamwe, atakuwa na hatia ya dhambi ya milele.”
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

kikuyu: Yesu alisema hivi kwa sababu walikuwa wanasema, “Ana pepo mchafu.”
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

kikuyu: Kisha wakaja ndugu zake Yesu pamoja na mama yake. Wakasimama nje, wakamtuma mtu kumwita.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

kikuyu: Umati wa watu ulikuwa umeketi kumzunguka, nao wakamwambia, “Mama yako na ndugu zako wako nje, wanakutafuta.”
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

kikuyu: Akawauliza, “Mama yangu na ndugu zangu ni nani?”
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

kikuyu: Kisha akawatazama wale watu waliokuwa wameketi kumzunguka pande zote, akasema, “Hawa ndio mama yangu na ndugu zangu.
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote anayetenda mapenzi ya Mungu, huyo ndiye ndugu yangu, na dada yangu na mama yangu.”
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Yesu akaanza kufundisha tena kando ya bahari. Umati wa watu uliokuwa umekusanyika kumzunguka ulikuwa mkubwa, kiasi kwamba ilimbidi Yesu aingie kwenye mashua iliyokuwa baharini na kuketi humo, nao watu wote walikuwa ufuoni mwa bahari.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

kikuyu: Akawafundisha mambo mengi kwa mifano, naye katika mafundisho yake akasema:
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

kikuyu: “Sikilizeni! Mpanzi alitoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zake.
english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa akitawanya mbegu, nyingine zilianguka kando ya njia, nao ndege wakaja na kuzila.
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

kikuyu: Nyingine zilianguka kwenye ardhi yenye mwamba isiyo na udongo wa kutosha. Zikaota haraka, kwa kuwa udongo ulikuwa haba.
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

kikuyu: Lakini jua lilipozidi, mimea ikanyauka na kukauka kwa kuwa mizizi yake haikuwa na kina.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

kikuyu: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye miiba, nayo miiba hiyo ikakua, ikaisonga hiyo mimea, hivyo haikutoa mazao.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

kikuyu: Mbegu nyingine zilianguka kwenye udongo mzuri, zikaota vizuri na kukua, zikatoa mazao, moja mara thelathini, nyingine mara sitini, na nyingine mara mia moja.”
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akasema, “Mwenye masikio ya kusikia, na asikie.”
english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Alipokuwa peke yake, watu waliokuwepo naye pamoja na wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili wakamuuliza kuhusu mifano yake.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

kikuyu: Naye akawaambia, “Ninyi mmepewa kujua siri ya Ufalme wa Mungu. Lakini kwa wale walioko nje, kila kitu husemwa kwao kwa mifano,
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

kikuyu: ili, “ ‘daima waone lakini wasitambue, daima wasikie lakini wasielewe; wasije wakageuka, wakatubu na kusamehewa!’ ”
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Hamwelewi maana ya mfano huu? Basi mtaelewaje mifano mingine?
