english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hiyo nawaambia, yoyote mtakayoyaomba mkisali, aminini ya kwamba mmeyapokea, nayo yatakuwa yenu.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

kikuyu: Nanyi kila msimamapo kusali, sameheni mkiwa na neno na mtu, ili naye Baba yenu aliye mbinguni awasamehe ninyi makosa yenu. [
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

kikuyu: Lakini kama ninyi msiposamehe, wala Baba yenu aliye mbinguni hatawasamehe ninyi makosa yenu.]”
english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

kikuyu: Wakafika tena Yerusalemu, na Yesu alipokuwa akitembea Hekaluni, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Na ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka ya kufanya hayo?”
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Nitawauliza swali moja. Nijibuni, nami nitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninafanya mambo haya.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Niambieni, je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

kikuyu: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao, wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’…” (Waliwaogopa watu, kwa sababu kila mtu aliamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii wa kweli.)
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, “Hatujui.” Naye Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Yesu akaanza kusema nao kwa mifano, akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akajenga ukuta kulizunguka, akachimba shimo ndani yake kwa ajili ya shinikizo la kusindika divai, na akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akalikodisha shamba hilo la mizabibu kwa wakulima fulani, kisha akasafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili kuchukua sehemu yake ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu kutoka kwa hao wapangaji.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Lakini wale wakulima walimkamata yule mtumishi, wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Kisha yule mwenye shamba akamtuma mtumishi mwingine kwao; nao wale wakulima wakampiga kichwani na kumfanyia mambo ya aibu.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

kikuyu: Kisha akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, naye huyo wakamuua. Akawatuma wengine wengi; baadhi yao wakawapiga, na wengine wakawaua.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

kikuyu: “Mwenye shamba alikuwa bado na mmoja wa kumtuma, mwanawe aliyempenda. Hatimaye akamtuma akisema, ‘Watamheshimu mwanangu.’
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: “Lakini wale wapangaji wakasemezana pamoja, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Njooni tumuue, nao urithi utakuwa wetu.’
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

kikuyu: Hivyo wakamchukua na kumuua, wakamtupa nje ya lile shamba la mizabibu.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

kikuyu: “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba atafanya nini? Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, kisha atawapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kikuyu: Je, hamjasoma Andiko hili: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni;
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

kikuyu: Bwana ndiye alitenda jambo hili, nalo ni ajabu machoni petu’?”
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

kikuyu: Walipotambua kuwa amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao, wakataka kumkamata, lakini wakaogopa ule umati wa watu. Wakamwacha, wakaondoka, wakaenda zao.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

kikuyu: Baadaye wakawatuma baadhi ya Mafarisayo na Maherode ili kwenda kumtega Yesu katika yale anayosema.
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

kikuyu: Wakamjia, wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, tunajua kwamba wewe ni mtu mwadilifu. Wewe huyumbishwi na wanadamu, kwa kuwa huna upendeleo. Lakini wewe huifundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli. Je, ni halali kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

kikuyu: Je, tulipe kodi au tusilipe?” Lakini Yesu alijua unafiki wao. Akawauliza “Mbona mnajaribu kunitega? Nileteeni hiyo dinariniione.”
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

kikuyu: Wakamletea hiyo sarafu. Naye akawauliza, “Sura hii ni ya nani? Na maandishi haya ni ya nani?” Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.”
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.” Nao wakamstaajabia sana.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

kikuyu: Kisha Masadukayo, wale wasemao kuwa hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu,
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

kikuyu: wakasema, “Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia kuwa kama ndugu wa mtu akifa na kumwacha mkewe bila mtoto, basi huyo mtu inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili amzalie ndugu yake watoto.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa mke, naye akafa pasipo kuwa na mtoto yeyote.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

kikuyu: Wa pili akamwoa yule mjane, lakini naye akafa bila kuacha mtoto yeyote. Ikawa vivyo hivyo kwa yule wa tatu.
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

kikuyu: Hakuna hata mmojawapo wa hao ndugu wote saba aliyeacha mtoto. Hatimaye yule mwanamke naye akafa.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wakati wa ufufuo, yeye atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, hampotoki kwa sababu hamfahamu Maandiko wala uweza wa Mungu?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

kikuyu: Wafu watakapofufuka, hawataoa wala kuolewa, bali watakuwa kama malaika wa mbinguni.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

kikuyu: Basi kuhusu wafu kufufuliwa, je hamjasoma katika Kitabu cha Mose jinsi Mungu alivyosema na Mose kutoka kile kichaka akisema, ‘Mimi ni Mungu wa Abrahamu, na Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo?’
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

kikuyu: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali ni Mungu wa walio hai. Kwa hiyo mmekosea kabisa.”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

kikuyu: Mwalimu mmoja wa sheria akaja, akawasikia wakijadiliana. Akiona kwamba Yesu amewajibu vyema, naye akamuuliza, “Katika amri zote, ni ipi iliyo kuu?”
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Amri iliyo kuu ndiyo hii: ‘Sikia ee Israeli. Bwana Mungu wetu, Bwana ndiye mmoja.
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

kikuyu: Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako wote, kwa roho yako yote, kwa akili zako zote, na kwa nguvu zako zote.’
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

kikuyu: Ya pili ndiyo hii: ‘Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.’ Hakuna amri nyingine iliyo kuu kuliko hizi.”
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

kikuyu: Yule mwalimu wa sheria akamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, umejibu vyema kwamba Mungu ni mmoja, wala hakuna mwingine ila yeye.
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

kikuyu: Kumpenda Mungu kwa moyo wote na kwa akili zote na kwa nguvu zote, na kumpenda jirani kama mtu anavyojipenda mwenyewe ni bora zaidi kuliko kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu zote.”
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipoona kwamba amejibu kwa busara, akamwambia, “Wewe hauko mbali na Ufalme wa Mungu.” Tangu wakati huo, hakuna mtu yeyote aliyethubutu kumuuliza maswali tena.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha Hekaluni, akauliza, “Imekuwaje walimu wa sheria wanasema kwamba Kristoni Mwana wa Daudi?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

kikuyu: Kwa maana Daudi mwenyewe, akinena kwa kuongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alisema: “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Daudi mwenyewe anamwita ‘Bwana.’ Awezaje basi yeye kuwa mwanawe?” Ule umati wote wa watu wakamsikiliza kwa furaha.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa akifundisha, Yesu alisema, “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni.
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

kikuyu: Pia wao hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kupewa nafasi za heshima katika karamu.
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

kikuyu: Wao hula nyumba za wajane, na ili waonekane kuwa wema wanasali sala ndefu. Watu kama hawa watapata hukumu iliyo kuu sana.”
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akaketi mkabala na sehemu ambapo sadaka zilikuwa zinawekwa na kuangalia umati wa watu wakiweka fedha zao kwenye sanduku la hazina ya Hekalu. Matajiri wengi wakaweka kiasi kikubwa cha fedha.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

kikuyu: Lakini mjane mmoja maskini akaja na kuweka sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba zenye thamani ya senti mbili.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaita wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, huyu mjane maskini ameweka katika sanduku la hazina zaidi ya watu wengine wote.
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

kikuyu: Wengine wote wametoa kutokana na ziada ya mali zao. Lakini huyu mjane ametoa kutokana na umaskini wake, akaweka kila kitu alichokuwa nacho, hata kile alichohitaji ili kuishi.”
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akitoka Hekaluni, mmojawapo wa wanafunzi wake akamwambia, “Mwalimu! Tazama jinsi mawe haya yalivyo makubwa, na majengo haya yalivyo mazuri!”
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akajibu akasema, “Je, unayaona majengo haya yalivyo makubwa? Hakuna hata jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali yote yatabomolewa.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa ameketi kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni mkabala na Hekalu, Petro, Yakobo, Yohana na Andrea wakamuuliza faraghani,
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

kikuyu: “Tafadhali tuambie, mambo haya yatatukia lini? Nayo dalili ya kuwa hayo yote yanakaribia kutimia itakuwa gani?”
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia: “Jihadharini mtu yeyote asiwadanganye.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye,’ nao watawadanganya wengi.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Msikiapo habari za vita na uvumi wa vita, msiwe na hofu. Mambo haya hayana budi kutukia, lakini ule mwisho bado.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa na ufalme dhidi ya ufalme. Kutakuwa na mitetemeko sehemu mbalimbali na njaa. Haya yatakuwa ndio mwanzo wa utungu.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: “Lakini ninyi jihadharini. Kwa maana watawapeleka katika mabaraza yao na kupigwa mijeledi katika masinagogi. Mtashtakiwa mbele ya watawala na wafalme kwa ajili yangu, ili kuwa ushuhuda kwao.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

kikuyu: Nayo habari njema lazima ihubiriwe kwanza kwa mataifa yote kabla ule mwisho haujawadia.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

kikuyu: Mtakapokamatwa na kushtakiwa, msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema. Semeni tu lolote mtakalopewa wakati huo, kwa kuwa si ninyi mtakaokuwa mkinena, bali ni Roho Mtakatifu.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: “Ndugu atamsaliti ndugu yake ili auawe, naye baba atamsaliti mtoto wake. Watoto nao wataasi dhidi ya wazazi wao na kusababisha wauawe.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: Watu wote watawachukia kwa ajili ya Jina langu. Lakini yule atakayevumilia hadi mwisho ataokolewa.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: “Mtakapoona ‘chukizo la uharibifu’ limesimama mahali pasipolipasa (asomaye na afahamu), basi wale walioko Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani.
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

kikuyu: Yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba asishuke au kuingia ndani ili kuchukua chochote.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

kikuyu: Aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua vazi lake.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

kikuyu: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

kikuyu: Ombeni mambo haya yasitokee wakati wa baridi.
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

kikuyu: Kwa maana siku hizo zitakuwa za dhiki kuu ambayo haijapata kuwako tangu mwanzo, hapo Mungu alipoumba ulimwengu, mpaka leo, na wala haitakuwako tena kamwe.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

kikuyu: Kama Bwana asingelifupisha siku hizo, kamwe asingeliokoka mtu yeyote. Lakini kwa ajili ya wateule, wale aliowachagua, amezifupisha siku hizo.
english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

kikuyu: Wakati huo mtu yeyote akiwaambia, ‘Tazama, Kristohuyu hapa!’ au, ‘Tazama, yuko kule,’ msisadiki.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Kwa maana watatokea makristo wa uongo na manabii wa uongo, nao watafanya ishara na maajabu ili kuwapotosha, ikiwezekana, hata wale wateule.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: Hivyo jihadharini. Nimekwisha kuwaambia mambo haya yote mapema kabla hayajatukia.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

kikuyu: “Lakini katika siku hizo, baada ya hiyo dhiki, “ ‘jua litatiwa giza nao mwezi hautatoa nuru yake;
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

kikuyu: nazo nyota zitaanguka kutoka angani, na nguvu za anga zitatikisika.’
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: “Ndipo watu wote watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni kwa nguvu nyingi na utukufu.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

kikuyu: Naye atawatuma malaika wake wawakusanye wateule wake kutoka pande zote nne za dunia, kutoka miisho ya dunia hadi miisho ya mbingu.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

kikuyu: “Basi jifunzeni somo hili kutokana na mtini: Matawi yake yanapoanza kuchipua na kutoa majani, mnatambua kwamba wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba wakati u karibu, hata malangoni.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

kikuyu: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kikuyu: “Kwa habari ya siku ile na saa hakuna yeyote ajuaye, hata malaika walio mbinguni wala Mwana, ila Baba peke yake.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

kikuyu: Jihadharini! Kesheni! Kwa maana hamjui wakati ule utakapowadia.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

kikuyu: Ni kama mtu anayesafiri. Anaiacha nyumba yake na kuwaachia watumishi wake kuiangalia, kila mtu na kazi yake, kisha akamwamuru yule bawabu aliye mlangoni akeshe.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

kikuyu: “Basi kesheni kwa sababu hamjui ni lini mwenye nyumba atakaporudi: iwapo ni jioni, au ni usiku wa manane, au alfajiri awikapo jogoo, au mapambazuko.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

kikuyu: Kama akija ghafula, asije akawakuta mmelala.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

kikuyu: Lile ninalowaambia ninyi, nawaambia watu wote: ‘Kesheni!’ ”
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

kikuyu: Zilikuwa zimebaki siku mbili tu kabla ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka, na Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta njia ya kumkamata Yesu kwa hila na kumuua.
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

kikuyu: Lakini walisema, “Tusilifanye jambo hili wakati wa Sikukuu, maana watu wanaweza wakafanya ghasia.”
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

kikuyu: Yesu alikuwa Bethania nyumbani kwa Simoni aliyekuwa na ukoma. Wakati alipokuwa ameketi mezani akila chakula cha jioni, mwanamke mmoja aliingia akiwa na chupa ya marhamu yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa. Akaivunja hiyo chupa, akamiminia hayo manukato kichwani mwa Yesu.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwepo pale walikuwa wakisemezana wao kwa wao, “Upotevu huu wote ni wa nini?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

kikuyu: Mafuta haya yangeweza kuuzwa kwa zaidi ya dinari 300, na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini.” Wakamkemea vikali huyo mwanamke.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Mbona mnamsumbua huyu mwanamke? Mwacheni! Yeye amenitendea jambo zuri sana.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote na mnaweza kuwasaidia wakati wowote mnaotaka. Lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

kikuyu: Huyu mwanamke amenitendea lile aliloweza. Ameumiminia mwili wangu manukato ili kuniandaa kwa maziko yangu.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, mahali popote ulimwenguni ambapo Injili itahubiriwa, jambo hili alilolitenda huyu mwanamke litatajwa pia kwa ukumbusho wake.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yuda Iskariote, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi kumi na wawili, akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani ili kumsaliti Yesu kwao.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Walifurahi sana kusikia jambo hili na wakaahidi kumpa fedha. Hivyo yeye akawa anatafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

kikuyu: Siku ya kwanza ya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo kwa desturi mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa, wanafunzi wa Yesu wakamuuliza, “Unataka twende wapi ili tukuandalie mahali pa kula Pasaka?”
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Basi akawatuma wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake, akawaambia, “Nendeni mjini. Huko mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

kikuyu: Mwambieni mwenye nyumba ile atakayoingia, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba changu cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa ghorofani, kilichopambwa tena kilicho tayari. Tuandalieni humo.”
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

kikuyu: Wale wanafunzi wakaondoka na kwenda mjini, nao wakakuta kila kitu kama Yesu alivyowaambia. Hivyo wakaiandaa Pasaka.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Ilipofika jioni, Yesu akaja pamoja na wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

kikuyu: Walipoketi mezani wakila, Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti, mmoja anayekula pamoja nami.”
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

kikuyu: Wakaanza kuhuzunika na kumuuliza mmoja baada ya mwingine, “Je, ni mimi Bwana?”
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

kikuyu: Akawajibu, “Ni mmoja miongoni mwenu ninyi kumi na wawili, yule anayechovya mkate kwenye bakuli pamoja nami.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama vile alivyoandikiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule amsalitiye Mwana wa Adamu! Ingekuwa heri kwake mtu huyo kama hangezaliwa.”
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wanakula, Yesu akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega na kuwapa wanafunzi wake, akisema, “Twaeni mle; huu ndio mwili wangu.”
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

kikuyu: Kisha akakitwaa kikombe, akashukuru, akawapa, nao wote wakanywa kutoka humo.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Hii ndiyo damu yangu ya agano, imwagikayo kwa ajili ya wengi.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, sitakunywa tena katika uzao wa mzabibu, hadi siku ile nitakapounywa mpya katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Walipokwisha kuimba wimbo, wakatoka wakaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi nyote mtaniacha, kwa maana imeandikwa: “ ‘Nitampiga mchungaji, nao kondoo watatawanyika.’
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Lakini baada ya kufufuka kwangu, nitawatangulia kwenda Galilaya.”
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: Petro akasema, “Hata kama wengine wote watakuacha, mimi sitakuacha.”
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, nakuambia; leo, usiku huu, kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, wewe mwenyewe utanikana mara tatu.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akasisitiza zaidi, “Hata kama itabidi kufa pamoja nawe, sitakukana kamwe.” Nao wale wengine wote wakasema vivyo hivyo.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

kikuyu: Wakaenda mahali paitwapo Gethsemane. Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kaeni hapa, nami niende nikaombe.”
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

kikuyu: Kisha akawachukua pamoja naye Petro, Yakobo na Yohana. Akaanza kuhuzunika sana na kutaabika.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Moyo wangu umejawa na huzuni kiasi cha kufa. Kaeni hapa na mkeshe.”
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

kikuyu: Akaenda mbele kidogo, akaanguka kifudifudi, akaomba kwamba kama ingewezekana saa hiyo ya mateso imwondokee.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

kikuyu: Akasema, “Abba,Baba, mambo yote yawezekana kwako. Niondolee kikombe hiki. Lakini si kama nipendavyo mimi, bali vile upendavyo wewe.”
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: Akarudi kwa wanafunzi wake, akawakuta wamelala. Akamwambia Petro, “Simoni, umelala? Je, hukuweza kukesha hata kwa saa moja?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

kikuyu: Kesheni na mwombe, msije mkaingia majaribuni. Roho iko radhi, lakini mwili ni mdhaifu.”
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Akaenda tena kuomba, akisema maneno yale yale.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Aliporudi, akawakuta tena wamelala kwa sababu macho yao yalikuwa mazito. Nao hawakujua la kumwambia.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

kikuyu: Akaja mara ya tatu, akawaambia, “Bado mmelala na kupumzika? Imetosha! Saa imewadia. Tazameni, Mwana wa Adamu anasalitiwa na kutiwa mikononi mwa wenye dhambi.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Inukeni, twende zetu! Tazameni, msaliti wangu yuaja!”
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, Yuda, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili, akatokea. Alikuwa amefuatana na umati wa watu wenye panga na marungu, waliokuwa wametumwa na viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, na wazee.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

kikuyu: Basi msaliti alikuwa amewapa hao watu ishara, kwamba: “Yule nitakayembusu ndiye. Mkamateni, mkamchukue chini ya ulinzi.”
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

kikuyu: Mara Yuda akamjia Yesu na kusema, “Rabi.” Akambusu.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Wale watu wakamkamata Yesu, wakamweka chini ya ulinzi.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

kikuyu: Ndipo mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu aliuchomoa upanga wake na kumpiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Mmekuja na panga na marungu kunikamata kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

kikuyu: Siku kwa siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi nikifundisha Hekaluni, wala hamkunikamata. Lakini Maandiko sharti yatimie.”
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wanafunzi wake wote wakamwacha, wakakimbia.
english: They all left him, and fled.

kikuyu: Kijana mmoja, ambaye hakuwa amevaa kitu isipokuwa alijitanda nguo ya kitani, alikuwa akimfuata Yesu. Walipomkamata,
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

kikuyu: alikimbia uchi, akaliacha vazi lake.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

kikuyu: Wakampeleka Yesu kwa kuhani mkuu, nao viongozi wa makuhani wote, na wazee na walimu wa sheria wote wakakusanyika pamoja.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

kikuyu: Petro akamfuata kwa mbali, hadi uani kwa kuhani mkuu. Huko akaketi pamoja na walinzi, akiota moto.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

kikuyu: Viongozi wa makuhani na Baraza la Wayahudi lote wakatafuta ushahidi dhidi ya Yesu ili wapate kumuua. Lakini hawakupata jambo lolote.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

kikuyu: Wengi walitoa ushahidi wa uongo dhidi yake, lakini maelezo yao hayakukubaliana.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

kikuyu: Ndipo wengine wakasimama wakatoa ushahidi wa uongo dhidi yake, wakisema:
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

kikuyu: “Sisi tulimsikia akisema, ‘Mimi nitalibomoa Hekalu hili lililojengwa na wanadamu, na katika siku tatu nitajenga jingine ambalo halikujengwa na wanadamu.’ ”
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

kikuyu: Lakini hata hivyo, ushahidi wao haukukubaliana.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

kikuyu: Basi kuhani mkuu akasimama mbele yao, akamuuliza Yesu, “Je, wewe hutajibu? Ni ushahidi gani hawa watu wanauleta dhidi yako?”
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akakaa kimya, hakusema neno lolote. Kuhani mkuu akamuuliza tena, “Je, wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu Aliyebarikiwa?”
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Mimi ndimi. Nanyi mtamwona Mwana wa Adamu akiwa ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Mwenye Nguvu, na akija juu ya mawingu ya mbinguni.”
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Kuhani mkuu akararua mavazi yake, akasema, “Tuna haja gani tena ya mashahidi zaidi?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

kikuyu: Ninyi mmesikia hayo makufuru. Uamuzi wenu ni gani?” Wote wakamhukumu kwamba anastahili kifo.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

kikuyu: Kisha baadhi ya watu wakaanza kumtemea mate; wakamfunga kitambaa machoni, wakampiga kwa ngumi na kumwambia, “Tabiri!” Walinzi wakamchukua na kumpiga makofi.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

kikuyu: Petro alipokuwa bado yuko chini kwenye ua wa jumba la kifalme, tazama akaja mmoja wa watumishi wa kike wa kuhani mkuu.
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

kikuyu: Alipomwona Petro akiota moto, akamtazama sana, akamwambia, “Wewe pia ulikuwa pamoja na Yesu, Mnazareti.”
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Sijui wala sielewi unalosema.” Naye akaondoka kuelekea kwenye njia ya kuingilia.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Yule mtumishi wa kike alipomwona mahali pale, akawaambia tena wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo, “Huyu mtu ni mmoja wao.”
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akakana tena. Baada ya muda kidogo wale waliokuwa wamesimama hapo karibu na Petro wakamwambia, “Hakika wewe ni mmoja wao, kwa maana wewe pia ni Mgalilaya!”
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

kikuyu: Petro akaanza kujilaani na kuwaapia, “Mimi simjui huyu mtu mnayesema habari zake!”
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

kikuyu: Papo hapo jogoo akawika mara ya pili. Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno Yesu alikuwa amemwambia: “Kabla jogoo hajawika mara mbili, utanikana mara tatu.” Akavunjika moyo, akalia sana.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

kikuyu: Asubuhi na mapema, viongozi wa makuhani, pamoja na wazee, walimu wa sheria na Baraza lote, wakafikia uamuzi. Wakamfunga Yesu, wakamchukua na kumkabidhi kwa Pilato.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

kikuyu: Pilato akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe umesema.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Viongozi wa makuhani wakamshtaki kwa mambo mengi.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

kikuyu: Pilato akamuuliza tena, “Je, huna la kujibu? Tazama ni mashtaka mangapi wanayaleta juu yako.”
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu hakujibu lolote, hivyo Pilato akashangaa.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

kikuyu: Ilikuwa desturi wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka kumfungulia mfungwa yeyote ambaye watu wangemtaka.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

kikuyu: Wakati huo, mtu aliyeitwa Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani pamoja na waasi wengine waliokuwa wametekeleza uuaji wakati wa maasi.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

kikuyu: Ule umati wa watu ukamjia Pilato na kumwomba awafanyie kama ilivyokuwa desturi yake.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

kikuyu: Pilato akawauliza, “Mnataka niwafungulie huyu Mfalme wa Wayahudi?”
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeye alitambua kuwa viongozi wa makuhani walikuwa wamemtia Yesu mikononi mwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Lakini viongozi wa makuhani wakauchochea ule umati wa watu wamwombe awafungulie Baraba badala yake.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

kikuyu: Pilato akawauliza tena, “Basi mnataka nifanye nini na huyu mtu mnayemwita Mfalme wa Wayahudi?”
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Wakapiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Pilato akawauliza, “Kwa nini? Amefanya kosa gani?” Lakini wao wakapiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, wakisema, “Msulubishe!”
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Pilato, akitaka kuuridhisha ule umati wa watu, akawafungulia Baraba. Naye baada ya kuamuru Yesu achapwe mijeledi, akamtoa ili asulubishwe.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

kikuyu: Askari wakampeleka Yesu hadi kwenye ukumbi wa ndani wa jumba la kifalme, ndio Praitorio, wakakusanya kikosi kizima cha askari.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

kikuyu: Wakamvalisha Yesu joho la zambarau, wakasokota taji ya miiba, wakamvika kichwani.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

kikuyu: Wakaanza kumsalimu kwa dhihaka, “Salamu, mfalme wa Wayahudi!”
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Wakampiga kwa fimbo ya mwanzi tena na tena kichwani na kumtemea mate. Wakapiga magoti mbele yake, wakamsujudia kwa kumdhihaki.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

kikuyu: Walipokwisha kumdhihaki, wakamvua lile joho la zambarau, wakamvika tena nguo zake. Kisha wakamtoa nje ili wakamsulubishe.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja kutoka Kirene, jina lake Simoni, baba yao Aleksanda na Rufo, alikuwa anapita zake kuingia mjini kutoka shamba, nao wakamlazimisha kuubeba ule msalaba.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

kikuyu: Kisha wakampeleka Yesu mpaka mahali palipoitwa Golgotha (maana yake ni Mahali pa Fuvu la Kichwa).
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

kikuyu: Nao wakampa divai iliyochanganywa na manemane, lakini hakuinywa.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

kikuyu: Basi wakamsulubisha, nazo nguo zake wakagawana miongoni mwao kwa kuzipigia kura ili kuamua ni gani kila mtu ataichukua.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

kikuyu: Ilikuwa yapata saa tatu asubuhi walipomsulubisha.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

kikuyu: Tangazo likaandikwa la mashtaka dhidi yake lenye maneno haya: “Mfalme wa Wayahudi.”
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Pamoja naye walisulubiwa wanyangʼanyi wawili, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wa kushoto. [
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

kikuyu: Nayo maandiko yakatimizwa, yale yasemayo, “Alihesabiwa pamoja na watenda dhambi.]”
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

kikuyu: Watu waliokuwa wakipita njiani wakamtukana huku wakitikisa vichwa vyao na kusema, “Aha! Wewe ambaye utalivunja Hekalu na kulijenga kwa siku tatu,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

kikuyu: basi shuka kutoka msalabani na ujiokoe mwenyewe!”
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, viongozi wa makuhani pamoja na walimu wa sheria wakamdhihaki miongoni mwao wakisema, “Aliwaokoa wengine, lakini hawezi kujiokoa mwenyewe!
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

kikuyu: Basi huyu Kristo, huyu Mfalme wa Israeli, ashuke sasa kutoka msalabani, ili tupate kuona na kuamini.” Wale waliosulubiwa pamoja naye pia wakamtukana.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

kikuyu: Ilipofika saa sita, giza liliifunika nchi yote hadi saa tisa.
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Mnamo saa tisa, Yesu akapaza sauti, akalia, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (maana yake, “Mungu wangu, Mungu wangu, mbona umeniacha?”)
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya watu waliokuwa wamesimama karibu waliposikia hayo, wakasema, “Msikieni, anamwita Eliya.”
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja akaenda mbio, akachovya sifongo kwenye siki, akaiweka kwenye mwanzi na akampa Yesu ili anywe, akisema, “Basi mwacheni. Hebu tuone kama Eliya atakuja kumshusha kutoka hapo msalabani.”
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akatoa sauti kuu, akakata roho.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

kikuyu: Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili kuanzia juu hadi chini.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

kikuyu: Basi yule jemadari aliyekuwa amesimama hapo mbele ya msalaba wa Yesu aliposikia ile sauti yake na kuona jinsi alivyokata roho, akasema, “Hakika mtu huyu alikuwa Mwana wa Mungu!”
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Walikuwepo pia wanawake waliokuwa wakiangalia kwa mbali. Miongoni mwao walikuwepo Maria Magdalene, na Maria mama yao Yakobo mdogo na Yose, pia na Salome.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

kikuyu: Hawa walifuatana na Yesu na kushughulikia mahitaji yake alipokuwa Galilaya. Pia walikuwepo wanawake wengine wengi waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja naye Yerusalemu.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ilipofika jioni, kwa kuwa ilikuwa Siku ya Maandalizi, yaani siku moja kabla ya Sabato,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

kikuyu: Yosefu wa Arimathaya, mtu aliyeheshimiwa katika Baraza, na ambaye alikuwa anautarajia Ufalme wa Mungu, akamwendea Pilato kwa ujasiri na kumwomba mwili wa Yesu.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Pilato alikuwa akijiuliza kama Yesu alikuwa amekwisha kufa. Hivyo akamwita yule jemadari, akamuuliza iwapo Yesu alikuwa amekwisha kufa.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

kikuyu: Baada ya kupata habari kutoka kwa yule jemadari kwamba kweli amekwisha kufa, Pilato akampa Yosefu ruhusa ya kuuchukua huo mwili.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

kikuyu: Hivyo Yosefu akanunua kitambaa cha kitani safi, akaushusha mwili kutoka msalabani, akaufunga katika kile kitambaa cha kitani, na kuuweka ndani ya kaburi lililochongwa kwenye mwamba. Kisha akavingirisha jiwe kwenye ingilio la kaburi.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

kikuyu: Maria Magdalene na Maria mamaye Yose walipaona mahali pale alipolazwa.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

kikuyu: Sabato ilipomalizika, Maria Magdalene, Maria mama yake Yakobo, na Salome walinunua manukato ili wakaupake mwili wa Yesu.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

kikuyu: Asubuhi na mapema, siku ya kwanza ya juma, mara tu baada ya kuchomoza jua, walikwenda kaburini.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

kikuyu: Njiani wakawa wanaulizana wao kwa wao, “Ni nani atakayetuvingirishia lile jiwe kutoka kwenye ingilio la kaburi?”
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

kikuyu: Lakini walipotazama, wakaona lile jiwe, ambalo lilikuwa kubwa sana, limekwisha kuvingirishwa kutoka pale penye ingilio la kaburi.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wakiingia mle kaburini, wakamwona kijana mmoja aliyevaa joho jeupe akiwa ameketi upande wa kuume, nao wakastaajabu.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

kikuyu: Yule malaika akawaambia, “Msistaajabu. Mnamtafuta Yesu, Mnazareti, aliyesulubiwa. Amefufuka! Hayuko hapa. Tazameni mahali walipomlaza.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

kikuyu: Lakini nendeni mkawaambie wanafunzi wake pamoja na Petro, kwamba, ‘Anawatangulia kwenda Galilaya. Huko ndiko mtamwona, kama alivyowaambia.’ ”
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

kikuyu: Hivyo wakatoka, wakakimbia kutoka mle kaburini wakiwa na hofu kuu na mshangao. Nao hawakumwambia mtu yeyote neno lolote, kwa sababu waliogopa.
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

kikuyu: Yesu alipofufuka alfajiri na mapema siku ya kwanza ya juma alimtokea kwanza Maria Magdalene, yule ambaye alikuwa amemtoa pepo wachafu saba.
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

kikuyu: Maria akaenda, naye akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamefuatana na Yesu, waliokuwa wanaomboleza na kulia.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

kikuyu: Lakini waliposikia kwamba Yesu yu hai na kwamba Maria alikuwa amemwona, hawakusadiki.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

kikuyu: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wawili miongoni mwa wanafunzi wake walipokuwa wakienda shambani akiwa katika sura nyingine.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

kikuyu: Nao wakarudi na kuwaambia wenzao. Lakini hawakuwasadiki wao pia.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

kikuyu: Baadaye Yesu akawatokea wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja walipokuwa wakila chakula. Akawakemea kwa kutoamini kwao na kwa ugumu wa mioyo yao kwa kutosadiki wale waliomwona baada yake kufufuka.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Enendeni ulimwenguni kote, mkaihubiri Injili kwa kila kiumbe.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

kikuyu: Yeyote aaminiye na kubatizwa ataokoka. Lakini yeyote asiyeamini atahukumiwa.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

kikuyu: Nazo ishara hizi zitafuatana na wanaoamini: Kwa Jina langu watatoa pepo wachafu; watasema kwa lugha mpya;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

kikuyu: watashika nyoka kwa mikono yao; na hata wakinywa kitu chochote cha kuua, hakitawadhuru kamwe; wataweka mikono yao juu ya wagonjwa, nao watapona.”
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

kikuyu: Baada ya Bwana Yesu kusema nao, alichukuliwa juu mbinguni na kuketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

kikuyu: Kisha wanafunzi wake wakatoka, wakahubiri kila mahali, naye Bwana akatenda kazi pamoja nao na kulithibitisha neno lake kwa ishara zilizofuatana nalo.]
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa watu wengi wamekaa ili kuandika habari za mambo yaliyotukia katikati yetu,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

kikuyu: kama vile yalivyokabidhiwa kwetu na wale waliokuwa mashahidi walioyaona na watumishi wa Bwana,
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

kikuyu: mimi nami baada ya kuchunguza kila kitu kwa uangalifu kuanzia mwanzo, niliamua kukuandikia habari za mambo hayo, ewe mtukufu Theofilo,
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

kikuyu: ili upate kujua ukweli kuhusu yale uliyofundishwa.
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

kikuyu: Wakati wa Herode mfalme wa Uyahudi, palikuwa na kuhani mmoja jina lake Zekaria, ambaye alikuwa wa ukoo wa kikuhani wa Abiya. Elizabeti mkewe alikuwa pia mzao wa Aroni.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Zekaria na Elizabeti mkewe wote walikuwa watu wanyofu mbele za Mungu, wakizishika amri zote za Bwana na maagizo yote bila lawama.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

kikuyu: Lakini walikuwa hawana watoto, kwa sababu Elizabeti alikuwa tasa; nao wote wawili walikuwa wazee sana.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

kikuyu: Siku moja ilipokuwa zamu ya kikundi cha Zekaria, yeye akifanya kazi ya ukuhani Hekaluni mbele za Mungu,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

kikuyu: alichaguliwa kwa kura kwa kufuata desturi za ukuhani, kuingia Hekaluni mwa Bwana ili kufukiza uvumba.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

kikuyu: Nao wakati wa kufukiza uvumba ulipowadia, wale wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika ili kuabudu walikuwa nje wakiomba.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

kikuyu: Ndipo malaika wa Bwana, akiwa amesimama upande wa kuume wa madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba, akamtokea Zekaria.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

kikuyu: Zekaria alipomwona huyo malaika, akafadhaika sana, akajawa na hofu.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

kikuyu: Lakini malaika akamwambia, “Usiogope, Zekaria, kwa maana Mungu amesikia maombi yako. Mkeo Elizabeti atakuzalia mtoto wa kiume, nawe utamwita jina lake Yohana.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

kikuyu: Yeye atakuwa furaha na shangwe kwako, nao watu wengi watashangilia kwa sababu ya kuzaliwa kwake.
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa atakuwa mkuu mbele za Bwana, kamwe hataonja mvinyo wala kinywaji chochote cha kulevya, naye atajazwa Roho Mtakatifu hata kabla ya kuzaliwa kwake.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Naye atawageuza wengi wa wana wa Israeli warudi kwa Bwana Mungu wao.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

kikuyu: Naye atatangulia mbele za Bwana katika roho na nguvu ya Eliya, ili kuigeuza mioyo ya baba kuwaelekea watoto wao, na wasiotii warejee katika hekima ya wenye haki, ili kuliweka tayari taifa lililoandaliwa kwa ajili ya Bwana.”
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

kikuyu: Zekaria akamuuliza malaika, “Jambo hilo linawezekanaje? Mimi ni mzee na mke wangu pia ana umri mkubwa.”
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

kikuyu: Malaika akamjibu, akamwambia, “Mimi ni Gabrieli, nisimamaye mbele za Mungu, nami nimetumwa kwako ili nikuambie habari hizi njema.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

kikuyu: Basi sasa kwa kuwa hujaamini maneno yangu ambayo yatatimizwa kwa wakati wake, utakuwa bubu hadi siku ile mambo haya yatakapotukia.”
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo watu walikuwa wanamngojea Zekaria nje huku wakishangaa kukawia kwake mle Hekaluni.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

kikuyu: Alipotoka akawa hawezi kusema nao, wao wakatambua kuwa ameona maono ndani ya Hekalu. Lakini kwa kuwa alikuwa bubu, akawa anawaashiria kwa mikono.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

kikuyu: Muda wake wa kuhudumu Hekaluni ulipomalizika, akarudi nyumbani kwake.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

kikuyu: Baada ya muda usio mrefu, Elizabeti mkewe akapata mimba, naye akajitenga kwa miezi mitano.
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

kikuyu: Akasema, “Hili ndilo Bwana alilonitendea aliponiangalia kwa upendeleo na kuniondolea aibu yangu mbele ya watu.”
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

kikuyu: Mwezi wa sita baada ya Elizabeti kupata mimba, Mungu alimtuma malaika Gabrieli aende Galilaya katika mji wa Nazareti,
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

kikuyu: kwa mwanamwali bikira aliyekuwa ameposwa na mtu mmoja jina lake Yosefu wa nyumba ya Daudi. Jina la huyu mwanamwali bikira ni Maria.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

kikuyu: Naye malaika akaja kwake akamwambia: “Salamu, wewe uliyebarikiwa, Bwana yu pamoja nawe!”
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

kikuyu: Maria akafadhaishwa sana na maneno haya, akajiuliza moyoni, “Salamu hii ni ya namna gani?”
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

kikuyu: Ndipo malaika akamwambia, “Usiogope, Maria, umepata kibali kwa Mungu.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

kikuyu: Tazama, utachukua mimba, nawe utamzaa mtoto mwanaume na utamwita jina lake Yesu.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

kikuyu: Yeye atakuwa mkuu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Aliye Juu Sana. Bwana Mungu atampa kiti cha enzi cha Daudi baba yake.
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

kikuyu: Ataimiliki nyumba ya Yakobo milele, na ufalme wake hautakuwa na mwisho.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Maria akamuuliza huyo malaika, “Maadamu mimi ni bikira, jambo hili litawezekanaje?”
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

kikuyu: Malaika akamjibu, “Roho Mtakatifu atakujilia juu yako, nazo nguvu zake Yeye Aliye Juu Sana zitakufunika kama kivuli. Kwa hiyo mtoto atakayezaliwa atakuwa mtakatifu, naye ataitwa Mwana wa Mungu.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

kikuyu: Tazama, jamaa yako Elizabeti amechukua mimba katika uzee wake, na huu ni mwezi wake wa sita, yeye aliyeitwa tasa.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwa Mungu hakuna lisilowezekana.”
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

kikuyu: Maria akasema, “Tazama, mimi ni mtumishi wa Bwana. Na iwe kwangu kama ulivyosema.” Kisha malaika akaondoka, akamwacha.
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

kikuyu: Wakati huo Maria akajiandaa, akaharakisha kwenda katika mji mmoja kwenye vilima vya Uyahudi.
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

kikuyu: Akaingia nyumbani kwa Zekaria na kumsalimu Elizabeti.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Naye Elizabeti aliposikia salamu ya Maria, mtoto aliyekuwa tumboni mwake akaruka. Elizabeti akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu,
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: akapaza sauti kwa nguvu akasema, “Umebarikiwa wewe miongoni mwa wanawake, naye mtoto utakayemzaa amebarikiwa.
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

kikuyu: Lakini ni kwa nini mimi nimepata upendeleo kiasi hiki, hata mama wa Bwana wangu afike kwangu?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

kikuyu: Mara tu niliposikia sauti ya salamu yako, mtoto aliyeko tumboni mwangu aliruka kwa furaha.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

kikuyu: Amebarikiwa yeye aliyeamini kwamba lile Bwana alilomwambia litatimizwa.”
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

kikuyu: Naye Maria akasema: “Moyo wangu wamwadhimisha Bwana,
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

kikuyu: nayo roho yangu inamfurahia Mungu Mwokozi wangu,
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa ameangalia kwa fadhili unyonge wa mtumishi wake. Hakika tangu sasa vizazi vyote vitaniita aliyebarikiwa,
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

kikuyu: kwa maana yeye Mwenye Nguvu amenitendea mambo ya ajabu: jina lake ni takatifu.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

kikuyu: Rehema zake huwaendea wale wamchao, kutoka kizazi hadi kizazi.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ametenda mambo ya ajabu kwa mkono wake; amewatawanya wale wenye kiburi ndani ya mioyo yao.
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

kikuyu: Amewashusha watawala toka kwenye viti vyao vya enzi, lakini amewainua wanyenyekevu.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

kikuyu: Amewashibisha wenye njaa kwa vitu vizuri, bali matajiri amewafukuza mikono mitupu.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

kikuyu: Amemsaidia mtumishi wake Israeli, kwa kukumbuka ahadi yake ya kumrehemu
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

kikuyu: Abrahamu na uzao wake milele, kama alivyowaahidi baba zetu.”
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

kikuyu: Maria akakaa na Elizabeti karibu miezi mitatu, kisha akarudi nyumbani kwake.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

kikuyu: Ulipowadia wakati wa Elizabeti kujifungua, alizaa mtoto mwanaume.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

kikuyu: Majirani zake na jamii zake wakasikia jinsi Bwana alivyomfanyia rehema kuu, nao wakafurahi pamoja naye.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

kikuyu: Siku ya nane wakaja kumtahiri mtoto, wakataka yule mtoto aitwe Zekaria, ambalo ndilo jina la baba yake.
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

kikuyu: Lakini mama yake akakataa na kusema, “Hapana! Jina lake ataitwa Yohana.”
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

kikuyu: Wakamwambia, “Hakuna mtu yeyote katika jamaa yako mwenye jina kama hilo.”
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

kikuyu: Basi wakamfanyia Zekaria baba yake ishara ili kujua kwamba yeye angependa kumpa mtoto jina gani.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

kikuyu: Akaomba wampe kibao cha kuandikia na kwa mshangao wa kila mtu akaandika: “Jina lake ni Yohana.”
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

kikuyu: Papo hapo kinywa chake kikafunguliwa na ulimi wake ukaachiwa, akawa anaongea akimsifu Mungu.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

kikuyu: Majirani wote wakajawa na hofu ya Mungu, na katika nchi yote ya vilima vya Uyahudi watu walikuwa wakinena juu ya mambo haya yote.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

kikuyu: Kila aliyesikia habari hizi alishangaa akauliza, “Je, mtoto huyu atakuwa mtu wa namna gani?” Maana mkono wa Bwana ulikuwa pamoja naye.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

kikuyu: Zekaria, baba yake, akajazwa na Roho Mtakatifu, naye akatoa unabii, akisema:
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

kikuyu: “Ahimidiwe Bwana, Mungu wa Israeli, kwa kuwa amewajilia watu wake na kuwakomboa.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

kikuyu: Naye ametusimamishia pembe ya wokovu katika nyumba ya Daudi mtumishi wake,
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

kikuyu: kama alivyonena kwa vinywa vya manabii wake watakatifu tangu zamani,
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

kikuyu: kwamba atatuokoa kutoka kwa adui zetu, na kutoka mikononi mwao wote watuchukiao:
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

kikuyu: ili kuonyesha rehema kwa baba zetu na kukumbuka Agano lake takatifu,
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

kikuyu: kiapo alichomwapia baba yetu Abrahamu:
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

kikuyu: kutuokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zetu, tupate kumtumikia yeye pasipo hofu
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

kikuyu: katika utakatifu na haki mbele zake, siku zetu zote.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

kikuyu: “Nawe mtoto wangu, utaitwa nabii wa Aliye Juu Sana; kwa kuwa utamtangulia Bwana na kuandaa njia kwa ajili yake,
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

kikuyu: kuwajulisha watu wake juu ya wokovu utakaopatikana kwa kusamehewa dhambi zao,
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

kikuyu: kwa ajili ya wingi wa rehema za Mungu wetu, nuru itokayo juu itatuzukia
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

kikuyu: ili kuwaangazia wale waishio gizani na katika uvuli wa mauti, kuiongoza miguu yetu katika njia ya amani.”
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

kikuyu: Yule mtoto akakua na kuongezeka nguvu katika roho; akaishi nyikani hadi siku ile alipojionyesha hadharani kwa Waisraeli.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

kikuyu: Siku zile Kaisari Augusto alitoa amri kwamba watu wote waandikishwe katika ulimwengu wa Kirumi.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

kikuyu: (Orodha hii ndiyo ya kwanza iliyofanyika wakati Krenio alikuwa mtawala wa Shamu).
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

kikuyu: Kila mtu alikwenda kuandikishwa katika mji wake alikozaliwa.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

kikuyu: Hivyo Yosefu akapanda kutoka mji wa Nazareti ulioko Galilaya kwenda Uyahudi, mpaka Bethlehemu, mji wa Daudi, kwa sababu yeye alikuwa wa ukoo na wa nyumba ya Daudi.
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

kikuyu: Alikwenda huko kujiandikisha pamoja na Maria, ambaye alikuwa amemposa naye alikuwa mjamzito.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

kikuyu: Wakiwa Bethlehemu, wakati wa Maria wa kujifungua ukawa umetimia,
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

kikuyu: naye akamzaa mwanawe, kifungua mimba. Akamfunika nguo za kitoto na kumlaza katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe, kwa sababu hapakuwa na nafasi katika nyumba ya wageni.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

kikuyu: Katika eneo lile walikuwako wachungaji waliokuwa wakikaa mashambani, wakilinda makundi yao ya kondoo usiku.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

kikuyu: Ghafula tazama, malaika wa Bwana akawatokea, nao utukufu wa Bwana ukawangʼaria kotekote, wakaingiwa na hofu.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

kikuyu: Lakini malaika akawaambia: “Msiogope. Kwa maana tazama nawaletea habari njema za furaha itakayokuwa kwa watu wote.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

kikuyu: Leo katika mji wa Daudi kwa ajili yenu amezaliwa Mwokozi, ndiye Kristo Bwana.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo itakayokuwa ishara kwenu: Mtamkuta mtoto mchanga amefunikwa nguo za kitoto na kulazwa katika hori ya kulia ngʼombe.”
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

kikuyu: Ghafula pakawa na jeshi kubwa la mbinguni pamoja na huyo malaika wakimsifu Mungu wakisema,
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

kikuyu: “Atukuzwe Mungu juu mbinguni, na duniani iwe amani kwa watu aliowaridhia.”
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

kikuyu: Hao malaika walipokwisha kuondoka na kwenda zao mbinguni, wale wachungaji wakasemezana wao kwa wao, “Twendeni Bethlehemu tukaone mambo haya ya ajabu yaliyotukia, ambayo Bwana ametuambia habari zake.”
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

kikuyu: Hivyo wakaenda haraka Bethlehemu, wakawakuta Maria na Yosefu na yule mtoto mchanga akiwa amelala katika hori la kulia ngʼombe.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

kikuyu: Walipomwona yule mtoto, wakawaeleza yale waliyokuwa wameambiwa kuhusu huyo mtoto.
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

kikuyu: Nao wote waliosikia habari hizi wakastaajabia yale waliyoambiwa na wale wachungaji wa kondoo.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

kikuyu: Lakini Maria akayaweka mambo haya yote moyoni mwake na kuyatafakari.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

kikuyu: Wale wachungaji wakarudi, huku wakimtukuza Mungu na kumsifu kwa ajili ya mambo yote waliyokuwa wameambiwa na kuyaona.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

kikuyu: Hata zilipotimia siku nane, ulikuwa ndio wakati wa kumtahiri mtoto, akaitwa Yesu, jina alilokuwa amepewa na malaika kabla hajatungwa mimba.
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

kikuyu: Ulipotimia wakati wa utakaso wake Maria kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Mose, basi Yosefu na Maria walimpeleka mtoto Yerusalemu, ili kumweka wakfu kwa Bwana
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

kikuyu: (kama ilivyoandikwa katika Sheria ya Bwana, kwamba, “Kila mtoto wa kiume kifungua mimba atawekwa wakfu kwa Bwana”),
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

kikuyu: na pia kutoa dhabihu kulingana na yale yaliyonenwa katika Sheria ya Bwana: “Hua wawili au makinda mawili ya njiwa.”
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

kikuyu: Basi alikuwako huko Yerusalemu mtu mmoja jina lake Simeoni, ambaye alikuwa mwenye haki na mcha Mungu, akitarajia faraja ya Israeli, na Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa juu yake.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

kikuyu: Roho Mtakatifu alikuwa amemfunulia kuwa hatakufa kabla hajamwona Kristo wa Bwana.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

kikuyu: Simeoni, akiwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu, alikwenda Hekaluni. Wazazi walipomleta mtoto Yesu ili kumfanyia kama ilivyokuwa desturi ya Sheria,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

kikuyu: ndipo Simeoni akampokea mtoto mikononi mwake na kumsifu Mungu, akisema:
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

kikuyu: “Bwana Mwenyezi, kama ulivyoahidi, sasa wamruhusu mtumishi wako aende zake kwa amani.
