english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Palikuwa na tajiri mmoja na msimamizi wake. Ilisemekana kwamba huyo msimamizi alikuwa anatumia vibaya mali ya tajiri yake.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

kikuyu: Hivyo huyo tajiri akamwita na kumuuliza, ‘Ni mambo gani haya ninayoyasikia kukuhusu? Toa taarifa ya usimamizi wako, kwa sababu huwezi kuendelea kuwa msimamizi.’
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

kikuyu: “Yule msimamizi akawaza moyoni mwake, ‘Nitafanya nini sasa? Bwana wangu ananiondoa katika kazi yangu. Sina nguvu za kulima, nami ninaona aibu kuombaomba.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

kikuyu: Najua nitakalofanya ili nikiachishwa kazi yangu hapa, watu wanikaribishe nyumbani kwao.’
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

kikuyu: “Kwa hiyo akawaita wadeni wote wa bwana wake, mmoja mmoja. Akamuuliza wa kwanza, ‘Deni lako kwa bwana wangu ni kiasi gani?’
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

kikuyu: “Akajibu, ‘Galoni 800za mafuta ya mizeituni.’ “Msimamizi akamwambia, ‘Chukua hati ya deni lako, ibadilishe upesi, uandike galoni 400.’
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

kikuyu: “Kisha akamuuliza wa pili, ‘Wewe deni lako ni kiasi gani?’ “Akajibu, ‘Vipimo 1,000vya ngano.’ “Yule msimamizi akamwambia, ‘Chukua hati yako, andika vipimo 800!’
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

kikuyu: “Yule bwana akamsifu yule msimamizi dhalimu kwa jinsi alivyotumia ujanja. Kwa maana watu wa dunia hii wana ujanja zaidi wanapojishughulisha na mambo ya dunia kuliko watu wa nuru.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

kikuyu: Nawaambia, tumieni mali ya kidunia kujipatia marafiki, ili itakapokwisha, mkaribishwe katika makao ya milele.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

kikuyu: “Yeyote aliye mwaminifu katika mambo madogo, pia ni mwaminifu hata katika mambo makubwa, naye mtu ambaye si mwaminifu katika mambo madogo pia si mwaminifu katika mambo makubwa.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

kikuyu: Ikiwa hamkuwa waaminifu katika mali ya kidunia, ni nani atakayewaaminia mali ya kweli?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

kikuyu: Nanyi kama hamkuwa waaminifu na mali ya mtu mwingine, ni nani atakayewapa iliyo yenu wenyewe?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

kikuyu: “Hakuna mtumishi awezaye kuwatumikia mabwana wawili. Kwa kuwa atamchukia huyu na kumpenda yule mwingine, au atashikamana sana na huyu na kumdharau yule mwingine. Hamwezi kumtumikia Mungu pamoja na Mali.”
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

kikuyu: Mafarisayo, waliokuwa wapenda fedha, waliyasikia hayo yote na wakamcheka kwa dharau.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi mnajionyesha kuwa wenye haki mbele za wanadamu, lakini Mungu anaijua mioyo yenu. Kwa maana vile vitu ambavyo wanadamu wanavithamini sana, kwa Mungu ni machukizo.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

kikuyu: “Sheria na Manabii vilihubiriwa mpaka kuja kwa Yohana Mbatizaji. Tangu wakati huo habari njema za Ufalme wa Mungu zinahubiriwa, na kila mmoja hujiingiza kwa nguvu.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

kikuyu: Lakini ni rahisi zaidi mbingu na dunia kupita kuliko hata herufi moja kuondoka katika Sheria.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

kikuyu: “Mtu yeyote amwachaye mkewe na kumwoa mwanamke mwingine anazini, naye mwanaume amwoaye mwanamke aliyetalikiwa anazini.
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

kikuyu: “Palikuwa na mtu mmoja tajiri aliyevaa nguo za rangi ya zambarau na kitani safi, ambaye aliishi kwa anasa kila siku.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

kikuyu: Hapo penye mlango wake aliishi maskini mmoja, jina lake Lazaro, mwenye vidonda mwili mzima.
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

kikuyu: Huyo Lazaro alitamani kujishibisha kwa makombo yaliyoanguka kutoka mezani kwa yule tajiri. Hata mbwa walikuwa wakija na kuramba vidonda vyake.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

kikuyu: “Wakati ukafika yule maskini akafa, nao malaika wakamchukua akae pamoja na Abrahamu. Yule tajiri naye akafa na akazikwa.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

kikuyu: Kule kuzimu alipokuwa akiteseka, alitazama juu, akamwona Abrahamu kwa mbali, naye Lazaro alikuwa karibu yake.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

kikuyu: Hivyo yule tajiri akamwita, ‘Baba Abrahamu, nihurumie na umtume Lazaro achovye ncha ya kidole chake ndani ya maji aupoze ulimi wangu, kwa sababu nina maumivu makuu kwenye moto huu.’
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

kikuyu: “Lakini Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Mwanangu, kumbuka kwamba wakati wa uhai wako ulipata mambo mazuri, lakini Lazaro alipata mambo mabaya. Lakini sasa anafarijiwa hapa na wewe uko katika maumivu makuu.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya hayo, kati yetu na ninyi huko kumewekwa shimo kubwa, ili wale wanaotaka kutoka huku kuja huko wasiweze, wala mtu yeyote asiweze kuvuka kutoka huko kuja kwetu.’
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

kikuyu: “Akasema, ‘Basi, nakuomba, umtume Lazaro aende nyumbani kwa baba yangu,
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

kikuyu: maana ninao ndugu watano. Awaonye, ili wasije nao wakafika mahali hapa pa mateso.’
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

kikuyu: “Abrahamu akamjibu, ‘Ndugu zako wana Maandiko ya Mose na Manabii, wawasikilize hao.’
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

kikuyu: “Yule tajiri akasema, ‘Hapana, baba Abrahamu, lakini mtu kutoka kwa wafu akiwaendea, watatubu.’
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

kikuyu: “Abrahamu akamwambia, ‘Kama wasipowasikiliza Mose na Manabii, hawataweza kushawishika hata kama mtu akifufuka kutoka kwa wafu.’ ”
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Mambo yanayosababisha watu watende dhambi hayana budi kutukia. Lakini ole wake mtu yule anayeyasababisha.
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

kikuyu: Ingekuwa heri kama mtu huyo angefungiwa jiwe la kusagia shingoni na kutoswa baharini, kuliko kumsababisha mmojawapo wa hawa wadogo kutenda dhambi.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, jilindeni. “Kama ndugu yako akikukosea mwonye, naye akitubu, msamehe.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

kikuyu: Kama akikukosea mara saba kwa siku moja na mara saba kwa siku moja akaja kwako akisema, ‘Ninatubu,’ msamehe.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

kikuyu: Mitume wake wakamwambia Bwana, “Tuongezee imani.”
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

kikuyu: Bwana akawajibu, “Kama mkiwa na imani ndogo kama punje ya haradali, mngeweza kuuambia mti huu wa mkuyu, ‘Ngʼoka ukaote baharini,’ nao ungewatii.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

kikuyu: “Ikiwa mmoja wenu ana mtumishi anayelima shambani au anayechunga kondoo, je, mtumishi huyo arudipo atamwambia, ‘Karibu hapa keti ule chakula?’
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

kikuyu: Je, badala yake, hatamwambia, ‘Niandalie chakula, nile, jifunge unitumikie ninapokula na kunywa; baadaye waweza kula na kunywa?’
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

kikuyu: Je, huyo mtu atamshukuru mtumishi huyo kwa kutimiza yale aliyoamriwa?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo nanyi mkiisha kufanya mliyoagizwa, semeni, ‘Sisi tu watumishi tusiostahili; tumefanya tu yale tuliyopaswa kufanya.’ ”
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa njiani akienda Yerusalemu, alipitia mpakani mwa Samaria na Galilaya.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa akiingia kwenye kijiji kimoja, watu kumi waliokuwa na ukoma wakakutana naye. Wakasimama mbali,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

kikuyu: wakapaza sauti, wakasema, “Yesu, Bwana, tuhurumie!”
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

kikuyu: Alipowaona akawaambia, “Nendeni mkajionyeshe kwa makuhani.” Nao walipokuwa njiani wakienda, wakatakasika.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

kikuyu: Mmoja wao alipoona kwamba amepona, akarudi kwa Yesu, akimsifu Mungu kwa sauti kuu.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

kikuyu: Akajitupa miguuni mwa Yesu akamshukuru. Yeye alikuwa Msamaria.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

kikuyu: Yesu akauliza, “Je, hawakutakaswa wote kumi? Wako wapi wale wengine tisa?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

kikuyu: Hakuna hata mmoja aliyeonekana kurudi ili kumshukuru Mungu isipokuwa huyu mgeni?”
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka na uende zako, imani yako imekuponya.”
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipoulizwa na Mafarisayo Ufalme wa Mungu utakuja lini, yeye akawajibu, “Ufalme wa Mungu hauji kwa kuchunguza kwa bidii,
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

kikuyu: wala watu hawatasema, ‘Huu hapa,’ au ‘Ule kule,’ kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu umo ndani yenu.”
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Wakati utafika ambapo mtatamani kuiona moja ya siku ya Mwana wa Adamu, lakini hamtaiona.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

kikuyu: Watu watawaambia, ‘Yule kule!’ Au, ‘Huyu hapa!’ Msiwakimbilie.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama vile umeme wa radi umulikavyo katika anga kuanzia mwisho mmoja hadi mwingine, ndivyo atakavyokuwa Mwana wa Adamu katika siku yake.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

kikuyu: Lakini kwanza itampasa kuteseka katika mambo mengi na kukataliwa na kizazi hiki.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

kikuyu: “Kama ilivyokuwa siku za Noa, ndivyo itakavyokuwa katika siku za Mwana wa Adamu.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

kikuyu: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakioa na kuolewa, mpaka siku ile Noa alipoingia katika safina. Ndipo gharika ikaja na kuwaangamiza wote.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: “Ndivyo ilivyokuwa katika siku za Loti: Watu walikuwa wakila na kunywa, wakinunua na kuuza, wakilima na kujenga.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

kikuyu: Lakini siku ile Loti alipoondoka Sodoma, ikanyesha mvua ya moto na kiberiti kutoka mbinguni ukawaangamiza wote.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: “Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa siku ile Mwana wa Adamu atakapofunuliwa.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

kikuyu: Siku hiyo, mtu yeyote aliye juu ya dari ya nyumba yake, hata vitu vyake vikiwa ndani ya hiyo nyumba, asishuke kuvichukua. Vivyo hivyo mtu aliye shambani asirudi nyumbani kuchukua chochote.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

kikuyu: Mkumbukeni mke wa Loti!
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote anayejaribu kuyaokoa maisha yake atayapoteza, na yeyote atakayeyapoteza maisha yake atayaokoa.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

kikuyu: Nawaambia, usiku huo watu wawili watakuwa wamelala kitanda kimoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

kikuyu: Wanawake wawili watakuwa wanasaga nafaka pamoja; naye mmoja atatwaliwa na mwingine ataachwa. [
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

kikuyu: Kisha wakamuuliza, “Haya yatatukia wapi Bwana?” Akawaambia, “Pale ulipo mzoga, huko ndiko tai watakapokusanyika.”
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawapa wanafunzi wake mfano ili kuwaonyesha kuwa yawapasa kuomba pasipo kukata tamaa.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Katika mji mmoja alikuwepo hakimu ambaye hakumwogopa Mungu wala kumjali mtu.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

kikuyu: Katika mji huo alikuwako mjane mmoja ambaye alikuwa akija kwake mara kwa mara akimwomba, ‘Tafadhali nipatie haki kati yangu na adui yangu.’
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

kikuyu: “Kwa muda mrefu yule hakimu alikataa. Lakini hatimaye akasema moyoni mwake, ‘Ijapokuwa simwogopi Mungu wala simjali mwanadamu,
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

kikuyu: lakini kwa kuwa huyu mjane ananisumbuasumbua, nitahakikisha amepata haki yake ili asiendelee kunichosha kwa kunijia mara kwa mara!’ ”
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

kikuyu: Bwana akasema, “Sikilizeni asemavyo huyu hakimu dhalimu.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

kikuyu: Je, Mungu hatawatendea haki wateule wake wanaomlilia usiku na mchana? Je, atakawia kuwasaidia?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

kikuyu: Ninawaambia, atawapatia haki upesi. Lakini je, Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja ataikuta imani duniani?”
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

kikuyu: Yesu akatoa mfano huu kwa wale waliojiamini kuwa wao ni wenye haki na kuwadharau wengine:
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

kikuyu: “Watu wawili walikwenda Hekaluni kusali, mmoja wao alikuwa Farisayo na mwingine alikuwa mtoza ushuru.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

kikuyu: Yule Farisayo, akasimama, akasali hivi na kuomba kwake mwenyewe: ‘Mungu, nakushukuru kwa sababu mimi si kama watu wengine ambao ni wanyangʼanyi, wadhalimu, na wazinzi, wala kama huyu mtoza ushuru.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

kikuyu: Mimi nafunga mara mbili kwa juma, na natoa sehemu ya kumi ya mapato yangu.’
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

kikuyu: “Lakini yule mtoza ushuru akasimama mbali, wala hakuthubutu hata kuinua uso wake kutazama mbinguni, bali alijipigapiga kifuani na kusema: ‘Mungu, nihurumie, mimi mwenye dhambi.’
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

kikuyu: “Nawaambia, huyu mtoza ushuru alirudi nyumbani akiwa amehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu zaidi ya yule Farisayo. Kwa maana yeyote ajikwezaye atashushwa, na yeyote ajishushaye atakwezwa.”
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Pia, watu walikuwa wakimletea Yesu watoto wachanga ili awaguse. Wanafunzi wake walipoona hivyo, wakawakemea.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akawaita wale watoto waje kwake, akasema, “Waacheni watoto wadogo waje kwangu, wala msiwazuie, kwa maana Ufalme wa Mungu ni wa wale walio kama hawa.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Amin, nawaambia, mtu yeyote asiyeupokea Ufalme wa Mungu kama mtoto mdogo, hatauingia kamwe.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Mtawala mmoja akamuuliza Yesu, “Mwalimu mwema, nifanye nini ili niurithi uzima wa milele?”
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Mbona unaniita mwema? Hakuna yeyote aliye mwema ila Mungu peke yake.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

kikuyu: Unazijua amri: ‘Usizini, usiue, usiibe, usishuhudie uongo, waheshimu baba yako na mama yako.’ ”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

kikuyu: Akajibu, “Amri hizi zote nimezishika tangu nikiwa mtoto.”
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

kikuyu: Yesu aliposikia haya, akamwambia, “Bado kuna jambo moja ulilopungukiwa. Nenda ukauze kila kitu ulicho nacho, uwape maskini, nawe utakuwa na hazina mbinguni. Kisha njoo, unifuate.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

kikuyu: Aliposikia jambo hili, alisikitika sana kwa maana alikuwa mtu mwenye mali nyingi.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

kikuyu: Yesu akamtazama, akasema, “Tazama jinsi ilivyo vigumu kwa tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu!
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: Hakika ni rahisi zaidi kwa ngamia kupita kwenye tundu la sindano kuliko mtu tajiri kuingia katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Wale waliosikia haya wakauliza, “Ni nani basi awezaye kuokoka?”
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Yasiyowezekana kwa wanadamu yanawezekana kwa Mungu.”
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Petro akamjibu, “Tazama, tumeacha vyote tulivyokuwa navyo tukakufuata!”
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, nawaambia, hakuna hata mtu aliyeacha nyumba yake, au mke, au ndugu, au wazazi au watoto kwa ajili ya Ufalme wa Mungu
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

kikuyu: ambaye hatapewa mara nyingi zaidi ya hivyo katika maisha haya, na hatimaye kupata uzima wa milele ujao.”
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawachukua wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili kando na kuwaambia, “Tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na kila kitu kilichoandikwa na manabii kumhusu Mwana wa Adamu kitatimizwa.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa atatiwa mikononi mwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, nao watamdhihaki, watamtukana na kumtemea mate, watampiga mijeledi na kumuua.
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

kikuyu: Naye siku ya tatu atafufuka.”
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa mambo haya, kwa kuwa maana yake ilikuwa imefichika kwao, nao hawakujua Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia nini.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya njia akiomba msaada.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

kikuyu: Kipofu huyo aliposikia umati wa watu ukipita, akauliza, “Kuna nini?”
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

kikuyu: Wakamwambia, “Yesu wa Nazareti anapita.”
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

kikuyu: Akapaza sauti, akasema, “Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Wale waliokuwa wametangulia mbele wakamkemea, wakamwambia akae kimya. Lakini yeye akapaza sauti zaidi, “Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!”
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Yesu akasimama, akawaamuru wamlete huyo mtu kwake. Alipokaribia, Yesu akamuuliza,
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

kikuyu: “Unataka nikufanyie nini?” Akajibu, “Bwana, nataka kuona.”
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Basi upate kuona. Imani yako imekuponya.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Akapata kuona saa ile ile, akamfuata Yesu, huku akimsifu Mungu. Watu wote walipoona mambo hayo, nao wakamsifu Mungu.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

kikuyu: Yesu akaingia Yeriko, naye alikuwa anapita katikati ya huo mji.
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

kikuyu: Tazama, palikuwa na mtu mmoja mkuu wa watoza ushuru naye alikuwa tajiri, jina lake Zakayo.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

kikuyu: Yeye alikuwa akijitahidi kumwona Yesu ni mtu wa namna gani. Lakini kutokana na umati mkubwa wa watu hakuweza kwa sababu alikuwa mfupi wa kimo.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo akatangulia mbio mbele ya umati wa watu akapanda juu ya mkuyu ili amwone Yesu, kwa sababu angeipitia njia ile.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

kikuyu: Yesu alipofika pale chini ya huo mkuyu, akatazama juu, akamwambia, “Zakayo, shuka upesi, kwa maana leo nitakuwa mgeni nyumbani kwako!”
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Zakayo akashuka upesi, akamkaribisha Yesu nyumbani kwake kwa furaha kubwa.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

kikuyu: Watu wote walipoona hivyo, wakaanza kunungʼunika wakisema, “Amekwenda kuwa mgeni wa ‘mtu mwenye dhambi.’ ”
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Lakini Zakayo akasimama na kumwambia Bwana, “Tazama, Bwana! Sasa hivi nusu ya mali yangu ninawapa maskini, nami kama nimemdhulumu mtu yeyote kitu chochote, nitamrudishia mara nne ya hicho kiwango.”
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akamwambia, “Leo, wokovu umeingia nyumbani humu, kwa sababu huyu naye ni mwana wa Abrahamu.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu amekuja kutafuta na kuokoa kile kilichopotea.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wanasikiliza haya, Yesu akaendelea kuwaambia mfano, kwa sababu alikuwa anakaribia Yerusalemu na watu walikuwa wakidhani ya kuwa Ufalme wa Mungu ulikuwa unakuja saa iyo hiyo.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

kikuyu: Hivyo akawaambia: “Mtu mmoja mwenye cheo kikubwa alisafiri kwenda nchi ya mbali ili akapokee madaraka ya kuwa mfalme, kisha arudi.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

kikuyu: Hivyo akawaita kumi miongoni mwa watumishi wake, na akawapa kila mmoja fungu la fedha. Akawaambia, ‘Fanyeni biashara na fedha hizi mpaka nitakaporudi.’
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

kikuyu: “Lakini raiya wa nchi yake walimchukia wakapeleka ujumbe na kusema, ‘Hatutaki huyu mtu awe mfalme wetu.’
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

kikuyu: “Hata hivyo alirudi akiwa amekwisha kupokea mamlaka ya ufalme, akawaita wale watumishi wake aliokuwa amewaachia fedha, ili afahamu ni faida kiasi gani kila mmoja wao aliyopata kwa kufanya biashara.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

kikuyu: “Wa kwanza akaja na kusema, ‘Bwana, kutokana na fedha uliyoniachia, nimepata faida mara kumi zaidi.’
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

kikuyu: “Yule bwana akamjibu, ‘Umefanya vizuri mtumishi mwema! Kwa sababu umekuwa mwaminifu katika wajibu mdogo sana, nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji kumi.’
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

kikuyu: “Wa pili naye akaja. Akasema, ‘Bwana, fedha yako imeleta faida mara tano zaidi.’
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

kikuyu: “Bwana wake akajibu, ‘Nakupa mamlaka juu ya miji mitano.’
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

kikuyu: “Kisha akaja yule mtumishi mwingine, akasema, ‘Bwana, hii hapa fedha yako. Niliitunza vizuri kwenye kitambaa.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

kikuyu: Nilikuogopa, kwa sababu wewe ni mtu mgumu. Unachukua ambapo hukuweka kitu, na unavuna mahali ambapo hukupanda kitu.’
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

kikuyu: “Bwana wake akamjibu, ‘Nitakuhukumu kwa maneno yako mwenyewe, wewe mtumishi mwovu! Kama ulifahamu kwamba mimi ni mtu mgumu, nichukuaye mahali ambapo sikuweka kitu na kuvuna mahali ambapo sikupanda,
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

kikuyu: kwa nini basi hukuweka fedha zangu kwa watoa riba, ili nitakaporudi nichukue iliyo yangu na riba yake?’
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

kikuyu: “Ndipo akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamesimama karibu, ‘Mnyangʼanyeni fungu lake la fedha, mkampe yule mwenye kumi.’
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

kikuyu: “Wakamwambia, ‘Bwana, mbona; tayari anayo mafungu kumi!’
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

kikuyu: “Akawajibu, ‘Nawaambia kwamba kila aliye na kitu, ataongezewa. Lakini yule asiye na kitu, hata alicho nacho atanyangʼanywa.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

kikuyu: Lakini wale adui zangu ambao hawakutaka mimi niwe mfalme juu yao. Waleteni hapa mkawaue mbele yangu.’ ”
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

kikuyu: Baada ya Yesu kusema haya, alitangulia kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Naye alipokaribia Bethfage na Bethania kwenye mlima uitwao Mlima wa Mizeituni, aliwatuma wanafunzi wake wawili, akawaambia,
english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

kikuyu: “Nendeni katika kijiji kilichoko mbele yenu. Na mtakapokuwa mnaingia kijijini, mtamkuta mwana-punda amefungwa hapo, ambaye hajapandwa na mtu bado. Mfungueni, mkamlete hapa.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

kikuyu: Kama mtu akiwauliza, ‘Mbona mnamfungua?’ Mwambieni, ‘Bwana anamhitaji.’ ”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

kikuyu: Wale waliotumwa wakaenda, wakakuta kila kitu kama vile Yesu alivyokuwa amewaambia.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wanamfungua yule mwana-punda, wenyewe wakawauliza, “Mbona mnamfungua huyo mwana-punda?”
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

kikuyu: Wale wanafunzi wakajibu, “Bwana anamhitaji.”
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

kikuyu: Wakamleta kwa Yesu, nao baada ya kutandika mavazi yao juu ya huyo mwana-punda, wakampandisha Yesu juu yake.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa akienda akiwa amempanda, watu wakatandaza mavazi yao barabarani.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

kikuyu: Alipokaribia mahali yanapoanzia materemko ya Mlima wa Mizeituni, umati wote wa wafuasi wake wakaanza kumsifu Mungu kwa furaha kwa sauti kuu kwa ajili ya matendo yote ya miujiza waliyoyaona. Wakasema:
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

kikuyu: “Amebarikiwa Mfalme ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amani mbinguni na utukufu huko juu sana.”
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwamo miongoni mwa ule umati wa watu wakamwambia, “Mwalimu, waamuru wanafunzi wako wanyamaze.”
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Nawaambia ninyi, kama hawa wakinyamaza, mawe yatapiga kelele.”
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

kikuyu: Alipokaribia Yerusalemu na kuuona mji, aliulilia,
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

kikuyu: akisema, “Laiti ungalijua hata wewe leo yale ambayo yangeleta amani, lakini sasa yamefichika machoni pako.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

kikuyu: Hakika siku zinakujia, ambazo adui zako watakuzingira, nao watakuzunguka pande zote na kukuzuilia ndani.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

kikuyu: Watakuponda chini, wewe na watoto walioko ndani ya kuta zako. Nao hawataacha hata jiwe moja juu ya jingine, kwa sababu hukutambua wakati wa kujiliwa kwako.”
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

kikuyu: Ndipo akaingia eneo la Hekalu, akaanza kuwafukuza wale waliokuwa wakiuza vitu humo.
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

kikuyu: Naye akawaambia, “Imeandikwa, ‘Nyumba yangu itakuwa nyumba ya sala,’ lakini ninyi mmeifanya kuwa ‘pango la wanyangʼanyi.’ ”
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

kikuyu: Kila siku alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni. Lakini viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa watu walikuwa wakitafuta njia ili kumuua.
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

kikuyu: Lakini hawakupata nafasi kwa sababu watu wote walimfuata wakiyasikiliza maneno yake kwa usikivu mwingi.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

kikuyu: Siku moja, Yesu alipokuwa akifundisha watu Hekaluni na kuhubiri habari njema, viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria, pamoja na wazee wa watu wakamjia.
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Tuambie, unafanya mambo haya kwa mamlaka gani? Ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya?”
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

kikuyu: Akawajibu, “Nami nitawauliza swali.
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

kikuyu: Je, ubatizo wa Yohana ulitoka mbinguni au kwa wanadamu?”
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

kikuyu: Wakahojiana wao kwa wao wakisema, “Kama tukisema, ‘Ulitoka mbinguni,’ atatuuliza, ‘Mbona hamkumwamini?’
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

kikuyu: Lakini tukisema, ‘Ulitoka kwa wanadamu,’ watu wote watatupiga mawe, kwa sababu wanaamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

kikuyu: Basi wakajibu, “Hatujui ulikotoka.”
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Wala mimi sitawaambia ni kwa mamlaka gani ninatenda mambo haya.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Akaendelea kuwaambia watu mfano huu: “Mtu mmoja alipanda shamba la mizabibu, akalikodisha kwa wakulima fulani, kisha akasafiri kwa muda mrefu.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

kikuyu: Wakati wa mavuno ulipofika, akamtuma mtumishi wake kwa hao wapangaji ili wampe sehemu ya mavuno ya shamba la mizabibu. Lakini wale wakulima wakampiga, wakamfukuza mikono mitupu.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Akamtuma mtumishi mwingine, huyo naye wakampiga, wakamfanyia mambo ya aibu na kumfukuza.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Bado akamtuma na mwingine wa tatu, huyu pia wakamjeruhi na kumtupa nje ya shamba.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

kikuyu: “Basi yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu akasema, ‘Nifanye nini? Nitamtuma mwanangu mpendwa, huenda yeye watamheshimu.’
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

kikuyu: “Lakini wale wapangaji walipomwona, wakasemezana wao kwa wao. Wakasema, ‘Huyu ndiye mrithi. Basi na tumuue ili urithi uwe wetu.’
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wakamtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, wakamuua.” “Sasa basi yule mwenye shamba la mizabibu atawafanyia nini wapangaji hawa?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

kikuyu: Atakuja na kuwaua hao wapangaji, na kuwapa wapangaji wengine hilo shamba la mizabibu.” Watu waliposikia hayo wakasema, “Mungu apishie mbali jambo hili lisitokee!”
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akawakazia macho, akasema, “Basi ni nini maana ya yale yaliyoandikwa: “ ‘Jiwe walilolikataa waashi, limekuwa jiwe kuu la pembeni’?
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

kikuyu: Kila mtu aangukaye juu ya jiwe hilo atavunjika vipande vipande, lakini yule litakayemwangukia atasagwa kabisa.”
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

kikuyu: Walimu wa sheria na viongozi wa makuhani wakatafuta njia ya kumkamata mara moja, kwa sababu walifahamu kwamba amesema mfano huo kwa ajili yao. Lakini waliwaogopa watu.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wakawa wanamchunguza na kutuma wapelelezi waliojifanya kuwa wenye haki ili wapate kumtega kwa maneno asemayo, ili wamtie katika uwezo na mamlaka ya mtawala.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

kikuyu: Hivyo wale wapelelezi wakamuuliza, “Mwalimu, tunajua unasema na kufundisha yaliyo kweli wala humpendelei mtu, bali wafundisha njia ya Mungu katika kweli.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

kikuyu: Je, ni halali sisi kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari, au la?”
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akatambua hila yao, kwa hiyo akawaambia,
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

kikuyu: “Nionyesheni dinari. Je, sura hii na maandishi haya yaliyoko juu yake ni vya nani?”
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Wakamjibu, “Ni vya Kaisari.” Akawaambia, “Basi mpeni Kaisari kilicho cha Kaisari, naye Mungu mpeni kilicho cha Mungu.”
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Wakashindwa kumkamata kwa yale aliyokuwa amesema hadharani. Nao wakashangazwa mno na majibu yake, wakanyamaza kimya.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

kikuyu: Baadhi ya Masadukayo, wale wasemao kwamba hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, wakamjia Yesu na kumuuliza,
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

kikuyu: “Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia kwamba kama ndugu wa mtu akifa na kumwacha mkewe bila mtoto, basi huyo mtu inampasa amwoe huyo mjane ili amzalie ndugu yake watoto.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

kikuyu: Basi palikuwepo ndugu saba. Yule wa kwanza akaoa, akafa bila kuzaa mtoto.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

kikuyu: Kisha yule wa pili akamwoa huyo mjane, naye akafa bila mtoto,
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

kikuyu: naye wa tatu pia akamwoa. Vivyo hivyo ndugu wote saba wakawa wamemwoa huyo mwanamke, na wote wakafa pasipo yeyote kupata mtoto.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

kikuyu: Mwishowe, yule mwanamke naye akafa.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

kikuyu: Sasa basi, siku ya ufufuo huyo mwanamke atakuwa mke wa nani, maana aliolewa na ndugu wote saba?”
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Katika maisha haya watu huoa na kuolewa.
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

kikuyu: Lakini wale ambao wamehesabiwa kwamba wanastahili kupata nafasi katika ulimwengu ule na katika ufufuo wa wafu, hawaoi wala hawaolewi.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

kikuyu: Hawa hawawezi kufa tena, kwa maana wao ni kama malaika. Wao ni watoto wa Mungu, kwa sababu ni watoto wa ufufuo.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

kikuyu: Hata Mose alidhihirisha kuwa wafu wanafufuka, kwa habari ya kile kichaka kilichokuwa kikiwaka moto bila kuteketea, alipomwita Bwana, ‘Mungu wa Abrahamu, Mungu wa Isaki, na Mungu wa Yakobo.’
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

kikuyu: Yeye si Mungu wa wafu, bali wa walio hai, kwa kuwa kwake wote ni hai.”
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya walimu wa sheria wakasema, “Mwalimu, umesema sawasawa kabisa!”
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

kikuyu: Baada ya hayo hakuna mtu aliyethubutu kumuuliza maswali tena.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Imekuwaje basi wao husema Kristoni Mwana wa Daudi?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

kikuyu: Daudi mwenyewe anasema katika Kitabu cha Zaburi: “ ‘Bwana alimwambia Bwana wangu: “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

kikuyu: hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako.” ’
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Ikiwa Daudi anamwita yeye ‘Bwana,’ basi atakuwaje mwanawe?”
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

kikuyu: Wakati watu wote walikuwa wanamsikiliza, Yesu akawaambia wanafunzi wake,
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: “Jihadharini na walimu wa sheria. Wao hupenda kutembea wakiwa wamevaa mavazi marefu, na kusalimiwa kwa heshima masokoni. Hupenda kukaa kwenye viti vya mbele katika masinagogi, na kukaa kwenye nafasi za heshima katika karamu.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

kikuyu: Wao hula nyumba za wajane, na ili waonekane kuwa wema, wanasali sala ndefu. Watu kama hawa watapata hukumu iliyo kuu sana.”
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipoinua macho yake, aliwaona matajiri wakiweka sadaka zao kwenye sanduku la hazina ya Hekalu.
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

kikuyu: Akamwona pia mjane mmoja maskini akiweka humo sarafu mbili ndogo za shaba.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Amin, nawaambia, huyu mjane maskini ameweka humo zaidi ya watu wengine wote.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

kikuyu: Hawa watu wengine wote wametoa sadaka kutokana na wingi wa mali zao. Lakini huyu mjane ametoa kutokana na umaskini wake vyote alivyokuwa navyo, hata kile alichohitaji ili kuishi.”
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya wanafunzi wake wakawa wanamwonyesha jinsi Hekalu lilivyopambwa kwa mawe mazuri na kwa vitu vilivyotolewa kuwa sadaka kwa Mungu. Lakini Yesu akawaambia,
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

kikuyu: “Kuhusu haya mnayoyaona hapa, wakati utafika ambapo hakuna jiwe moja litakalobaki juu ya jingine, bali kila moja litabomolewa.”
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Mwalimu, mambo haya yatatukia lini? Ni dalili gani itaonyesha kwamba yanakaribia kutendeka?”
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Jihadharini msije mkadanganywa. Maana wengi watakuja kwa Jina langu, wakidai, ‘Mimi ndiye,’ na, ‘Wakati umekaribia.’ Msiwafuate.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

kikuyu: Lakini msikiapo habari za vita na machafuko, msiogope. Kwa maana hayo ni lazima yatokee kwanza, ila ule mwisho hautakuja wakati huo.”
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

kikuyu: Kisha akawaambia: “Taifa litainuka dhidi ya taifa jingine, na ufalme mmoja dhidi ya ufalme mwingine.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: Kutakuwa na mitetemeko mikubwa ya ardhi, na njaa kali, na magonjwa ya kuambukiza katika sehemu mbalimbali. Pia kutakuwa na matukio ya kutisha na ishara kuu kutoka mbinguni.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

kikuyu: “Lakini kabla yote hayajatokea, watawakamata ninyi na kuwatesa. Watawatia mikononi mwa wakuu wa masinagogi na kuwafunga magerezani. Nanyi mtapelekwa mbele ya wafalme na watawala kwa ajili ya Jina langu.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Hii itawapa nafasi ya kushuhudia.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

kikuyu: Lakini kusudieni mioyoni mwenu msisumbuke awali kuhusu mtakalosema mbele ya mashtaka.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

kikuyu: Kwa maana nitawapa maneno na hekima ambayo hakuna hata adui yenu mmoja atakayeweza kushindana nayo wala kuipinga.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

kikuyu: Mtasalitiwa hata na wazazi, ndugu, jamaa na marafiki, na baadhi yenu watawaua.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

kikuyu: Mtachukiwa na watu wote kwa ajili ya Jina langu.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Lakini hapatakuwa na unywele mmoja wa kichwa chenu utakaoangamia.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

kikuyu: Kwa kuvumilia mtaokoa roho zenu.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

kikuyu: “Mtakapoona mji wa Yerusalemu umezungukwa na majeshi, basi fahamuni kwamba kuharibiwa kwake kumekaribia.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

kikuyu: Wakati huo, wale walio Uyahudi wakimbilie milimani, walio mjini Yerusalemu watoke humo, nao wale walioko mashambani wasiingie mjini.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu huu utakuwa ni wakati wa adhabu ili kutimiza yote yaliyoandikwa.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Ole wao wenye mimba na wale wanaonyonyesha watoto siku hizo! Kutakuwa na dhiki kuu katika nchi na ghadhabu juu ya hawa watu.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

kikuyu: Wataanguka kwa makali ya upanga, na wengine watachukuliwa kuwa mateka katika mataifa yote. Nao mji wa Yerusalemu utakanyagwa na watu wa Mataifa hadi muda wa hao watu wa Mataifa utimie.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

kikuyu: “Kutakuwa na ishara katika jua, mwezi na nyota. Hapa duniani, mataifa yatakuwa katika dhiki na fadhaa kutokana na ngurumo na misukosuko ya bahari.
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

kikuyu: Watu watazimia roho kutokana na hofu kuu na kuyaona yale mambo yanayotokea duniani, kwa maana nguvu za angani zitatikisika.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: Wakati huo ndipo watakapomwona Mwana wa Adamu akija mawinguni pamoja na uweza na utukufu mkuu.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Mambo haya yatakapoanza kutendeka, simameni na mkaviinue vichwa vyenu, kwa sababu ukombozi wenu umekaribia.”
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia mfano huu: “Uangalieni mtini na miti mingine yote.
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

kikuyu: Inapochipua majani, ninyi wenyewe mnaweza kuona na kutambua wenyewe ya kuwa wakati wa kiangazi umekaribia.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, myaonapo mambo haya yakitukia, mnatambua kwamba Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

kikuyu: “Amin, nawaambia, kizazi hiki hakitapita hadi mambo haya yote yawe yametimia.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Mbingu na nchi zitapita, lakini maneno yangu hayatapita kamwe.”
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

kikuyu: “Jihadharini mioyo yenu isije ikalemewa na anasa, ulevi na fadhaa za maisha haya, nayo siku ile ikawakuta ninyi bila kutazamia kama vile mtego unasavyo.
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama vile mtego unasavyo, ndivyo siku hiyo itakavyowapata wanadamu wote waishio katika uso wa dunia yote.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Kesheni daima na mwombe ili mweze kuokoka na yale yote yatakayotokea na kusimama mbele ya Mwana wa Adamu.”
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Kila siku Yesu alikuwa akifundisha Hekaluni, na jioni ilipofika, alikwenda zake kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni na kukaa huko usiku kucha.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

kikuyu: Nao watu wote walikuja asubuhi na mapema Hekaluni ili kumsikiliza.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

kikuyu: Wakati huu Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, iitwayo Pasaka, ilikuwa imekaribia.
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

kikuyu: Viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wanatafuta njia ya kumuua Yesu, kwa sababu waliwaogopa watu.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

kikuyu: Shetani akamwingia Yuda, aliyeitwa Iskariote, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

kikuyu: Yuda akaenda kwa viongozi wa makuhani na kwa maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, akazungumza nao jinsi ambavyo angeweza kumsaliti Yesu.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Wakafurahi na wakakubaliana kumpa fedha.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

kikuyu: Naye akakubali, akaanza kutafuta wakati uliofaa wa kumsaliti Yesu kwao, wakati ambapo hakuna umati wa watu.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

kikuyu: Basi ikawadia siku ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka huchinjwa.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

kikuyu: Hivyo Yesu akawatuma Petro na Yohana, akisema, “Nendeni mkatuandalie chakula cha Pasaka ili tuweze kuila.”
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Unataka tukuandalie wapi?”
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Tazameni, mtakapokuwa mkiingia mjini, mtakutana na mwanaume amebeba mtungi wa maji. Mfuateni mpaka kwenye nyumba atakayoingia.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

kikuyu: Nanyi mwambieni mwenye nyumba, ‘Mwalimu anauliza: Kiko wapi chumba cha wageni, ambamo mimi na wanafunzi wangu tutakula Pasaka?’
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa ghorofani, kikiwa kimepambwa vizuri. Andaeni humo.”
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

kikuyu: Wakaenda, nao wakakuta kila kitu kama Yesu alivyowaambia. Hivyo wakaiandaa Pasaka.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Wakati ulipowadia, Yesu akaketi mezani pamoja na wale mitume wake.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

kikuyu: Kisha akawaambia, “Nimetamani sana kuila Pasaka hii pamoja nanyi kabla ya kuteswa kwangu.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

kikuyu: Kwa maana, nawaambia, sitaila tena Pasaka mpaka itakapotimizwa katika Ufalme wa Mungu.”
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Akiisha kukichukua kikombe, akashukuru, akasema, “Chukueni hiki mnywe wote.
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

kikuyu: Kwa maana nawaambia tangu sasa sitakunywa tena katika uzao wa mzabibu, hadi Ufalme wa Mungu utakapokuja.”
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

kikuyu: Kisha akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, na kuwapa, akisema, “Huu ni mwili wangu unaotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi kwa ukumbusho wangu.”
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu, imwagikayo kwa ajili yenu.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

kikuyu: Lakini mkono wake huyo atakayenisaliti uko hapa mezani pamoja nami.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

kikuyu: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda zake kama ilivyokusudiwa. Lakini ole wake mtu huyo amsalitiye.”
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

kikuyu: Wakaanza kuulizana wenyewe ni nani miongoni mwao angeweza kufanya jambo hilo.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

kikuyu: Pia yakazuka mabishano katikati ya wanafunzi kwamba ni nani aliyeonekana kuwa mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwao.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Wafalme na watu wa Mataifa huwatawala watu kwa nguvu. Nao wenye mamlaka juu yao hujiita ‘Wafadhili.’
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

kikuyu: Lakini ninyi msifanane nao. Bali yeye aliye mkuu kuliko wote miongoni mwenu, inampasa kuwa kama yeye aliye mdogo wa wote, naye atawalaye na awe kama yeye ahudumuye.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

kikuyu: Kwani ni nani aliye mkuu? Ni yule aketiye mezani au ni yule ahudumuye? Si ni yule aliyekaa mezani? Lakini mimi niko miongoni mwenu kama yule ahudumuye.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

kikuyu: Ninyi mmekuwa pamoja nami katika majaribu yangu.
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

kikuyu: Nami kama Baba yangu alivyonipa ufalme, kadhalika mimi nami ninawapa ninyi,
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

kikuyu: ili mpate kula na kunywa mezani pangu katika karamu ya ufalme wangu, na kukaa katika viti vya enzi, mkihukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.”
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Simoni, Simoni, sikiliza, Shetani ameomba kuwapepeta ninyi wote kama ngano.
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

kikuyu: Lakini nimekuombea wewe Simoni ili imani yako isishindwe, nawe ukiisha kunirudia, uwaimarishe ndugu zako.”
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

kikuyu: Petro akajibu, “Bwana, niko tayari kwenda pamoja nawe gerezani na hata kifoni.”
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakuambia Petro, kabla jogoo hajawika usiku wa leo, utakana mara tatu kwamba hunijui mimi.”
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, “Nilipowatuma bila mfuko, wala mkoba, wala viatu, mlipungukiwa na kitu chochote?” Wakajibu, “La, hatukupungukiwa na kitu chochote.”
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Lakini sasa, aliye na mfuko na auchukue, na aliye na mkoba vivyo hivyo. Naye asiye na upanga, auze joho lake anunue mmoja.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu, nawaambia, andiko hili lazima litimizwe juu yangu, kwamba, ‘Alihesabiwa pamoja na wakosaji’; kwa kweli yaliyoandikwa kunihusu mimi hayana budi kutimizwa.”
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Bwana, tazama hapa kuna panga mbili.” Akawajibu, “Inatosha.”
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

kikuyu: Yesu akatoka, akaenda kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni kama ilivyokuwa kawaida yake, nao wanafunzi wake wakamfuata.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

kikuyu: Walipofika huko, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Ombeni, msije mkaingia majaribuni.”
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Akajitenga nao kama umbali wa kutupa jiwe, akapiga magoti, akaomba
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

kikuyu: akisema, “Baba, kama ni mapenzi yako, niondolee kikombe hiki. Lakini si kama nipendavyo, bali mapenzi yako yatendeke.”
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

kikuyu: Malaika kutoka mbinguni akamtokea, akamtia nguvu.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

kikuyu: Naye akiwa katika maumivu makuu, akaomba kwa bidii, nalo jasho lake likawa kama matone ya damu yakidondoka ardhini.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

kikuyu: Baada ya kuomba, akawarudia wanafunzi wake akawakuta wamelala, wakiwa wamechoka kutokana na huzuni.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

kikuyu: Naye akawauliza, “Mbona mmelala? Amkeni, mwombe ili msije mkaingia majaribuni.”
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa bado anazungumza, umati mkubwa wa watu ukaja. Uliongozwa na Yuda, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wa wale wanafunzi Kumi na Wawili. Akamkaribia Yesu ili ambusu.
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, “Yuda, je, unamsaliti Mwana wa Adamu kwa busu?”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

kikuyu: Wafuasi wa Yesu walipoona yale yaliyokuwa yanakaribia kutokea, wakasema, “Bwana, tuwakatekate kwa panga zetu?”
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

kikuyu: Mmoja wao akampiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu kwa upanga, akamkata sikio la kuume.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akasema, “Acheni!” Akaligusa lile sikio la yule mtu na kumponya.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wale viongozi wa makuhani, maafisa wa walinzi wa Hekalu, pamoja na wazee waliokuwa wamekuja kumkamata, “Mmekuja na panga na marungu, kana kwamba mimi ni mnyangʼanyi?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

kikuyu: Siku kwa siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi Hekaluni lakini hamkunikamata. Lakini hii ni saa yenu, wakati giza linatawala!”
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

kikuyu: Kisha wakamkamata Yesu, wakamchukua, wakaenda naye mpaka nyumbani kwa kuhani mkuu. Lakini Petro akafuata kwa mbali.
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

kikuyu: Walipokwisha kuwasha moto katikati ya ua na kuketi pamoja, Petro naye akaketi pamoja nao.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

kikuyu: Mtumishi mmoja wa kike akamwona kwa mwanga wa moto akiwa ameketi pale. Akamtazama sana, akasema, “Huyu mtu pia alikuwa pamoja na Yesu!”
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

kikuyu: Lakini Petro akakana, akasema, “Ewe mwanamke, hata simjui!”
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

kikuyu: Baadaye kidogo, mtu mwingine alimwona Petro akasema, “Wewe pia ni mmoja wao!” Petro akajibu, “Wewe mtu, mimi sio mmoja wao!”
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

kikuyu: Baada ya muda wa kama saa moja hivi, mtu mwingine akazidi kusisitiza, “Kwa hakika huyu mtu naye alikuwa pamoja na Yesu, kwa maana yeye pia ni Mgalilaya.”
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

kikuyu: Petro akajibu, “Wewe mtu, mimi sijui unalosema!” Wakati huo huo, akiwa bado anazungumza, jogoo akawika.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Naye Bwana akageuka, akamtazama Petro. Ndipo Petro akakumbuka lile neno ambalo Bwana alimwambia: “Kabla jogoo hajawika leo, utanikana mara tatu.”
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Naye akaenda nje, akalia kwa majonzi.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Watu waliokuwa wanamlinda Yesu wakaanza kumdhihaki na kumpiga.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

kikuyu: Wakamfunga kitambaa machoni na kumuuliza, “Tabiri! Tuambie ni nani aliyekupiga?”
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

kikuyu: Wakaendelea kumtukana kwa matusi mengi.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

kikuyu: Kulipopambazuka, baraza la wazee wa watu, yaani viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria, wakakutana pamoja, naye Yesu akaletwa mbele yao.
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

kikuyu: Wakamwambia, “Kama wewe ndiye Kristo, tuambie.” Yesu akawajibu, “Hata nikiwaambia hamtaamini.
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

kikuyu: Nami nikiwauliza swali, hamtanijibu.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

kikuyu: Lakini kuanzia sasa, Mwana wa Adamu ataketi mkono wa kuume wa Mungu Mwenye Nguvu.”
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

kikuyu: Wote wakauliza, “Wewe basi ndiwe Mwana wa Mungu?” Yeye akawajibu, “Ninyi mwasema kwamba mimi ndiye.”
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

kikuyu: Kisha wakasema, “Tuna haja gani tena ya ushahidi zaidi? Tumesikia wenyewe kutoka kinywani mwake.”
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

kikuyu: Kisha umati wote wa watu ukainuka na kumpeleka Yesu kwa Pilato.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

kikuyu: Nao wakaanza kumshtaki wakisema: “Tumemwona huyu mtu akipotosha taifa letu, akiwazuia watu wasilipe kodi kwa Kaisari na kujiita kuwa yeye ni Kristo, mfalme.”
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

kikuyu: Basi Pilato akamuuliza Yesu, “Wewe ndiye mfalme wa Wayahudi?” Yesu akajibu, “Wewe wasema.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Pilato akawaambia viongozi wa makuhani na watu wote waliokuwepo, “Sioni sababu ya kutosha kumshtaki mtu huyu!”
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

kikuyu: Lakini wao wakakazana kusema, “Anawachochea watu kwa mafundisho yake katika Uyahudi yote, tangu Galilaya alikoanzia, hadi sehemu hii!”
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

kikuyu: Pilato aliposikia hayo akauliza, “Huyu mtu ni Mgalilaya?”
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

kikuyu: Alipofahamu kwamba Yesu alikuwa chini ya mamlaka ya Herode, akampeleka kwa Herode, ambaye wakati huo alikuwa pia Yerusalemu.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

kikuyu: Herode alipomwona Yesu alifurahi sana, kwa sababu kwa muda mrefu alikuwa amesikia mambo mengi kumhusu yeye. Pia alitarajia kumwona akifanya miujiza kadha wa kadha.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

kikuyu: Herode akamuuliza maswali mengi, lakini Yesu hakumjibu lolote.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

kikuyu: Wakati huo viongozi wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwepo wakitoa mashtaka yao kwa nguvu sana.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

kikuyu: Herode na askari wake wakamdhihaki Yesu na kumfanyia mzaha. Wakamvika vazi zuri sana, wakamrudisha kwa Pilato.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

kikuyu: Siku hiyo, Herode na Pilato wakawa marafiki; kabla ya jambo hili walikuwa na uadui kati yao.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

kikuyu: Basi Pilato akawaita pamoja viongozi wa makuhani, viongozi wengine na watu,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

kikuyu: akawaambia, “Ninyi mlimleta huyu mtu kwangu kana kwamba ni mtu anayewachochea watu ili waasi. Nimemhoji mbele yenu nami nimeona hakuna msingi wowote wa mashtaka yenu dhidi yake.
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

kikuyu: Wala Herode hakumwona na kosa lolote, ndiyo sababu amemrudisha kwetu. Kama mnavyoona, mtu huyu hakufanya jambo lolote linalostahili kifo.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi na kumwachia.” [
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ilikuwa lazima kuwafungulia mfungwa mmoja wakati wa Sikukuu.]
english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

kikuyu: Ndipo watu wote wakapiga kelele kwa pamoja, “Mwondoe mtu huyo! Tufungulie Baraba!”
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

kikuyu: (Baraba alikuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa sababu ya maasi yaliyokuwa yametokea mjini, na kwa ajili ya uuaji.)
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

kikuyu: Pilato, akitaka kumwachia Yesu, akasema nao tena.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

kikuyu: Lakini wao wakaendelea kupiga kelele wakisema, “Msulubishe! Msulubishe!”
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Kwa mara ya tatu, Pilato akawauliza, “Kwani amefanya kosa gani huyu mtu? Sikuona kwake sababu yoyote inayostahili adhabu ya kifo. Kwa hiyo nitaamuru apigwe mijeledi, na kisha nitamwachia.”
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Lakini watu wakazidi kupiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, wakidai kwamba Yesu asulubiwe. Hivyo, kelele zao zikashinda.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Pilato akatoa hukumu kwamba madai yao yatimizwe.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

kikuyu: Akamfungua yule mtu aliyekuwa amefungwa gerezani kwa kuhusika katika uasi dhidi ya serikali na mauaji. Akamkabidhi Yesu mikononi mwao, wamfanyie watakavyo.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wakienda naye, wakamkamata mtu mmoja aitwaye Simoni mwenyeji wa Kirene, aliyekuwa anapita zake kuingia mjini kutoka shambani. Wakambebesha msalaba, wakamlazimisha auchukue nyuma ya Yesu.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

kikuyu: Idadi kubwa ya watu wakamfuata Yesu, wakiwamo wanawake waliokuwa wakimlilia na kumwombolezea.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

kikuyu: Yesu akawageukia, akawaambia, “Enyi binti za Yerusalemu, msinililie mimi bali jililieni ninyi wenyewe na watoto wenu.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wakati utafika mtakaposema, ‘Wamebarikiwa wanawake tasa, ambao matumbo yao hayakuzaa, wala matiti yao hayakunyonyesha!’
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

kikuyu: Ndipo “ ‘wataiambia milima, “Tuangukieni!” na vilima, “Tufunikeni!” ’
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama wamefanya hivi kwa mti mbichi, kwa mti mkavu itakuwaje?”
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

kikuyu: Watu wengine wawili wahalifu, walipelekwa pamoja na Yesu ili wakasulubiwe.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
