kikuyu: Walipofika mahali paitwapo Fuvu la Kichwa, hapo ndipo walipomsulubisha Yesu pamoja na hao wahalifu, mmoja upande wake wa kuume na mwingine upande wake wa kushoto.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Baba, wasamehe, kwa maana hawajui walitendalo!” Wakagawana nguo zake kwa kupiga kura.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

kikuyu: Watu wakasimama hapo wakimwangalia, nao viongozi wa Wayahudi wakamdhihaki wakisema, “Aliokoa wengine! Ajiokoe mwenyewe basi, kama yeye ndiye Kristo wa Mungu, Mteule wake.”
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

kikuyu: Askari nao wakaja, wakamdhihaki. Wakamletea siki ili anywe,
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

kikuyu: na wakamwambia, “Kama wewe ni Mfalme wa Wayahudi, jiokoe mwenyewe.”
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

kikuyu: Kwenye msalaba juu ya kichwa chake, kulikuwa na maandishi haya: Huyu ndiye Mfalme wa Wayahudi. Maandishi haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa lugha za Kiyunani, Kilatini na Kiebrania.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Mmoja wa wale wahalifu waliosulubiwa pamoja naye akamtukana, akasema: “Wewe si ndiye Kristo? Jiokoe mwenyewe na utuokoe na sisi.”
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

kikuyu: Lakini yule mhalifu mwingine akamkemea mwenzake, akasema, “Je, wewe humwogopi Mungu, wakati uko kwenye adhabu iyo hiyo?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

kikuyu: Sisi tumehukumiwa kwa haki kwa kuwa tunapata tunayostahili kwa ajili ya matendo yetu. Lakini huyu mtu hajafanya kosa lolote.”
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

kikuyu: Kisha akasema, “Yesu, unikumbuke utakapokuja katika Ufalme wako.”
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, nakuambia, leo hii utakuwa pamoja nami Paradiso.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

kikuyu: Ilikuwa kama saa sita mchana, nalo giza likafunika nchi yote hadi saa tisa,
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: kwa sababu jua liliacha kutoa nuru. Pazia la Hekalu likachanika vipande viwili.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

kikuyu: Yesu akapaza sauti yake akasema, “Baba, mikononi mwako naikabidhi roho yangu.” Baada ya kusema haya, akakata roho.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

kikuyu: Yule jemadari alipoona yaliyotukia, akamsifu Mungu, akasema, “Hakika, mtu huyu alikuwa mwenye haki.”
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

kikuyu: Watu wote waliokuwa wamekusanyika hapo kushuhudia tukio hili walipoyaona hayo, wakapigapiga vifua vyao kwa huzuni na kwenda zao.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

kikuyu: Lakini wale wote waliomfahamu, pamoja na wale wanawake waliokuwa wamemfuata kutoka Galilaya, walisimama kwa mbali wakiyatazama mambo haya.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

kikuyu: Basi kulikuwa na mtu mmoja mwema na mwenye haki, jina lake Yosefu. Yeye alikuwa mjumbe wa Baraza la Wayahudi,
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

kikuyu: lakini yeye hakuwa amekubaliana na maamuzi na vitendo vya viongozi wenzake. Huyu alikuwa mwenyeji wa Arimathaya huko Uyahudi, naye alikuwa anaungojea Ufalme wa Mungu kwa matarajio makubwa.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Yosefu alikwenda kwa Pilato, akaomba apewe mwili wa Yesu.
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Akaushusha kutoka msalabani, akaufunga katika kitambaa cha kitani safi, na kuuweka katika kaburi lililochongwa kwenye mwamba, ambalo halikuwa limezikiwa mtu mwingine bado.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

kikuyu: Ilikuwa Siku ya Maandalizi, nayo Sabato ilikuwa karibu kuanza.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

kikuyu: Wale wanawake waliokuwa wamekuja pamoja na Yesu wakimfuata kutoka Galilaya wakamfuata Yosefu, wakaliona kaburi na jinsi mwili wa Yesu ulivyolazwa.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

kikuyu: Kisha wakarudi nyumbani, wakaandaa manukato na marhamu ya kuupaka huo mwili. Lakini wakapumzika siku ya Sabato kama ilivyoamriwa.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

kikuyu: Mnamo siku ya kwanza ya juma, alfajiri na mapema, wale wanawake walichukua yale manukato waliyokuwa wameyaandaa, wakaenda kaburini.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

kikuyu: Wakakuta lile jiwe limevingirishwa kutoka kwenye kaburi,
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

kikuyu: lakini walipoingia ndani, hawakuuona mwili wa Bwana Yesu.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wanashangaa juu ya jambo hili, ghafula watu wawili waliokuwa wamevaa mavazi yanayongʼaa kama umeme wakasimama karibu nao.
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

kikuyu: Wale wanawake, wakiwa na hofu, wakainamisha nyuso zao mpaka chini. Lakini wale watu wakawaambia, “Kwa nini mnamtafuta aliye hai miongoni mwa wafu?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

kikuyu: Hayuko hapa; amefufuka! Kumbukeni alivyowaambia alipokuwa bado yuko pamoja nanyi huko Galilaya kwamba:
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

kikuyu: ‘Ilikuwa lazima Mwana wa Adamu atiwe mikononi mwa watu wenye dhambi na waovu ili asulubiwe, na siku ya tatu afufuke.’ ”
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakayakumbuka maneno ya Yesu.
english: They remembered his words,

kikuyu: Waliporudi kutoka huko kaburini, wakawaeleza wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja pamoja na wengine wote mambo haya yote.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

kikuyu: Basi Maria Magdalene, Yoana, na Maria mama yake Yakobo, pamoja na wanawake wengine waliofuatana nao ndio waliwaelezea mitume habari hizi.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

kikuyu: Lakini hawakuwasadiki hao wanawake, kwa sababu maneno yao yalionekana kama upuzi.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, Petro akainuka na kukimbia kwenda kule kaburini. Alipoinama kuchungulia, akaona vile vitambaa vya kitani, ila hakuona kitu kingine. Naye akaenda zake akijiuliza nini kilichotokea.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

kikuyu: Ikawa siku iyo hiyo, wanafunzi wawili wa Yesu walikuwa njiani wakienda kijiji kilichoitwa Emau, yapata maili saba kutoka Yerusalemu.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Walikuwa wakizungumza wao kwa wao kuhusu mambo yote yaliyotukia.
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa wakizungumza na kujadiliana, Yesu mwenyewe akaja akatembea pamoja nao,
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

kikuyu: lakini macho yao yakazuiliwa ili wasimtambue.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

kikuyu: Akawauliza, “Ni mambo gani haya mnayozungumza wakati mnatembea?” Wakasimama, nyuso zao zikionyesha huzuni.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

kikuyu: Mmoja wao, aliyeitwa Kleopa, akamuuliza, “Je, wewe ndiye peke yako mgeni huku Yerusalemu ambaye hufahamu mambo yaliyotukia humo siku hizi?”
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

kikuyu: Akawauliza, “Mambo gani?” Wakamjibu, “Mambo ya Yesu wa Nazareti. Yeye alikuwa nabii, mwenye uwezo mkuu katika maneno yake na matendo yake, mbele za Mungu na mbele ya wanadamu wote.
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

kikuyu: Viongozi wa makuhani na viongozi wetu walimtoa ahukumiwe kufa, nao wakamsulubisha.
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

kikuyu: Lakini tulikuwa tumetegemea kwamba yeye ndiye angelikomboa Israeli. Zaidi ya hayo, leo ni siku ya tatu tangu mambo haya yatokee.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

kikuyu: Isitoshe, baadhi ya wanawake katika kundi letu wametushtusha. Walikwenda kaburini leo alfajiri,
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

kikuyu: lakini hawakuukuta mwili wake. Walirudi wakasema wameona maono ya malaika ambao waliwaambia kwamba Yesu yu hai.
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

kikuyu: Kisha baadhi ya wenzetu walikwenda kaburini wakalikuta kama vile wale wanawake walivyokuwa wamesema, lakini yeye hawakumwona.”
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Ninyi ni wajinga kiasi gani, nanyi ni wazito mioyoni mwenu kuamini mambo yote yaliyonenwa na manabii!
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

kikuyu: Je, haikumpasa Kristokuteswa kwa njia hiyo na kisha aingie katika utukufu wake?”
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

kikuyu: Naye akianzia na Sheria ya Mose na Manabii wote, akawafafanulia jinsi Maandiko yalivyosema kumhusu yeye.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

kikuyu: Nao walipokaribia kile kijiji walichokuwa wakienda, Yesu akawa kama anaendelea mbele.
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

kikuyu: Lakini wao wakamsihi sana akae nao, wakisema, “Kaa hapa nasi, kwa maana sasa ni jioni na usiku unaingia.” Basi akaingia ndani kukaa nao.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa mezani pamoja nao, akachukua mkate, akashukuru, akaumega, akaanza kuwagawia.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

kikuyu: Ndipo macho yao yakafumbuliwa, nao wakamtambua, naye akatoweka machoni pao. Hawakumwona tena.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

kikuyu: Wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Je, mioyo yetu haikuwakawaka kwa furaha ndani yetu alipokuwa anazungumza nasi njiani na kutufafanulia Maandiko?”
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

kikuyu: Wakaondoka mara, wakarudi Yerusalemu. Wakawakuta wale wanafunzi kumi na mmoja na wale waliokuwa pamoja nao, wamekusanyika
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

kikuyu: wakisema, “Ni kweli! Bwana amefufuka, naye amemtokea Simoni.”
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

kikuyu: Kisha wale wanafunzi wawili wakaeleza yaliyotukia njiani na jinsi walivyomtambua Yesu alipoumega mkate.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

kikuyu: Walipokuwa bado wanazungumza hayo, Yesu mwenyewe akasimama katikati yao, akasema, “Amani iwe nanyi!”
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Wakashtuka na kuogopa wakidhani kwamba wameona mzuka.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akawauliza, “Kwa nini mnaogopa? Kwa nini mna shaka mioyoni mwenu?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

kikuyu: Tazameni mikono yangu na miguu yangu, mwone kuwa ni mimi hasa. Niguseni mwone; kwa maana mzuka hauna nyama na mifupa, kama mnionavyo kuwa navyo.”
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

kikuyu: Aliposema haya, akawaonyesha mikono na miguu yake.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

kikuyu: Wakashindwa kuamini kwa ajili ya furaha na mshangao waliokuwa nao. Akawauliza, “Mna chakula chochote hapa?”
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

kikuyu: Wakampa kipande cha samaki aliyeokwa,
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

kikuyu: naye akakichukua na kukila mbele yao.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yale niliyowaambia nilipokuwa bado niko pamoja nanyi, kwamba yote yaliyoandikwa kunihusu mimi katika Sheria ya Mose, Manabii na Zaburi hayana budi kutimizwa.”
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Ndipo akafungua fahamu zao ili waweze kuyaelewa Maandiko.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Haya ndiyo yaliyoandikwa: Kristo atateswa na siku ya tatu atafufuka kutoka kwa wafu.
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

kikuyu: Toba na msamaha wa dhambi zitatangaziwa mataifa yote kupitia jina lake kuanzia Yerusalemu.
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ninyi ni mashahidi wa mambo haya.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

kikuyu: “Tazama nitawatumia ahadi ya Baba yangu; lakini kaeni humu mjini hadi mtakapovikwa uwezo utokao juu.”
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

kikuyu: Akiisha kuwaongoza mpaka kwenye viunga vya Bethania, akainua mikono yake juu na kuwabariki.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa anawabariki, akawaacha, akachukuliwa mbinguni.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

kikuyu: Kisha wakamwabudu na kurudi Yerusalemu wakiwa wamejawa na furaha kuu.
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

kikuyu: Nao wakadumu ndani ya Hekalu wakimtukuza Mungu. Amen.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

kikuyu: Hapo mwanzo alikuwako Neno, huyo Neno alikuwa pamoja na Mungu, naye Neno alikuwa Mungu.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

kikuyu: Tangu mwanzo huyo Neno alikuwa pamoja na Mungu.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

kikuyu: Vitu vyote viliumbwa kwa yeye, wala pasipo yeye hakuna chochote kilichoumbwa ambacho kimeumbwa.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

kikuyu: Ndani yake ndimo ulimokuwa uzima na huo uzima ulikuwa nuru ya watu.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

kikuyu: Nuru hungʼaa gizani nalo giza halikuishinda.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

kikuyu: Alikuja mtu mmoja aliyetumwa kutoka kwa Mungu, jina lake Yohana.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

kikuyu: Alikuja kama shahidi apate kuishuhudia hiyo nuru, ili kwa kupitia kwake watu wote waweze kuamini.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

kikuyu: Yeye mwenyewe hakuwa ile nuru, bali alikuja kuishuhudia hiyo nuru.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

kikuyu: Kwamba nuru halisi, imwangaziayo kila mtu ilikuwa inakuja ulimwenguni.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

kikuyu: Huyo Neno alikuwako ulimwenguni na ingawa ulimwengu uliumbwa kupitia kwake, haukumtambua.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: Alikuja kwa walio wake, lakini wao hawakumpokea.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

kikuyu: Bali wote waliompokea, aliwapa uwezo wa kufanyika watoto wa Mungu, ndio wale waliaminio jina lake.
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

kikuyu: Hawa ndio wasiozaliwa kwa damu, wala kwa mapenzi ya mwili au kwa mapenzi ya mtu, bali kwa mapenzi ya Mungu.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

kikuyu: Neno alifanyika mwili, akakaa miongoni mwetu, nasi tukauona utukufu wake, utukufu kama wa Mwana pekee atokaye kwa Baba, amejaa neema na kweli.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

kikuyu: Yohana alishuhudia habari zake, akapaza sauti, akisema, “Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Yeye ajaye baada yangu ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’ ”
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

kikuyu: Kutokana na ukamilifu wake, sisi sote tumepokea neema juu ya neema.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa sheria ilitolewa kwa mkono wa Mose, lakini neema na kweli imekuja kupitia Yesu Kristo.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Mungu wakati wowote, ila ni Mungu Mwana pekee, aliye kifuani mwa Baba ndiye ambaye amemdhihirisha.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

kikuyu: Huu ndio ushuhuda wa Yohana wakati Wayahudi walipowatuma makuhani na Walawi kutoka Yerusalemu kumuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?”
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

kikuyu: Yohana alikiri waziwazi pasipo kuficha akasema, “Mimi si Kristo.”
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani basi? Je, wewe ni Eliya?” Yeye akajibu, “Hapana, mimi siye.” “Je, wewe ni yule Nabii?” Akajibu, “Hapana.”
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakasema, “Basi tuambie wewe ni nani ili tupate jibu la kuwapelekea wale waliotutuma. Wewe wasemaje juu yako mwenyewe?”
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

kikuyu: Akawajibu kwa maneno ya nabii Isaya, akisema, “Mimi ni sauti ya mtu aliaye nyikani, ‘Yanyoosheni mapito ya Bwana.’ ”
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

kikuyu: Basi walikuwa wametumwa watu kutoka kwa Mafarisayo
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

kikuyu: wakamuuliza, “Kama wewe si Kristo, wala si Eliya na wala si yule Nabii, kwa nini basi unabatiza?”
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

kikuyu: Yohana akawajibu, “Mimi ninabatiza kwa maji, lakini katikati yenu yupo mtu msiyemjua.
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: Yeye ajaye baada yangu, sistahili hata kufungua kamba za viatu vyake.”
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

kikuyu: Mambo haya yote yalitukia huko Bethania, ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani, mahali Yohana alipokuwa akibatiza.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

kikuyu: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alimwona Yesu akimjia akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu aichukuaye dhambi ya ulimwengu!
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

kikuyu: Huyu ndiye yule niliyewaambia kwamba, ‘Mtu anakuja baada yangu ambaye ni mkuu kuniliko mimi, kwa kuwa alikuwepo kabla yangu.’
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

kikuyu: Mimi mwenyewe sikumfahamu, lakini sababu ya kuja nikibatiza kwa maji ni ili yeye apate kufunuliwa kwa Israeli.”
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yohana akatoa ushuhuda huu: “Nilimwona Roho akishuka kutoka mbinguni kama hua, akakaa juu yake.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

kikuyu: Mimi nisingemtambua, lakini yeye aliyenituma nibatize kwa maji alikuwa ameniambia, ‘Yule mtu utakayemwona Roho akimshukia na kukaa juu yake, huyo ndiye atakayebatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu.’
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Mimi mwenyewe nimeona jambo hili na ninashuhudia kuwa huyu ndiye Mwana wa Mungu.”
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Siku iliyofuata, Yohana alikuwa huko tena pamoja na wanafunzi wake wawili.
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

kikuyu: Alipomwona Yesu akipita, akasema, “Tazama, Mwana-Kondoo wa Mungu!”
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

kikuyu: Wale wanafunzi wawili walipomsikia Yohana akisema haya, wakamfuata Yesu.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesu akageuka, akawaona wakimfuata akawauliza, “Mnataka nini?” Wakamwambia, “Rabi,” (maana yake Mwalimu), “Unaishi wapi?”
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Njooni, nanyi mtapaona!” Hivyo wakaenda na kupaona mahali alipokuwa anaishi, wakakaa naye siku ile, kwa kuwa ilikuwa yapata saa kumi.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

kikuyu: Andrea nduguye Simoni Petro, alikuwa mmoja wa wale wawili waliosikia yale Yohana aliyokuwa amesema, naye ndiye alimfuata Yesu.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

kikuyu: Kitu cha kwanza Andrea alichofanya ni kumtafuta Simoni nduguye na kumwambia, “Tumemwona Masiya” (yaani, Kristo).
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

kikuyu: Naye akamleta kwa Yesu. Yesu akamwangalia na kusema, “Wewe ni Simoni mwana wa Yohana. Utaitwa Kefa” (ambalo limetafsiriwa Petro).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

kikuyu: Siku iliyofuata Yesu aliamua kwenda Galilaya. Akamkuta Filipo, akamwambia, “Nifuate.”
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: Basi Filipo alikuwa mwenyeji wa Bethsaida, mji alikotoka Andrea na Petro.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

kikuyu: Filipo naye akamkuta Nathanaeli na kumwambia, “Tumemwona yeye ambaye Mose aliandika habari zake katika Sheria na ambaye pia manabii waliandika kumhusu, yaani, Yesu wa Nazareti, mwana wa Yosefu.”
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

kikuyu: Nathanaeli akauliza, “Nazareti! Je, kitu chochote chema chaweza kutoka Nazareti?” Filipo akamwambia, “Njoo uone.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipomwona Nathanaeli anakaribia, akanena habari zake akasema, “Tazama huyu ni Mwisraeli kweli kweli; hana hila ndani yake.”
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

kikuyu: Nathanaeli akamuuliza, “Umenifahamuje?” Yesu akamjibu, “Nilikuona ulipokuwa bado uko chini ya mtini, kabla hata Filipo hajakuita.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

kikuyu: Nathanaeli akamwambia, “Rabi, wewe ni Mwana wa Mungu! Wewe ni Mfalme wa Israeli!”
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Unaamini kwa kuwa nilikuambia nilikuona ulipokuwa bado uko chini ya mtini? Basi utaona mambo makuu zaidi kuliko hilo.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

kikuyu: Ndipo akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi mtaona mbingu ikifunguka na malaika wa Mungu wakipanda na kushuka juu ya Mwana wa Adamu.”
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Siku ya tatu kulikuwa na arusi katika mji wa Kana ya Galilaya, naye mama yake Yesu alikuwepo pale.
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

kikuyu: Yesu pamoja na wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamealikwa arusini pia.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

kikuyu: Divai ilipokwisha, mama yake Yesu akamwambia, “Wameishiwa na divai.”
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Mwanamke, nina nini nawe? Saa yangu haijawadia.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

kikuyu: Mama yake akawaambia wale watumishi, “Lolote atakalowaambia, fanyeni.”
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

kikuyu: Basi ilikuwepo mitungi sita ya kuhifadhia maji iliyotengenezwa kwa mawe kwa ajili ya kujitakasa kwa desturi ya Kiyahudi; kila mtungi ungeweza kuchukua vipipa viwili au vitatu.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia wale watumishi, “Ijazeni hiyo mitungi maji.” Nao wakaijaza ile mitungi mpaka juu.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

kikuyu: Kisha akawaambia, “Sasa choteni hayo maji kidogo, mpelekeeni mkuu wa meza.” Hivyo wakachota, wakampelekea.
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

kikuyu: Yule mkuu wa meza akayaonja yale maji ambayo yalikuwa yamebadilika kuwa divai. Hakujua divai hiyo ilikotoka ingawa wale watumishi waliochota yale maji wao walifahamu. Basi akamwita bwana arusi kando
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

kikuyu: akamwambia, “Watu wote hutoa kwanza divai nzuri, kisha huleta ile divai hafifu wageni wakisha kunywa vya kutosha, lakini wewe umeiweka ile nzuri kupita zote mpaka sasa.”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

kikuyu: Huu, ndio uliokuwa muujiza wa kwanza Yesu aliofanya Kana ya Galilaya. Hivyo Yesu alidhihirisha utukufu wake, nao wanafunzi wake wakamwamini.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

kikuyu: Baada ya hayo, Yesu pamoja na mama yake, ndugu zake na wanafunzi wake, walishuka mpaka Kapernaumu, wakakaa huko siku chache.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

kikuyu: Ilipokaribia wakati wa Pasaka ya Wayahudi, Yesu alipanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Huko Hekaluni aliwakuta watu wakiuza ngʼombe, kondoo na njiwa, nao wengine walikuwa wameketi mezani wakibadili fedha.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

kikuyu: Akatengeneza mjeledi kutokana na kamba, akawafukuza wote kutoka kwenye eneo la Hekalu, pamoja na kondoo na ngʼombe. Akazipindua meza za wale wabadili fedha na kuzimwaga fedha zao.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

kikuyu: Akawaambia wale waliokuwa wakiuza njiwa, “Waondoeni hapa! Mnathubutuje kuifanya nyumba ya Baba yangu kuwa mahali pa biashara?”
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakakumbuka kuwa imeandikwa: “Wivu wa nyumba yako utanila.”
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamuuliza, “Unaweza kutuonyesha ishara gani ili kuthibitisha mamlaka uliyo nayo ya kufanya mambo haya?”
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Libomoeni hili Hekalu, nami nitalijenga tena kwa siku tatu!”
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

kikuyu: Wale Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hekalu hili lilijengwa kwa muda wa miaka arobaini na sita, nawe wasema utalijenga kwa siku tatu?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

kikuyu: Lakini yeye Hekalu alilozungumzia ni mwili wake.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

kikuyu: Baada ya kufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, wanafunzi wake wakakumbuka yale aliyokuwa amesema. Ndipo wakayaamini Maandiko na yale maneno Yesu aliyokuwa amesema.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

kikuyu: Ikawa Yesu alipokuwa Yerusalemu kwenye Sikukuu ya Pasaka, watu wengi waliona ishara na miujiza aliyokuwa akifanya, wakaamini katika jina lake.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu hakujiaminisha kwao kwa sababu aliwajua wanadamu wote.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

kikuyu: Hakuhitaji ushuhuda wa mtu yeyote kuhusu mtu, kwa kuwa alijua yote yaliyokuwa moyoni mwa mtu.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

kikuyu: Basi palikuwa na mtu mmoja Farisayo, jina lake Nikodemo, mmoja wa Baraza la Wayahudi lililotawala.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

kikuyu: Huyu alimjia Yesu usiku akamwambia, “Rabi, tunajua kuwa wewe ni mwalimu uliyetumwa na Mungu, kwa maana hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya miujiza hii uifanyayo wewe, kama Mungu hayuko pamoja naye.”
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Amin, amin nakuambia, hakuna mtu anayeweza kuuona Ufalme wa Mungu kama hajazaliwa mara ya pili.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Nikodemo akauliza, “Awezaje mtu kuzaliwa wakati akiwa mzee? Hakika hawezi kuingia mara ya pili kwenye tumbo la mama yake ili azaliwe!”
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Amin, amin nakuambia, hakuna mtu yeyote anayeweza kuingia Ufalme wa Mungu kama hajazaliwa kwa maji na kwa Roho.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Mwili huzaa mwili, lakini Roho huzaa roho.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo usishangae ninapokuambia huna budi ‘kuzaliwa mara ya pili.’
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

kikuyu: Upepo huvuma popote upendapo. Mvumo wake unausikia lakini huwezi ukafahamu utokako wala uendako. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa kila mtu aliyezaliwa na Roho.”
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

kikuyu: Nikodemo akamuuliza, “Mambo haya yanawezekanaje?”
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Wewe ni mwalimu mashuhuri wa Waisraeli, nawe huelewi mambo haya?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

kikuyu: Amin, amin ninakuambia, sisi tunazungumza lile tunalolijua na tunashuhudia lile tuliloliona. Lakini ninyi watu hamkubali ushuhuda wetu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

kikuyu: Nimewaambia mambo ya duniani, nanyi hamkuniamini, mtaniaminije basi nitakapowaambia mambo ya mbinguni?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyekwenda mbinguni isipokuwa yeye aliyeshuka kutoka mbinguni, yaani, Mwana wa Adamu.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Kama vile Mose alivyomwinua yule nyoka kule jangwani, vivyo hivyo Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu.
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

kikuyu: Ili kila mtu amwaminiye awe na uzima wa milele.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: “Kwa maana jinsi hii Mungu aliupenda ulimwengu hata akamtoa Mwanawe wa pekee, ili kila mtu amwaminiye asipotee, bali awe na uzima wa milele.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mungu hakumtuma Mwanawe kuuhukumu ulimwengu, bali kupitia kwake ulimwengu upate kuokolewa.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

kikuyu: Yeyote amwaminiye hahukumiwi, lakini asiyeamini amekwisha kuhukumiwa, kwa sababu hakuliamini jina la Mwana pekee wa Mungu.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo hukumu kwamba: Nuru imekuja ulimwenguni, nao watu wakapenda giza kuliko nuru kwa sababu matendo yao ni maovu.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa kila atendaye maovu huchukia nuru, wala haji kwenye nuru ili matendo yake maovu yasifichuliwe.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

kikuyu: Lakini yule aishiye kwa ukweli huja kwenye nuru, ili ionekane wazi kwamba matendo yake yametendeka katika Mungu.”
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

kikuyu: Baada ya haya, Yesu na wanafunzi wake walikwenda katika nchi ya Uyahudi, nao wakakaa huko kwa muda na kubatiza.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

kikuyu: Yohana naye alikuwa akibatiza huko Ainoni karibu na Salimu kwa sababu huko kulikuwa na maji tele. Watu wazima wakamjia huko ili kubatizwa.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

kikuyu: (Hii ilikuwa kabla Yohana hajatiwa gerezani).
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

kikuyu: Mashindano yakazuka kati ya baadhi ya wanafunzi wa Yohana na Myahudi mmoja kuhusu suala la desturi ya kunawa kwa utakaso.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

kikuyu: Wakamwendea Yohana wakamwambia, “Rabi, yule mtu aliyekuwa pamoja nawe ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani, yule uliyeshuhudia habari zake, sasa anabatiza na kila mtu anamwendea!”
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

kikuyu: Yohana akawajibu, “Hakuna mtu yeyote awezaye kupata kitu chochote isipokuwa kile tu alichopewa kutoka mbinguni.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

kikuyu: Ninyi wenyewe ni mashahidi wangu kwamba nilisema, ‘Mimi si Kristo, ila nimetumwa nimtangulie.’
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

kikuyu: Bibi arusi ni wa bwana arusi. Lakini rafiki yake bwana arusi anayesimama karibu naye na kusikiliza kutoka kwake, hufurahi sana aisikiapo sauti ya bwana arusi. Kwa sababu hii furaha yangu imekamilika.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

kikuyu: Yeye hana budi kuwa mkuu zaidi na mimi nizidi kuwa mdogo.”
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

kikuyu: “Yeye ajaye kutoka juu yu juu ya yote, yeye aliye wa duniani ni wa dunia, naye huzungumza mambo ya duniani. Yeye aliyekuja kutoka mbinguni, yu juu ya yote.
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

kikuyu: Yeye hushuhudia yale aliyoyaona na kuyasikia, lakini hakuna yeyote anayekubali ushuhuda wake.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

kikuyu: Lakini yeyote anayekubali huo ushuhuda anathibitisha kwamba, Mungu ni kweli.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

kikuyu: Yeye aliyetumwa na Mungu husema maneno ya Mungu, kwa kuwa Mungu humtoa Roho pasipo kipimo.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

kikuyu: Baba anampenda Mwana, naye ametia vitu vyote mikononi mwake.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

kikuyu: Yeyote anayemwamini Mwana ana uzima wa milele, lakini yeye asiyemwamini Mwana hatauona uzima, bali ghadhabu ya Mungu itakuwa juu yake.”
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

kikuyu: Mafarisayo wakasikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa anapata na kubatiza wanafunzi wengi zaidi kuliko Yohana,
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

kikuyu: ingawa kwa kweli si Yesu mwenyewe aliyekuwa akibatiza, ila ni wanafunzi wake.
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

kikuyu: Bwana alipojua mambo haya, aliondoka Uyahudi akarudi tena Galilaya.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

kikuyu: Wakati huo ilimlazimu apitie Samaria.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

kikuyu: Akafika kwenye mji mmoja wa Samaria uitwao Sikari, karibu na lile shamba ambalo Yakobo alimpa mwanawe Yosefu.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

kikuyu: Huko ndiko kulikokuwa na kile kisima cha Yakobo. Naye Yesu alikuwa amechoka kwa kuwa alikuwa ametoka safarini. Akaketi karibu na hicho kisima. Ilikuwa yapata saa sita mchana.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

kikuyu: Mwanamke mmoja Msamaria akaja kuteka maji, Yesu akamwambia, “Naomba maji ninywe.”
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

kikuyu: (Wakati huo wanafunzi wake walikuwa wamekwenda mjini kununua chakula.)
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke Msamaria akamjibu, “Wewe ni Myahudi na mimi ni Msamaria. Yawezekanaje uniombe nikupe maji ya kunywa?” (Wayahudi walikuwa hawashirikiani kabisa na Wasamaria.)
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu akamwambia, “Kama ungelijua karama ya Mungu, naye ni nani anayekuambia, Nipe maji ninywe, wewe ungelimwomba yeye, naye angelikupa maji yaliyo hai.”
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akamjibu, “Bwana, wewe huna chombo cha kutekea maji na kisima hiki ni kirefu. Hayo maji ya uzima utayapata wapi?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

kikuyu: Kwani wewe ni mkuu kuliko baba yetu Yakobo ambaye alitupatia kisima hiki, ambacho yeye pamoja na watoto wake na mifugo yake walikitumia?”
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Kila mtu anayekunywa maji ya kisima hiki ataona kiu tena.
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

kikuyu: Lakini yeyote anywaye maji nitakayompa hataona kiu kamwe. Maji nitakayompa yatakuwa ndani yake chemchemi ya maji, yakibubujika uzima wa milele.”
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Bwana, tafadhali nipe maji hayo ili nisipate kiu tena na wala nisije tena hapa kuteka maji!”
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Nenda ukamwite mumeo, uje naye hapa.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Sina mume.” Yesu akamwambia, “Umesema kweli kuwa huna mume.
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

kikuyu: Kwa maana umeshakuwa na wanaume watano na mwanaume unayeishi naye sasa si mume wako! Umesema ukweli.”
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akasema, “Bwana, naona bila shaka wewe ni nabii.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

kikuyu: Baba zetu waliabudu kwenye mlima huu, lakini ninyi Wayahudi mnasema ni lazima tukaabudu huko Yerusalemu.”
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Mwanamke, niamini, wakati unakuja ambapo hamtamwabudu Baba katika mlima huu, wala huko Yerusalemu.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

kikuyu: Ninyi Wasamaria mnaabudu msichokijua. Sisi Wayahudi tunamwabudu Mungu tunayemjua kwa sababu wokovu unatoka kwa Wayahudi.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

kikuyu: Lakini saa yaja, tena ipo, ambapo wale waabuduo halisi, watamwabudu Baba katika roho na kweli. Watu wanaoabudu namna hii, ndio Baba anawatafuta.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

kikuyu: Mungu ni Roho na wote wanaomwabudu imewapasa kumwabudu katika roho na kweli.”
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akamwambia, “Ninafahamu kwamba Masiya (aitwaye Kristo) anakuja. Yeye akija, atatueleza mambo yote.”
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ninayezungumza nawe, ndiye.”
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

kikuyu: Wakati huo wanafunzi wake wakarudi, wakashangaa sana kumwona akizungumza na mwanamke. Lakini hakuna aliyemuuliza, “Unataka nini kwake?” Au “Kwa nini unazungumza naye?”
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akaacha mtungi wake, akarudi mjini akawaambia watu,
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

kikuyu: “Njooni mkamwone mtu aliyeniambia kila kitu nilichotenda! Je, yawezekana huyu ndiye Kristo?”
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

kikuyu: Basi wakamiminika watu kutoka mjini wakamwendea Yesu.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

kikuyu: Wakati huo wanafunzi wake walikuwa wakimsihi, “Rabi, kula angalau chochote.”
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

kikuyu: Lakini yeye akawajibu, “Mimi ninacho chakula ambacho ninyi hamkifahamu.”
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

kikuyu: Basi wanafunzi wakaanza kuulizana, “Kuna mtu ambaye amemletea chakula?”
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akawajibu, “Chakula changu ni kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu ambaye amenituma na kuikamilisha kazi yake.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

kikuyu: Je, ninyi hamsemi, ‘Bado miezi minne tuvune?’ Inueni macho yenu myaangalie mashamba jinsi mazao yalivyo tayari kuvunwa!
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

kikuyu: Mvunaji tayari anapokea mshahara wake, naye anakusanya mazao kwa ajili ya uzima wa milele. Ili yeye apandaye na yeye avunaye wafurahi pamoja.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

kikuyu: Hivyo kule kusema, ‘Mmoja hupanda na mwingine huvuna,’ ni kweli kabisa.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

kikuyu: Niliwatuma mkavune mazao ambayo hamkupanda, wengine walifanya kazi ngumu, nanyi mmevuna faida ya taabu yao.”
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

kikuyu: Wasamaria wengi katika mji ule wakamwamini Yesu kwa sababu ya ushuhuda wa yule mwanamke alipowaambia kwamba, “Ameniambia kila kitu nilichotenda.”
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

kikuyu: Hivyo wale Wasamaria walipomjia, wakamsihi akae kwao. Naye akakaa huko siku mbili.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya neno lake, watu wengi wakaamini.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

kikuyu: Wakamwambia yule mwanamke, “Sasa tunaamini, wala si kwa sababu ya maneno yako tu, bali kwa kuwa tumemsikia sisi wenyewe. Tumejua hakika kweli ya kwamba huyu ndiye Kristo, Mwokozi wa ulimwengu.”
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

kikuyu: Baada ya zile siku mbili, Yesu aliondoka kwenda Galilaya.
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

kikuyu: (Basi Yesu mwenyewe alikuwa amesema kwamba nabii hapati heshima katika nchi yake mwenyewe.)
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

kikuyu: Alipofika Galilaya, Wagalilaya walimkaribisha, kwani walikuwa wameona yale aliyoyatenda huko Yerusalemu wakati wa Sikukuu ya Pasaka. Kwa maana wao pia walikuwa wamehudhuria hiyo Sikukuu.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

kikuyu: Hivyo Yesu akaja tena mpaka Kana ya Galilaya, kule alikokuwa amebadili maji kuwa divai. Huko kulikuwepo na afisa mmoja wa mfalme, ambaye mwanawe alikuwa mgonjwa huko Kapernaumu.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

kikuyu: Huyo mtu aliposikia kwamba Yesu alikuwa amewasili Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi, alimwendea na kumwomba ili aje kumponya mwanawe, aliyekuwa mgonjwa karibu ya kufa.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Ninyi watu msipoona ishara na miujiza kamwe hamtaamini.”
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

kikuyu: Yule afisa wa mfalme akamwambia, “Bwana, tafadhali shuka kabla mwanangu hajafa.”
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Enenda zako, mwanao yu hai.” Yule afisa akaamini yale maneno Yesu aliyomwambia, akaondoka akaenda zake.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

kikuyu: Alipokuwa bado yuko njiani, akakutana na watumishi wake wakamwambia kwamba mwanawe yu mzima.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

kikuyu: Akawauliza saa ambayo alianza kupata nafuu. Wakamwambia, “Jana yapata saa saba, homa ilimwacha.”
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

kikuyu: Ndipo baba wa huyo mtoto akakumbuka kuwa huo ndio wakati ambapo Yesu alikuwa amemwambia, “Mwanao yu hai.” Kwa hiyo yeye pamoja na wote wa nyumbani mwake wakamwamini Yesu.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

kikuyu: Hii ilikuwa ishara ya pili ambayo Yesu alifanya aliporudi Galilaya kutoka Uyahudi.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

kikuyu: Baada ya haya, kulikuwa na Sikukuu ya Wayahudi, naye Yesu akapanda kwenda Yerusalemu.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Huko Yerusalemu, karibu na mlango uitwao Mlango wa Kondoo, palikuwa na bwawa moja lililoitwa kwa Kiebrania Bethzatha, ambalo lilikuwa limezungukwa na kumbi tano.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

kikuyu: Hapa palikuwa na idadi kubwa ya wasiojiweza, yaani, vipofu, viwete, na waliopooza [wakingojea maji yatibuliwe.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

kikuyu: Kwa maana malaika alikuwa akishuka wakati fulani, akayatibua maji. Yule aliyekuwa wa kwanza kuingia ndani baada ya maji kutibuliwa alipona ugonjwa wowote aliokuwa nao].
english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

kikuyu: Mtu mmoja alikuwako huko ambaye alikuwa ameugua kwa miaka thelathini na minane.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

kikuyu: Yesu alipomwona akiwa amelala hapo, naye akijua kuwa amekuwa hapo kwa muda mrefu, akamwambia, “Je, wataka kuponywa?”
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

kikuyu: Yule mgonjwa akamjibu, “Bwana, mimi sina mtu wa kuniingiza bwawani maji yanapotibuliwa. Nami ninapotaka kutumbukia bwawani, mtu mwingine huingia kabla yangu.”
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Inuka! Chukua mkeka wako na uende.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

kikuyu: Mara yule mtu akapona, akachukua mkeka wake, akaanza kutembea. Basi siku hiyo ilikuwa siku ya Sabato.
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Wayahudi wakamwambia yule mtu aliyeponywa, “Leo ni Sabato, si halali wewe kubeba mkeka wako.”
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

kikuyu: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aliyeniponya aliniambia, ‘Chukua mkeka wako na uende.’ ”
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Ni mtu gani huyo aliyekuambia uchukue mkeka wako uende?”
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

kikuyu: Basi yule mtu aliyeponywa hakufahamu ni nani aliyemponya, kwa sababu Yesu alikuwa amejiondoa katika ule umati wa watu uliokuwa hapo.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

kikuyu: Baadaye Yesu akamkuta yule mtu aliyemponya ndani ya Hekalu na kumwambia, “Tazama umeponywa, usitende dhambi tena. La sivyo, lisije likakupata jambo baya zaidi.”
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

kikuyu: Yule mtu akaenda, akawaambia wale Wayahudi kuwa ni Yesu aliyemponya.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Wayahudi wakaanza kumsumbua Yesu, kwa sababu alikuwa anafanya mambo kama hayo siku ya Sabato.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Baba yangu anafanya kazi yake daima hata siku hii ya leo, nami pia ninafanya kazi.”
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

kikuyu: Maneno haya yaliwaudhi sana viongozi wa Wayahudi. Wakajaribu kila njia wapate jinsi ya kumuua, kwani si kwamba alivunja Sabato tu, bali alikuwa akimwita Mungu Baba yake, hivyo kujifanya sawa na Mungu.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, Mwana hawezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yake, yeye aweza tu kufanya lile analomwona Baba yake akifanya, kwa maana lolote afanyalo Baba, Mwana pia hufanya vivyo hivyo.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

kikuyu: Baba ampenda Mwana na kumwonyesha yale ambayo yeye Baba mwenyewe anayafanya, naye atamwonyesha kazi kuu kuliko hizi ili mpate kushangaa.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

kikuyu: Hakika kama vile Baba awafufuavyo wafu na kuwapa uzima, vivyo hivyo Mwana huwapa uzima wale anaopenda.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

kikuyu: Wala Baba hamhukumu mtu yeyote, lakini hukumu yote amempa Mwana,
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

kikuyu: ili wote wamheshimu Mwana kama vile wanavyomheshimu Baba. Yeyote asiyemheshimu Mwana, hamheshimu Baba aliyemtuma.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

kikuyu: “Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote anayesikia maneno yangu na kumwamini yeye aliyenituma, anao uzima wa milele, naye hatahukumiwa, bali amepita kutoka mautini, na kuingia uzimani.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

kikuyu: Amin, amin nawaambia, saa yaja, nayo saa ipo, wafu watakapoisikia sauti ya Mwana wa Mungu, nao watakaoisikia watakuwa hai.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

kikuyu: Kama vile Baba alivyo na uzima ndani yake, vivyo hivyo amempa Mwana kuwa na uzima ndani yake.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

kikuyu: Naye amempa Mwanawe mamlaka ya kuhukumu kwa kuwa yeye ni Mwana wa Adamu.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

kikuyu: “Msishangae kusikia haya, kwa maana saa inakuja ambapo wale walio makaburini wataisikia sauti yake.
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

kikuyu: Nao watatoka nje, wale waliotenda mema watafufuka wapate uzima na wale waliotenda maovu, watafufuka wahukumiwe.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

kikuyu: “Mimi siwezi kufanya jambo lolote peke yangu. Ninavyosikia ndivyo ninavyohukumu, nayo hukumu yangu ni ya haki kwa kuwa sitafuti kufanya mapenzi yangu mwenyewe, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

kikuyu: “Kama ningejishuhudia mimi mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu si kweli.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

kikuyu: Lakini yuko mwingine anishuhudiaye na ninajua kwamba ushuhuda wake ni wa kweli.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

kikuyu: “Mlituma wajumbe kwa Yohana, naye akashuhudia juu ya kweli.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

kikuyu: Si kwamba naukubali ushuhuda wa mwanadamu, la, bali ninalitaja hili kusudi ninyi mpate kuokolewa.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

kikuyu: Yohana alikuwa taa iliyowaka na kutoa nuru, nanyi kwa muda mlichagua kuifurahia nuru yake.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

kikuyu: “Lakini ninao ushuhuda mkuu zaidi kuliko wa Yohana. Kazi zile nizifanyazo, zinashuhudia juu yangu, zile ambazo Baba amenituma nizikamilishe, naam, ishara hizi ninazofanya, zinashuhudia kuwa Baba ndiye alinituma.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

kikuyu: Naye Baba mwenyewe ameshuhudia juu yangu. Hamjapata kamwe kuisikia sauti yake wala kuona umbo lake,
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

kikuyu: wala hamna neno lake ndani yenu, kwa sababu hamkumwamini yeye aliyetumwa naye.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

kikuyu: Ninyi mnachunguza Maandiko mkidhani ya kuwa ndani yake mna uzima wa milele, maandiko haya ndiyo yanayonishuhudia Mimi.
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

kikuyu: Lakini mnakataa kuja kwangu ili mpate uzima.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

kikuyu: “Mimi sitafuti kutukuzwa na wanadamu.
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

kikuyu: Lakini ninajua kwamba hamna upendo wa Mungu mioyoni mwenu.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

kikuyu: Mimi nimekuja kwa jina la Baba yangu, nanyi hamnipokei, lakini mtu mwingine akija kwa jina lake mwenyewe, mtampokea.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

kikuyu: Ninyi mwawezaje kuamini ikiwa mnapeana utukufu ninyi kwa ninyi, lakini hamna bidii kupata utukufu utokao kwa Mungu?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

kikuyu: “Lakini msidhani kuwa mimi nitawashtaki mbele za Baba, mshtaki wenu ni Mose, ambaye mmemwekea tumaini lenu.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

kikuyu: Kama mngelimwamini Mose, mngeliniamini na mimi kwa maana aliandika habari zangu.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

kikuyu: Lakini ikiwa hamwamini aliyoandika Mose, mtaaminije ninayoyasema?”
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

kikuyu: Baada ya haya, Yesu alikwenda ngʼambo ya Bahari ya Galilaya, ambayo pia huitwa Bahari ya Tiberia.
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

kikuyu: Umati mkubwa wa watu uliendelea kumfuata, kwa sababu waliona ishara nyingi za miujiza alizofanya kwa wagonjwa.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akapanda mlimani akaketi huko pamoja na wanafunzi wake.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

kikuyu: Yesu alipotazama na kuuona ule umati mkubwa wa watu ukimjia, akamwambia Filipo, “Tutanunua wapi mikate ili watu hawa wale?”
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

kikuyu: Aliuliza swali hili kumpima, kwa maana alishajua la kufanya.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

kikuyu: Filipo akamjibu, “Hata fedha kiasi cha dinari mia mbili, hazitoshi kununua mikate ya kuwapa watu hawa ili kila mtu apate kidogo.”
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

kikuyu: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wake aitwaye Andrea, ndugu yake Simoni Petro, akamwambia,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

kikuyu: “Hapa kuna mvulana mmoja mwenye mikate mitano ya shayiri na samaki wawili wadogo. Lakini hivi vitatosha nini kwa umati huu wote?”
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Waketisheni watu chini.” Palikuwa na majani mengi katika eneo lile, nao watu wakaketi. Palikuwa na wanaume wapatao 5,000.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akachukua ile mikate, akamshukuru Mungu na kuwagawia wale watu waliokuwa wameketi. Akafanya vivyo hivyo na wale samaki. Kila mtu akapata kadiri alivyotaka.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

kikuyu: Watu wote walipokwisha kula na kushiba, akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Kusanyeni vipande vilivyobaki vya ile mikate, kisipotee chochote.”
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

kikuyu: Hivyo wakavikusanya, wakajaza vikapu kumi na viwili kwa vipande vya ile mikate mitano ya shayiri na samaki wale wawili wadogo vilivyobakishwa na waliokula.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

kikuyu: Baada ya watu kuona muujiza ule Yesu aliofanya, walianza kusema, “Hakika huyu ndiye Nabii ajaye ulimwenguni!”
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Yesu akijua kwamba walitaka kuja kumfanya awe mfalme wao, kwa nguvu, akajitenga nao akaenda milimani peke yake.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

kikuyu: Ilipofika jioni, wanafunzi wake waliteremka kwenda baharini.
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

kikuyu: Wakaingia kwenye mashua, wakaanza kuvuka bahari kwenda Kapernaumu. Wakati huu kulikuwa tayari giza na Yesu alikuwa hajajumuika nao.
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

kikuyu: Bahari ikachafuka kwa sababu upepo mkali ulikuwa unavuma.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

kikuyu: Wanafunzi walipokuwa wamekwenda mwendo wa karibu maili tatu au nne, walimwona Yesu akitembea juu ya maji akikaribia mashua, nao wakaogopa sana.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Ni mimi. Msiogope.”
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakamkaribisha kwa furaha ndani ya mashua, na mara wakafika ufuoni walikokuwa wakienda.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

kikuyu: Siku iliyofuata, wale watu waliokuwa wamebaki ngʼambo waliona kwamba palikuwepo na mashua moja tu na kwamba Yesu hakuwa ameondoka pamoja na wanafunzi wake, ila walikuwa wameondoka peke yao.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

kikuyu: Lakini zikaja mashua nyingine kutoka Tiberia zikafika karibu na mahali pale walipokula mikate baada ya Bwana kumshukuru Mungu.
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

kikuyu: Mara wale watu wakatambua kwamba Yesu hakuwepo hapo, wala wanafunzi wake. Wakaingia kwenye mashua hizo, wakaenda Kapernaumu ili kumtafuta Yesu.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

kikuyu: Walipomkuta Yesu ngʼambo ya bahari wakamuuliza, “Rabi, umefika lini huku?”
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Amin, amin nawaambia, ninyi hamnitafuti kwa kuwa mliona ishara na miujiza, bali kwa sababu mlikula ile mikate mkashiba.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

kikuyu: Msishughulikie chakula kiharibikacho, bali chakula kidumucho hata uzima wa milele, ambacho Mwana wa Adamu atawapa. Yeye ndiye ambaye Mungu Baba amemtia muhuri.”
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakamuuliza, “Tufanye nini ili tupate kuitenda kazi ya Mungu?”
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Kazi ya Mungu ndiyo hii: Mwaminini yeye aliyetumwa naye.”
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

kikuyu: Hivyo wakamuuliza, “Utafanya ishara gani ya muujiza, ili tuione tukuamini? Utafanya jambo gani?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

kikuyu: Baba zetu walikula mana jangwani, kama ilivyoandikwa, ‘Aliwapa mikate kutoka mbinguni ili wale.’ ”
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, si Mose aliyewapa mikate kutoka mbinguni, bali Baba yangu ndiye anawapa mkate wa kweli kutoka mbinguni.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mkate wa Mungu ni yule ashukaye kutoka mbinguni na kuupa ulimwengu uzima.”
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

kikuyu: Wakamwambia, “Bwana, kuanzia sasa tupatie huo mkate siku zote.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Mimi ndimi mkate wa uzima. Yeye ajaye kwangu, hataona njaa kamwe na yeye aniaminiye, hataona kiu kamwe.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

kikuyu: Lakini kama nilivyowaambia, mmeniona lakini bado hamwamini.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

kikuyu: Wale wote anipao Baba watakuja kwangu na yeyote ajaye kwangu, sitamfukuzia nje kamwe.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa nimeshuka kutoka mbinguni si ili kufanya mapenzi yangu, bali mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo mapenzi yake yeye aliyenituma, kwamba, nisimpoteze hata mmoja wa wale alionipa, bali niwafufue siku ya mwisho.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mapenzi ya Baba yangu ni kwamba kila mmoja amtazamaye, Mwana na kumwamini awe na uzima wa milele, nami nitawafufua siku ya mwisho.”
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakaanza kunungʼunika kwa kuwa alisema, “Mimi ndimi mkate ulioshuka kutoka mbinguni.”
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

kikuyu: Wakasema, “Huyu si Yesu, mwana wa Yosefu, ambaye baba yake na mama yake tunawajua? Anawezaje basi sasa kusema, ‘Nimeshuka kutoka mbinguni’?”
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

kikuyu: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Acheni kunungʼunikiana ninyi kwa ninyi.
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu kama asipovutwa na Baba aliyenituma, nami nitamfufua siku ya mwisho.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

kikuyu: Imeandikwa katika Manabii, ‘Wote watafundishwa na Mungu.’ Yeyote amsikilizaye Baba na kujifunza kutoka kwake, huyo huja kwangu.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemwona Baba isipokuwa yeye atokaye kwa Mungu, yeye ndiye peke yake aliyemwona Baba.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

kikuyu: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye anayeamini anao uzima wa milele.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

kikuyu: Mimi ni mkate wa uzima.
english: I am the bread of life.

kikuyu: Baba zenu walikula mana jangwani, lakini wakafa.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

kikuyu: Lakini hapa kuna mkate utokao mbinguni, ambao mtu yeyote akiula, hatakufa.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

kikuyu: Mimi ni mkate wa uzima ule uliotoka mbinguni. Mtu yeyote akiula mkate huu, ataishi milele. Mkate huu ni mwili wangu, ambao nitautoa kwa ajili ya uzima wa ulimwengu.”
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Wayahudi wakaanza kuhojiana vikali wao kwa wao wakisema, “Mtu huyu awezaje kutupatia mwili wake tuule?”
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

kikuyu: Hivyo Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, msipoula mwili wa Mwana wa Adamu na kuinywa damu yake, hamna uzima ndani yenu.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote aulaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, anao uzima wa milele. Nami nitamfufua siku ya mwisho.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mwili wangu ni chakula cha kweli na damu yangu ni kinywaji cha kweli.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

kikuyu: Yeyote alaye mwili wangu na kunywa damu yangu, atakaa ndani yangu nami nitakaa ndani yake.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

kikuyu: Kama vile Baba aliye hai alivyonituma mimi, na kama nami ninavyoishi kwa sababu ya Baba, hivyo anilaye mimi ataishi kwa sababu yangu.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

kikuyu: Huu ndio mkate ushukao kutoka mbinguni, si kama ule mkate baba zenu waliokula nao wakafa. Lakini yeye aulaye mkate huu ataishi milele.”
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

kikuyu: Yesu alisema maneno haya alipokuwa akifundisha katika sinagogi huko Kapernaumu.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

kikuyu: Wengi wa wafuasi wake waliposikia jambo hili wakasema, “Mafundisho haya ni magumu. Ni nani awezaye kuyapokea?”
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

kikuyu: Yesu alipojua kwamba wafuasi wake wananungʼunika kuhusu mafundisho yake, akawaambia, “Je, jambo hili limewaudhi?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

kikuyu: Ingekuwaje basi kama mngemwona Mwana wa Adamu akipaa kwenda zake huko alipokuwa kwanza?
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?
