kikuyu: Roho ndiye atiaye uzima, mwili haufai kitu. Maneno haya niliyowaambia ni Roho tena ni uzima.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

kikuyu: Lakini baadhi yenu hamwamini.” Kwa maana Yesu alifahamu tangu mwanzo wale ambao hawangemwamini miongoni mwao na yule ambaye angemsaliti.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

kikuyu: Akaendelea kusema, “Hii ndiyo sababu niliwaambia kwamba hakuna mtu awezaye kuja kwangu isipokuwa amejaliwa na Baba yangu.”
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

kikuyu: Tangu wakati huo wafuasi wake wengi wakarejea nyuma wakaacha kumfuata.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

kikuyu: Hivyo Yesu akawauliza wale wanafunzi wake kumi na wawili, “Je, ninyi pia mnataka kuondoka?”
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

kikuyu: Simoni Petro akamjibu, “Bwana, tuondoke twende kwa nani? Wewe unayo maneno ya uzima wa milele.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

kikuyu: Tunaamini na kujua kuwa wewe ndiwe Aliye Mtakatifu wa Mungu.”
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akajibu, “Je, sikuwachagua ninyi kumi na wawili? Lakini mmoja wenu ni ibilisi.”
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

kikuyu: (Hapa alikuwa anasema juu ya Yuda, mwana wa Simoni Iskariote. Ingawa alikuwa mmoja wa wale kumi na wawili, ndiye ambaye baadaye angemsaliti Yesu.)
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

kikuyu: Baada ya mambo haya, Yesu alikwenda sehemu mbalimbali za Galilaya. Hakutaka kwenda Uyahudi kwa sababu Wayahudi huko walitaka kumuua.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

kikuyu: Sikukuu ya Vibanda ya Wayahudi ilikuwa imekaribia.
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

kikuyu: Hivyo ndugu zake Yesu wakamwambia, “Ondoka hapa uende Uyahudi ili wanafunzi Wako wapate kuona miujiza unayofanya.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

kikuyu: Mtu anayetaka kujulikana hafanyi mambo yake kwa siri. Kama unafanya mambo haya, jionyeshe kwa ulimwengu.”
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

kikuyu: Hata ndugu zake mwenyewe hawakumwamini.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Wakati wangu bado haujawadia, lakini wakati wenu upo siku zote.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

kikuyu: Ulimwengu hauwezi kuwachukia ninyi, lakini unanichukia mimi kwa sababu ninawashuhudia kwamba matendo yao ni maovu.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

kikuyu: Ninyi nendeni kwenye Sikukuu, lakini mimi sitahudhuria Sikukuu hii kwa sababu wakati wangu haujawadia.”
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Akiisha kusema hayo, akabaki Galilaya.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

kikuyu: Lakini ndugu zake walipokwisha kuondoka kwenda kwenye Sikukuu, yeye pia alikwenda lakini kwa siri.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

kikuyu: Wayahudi walikuwa wakimtafuta huko kwenye Sikukuu na kuulizana, “Yuko wapi huyu mtu?”
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

kikuyu: Kulikuwa na minongʼono iliyoenea kumhusu Yesu katika umati wa watu, wakati wengine wakisema, “Ni mtu mwema.” Wengine walikuwa wakisema, “La, yeye anawadanganya watu.”
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

kikuyu: Lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyemsema waziwazi kumhusu kwa sababu ya kuwaogopa Wayahudi.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

kikuyu: Ilipokaribia katikati ya Sikukuu, Yesu alipanda kwenda Hekaluni na kuanza kufundisha.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakastaajabia mafundisho yake wakasema, “Mtu huyu amepataje kujua mambo haya bila kufundishwa?”
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akawajibu, “Mafundisho yangu si yangu mwenyewe, bali yanatoka kwake yeye aliyenituma.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote akipenda kufanya mapenzi ya Mungu, atajua kama mafundisho yangu yanatoka kwa Mungu au ninasema kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

kikuyu: Wale wanenao kwa ajili yao wenyewe hufanya hivyo kwa kutaka utukufu wao wenyewe. Lakini yeye atafutaye utukufu wa yule aliyemtuma ni wa kweli, wala hakuna uongo ndani yake.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

kikuyu: Je, Mose hakuwapa ninyi sheria? Lakini hakuna hata mmoja wenu anayeishika hiyo sheria. Kwa nini mnataka kuniua?”
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

kikuyu: Ule umati wa watu ukamjibu, “Wewe una pepo mchafu! Ni nani anayetaka kukuua?”
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimefanya muujiza mmoja na nyote mkastaajabu.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa kuwa Mose aliwaamuru tohara (ingawa kwa kweli haikutoka kwa Mose bali kwa baba zenu wakuu), mnamtahiri mtoto hata siku ya Sabato.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtoto aweza kutahiriwa siku ya Sabato kusudi sheria ya Mose isivunjwe, kwa nini mnanikasirikia kwa kumponya mtu mwili wake wote siku ya Sabato?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

kikuyu: Acheni kuhukumu mambo kwa jinsi mnavyoona tu, bali hukumuni kwa haki.”
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

kikuyu: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wa Yerusalemu wakawa wanasema, “Tazameni, huyu si yule mtu wanayetaka kumuua?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

kikuyu: Mbona yuko hapa anazungumza hadharani na wala hawamwambii neno lolote? Je, inawezekana viongozi wanafahamu kuwa huyu ndiye Kristo?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

kikuyu: Tunafahamu huyu mtu anakotoka, lakini Kristo atakapokuja, hakuna yeyote atakayejua atokako.”
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu, akaendelea kufundisha Hekaluni, akisema, “Ninyi mnanifahamu na kujua nitokako. Mimi sikuja kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali yeye aliyenituma ni wa kweli na ninyi hammjui.
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: Mimi namjua kwa kuwa nimetoka kwake, naye ndiye alinituma.”
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakatafuta kumkamata, lakini hakuna mtu yeyote aliyethubutu kumshika kwa sababu saa yake ilikuwa bado haijawadia.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Nao watu wengi wakamwamini, wakasema, “Je, Kristo atakapokuja, atafanya miujiza mikuu zaidi kuliko aliyoifanya mtu huyu?”
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

kikuyu: Mafarisayo wakasikia watu wakinongʼona mambo kama hayo kuhusu Yesu, ndipo wao pamoja na viongozi wa makuhani wakatuma walinzi wa Hekalu waende kumkamata.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Mimi bado niko pamoja nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo, kisha nitarudi kwake yeye aliyenituma.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

kikuyu: Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona, nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja.”
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakaulizana wao kwa wao, “Huyu mtu anataka kwenda wapi ambako hatuwezi kumfuata? Je, anataka kwenda kwa Wayunani ambako baadhi ya watu wetu wametawanyikia, akawafundishe Wayunani?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

kikuyu: Yeye ana maana gani anaposema, ‘Mtanitafuta lakini hamtaniona,’ na, ‘nami niliko ninyi hamwezi kuja’?”
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Siku ile ya mwisho ya Sikukuu, siku ile kuu, wakati Yesu akiwa amesimama huko, akapaza sauti yake akasema, “Kama mtu yeyote anaona kiu na aje kwangu anywe.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

kikuyu: Yeyote aniaminiye mimi, kama Maandiko yasemavyo, vijito vya maji ya uzima vitatiririka ndani mwake.”
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

kikuyu: Yesu aliposema haya alimaanisha Roho Mtakatifu ambaye wote waliomwamini wangempokea, kwani mpaka wakati huo, Roho alikuwa hajatolewa, kwa kuwa Yesu alikuwa bado hajatukuzwa.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

kikuyu: Waliposikia maneno hayo, baadhi ya watu miongoni mwa ule umati wakasema, “Hakika huyu ndiye yule Nabii.”
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

kikuyu: Wengine wakasema, “Huyu ndiye Kristo!” Lakini wengine wakauliza, “Je, Kristo kwao ni Galilaya?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

kikuyu: Je, Maandiko hayasemi kwamba Kristo atakuja kutoka jamaa ya Daudi na kutoka Bethlehemu, mji alioishi Daudi?”
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo watu wakagawanyika kwa ajili ya Yesu.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

kikuyu: Baadhi yao walitaka kumkamata, lakini hakuna aliyethubutu kumgusa.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

kikuyu: Hatimaye wale walinzi wa Hekalu wakarudi kwa viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo waliokuwa wamewatuma ili kumkamata Yesu, wakaulizwa, “Mbona hamkumkamata?”
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

kikuyu: Wale walinzi wakajibu, “Kamwe hajanena mtu yeyote kama yeye anenavyo.”
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

kikuyu: Mafarisayo wakajibu, “Je, nanyi pia mmedanganyika?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

kikuyu: Je, kuna kiongozi yeyote au mmoja wa Mafarisayo ambaye amemwamini?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

kikuyu: Lakini huu umati wa watu wasiojua Sheria ya Mose, wamelaaniwa.”
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Nikodemo, yule aliyekuwa amemwendea Yesu siku moja usiku, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wao akauliza,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

kikuyu: “Je, sheria zetu zinaturuhusu kumhukumu mtu kabla ya kumsikiliza na kufahamu alilotenda?”
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

kikuyu: Wakamjibu, “Je, wewe pia unatoka Galilaya? Chunguza nawe utaona kwamba hakuna nabii atokae Galilaya!” [
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

kikuyu: Kisha wakaondoka, kila mtu akarudi nyumbani kwake.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu akaenda katika Mlima wa Mizeituni.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Alfajiri na mapema Yesu akaja tena Hekaluni, watu wote wakakusanyika, akakaa akaanza kuwafundisha.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

kikuyu: Walimu wa sheria na Mafarisayo wakamleta mwanamke mmoja aliyefumaniwa akizini. Wakamsimamisha katikati ya umati wa watu wote.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

kikuyu: Wakamwambia Yesu, “Mwalimu, huyu mwanamke amekutwa akizini.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

kikuyu: Katika sheria, Mose alituamuru kuwapiga kwa mawe wanawake wa namna hii, mpaka wafe. Sasa wewe wasemaje?”
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

kikuyu: Walimuuliza swali hili kama mtego ili wapate sababu ya kumshtaki. Lakini Yesu akainama akaanza kuandika ardhini kwa kidole chake.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Walipoendelea kumuulizauliza akainuka, akawaambia, “Kama kuna mtu yeyote miongoni mwenu ambaye hana dhambi na awe wa kwanza kumtupia jiwe.”
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

kikuyu: Akainama tena na kuandika ardhini.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Waliposikia haya, wakaanza kuondoka mmoja mmoja, wakianzia wazee, hadi Yesu akabaki peke yake na yule mwanamke akiwa amesimama mbele yake.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

kikuyu: Yesu akainuka na kumwambia, “Wako wapi wale waliokuwa wanakuhukumu kuwa mwenye hatia?”
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

kikuyu: Yule mwanamke akajibu, “Hakuna hata mmoja Bwana.” Yesu akamwambia, “Hata mimi sikuhukumu. Nenda zako, kuanzia sasa usitende dhambi tena.”]
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu. Mtu yeyote akinifuata hatatembea gizani kamwe, bali atakuwa na nuru ya uzima.”
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

kikuyu: Mafarisayo wakamwambia, “Ushuhuda wako haukubaliki kwa kuwa unajishuhudia mwenyewe.”
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Hata kama najishuhudia mwenyewe, ushuhuda wangu ni kweli kwa sababu najua nilikotoka na ninakokwenda. Lakini ninyi hamjui nilikotoka wala ninakokwenda.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

kikuyu: Ninyi mnahukumu kwa kufuata vipimo vya kibinadamu, mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

kikuyu: Lakini hata kama nikihukumu, uamuzi wangu ni sahihi kwa sababu sitoi hukumu yangu peke yangu, bali niko pamoja na Baba, aliyenituma.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

kikuyu: Imeandikwa katika Sheria yenu kwamba, ushahidi wa watu wawili ni thabiti.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

kikuyu: Mimi najishuhudia mwenyewe, naye Baba aliyenituma hunishuhudia.”
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakamuuliza, “Huyo Baba yako yuko wapi?” Yesu akawajibu, “Ninyi hamnifahamu mimi ni nani, wala hammfahamu Baba yangu. Kama mngenifahamu mimi, mngemfahamu na Baba yangu.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

kikuyu: Yesu alisema maneno haya alipokuwa akifundisha katika chumba cha hazina Hekaluni. Lakini hakuna mtu aliyemkamata kwa kuwa saa yake ilikuwa haijawadia.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia tena, “Ninaenda zangu, nanyi mtanitafuta, lakini mtakufa katika dhambi zenu. Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja.”
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wale Wayahudi wakasema, “Je, atajiua? Je, hii ndiyo sababu amesema, ‘Niendako mimi ninyi hamwezi kuja’?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Akawaambia, “Ninyi mmetoka chini, mimi nimetoka juu. Ninyi ni wa ulimwengu huu, mimi si wa ulimwengu huu.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

kikuyu: Niliwaambia kuwa mtakufa katika dhambi zenu, kwa maana msipoamini ya kwamba ‘Mimi Ndiye,’ mtakufa katika dhambi zenu.”
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Wewe ni nani?” Naye Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi ndiye yule ambaye nimekuwa nikiwaambia tangu mwanzo.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

kikuyu: Nina mambo mengi ya kusema juu yenu na mengi ya kuwahukumu. Lakini yeye aliyenituma ni wa kweli, nami nanena na ulimwengu niliyoyasikia kutoka kwake.”
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

kikuyu: Hawakuelewa kuwa alikuwa akiwaambia juu ya Baba yake wa Mbinguni.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia, “Mtakapokwisha kumwinua juu Mwana wa Adamu, ndipo mtakapojua kuwa, ‘Mimi ndiye yule niliyesema na kwamba mimi sitendi jambo lolote peke yangu bali ninasema yale tu ambayo Baba yangu amenifundisha.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

kikuyu: Yeye aliyenituma yu pamoja nami, hajaniacha, kwa kuwa siku zote nafanya mapenzi yake.’ ”
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

kikuyu: Wengi waliomsikia Yesu akisema maneno haya wakamwamini.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

kikuyu: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wale Wayahudi waliomwamini, “Kama mkidumu katika maneno yangu, mtakuwa wanafunzi wangu kweli kweli.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

kikuyu: Ndipo mtaijua kweli nayo kweli itawaweka huru.”
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

kikuyu: Wao wakamjibu, “Sisi tu wazao wa Abrahamu, nasi hatujawa watumwa wa mtu yeyote. Wawezaje kusema kwamba tutawekwa huru?”
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Amin, amin nawaambia, kila atendaye dhambi ni mtumwa wa dhambi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

kikuyu: Mtumwa hakai nyumbani anakotumika siku zote, lakini mwana hukaa nyumbani daima.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

kikuyu: Hivyo Mwana akiwaweka huru mtakuwa huru kweli kweli.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

kikuyu: Ninajua ya kuwa ninyi ni wazao wa Abrahamu, lakini mnatafuta wasaa wa kuniua kwa sababu ndani yenu hamna nafasi ya neno langu.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

kikuyu: Ninasema yale niliyoyaona mbele za Baba yangu, nanyi inawapa kufanya yale mliyosikia kutoka kwa baba yenu.”
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

kikuyu: Wakajibu, “Baba yetu ni Abrahamu.” Yesu akawaambia, “Kama mngekuwa wazao wa Abrahamu mngefanya mambo yale aliyofanya Abrahamu.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa ninyi mnatafuta kuniua, mtu ambaye nimewaambia kweli ile niliyosikia kutoka kwa Mungu, Abrahamu hakufanya jambo la namna hii.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

kikuyu: Ninyi mnafanya mambo afanyayo baba yenu.” Wakamjibu, “Sisi hatukuzaliwa kwa uzinzi. Tunaye Baba mmoja, Mungu pekee.”
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Kama Mungu angekuwa Baba yenu, mngenipenda, kwa maana nilitoka kwa Mungu na sasa niko hapa. Sikuja kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, ila yeye alinituma.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

kikuyu: Kwa nini hamwelewi ninayowaambia? Ni kwa sababu hamwezi kusikia nisemacho.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

kikuyu: Ninyi ni watoto wa baba yenu ibilisi, nanyi mnataka kutimiza matakwa ya baba yenu. Yeye alikuwa muuaji tangu mwanzo, wala hakushikana na kweli maana hamna kweli ndani yake. Asemapo uongo husema yaliyo yake mwenyewe kwa maana yeye ni mwongo na baba wa huo uongo.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa sababu nimewaambia kweli hamkuniamini!
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Je, kuna yeyote miongoni mwenu awezaye kunithibitisha kuwa mwenye dhambi? Kama nawaambia yaliyo kweli, mbona hamniamini?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

kikuyu: Yeye atokaye kwa Mungu husikia kile Mungu asemacho. Sababu ya ninyi kutosikia ni kwa kuwa hamtokani na Mungu.”
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakamjibu Yesu, “Je, hatuko sahihi tunaposema ya kwamba wewe ni Msamaria na ya kwamba una pepo mchafu?”
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Mimi sina pepo mchafu, bali ninamheshimu Baba yangu, nanyi mnanidharau.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi sitafuti utukufu wangu mwenyewe, bali yuko anayetaka kunitukuza, naye ndiye mwamuzi.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

kikuyu: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtu yeyote akilitii neno langu hataona mauti milele.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Wayahudi wakamwambia, “Sasa tumejua kwamba una pepo mchafu. Ikiwa Abrahamu alikufa na vivyo hivyo manabii, nawe unasema ‘Mtu akitii neno langu hatakufa milele.’
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

kikuyu: Je, wewe ni mkuu kuliko baba yetu Abrahamu ambaye alikufa na manabii ambao nao pia walikufa? Hivi wewe unajifanya kuwa nani?”
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Kama nikijitukuza utukufu wangu hauna maana. Baba yangu, huyo ambaye ninyi mnadai kuwa ni Mungu wenu, ndiye anitukuzaye mimi.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

kikuyu: Ingawa hamkumjua, mimi ninamjua. Kama ningesema simjui, ningekuwa mwongo kama ninyi, lakini mimi ninamjua na ninalitii neno lake.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

kikuyu: Baba yenu Abrahamu alishangilia kwamba angaliiona siku yangu, naye akaiona na akafurahi.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakamwambia, “Wewe hujatimiza hata miaka hamsini, wewe wasema umemwona Abrahamu?”
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, kabla Abrahamu hajakuwako, ‘Mimi niko.’ ”
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakaokota mawe ili kumpiga, lakini Yesu akajificha, naye akatoka Hekaluni.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

kikuyu: Yesu alipokuwa akipita, akamwona mtu aliyekuwa kipofu tangu kuzaliwa.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakamuuliza, “Rabi, ni nani aliyetenda dhambi, ni huyu mtu au wazazi wake hata azaliwe kipofu?”
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Huyu mtu wala wazazi wake hawakutenda dhambi. Alizaliwa kipofu ili kazi za Mungu zidhihirishwe katika maisha yake.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

kikuyu: Yanipasa kuzifanya kazi zake yeye aliyenituma wakati bado ni mchana, kwa kuwa usiku waja ambapo hakuna mtu awezaye kufanya kazi.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

kikuyu: Wakati niko ulimwenguni, mimi ni nuru ya ulimwengu.”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

kikuyu: Baada ya kusema haya, akatema mate ardhini, akatengeneza tope kwa mate na kumpaka yule mtu kipofu machoni.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

kikuyu: Kisha akamwambia, “Nenda ukanawe katika bwawa la Siloamu.” (Siloamu maana yake ni aliyetumwa.) Ndipo yule kipofu akaenda, akanawa, naye akarudi akiwa anaona.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

kikuyu: Majirani zake na wale wote waliokuwa wamemwona hapo awali akiombaomba wakaanza kuuliza, “Je, huyu si yule aliyekuwa akiketi akiombaomba?”
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

kikuyu: Wengine wakasema, “Ndiye.” Wengine wakasema, “Siye, bali wamefanana.” Lakini yeye akawaambia, “Mimi ndiye.”
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Basi macho yako yalifumbuliwaje?”
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

kikuyu: Yeye akawajibu, “Yule mtu aitwaye Yesu alitengeneza tope, akanipaka machoni mwangu, naye akaniambia nenda ukanawe katika Bwawa la Siloamu, ndipo nikanawa nami nikapata kuona!”
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

kikuyu: Wale wakamuuliza, “Yeye huyo mtu yuko wapi?” Akawajibu, “Sijui.”
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

kikuyu: Wakamleta kwa Mafarisayo yule mtu aliyekuwa kipofu hapo awali.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

kikuyu: Basi siku hiyo Yesu alipotengeneza tope na kuyafungua macho ya huyo mtu ilikuwa Sabato.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

kikuyu: Mafarisayo nao wakaanza kumuuliza alivyopata kuponywa. Naye akawaambia, “Alinipaka tope kwenye macho yangu, nikanawa na sasa ninaona.”
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo wakasema, “Huyu mtu hatoki kwa Mungu, kwa sababu hashiki Sabato.” Lakini wengine wakasema, “Awezaje mtu mwenye dhambi kufanya miujiza kama hii?” Wakagawanyika.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

kikuyu: Hivyo wakamwambia tena yule mtu aliyekuwa kipofu, “Wewe ndiwe uliyefumbuliwa macho, wasemaje kuhusu mtu huyo?” Maana macho yako ndiyo yaliyofumbuliwa. Yeye akawajibu, “Yeye ni nabii.”
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

kikuyu: Wale Wayahudi hawakuamini ya kuwa mtu huyo alikuwa kipofu, akapata kuona, mpaka walipowaita wazazi wake.
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

kikuyu: Wakawauliza, “Je, huyu ni mtoto wenu, ambaye mnasema alizaliwa kipofu? Imekuwaje basi sasa anaona?”
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

kikuyu: Wazazi wake wakajibu, “Tunajua ya kuwa huyu ni mtoto wetu na ya kuwa alizaliwa kipofu.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

kikuyu: Lakini sisi hatujui ni kwa jinsi gani kwamba sasa anaona, wala hatujui ni nani aliyemfungua macho yake. Muulizeni, yeye ni mtu mzima na anaweza kujieleza mwenyewe.”
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

kikuyu: Wazazi wake walisema hivi kwa sababu waliwaogopa Wayahudi kwani walikuwa wamekubaliana kuwa mtu yeyote atakayemkiri Yesu kuwa ndiye Kristo atafukuzwa kutoka sinagogi.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wazazi wake wakasema, “Yeye ni mtu mzima. Muulizeni.”
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

kikuyu: Hivyo kwa mara ya pili wakamwita yule aliyekuwa kipofu, nao wakamwambia, “Mpe Mungu utukufu! Sisi tunafahamu kuwa mtu huyu aliyekuponya ni mwenye dhambi.”
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Akawajibu, “Mimi sijui kama yeye ni mwenye dhambi. Lakini jambo moja ninalojua, nilikuwa kipofu na sasa ninaona.”
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

kikuyu: Wakamuuliza, “Alikufanyia nini? Aliyafumbuaje macho yako?”
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

kikuyu: Akawajibu, “Tayari nimekwisha kuwaambia, nanyi hamtaki kunisikiliza. Mbona mnataka kusikia tena? Je, ninyi nanyi mnataka kuwa wanafunzi wake?”
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakamtukana na kusema, “Wewe ndiwe mwanafunzi wake, Sisi ni wanafunzi wa Mose.
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

kikuyu: Tunajua kwamba Mungu alisema na Mose, lakini kwa habari ya mtu huyu hatujui atokako.”
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Yule mtu akawajibu, “Hili ni jambo la ajabu! Hamjui anakotoka, naye amenifungua macho yangu!
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

kikuyu: Tunajua ya kuwa Mungu hawasikilizi wenye dhambi, lakini huwasikiliza wote wanaomcha na kumtii.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

kikuyu: Tangu zamani hatujasikia kwamba mtu amemponya yeyote aliyezaliwa kipofu.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

kikuyu: Kama huyu mtu hakutoka kwa Mungu, asingeweza kufanya lolote.”
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

kikuyu: Wao wakamjibu, “Wewe ulizaliwa katika dhambi kabisa, nawe unajaribu kutufundisha?” Wakamfukuza atoke nje.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

kikuyu: Yesu aliposikia kuwa wamemfukuzia nje yule mtu aliyemfumbua macho, alimkuta akamuuliza, “Je, unamwamini Mwana wa Adamu?”
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

kikuyu: Yule mtu akamjibu, “Yeye ni nani, Bwana? Niambie ili nipate kumwamini.”
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Umekwisha kumwona, naye anayezungumza nawe, ndiye.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

kikuyu: Yule mtu akasema, “Bwana, naamini.” Naye akamwabudu.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Nimekuja ulimwenguni humu kwa ajili ya kuhukumu, ili wale walio vipofu wapate kuona, nao wale wanaoona, wawe vipofu.”
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

kikuyu: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliokuwa karibu naye wakamsikia na kumwambia, “Je, kweli sisi ni vipofu?”
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Kama mngekuwa vipofu kweli, msingekuwa na hatia ya dhambi, lakini kwa kuwa mnasema, ‘Tunaona,’ basi mna hatia.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

kikuyu: “Amin, amin nawaambia, yeye asiyeingia katika zizi la kondoo kwa kupitia kwenye lango, lakini akwea kuingia ndani kwa njia nyingine, ni mwizi na mnyangʼanyi.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

kikuyu: Yeye anayeingia kwa kupitia kwenye lango ndiye mchungaji wa kondoo.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

kikuyu: Mlinzi humfungulia lango na kondoo huisikia sauti yake. Huwaita kondoo wake kwa majina yao na kuwatoa nje ya zizi.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

kikuyu: Akiisha kuwatoa wote nje, hutangulia mbele yao na kondoo humfuata kwa kuwa wanaijua sauti yake.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

kikuyu: Lakini kondoo hawatamfuata mgeni bali watamkimbia, kwa sababu hawaijui sauti ya mgeni.”
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

kikuyu: Yesu alitumia mfano huu, lakini wao hawakuelewa hayo aliyokuwa akiwaambia.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Yesu akasema nao tena akawaambia, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mimi ndimi lango la kondoo.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

kikuyu: Wote walionitangulia ni wevi na wanyangʼanyi, lakini kondoo hawakuwasikia.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

kikuyu: Mimi ndimi lango, yeyote anayeingia zizini kwa kupitia kwangu ataokoka, ataingia na kutoka, naye atapata malisho.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

kikuyu: Mwizi huja ili aibe, kuua na kuangamiza. Mimi nimekuja ili wapate uzima kisha wawe nao tele.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

kikuyu: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Mchungaji mwema huutoa uhai wake kwa ajili ya kondoo.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Mtu wa kuajiriwa sio mchungaji mwenye kondoo. Amwonapo mbwa mwitu akija, yeye hukimbia na kuwaacha kondoo. Naye mbwa mwitu hulishambulia kundi na kulitawanya.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

kikuyu: Yeye hukimbia kwa sababu ameajiriwa wala hawajali kondoo.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

kikuyu: “Mimi ndimi mchungaji mwema. Ninawajua kondoo wangu nao kondoo wangu wananijua.
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

kikuyu: Kama vile Baba anavyonijua mimi, nami ninavyomjua Baba, nami nautoa uhai wangu kwa ajili ya kondoo.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Ninao kondoo wengine ambao si wa zizi hili, inanipasa kuwaleta, nao wataisikia sauti yangu, hivyo patakuwa na kundi moja na mchungaji mmoja.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

kikuyu: Baba yangu ananipenda kwa kuwa ninautoa uhai wangu ili niupate tena.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu aniondoleaye uhai wangu, bali ninautoa kwa hiari yangu mwenyewe. Ninao uwezo wa kuutoa uhai wangu na pia ninao uwezo wa kuutwaa tena. Amri hii nimepewa na Baba yangu.”
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

kikuyu: Kwa maneno haya Wayahudi waligawanyika.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

kikuyu: Wengi wao wakasema, “Huyu amepagawa na pepo mchafu, naye amechanganyikiwa.”
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

kikuyu: Wengine wakasema, “Haya si maneno ya mtu aliyepagawa na pepo mchafu. Je, pepo mchafu aweza kufungua macho ya kipofu?”
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

kikuyu: Wakati huo ilikuwa Sikukuu ya Kuwekwa wakfu kwa Hekalu huko Yerusalemu, nao ulikuwa wakati wa majira ya baridi.
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Naye Yesu alikuwa akitembea ndani ya Hekalu katika ukumbi wa Solomoni.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakamkusanyikia wakamuuliza, “Utatuweka katika hali ya mashaka mpaka lini? Kama wewe ndiye Kristo tuambie waziwazi.”
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Nimewaambia, lakini hamwamini. Mambo ninayoyatenda kwa jina la Baba yangu yananishuhudia.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

kikuyu: Lakini hamwamini, kwa sababu ninyi si wa kundi la kondoo wangu.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

kikuyu: Kondoo wangu huisikia sauti yangu nami nawajua, nao hunifuata,
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

kikuyu: nami ninawapa uzima wa milele, hawataangamia kamwe wala hakuna mtu atakayewapokonya kutoka mikono yangu.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

kikuyu: Baba yangu aliyenipa hawa ni mkuu kuliko wote na hakuna awezaye kuwapokonya kutoka mikononi mwake.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

kikuyu: Mimi na Baba yangu tu umoja.”
english: I and the Father are one.”

kikuyu: Kwa mara nyingine Wayahudi wakainua mawe ili wampige nayo,
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

kikuyu: lakini Yesu akawaambia, “Nimewaonyesha miujiza mingi mikubwa kutoka kwa Baba yangu. Ni ipi katika hiyo mnataka kunipiga mawe?”
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

kikuyu: Wayahudi wakamjibu, “Hatukupigi mawe kwa sababu ya mambo mema uliyotenda, bali ni kwa kuwa umekufuru. Wewe ingawa ni mwanadamu unajifanya kuwa Mungu.”
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Je, haikuandikwa katika Sheria ya kwamba, ‘Nimesema kuwa, ninyi ni miungu?’
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

kikuyu: Kama aliwaita ‘miungu,’ wale ambao neno la Mungu liliwafikia, nayo Maandiko hayawezi kutanguka,
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

kikuyu: je, mwawezaje kusema kwamba yule ambaye Baba amemweka wakfu na kumtuma ulimwenguni anakufuru, kwa sababu nilisema, ‘Mimi ni Mwana wa Mungu?’
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

kikuyu: Ikiwa sifanyi kazi za Baba yangu, basi msiniamini,
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

kikuyu: lakini ikiwa nazifanya kazi za Mungu, hata kama hamniamini mimi ziaminini hizo kazi, ili mpate kujua na kuelewa kwamba Baba yu ndani yangu, nami ndani yake.”
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

kikuyu: Ndipo wakajaribu kumkamata kwa mara nyingine, lakini akaponyoka kutoka mikononi mwao.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

kikuyu: Akaenda tena ngʼambo ya Mto Yordani mpaka mahali pale ambapo Yohana alikuwa akibatiza hapo awali, naye akakaa huko.
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

kikuyu: Watu wengi wakamjia, nao wakawa wakisema, “Yohana hakufanya muujiza wowote, lakini kila jambo alilosema kumhusu huyu mtu ni kweli.”
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

kikuyu: Nao wengi wakamwamini Yesu huko.
english: Many believed in him there.

kikuyu: Basi mtu mmoja jina lake Lazaro alikuwa mgonjwa. Yeye alikuwa akiishi Bethania kijiji cha Maria na Martha dada zake.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

kikuyu: Huyu Maria, ambaye Lazaro kaka yake alikuwa mgonjwa, ndiye yule ambaye alimpaka Bwana mafuta na kuifuta miguu yake kwa nywele zake.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

kikuyu: Hivyo hawa dada wawili walituma ujumbe kwa Yesu kumwambia, “Bwana, yule umpendaye ni mgonjwa.”
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

kikuyu: Lakini Yesu aliposikia hayo, akasema, “Ugonjwa huu hautaleta mauti bali umetokea ili kudhihirisha utukufu wa Mungu, ili Mwana wa Mungu apate kutukuzwa kutokana na ugonjwa huu.”
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

kikuyu: Pamoja na hivyo, ingawa Yesu aliwapenda Martha, Maria na Lazaro ndugu yao,
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

kikuyu: baada ya kusikia kwamba Lazaro ni mgonjwa, aliendelea kukawia huko alikokuwa kwa siku mbili zaidi.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

kikuyu: Ndipo akawaambia wanafunzi wake, “Haya, turudi Uyahudi.”
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakamwambia, “Rabi, Wayahudi walikuwa wanataka kukupiga mawe, nawe unataka kurudi huko?”
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Si kuna saa kumi na mbili za mchana katika siku moja? Wala watembeao mchana hawawezi kujikwaa kwa maana wanaona nuru ya ulimwengu huu.
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

kikuyu: Lakini wale watembeao usiku hujikwaa kwa sababu hakuna nuru ndani yao.”
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

kikuyu: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akawaambia, “Rafiki yetu Lazaro amelala, lakini naenda kumwamsha.”
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wakamwambia, “Bwana, kama amelala usingizi ataamka.”
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, Yesu alikuwa anazungumzia kuwa Lazaro amekufa, lakini wanafunzi wake hawakuelewa, walidhani kwamba anasema Lazaro amelala usingizi tu.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawaambia waziwazi, “Lazaro amekufa.
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo nafurahi kwa kuwa sikuwepo huko kabla ya Lazaro kufa, ili mpate kuamini. Lakini sasa twendeni kwake.”
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

kikuyu: Tomaso aliyeitwa Pacha akawaambia wanafunzi wenzake, “Sisi nasi twendeni tukafe pamoja naye.”
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipowasili huko alikuta Lazaro amekuwa kaburini siku nne.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

kikuyu: Basi Bethania ulikuwa karibu na Yerusalemu umbali wa karibu maili mbili,
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

kikuyu: na Wayahudi wengi walikuwa wamekuja kuwafariji Martha na Maria kwa ajili ya kufiwa na ndugu yao.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

kikuyu: Martha aliposikia kwamba Yesu anakuja, alitoka kwenda kumlaki, ila Maria alibaki nyumbani.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

kikuyu: Martha akamwambia Yesu, “Bwana, kama ungalikuwa hapa, ndugu yangu hangalikufa.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa ninajua kuwa chochote utakachomwomba Mungu, atakupa.”
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Ndugu yako atafufuka.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

kikuyu: Martha akamjibu, “Ninajua ya kuwa atafufuka wakati wa ufufuo wa wafu siku ya mwisho.”
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Mimi ndiye huo ufufuo na uzima. Yeye aniaminiye mimi, hata akifa atakuwa anaishi
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

kikuyu: na yeyote aishiye na kuniamini hatakufa kabisa hata milele. Je, unasadiki haya?”
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

kikuyu: Martha akamwambia, “Ndiyo Bwana, ninaamini ya kuwa wewe ndiwe Kristo, Mwana wa Mungu, yeye ajaye ulimwenguni.”
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Baada ya kusema haya Martha alikwenda, akamwita Maria dada yake faraghani na kumwambia, “Mwalimu yuko hapa anakuita.”
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

kikuyu: Maria aliposikia hivyo, akaondoka upesi akaenda mpaka alipokuwa Yesu.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

kikuyu: Yesu alikuwa hajaingia kijijini, bali alikuwa bado yuko mahali pale alipokutana na Martha.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

kikuyu: Wale Wayahudi waliokuwa pamoja na Maria nyumbani wakimfariji walipoona ameondoka haraka na kutoka nje, walimfuata wakidhani ya kwamba alikuwa anakwenda kule kaburini kulilia huko.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

kikuyu: Maria alipofika mahali pale Yesu alipokuwa, alipiga magoti miguuni Pake na kusema, “Bwana, kama ungalikuwa hapa, ndugu yangu hangalikufa.”
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

kikuyu: Yesu alipomwona Maria akilia na wale Wayahudi waliokuja pamoja naye pia wakilia, Yesu alisikia uchungu moyoni, akafadhaika sana.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

kikuyu: Akauliza, “Mmemweka wapi?” Wakamwambia, “Bwana, njoo upaone.”
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

kikuyu: Yesu akalia machozi.
english: Jesus wept.

kikuyu: Ndipo Wayahudi wakasema, “Tazama jinsi alivyompenda Lazaro!”
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

kikuyu: Lakini wengine wakasema, “Je, yule aliyefungua macho ya kipofu, hakuweza kumfanya na huyu asife?”
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

kikuyu: Yesu kwa mara nyingine akiwa amefadhaika sana, akafika penye kaburi. Hilo kaburi lilikuwa pango ambalo jiwe lilikuwa limewekwa kwenye ingilio lake.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Liondoeni hilo jiwe.” Martha ndugu yake yule aliyekuwa amekufa akasema, “Lakini Bwana, wakati huu atakuwa ananuka kwani amekwisha kuwa kaburini siku nne.”
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamwambia, “Sikukuambia kwamba kama ukiamini utauona utukufu wa Mungu?”
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wakaliondoa lile jiwe kutoka kaburini. Yesu akainua macho yake juu akasema, “Baba, ninakushukuru kwa kuwa wanisikia.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

kikuyu: Ninajua ya kuwa wewe hunisikia siku zote, lakini nimesema haya kwa ajili ya umati huu uliosimama hapa, ili wapate kuamini ya kuwa wewe umenituma.”
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

kikuyu: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu akapaza sauti yake akaita, “Lazaro, njoo huku!”
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

kikuyu: Yule aliyekuwa amekufa akatoka nje, mikono yake na miguu yake ikiwa imeviringishiwa vitambaa vya kitani na leso usoni pake. Yesu akawaambia, “Mfungueni, mwacheni aende zake.”
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

kikuyu: Hivyo Wayahudi wengi waliokuwa wamekuja kumfariji Maria, walipoona yale Yesu aliyoyatenda wakamwamini.
english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

kikuyu: Lakini baadhi yao wakaenda kwa Mafarisayo na kuwaambia mambo Yesu aliyoyafanya.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo wakaita mkutano wa baraza. Wakaulizana, “Tufanyeje? Huyu mtu anafanya ishara nyingi.
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

kikuyu: Kama tukimwacha aendelee hivi, kila mtu atamwamini, nao Warumi watakuja na kupaharibu mahali petu patakatifu na taifa letu.”
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

kikuyu: Mmoja wao aliyeitwa Kayafa, ambaye alikuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, akasema, “Ninyi hamjui kitu chochote!
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

kikuyu: Hamjui kwamba ni afadhali mtu mmoja afe kwa ajili ya watu, kuliko taifa lote liangamie?”
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

kikuyu: Hakusema haya kutokana na mawazo yake mwenyewe bali kama kuhani mkuu mwaka huo, alitabiri kuwa Yesu angelikufa kwa ajili ya taifa la Wayahudi,
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

kikuyu: wala si kwa ajili ya taifa hilo pekee, bali pia kwa ajili ya watoto wa Mungu waliotawanyika, ili kuwaleta pamoja na kuwafanya wawe wamoja.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Hivyo tangu siku hiyo wakawa wanafanya mipango ili wamuue Yesu.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Yesu akawa hatembei hadharani miongoni mwa Wayahudi, bali alijitenga akaenda sehemu iliyo karibu na jangwa kwenye kijiji kiitwacho Efraimu. Akakaa huko na wanafunzi wake.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Basi Pasaka ya Wayahudi ilipokuwa imekaribia, watu wengi walitoka vijijini wakaenda Yerusalemu kabla ya Pasaka ili wakajitakase.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

kikuyu: Watu wakawa wanamtafuta Yesu, nao waliposimama kwenye eneo la Hekalu waliulizana, Je, mtu huyu hatakuja kamwe kwenye Sikukuu?
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

kikuyu: Viongozi wa makuhani na Mafarisayo walikuwa wametoa amri kuwa yeyote atakayejua mahali Yesu aliko, lazima atoe taarifa ili wapate kumkamata.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

kikuyu: Siku sita kabla ya Pasaka, Yesu alikwenda Bethania mahali ambako Lazaro aliyekuwa amefufuliwa na Yesu alikuwa anaishi.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Wakaandaa karamu kwa heshima ya Yesu. Martha akawahudumia wakati Lazaro alikuwa miongoni mwa waliokaa mezani pamoja na Yesu.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

kikuyu: Kisha Maria akachukua chupa ya painti moja yenye manukato ya nardo safi ya thamani kubwa, akayamimina miguuni mwa Yesu na kuifuta kwa nywele zake. Nyumba nzima ikajaa harufu nzuri ya manukato.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

kikuyu: Ndipo Yuda Iskariote mwana wa Simoni, mmoja wa wale wanafunzi ambaye ndiye angemsaliti Yesu, akasema,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

kikuyu: “Kwa nini manukato haya hayakuuzwa kwa dinari 300 na fedha hizo wakapewa maskini?”
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

kikuyu: Yuda alisema hivi si kwa kuwa aliwajali maskini, bali kwa kuwa alikuwa mwizi, kwani ndiye alikuwa akitunza mfuko wa fedha akawa anaiba kile kilichowekwa humo.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

kikuyu: Yesu akasema, “Mwacheni. Aliyanunua manukato hayo ili ayaweke kwa ajili ya siku ya maziko yangu.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

kikuyu: Maskini mtakuwa nao siku zote, lakini mimi hamtakuwa nami siku zote.”
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

kikuyu: Umati mkubwa wa Wayahudi walipojua kwamba Yesu alikuwa huko Bethania, walikuja si tu kwa ajili ya Yesu, lakini pia kumwona Lazaro ambaye Yesu alikuwa amemfufua.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo viongozi wa makuhani wakafanya mpango wa kumuua Lazaro pia,
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa kutokana na habari za kufufuliwa kwake Wayahudi wengi walikuwa wanamwendea Yesu na kumwamini.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

kikuyu: Siku iliyofuata umati mkubwa uliokuwa umekuja kwenye Sikukuu walisikia kwamba Yesu angekuja Yerusalemu.
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Basi wakachukua matawi ya mitende, wakatoka kwenda kumlaki, huku wakipaza sauti wakisema, “Hosana!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Amebarikiwa Mfalme wa Israeli!”
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Yesu akamkuta mwana-punda akampanda, kama ilivyoandikwa,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

kikuyu: “Usiogope, Ewe binti Sayuni; tazama, Mfalme wako anakuja, amepanda mwana-punda!”
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake Yesu mwanzoni hawakuelewa mambo haya, lakini Yesu alipotukuzwa, ndipo walipokumbuka kuwa mambo haya yalikuwa yameandikwa kwa ajili yake na alitendewa yeye.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

kikuyu: Wale waliokuwepo wakati Yesu alipomwita Lazaro kutoka kaburini na kumfufua kutoka kwa wafu, waliendelea kushuhudia.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

kikuyu: Ni kwa sababu pia walikuwa wamesikia kwamba alikuwa ametenda muujiza huu ndiyo maana umati wa watu ukaenda kumlaki.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

kikuyu: Hivyo Mafarisayo walipoona hayo wakaambiana, “Mnaona, hamwezi kufanya lolote. Angalieni, ulimwengu wote unamfuata yeye!”
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

kikuyu: Basi palikuwa Wayunani fulani miongoni mwa wale waliokuwa wamekwenda kuabudu wakati wa Sikukuu.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

kikuyu: Hawa wakamjia Filipo, ambaye alikuwa mwenyeji wa Bethsaida huko Galilaya, wakiwa na ombi. Wakamwambia, “Tungependa kumwona Yesu.”
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

kikuyu: Filipo akaenda akamweleza Andrea, nao wote wawili wakamwambia Yesu.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesu akawajibu, “Saa imewadia ya Mwana wa Adamu kutukuzwa.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

kikuyu: Amin, amin nawaambia, mbegu ya ngano isipoanguka ardhini na kufa, hubakia kama mbegu peke yake. Lakini ikifa huzaa mbegu nyingi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote anayependa maisha yake atayapoteza, naye ayachukiaye maisha yake katika ulimwengu huu atayaokoa hata kwa uzima wa milele.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote akinitumikia lazima anifuate, nami mahali nilipo ndipo mtumishi wangu atakapokuwa. Mtu akinitumikia, Baba yangu atamheshimu.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

kikuyu: “Sasa roho yangu imefadhaika sana. Niseme nini? ‘Baba, niokoe katika saa hii.’ Lakini ni kwa kusudi hili nimeufikia wakati huu.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

kikuyu: Baba, litukuze jina lako.” Ndipo ikaja sauti kutoka mbinguni, “Nimelitukuza, nami nitalitukuza tena.”
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

kikuyu: Ule umati wa watu uliokuwa mahali pale uliisikia nao ukasema, “Hiyo ni sauti ya radi,” wengine wakasema, “Malaika ameongea naye.”
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

kikuyu: Yesu akawaambia, “Sauti hii imesikika kwa faida yenu, wala si kwa faida yangu.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

kikuyu: Sasa ni saa ya hukumu kwa ajili ya ulimwengu huu, sasa mkuu wa ulimwengu huu atatupwa nje.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

kikuyu: Lakini mimi, nikiinuliwa kutoka nchi, nitawavuta watu wote waje kwangu.”
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

kikuyu: Yesu aliyasema haya akionyesha ni kifo gani atakachokufa.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: Ule umati wa watu ukapiga kelele ukasema, “Tumesikia kutoka Sheria kwamba ‘Kristo adumu milele,’ wewe wawezaje kusema, ‘Mwana wa Adamu hana budi kuinuliwa juu’? Huyu ‘Mwana wa Adamu’ ni nani?”
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

kikuyu: Ndipo Yesu akawaambia, “Bado kitambo kidogo nuru ingalipo pamoja nanyi. Enendeni maadamu mna nuru, msije mkakumbwa na giza. Mtu anayetembea gizani hajui anakokwenda.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

kikuyu: Wekeni tumaini lenu katika nuru hiyo ili mpate kuwa wana wa nuru.” Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu aliondoka, akajificha wasimwone.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

kikuyu: Hata baada ya Yesu kufanya miujiza hii yote mbele yao, bado hawakumwamini.
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

kikuyu: Hili lilikuwa ili kutimiza lile neno la nabii Isaya lililosema: “Bwana, ni nani aliyeamini ujumbe wetu, na mkono wa Bwana umefunuliwa kwa nani?”
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

kikuyu: Kwa hivyo hawakuamini, kwa sababu Isaya anasema mahali pengine:
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

kikuyu: “Amewafanya vipofu, na kuifanya mioyo yao kuwa migumu, ili wasiweze kuona kwa macho yao, wala kuelewa kwa mioyo yao, wasije wakageuka nami nikawaponya.”
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

kikuyu: Isaya alisema haya alipoona utukufu wa Yesu na kunena habari zake.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

kikuyu: Lakini wengi miongoni mwa viongozi wa Wayahudi walimwamini, lakini kwa sababu ya Mafarisayo hawakukiri waziwazi kwa maana waliogopa kufukuzwa katika masinagogi.
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

kikuyu: Wao walipenda sifa za wanadamu kuliko sifa zitokazo kwa Mungu.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

kikuyu: Yesu akapaza sauti akasema, “Yeyote aniaminiye, haniamini mimi peke yangu, bali yeye aliyenituma.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

kikuyu: Yeyote anionaye mimi, amemwona yeye aliyenituma.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

kikuyu: Mimi nimekuja kama nuru ulimwenguni, ili kwamba kila mtu aniaminiye asibaki gizani.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

kikuyu: “Mimi simhukumu mtu yeyote anayesikia maneno yangu na asiyatii, kwa maana sikuja kuuhukumu ulimwengu, bali kuuokoa.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

kikuyu: Yuko amhukumuye yeye anikataaye mimi na kutokuyapokea maneno yangu, yaani, yale maneno niliyosema yenyewe yatamhukumu siku ya mwisho.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sisemi kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe, bali Baba aliyenituma aliniamuru ni nini cha kusema na jinsi ya kukisema.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

kikuyu: Nami ninajua amri zake huongoza hadi kwenye uzima wa milele. Hivyo lolote nisemalo, ndilo lile Baba aliloniambia niseme.”
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

kikuyu: Ilikuwa mara tu kabla ya Sikukuu ya Pasaka. Yesu alijua ya kuwa wakati wake wa kuondoka ulimwenguni ili kurudi kwa Baba umewadia. Alikuwa amewapenda watu wake waliokuwa ulimwenguni, naam, aliwapenda hadi kipimo cha mwisho.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

kikuyu: Wakati alipokuwa akila chakula cha jioni na wanafunzi wake, ibilisi alikuwa amekwisha kutia ndani ya moyo wa Yuda Iskariote, mwana wa Simoni, wazo la kumsaliti Yesu.
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

kikuyu: Yesu akijua ya kwamba Baba ameweka vitu vyote chini ya mamlaka yake na kwamba yeye alitoka kwa Mungu na alikuwa anarudi kwa Mungu,
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

kikuyu: hivyo aliondoka chakulani, akavua vazi lake la nje, akajifunga kitambaa kiunoni.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

kikuyu: Kisha akamimina maji kwenye sinia na kuanza kuwanawisha wanafunzi wake miguu na kuikausha kwa kile kitambaa alichokuwa amejifunga kiunoni.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

kikuyu: Alipomfikia Simoni Petro, Petro akamwambia, “Bwana, je, wewe utaninawisha mimi miguu?”
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Hivi sasa hutambui lile ninalofanya, lakini baadaye utaelewa.”
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

kikuyu: Petro akamwambia, “La, wewe hutaninawisha miguu kamwe.” Yesu akamjibu, “Kama nisipokunawisha, wewe huna sehemu nami.”
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

kikuyu: Ndipo Simoni Petro akajibu, “Usininawishe miguu peke yake, Bwana, bali pamoja na mikono na kichwa pia!”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Mtu aliyekwisha kuoga anahitaji kunawa miguu tu, kwani mwili wake wote ni safi. Ninyi ni safi, ingawa si kila mmoja wenu.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa yeye alijua ni nani ambaye angemsaliti, ndiyo sababu akasema si kila mmoja aliyekuwa safi.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

kikuyu: Alipomaliza kuwanawisha miguu yao, alivaa tena mavazi yake, akarudi alikokuwa ameketi, akawauliza, “Je, mmeelewa nililowafanyia?
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

kikuyu: Ninyi mnaniita mimi ‘Mwalimu’ na ‘Bwana,’ hii ni sawa, maana ndivyo nilivyo.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, ikiwa mimi niliye Bwana wenu na Mwalimu wenu nimewanawisha ninyi miguu, pia hamna budi kunawishana miguu ninyi kwa ninyi.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

kikuyu: Mimi nimewawekea kielelezo kwamba imewapasa kutenda kama vile nilivyowatendea ninyi.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

kikuyu: Amin, amin nawaambia, mtumishi si mkuu kuliko bwana wake, wala aliyetumwa si mkuu kuliko yule aliyemtuma.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

kikuyu: Sasa kwa kuwa mmejua mambo haya, heri yenu ninyi kama mkiyatenda.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

kikuyu: “Sisemi hivi kuhusu ninyi nyote. Ninawajua wale niliowachagua. Lakini ni ili Andiko lipate kutimia, kwamba, ‘Yeye aliyekula chakula changu, ameinua kisigino chake dhidi yangu.’
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

kikuyu: “Ninawaambia mambo haya kabla hayajatukia, ili yatakapotukia mpate kuamini ya kuwa Mimi ndiye.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

kikuyu: Amin, amin nawaambia, yeyote anayempokea yule niliyemtuma anipokea mimi, naye anipokeaye mimi ampokea yeye aliyenituma mimi.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Baada ya kusema haya, Yesu alifadhaika sana moyoni, akasema, “Amin, amin nawaambia, mmoja wenu atanisaliti.”
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Wanafunzi wake wakatazamana bila kujua kuwa alikuwa anamsema nani.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

kikuyu: Mmoja wa wanafunzi wake ambaye Yesu alimpenda sana, alikuwa ameegama kifuani mwa Yesu.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

kikuyu: Simoni Petro akampungia mkono yule mwanafunzi, akamwambia, “Muulize anamaanisha nani.”
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

kikuyu: Yule mwanafunzi akamwegemea Yesu, akamuuliza, “Bwana, tuambie, ni nani?”
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

kikuyu: Yesu akajibu, “Ni yule nitakayempa hiki kipande cha mkate baada ya kukichovya kwenye bakuli.” Hivyo baada ya kukichovya kile kipande cha mkate, akampa Yuda Iskariote, mwana wa Simoni.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

kikuyu: Mara tu baada ya kukipokea kile kipande cha mkate, Shetani akamwingia. Yesu akamwambia Yuda, “Lile unalotaka kulitenda litende haraka.”
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

kikuyu: Hakuna hata mmoja wa wale waliokuwa wameketi naye mezani aliyeelewa kwa nini Yesu alimwambia hivyo.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa Yuda alikuwa mtunza fedha, wengine walifikiri Yesu alikuwa amemwambia akanunue vitu vilivyohitajika kwa ajili ya Sikukuu, au kuwapa maskini chochote.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

kikuyu: Mara tu baada ya kupokea ule mkate, Yuda akatoka nje. Wakati huo ulikuwa ni usiku.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

kikuyu: Baada ya Yuda kutoka nje, Yesu akasema, “Sasa Mwana wa Adamu ametukuzwa, naye Mungu ametukuzwa ndani yake.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

kikuyu: Ikiwa Mungu ametukuzwa ndani ya Mwana, Mungu atamtukuza Mwana ndani yake mwenyewe naye atamtukuza mara.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

kikuyu: “Watoto wangu, mimi bado niko pamoja nanyi kwa kitambo kidogo. Mtanitafuta, na kama vile nilivyowaambia Wayahudi, vivyo hivyo sasa nawaambia na ninyi. Niendako, ninyi hamwezi kuja.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

kikuyu: “Amri mpya nawapa: Mpendane kama mimi nilivyowapenda ninyi, vivyo hivyo nanyi mpendane.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

kikuyu: Kama mkipendana ninyi kwa ninyi, kwa njia hii, watu wote watajua kuwa ninyi ni wanafunzi wangu.”
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

kikuyu: Simoni Petro akamuuliza, “Bwana, unakwenda wapi?” Yesu akamjibu, “Ninakokwenda huwezi kunifuata sasa, lakini utanifuata baadaye.”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

kikuyu: Petro akamuuliza tena, “Bwana, kwa nini siwezi kukufuata sasa? Mimi niko tayari kuutoa uhai wangu kwa ajili yako.”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

kikuyu: Yesu akamjibu, “Je, ni kweli uko tayari kuutoa uhai wako kwa ajili yangu? Amin, amin nakuambia, kabla jogoo hajawika, utanikana mara tatu.”
