english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

kikuyu: Hamjui kwamba aliyeungwa na kahaba anakuwa mwili mmoja naye? Kwa kuwa imenenwa, “Hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.”
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Lakini mtu aliyeungwa na Bwana anakuwa roho moja naye.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

kikuyu: Ikimbieni zinaa. Dhambi zingine zote atendazo mtu ziko nje ya mwili wake, lakini yeye aziniye hutenda dhambi ndani ya mwili wake mwenyewe.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

kikuyu: Je, hamjui ya kwamba miili yenu ni hekalu la Roho Mtakatifu akaaye ndani yenu, ambaye mmepewa na Mungu? Ninyi si mali yenu wenyewe,
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

kikuyu: kwa maana mmenunuliwa kwa gharama. Kwa hiyo mtukuzeni Mungu katika miili yenu.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

kikuyu: Basi kuhusu mambo yale mliyoyaandika: Ni vyema mwanaume asimguse mwanamke.
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

kikuyu: Lakini ili kuepuka zinaa, kila mwanaume na awe na mke wake mwenyewe na kila mwanamke awe na mume wake mwenyewe.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

kikuyu: Mume atimize wajibu wake wa ndoa kwa mkewe, naye vivyo hivyo mke kwa mumewe.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

kikuyu: Mwanamke hana mamlaka juu ya mwili wake bali mumewe, wala mume hana mamlaka juu ya mwili wake bali mkewe.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

kikuyu: Msinyimane, isipokuwa mmekubaliana kufanya hivyo kwa muda fulani ili mweze kujitoa kwa maombi, kisha mrudiane tena ili Shetani asije akapata nafasi ya kuwajaribu kwa sababu ya kutokuwa na kiasi.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

kikuyu: Nasema haya kama ushauri na si amri.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

kikuyu: Laiti watu wangekuwa kama mimi nilivyo. Lakini kila mtu amepewa kipawa chake kutoka kwa Mungu, mmoja ana kipawa cha namna hii na mwingine ana cha namna ile.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

kikuyu: Kwa wale wasiooa na kwa wajane, nasema hivi, ingekuwa vizuri wasioe.
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

kikuyu: Lakini kama hawawezi kujizuia, basi waoe na kuolewa, kwa maana ni afadhali kuoa au kuolewa kuliko kuwaka tamaa.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

kikuyu: Kwa wale waliooana nawapa amri (si mimi ila ni Bwana): Mke asitengane na mumewe.
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

kikuyu: Lakini akitengana, ni lazima akae bila kuolewa, ama sivyo apatane tena na mumewe. Wala mume asimpe mkewe talaka.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa wengine nasema (si Bwana ila ni mimi): Kama ndugu ana mke asiyeamini, naye huyo mke anakubali kuishi pamoja naye, basi asimwache.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

kikuyu: Naye mwanamke aaminiye kama ameolewa na mwanaume asiyeamini na huyo mume anakubali kuishi naye, basi huyo mwanamke asimwache.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

kikuyu: Kwa maana huyo mume asiyeamini anatakaswa kupitia mkewe, naye mke asiyeamini anatakaswa kupitia mumewe anayeamini. Kama isingalikuwa hivyo watoto wenu wangalikuwa si safi, lakini ilivyo sasa wao ni watakatifu.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

kikuyu: Lakini kama yule asiyeamini akijitenga, basi afanye hivyo. Katika hali kama hiyo mwanamke au mwanaume aaminiye hafungwi, kwa sababu Mungu ametuita tuishi kwa amani.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

kikuyu: Wewe mke, unajuaje kama utamwokoa mumeo? Au wewe mume unajuaje kama utamwokoa mkeo?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

kikuyu: Lakini kila mtu na aishi maisha aliyopangiwa na Bwana, yale Mungu aliyomwitia. Hii ni sheria ninayoiweka kwa makanisa yote.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Je, mtu alikuwa tayari ametahiriwa alipoitwa? Asijifanye asiyetahiriwa. Je, mtu alikuwa hajatahiriwa alipoitwa? Asitahiriwe.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

kikuyu: Kutahiriwa si kitu, na kutokutahiriwa si kitu. Lakini kuzitii amri za Mungu ndilo jambo muhimu.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

kikuyu: Basi kila mmoja wenu na abaki katika hali aliyoitwa nayo.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

kikuyu: Je, wewe ulipoitwa ulikuwa mtumwa? Jambo hilo lisikusumbue. Ingawaje unaweza kupata uhuru, tumia nafasi uliyo nayo sasa kuliko wakati mwingine wowote.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeyote aliyeitwa katika Bwana akiwa mtumwa yeye ni mtu huru kwa Bwana, kama vile yeyote aliyekuwa huru alipoitwa yeye ni mtumwa wa Kristo.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

kikuyu: Mlinunuliwa kwa gharama; msiwe watumwa wa wanadamu.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, kama kila mtu alivyoitwa, akae katika wito wake alioitiwa na Mungu.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

kikuyu: Basi, kuhusu wale walio bikira, mimi sina amri kutoka kwa Bwana, lakini mimi natoa shauri kama mtu ambaye ni mwaminifu kwa rehema za Bwana.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya shida iliyoko kwa sasa, naona ni vyema mkibaki kama mlivyo.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

kikuyu: Je, umeolewa? Basi usitake talaka. Je, hujaoa? Usitafute mke.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

kikuyu: Lakini kama ukioa, hujatenda dhambi; na kama bikira akiolewa, hajatenda dhambi. Lakini wale wanaooa watakabiliana na matatizo mengi katika maisha haya, nami nataka kuwazuilia hayo.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

kikuyu: Lakini ndugu zangu, nina maana kwamba muda uliobaki ni mfupi. Tangu sasa wale waliooa waishi kama wasio na wake;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

kikuyu: nao wanaoomboleza, kama ambao hawaombolezi; wenye furaha kama wasiokuwa nayo; wale wanaonunua, kama vile vitu walivyonunua si mali yao;
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

kikuyu: nao wale wanaoshughulika na vitu vya dunia hii, kama ambao hawahusiki navyo. Kwa maana dunia hii kama tunavyoiona sasa inapita.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

kikuyu: Ningetaka msiwe na masumbufu. Mwanaume ambaye hajaoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana, jinsi ya kumpendeza Bwana.
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

kikuyu: Lakini mwanaume aliyeoa anajishughulisha na mambo ya dunia, jinsi ya kumfurahisha mkewe,
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

kikuyu: na mawazo yake yamegawanyika. Mwanamke asiyeolewa hujishughulisha na mambo ya Bwana: lengo lake ni awe mtakatifu kimwili na kiroho. Lakini yule aliyeolewa hujishughulisha na mambo ya dunia, jinsi atakavyoweza kumfurahisha mumewe.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

kikuyu: Ninasema haya kwa faida yenu wenyewe, sio ili kuwawekea vizuizi bali mpate kuishi kwa jinsi ilivyo vyema bila kuvutwa pengine katika kujitoa kwenu kwa Bwana.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote anadhani kwamba hamtendei ilivyo sawa mwanamwali ambaye amemposa, naye akiwa umri wake unazidi kuendelea na mtu huyo anajisikia kwamba inampasa kuoa, afanye kama atakavyo. Yeye hatendi dhambi. Yawapasa waoane.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

kikuyu: Lakini mwanaume ambaye ameamua moyoni mwake kutooa bila kulazimishwa na mtu yeyote, bali anaweza kuzitawala tamaa zake kutomwoa huyo mwanamwali, basi anafanya ipasavyo.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

kikuyu: Hivyo basi, mwanaume amwoaye mwanamwali afanya vyema, lakini yeye asiyemwoa afanya vyema zaidi.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

kikuyu: Mwanamke aliyeolewa amefungwa na sheria maadamu mumewe yu hai. Lakini mumewe akifa, basi mwanamke huyo yuko huru kuolewa na mume mwingine ampendaye, lakini lazima awe katika Bwana.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa maoni yangu, angekuwa na furaha zaidi akibaki alivyo. Nami nadhani pia nina Roho wa Mungu.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Sasa kuhusu chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu, tunajua kwamba “sisi sote tuna ujuzi.” Lakini ujuzi hujivuna, bali upendo hujenga.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote anayedhani kwamba anajua kitu, bado hajui kama impasavyo kujua.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

kikuyu: Lakini mtu ampendaye Mungu, hujulikana naye Mungu.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

kikuyu: Hivyo basi, kuhusu kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu: Tunajua kwamba “Sanamu si kitu chochote kabisa duniani,” na kwamba “Kuna Mungu mmoja tu.”
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hata kama wapo hao wanaoitwa miungu, kama wakiwa mbinguni au duniani (kama ilivyo kweli wapo “miungu” wengi na “mabwana” wengi),
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

kikuyu: kwetu sisi yuko Mungu mmoja, aliye Baba, ambaye vitu vyote vyatoka kwake na kwa ajili yake sisi twaishi; na kuna Bwana mmoja tu, Yesu Kristo, ambaye kwa yeye vitu vyote vimekuwepo na kwa yeye tunaishi.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

kikuyu: Lakini si wote wanaojua jambo hili. Baadhi ya watu bado wamezoea sanamu kuwa halisi hivi kwamba wanapokula chakula kama hicho wanadhani kimetolewa sadaka kwa sanamu na kwa kuwa dhamiri zao ni dhaifu, dhamiri yao inanajisika.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

kikuyu: Lakini chakula hakituleti karibu na Mungu, wala hatupotezi chochote tusipokula, wala hatuongezi chochote kama tukila.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

kikuyu: Lakini angalieni jinsi mnavyotumia uhuru wenu usije ukawa kikwazo kwao walio dhaifu.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama mtu yeyote mwenye dhamiri dhaifu akiwaona ninyi wenye ujuzi huu mkila katika hekalu la sanamu, je, si atatiwa moyo kula chakula kilichotolewa sadaka kwa sanamu?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

kikuyu: Kwa njia hiyo, huyo ndugu mwenye dhamiri dhaifu, ambaye Kristo alikufa kwa ajili yake, ataangamia kwa sababu ya ujuzi wenu.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

kikuyu: Mnapotenda dhambi dhidi ya ndugu zenu kwa njia hii na kujeruhi dhamiri zao zilizo dhaifu, mnamkosea Kristo.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, kama kile ninachokula kitamfanya ndugu yangu aanguke katika dhambi, sitakula nyama kamwe, nisije nikamfanya ndugu yangu aanguke.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

kikuyu: Je, mimi si huru? Je, mimi si mtume? Je, mimi sikumwona Yesu, Bwana wetu? Je, ninyi si matunda ya kazi yangu katika Bwana?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

kikuyu: Hata kama mimi si mtume kwa wengine, hakika mimi ni mtume kwenu, kwa maana ninyi ni mhuri wa utume wangu katika Bwana.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

kikuyu: Huu ndio utetezi wangu kwa hao wanaokaa kunihukumu.
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

kikuyu: Je, hatuna haki ya kula na kunywa?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

kikuyu: Je, hatuna haki ya kusafiri na mke anayeamini, kama wanavyofanya mitume wengine na ndugu zake Bwana na Kefa?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

kikuyu: Au ni mimi na Barnaba tu inatubidi kufanya kazi ili tuweze kupata mahitaji yetu?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

kikuyu: Ni askari yupi aendaye vitani kwa gharama zake mwenyewe? Ni nani apandaye shamba la mizabibu na asile matunda yake? Ni nani achungaye kundi na asipate maziwa yake.
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

kikuyu: Je, nasema mambo haya katika mtazamo wa kibinadamu tu? Je, sheria haisemi vivyo hivyo?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

kikuyu: Kwa maana imeandikwa katika Sheria ya Mose: “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka.” Je, Mungu hapa anahusika na ngʼombe?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

kikuyu: Je, Mungu hasemi haya hasa kwa ajili yetu? Hakika yameandikwa kwa ajili yetu, kwa sababu mtu anapolima na mpuraji akapura nafaka, wote wanapaswa kufanya hivyo wakiwa na tumaini la kushiriki mavuno.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

kikuyu: Je, ikiwa sisi tulipanda mbegu ya kiroho miongoni mwenu, itakuwa ni jambo kubwa iwapo tutavuna vitu vya mwili kutoka kwenu?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

kikuyu: Kama wengine wana haki ya kupata msaada kutoka kwenu, isingepasa tuwe na haki hiyo hata zaidi? Lakini sisi hatukutumia haki hii. Kinyume chake, tunavumilia kila kitu ili tusije tukazuia Injili ya Kristo.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Je, hamjui kwamba, watu wafanyao kazi hekaluni hupata chakula chao kutoka hekaluni, nao wale wahudumiao madhabahuni hushiriki kile kitolewacho madhabahuni?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, Bwana ameamuru kwamba wale wanaohubiri Injili wapate riziki yao kutokana na Injili.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

kikuyu: Lakini sijatumia hata mojawapo ya haki hizi. Nami siandiki haya nikitumaini kwamba mtanifanyia mambo hayo. Heri nife kuliko mtu yeyote kuninyima huku kujisifu kwangu.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

kikuyu: Lakini ninapohubiri Injili siwezi kujisifu maana ninalazimika kuhubiri. Ole wangu nisipoihubiri Injili!
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

kikuyu: Nikihubiri kwa hiari, ninayo thawabu. Lakini kama si kwa hiari, basi ninachofanya ni kutekeleza tu uwakili niliowekewa.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

kikuyu: Basi je, thawabu yangu ni nini? Thawabu yangu ni hii: Ya kwamba katika kuhubiri Injili niitoe bila gharama, bila kutumia kwa utimilifu uwezo wangu nilio nao katika Injili.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

kikuyu: Ingawa mimi ni huru, wala si mtumwa wa mtu yeyote, nimejifanya kuwa mtumwa wa kila mtu, ili niweze kuwavuta wengi kadri iwezekanavyo.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

kikuyu: Kwa Wayahudi, nilikuwa kama Myahudi, ili niwapate Wayahudi. Kwa watu wale walio chini ya sheria, nilikuwa kama aliye chini ya sheria (ingawa mimi siko chini ya sheria), ili niweze kuwapata wale walio chini ya sheria.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

kikuyu: Kwa watu wasio na sheria nilikuwa kama asiye na sheria (ingawa siko huru mbali na sheria ya Mungu, bali niko chini ya sheria ya Kristo), ili niweze kuwapata wale wasio na sheria.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

kikuyu: Kwa walio dhaifu nilikuwa dhaifu, ili niweze kuwapata walio dhaifu. Nimekuwa mtu wa hali zote kwa watu wote ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kuwaokoa baadhi yao.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

kikuyu: Nafanya haya yote kwa ajili ya Injili, ili nipate kushiriki baraka zake.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

kikuyu: Je, hamjui kwamba katika mashindano ya mbio wote wanaoshindana hukimbia, lakini ni mmoja wao tu apewaye tuzo? Kwa hiyo kimbieni katika mashindano kwa jinsi ambavyo mtapata tuzo.
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

kikuyu: Kila mmoja anayeshiriki katika mashindano hufanya mazoezi makali. Wao hufanya hivyo ili wapokee taji isiyodumu, lakini sisi tunafanya hivyo ili kupata taji idumuyo milele.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo mimi sikimbii kama mtu akimbiaye bila lengo, sipigani kama mtu anayepiga hewa,
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

kikuyu: la, bali nautesa mwili wangu na kuutumikisha ili nikiisha kuwahubiria wengine, mimi nisiwe mtu wa kukataliwa.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, sitaki mkose kufahamu ukweli huu kwamba baba zetu walikuwa wote chini ya wingu na kwamba wote walipita katikati ya bahari.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

kikuyu: Wote wakabatizwa kuwa wa Mose ndani ya lile wingu na ndani ya ile bahari.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

kikuyu: Wote walikula chakula kile kile cha roho,
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

kikuyu: na wote wakanywa kile kile kinywaji cha roho, kwa maana walikunywa kutoka ule mwamba wa roho uliofuatana nao, nao ule mwamba ulikuwa Kristo.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

kikuyu: Lakini Mungu hakupendezwa na wengi wao, kwa hiyo miili yao ilitapakaa jangwani.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Basi mambo haya yalitokea kama mifano ili kutuzuia tusiweke mioyo yetu katika mambo maovu kama wao walivyofanya.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

kikuyu: Msiwe waabudu sanamu, kama baadhi yao walivyokuwa, kama ilivyoandikwa, “Watu waliketi chini kula na kunywa, kisha wakainuka kucheza na kufanya sherehe za kipagani.”
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

kikuyu: Wala tusifanye uzinzi kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa watu 23,000 kwa siku moja.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

kikuyu: Wala tusimjaribu Kristo, kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakafa kwa kuumwa na nyoka.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

kikuyu: Msinungʼunike kama baadhi yao walivyofanya, wakaangamizwa na mharabu.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

kikuyu: Mambo haya yote yaliwapata wao ili yawe mifano kwa wengine, nayo yaliandikwa ili yatuonye sisi ambao mwisho wa nyakati umetufikia.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

kikuyu: Hivyo, yeye ajidhaniaye amesimama, aangalie asianguke.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

kikuyu: Hakuna jaribu lolote lililowapata ambalo si la kawaida kwa wanadamu. Naye Mungu ni mwaminifu; hataruhusu mjaribiwe kupita mnavyoweza. Lakini mnapojaribiwa atawapa njia ya kutokea ili mweze kustahimili.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo wapenzi wangu, zikimbieni ibada za sanamu.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

kikuyu: Nasema watu wenye ufahamu, amueni wenyewe kuhusu haya niyasemayo.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

kikuyu: Je, kikombe cha baraka ambacho tunakibariki, si ushirika katika damu ya Kristo? Mkate tuumegao, si ushirika wa mwili wa Kristo?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mkate ni mmoja, sisi tulio wengi tu mwili mmoja, kwa kuwa wote twashiriki mkate mmoja.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

kikuyu: Waangalieni watu wa Israeli: Je, wale wote walao dhabihu si ni wale watendao kazi madhabahuni?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

kikuyu: Je, nina maana kwamba kafara iliyotolewa kwa sanamu ni kitu chenye maana yoyote? Au kwamba sanamu ni kitu chenye maana yoyote?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

kikuyu: La hasha! Lakini kafara za watu wasiomjua Mungu hutolewa kwa mashetani, wala si kwa Mungu. Nami sitaki ninyi mwe na ushirika na mashetani.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

kikuyu: Hamwezi kunywa katika kikombe cha Bwana na cha mashetani pia. Hamwezi kuwa na sehemu katika meza ya Bwana na katika meza ya mashetani pia.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

kikuyu: Je, tunataka kuamsha wivu wa Bwana? Je, sisi tuna nguvu kuliko yeye?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

kikuyu: “Vitu vyote ni halali,” lakini si vitu vyote vilivyo na faida. “Vitu vyote ni halali,” lakini si vyote vinavyojenga.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote asitafute yaliyo yake mwenyewe, bali kila mtu atafute yale yanayowafaa wengine.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

kikuyu: Kuleni chochote kinachouzwa sokoni, bila kuuliza swali lolote kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

kikuyu: Kwa maana, “Dunia na vyote vilivyomo ni mali ya Bwana.”
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

kikuyu: Kama ukikaribishwa chakula na mtu asiyeamini nawe ukikubali kwenda, kula kila kitu kitakachowekwa mbele yako bila kuuliza maswali kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mtu yeyote akikuambia, “Hiki kimetolewa kafara kwa sanamu,” basi usikile kwa ajili ya huyo aliyekuambia na kwa ajili ya dhamiri.
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

kikuyu: Nina maana dhamiri ya huyo aliyekuambia, wala si kwa ajili ya dhamiri yako. Lakini kwa nini uhuru wangu uhukumiwe na dhamiri ya mtu mwingine?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

kikuyu: Kama nikila kwa shukrani, kwa nini nashutumiwa kwa kile ambacho kwa hicho ninamshukuru Mungu?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

kikuyu: Basi, lolote mfanyalo, kama ni kula au kunywa, fanyeni yote kwa utukufu wa Mungu.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Msiwe kikwazo kwa mtu yeyote, wawe Wayahudi au Wayunani, au kwa kanisa la Mungu,
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

kikuyu: kama hata mimi ninavyojaribu kumpendeza kila mtu kwa kila namna. Kwa maana sitafuti mema kwa ajili yangu mwenyewe bali kwa ajili ya wengi, ili waweze kuokolewa.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Igeni mfano wangu, kama ninavyouiga mfano wa Kristo.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

kikuyu: Ninawasifu kwa kuwa mnanikumbuka katika kila jambo na kwa kushika mafundisho niliyowapa.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

kikuyu: Napenda mfahamu kwamba kichwa cha kila mwanaume ni Kristo, na kichwa cha mwanamke ni mwanaume, nacho kichwa cha Kristo ni Mungu.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

kikuyu: Kila mwanaume anayeomba au kutoa unabii akiwa amefunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

kikuyu: Naye kila mwanamke anayeomba au kutoa unabii pasipo kufunika kichwa chake, anakiaibisha kichwa chake, kwani ni sawa na yeye aliyenyoa nywele.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

kikuyu: Kama mwanamke hatajifunika kichwa chake, basi inampasa kunyoa nywele zake. Lakini kama ni aibu kwa mwanamke kukata au kunyoa nywele zake, basi afunike kichwa chake.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

kikuyu: Haimpasi mwanaume kufunika kichwa chake kwa kuwa yeye ni mfano wa Mungu na utukufu wa Mungu, lakini mwanamke ni utukufu wa mwanaume.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mwanaume hakutoka kwa mwanamke, bali mwanamke alitoka kwa mwanaume.
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

kikuyu: Wala mwanaume hakuumbwa kwa ajili ya mwanamke, bali mwanamke kwa ajili ya mwanaume.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii na kwa sababu ya malaika, inampasa mwanamke awe na ishara ya mamlaka juu yake.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

kikuyu: Lakini katika Bwana, mwanamke hajitegemei pasipo mwanaume na mwanaume hajitegemei pasipo mwanamke.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

kikuyu: Kama vile mwanamke alivyoumbwa kutoka kwa mwanaume, vivyo hivyo mwanaume huzaliwa na mwanamke. Lakini vitu vyote vyatoka kwa Mungu.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

kikuyu: Hukumuni ninyi wenyewe: Je, inafaa kwa mwanamke kumwomba Mungu bila kufunika kichwa chake?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

kikuyu: Je, maumbile ya asili hayatufundishi kuwa ni aibu kwa mwanaume kuwa na nywele ndefu?
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

kikuyu: Lakini mwanamke akiwa na nywele ndefu ni utukufu kwake? Kwa maana mwanamke amepewa nywele ndefu ili kumfunika.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

kikuyu: Kama mtu anataka kubishana juu ya jambo hili, sisi wala makanisa ya Mungu hatutambui desturi nyingine.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

kikuyu: Basi katika maagizo yafuatayo, siwezi kuwasifu, kwa sababu mkutanikapo si kwa ajili ya faida bali kwa hasara.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

kikuyu: Kwanza, mnapokutana kama kanisa, nasikia kwamba kuna mgawanyiko miongoni mwenu, nami kwa kiasi fulani nasadiki kuwa ndivyo ilivyo.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

kikuyu: Bila shaka lazima pawe na tofauti miongoni mwenu ili kuonyesha ni nani anayekubaliwa na Mungu.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

kikuyu: Mkutanikapo pamoja si chakula cha Bwana mnachokula,
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa mnapokula, kila mmoja wenu anakula bila kuwangoja wengine. Mmoja hukaa njaa na mwingine analewa.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

kikuyu: Je, hamna nyumbani kwenu ambako mnaweza kula na kunywa? Au mnalidharau kanisa la Mungu na kuwadhalilisha wale wasio na kitu? Niwaambie nini? Je, niwasifu juu ya jambo hili? La, hasha!
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mimi nilipokea kutoka kwa Bwana yale niliyowapa ninyi, kwamba Bwana Yesu, usiku ule aliposalitiwa, alitwaa mkate,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

kikuyu: naye akiisha kushukuru, akaumega, akasema, “Huu ndio mwili wangu, uliotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi kwa ukumbusho wangu.”
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo baada ya kula, akakitwaa kikombe, akisema, “Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya katika damu yangu. Fanyeni hivi kila mnywapo, kwa ukumbusho wangu.”
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Maana kila mlapo mkate huu na kunywea kikombe hiki, mnatangaza mauti ya Bwana mpaka ajapo.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, mtu yeyote alaye mkate huo au kukinywea kikombe hicho cha Bwana isivyostahili, atakuwa na hatia ya dhambi juu ya mwili na damu ya Bwana.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

kikuyu: Inampasa mtu ajichunguze mwenyewe, kabla ya kula mkate na kukinywea kikombe.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mtu yeyote alaye na kunywa pasipo kuutambua mwili wa Bwana, hula na kunywa hukumu juu yake mwenyewe.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo sababu wengi miongoni mwenu ni wagonjwa na dhaifu na wengine wenu hata wamekufa.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

kikuyu: Lakini kama tungejichunguza wenyewe tusingehukumiwa.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

kikuyu: Tunapohukumiwa na Bwana, tunaadibishwa ili tusije tukahukumiwa pamoja na ulimwengu.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, mkutanikapo pamoja ili kula, mngojane.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

kikuyu: Kama mtu akiwa na njaa, ale nyumbani kwake ili mkutanapo pamoja msije mkahukumiwa. Nami nitakapokuja nitawapa maelekezo zaidi.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

kikuyu: Basi ndugu zangu, kuhusu karama za rohoni, sitaki mkose kufahamu.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

kikuyu: Mnajua kwamba mlipokuwa watu wasiomjua Mungu, kwa njia moja au ingine mlishawishika na kupotoshwa mkielekezwa kwa sanamu zisizonena.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nawaambieni ya kuwa hakuna mtu anayeongozwa na Roho wa Mungu anayeweza kusema, “Yesu na alaaniwe.” Pia hakuna mtu awezaye kusema, “Yesu ni Bwana,” isipokuwa ameongozwa na Roho Mtakatifu.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Kuna aina mbalimbali za karama, lakini Roho ni yule yule.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

kikuyu: Kuna huduma za aina mbalimbali, lakini Bwana ni yule yule.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

kikuyu: Kisha kuna tofauti za kutenda kazi, lakini ni Mungu yule yule atendaye kazi zote kwa watu wote.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

kikuyu: Basi kila mmoja hupewa ufunuo wa Roho kwa faida ya wote.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

kikuyu: Maana mtu mmoja kwa Roho hupewa neno la hekima na mwingine neno la maarifa kwa Roho huyo huyo.
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

kikuyu: Mtu mwingine imani kwa huyo Roho na mwingine karama za kuponya kwa huyo Roho mmoja.
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

kikuyu: Kwa mwingine matendo ya miujiza, kwa mwingine unabii kwa mwingine kupambanua roho, kwa mwingine aina mbalimbali za lugha, na kwa mwingine bado, tafsiri za lugha.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

kikuyu: Haya yote hufanywa na huyo huyo Roho mmoja, Roho naye humgawia kila mtu, kama apendavyo.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

kikuyu: Kama vile mwili ulivyo mmoja nao una viungo vingi, navyo viungo vyote vya mwili ingawa ni vingi, ni mwili mmoja, vivyo hivyo na Kristo.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

kikuyu: Kwa maana katika Roho mmoja wote tulibatizwa katika mwili mmoja, kama ni Wayahudi au Wayunani, kama ni watumwa au watu huru, nasi sote tulinyweshwa Roho mmoja.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

kikuyu: Basi mwili si kiungo kimoja, bali ni viungo vingi.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

kikuyu: Kama mguu ungesema, “Kwa kuwa mimi si mkono basi mimi si wa mwili,” hiyo isingefanya huo mguu usiwe sehemu ya mwili.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Na kama sikio lingesema, “Kwa kuwa mimi si jicho, basi mimi si wa mwili,” hiyo isingefanya hilo sikio lisiwe sehemu ya mwili.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Kama mwili wote ungelikuwa jicho, kusikia kungekuwa wapi? Au kama mwili wote ungelikuwa sikio, kunusa kungekuwa wapi?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

kikuyu: Lakini kama ilivyo, Mungu ameweka viungo katika mwili, kila kimoja kama alivyopenda.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

kikuyu: Kama vyote vingekuwa kiungo kimoja, mwili ungekuwa wapi?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

kikuyu: Kama ulivyo, una viungo vingi, lakini mwili ni mmoja.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

kikuyu: Jicho haliwezi kuuambia mkono, “Sina haja nawe!” Wala kichwa hakiwezi kuiambia miguu, “Sina haja na ninyi!”
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

kikuyu: Lakini badala yake, vile viungo vya mwili vinavyoonekana kuwa dhaifu, ndivyo ambavyo ni vya muhimu sana.
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

kikuyu: Navyo vile viungo tunavyoviona havina heshima, ndivyo tunavipa heshima maalum. Vile viungo vya mwili ambavyo havina uzuri, tunavipa heshima ya pekee;
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

kikuyu: wakati vile viungo vyenye uzuri havihitaji utunzaji wa pekee. Lakini Mungu ameviweka pamoja viungo vya mwili na akavipa heshima zaidi vile vilivyopungukiwa,
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

kikuyu: ili pasiwe na mafarakano katika mwili, bali viungo vyote vihudumiane kwa usawa kila kimoja na mwenzake.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

kikuyu: Kama kiungo kimoja kikiumia, viungo vyote huumia pamoja nacho, kama kiungo kimoja kikipewa heshima, viungo vyote hufurahi pamoja nacho.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

kikuyu: Sasa ninyi ni mwili wa Kristo na kila mmoja wenu ni sehemu ya huo mwili.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

kikuyu: Mungu ameweka katika kanisa, kwanza mitume, pili manabii, tatu walimu, kisha watenda miujiza, pia karama za kuponya, karama za kusaidiana, karama za uongozi, aina mbalimbali za lugha.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

kikuyu: Je, wote ni mitume? Je, wote ni manabii? Je, wote ni walimu? Je, wote wanatenda miujiza?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

kikuyu: Je, wote wana karama ya kuponya? Je, wote hunena kwa lugha mpya? Je, wote wanatafsiri?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

kikuyu: Basi tamanini sana karama zilizo kuu. Nami nitawaonyesha njia iliyo bora zaidi.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

kikuyu: Hata kama nitasema kwa lugha za wanadamu na za malaika, kama sina upendo, nimekuwa kengele inayolialia au toazi livumalo.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

kikuyu: Ningekuwa na karama ya unabii na kujua siri zote na maarifa yote, hata kama nina imani kiasi cha kuweza kuhamisha milima, kama sina upendo, mimi si kitu.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

kikuyu: Kama nikitoa mali yote niliyo nayo na kama nikijitolea mwili wangu uchomwe moto, kama sina upendo, hainifaidi kitu.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

kikuyu: Upendo huvumilia, upendo hufadhili, upendo hauoni wivu, hauna majivuno, hauna kiburi.
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

kikuyu: Haukosi kuwa na adabu, hautafuti mambo yake, haukasiriki upesi, hauweki kumbukumbu ya mabaya.
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

kikuyu: Upendo haufurahii mabaya bali hufurahi pamoja na kweli.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

kikuyu: Upendo huvumilia yote, huamini yote, hutumaini yote, hustahimili yote.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

kikuyu: Upendo haushindwi kamwe. Lakini ukiwepo unabii, utakoma; zikiwepo lugha, zitakoma; yakiwepo maarifa, yatapita.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

kikuyu: Kwa maana tunafahamu kwa sehemu na tunatoa unabii kwa sehemu.
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

kikuyu: Lakini ukamilifu ukija, yale yasiyo kamili hutoweka.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

kikuyu: Nilipokuwa mtoto, nilisema kama mtoto, niliwaza kama mtoto, nilifikiri kama mtoto. Nilipokuwa mtu mzima niliacha mambo ya kitoto.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sasa tunaona taswira kama kwa kioo, lakini wakati huo tutaona wazi. Sasa nafahamu kwa sehemu, wakati huo nitafahamu kikamilifu, kama vile mimi ninavyofahamika kikamilifu.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

kikuyu: Basi sasa, yanadumu mambo haya matatu: Imani, tumaini na upendo. Lakini lililo kuu miongoni mwa haya matatu ni upendo.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

kikuyu: Fuateni upendo na kutaka sana karama za roho, hasa karama ya unabii.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mtu yeyote anayesema kwa lugha, hasemi na wanadamu bali anasema na Mungu. Kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote anayemwelewa, kwani anasema mambo ya siri kwa roho.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

kikuyu: Lakini anayetoa unabii anasema na watu akiwajenga, kuwatia moyo na kuwafariji.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

kikuyu: Anenaye kwa lugha hujijenga mwenyewe, bali atoaye unabii hulijenga kanisa.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

kikuyu: Ningependa kila mmoja wenu anene kwa lugha lakini ningependa zaidi nyote mtoe unabii. Kwa kuwa yeye atoaye unabii ni mkuu kuliko anenaye kwa lugha, isipokuwa atafsiri, ili kanisa lipate kujengwa.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

kikuyu: Sasa ndugu zangu, kama nikija kwenu nikasema kwa lugha mpya nitawafaidia nini kama sikuwaletea ufunuo au neno la maarifa au unabii au mafundisho?
english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

kikuyu: Hata vitu visivyo na uhai vitoapo sauti, kama vile filimbi au kinubi, mtu atajuaje ni wimbo gani unaoimbwa kusipokuwa na tofauti ya upigaji?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

kikuyu: Tena kama tarumbeta haitoi sauti inayoeleweka, ni nani atakayejiandaa kwa ajili ya vita?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo na ninyi, kama mkinena maneno yasiyoeleweka katika akili, mtu atajuaje mnalosema? Kwa maana mtakuwa mnasema hewani tu.
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

kikuyu: Bila shaka ziko sauti nyingi ulimwenguni, wala hakuna isiyo na maana.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

kikuyu: Basi kama sielewi maana ya hiyo sauti, nitakuwa mgeni kwa yule msemaji, naye atakuwa mgeni kwangu.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo na ninyi. Kwa kuwa mnatamani kuwa na karama za rohoni, jitahidini kuzidi sana katika karama kwa ajili ya kulijenga kanisa.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii, yeye anenaye kwa lugha na aombe kwamba apate kutafsiri kile anachonena.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nikiomba kwa lugha, roho yangu inaomba, lakini akili yangu haina matunda.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

kikuyu: Nifanyeje basi? Nitaomba kwa roho, na pia nitaomba kwa akili yangu. Nitaimba kwa roho na nitaimba kwa akili yangu pia.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

kikuyu: Ikiwa unabariki kwa roho, mtu mwingine atakayejikuta miongoni mwa hao wasiojua, atawezaje kusema “Amen” katika kushukuru kwako, wakati haelewi unachosema?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

kikuyu: Mnaweza kuwa mnatoa shukrani kweli, sawa, lakini huyo mtu mwingine hajengeki.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

kikuyu: Namshukuru Mungu kwamba mimi nanena kwa lugha kuliko ninyi nyote.
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

kikuyu: Lakini ndani ya kanisa ni afadhali niseme maneno matano ya kueleweka ili niwafundishe wengine kuliko kusema maneno 10,000 kwa lugha.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, msiwe kama watoto katika kufikiri kwenu, afadhali kuhusu uovu mwe kama watoto wachanga, lakini katika kufikiri kwenu, mwe watu wazima.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

kikuyu: Katika Sheria imeandikwa kwamba: “Kupitia kwa watu wenye lugha ngʼeni na kupitia midomo ya wageni, nitasema na watu hawa, lakini hata hivyo hawatanisikiliza,” asema Bwana.
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Basi kunena kwa lugha ni ishara, si kwa watu waaminio, bali kwa wasioamini, wakati unabii si kwa ajili ya wasioamini, bali kwa ajili ya waaminio.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo kama kanisa lote likikutana na kila mmoja akanena kwa lugha, kisha wakaingia wageni wasioelewa wasioamini, je, hawatasema kwamba wote mna wazimu?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

kikuyu: Lakini kama mtu asiyeamini au asiyeelewa akiingia wakati kila mtu anatoa unabii, ataaminishwa na watu wote kuwa yeye ni mwenye dhambi na kuhukumiwa na wote,
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

kikuyu: nazo siri za moyo wake zitawekwa wazi. Kwa hiyo ataanguka chini na kumwabudu Mungu akikiri, “Kweli Mungu yuko katikati yenu!”
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

kikuyu: Basi tuseme nini ndugu zangu? Mnapokutana pamoja, kila mmoja ana wimbo, au neno la mafundisho, au ufunuo, lugha mpya au atatafsiri. Mambo yote yatendeke kwa ajili ya kulijenga kanisa.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote akinena kwa lugha, basi waseme watu wawili au watatu si zaidi, mmoja baada ya mwingine na lazima awepo mtu wa kutafsiri.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

kikuyu: Lakini kama hakuna mtu wa kutafsiri, hao watu na wanyamaze kimya kanisani na wanene na nafsi zao wenyewe na Mungu.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

kikuyu: Manabii wawili au watatu wanene na wengine wapime yale yasemwayo.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote aliyeketi karibu, akipata ufunuo, basi yule wa kwanza na anyamaze.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wote mnaweza kutoa unabii, mmoja baada ya mwingine, ili kila mtu apate kufundishwa na kutiwa moyo.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

kikuyu: Roho za manabii huwatii manabii.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mungu si Mungu wa machafuko bali ni Mungu wa amani. Kama ilivyo katika makusanyiko yote ya watakatifu,
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

kikuyu: wanawake wanapaswa kuwa kimya kanisani. Hawaruhusiwi kusema, bali wanyenyekee kama sheria isemavyo.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

kikuyu: Kama wakitaka kuuliza kuhusu jambo lolote, wawaulize waume zao nyumbani. Kwa maana ni aibu kwa mwanamke kuzungumza kanisani.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

kikuyu: Je, neno la Mungu lilianzia kwenu? Au ni ninyi tu ambao neno la Mungu limewafikia?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote akidhani kwamba yeye ni nabii, au ana karama za rohoni, basi na akubali kwamba haya ninayoandika ni maagizo kutoka kwa Bwana.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

kikuyu: Kama mtu akipuuza jambo hili yeye mwenyewe atapuuzwa.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, takeni sana kutoa unabii na msikataze watu kusema kwa lugha.
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

kikuyu: Lakini kila kitu kitendeke kwa heshima na kwa utaratibu.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

kikuyu: Basi ndugu zangu nataka niwakumbushe kuhusu Injili niliyowahubiria, mkaipokea na ambayo katika hiyo mmesimama.
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

kikuyu: Kwa Injili hii mnaokolewa mkishikilia kwa uthabiti neno nililowahubiria ninyi. La sivyo, mmeamini katika ubatili.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yale niliyopokea ndiyo niliyowapa ninyi, kama yenye umuhimu wa kwanza: Kwamba Kristo alikufa kwa ajili ya dhambi zetu, kama yasemavyo Maandiko,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: ya kuwa alizikwa na alifufuliwa siku ya tatu, kama yasemavyo Maandiko,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: na kwamba alimtokea Kefa, kisha akawatokea wale kumi na wawili.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

kikuyu: Baadaye akawatokea wale ndugu waumini zaidi ya 500 kwa pamoja, ambao wengi wao bado wako hai, ingawa wengine wamelala.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

kikuyu: Ndipo akamtokea Yakobo na kisha mitume wote.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

kikuyu: Mwisho wa wote, akanitokea mimi pia, ambaye ni kama aliyezaliwa si kwa wakati wake.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mimi ndiye mdogo kuliko mitume wote, nisiyestahili kuitwa mtume, kwa sababu nililitesa kanisa la Mungu.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa neema ya Mungu nimekuwa hivi nilivyo na neema yake kwangu haikuwa kitu bure. Bali nilizidi sana kufanya kazi kuliko mitume wote, lakini haikuwa mimi, bali ni ile neema ya Mungu iliyokuwa pamoja nami.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

kikuyu: Hivyo basi, kama ilikuwa mimi au wao, hili ndilo tunalohubiri, na hili ndilo mliloamini.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

kikuyu: Basi kama tumehubiri ya kwamba Kristo alifufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, mbona baadhi yenu mnasema hakuna ufufuo wa wafu?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

kikuyu: Lakini kama hakuna ufufuo wa wafu, basi hata Kristo hakufufuliwa.
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Tena ikiwa Kristo hakufufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, kuhubiri kwetu kumekuwa ni bure na imani yenu ni batili.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya hayo, twaonekana kuwa mashahidi wa uongo kuhusu Mungu, kwa sababu tumeshuhudia kumhusu Mungu kwamba alimfufua Kristo kutoka kwa wafu, lakini hilo haliwezi kuwa kweli kama wafu hawafufuliwi.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa kama wafu hawafufuliwi, basi hata Kristo hajafufuka.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Tena kama Kristo hajafufuliwa, imani yenu ni batili; nanyi bado mko katika dhambi zenu.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

kikuyu: Hivyo basi, wote waliolala katika Kristo wamepotea.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

kikuyu: Ikiwa tumaini letu ndani ya Kristo ni kwa ajili ya maisha haya tu, sisi tunastahili kuhurumiwa kuliko watu wote.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

kikuyu: Lakini kweli Kristo amefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, tunda la kwanza la wale wote waliolala.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama vile mauti ilivyokuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja, vivyo hivyo, ufufuo wa wafu umekuja kwa njia ya mtu mmoja.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama vile katika Adamu watu wote wanakufa, vivyo hivyo katika Kristo wote watafanywa hai.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

kikuyu: Lakini kila mmoja kwa wakati wake: Kristo, tunda la kwanza kisha, wale walio wake, wakati atakapokuja.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

kikuyu: Ndipo mwisho utafika, wakati atakapomkabidhi Mungu Baba ufalme, akiisha angamiza kila utawala na kila mamlaka na nguvu.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

kikuyu: Kwa maana lazima Kristo atawale mpaka awe amewaweka adui zake wote chini ya miguu yake.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

kikuyu: Adui wa mwisho atakayeangamizwa ni mauti.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Mungu “ameweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.” Lakini isemapo kwamba “vitu vyote” vimewekwa chini yake, ni wazi kwamba Mungu aliyetiisha vitu vyote chini ya Kristo hayumo miongoni mwa hivyo vilivyotiishwa.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

kikuyu: Atakapokuwa amekwisha kuyafanya haya, ndipo Mwana mwenyewe atatiishwa chini yake yeye aliyetiisha vitu vyote, ili Mungu awe yote katika yote.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

kikuyu: Basi kama hakuna ufufuo, watafanyaje wale wabatizwao kwa ajili ya wafu? Kama wafu hawafufuliwi kamwe, mbona watu wanabatizwa kwa ajili yao?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

kikuyu: Nasi kwa upande wetu kwa nini tunajihatarisha kila saa?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

kikuyu: Kama majivuno yangu kwa ajili yenu katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu ni kweli, ndugu zangu, ninakufa kila siku.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

kikuyu: Kama kwa sababu za kibinadamu tu nilipigana na wanyama wakali huko Efeso, ningekuwa nimepata faida gani? Kama wafu hawafufuliwi, “Tuleni na kunywa, kwa kuwa kesho tutakufa.”
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

kikuyu: Msidanganyike: “Ushirika na watu wabaya huharibu tabia njema.”
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

kikuyu: Zindukeni mwe na akili kama iwapasavyo, wala msitende dhambi tena; kwa maana watu wengine hawamjui Mungu. Nasema mambo haya ili mwone aibu.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

kikuyu: Lakini mtu anaweza kuuliza, “Wafu wafufuliwaje? Watakuwa na mwili wa namna gani?”
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

kikuyu: Ninyi wapumbavu kiasi gani? Mpandacho hakiwi hai kama hakikufa.
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

kikuyu: Mpandapo, hampandi mwili ule utakao kuwa, bali mwapanda mbegu tu, pengine ya ngano au ya kitu kingine.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

kikuyu: Lakini Mungu huipa mbegu umbo kama alivyokusudia mwenyewe na kila aina ya mbegu huipa umbo lake.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

kikuyu: Kwa maana nyama zote si za aina moja. Binadamu wana nyama ya aina moja, wanyama wana aina nyingine, kadhalika ndege na samaki wana nyama tofauti.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

kikuyu: Pia kuna miili ya mbinguni na miili ya duniani, lakini fahari wa ile miili ya mbinguni ni wa aina moja na fahari wa ile miili ya duniani ni wa aina nyingine.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

kikuyu: Jua lina fahari ya aina moja, mwezi nao una fahari yake na nyota pia, nazo nyota hutofautiana katika fahari.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

kikuyu: Hivyo ndivyo itakavyokuwa wakati wa ufufuo wa wafu. Ule mwili wa kuharibika uliopandwa, utafufuliwa usioharibika,
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

kikuyu: unapandwa katika aibu, unafufuliwa katika utukufu, unapandwa katika udhaifu, unafufuliwa katika nguvu,
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

kikuyu: unapandwa mwili wa asili, unafufuliwa mwili wa kiroho. Kama kuna mwili wa asili, basi kuna mwili wa kiroho pia.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo imeandikwa, “Mtu wa kwanza Adamu alifanyika kiumbe hai”; Adamu wa mwisho, yeye ni roho iletayo uzima.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

kikuyu: Lakini si ule wa kiroho uliotangulia, bali ni ule wa asili, kisha ule wa kiroho.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

kikuyu: Mtu wa kwanza aliumbwa kwa mavumbi ya ardhini, mtu wa pili alitoka mbinguni.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

kikuyu: Kama vile alivyokuwa yule wa ardhini, ndivyo walivyo wale walio wa ardhini; na kwa vile alivyo mtu yule aliyetoka mbinguni, ndivyo walivyo wale walio wa mbinguni.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

kikuyu: Kama vile tulivyochukua mfano wa mtu wa ardhini, ndivyo tutakavyochukua mfano wa yule mtu aliyetoka mbinguni.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu nisemalo ni hili: nyama na damu haviwezi kuurithi ufalme wa Mungu, wala kuharibika kurithi kutokuharibika.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

kikuyu: Sikilizeni, nawaambia siri: Sote hatutalala, lakini sote tutabadilishwa
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

kikuyu: ghafula, kufumba na kufumbua, parapanda ya mwisho itakapolia. Kwa kuwa parapanda italia, nao wafu watafufuliwa na miili isiyoharibika, nasi tutabadilishwa.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mwili huu wa kuharibika lazima uvae kutokuharibika, nao huu wa kufa lazima uvae kutokufa.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, mwili huu wa kuharibika utakapovaa kutokuharibika, nao huu mwili wa kufa utakapovaa kutokufa, ndipo lile neno lililoandikwa litakapotimia: “Mauti imemezwa kwa kushinda.”
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

kikuyu: “Kuko wapi, ee mauti, kushinda kwako? Uko wapi, ee mauti, uchungu wako?”
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

kikuyu: Uchungu wa mauti ni dhambi na nguvu ya dhambi ni sheria.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

kikuyu: Lakini ashukuriwe Mungu, yeye atupaye ushindi kwa njia ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu wapenzi, simameni imara, msitikisike, mzidi sana katika kuitenda kazi ya Bwana, kwa maana mnajua ya kuwa, kazi yenu katika Bwana si bure.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

kikuyu: Basi kuhusu changizo kwa ajili ya watakatifu: Kama nilivyoyaagiza makanisa ya Galatia, fanyeni vivyo hivyo.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

kikuyu: Siku ya kwanza ya kila juma, kila mmoja wenu atenge kiasi cha fedha, kulingana na mapato yake na fedha hizo aziweke akiba, ili nitakapokuja pasiwe na lazima ya kufanya mchango.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nitakapowasili, nitawapa wale mtakaowachagua barua za kuwatambulisha, ili kuwatuma wapeleke zawadi zenu huko Yerusalemu.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Kama ikionekana ni vyema na mimi niende, basi hao watu watafuatana nami.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

kikuyu: Baada ya kupitia Makedonia nitakuja kwenu, maana ninakusudia kupitia Makedonia.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

kikuyu: Huenda nitakaa nanyi kwa muda, au hata kukaa nanyi kipindi chote cha baridi, ili mweze kunisaidia katika safari yangu, popote niendapo.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sitaki niwaone sasa na kupita tu; natarajia kuwa nanyi kwa muda wa kutosha, kama Bwana akipenda.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

kikuyu: Lakini nitakaa Efeso mpaka wakati wa Pentekoste,
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

kikuyu: kwa maana mlango mkubwa umefunguliwa kwangu kufanya kazi yenye matunda, nako huko kuna adui wengi wanaonipinga.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

kikuyu: Ikiwa Timotheo atakuja kwenu, hakikisheni kwamba hana hofu yoyote akiwa nanyi, kwa sababu anafanya kazi ya Bwana, kama mimi nifanyavyo.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

kikuyu: Basi asiwepo mtu atakayekataa kumpokea. Msafirisheni kwa amani ili aweze kunijia tena. Namtarajia pamoja na ndugu.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

kikuyu: Basi kwa habari za ndugu yetu Apolo, nimemsihi kwa bidii aje kwenu pamoja na hao ndugu. Ingawa alikuwa hapendi kabisa kuja sasa, lakini atakuja apatapo nafasi.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

kikuyu: Kesheni, simameni imara katika imani, fanyeni kiume, kuweni mashujaa kuweni hodari.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

kikuyu: Fanyeni kila kitu katika upendo.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

kikuyu: Ninyi mnajua kwamba watu wa nyumbani mwa Stefana ndio waliokuwa wa kwanza kuamini katika Akaya, nao wamejitoa kwa ajili ya kuwahudumia watakatifu. Ndugu nawasihi,
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

kikuyu: mjitie katika kuwahudumia watu kama hawa na kila mmoja aingiaye kwenye kazi na kuifanya kwa bidii.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

kikuyu: Nilifurahi wakati Stefana, Fortunato na Akaiko walipofika, kwa sababu wamenipatia yale niliyopungukiwa kutoka kwenu.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa waliiburudisha roho yangu na zenu pia. Watu kama hawa wanastahili kutambuliwa.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

kikuyu: Makanisa ya Asia yanawasalimu. Akila na Prisila, pamoja na kanisa lililoko nyumbani kwao wanawasalimu sana katika Bwana.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

kikuyu: Ndugu wote walioko hapa wanawasalimu. Salimianeni kwa busu takatifu.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Mimi, Paulo, naandika salamu hizi kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote hampendi Bwana Yesu Kristo, na alaaniwe. Bwana wetu, njoo.
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

kikuyu: Neema ya Bwana Yesu iwe nanyi.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: Upendo wangu uwe nanyi nyote katika Kristo Yesu. Amen.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Barua hii ni kutoka kwangu mimi Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, na Timotheo ndugu yetu, Kwa kanisa la Mungu lililoko Korintho, pamoja na watakatifu wote walioko Akaya yote:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

kikuyu: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa huruma na Mungu wa faraja yote.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

kikuyu: Yeye hutufariji katika taabu zetu, ili tuweze kuwafariji walio katika taabu yoyote kwa faraja ambayo sisi wenyewe tumepokea kutoka kwa Mungu.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

kikuyu: Kama vile mateso ya Kristo yanavyozidi ndani ya maisha yetu, hivyo ndivyo faraja yetu inavyofurika kwa njia ya Kristo.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

kikuyu: Kama tunataabika, ni kwa ajili ya faraja na wokovu wenu; kama tukifarijiwa, ni kwa ajili ya faraja yenu, iwaleteayo saburi ya mateso yale yale yanayotupata.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

kikuyu: Nalo tumaini letu kwenu ni thabiti, kwa sababu tunajua kwamba kama vile mnavyoshiriki mateso yetu, ndivyo pia mnavyoshiriki katika faraja yetu.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

kikuyu: Ndugu wapendwa, hatutaki mkose kujua kuhusu zile taabu tulizopata huko Asia. Kwa maana tulilemewa na mizigo sana, kiasi cha kushindwa kuvumilia, hata tulikata tamaa ya kuishi.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

kikuyu: Kwa kweli, mioyoni mwetu tulihisi tumekabiliwa na hukumu ya kifo, ili tusijitegemee sisi wenyewe bali tumtegemee Mungu afufuaye wafu.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

kikuyu: Yeye aliyetuokoa kwenye hatari kubwa ya kifo na atatuokoa tena. Kwake yeye tumeweka tumaini letu kwamba ataendelea kutuokoa.
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

kikuyu: Kama vile mlivyoungana kusaidiana nasi katika maombi, hivyo wengi watatoa shukrani kwa niaba yetu kwa ajili ya baraka za neema tulizopata kwa majibu ya maombi ya wengi.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

kikuyu: Basi haya ndiyo majivuno yetu: Dhamiri yetu inatushuhudia kwamba tumeenenda katika ulimwengu na hasa katika uhusiano wetu na ninyi, katika utakatifu na uaminifu utokao kwa Mungu. Hatukufanya hivyo kwa hekima ya kidunia bali kwa neema ya Mungu.
