kikuyu: Kama vile “Abrahamu alimwamini Mungu na ikahesabiwa kwake kuwa haki.”
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Fahamuni basi kwamba wale walio na imani, hao ndio watoto wa Abrahamu.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

kikuyu: Maandiko yakitabiri kwamba Mungu angewahesabia haki watu wa Mataifa kwa imani, alitangulia kumtangazia Abrahamu Injili akisema kwamba, “Kwa kupitia kwako mataifa yote yatabarikiwa.”
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii, wale wote wanaoamini wanabarikiwa pamoja na Abrahamu, mtu wa imani.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wote wanaotumainia matendo ya sheria wako chini ya laana, kwa kuwa imeandikwa, “Alaaniwe kila mtu asiyeshikilia kutii mambo yote yaliyoandikwa katika Kitabu cha Sheria.”
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

kikuyu: Basi ni dhahiri kwamba hakuna mtu anayehesabiwa haki mbele za Mungu kwa kushikilia sheria, kwa maana, “Mwenye haki ataishi kwa imani.”
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

kikuyu: Lakini sheria haitegemei imani. Kinyume chake, “Mtu atendaye matendo hayo ataishi kwa hayo.”
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Kristo alitukomboa kutoka laana ya sheria kwa kufanyika laana kwa ajili yetu, kwa maana imeandikwa, “Amelaaniwa yeye aangikwaye juu ya mti.”
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

kikuyu: Alitukomboa ili kwamba baraka aliyopewa Abrahamu ipate kuwafikia watu wa Mataifa kwa njia ya Kristo Yesu, ili kwa imani tupate kupokea ile ahadi ya Roho.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, nataka nitoe mfano kutoka maisha ya kila siku. Kama vile hakuna mtu awezaye kutangua au kuongeza kitu katika agano la mtu ambalo limekwisha kuthibitishwa, vivyo hivyo kwa hali kama hii.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

kikuyu: Ahadi zilinenwa kwa Abrahamu na kwa mzao wake. Maandiko hayasemi “kwa wazao,” likimaanisha watu wengi, bali “kwa mzao wako,” yaani mtu mmoja, ndiye Kristo.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

kikuyu: Ninachotaka kusema ni kwamba, sheria, ambayo ilitolewa miaka 430 baadaye, haitangui Agano lililothibitishwa na Mungu ili kuibatilisha ahadi ile.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama urithi hupatikana kwa sheria, basi hautegemei tena ahadi, lakini Mungu kwa neema yake alimpa Abrahamu urithi kwa njia ya ahadi.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

kikuyu: Kwa nini basi iwepo sheria? Sheria iliwekwa kwa sababu ya makosa mpaka atakapokuja yule Mzao wa Abrahamu, ambaye alitajwa katika ile ahadi. Sheria iliamriwa na malaika kwa mkono wa mpatanishi.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

kikuyu: Basi mpatanishi huhusisha zaidi ya upande mmoja, lakini Mungu ni mmoja.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

kikuyu: Je basi, sheria inapingana na ahadi za Mungu? La hasha! Kwa maana kama sheria iliyotolewa ingeweza kuwapa watu uzima, basi haki ingepatikana kwa njia ya sheria.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

kikuyu: Lakini Maandiko yamefanya vitu vyote vifungwe chini ya nguvu ya dhambi, ili yale yaliyoahidiwa kwa njia ya imani katika Yesu Kristo yapate kupewa wale wanaoamini.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

kikuyu: Kabla imani hii haijaja tulikuwa tumewekwa chini ya sheria, tumefungwa mpaka ile imani ifunuliwe.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

kikuyu: Hivyo, sheria ilikuwa kiongozi kutufikisha kwa Kristo, ili tupate kuhesabiwa haki kwa imani.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa ile imani imekuja, hatusimamiwi tena na sheria.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ninyi nyote mmekuwa watoto wa Mungu katika Kristo Yesu kwa njia ya imani.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wote mliobatizwa ndani ya Kristo, mmemvaa Kristo.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

kikuyu: Wala hakuna tena Myahudi au Myunani, mtumwa au mtu huru, mwanaume wala mwanamke, maana nyote mmekuwa wamoja ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Nanyi mkiwa ni mali ya Kristo, basi ninyi ni wa uzao wa Abrahamu na warithi sawasawa na ile ahadi.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

kikuyu: Lile nisemalo ni kwamba wakati wote mrithi bado ni mtoto, hana tofauti na mtumwa, ingawa ndiye mmiliki wa mali yote.
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

kikuyu: Yeye huwa yuko chini ya uangalizi wa walezi na wadhamini mpaka ufike wakati uliowekwa na baba yake.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo na sisi, tulipokuwa bado watoto wadogo, tulikuwa utumwani chini ya taratibu za kawaida za ulimwengu.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

kikuyu: Lakini ulipowadia utimilifu wa wakati, Mungu alimtuma Mwanawe, ambaye alizaliwa na mwanamke, akazaliwa chini ya sheria,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

kikuyu: kusudi awakomboe wale waliokuwa chini ya sheria, ili tupate kupokea zile haki kamili za kufanywa watoto wa Mungu.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ninyi ni watoto wa Mungu, Mungu amemtuma Roho wa Mwanawe mioyoni mwetu, anayelia, “Abba, Baba.”
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, wewe si mtumwa tena, bali ni mtoto, kwa kuwa wewe ni mtoto, Mungu amekufanya wewe pia kuwa mrithi kwa kupitia Kristo.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

kikuyu: Zamani, mlipokuwa hammjui Mungu, mlikuwa watumwa wa viumbe ambavyo kwa asili si Mungu.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa kwa kuwa mmemjua Mungu, au zaidi mmejulikana na Mungu, inakuwaje mnarejea tena katika zile kanuni za kwanza zenye udhaifu na upungufu? Mnataka ziwafanye tena watumwa?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

kikuyu: Mnaadhimisha siku maalum, miezi, nyakati na miaka!
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

kikuyu: Nina hofu juu yenu, kwamba kazi niliyofanya kwa ajili yenu inaweza kuwa nimejitaabisha bure.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, nawasihi mwe kama mimi, kwa sababu mimi nimekuwa kama ninyi. Hamkunitendea jambo lolote baya.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

kikuyu: Ninyi mwajua kwamba ni kwa ajili ya udhaifu wangu niliwahubiria Injili.
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

kikuyu: Ingawa hali yangu iliwatia majaribuni, hamkunidharau wala kunidhihaki, bali mlinikaribisha kama malaika wa Mungu, kama vile Kristo Yesu.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ile hali ya furaha mliyokuwa nayo imekwenda wapi? Naweza kushuhudia kwamba, kama ingewezekana mngengʼoa macho yenu na kunipa mimi.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

kikuyu: Je, sasa nimekuwa adui yenu kwa kuwaambia kweli?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

kikuyu: Hao wana shauku ya kuwapata lakini si kwa kusudi zuri. Wanachotaka ni kuwatenga mbali nasi, ili ninyi mpate kuwaonea wao shauku.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

kikuyu: Ni vizuri wakati wote kuwa na shauku kwa ajili ya kusudi zuri, si wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi tu.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

kikuyu: Watoto wangu wapendwa, ambao kwa mara nyingine ninawaonea utungu, ninatamani kwamba Kristo aumbike ndani yenu.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

kikuyu: Natamani kama ningekuwa pamoja nanyi sasa, pengine ningebadilisha sauti yangu. Kwa maana nina wasiwasi kwa ajili yenu.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

kikuyu: Niambieni, ninyi mnaotaka kuwa chini ya sheria, je, hamjui sheria inavyosema?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

kikuyu: Kwa maana imeandikwa kwamba Abrahamu alikuwa na wana wawili, mmoja wa mwanamke mtumwa na wa pili wa mwanamke huru.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

kikuyu: Lakini, mtoto wa mwanamke mtumwa alizaliwa kwa mapenzi ya mwili, na yule mwingine wa mwanamke huru alizaliwa kutokana na ahadi ya Mungu.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

kikuyu: Mambo haya yanaweza kuchukuliwa kama mfano. Kwa maana hao wanawake wawili ni mfano wa maagano mawili: Agano la kwanza, ni lile lililofanyika katika Mlima Sinai, lizaalo watoto wa utumwa. Hili ndilo huyo Hagari.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

kikuyu: Basi Hagari anawakilisha Mlima Sinai ulioko Arabuni, na unafanana na Yerusalemu ya sasa ambayo iko utumwani pamoja na watoto wake.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

kikuyu: Lakini Yerusalemu wa juu ni huru, nayo ndiye mama yetu.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

kikuyu: Kwa maana imeandikwa: “Furahi, ewe mwanamke tasa, wewe usiyezaa; paza sauti, na kuimba kwa furaha, wewe usiyepatwa na utungu wa kuzaa; kwa maana watoto wa mwanamke aliyeachwa ukiwa ni wengi kuliko wa mwanamke mwenye mume.”
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

kikuyu: Basi, sisi ndugu zangu, ni kama Isaki, tu watoto wa ahadi.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

kikuyu: Lakini, kama vile ilivyokuwa siku zile yule aliyezaliwa kwa mwili alivyomchokoza yule aliyezaliwa kwa Roho, ndivyo ilivyo hata sasa.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

kikuyu: Lakini Maandiko yasemaje? “Mwondoe mwanamke mtumwa pamoja na mwanawe, kwa sababu mwana wa mwanamke mtumwa kamwe hatarithi pamoja na mwana wa aliye huru.”
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo ndugu zangu, sisi si watoto wa mwanamke mtumwa, bali wa yule aliye huru.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

kikuyu: Kristo alitupa uhuru, akataka tubaki huru. Hivyo simameni imara wala msikubali tena kulemewa na kongwa la utumwa.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

kikuyu: Sikilizeni! Mimi, Paulo, nawaambieni kwamba kama mkikubali kutahiriwa, basi Kristo hatawafaidia chochote.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

kikuyu: Namshuhudia tena kila mtu anayekubali kutahiriwa kwamba inampasa kushika sheria yote.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

kikuyu: Ninyi mnaotafuta kuhesabiwa haki kwa njia ya sheria mmetengwa na Kristo, mko mbali na neema ya Mungu.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

kikuyu: Kwa maana, kwa njia ya Roho kwa imani, tunangojea kwa shauku tumaini la haki.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ndani ya Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa hakuleti tofauti, bali lililo muhimu ni imani itendayo kazi kwa njia ya upendo.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

kikuyu: Mlikuwa mkipiga mbio vizuri. Ni nani aliyewazuia msiitii kweli?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

kikuyu: Ushawishi wa namna hiyo haukutokana na yule anayewaita.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

kikuyu: “Chachu kidogo huchachua donge zima.”
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

kikuyu: Nina hakika katika Bwana kwamba hamtakuwa na msimamo mwingine. Mtu anayewachanganya anastahili adhabu, hata awe nani.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

kikuyu: Lakini ndugu zangu, kama mimi bado ninahubiri kuhusu kutahiriwa, kwa nini bado ninateswa? Katika hiyo hali basi, kwazo la msalaba limeondolewa.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

kikuyu: Laiti hao wanaowavuruga wangejihasi wao wenyewe!
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, ninyi mliitwa ili mwe huru, hivyo msitumie uhuru wenu kama fursa ya kufuata tamaa za mwili, bali tumikianeni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa upendo.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sheria yote hukamilika katika amri moja: “Mpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako.”
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Kama mkiumana na kutafunana, angalieni, msije mkaangamizana.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo nasema, enendeni kwa Roho, wala hamtazitimiza kamwe tamaa za mwili.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mwili hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na Roho, naye Roho hutamani yale yaliyo kinyume na mwili. Roho na mwili hupingana na kwa sababu hiyo hamwezi kufanya mnayotaka.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mkiongozwa na Roho, hamko chini ya sheria.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

kikuyu: Basi matendo ya mwili ni dhahiri nayo ni haya: Uasherati, uchafu, ufisadi,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kikuyu: kuabudu sanamu, uchawi, uadui, ugomvi, wivu, hasira, fitina, faraka, uzushi,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

kikuyu: husuda, ulevi, ulafi na mambo mengine yanayofanana na hayo. Nawaonya, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaonya kabla, kwamba watu watendao mambo kama hayo, hawataurithi Ufalme wa Mungu.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Lakini tunda la Roho ni upendo, furaha, amani, uvumilivu, utu wema, fadhili, uaminifu,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

kikuyu: upole na kiasi. Katika mambo kama haya hakuna sheria.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

kikuyu: Wote walio wa Kristo Yesu wameusulubisha mwili na shauku zake pamoja na tamaa zake.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa tunaishi kwa Roho, basi, tuenende kwa Roho.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

kikuyu: Tusijisifu bure, tukichokozana na kuoneana wivu.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, ikiwa mtu ameghafilika akatenda dhambi, basi ninyi mlio wa rohoni, mrejesheni upya mtu huyo kwa roho ya upole. Lakini jihadharini, ili ninyi wenyewe msije mkajaribiwa.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

kikuyu: Chukulianeni mizigo ninyi kwa ninyi, nanyi kwa njia hii mtatimiza sheria ya Kristo.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

kikuyu: Kama mtu yeyote akijiona kuwa yeye ni bora na kumbe sivyo, basi mtu huyo anajidanganya mwenyewe.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

kikuyu: Lakini kila mtu na aipime kazi yake mwenyewe, ndipo aweze kujisifu, bila kujilinganisha na mtu mwingine.
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

kikuyu: Kwa maana, kila mtu atauchukua mzigo wake mwenyewe.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

kikuyu: Basi, yeye afundishwaye katika neno na amshirikishe mwalimu wake mema yote.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

kikuyu: Msidanganyike, Mungu hadhihakiwi. Kwa kuwa kile apandacho mtu ndicho atakachovuna.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

kikuyu: Apandaye kwa mwili, katika mwili wake atavuna uharibifu, lakini yeye apandaye katika Roho, katika Roho atavuna uzima wa milele.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

kikuyu: Hivyo, tusichoke katika kutenda mema, kwa kuwa tutavuna kwa wakati wake tusipokata tamaa.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, kadiri tupatavyo nafasi na tuwatendee watu wote mema, hasa wale wa jamaa ya waaminio.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

kikuyu: Angalieni herufi kubwa nitumiazo ninapowaandikia kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe!
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

kikuyu: Wale wanaotaka kuonekana wazuri kwa mambo ya mwili wanataka wawalazimishe kutahiriwa. Sababu pekee ya kufanya hivyo ni kuepuka kuteswa kwa ajili ya msalaba wa Kristo.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

kikuyu: Hata wale waliotahiriwa wenyewe hawaitii sheria, lakini wanataka ninyi mtahiriwe ili wapate kujivuna kwa habari ya miili yenu.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

kikuyu: Mungu apishie mbali nisije nikajivunia kitu chochote isipokuwa msalaba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, ambaye kwa yeye ulimwengu umesulubiwa kwangu, nami nimesulubiwa kwa ulimwengu.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

kikuyu: Kwa maana katika Kristo Yesu, kutahiriwa au kutokutahiriwa si kitu, bali kule kuwa kiumbe kipya ni kila kitu!
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

kikuyu: Amani na rehema viwe na wote wanaofuata kanuni hii, na juu ya Israeli wa Mungu.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

kikuyu: Hatimaye, tangu sasa mtu yeyote asinitaabishe, kwa maana nachukua katika mwili wangu chapa zake Yesu.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, neema ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

kikuyu: Paulo, mtume wa Kristo Yesu, kwa mapenzi ya Mungu: Kwa watakatifu walioko Efeso, walio waaminifu katika Kristo Yesu:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

kikuyu: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, aliyetubariki sisi kwa baraka zote za rohoni, katika ulimwengu wa roho ndani ya Kristo.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

kikuyu: Kwa maana alituchagua katika yeye kabla ya kuumbwa ulimwengu ili tuwe watakatifu na bila lawama mbele zake. Kwa upendo
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

kikuyu: alitangulia kutuchagua tuwe wanawe kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo kwa furaha yake na mapenzi yake mwenyewe.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo tunamsifu Mungu kwa huruma zake kuu alizotumiminia sisi katika Mwanawe Mpendwa.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

kikuyu: Ndani yake tunao ukombozi kwa njia ya damu yake, yaani, msamaha wa dhambi, sawasawa na wingi wa neema yake
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

kikuyu: aliyotumiminia kwa wingi, kwa hekima yote na maarifa yote.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

kikuyu: Naye alitujulisha siri ya mapenzi yake sawasawa na uradhi wa mapenzi yake, ambayo alikusudia katika Kristo,
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

kikuyu: ili yapate kutimizwa wakati mkamilifu utakapowadia, yaani, kuvitia vitu vyote vya mbinguni na vya duniani pamoja, chini ya kiongozi mmoja, ndiye Kristo.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

kikuyu: Katika Kristo sisi nasi tumepata urithi, tukisha kuchaguliwa sawasawa na kusudi la Mungu, yeye ambaye hufanya mambo yote kulingana na kusudi la mapenzi yake,
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

kikuyu: ili kwamba, sisi tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini katika Kristo, tupate kuishi kwa sifa ya utukufu wake.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

kikuyu: Ninyi pia mliingia ndani ya Kristo mliposikia Neno la kweli, Injili ya wokovu wenu. Mkiisha kuamini, ndani yake mlitiwa muhuri, yaani, Roho Mtakatifu mliyeahidiwa,
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: yeye ambaye ni amana yetu akituhakikishia urithi wetu hadi ukombozi wa wale walio milki ya Mungu kwa sifa ya utukufu wake.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii, tangu niliposikia juu ya imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watakatifu wote,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu, nikiwakumbuka katika maombi yangu.
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: Nazidi kumwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo, Baba wa utukufu, awajalieni ninyi roho ya hekima na ya ufunuo, ili mpate kumjua zaidi.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

kikuyu: Ninaomba pia kwamba macho ya mioyo yenu yatiwe nuru ili mpate kujua tumaini mliloitiwa, utajiri wa urithi wa utukufu wake kwa watakatifu
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

kikuyu: na uweza wake mkuu usiolinganishwa kwa ajili yetu sisi tuaminio. Uweza huo unaofanya kazi ndani yetu, ni sawa na ile nguvu kuu mno
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

kikuyu: aliyoitumia katika Kristo alipomfufua kutoka kwa wafu, na akamketisha mkono wake wa kuume huko mbinguni,
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: juu sana kuliko falme zote na mamlaka, enzi na milki, na juu ya kila jina litajwalo, si katika ulimwengu huu tu, bali katika ule ujao pia.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

kikuyu: Naye Mungu ameweka vitu vyote viwe chini ya miguu yake na amemfanya yeye awe kichwa cha vitu vyote kwa ajili ya Kanisa,
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

kikuyu: ambalo ndilo mwili wake, ukamilifu wake yeye aliye yote katika yote.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

kikuyu: Kwa habari zenu, mlikuwa wafu katika makosa na dhambi zenu,
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

kikuyu: ambazo mlizitenda mlipofuatisha namna ya ulimwengu huu na za yule mtawala wa ufalme wa anga, yule roho atendaye kazi sasa ndani ya wale wasiotii.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Sisi sote pia tuliishi katikati yao hapo zamani, tukitimiza tamaa za asili yetu ya dhambi na kufuata tamaa zake na mawazo yake. Nasi kwa asili tulikuwa wana wa ghadhabu, kama mtu mwingine yeyote.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

kikuyu: Lakini Mungu kwa upendo wake mwingi kwetu sisi, ambaye ni mwingi wa rehema,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

kikuyu: hata tulipokuwa wafu kwa ajili ya makosa yetu, alitufanya tuwe hai pamoja na Kristo Yesu, yaani, mmeokolewa kwa neema.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

kikuyu: Mungu alitufufua pamoja na Kristo na kutuketisha pamoja naye katika ulimwengu wa roho katika Kristo Yesu,
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: ili katika ule ulimwengu ujao apate kuonyesha wingi wa neema yake isiyopimika, iliyodhihirishwa kwetu kwa wema wake ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Kwa maana mmeokolewa kwa neema, kwa njia ya imani, wala si kwa matendo yenu mema. Hii ni zawadi kutoka kwa Mungu,
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

kikuyu: si kwa matendo, ili mtu yeyote asije akajisifu.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sisi ni kazi ya mikono ya Mungu, tulioumbwa katika Kristo Yesu, ili tupate kutenda matendo mema, ambayo Mungu alitangulia kuyaandaa tupate kuishi katika hayo.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo kumbukeni kwamba ninyi ambao hapo awali mlikuwa watu wa Mataifa kwa kuzaliwa na kuitwa “wasiotahiriwa” na wale wanaojiita “waliotahiriwa” (yaani tohara ifanyikayo katika mwili kwa mikono ya wanadamu),
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

kikuyu: kumbukeni kwamba wakati ule mlikuwa mbali na Kristo, mkiwa mmetengwa kutoka jumuiya ya Israeli, na mkiwa wageni katika yale maagano ya ahadi, nanyi mkiwa hamna tumaini wala Mungu duniani.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

kikuyu: Lakini sasa katika Kristo Yesu, ninyi ambao hapo kwanza mlikuwa mbali na Mungu, sasa mmeletwa karibu kwa njia ya damu ya Kristo.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeye mwenyewe ndiye amani yetu, aliyetufanya sisi tuliokuwa wawili, yaani, Wayahudi na watu wa Mataifa, tuwe wamoja kwa kuvunja kizuizi na kubomoa ule ukuta wa uadui uliokuwa kati yetu,
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

kikuyu: kwa kuibatilisha ile sheria pamoja na amri zake na maagizo yake alipoutoa mwili wake, ili apate kufanya ndani yake mtu mmoja mpya badala ya hao wawili, hivyo akifanya amani,
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

kikuyu: naye katika mwili huu mmoja awapatanishe wote wawili na Mungu kupitia msalaba, ili kwa huo msalaba akaangamiza uadui wao.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

kikuyu: Alikuja na kuhubiri amani kwenu ninyi mliokuwa mbali na pia akahubiri amani kwao waliokuwa karibu.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwa kupitia kwake, sisi sote tunaweza kumkaribia Baba katika Roho mmoja.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

kikuyu: Hivyo basi, ninyi sasa si wageni tena wala wapitaji, bali mmekuwa wenyeji pamoja na watakatifu na pia jamaa wa nyumbani mwake Mungu.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

kikuyu: Mmejengwa juu ya msingi wa mitume na manabii, naye Kristo Yesu mwenyewe ndiye jiwe kuu la pembeni.
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

kikuyu: Ndani yake jengo lote limeshikamanishwa pamoja na kusimamishwa ili kuwa Hekalu takatifu katika Bwana.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

kikuyu: Katika yeye ninyi nanyi mnajengwa pamoja ili mpate kuwa makao ambayo Mungu anaishi ndani yake kwa njia ya Roho wake.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii, mimi Paulo, mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu kwa ajili yenu ninyi watu wa Mataifa:
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

kikuyu: Kwa hakika mmekwisha kusikia kuhusu ile huduma ya neema ya Mungu niliyopewa kwa ajili yenu,
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

kikuyu: yaani, ile siri iliodhihirishwa kwangu kwa njia ya ufunuo, kama nilivyotangulia kuandika kwa kifupi.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

kikuyu: Kwa kusoma haya, basi mtaweza kuelewa ufahamu wangu katika siri ya Kristo.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

kikuyu: Siri hii haikudhihirishwa kwa wanadamu katika vizazi vingine kama vile sasa ilivyodhihirishwa na Roho kwa mitume na manabii watakatifu wa Mungu.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

kikuyu: Siri hii ni kwamba, kwa njia ya Injili, watu wa Mataifa ni warithi pamoja na Israeli, viungo vya mwili mmoja na washiriki pamoja wa ahadi katika Kristo Yesu.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

kikuyu: Nimekuwa mtumishi wa Injili hii kwa kipawa cha neema ya Mungu niliyopewa kwa nguvu yake itendayo kazi.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

kikuyu: Ingawa mimi ni mdogo kuliko aliye mdogo kabisa miongoni mwa watakatifu wote, nilipewa neema hii: ili niwahubirie watu wa Mataifa kuhusu utajiri usiopimika ulio ndani ya Kristo,
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

kikuyu: na kuweka wazi kwa kila mtu siri hii iliyokuwa imefichwa tangu zamani katika Mungu, aliyeumba vitu vyote.
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ili sasa kwa njia ya Kanisa, hekima yote ya Mungu ipate kujulikana kwa watawala na wenye mamlaka katika ulimwengu wa roho,
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: sawasawa na kusudi lake la milele katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Ndani yake na kwa njia ya imani katika yeye twaweza kumkaribia Mungu kwa uhuru na kwa ujasiri.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, nawaomba msikate tamaa kwa sababu ya mateso yangu kwa ajili yenu, hayo ni utukufu wenu.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii nampigia Baba magoti,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: ambaye ubaba wote wa kila jamaa za mbinguni na za duniani unatokana naye.
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

kikuyu: Namwomba Mungu awaimarishe kwa kuwatia nguvu mioyo yenu kwa njia ya Roho wake kwa kadiri ya utajiri wa utukufu wake,
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

kikuyu: ili kwamba, Kristo apate kukaa mioyoni mwenu kwa njia ya imani. Nami ninaomba kwamba ninyi mkiwa wenye mizizi tena imara katika msingi wa upendo,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

kikuyu: mwe na uwezo wa kufahamu pamoja na watakatifu wote jinsi ulivyo upana, urefu, kimo na kina upendo wa Kristo,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

kikuyu: na kujua upendo huu unaopita fahamu, ili mpate kujazwa na kufikia kipimo cha ukamilifu wote wa Mungu.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

kikuyu: Basi kwa yeye awezaye kutenda mambo ya ajabu yasiyopimika kuliko yote tuyaombayo au tuyawazayo, kwa kadiri ya uweza wake ule utendao kazi ndani yetu,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

kikuyu: yeye atukuzwe katika kanisa na katika Kristo Yesu kwa vizazi vyote, milele na milele. Amen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Basi, mimi niliye mfungwa wa Bwana, nawasihi mwenende kama inavyostahili wito wenu mlioitiwa.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

kikuyu: Kwa unyenyekevu wote na upole, mkiwa wavumilivu, mkichukuliana kwa upendo.
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

kikuyu: Jitahidini kudumisha umoja wa Roho katika kifungo cha amani.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

kikuyu: Kuna mwili mmoja na Roho mmoja, kama vile mlivyoitwa katika tumaini moja.
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

kikuyu: Tena kuna Bwana mmoja, imani moja, ubatizo mmoja,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

kikuyu: Mungu mmoja ambaye ni Baba wa wote, aliye juu ya yote, katika yote na ndani ya yote.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

kikuyu: Lakini kila mmoja wetu amepewa neema kwa kadiri ya kipimo cha kipawa cha Kristo.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo husema: “Alipopaa juu zaidi, aliteka mateka, akawapa wanadamu vipawa.”
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

kikuyu: (Asemapo “alipaa juu,” maana yake nini isipokuwa ni kusema pia kwamba Kristo alishuka pande za chini sana za dunia?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

kikuyu: Yeye aliyeshuka ndiye alipaa juu zaidi kupita mbingu zote, ili apate kuujaza ulimwengu wote.)
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

kikuyu: Ndiye aliweka wengine kuwa mitume, wengine kuwa manabii, wengine kuwa wainjilisti, wengine kuwa wachungaji na walimu,
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

kikuyu: kwa kusudi la kuwakamilisha watakatifu kwa ajili ya kazi za huduma, ili kwamba mwili wa Kristo upate kujengwa
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

kikuyu: mpaka sote tutakapoufikia umoja katika imani na katika kumjua sana Mwana wa Mungu na kuwa watu wazima kwa kufikia kimo cha ukamilifu wa Kristo.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

kikuyu: Ili tusiwe tena watoto wachanga, tukitupwatupwa huku na huku na kuchukuliwa na kila upepo wa mafundisho kwa hila za watu, kwa ujanja, kwa kufuata njia zao za udanganyifu.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

kikuyu: Badala yake, tukiambiana kweli kwa upendo, katika mambo yote tukue, hata tumfikie yeye aliye kichwa, yaani, Kristo.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

kikuyu: Kutoka kwake, mwili wote ukiwa umeungamanishwa na kushikamanishwa pamoja kwa msaada wa kila kiungo, hukua na kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo, wakati kila kiungo kinafanya kazi yake.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

kikuyu: Hivyo nawaambia hivi, nami nasisitiza katika Bwana kwamba, msiishi tena kama watu wa Mataifa waishivyo, katika ubatili wa mawazo yao.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

kikuyu: Watu hao akili zao zimetiwa giza na wametengwa mbali na uzima wa Mungu kwa sababu ya ujinga wao kutokana na ugumu wa mioyo yao.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

kikuyu: Wakiisha kufa ganzi, wamejitia katika mambo ya ufisadi na kupendelea kila aina ya uchafu, wakiendelea kutamani zaidi.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

kikuyu: Lakini ninyi, hivyo sivyo mlivyojifunza Kristo.
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

kikuyu: Kama hivyo ndivyo ilivyo, ninyi mmemsikia, tena mmefundishwa naye, vile kweli ilivyo katika Yesu.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

kikuyu: Mlifundishwa kuuvua mwenendo wenu wa zamani, utu wenu wa kale, ulioharibiwa na tamaa zake za udanganyifu,
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

kikuyu: ili mfanywe upya roho na nia zenu,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

kikuyu: mkajivike utu mpya, ulioumbwa sawasawa na mfano wa Mungu katika haki yote na utakatifu.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo kila mmoja wenu avue uongo na kuambiana kweli mtu na jirani yake, kwa maana sisi sote tu viungo vya mwili mmoja.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

kikuyu: Mkikasirika, msitende dhambi, wala jua lisichwe mkiwa bado mmekasirika,
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

kikuyu: wala msimpe ibilisi nafasi.
english: and don’t give place to the devil.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye amekuwa akiiba, asiibe tena, lakini lazima ajishughulishe, afanye kitu kifaacho kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na kitu cha kuwagawia wahitaji.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

kikuyu: Maneno mabaya yasitoke vinywani mwenu, bali yale yafaayo kwa ajili ya kuwajenga wengine kulingana na mahitaji yao, ili yawafae wale wasikiao.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

kikuyu: Wala msimhuzunishe Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu, ambaye kwake mlitiwa muhuri kwa ajili ya siku ya ukombozi.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

kikuyu: Ondoeni kabisa uchungu, ghadhabu, hasira, makelele na masingizio pamoja na kila aina ya uovu.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

kikuyu: Kuweni wafadhili na wenye kuhurumiana ninyi kwa ninyi, mkisameheana, kama vile naye Mungu katika Kristo alivyowasamehe ninyi.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, mfuateni Mungu kama watoto wapendwao,
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

kikuyu: mkiishi maisha ya upendo, kama vile Kristo alivyotupenda sisi akajitoa kwa ajili yetu kuwa sadaka yenye harufu nzuri na dhabihu kwa Mungu.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

kikuyu: Lakini uasherati, usitajwe miongoni mwenu, wala uchafu wa aina yoyote, wala tamaa, kwa sababu mambo haya hayastahili miongoni mwa watakatifu.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

kikuyu: Wala pasiwepo mazungumzo machafu ya aibu, au maneno ya upuzi au mzaha, ambayo hayafai, badala yake mshukuruni Mungu.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

kikuyu: Kwa habari ya mambo haya mjue hakika kwamba: Msherati, wala mtu mwovu, wala mwenye tamaa mbaya, mtu kama huyo ni mwabudu sanamu, kamwe hataurithi Ufalme wa Kristo na wa Mungu.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

kikuyu: Mtu yeyote na asiwadanganye kwa maneno matupu, kwa kuwa hasira ya Mungu huwaka kwa sababu ya mambo kama haya juu ya wale wasiomtii.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, msishirikiane nao.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

kikuyu: Kwa maana zamani ninyi mlikuwa giza, lakini sasa ninyi ni nuru katika Bwana. Enendeni kama watoto wa nuru
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

kikuyu: (kwa kuwa tunda la nuru hupatikana katika wema wote, haki na kweli),
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

kikuyu: nanyi tafuteni yale yanayompendeza Bwana.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

kikuyu: Msishiriki matendo ya giza yasiyofaa, bali yafichueni.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ni aibu hata kutaja mambo yale ambayo wasiotii wanayafanya sirini.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

kikuyu: Lakini kila kitu kilichowekwa nuruni, huonekana,
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa nuru ndiyo hufanya kila kitu kionekane. Hii ndiyo sababu imesemekana: “Amka, wewe uliyelala, ufufuke kutoka kwa wafu, naye Kristo atakuangazia.”
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo angalieni sana jinsi mnavyoenenda, si kama watu wasio na hekima, bali kama wenye hekima,
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

kikuyu: mkiukomboa wakati, kwa sababu nyakati hizi ni za uovu.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo msiwe wajinga, bali mpate kujua nini mapenzi ya Bwana.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

kikuyu: Pia msilewe kwa mvinyo, ambamo ndani yake mna upotovu, bali mjazwe Roho.
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

kikuyu: Msemezane ninyi kwa ninyi kwa zaburi, nyimbo na tenzi za rohoni, mkimwimbia na kumsifu Bwana mioyoni mwenu,
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

kikuyu: siku zote mkimshukuru Mungu Baba kwa kila jambo katika Jina la Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

kikuyu: Nyenyekeaneni ninyi kwa ninyi kwa heshima kwa ajili ya Kristo.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

kikuyu: Ninyi wake, watiini waume zenu kama kumtii Bwana.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mume ni kichwa cha mkewe kama vile Kristo alivyo kichwa cha Kanisa, ambalo ni mwili wake, naye Kristo ni Mwokozi wake.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

kikuyu: Basi, kama vile Kanisa linavyomtii Kristo, vivyo hivyo na wake nao imewapasa kuwatii waume zao kwa kila jambo.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

kikuyu: Ninyi waume, wapendeni wake zenu, kama vile Kristo alivyolipenda Kanisa akajitoa kwa ajili yake
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

kikuyu: kusudi alifanye takatifu, akilitakasa kwa kuliosha kwa maji katika Neno lake,
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

kikuyu: apate kujiletea Kanisa tukufu lisilo na doa wala kunyanzi au waa lolote, bali takatifu na lisilo na hatia.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo imewapasa waume kuwapenda wake zao kama miili yao wenyewe. Ampendaye mkewe hujipenda mwenyewe.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

kikuyu: Hakuna mtu anayeuchukia mwili wake mwenyewe, bali huulisha na kuutunza vizuri, kama Kristo anavyolitunza Kanisa lake.
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

kikuyu: Sisi tu viungo vya mwili wake.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

kikuyu: “Kwa sababu hii, mwanaume atamwacha baba yake na mama yake, naye ataambatana na mkewe, na hao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.”
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Siri hii ni kubwa, bali mimi nanena kuhusu Kristo na Kanisa.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, kila mmoja wenu ampende mkewe kama anavyoipenda nafsi yake mwenyewe, naye mke lazima amheshimu mumewe.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

kikuyu: Enyi watoto, watiini wazazi wenu katika Bwana, kwa kuwa hili ni jema.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

kikuyu: “Waheshimu baba yako na mama yako,” hii ndio amri ya kwanza yenye ahadi,
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

kikuyu: “upate baraka na uishi siku nyingi duniani.”
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

kikuyu: Ninyi akina baba, msiwachokoze watoto wenu, bali waleeni kwa nidhamu na mafundisho ya Bwana.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

kikuyu: Ninyi watumwa, watiini hao walio mabwana zenu hapa duniani kwa heshima na kwa kutetemeka na kwa moyo mmoja, kama vile mnavyomtii Kristo.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

kikuyu: Watiini, si tu wakati wakiwaona ili mpate upendeleo wao, bali mtumike kama watumwa wa Kristo, mkifanya mapenzi ya Mungu kwa moyo.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

kikuyu: Tumikeni kwa moyo wote, kama vile mnamtumikia Bwana na si wanadamu.
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

kikuyu: Mkijua kwamba Bwana atampa kila mtu thawabu kwa lolote jema alilotenda, kama yeye ni mtumwa au ni mtu huru.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

kikuyu: Nanyi mabwana, watendeeni watumwa wenu kwa jinsi iyo hiyo. Msiwatishe, kwa kuwa mnajua ya kwamba yeye aliye Bwana wenu na Bwana wao yuko mbinguni, naye hana upendeleo.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

kikuyu: Hatimaye, mzidi kuwa hodari katika Bwana na katika uweza wa nguvu zake.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

kikuyu: Vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili kwamba mweze kuzipinga hila za ibilisi.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kushindana kwetu si juu ya nyama na damu, bali dhidi ya falme, mamlaka, dhidi ya wakuu wa giza na majeshi ya pepo wabaya katika ulimwengu wa roho.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo vaeni silaha zote za Mungu ili mweze kushindana siku ya uovu itakapokuja nanyi mkiisha kufanya yote, simameni imara.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo simameni imara mkiwa mmejifunga kweli kiunoni na kuvaa dirii ya haki kifuani,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

kikuyu: nayo miguu yenu ifungiwe utayari tuupatao kwa Injili ya amani.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

kikuyu: Zaidi ya haya yote, twaeni ngao ya imani, ambayo kwa hiyo mtaweza kuizima mishale yote yenye moto ya yule mwovu.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

kikuyu: Vaeni chapeo ya wokovu na mchukue upanga wa Roho, ambao ni Neno la Mungu.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

kikuyu: Mkiomba kwa Roho siku zote katika sala zote na maombi, mkikesha kila wakati mkiwaombea watakatifu wote.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

kikuyu: Niombeeni na mimi pia, ili kila nifunguapo kinywa changu, nipewe maneno ya kusema, niweze kutangaza siri ya Injili kwa ujasiri,
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

kikuyu: ambayo mimi ni balozi wake katika vifungo. Ombeni ili nipate kuhubiri kwa ujasiri kama inipasavyo.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Tikiko, aliye ndugu mpendwa na mtumishi mwaminifu katika Bwana, atawaambia kila kitu, ili pia mpate kujua hali yangu na kile ninachofanya sasa.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

kikuyu: Ninamtuma kwenu kwa ajili ya kusudi hili hasa, ili mpate kujua hali yetu, na awatie moyo.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

kikuyu: Amani iwe kwa ndugu, na pendo pamoja na imani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba na Bwana Yesu Kristo.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Neema iwe na wote wampendao Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo kwa upendo wa dhati. Amen.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

kikuyu: Waraka wa Paulo na Timotheo, watumishi wa Kristo Yesu: Kwa watakatifu wote katika Kristo Yesu walioko Filipi, pamoja na waangalizi na mashemasi:
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

kikuyu: Neema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo iwe nanyi.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ninamshukuru Mungu wangu kila niwakumbukapo ninyi.
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

kikuyu: Katika maombi yangu yote daima nimekuwa nikiwaombea ninyi nyote kwa furaha,
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

kikuyu: kwa sababu ya kushiriki kwenu katika kueneza Injili, tangu siku ya kwanza hadi leo.
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

kikuyu: Nina hakika kwamba yeye aliyeianza kazi njema mioyoni mwenu, ataiendeleza na kuikamilisha hata siku ya Kristo Yesu.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ni haki na ni wajibu wangu kufikiri hivi juu yenu nyote, kwa sababu ninyi mko moyoni mwangu. Ikiwa nimefungwa au nikiwa ninaitetea na kuithibitisha Injili, ninyi nyote mnashiriki neema ya Mungu pamoja nami.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

kikuyu: Mungu ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyowaonea shauku ninyi nyote kwa huruma ya Kristo Yesu.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Haya ndiyo maombi yangu: kwamba upendo wenu uongezeke zaidi na zaidi katika maarifa na ufahamu wote,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

kikuyu: ili mpate kutambua yale yaliyo mema, mkawe safi, wasio na hatia hadi siku ya Kristo,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

kikuyu: mkiwa mmejawa na matunda ya haki yapatikanayo kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo, kwa utukufu na sifa za Mungu.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

kikuyu: Basi, ndugu zangu, nataka mjue kwamba mambo yale yaliyonipata kwa kweli yamesaidia sana kueneza Injili.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

kikuyu: Matokeo yake ni kwamba imejulikana wazi kwa walinzi wote wa jumba la kifalme na kwa wengine wote kuwa nimefungwa kwa ajili ya Kristo.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

kikuyu: Kwa sababu ya vifungo vyangu, ndugu wengi katika Bwana wametiwa moyo kuhubiri neno la Mungu kwa ujasiri zaidi na bila woga.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

kikuyu: Ni kweli kwamba wengine wanamhubiri Kristo kutokana na wivu na kwa kutaka kushindana, lakini wengine wanamhubiri Kristo kwa nia njema.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

kikuyu: Hawa wa mwisho wanamhubiri Kristo kwa moyo wa upendo, wakifahamu kwamba nimo humu gerezani kwa ajili ya kuitetea Injili.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

kikuyu: Hao wa kwanza wanamtangaza Kristo kutokana na tamaa zao wenyewe wala si kwa moyo mweupe, bali wanakusudia kuongeza mateso yangu katika huku kufungwa kwangu.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

kikuyu: Lakini inadhuru nini? Jambo la muhimu ni kwamba kwa kila njia, ikiwa ni kwa nia mbaya au njema, Kristo anahubiriwa. Nami kwa ajili ya jambo hilo ninafurahi. Naam, nami nitaendelea kufurahi,
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

kikuyu: kwa maana ninajua kwamba kwa maombi yenu na kwa msaada unaotolewa na Roho wa Yesu Kristo, yale yaliyonipata mimi yatageuka kuwa wokovu wangu.
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ninatarajia kwa shauku kubwa na kutumaini kwamba sitaaibika kwa njia yoyote, bali nitakuwa na ujasiri wa kutosha ili sasa kama wakati mwingine wowote, Kristo atukuzwe katika mwili wangu, ikiwa ni kwa kuishi au kwa kufa.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwangu mimi, kuishi ni Kristo, na kufa ni faida.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

kikuyu: Kama nitaendelea kuishi katika mwili, kwangu hili ni kwa ajili ya matunda ya kazi. Lakini sijui nichague lipi? Mimi sijui!
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

kikuyu: Ninavutwa kati ya mambo mawili: Ninatamani kuondoka nikakae pamoja na Kristo, jambo hilo ni bora zaidi.
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa sababu yenu ni muhimu zaidi mimi nikiendelea kuishi katika mwili.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa nina matumaini haya, ninajua kwamba nitaendelea kuwepo na kuwa pamoja nanyi nyote, ili mpate kukua na kuwa na furaha katika imani.
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

kikuyu: Ili kwamba furaha yenu iwe nyingi katika Kristo Yesu kwa ajili yangu kwa kule kuja kwangu kwenu tena.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

kikuyu: Lakini lolote litakalotukia, mwenende kama ipasavyo Injili ya Kristo, ili kwamba nikija na kuwaona au ikiwa sipo, nipate kusikia haya juu yenu: Kuwa mnasimama imara katika roho moja, mkiishindania imani ya Injili kwa umoja,
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

kikuyu: wala msitishwe na wale wanaowapinga. Hii ni ishara kwao kuwa wataangamia, lakini ninyi mtaokolewa, na hii ni kazi ya Mungu.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mmepewa kwa ajili ya Kristo, si kumwamini tu, bali pia kuteswa kwa ajili yake,
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

kikuyu: kwa kuwa mnashiriki mashindano yale yale mliyoyaona nikiwa nayo na ambayo hata sasa mnasikia kuwa bado ninayo.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

kikuyu: Kama kukiwa na jambo lolote la kutia moyo katika kuunganishwa na Kristo, kukiwa faraja yoyote katika upendo wake, kukiwa na ushirika wowote na Roho, kukiwa na wema wowote na huruma,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

kikuyu: basi ikamilisheni furaha yangu kwa kuwa na nia moja, mkiwa na upendo huo moja, mkiwa wa roho na kusudi moja.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

kikuyu: Msitende jambo lolote kwa nia ya kujitukuza wala kujivuna, bali kwa unyenyekevu kila mtu amhesabu mwingine bora kuliko nafsi yake.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

kikuyu: Kila mmoja wenu asiangalie faida yake mwenyewe tu, bali pia ajishughulishe kwa faida ya wengine.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

kikuyu: Kuweni na nia ile ile aliyokuwa nayo Kristo Yesu:
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Yeye, ingawa alikuwa na asili ya Mungu hasa, hakuona kule kuwa sawa na Mungu kuwa kitu cha kushikilia,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

kikuyu: bali alijifanya si kitu, akachukua hali hasa na mtumwa, naye akazaliwa katika umbo la mwanadamu.
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

kikuyu: Naye akiwa na umbo la mwanadamu, alijinyenyekeza, akatii hata mauti: naam, mauti ya msalaba!
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, Mungu alimtukuza juu sana, na kumpa Jina lililo kuu kuliko kila jina,
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

kikuyu: ili kwa Jina la Yesu, kila goti lipigwe, la vitu vya mbinguni, na vya duniani, na vya chini ya nchi,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

kikuyu: na kila ulimi ukiri ya kwamba Yesu Kristo ni Bwana, kwa utukufu wa Mungu Baba.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, wapenzi wangu, kama vile ambavyo mmekuwa mkitii siku zote, si tu wakati nikiwa pamoja nanyi, bali sasa zaidi sana nisipokuwepo, utimizeni wokovu wenu kwa kuogopa na kutetemeka,
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

kikuyu: kwa maana Mungu ndiye atendaye kazi ndani yenu, kutaka kwenu na kutenda kwenu kwa kulitimiza kusudi lake jema.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

kikuyu: Fanyeni mambo yote bila kunungʼunika wala kushindana,
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

kikuyu: ili msiwe na lawama wala hatia, bali mwe wana wa Mungu wasio na kasoro katika kizazi chenye ukaidi na kilichopotoka, ambacho ndani yake ninyi mnangʼaa kama mianga ulimwenguni.
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

kikuyu: Mkilishika neno la uzima, ili nipate kuona fahari siku ya Kristo kwamba sikupiga mbio wala kujitaabisha bure.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

kikuyu: Lakini hata kama nikimiminwa kama sadaka ya kinywaji kwenye dhabihu na huduma itokayo katika imani yenu, mimi ninafurahi na kushangilia pamoja nanyi nyote.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, ninyi nanyi imewapasa kufurahi na kushangilia pamoja nami.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

kikuyu: Natumaini katika Bwana Yesu kumtuma Timotheo hivi karibuni aje kwenu, ili nipate kufarijika moyo nitakapopata habari zenu.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

kikuyu: Sina mtu mwingine kama yeye, ambaye ataangalia hali yenu kwa halisi.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kila mmoja anajishughulisha zaidi na mambo yake mwenyewe wala si yale ya Yesu Kristo.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Lakini ninyi wenyewe mnajua jinsi Timotheo alivyojithibitisha mwenyewe, kwa maana ametumika pamoja nami kwa kazi ya Injili, kama vile mwana kwa baba yake.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, ninatumaini kumtuma kwenu upesi mara nitakapojua mambo yangu yatakavyokuwa.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

kikuyu: Nami mwenyewe ninatumaini katika Bwana kwamba nitakuja kwenu hivi karibuni.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

kikuyu: Lakini nadhani ni muhimu kumtuma tena kwenu Epafrodito, ndugu yangu na mtendakazi pamoja nami, aliye askari mwenzangu, ambaye pia ni mjumbe wenu mliyemtuma ili ashughulike na mahitaji yangu.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

kikuyu: Kwa maana amekuwa akiwaonea sana shauku ninyi nyote, akiwa na wasiwasi kwa kuwa mlisikia kwamba alikuwa mgonjwa.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

kikuyu: Kweli alikuwa mgonjwa, tena karibu ya kufa. Lakini Mungu alimhurumia, wala si yeye tu, bali hata na mimi alinihurumia, nisipatwe na huzuni juu ya huzuni.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo mimi ninafanya bidii kumtuma kwenu ili mtakapomwona kwa mara nyingine, mpate kufurahi, nami wasiwasi wangu upungue.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo mpokeeni katika Bwana kwa furaha kubwa, nanyi wapeni heshima watu kama hawa,
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

kikuyu: kwa sababu alikaribia kufa kwa ajili ya kazi ya Kristo, akihatarisha maisha yake ili aweze kunihudumia vile ninyi hamkuweza.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

kikuyu: Hatimaye, ndugu zangu, furahini katika Bwana! Mimi kuwaandikia mambo yale yale hakuniudhi, kwa maana ni kinga kwa ajili yenu.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

kikuyu: Jihadharini na mbwa, wale watenda maovu, jihadharini na wale wajikatao miili yao, wasemao ili kuokoka ni lazima kutahiriwa.
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sisi ndio tulio tohara, sisi tumwabuduo Mungu katika Roho, tunaona fahari katika Kristo Yesu, ambao hatuweki tumaini letu katika mwili,
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

kikuyu: ingawa mimi mwenyewe ninazo sababu za kuutumainia mwili. Kama mtu yeyote akidhani anazo sababu za kuutumainia mwili, mimi zaidi.
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

kikuyu: Nilitahiriwa siku ya nane, mimi ni Mwisraeli wa kabila la Benyamini, Mwebrania wa Waebrania. Kwa habari ya sheria, ni Farisayo,
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

kikuyu: kwa habari ya juhudi, nilikuwa nalitesa kanisa, kuhusu haki ipatikanayo kwa sheria, mimi nilikuwa sina hatia.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

kikuyu: Lakini mambo yale yaliyokuwa faida kwangu, sasa nayahesabu kuwa hasara kwa ajili ya Kristo.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya hayo, nayahesabu mambo yote kuwa hasara tupu nikiyalinganisha na faida kubwa ipitayo kiasi cha kumjua Kristo Yesu Bwana wangu, ambaye kwa ajili yake nimepata hasara ya mambo yote, nikiyahesabu kuwa kama mavi ili nimpate Kristo.
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

kikuyu: Nami nionekane mbele zake bila kuwa na haki yangu mwenyewe ipatikanayo kwa sheria, bali ile ipatikanayo kwa imani katika Kristo, haki ile itokayo kwa Mungu kwa njia ya imani.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

kikuyu: Nataka nimjue Kristo na uweza wa kufufuka kwake na ushirika wa mateso yake, ili nifanane naye katika mauti yake,
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

kikuyu: ili kwa njia yoyote niweze kufikia ufufuo wa wafu.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Si kwamba nimekwisha kufikia, au kwamba nimekwisha kuwa mkamilifu, la hasha! Bali nakaza mwendo ili nipate kile ambacho kwa ajili yake, nimeshikwa na Kristo Yesu.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, sijihesabu kuwa nimekwisha kushika. Lakini ninafanya jambo moja: Ninasahau mambo yale yaliyopita, nakaza mwendo kufikia yale yaliyo mbele.
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

kikuyu: Nakaza mwendo nifikie ile alama ya ushindi iliyowekwa ili nipate tuzo ya mwito mkuu wa Mungu ambao nimeitiwa huko juu mbinguni katika Kristo Yesu.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Hivyo sisi sote tuliokuwa kiroho tuwaze jambo hili, hata mkiwaza mengine katika jambo lolote, Mungu ataliweka wazi hilo nalo.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

kikuyu: Lakini na tushike sana lile ambalo tumekwisha kulifikia.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, kwa pamoja fuateni mfano wangu na kuwatazama wale wanaofuata kielelezo tulichowawekea.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

kikuyu: Kwa maana, kama nilivyokwisha kuwaambia mara nyingi kabla, nami sasa nasema tena hata kwa machozi, watu wengi wanaishi kama adui wa msalaba wa Kristo.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

kikuyu: Mwisho wa watu hao ni maangamizi, Mungu wao ni tumbo, na utukufu wao ni aibu, na mawazo yao yamo katika mambo ya dunia.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

kikuyu: Lakini uenyeji wetu uko mbinguni. Nasi tunamngoja kwa shauku Mwokozi kutoka huko, yaani, Bwana Yesu Kristo,
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: atakayeubadili mwili wetu wa unyonge, ili upate kufanana na mwili wake wa utukufu, kwa uweza ule ambao kwa huo aweza hata kuvitiisha vitu vyote chini yake.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, ninaowapenda na ambao ninawaonea shauku, ninyi mlio furaha yangu na taji yangu, hivi ndivyo iwapasavyo kusimama imara katika Bwana, ninyi wapenzi wangu.
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

kikuyu: Nawasihi Euodia na Sintike wawe na nia moja katika Bwana.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

kikuyu: Naam, nakusihi wewe pia, mwenzangu mwaminifu, uwasaidie hawa wanawake, kwa sababu walijitaabisha katika kazi ya Injili pamoja nami bega kwa bega, wakiwa pamoja na Klementi na watendakazi wenzangu ambao majina yao yameandikwa katika kitabu cha uzima.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

kikuyu: Furahini katika Bwana siku zote, tena nasema furahini!
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

kikuyu: Upole wenu na ujulikane na watu wote. Bwana yu karibu.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
