english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

kikuyu: awe ameshuhudiwa kwa matendo yake mema, aliyewalea watoto wake vizuri, aliye mkarimu, aliyewanawisha watakatifu miguu, aliyewasaidia wenye shida na aliyejitolea kwa ajili ya matendo mema ya kila namna.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa habari za wajane vijana usiwaweke kwenye orodha hiyo, maana tamaa zao za kimaumbile zikizidi kule kujitoa kwao kwa Kristo, watataka kuolewa tena.
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

kikuyu: Nao kwa njia hiyo watajiletea hukumu kwa kukiuka ahadi yao ya kwanza.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

kikuyu: Zaidi ya hayo, wajane kama hao huwa na tabia ya uvivu wakizurura nyumba kwa nyumba, wala hawawi wavivu tu, bali pia huwa wasengenyaji, wajiingizao katika mambo yasiyowahusu na kusema mambo yasiyowapasa kusema.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

kikuyu: Hivyo nawashauri wajane vijana waolewe, wazae watoto na wasimamie nyumba zao, wasije wakampa adui nafasi ya kutushutumu.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kwa kweli wajane wengine wamepotoka ili kumfuata Shetani.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

kikuyu: Lakini kama mwanamke yeyote aaminiye ana wajane katika jamaa yake, inampasa awasaidie wala si kuwaacha wakililemea kanisa, ili kanisa liweze kuwasaidia wale ambao ni wajane kweli kweli.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: Wazee wa kanisa wanaoongoza shughuli za kanisa vizuri wanastahili heshima mara mbili, hasa wale ambao kazi yao ni kuhubiri na kufundisha.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Maandiko husema, “Usimfunge maksai kinywa apurapo nafaka,” tena, “Mfanyakazi anastahili mshahara wake.”
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

kikuyu: Usiendekeze mashtaka dhidi ya mzee isipokuwa yawe yameletwa na mashahidi wawili au watatu.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

kikuyu: Wale wanaodumu katika dhambi uwakemee hadharani, ili wengine wapate kuogopa.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

kikuyu: Ninakuagiza mbele za Mungu na mbele za Kristo Yesu na mbele za malaika wateule, shika maagizo haya pasipo ubaguzi wala upendeleo.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

kikuyu: Usiwe na haraka kumwekea mtu mikono wala usishiriki dhambi za watu wengine. Jilinde nafsi yako uwe safi.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

kikuyu: Acha kunywa maji peke yake, tumia divai kidogo kwa sababu ya tumbo lako na maumivu yako ya mara kwa mara.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

kikuyu: Dhambi za watu wengine ni dhahiri nazo zinawatangulia kwenda hukumuni; na dhambi za watu wengine zinawafuata nyuma yao.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, matendo mema yako dhahiri, na hata yale ambayo si mema hayawezi kufichika.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: Wale wote walio chini ya kongwa la utumwa inawapasa kuwahesabu mabwana zao kuwa wanastahili heshima yote, ili jina la Mungu lisitukanwe wala mafundisho yetu.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Wale watumwa ambao wana mabwana waaminio, haiwapasi kupunguza heshima yao kwa sababu wao ni ndugu. Badala yake, wawatumikie hata vizuri zaidi, kwa sababu wale wanaonufaika na huduma yao ni waaminio, ambao ni wapenzi wao. Fundisha mambo haya na uwahimize kuyafuata.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

kikuyu: Ikiwa mtu yeyote atafundisha mafundisho mapotovu wala hakubaliani na mafundisho manyofu ya Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo na yale ya utauwa,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: huyo amejivuna wala hajui kitu chochote. Yeye amejaa tamaa ya mabishano na ugomvi kuhusu maneno ambavyo matokeo yake ni wivu na mapigano, maneno ya ukorofi, shuku mbaya,
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

kikuyu: na kuzozana kusikokoma kati ya watu walioharibika akili zao, walioikosa kweli, na ambao hudhani kwamba utauwa ni njia ya kupata faida.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

kikuyu: Lakini utauwa na kuridhika ni faida kubwa.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hatukuja humu duniani na kitu chochote, wala hatuwezi kutoka humu na kitu.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

kikuyu: Lakini kama tuna chakula na mavazi, tutaridhika navyo.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

kikuyu: Lakini wale watu wanaotamani kuwa na mali kwa haraka huanguka kwenye majaribu, na wamenaswa na tamaa nyingi za kipumbavu zenye kudhuru, zinazowazamisha watu katika uharibifu na maangamizi.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kupenda fedha ndiyo shina moja la maovu ya kila namna. Baadhi ya watu wakitamani fedha, wameiacha imani na kujichoma wenyewe kwa maumivu mengi.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe, mtu wa Mungu, yakimbie mambo haya yote. Fuata haki, utauwa, imani, upendo, saburi na upole.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

kikuyu: Pigana vile vita vizuri vya imani. Shika uzima wa milele ambao ndio ulioitiwa ulipokiri ule ukiri mzuri mbele ya mashahidi wengi.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

kikuyu: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu avipaye vitu vyote uhai, na mbele za Kristo Yesu ambaye alipokuwa anashuhudia mbele ya Pontio Pilato alikiri ukiri mzuri,
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

kikuyu: uishike amri hii bila dosari wala lawama mpaka kuja kwake Bwana wetu Yesu Kristo,
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: ambaye Mungu atamleta kwa wakati wake mwenyewe: yeye ahimidiwaye, aliye peke yake Mtawala, Mfalme wa wafalme, na Bwana wa mabwana,
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

kikuyu: yeye peke yake ambaye hapatikani na mauti, na anakaa katika nuru isiyoweza kukaribiwa, ambaye hakuna mwanadamu aliyemwona wala awezaye kumwona. Heshima na uweza una yeye milele. Amen.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

kikuyu: Waagize wale ambao ni matajiri wa ulimwengu huu waache kujivuna, wala wasiweke tumaini lao katika mali ambayo si ya hakika, bali waweke tumaini lao katika Mungu ambaye hutupatia vitu vyote kwa wingi ili tuvifurahie.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

kikuyu: Waagize watende mema, wawe matajiri katika matendo mema, pia wawe wakarimu na walio tayari kushiriki mali zao na wengine.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

kikuyu: Kwa njia hii watajiwekea hazina kama msingi kwa ajili ya wakati ujao na hivyo watajipatia uzima, yaani, ule uzima ambao ni wa kweli.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

kikuyu: Timotheo, linda kile kilichowekwa amana kwako. Epuka majadiliano yasiyo ya utauwa na mabishano ambayo kwa uongo huitwa elimu,
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

kikuyu: ambayo wengine kwa kujidai kuwa nayo wameiacha imani. Neema iwe nanyi. Amen.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Paulo mtume wa Kristo Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, kulingana na ile ahadi ya uzima uliomo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Kwa Timotheo, mwanangu mpendwa: Neema, rehema na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba, na kwa Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Ninamshukuru Mungu, ninayemtumikia kwa dhamiri safi, kama walivyofanya baba zangu, ninapokukumbuka usiku na mchana katika maombi yangu.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

kikuyu: Nikiyakumbuka machozi yako, ninatamani sana kukuona ili nipate kujawa na furaha.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

kikuyu: Nimekuwa nikiikumbuka imani yako ya kweli, waliokuwa nayo bibi yako Loisi na mama yako Eunike na ambayo mimi ninasadiki sasa wewe pia unayo.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii nakukumbusha uchochee ile karama ya Mungu, iliyowekwa ndani yako nilipokuwekea mikono yangu.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

kikuyu: Maana Mungu hakutupa roho ya woga, bali roho ya nguvu, ya upendo na ya moyo wa kiasi.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo usione haya kushuhudia kuhusu Bwana wetu, wala usinionee haya mimi niliye mfungwa kwa ajili yake. Bali uishiriki pamoja nami taabu ya Injili, kwa kadiri ya nguvu ya Mungu,
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

kikuyu: ambaye alituokoa na kutuita katika mwito mtakatifu: si kwa kadiri ya matendo yetu mema bali kwa sababu ya kusudi lake mwenyewe na neema yake. Neema hii tulipewa katika Kristo Yesu tangu milele.
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

kikuyu: Lakini sasa imefunuliwa kwa kudhihirishwa kwake Mwokozi wetu, Kristo Yesu, ambaye amebatilisha mauti na kuleta uzima na kutokufa kwa njia ya Injili.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

kikuyu: Nami nimewekwa kuwa mhubiri, mtume na mwalimu wa Injili hii.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo sababu ninateseka namna hii, lakini sioni haya kwa maana ninamjua yeye niliyemwamini, na kusadiki ya kuwa anaweza kukilinda kile nilichokiweka amana kwake hadi siku ile.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

kikuyu: Shika kwa uthabiti kielelezo cha mafundisho yenye uzima yale uliyoyasikia kwangu, pamoja na imani na upendo katika Kristo Yesu.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ilinde ile amana uliyokabidhiwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu akaaye ndani yetu.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

kikuyu: Unajua ya kuwa watu wote katika Asia wameniacha, miongoni mwao wamo Filego na Hermogene.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

kikuyu: Bwana akawahurumie watu wa nyumbani mwa Onesiforo, kwa sababu aliniburudisha mara kwa mara wala hakuionea aibu minyororo yangu.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

kikuyu: Badala yake, alipokuwa Rumi, alinitafuta kwa bidii mpaka akanipata.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

kikuyu: Bwana na amjalie kupata rehema zake siku ile! Nawe unajua vyema jinsi alivyonisaidia huko Efeso.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

kikuyu: Basi, wewe mwanangu, uwe hodari katika neema iliyo ndani ya Kristo Yesu.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Nayo mambo yale uliyonisikia nikiyasema mbele ya mashahidi wengi, uwakabidhi watu waaminifu watakaoweza kuwafundisha watu wengine vilevile.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

kikuyu: Vumilia taabu pamoja nasi kama askari mwema wa Kristo Yesu.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Hakuna askari yeyote ambaye akiwa vitani hujishughulisha na mambo ya kawaida ya maisha haya kwa sababu nia yake ni kumpendeza yule aliyemwandika awe askari.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, yeye ashindanaye katika michezo hawezi kupewa tuzo ya ushindi asiposhindana kulingana na kanuni za mashindano.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

kikuyu: Mkulima mwenye bidii ya kazi ndiye anayestahili kuwa wa kwanza kupata fungu la mavuno.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

kikuyu: Fikiri sana kuhusu haya nisemayo, kwa maana Bwana atakupa ufahamu katika mambo hayo yote.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

kikuyu: Mkumbuke Yesu Kristo, aliyefufuliwa kutoka kwa wafu, yeye aliye wa uzao wa Daudi. Hii ndiyo Injili yangu,
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

kikuyu: ambayo kwayo ninateseka hata kufikia hatua ya kufungwa minyororo kama mhalifu. Lakini neno la Mungu halifungwi.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo ninavumilia mambo yote kwa ajili ya wateule wa Mungu, kusudi wao nao wapate wokovu ulio katika Kristo Yesu, pamoja na utukufu wa milele.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

kikuyu: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa: Kwa maana kama tumekufa pamoja naye, tutaishi pia pamoja naye.
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

kikuyu: Kama tukistahimili, pia tutatawala pamoja naye. Kama tukimkana yeye, naye atatukana sisi.
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

kikuyu: Kama tusipoamini, yeye hudumu kuwa mwaminifu, kwa maana hawezi kujikana mwenyewe.
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

kikuyu: Endelea kuwakumbusha mambo haya ukiwaonya mbele za Bwana waache kushindana kwa maneno ambayo hayana faida yoyote bali huwaangamiza tu wale wanaoyasikia.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

kikuyu: Jitahidi kujionyesha kwa Mungu kuwa umekubaliwa naye, mtendakazi asiye na sababu ya kuona aibu, ukilitumia kwa usahihi neno la kweli.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

kikuyu: Jiepushe na maneno mabaya, yasiyo na maana, yasiyo ya utauwa, kwa maana hayo huzidi kuwatosa watu katika kukosa heshima kwa Mungu.
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

kikuyu: Mafundisho yao yataenea kama kidonda kisichopona. Miongoni mwao wamo Himenayo na Fileto
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

kikuyu: ambao wameiacha kweli, wakisema kwamba ufufuo wa wafu umekwisha kuwako, nao huharibu imani ya baadhi ya watu.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

kikuyu: Lakini msingi wa Mungu ulio imara umesimama, ukiwa na muhuri wenye maandishi haya: “Bwana anawajua walio wake”; tena, “Kila alitajaye jina la Bwana, na auache uovu.”
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

kikuyu: Katika nyumba kubwa si kwamba kuna vyombo vya dhahabu na fedha tu, bali pia vimo vyombo vya miti na vya udongo; vingine kwa matumizi maalum, na vingine kwa matumizi ya kawaida.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

kikuyu: Basi ikiwa mtu amejitakasa na kujitenga na hayo niliyoyataja, atakuwa chombo maalum, kilichotengwa na ambacho kinamfaa mwenye nyumba, kimeandaliwa tayari kwa kila kazi njema.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

kikuyu: Zikimbie tamaa mbaya za ujana, ufuate haki, imani, upendo na amani pamoja na wale wamwitao Bwana kwa moyo safi.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

kikuyu: Jiepushe na mabishano ya kipumbavu na yasiyo na maana, kwa kuwa wajua ya kwamba hayo huzaa magomvi.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

kikuyu: Tena haimpasi mtumishi wa Bwana kuwa mgomvi, bali inampasa awe mwema kwa kila mtu, awezaye kufundisha, tena mvumilivu.
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

kikuyu: Inampasa kuwaonya kwa upole wale wanaopingana naye, kwa matumaini kwamba Mungu atawajalia kutubu na kuijua kweli,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

kikuyu: ili fahamu zao ziwarudie tena, nao waponyoke katika mtego wa ibilisi ambaye amewateka wapate kufanya mapenzi yake.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

kikuyu: Lakini yakupasa ufahamu jambo hili, kwamba siku za mwisho kutakuwa na nyakati za hatari.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

kikuyu: Kwa maana watu watakuwa wenye kujipenda wenyewe, wenye kupenda fedha, wenye kujisifu, wenye kiburi, wenye kumkufuru Mungu, wasiotii wazazi wao, wasio na shukrani, wasio watakatifu,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

kikuyu: wasio na upendo, wasiopenda kupatanishwa, wasingiziaji, wasiozuia tamaa zao, wakatili, wasiopenda mema,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

kikuyu: wasaliti, wakaidi, waliojaa majivuno, wapendao anasa zaidi kuliko kumpenda Mungu:
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

kikuyu: wakiwa na mfano wa utauwa kwa nje, lakini wakizikana nguvu za Mungu. Jiepushe na watu wa namna hiyo.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

kikuyu: Miongoni mwao wamo wale wajiingizao katika nyumba za watu na kuwachukua mateka wanawake wajinga, waliolemewa na dhambi zao na kuyumbishwa na aina zote za tamaa mbaya.
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

kikuyu: Wakijifunza siku zote lakini kamwe wasiweze kufikia ujuzi wa kweli.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: Kama vile Yane na Yambre walivyopingana na Mose, vivyo hivyo watu hawa hupingana na ile kweli. Hawa ni watu wenye akili zilizopotoka, ambao wamekataliwa kwa mambo ya imani.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

kikuyu: Lakini hawataendelea sana, kwa sababu upumbavu wao utakuwa dhahiri kwa watu wote, kama ulivyokuwa dhahiri upumbavu wa hao watu wawili.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

kikuyu: Lakini wewe umeyajua mafundisho yangu, mwenendo, makusudi, imani, uvumilivu, upendo, ustahimilivu,
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

kikuyu: mateso na taabu, yaani mambo yote yaliyonipata huko Antiokia, Ikonio na Listra, mateso yote niliyostahimili, lakini Bwana aliniokoa katika hayo yote.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

kikuyu: Naam, yeyote anayetaka kuishi maisha ya utauwa ndani ya Kristo Yesu atateswa.
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

kikuyu: Lakini watu waovu na wadanganyaji watazidi kuwa waovu, wakidanganya na kudanganyika.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

kikuyu: Bali wewe, udumu katika yale uliyojifunza na kuyaamini kwa uthabiti, ukitambua ya kuwa ulijifunza hayo kutoka kwa nani,
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

kikuyu: na jinsi ambavyo tangu utoto umeyajua Maandiko matakatifu, ambayo yanaweza kukuhekimisha upate wokovu kwa njia ya imani katika Kristo Yesu.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Kila Andiko limevuviwa na Mungu na lafaa kwa mafundisho, kwa kuwaonya watu makosa yao, kwa kuwaongoza na kwa kuwafundisha katika haki,
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

kikuyu: ili mtu wa Mungu awe amekamilishwa, apate kutenda kila kazi njema.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

kikuyu: Nakuagiza mbele za Mungu na mbele za Kristo Yesu, atakayewahukumu watu walio hai na waliokufa wakati wa kuja kwake na ufalme wake, kwamba:
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

kikuyu: Hubiri Neno; kuwa tayari wakati ufaao na wakati usiofaa; karipia, kemea na utie moyo kwa uvumilivu wote na kwa mafundisho mazuri.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

kikuyu: Maana wakati utakuja watu watakapokataa kuyakubali mafundisho yenye uzima. Badala yake, ili kutimiza tamaa zao wenyewe, watajikusanyia idadi kubwa ya walimu wapate kuwaambia yale ambayo masikio yao yanayowasha yanatamani kuyasikia.
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

kikuyu: Watakataa kusikiliza kweli na kuzigeukia hadithi za uongo.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

kikuyu: Kwa habari yako wewe, vumilia mateso, fanya kazi ya mhubiri wa Injili, timiza wajibu wote wa huduma yako.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mimi sasa ni tayari kumiminwa kama sadaka ya kinywaji, nayo saa yangu ya kuondoka imetimia.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

kikuyu: Nimevipiga vita vizuri, mashindano nimeyamaliza, imani nimeilinda.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

kikuyu: Sasa nimewekewa taji ya haki ambayo Bwana, mwamuzi wa haki, atanitunukia siku ile: wala si mimi tu, bali pia wote ambao wamengoja kwa shauku kudhihirishwa kwake.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

kikuyu: Jitahidi kuja kwangu upesi
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

kikuyu: kwa sababu Dema, kwa kuupenda ulimwengu, ameniacha na amekwenda Thesalonike. Kreske amekwenda Galatia na Tito amekwenda Dalmatia.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

kikuyu: Ni Luka peke yake aliye hapa pamoja nami. Mtafute Marko uje naye kwa sababu ananifaa sana katika huduma yangu.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

kikuyu: Nimemtuma Tikiko huko Efeso.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

kikuyu: Utakapokuja, niletee lile joho nililoliacha kwa Karpo huko Troa na vile vitabu vyangu, hasa vile vya ngozi.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

kikuyu: Aleksanda yule mfua chuma alinitendea ubaya mkubwa. Bwana atamlipa kwa ajili ya yale aliyotenda.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

kikuyu: Wewe pia ujihadhari naye kwa sababu aliyapinga sana maneno yetu.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

kikuyu: Katika utetezi wangu wa mara ya kwanza, hakuna hata mmoja aliyeniunga mkono, bali kila mmoja aliniacha. Namwomba Mungu wasihesabiwe hatia kwa jambo hilo.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

kikuyu: Lakini Bwana alisimama upande wangu akanitia nguvu, ili kupitia kwangu lile Neno lihubiriwe kwa ukamilifu, watu wote Mataifa wapate kulisikia. Mimi niliokolewa kutoka kinywa cha simba.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

kikuyu: Bwana ataniokoa katika kila shambulio baya na kunileta salama katika Ufalme wake wa mbinguni. Atukuzwe yeye milele na milele. Amen.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Wasalimu Prisila na Akila, na wote wa nyumbani kwa Onesiforo.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

kikuyu: Erasto alibaki Korintho. Nami nikamwacha Trofimo huko Mileto akiwa mgonjwa.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

kikuyu: Jitahidi ufike huku kabla ya majira ya baridi. Eubulo anakusalimu, vivyo hivyo Pude, Lino, Klaudia na ndugu wote.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

kikuyu: Bwana awe pamoja na roho yako. Neema iwe pamoja nanyi. Amen.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Paulo, mtumishi wa Mungu na mtume wa Yesu Kristo kwa ajili ya imani ya wateule wa Mungu na kuijua kweli iletayo utauwa:
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: imani na ujuzi ulioko katika tumaini la uzima wa milele, ambao Mungu, asiyesema uongo, aliahidi hata kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu,
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

kikuyu: naye kwa wakati wake aliouweka alilidhihirisha neno lake kwa njia ya mahubiri ambayo mimi nimewekewa amana kwa amri ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu:
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

kikuyu: Kwa Tito, mwanangu hasa katika imani tunayoshiriki sote: Neema iwe kwako na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba na kwa Kristo Yesu Mwokozi wetu.
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

kikuyu: Sababu ya mimi kukuacha huko Krete ni ili uweke utaratibu mambo yale yaliyosalia na kuwaweka wazee wa kanisa katika kila mji, kama nilivyokuagiza.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

kikuyu: Mzee wa kanisa asiwe na lawama, awe mume wa mke mmoja, mtu ambaye watoto wake ni waaminio na wala hawashtakiwi kwa ufisadi.
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa mwangalizi, kama wakili wa Mungu, imempasa kuwa mtu asiye na lawama, asiwe mwenye majivuno au mwepesi wa hasira, wala mlevi, wala asiwe mtu mwenye tamaa ya mapato yasiyo ya halali.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

kikuyu: Bali awe mkarimu, anayependa mema, mwenye kiasi, mwenye haki, mwadilifu, mnyofu, mtakatifu na mwenye kuitawala nafsi yake.
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

kikuyu: Inampasa alishike kwa uthabiti lile neno la imani kama lilivyofundishwa, kusudi aweze kuwaonya wengine kwa mafundisho manyofu na kuwakanusha wale wanaopingana nayo.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

kikuyu: Kwa maana wako wengi wasiotii, wenye maneno yasiyo na maana, hasa wale wa kikundi cha tohara.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

kikuyu: Hao ni lazima wanyamazishwe, kwa sababu wanaharibu watu wa nyumba nzima wakifundisha mambo yasiyowapasa kufundisha. Wanafanya hivyo kwa ajili ya kujipatia mapato ya udanganyifu.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

kikuyu: Hata mmojawapo wa manabii wao mwenyewe amesema, “Wakrete ni waongo siku zote, wanyama wabaya, walafi, wavivu.”
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

kikuyu: Ushuhuda huu ni kweli. Kwa hiyo, uwakemee kwa ukali wapate kuwa wazima katika imani,
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

kikuyu: ili wasiendelee kuangalia hadithi za Kiyahudi au maagizo ya wale watu wanaoikataa kweli.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

kikuyu: Kwa wale walio safi, kila kitu ni safi kwao. Lakini kwa wale waliopotoka na wasioamini, hakuna chochote kilicho safi. Kwa kweli nia zao na dhamiri zao zimepotoka.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

kikuyu: Wanadai kumjua Mungu, lakini kwa matendo yao wanamkana. Hao watu ni chukizo, wasiotii, wasiofaa kwa jambo lolote jema.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

kikuyu: Inakupasa kufundisha itikadi sahihi.
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

kikuyu: Wafundishe wazee kuwa na kiasi, wastahivu, wenye busara na wanyofu katika imani, upendo na saburi.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, wafundishe wanawake wazee kuwa na mwenendo wa utakatifu, wala wasiwe wasingiziaji au walevi, bali wafundishe yale yaliyo mema,
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

kikuyu: ili waweze kuwafundisha wanawake vijana kuwa na kiasi, wawapende waume zao na kuwapenda watoto wao,
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

kikuyu: wawe waaminifu, watakatifu, wakitunza vyema nyumba zao, wema, watiifu kwa waume zao, ili mtu yeyote asije akalikufuru neno la Mungu.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo, himiza vijana wawe na kiasi.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

kikuyu: Katika kila jambo uwe kielelezo kwa kutenda mema. Katika mafundisho yako uonyeshe uadilifu, utaratibu,
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

kikuyu: na usemi sahihi usio na lawama, ili wanaokupinga watahayari, wakose neno lolote baya la kusema juu yetu.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

kikuyu: Wafundishe watumwa kuwatii mabwana zao katika kila jambo, wakijitahidi kuwapendeza wala wasijibizane nao,
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

kikuyu: wala wasiwaibie, bali waonyeshe kuwa wanaweza kuaminika kabisa, ili kwa kila namna wayafanye mafundisho ya Mungu Mwokozi wetu yawe ya kuvutia.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

kikuyu: Kwa maana neema ya Mungu ambayo inawaokoa wanadamu wote imefunuliwa.
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

kikuyu: Nayo yatufundisha kukataa ubaya na tamaa za kidunia, ili tupate kuishi maisha ya kiasi, ya haki na ya utaua katika ulimwengu huu wa sasa,
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

kikuyu: huku tukilitazamia tumaini lenye baraka na ufunuo wa utukufu wa Mungu wetu Mkuu, aliye Mwokozi wetu Yesu Kristo.
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ndiye alijitoa nafsi yake kwa ajili yetu, ili atukomboe kutoka uovu wote na kujisafishia watu kuwa mali yake Mwenyewe, yaani, wale walio na juhudi katika kutenda mema.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

kikuyu: Basi wewe fundisha mambo haya. Onya na kukaripia kwa mamlaka yote. Mtu yeyote asikudharau.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

kikuyu: Wakumbushe watu kuwanyenyekea watawala na kuwatii wenye mamlaka, wawe tayari kutenda kila lililo jema.
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

kikuyu: Wasimnenee mtu yeyote mabaya, wasiwe wagomvi, bali wawe wapole, wakionyesha unyenyekevu kwa watu wote.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

kikuyu: Maana sisi wenyewe wakati fulani tulikuwa wajinga, wasiotii, tukiwa watumwa wa tamaa mbaya na anasa za kila aina. Tuliishi katika uovu na wivu, tukichukiwa na kuchukiana sisi kwa sisi.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

kikuyu: Lakini wema na upendo wa Mungu Mwokozi wetu ulipofunuliwa,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

kikuyu: alituokoa, si kwa sababu ya matendo ya haki tuliyotenda, bali kwa sababu ya rehema zake. Alituokoa kwa kutuosha kwa kuzaliwa mara ya pili na kwa kufanywa wapya kwa njia ya Roho Mtakatifu,
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: ambaye Mungu alitumiminia kwa wingi kwa njia ya Yesu Kristo Mwokozi wetu,
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

kikuyu: ili kwamba, tukiisha kuhesabiwa haki kwa neema yake, tupate kuwa warithi tukiwa na tumaini la uzima wa milele.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

kikuyu: Hili ni neno la kuaminiwa. Nami nataka uyasisitize mambo haya, ili wale ambao wamemwamini Mungu wapate kuwa waangalifu kujitoa kwa ajili ya kutenda mema wakati wote. Mambo haya ni mazuri tena ya manufaa kwa kila mtu.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

kikuyu: Lakini jiepushe na maswali ya kipuzi, mambo ya koo, mabishano na ugomvi kuhusu sheria, kwa sababu hayana faida, tena ni ubatili.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

kikuyu: Mtu anayesababisha mafarakano, mwonye mara ya kwanza, kisha mwonye mara ya pili. Baada ya hapo, usihusike naye tena.
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa unajua kwamba mtu kama huyo amepotoka na tena ni mwenye dhambi. Yeye amejihukumu mwenyewe.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

kikuyu: Mara nitakapomtuma Artema au Tikiko kwako, jitahidi kuja unione huko Nikopoli, kwa sababu nimeamua kukaa huko wakati wa majira ya baridi.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

kikuyu: Fanya kila uwezalo uwasafirishe Zena yule mwanasheria na Apolo na uhakikishe kwamba wana kila kitu wanachohitaji katika safari yao.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

kikuyu: Watu wetu hawana budi kujifunza kutenda mema, ili waweze kuyakimu mahitaji ya kila siku, wasije wakaishi maisha yasiyokuwa na matunda.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

kikuyu: Wote walio pamoja nami wanakusalimu. Wasalimu wale wanaotupenda katika imani. Neema iwe nanyi nyote. Amen.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Paulo, mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu, pamoja na Timotheo ndugu yetu: Kwa Filemoni rafiki yetu mpendwa na mtendakazi mwenzetu,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

kikuyu: kwa dada yetu mpendwa Afia, kwa Arkipo askari mwenzetu na kwa kanisa lile likutanalo nyumbani mwako:
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

kikuyu: Neema iwe nanyi na amani itokayo kwa Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu Kristo.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Siku zote ninamshukuru Mungu ninapokukumbuka katika maombi yangu,
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: kwa sababu ninasikia juu ya imani yako katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wako kwa watakatifu wote.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Naomba utiwe nguvu katika kuishuhudia imani yako, ili upate kuwa na ufahamu mkamilifu juu ya kila kitu chema tulicho nacho ndani ya Kristo.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Upendo wako umenifurahisha mno na kunitia moyo, kwa sababu wewe ndugu, umeiburudisha mioyo ya watakatifu.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

kikuyu: Hata hivyo, ingawa katika Kristo ningeweza kuwa na ujasiri na kukuagiza yale yakupasayo kutenda,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

kikuyu: lakini ninakuomba kwa upendo, mimi Paulo, mzee na pia sasa nikiwa mfungwa wa Kristo Yesu,
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: nakuomba kwa ajili ya mwanangu Onesimo, aliyefanyika mwanangu nilipokuwa kwenye minyororo.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

kikuyu: Mwanzoni alikuwa hakufai, lakini sasa anakufaa sana wewe na mimi pia.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

kikuyu: Namtuma kwako, yeye aliye moyo wangu hasa.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

kikuyu: Ningependa nikae naye ili ashike nafasi yako ya kunisaidia wakati huu nikiwa kifungoni kwa ajili ya Injili.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

kikuyu: Lakini sikutaka kufanya lolote bila idhini yako, ili wema wowote uufanyao usiwe wa lazima, bali wa hiari.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

kikuyu: Huenda sababu ya yeye kutengwa nawe kwa kitambo kidogo ni ili uwe naye daima.
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

kikuyu: Si kama mtumwa, bali bora kuliko mtumwa, kama ndugu mpendwa. Yeye ni mpendwa sana kwangu na hata kwako zaidi, yeye kama mwanadamu na kama ndugu katika Bwana.
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

kikuyu: Hivyo kama unanihesabu mimi kuwa mshirika wako, mkaribishe kama vile ungenikaribisha mimi mwenyewe.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

kikuyu: Kama amekukosea lolote au kama unamdai chochote, nidai mimi.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

kikuyu: Ni mimi Paulo, ninayeandika waraka huu kwa mkono wangu mwenyewe. Nitakulipa. Sitaji kwamba nakudai hata nafsi yako.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

kikuyu: Ndugu yangu, natamani nipate faida kwako katika Bwana, uuburudishe moyo wangu katika Kristo.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

kikuyu: Nikiwa na hakika ya utii wako, nakuandikia, nikijua kwamba utafanya hata zaidi ya yale ninayokuomba.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

kikuyu: Jambo moja zaidi: Niandalie chumba cha wageni, kwa kuwa nataraji kurudishwa kwenu kama jibu la maombi yenu.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

kikuyu: Epafra, aliye mfungwa mwenzangu katika Kristo Yesu, anakusalimu.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

kikuyu: Vivyo hivyo Marko, Aristarko, Dema na Luka, watendakazi wenzangu wanakusalimu.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

kikuyu: Neema ya Bwana Yesu Kristo iwe pamoja na roho zenu. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

kikuyu: Zamani Mungu alisema na baba zetu kwa njia ya manabii mara nyingi na kwa njia mbalimbali,
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

kikuyu: lakini katika siku hizi za mwisho anasema nasi kwa njia ya Mwanawe, ambaye amemweka kuwa mrithi wa vitu vyote, na ambaye kupitia kwake aliuumba ulimwengu.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

kikuyu: Mwana ni mngʼao wa utukufu wa Mungu na mfano halisi wa nafsi yake, akivihifadhi vitu vyote kwa neno lake lenye uweza. Akiisha kufanya utakaso kwa ajili ya dhambi, aliketi mkono wa kuume wa Aliye Mkuu huko mbinguni.
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo alifanyika bora kuliko malaika, kama jina alilorithi lilivyo bora kuliko lao.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ni malaika yupi ambaye wakati wowote Mungu alipata kumwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa?” Au tena, “Mimi nitakuwa Baba yake, naye atakuwa Mwanangu?”
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

kikuyu: Tena, Mungu amletapo mzaliwa wake wa kwanza ulimwenguni, anasema, “Malaika wote wa Mungu na wamsujudu.”
english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

kikuyu: Anenapo kuhusu malaika asema, “Huwafanya malaika wake kuwa pepo, watumishi wake kuwa miali ya moto.”
english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

kikuyu: Lakini kwa habari za Mwana asema, “Kiti chako cha enzi, Ee Mungu, kitadumu milele na milele, nayo haki itakuwa fimbo ya utawala ya ufalme wako.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

kikuyu: Umependa haki na kuchukia uovu; kwa hiyo Mungu, Mungu wako, amekuweka juu ya wenzako kwa kukupaka mafuta ya furaha.”
english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

kikuyu: Pia asema, “Hapo mwanzo, Ee Bwana, uliweka misingi ya dunia, nazo mbingu ni kazi ya mikono yako.
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Hizo zitatoweka, lakini wewe utadumu; zote zitachakaa kama vazi.
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

kikuyu: Utazikungʼutakungʼuta kama joho, nazo zitachakaa kama vazi. Lakini wewe hubadiliki, nayo miaka yako haikomi kamwe.”
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

kikuyu: Je, ni kwa malaika yupi ambaye Mungu amepata kumwambia wakati wowote, “Keti mkono wangu wa kuume, hadi nitakapowaweka adui zako chini ya miguu yako”?
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

kikuyu: Je, malaika wote si roho watumikao, waliotumwa kuwahudumia wale watakaourithi wokovu?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, imetupasa kuwa waangalifu sana kuhusu kile tulichosikia, ili tusije tukakiacha.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa kama ujumbe ulionenwa na malaika ulikuwa imara, na kila uasi na kutokutii kulipata adhabu ya haki,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

kikuyu: je, sisi tutapaje kupona kama tusipojali wokovu mkuu namna hii? Wokovu huu, ambao mwanzo ulitangazwa na Bwana, ulithibitishwa kwetu na wale waliomsikia.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

kikuyu: Pia Mungu aliushuhudia kwa ishara, maajabu na kwa miujiza mbalimbali, na karama za Roho Mtakatifu alizozigawa kulingana na mapenzi yake.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

kikuyu: Mungu hakuuweka ulimwengu ujao ambao tunanena habari zake chini ya malaika.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

kikuyu: Lakini kuna mahali mtu fulani ameshuhudia akisema: “Mwanadamu ni kitu gani hata unamfikiria, binadamu ni nani hata unamjali?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Umemfanya chini kidogo kuliko malaika; ukamvika taji ya utukufu na heshima,
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: nawe umeweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu yake.” Kwa kuweka vitu vyote chini yake, Mungu hakuacha kitu chochote ambacho hakukiweka chini ya mwanadamu. Lakini kwa sasa, hatuoni kwamba kila kitu kiko chini yake.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

kikuyu: Lakini twamwona Yesu, aliyefanywa chini kidogo kuliko malaika, sasa akiwa amevikwa taji ya utukufu na heshima kwa sababu alistahimili mauti, ili kwamba kwa neema ya Mungu apate kuonja mauti kwa ajili ya kila mtu.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

kikuyu: Ili kuwaleta wana wengi katika utukufu, ilifaa kwamba Mungu, ambaye ni kwa ajili yake na kupitia kwake kila kitu kimekuwepo, amkamilishe mwanzilishi wa wokovu wao kwa njia ya mateso.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

kikuyu: Yeye awafanyaye watu kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na hao ambao hufanywa watakatifu, wote hutoka katika jamaa moja. Hivyo Yesu haoni aibu kuwaita ndugu zake.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

kikuyu: Yeye husema, “Nitalitangaza jina lako kwa ndugu zangu; mbele ya kusanyiko nitaimba sifa zako.”
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

kikuyu: Tena, “Nitaweka tumaini langu kwake.” Tena anasema, “Niko hapa, pamoja na watoto ambao Mungu amenipa.”
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

kikuyu: Basi kwa kuwa watoto wana nyama na damu, yeye pia alishiriki katika ubinadamu wao, ili kwa kifo chake, apate kumwangamiza huyo mwenye nguvu za mauti, yaani ibilisi,
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

kikuyu: na kuwaweka huru wale waliokuwa utumwani maisha yao yote kwa sababu ya kuogopa mauti.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ni dhahiri kwamba hakuja kusaidia malaika, bali uzao wa Abrahamu.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

kikuyu: Kwa sababu hii ilibidi afanane na ndugu zake kwa kila hali, ili apate kuwa Kuhani Mkuu mwenye huruma na mwaminifu katika kumtumikia Mungu, ili pia apate kufanya upatanisho kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe aliteswa alipojaribiwa, aweza kuwasaidia wale wanaojaribiwa.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo ndugu watakatifu, mnaoshiriki mwito wa mbinguni, mtafakarini Yesu, mtume na Kuhani Mkuu wa ukiri wetu.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

kikuyu: Alikuwa mwaminifu kwa yeye aliyemweka, kama vile Mose alivyokuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

kikuyu: Yesu ameonekana anastahili heshima kubwa kuliko Mose, kama vile mjenzi wa nyumba alivyo wa heshima kubwa kuliko nyumba yenyewe.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa kila nyumba hujengwa na mtu fulani, lakini Mungu ni mjenzi wa kila kitu.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

kikuyu: Basi Mose kama mtumishi alikuwa mwaminifu katika nyumba yote ya Mungu, akishuhudia kwa yale ambayo yangetamkwa baadaye.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

kikuyu: Lakini Kristo ni mwaminifu kama Mwana katika nyumba ya Mungu. Sisi ndio nyumba yake, kama tutashikilia sana ujasiri wetu na tumaini tunalojivunia.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, kama Roho Mtakatifu asemavyo: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

kikuyu: msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu, kama mlivyofanya katika uasi, wakati ule wa kujaribiwa jangwani,
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

kikuyu: ambapo baba zenu walinijaribu na kunipima ingawa kwa miaka arobaini walikuwa wameyaona matendo yangu.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

kikuyu: Hiyo ndiyo sababu nilikasirikia kizazi kile, nami nikasema, ‘Siku zote mioyo yao imepotoka, nao hawajazijua njia zangu.’
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

kikuyu: Hivyo nikatangaza kwa kiapo katika hasira yangu, ‘Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.’ ”
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

kikuyu: Ndugu zangu, angalieni, asiwepo miongoni mwenu mtu mwenye moyo mwovu usioamini, unaojitenga na Mungu aliye hai.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

kikuyu: Lakini mtiane moyo mtu na mwenzake kila siku, maadamu iitwapo Leo, ili asiwepo hata mmoja wenu mwenye kufanywa mgumu kwa udanganyifu wa dhambi.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa tumekuwa washiriki wa Kristo, kama tukishikamana tu kwa uthabiti na tumaini letu la kwanza hadi mwisho.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

kikuyu: Kama ilivyonenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu kama mlivyofanya wakati wa kuasi.”
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

kikuyu: Basi ni nani waliosikia lakini bado wakaasi? Je, si wale wote waliotoka Misri wakiongozwa na Mose?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

kikuyu: Lakini ni nani aliowakasirikia miaka arobaini? Je, si wale waliofanya dhambi ambao miili yao ilianguka jangwani?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Ni nani hao ambao Mungu aliapa kuwa kamwe hawataingia rahani mwake isipokuwa ni wale waliokataa kutii?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

kikuyu: Hivyo tunaona kwamba hawakuweza kuingia kwa sababu ya kutokuamini kwao.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, kwa kuwa bado ahadi ya kuingia rahani iko wazi, tujihadhari ili hata mmoja wenu asije akaikosa.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

kikuyu: Kwa maana sisi pia tumesikia Injili iliyohubiriwa kwetu, kama nao walivyosikia; lakini ujumbe ule waliousikia haukuwa na maana kwao, kwa sababu wale waliousikia hawakuuchanganya na imani.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

kikuyu: Sasa sisi ambao tumeamini tunaingia katika ile raha, kama vile Mungu alivyosema, “Kwa hiyo nikaapa katika hasira yangu, ‘Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.’ ” Lakini kazi yake ilikamilika tangu kuumbwa kwa ulimwengu.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: Kwa maana mahali fulani amezungumza kuhusu siku ya saba, akisema: “Katika siku ya saba Mungu alipumzika kutoka kazi zake zote.”
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

kikuyu: Tena hapo juu asema, “Kamwe hawataingia rahani mwangu.”
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo inabaki kuwa wazi kwa wengine kuingia, nao wale wa kwanza waliopokea Injili walishindwa kuingia kwa sababu ya kutokutii.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo Mungu ameweka siku nyingine, akaiita Leo, akisema kwa kinywa cha Daudi baadaye sana, kwa maneno yaliyotangulia kunenwa: “Leo, kama mkiisikia sauti yake, msiifanye mioyo yenu migumu.”
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

kikuyu: Kwa maana kama Yoshua alikuwa amewapa raha, Mungu hangesema tena baadaye kuhusu siku nyingine.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo basi, imebaki raha ya Sabato kwa ajili ya watu wa Mungu;
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

kikuyu: kwa kuwa kila mmoja aingiaye katika raha ya Mungu pia hupumzika kutoka kazi zake mwenyewe, kama vile Mungu alivyopumzika kutoka kazi zake.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

kikuyu: Basi, na tufanye bidii kuingia katika raha hiyo, ili kwamba asiwepo yeyote atakayeanguka kwa kufuata mfano wao wa kutokutii.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

kikuyu: Kwa maana Neno la Mungu li hai tena lina nguvu. Lina makali kuliko upanga wowote wenye makali kuwili, hivyo linachoma hata kuzigawanya nafsi na roho, viungo na mafuta yaliyo ndani yake; tena li jepesi kuyatambua mawazo na makusudi ya moyo.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

kikuyu: Wala hakuna kiumbe chochote kilichofichika machoni pa Mungu. Kila kitu kimefunuliwa na kiko wazi machoni pake yeye ambaye kwake ni lazima tutatoa hesabu.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa tunaye Kuhani Mkuu kuliko wote ambaye ameingia mbinguni, Yesu Mwana wa Mungu, basi na tushikamane sana kwa uthabiti na ule ukiri wa imani yetu.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa hatuna Kuhani Mkuu asiyeweza kuchukuliana na sisi katika udhaifu wetu, lakini tunaye mmoja ambaye alijaribiwa kwa kila namna, kama vile sisi tujaribiwavyo: lakini yeye hakutenda dhambi.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

kikuyu: Basi na tukikaribie kiti cha rehema kwa ujasiri, ili tupewe rehema na kupata neema ya kutusaidia wakati wa mahitaji.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

kikuyu: Kwa maana kila kuhani mkuu anayechaguliwa miongoni mwa wanadamu anawekwa kuwawakilisha kwa mambo yanayomhusu Mungu, ili apate kutoa matoleo na dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa yeye mwenyewe ni dhaifu, aweza kuwachukulia kwa upole wale wasiojua na kupotoka.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

kikuyu: Hii ndiyo sababu inampasa kutoa dhabihu kwa ajili ya dhambi zake mwenyewe na vivyo hivyo kwa ajili ya dhambi za watu.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

kikuyu: Hakuna anayejitwalia heshima hii mwenyewe; ni lazima aitwe na Mungu, kama vile Aroni alivyoitwa.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

kikuyu: Pia Kristo hakujitwalia utukufu yeye mwenyewe wa kuwa Kuhani Mkuu, bali Mungu alimwambia, “Wewe ni Mwanangu; leo mimi nimekuzaa.”
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

kikuyu: Pia mahali pengine asema, “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Katika siku za maisha ya Yesu hapa duniani, alimtolea maombi na dua pamoja na kulia sana na machozi, yeye awezaye kumwokoa na mauti, naye Mungu akamsikia kwa sababu ya kutii kwake kwa unyenyekevu.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

kikuyu: Ingawa alikuwa Mwana, alijifunza utiifu kutokana na mateso aliyoyapata,
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

kikuyu: na akiisha kukamilishwa, akawa chanzo cha wokovu wa milele kwa wote wanaomtii.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

kikuyu: Naye amewekwa na Mungu kuwa Kuhani Mkuu kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: Tunayo mengi ya kusema kuhusu habari ya ukuhani huu, lakini ni vigumu kuyaeleza, kwa sababu ninyi ni wazito wa kuelewa.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

kikuyu: Kwa hakika, ingawa mpaka wakati huu ingewapasa kuwa walimu, bado mnahitaji mtu wa kuwafundisha tena hatua za awali za kweli ya Neno la Mungu. Mnahitaji maziwa, wala si chakula kigumu!
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

kikuyu: Kwa maana yeyote aishiye kwa kunywa maziwa bado yeye ni mtoto mchanga, hana ujuzi katika mafundisho kuhusu neno la haki.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

kikuyu: Lakini chakula kigumu ni kwa ajili ya watu wazima, ambao kwa kujizoeza wamejifunza kupambanua kati ya mema na mabaya.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo, tukiachana na mafundisho yale ya awali kuhusu Kristo na tukisonga mbele ili tufikie utimilifu, sio kuweka tena msingi wa mafundisho ya kuzitubia kazi zisizo na uhai na imani katika Mungu,
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

kikuyu: mafundisho kuhusu aina za ubatizo, kuwekea watu mikono, ufufuo wa wafu, na hukumu ya milele.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

kikuyu: Mungu akitujalia tutafanya hivyo.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ni vigumu kwa wale ambao wakati fulani walishapata nuru, ambao walishaonja kipawa cha mbinguni, ambao wamekwisha kushiriki katika Roho Mtakatifu,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: ambao wameonja uzuri wa Neno la Mungu na nguvu za wakati ujao,
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

kikuyu: kisha wakianguka, kuwarejesha tena katika toba. Kwa kuwa wanamsulubisha Mwana wa Mungu mara ya pili na kumdhalilisha hadharani, nayo ikawa hasara kwao.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

kikuyu: Ardhi ile ipokeayo mvua inyeshayo juu yake mara kwa mara hutoa mazao yanayowanufaisha wale ambao kwa ajili yao yalimwa, nayo nchi hiyo hupokea baraka kutoka kwa Mungu.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

kikuyu: Lakini ardhi ikizaa miiba na mibaruti, haina thamani na iko hatarini ya kulaaniwa. Mwisho wake ni kuchomwa moto.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

kikuyu: Ingawa tunasema hivi, ndugu zangu wapendwa, kwa upande wenu tuna hakika ya mambo mema zaidi, mambo yale yahusuyo wokovu.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

kikuyu: Mungu si mdhalimu: yeye hataisahau kazi yenu na upendo ule mlioonyesha kwa ajili yake katika kuwahudumia watakatifu na hata sasa mnaendelea kuwahudumia.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

kikuyu: Nasi twataka kila mmoja wenu aonyeshe bidii iyo hiyo ili mpate kujua uhakika kamili wa lile tumaini mpaka mwisho,
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

kikuyu: ili msije mkawa wavivu, bali mpate kuwaiga wale ambao kwa imani na saburi hurithi zile ahadi.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

kikuyu: Mungu alipompa Abrahamu ahadi yake, kwa kuwa hakuwepo mwingine aliyekuwa mkuu kuliko yeye ambaye angeweza kuapa kwa jina lake, aliapa kwa nafsi yake,
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

kikuyu: akisema, “Hakika nitakubariki na kukupa wazao wengi.”
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

kikuyu: Abrahamu naye, baada ya kungoja kwa saburi, alipokea kile kilichoahidiwa.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

kikuyu: Wanadamu huapa kwa yeye aliye mkuu kuwaliko, nacho kiapo hicho huthibitisha kile kilichosemwa na hivyo humaliza mabishano yote.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

kikuyu: Mungu alipotaka kuonyesha kwa udhahiri zaidi ile asili ya kutokubadilika kwa ahadi yake kwa warithi wa ahadi, aliithitibisha kwa kiapo.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

kikuyu: Mungu alifanya hivyo ili kwa vitu viwili visivyobadilika, yaani ahadi yake na kiapo chake, ambavyo kwavyo Mungu hawezi kusema uongo, sisi ambao tumemkimbilia ili tulishike lile tumaini lililowekwa mbele yetu tuwe na faraja thabiti.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

kikuyu: Tunalo tumaini hili kama nanga ya roho iliyo imara na thabiti. Tumaini hili huingia katika sehemu takatifu iliyopo nyuma ya pazia,
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

kikuyu: mahali ambapo Yesu mtangulizi wetu aliingia kwa niaba yetu. Yeye amekuwa Kuhani Mkuu milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa huyu Melkizedeki alikuwa mfalme wa Salemu na kuhani wa Mungu Aliye Juu Sana. Alipokutana na Abrahamu akirudi kutoka kuwashinda hao wafalme, Melkizedeki alimbariki,
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

kikuyu: naye Abrahamu alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya kila kitu. Kwanza, jina hilo Melkizedeki maana yake ni “mfalme wa haki.” Na pia “mfalme wa Salemu” maana yake ni “mfalme wa amani.”
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

kikuyu: Hana Baba wala mama, hana ukoo, hana mwanzo wala mwisho wa siku zake. Kama Mwana wa Mungu, yeye adumu akiwa kuhani milele.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

kikuyu: Tazama jinsi alivyokuwa mkuu: Hata Abrahamu, baba yetu mkuu, alimpa sehemu ya kumi ya nyara zake.
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

kikuyu: Basi sheria inawaagiza wana wa Lawi ambao hufanyika makuhani kupokea sehemu ya kumi kutoka kwa watu ambao ni ndugu zao, ingawa ndugu zao ni wazao wa Abrahamu.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

kikuyu: Huyu Melkizedeki, ingawa hakufuatia ukoo wake kutoka kwa Lawi, lakini alipokea sehemu ya kumi kutoka kwa Abrahamu na kumbariki yeye aliyekuwa na zile ahadi.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

kikuyu: Wala hakuna shaka kwamba mdogo hubarikiwa na aliye mkuu kumliko yeye.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

kikuyu: Kwa upande mmoja, sehemu ya kumi hupokelewa na wale ambao hupatikana na kufa; lakini kwa upande mwingine hupokelewa na yeye ambaye hushuhudiwa kuwa yu hai.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

kikuyu: Mtu anaweza hata kusema kwamba Lawi, ambaye hupokea sehemu ya kumi, alitoa hiyo sehemu ya kumi kupitia kwa Abrahamu,
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

kikuyu: kwa sababu Melkizedeki alipokutana na Abrahamu, Lawi alikuwa bado katika viuno vya baba yake wa zamani.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

kikuyu: Kama ukamilifu ungeweza kupatikana kwa njia ya ukuhani wa Walawi (kwa kuwa katika msingi huo, sheria ilitolewa kwa watu), kwa nini basi imekuwepo haja ya kuja kuhani mwingine: kuhani kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki, wala si kwa mfano wa Aroni?
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa yanapotokea mabadiliko ya ukuhani, pia lazima yawepo mabadiliko ya sheria.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

kikuyu: Yeye ambaye mambo haya yanasemwa alikuwa wa kabila lingine, na hakuna mtu wa kabila hilo aliyewahi kuhudumu katika madhabahu.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

kikuyu: Kwa maana ni dhahiri kwamba Bwana wetu alitoka katika uzao wa Yuda, tena kuhusu kabila hilo Mose hakusema lolote kwa habari za makuhani.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

kikuyu: Tena hayo tuliyosema yako wazi zaidi kama akitokea kuhani mwingine kama Melkizedeki,
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

kikuyu: yeye ambaye amefanyika kuhani si kwa misingi ya sheria kama ilivyokuwa kwa baba zake, bali kwa misingi ya uwezo wa uzima usioharibika.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

kikuyu: Kwa maana imeshuhudiwa kwamba: “Wewe ni kuhani milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki.”
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Kwa upande mmoja, ile amri ya mwanzo isiyofaa na dhaifu imebatilishwa
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

kikuyu: (kwa maana sheria haikufanya kitu chochote kuwa kikamilifu). Kwa upande mwingine, tumeletewa tumaini lililo bora zaidi ambalo linatuleta karibu na Mungu.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

kikuyu: Nalo tumaini hilo halikutolewa pasipo kiapo! Wengine walikuwa makuhani pasipo kiapo chochote,
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

kikuyu: lakini Yesu alifanywa kuhani kwa kiapo wakati Mungu alimwambia: “Bwana ameapa naye hatabadilisha mawazo yake: ‘Wewe ni kuhani milele.’ ”
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

kikuyu: Kwa ajili ya kiapo hiki, Yesu amekuwa mdhamini wa agano lililo bora zaidi.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

kikuyu: Basi pamekuwepo na makuhani wengi wa aina hiyo, kwa kuwa kifo kiliwazuia kuendelea na huduma yao ya ukuhani.
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

kikuyu: Lakini kwa sababu Yesu anaishi milele, anao ukuhani wa kudumu.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

kikuyu: Kwa hiyo anaweza kuwaokoa kabisa wale wanaomjia Mungu kupitia kwake, kwa sababu yeye adumu daima kuomba kwa ajili yao.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

kikuyu: Kwa kuwa ilitupasa tuwe na Kuhani Mkuu wa namna hii, yaani, aliye mtakatifu, asiye na lawama, asiye na dosari, aliyetengwa na wenye dhambi na kuinuliwa juu ya mbingu.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
